They were distinguished from landspeeders by a higher operating altitude and normally higher top speed. Some were also equipped with boosters that enabled them to achieve low planetary orbit for a short time. They were not designed for orbital flight, though they could attain such high altitude that they pushed the boundaries of atmosphere and space.

Agriworld-2079.title: Agriworld-2079/Legends

facts.government: Nomadic (originally), Corporate: M'shinni Rootlines monitored by the Council of the Wise
facts.affiliation: Completely under the control of the M'shinni, Galactic Republic

Agriworld-2079.lead: Agriworld-2079 was a planet located on the spinward edge of the Mid Rim. Originally, it was the ancestral homeworld of a species of primitive nomadic herders. The M'shinn from Genassa later colonized the planet. The newcomers fenced in the nomadic herders, claimed their land, and left the peaceful aliens to figure out how to survive. Since that time, the original names of the inhabitants and their homeworld were lost to history, and the M'shinni imposed their own names instead.

Akrit'tar.title: Akrit'tar/Legends
Akrit'tar.lead: Akrit'tar was an inhospitable, barren and lifeless world of the Calaron sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was an prison world for the safe keeping of political enemies of the Galactic Empire. Of the many residents of Akrit'tar's prisons one of Han Solo's former smuggling associates, Tregga, was sentenced to a life of hard labor after being caught with a smuggled cargo of chak-root. Rogue Squadron pilot Tycho Celchu was also held here after a failed attempt at "brainwashing," on the Lusankya, escaping three months later.

Aida.title: Aida
Aida.lead: Aida was the sparsely-populated primary planet in the Aida system, near Lomabu III on the Mid Rim. Under the Galactic Empire, the world would be overseen by Imperial Governor Io Desnand during the Galactic Civil War. When the Wookiee Chenlambec arrived on Aida requesting help from his fellow Wookiees to trap the bounty hunter Bossk, they quickly assisted in leading him to the Lomabu system.

Akuria II.title: Akuria II

facts.affiliation: Galactic Empire, Alliance to Restore the Republic

Akuria II.lead: Akuria II was an ice planet in the Akuria system of the Outer Rim Territories.

Aikhibba.title: Aikhibba
Aikhibba.lead: Aikhibba was a Mid Rim planet located in the Fei Hu sector. Situated on the Gamor Run hyperspace route, it had become a part of the Galactic Republic by 17,000 BBY, and around that time, it was also a part of the Exploitation Region that was controlled by the Core Worlds–based trading conglomerates known as the Grand Companies. Around the time of the Galactic Empire's reign, the smuggler Lo Khan made a highly profitable smuggling run to Aikhibba, where the crime lord Spadda lived, by delivering them a spice shipment from the royal governor of the Thokosia system.

Alabash.title: Alabash
Alabash.lead: Alabash was a planet on the edge of the Fakir sector. Located in the Alabash system, it was a volcanic planet.

Ailon.title: Ailon/Legends
Ailon.lead: Ailon was a heavily-fortified planet in the Ailon system of the Inner Rim.

Akana.title: Akana

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Metharian Nebula Territories

Akana.lead: Akana was the dry and barren fourth world within the Elrood system, located in the Outer Rim Territories of the galaxy in the Elrood sector. The surface itself only boasted life in the microbial range, although the Professiona Artists Guild maintained an artistic colony in a small, sealed outpost there. Its only satellite, Akanala was a source of inspiration for those artists.

Ahug.title: Ahug
Ahug.lead: Ahug was a planet in Wild Space covered in oceans of molten metal. It was the innermost planet in the Kriekaal system.

Ahlenn.title: Ahlenn
Ahlenn.lead: Ahlenn was a planet in the Ahlenn system. During the Galactic Civil War, a prolonged conflict between Rebel Alliance and Galactic Empire, the Imperial Admiral Kohrin's second fleet bombarded the planet thinking that it was home to an active Rebel base, in retaliation for Luke Skywalker's attack on the Executor-class Star Dreadnought Enforcer at the nearby planet of Bespin. The base was in fact empty, abandoned two months previously.

Agridorn.title: Agridorn
Agridorn.lead: Agridorn was a planet in the Agridorn system of the Colonies region. During the latter days of the Galactic Republic, Agridorn was represented in the Senate by Rhya Taloon, who pledge her world's support to the Republic at the start of the Clone Wars. When the Republic was transformed into the Galactic Empire, Senator Taloon fled into the depth of Coruscant to avoid assassination. Despite her efforts she was discovered to be a member of the Erased and was executed by stormtroopers.

Ahakista.title: Ahakista/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Imperial Remnant, Yuuzhan Vong empire, Fel Empire, Empire-in-exile

Ahakista.lead: Ahakista was a pleasure planet located in the Myto sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Aing-Tii homeworld.title: Aing-Tii homeworld
Aing-Tii homeworld.lead: This planet was the homeworld of the Aing-Tii, a secretive race of aliens with a unique perspective of the Force. Located deep within the Kathol Rift, a volatile area of space in the Outer Rim Territories, its location was a secret to the rest of the galaxy.

Akaan.title: Akaan
Akaan.lead: Akaan was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories' Mandalore sector. Located within the Mandalore system, Akaan occupied the second orbit around the system's star, Mandalore, between the orbits of Nog and Tracyn. A barren world without an atmosphere, Akaan was orbited by two moons. After the Taung forces of Mandalore the First journeyed from Roon to conquer the uninhabited planet that became Mandalore, the newly renamed Mandalorians spread out to conquer the planets of the surrounding system, including Akaan. The world's name came from the Mando'a word akaan, meaning "war".

Aiquin.title: Aiqin 4
Aiquin.lead: Aiqin 4 was a planet located in the Aiqin 4 system, which was found in the Airam sector of the Outer Rim. During the Galactic Civil War, the Rebel Alliance staged an attack in the system to capture the Airam clan leader Ilay, who was attempting a peace settlement with the Empire that would cost the Alliance the planet. When the Rebels succeeded in capturing the clan leader, they were able to repel Imperial forces at Nocto and fortify the sector.

Al'Moab III.title: Al'Moab III
Al'Moab III.lead: Al'Moab III was the third world in the Al'Moab system. A relatively imposing planet, Al'Moab III was mostly covered in deserts. However, that had not prevented the colonization of the land. At the time of the Galactic Civil War, Al'Moab III was mostly populated by Humans who built their cities in its wide barren zones. Those colonists had been there for an undetermined, and yet quite ancient, period of time, and the planet was known for both its archaeological remains and troubled history.

Akiva.title: Akiva

facts.affiliation: Trade Federation, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, New Republic, First Order

Akiva.lead: Akiva was a remote jungle planet in the Outer Rim Territories. The planet was once part of the Confederacy of Independent Systems, who created a large droid construction facility under the planet's surface. After the Clone Wars, the planet fell under the occupation of the Galactic Empire with the Satrapy of Myrra collaborating with its new rulers.

Ahch-To.title: Ahch-To
Ahch-To.lead: Ahch-To , known by many names in ancient legends, was a planet mostly covered in water, with numerous rocky islands blanketed with green trees located in the Unknown Regions. It was the birthplace of the Jedi Order and held the ancient Jedi texts. During the New Republic Era, it served as the home of Jedi Master Luke Skywalker who went into exile seeking the first Jedi Temple after his temple and his Jedi students were destroyed by Kylo Ren.

Akuria.title: Akuria
Akuria.lead: Akuria was an astronomical object located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories, not far from the planet Dantooine, that was a suspected base of rebel operations. Akuria and several other locations were identified in a 3 ABY Imperial Security Bureau report that generated targets for Viper probe droid surveys by cross-referencing areas with a high degree of suspicious activity with the unsettled parts of the galaxy favored by the rebels.

Alderaan.title: Alderaan/Legends

facts.terrain: Modern:, Asteroid field, Historic:, Forests, Plains, Grasslands, Small seas, Mountains
facts.government: Elected monarchy and Alderaanian Parliament (pre-25,053–Cold War), Self-declared monarchy (post-3653–3643 BBY), Constitutional monarchy ( –0 BBY)

Alderaan.lead: Alderaan, located in the Core Worlds, was the second planet in the Alderaan system and the home of many famous heroes, including Leia Organa Solo, Bail Organa, and Ulic Qel-Droma. Renowned galaxy-wide for their planet's unspoiled beauty, refined culture, and commitment to peace, Alderaanians worked with and around the land to preserve as much of the natural surroundings as they could.

Aldraig IV.title: Aldraig IV
Aldraig IV.lead: Aldraig IV was a Core Worlds planet located on the Hydian Way super-hyperroute. Its surface featured forests and a picturesque countryside. During the Alsakan Conflicts, the planet was affiliated with the Galactic Republic's capital world, Coruscant. Tens of millennia later, Aldraig IV was the homeworld of the child prodigy artist Gayla Riemann, who eventually traveled off-world.

Albrae-Don.title: Albrae-Don/Legends
Albrae-Don.lead: Albrae-Don was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Albrae-Don system, a part of the Sern sector in the Southern Core portion of the Colonies. Its surface featured a sea. The Pica Rim Pipeline, an underwater monorail train transit tunnel more than 4,000 kilometers in length, was located on Albrae-Don, as was the settlement of Draeo-Kax.

Alashan.title: Alashan

facts.affiliation: A culture, Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire

Alashan.lead: Alashan was a planet located in Wild Space of the the galaxy.

Aldivy.title: Aldivy

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Imperial Remnant, Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire

Aldivy.lead: Aldivy was an Outer Rim Territories backwater agriworld.

Alba-16.title: Alba-16
Alba-16.lead: Alba-16 was an Outer Rim planet located in the Belsmuth sector. In 44 BBY, the planet was in the midst of a violent civil war. Nuuta, one of the renewed Phindians, was sent to Alba as punishment for fighting against the Syndicat on Phindar. The use of the world as a penal camp was ended by the efforts of Jedi Qui-Gon Jinn and Obi-Wan Kenobi. After the rise of the Empire, the planet had little real Imperial presence, lacking a garrison. Ex-Jedi and fugitive Ferus Olin went to a cantina on Alba-16 following his escape from Dontamo's prison facility.

Albecus.title: Albecus

facts.affiliation: Galactic Empire, Alliance to Restore the Republic

Albecus.lead: Albecus was a planet in the Galactic Core friendly to the Jedi Order during the last years of the Galactic Republic. It was situated close to the world Ralltiir. The planet saw the establishment of a Rebel Alliance safe-house after the Battle of Yavin. The criminal Kikow tried and failed to set up an underworld empire on Albecus during the Galactic Civil War.

Alaris.title: Alaris/Legends

facts.region: Mid Rim, Kashyyyk Region, The Slice
facts.routes: Durkteel Loop, Great Kashyyyk Branch, Nightroad, Randon Run

Alaris.lead: Alaris was a large gas giant located within the Alaris Expanse in the outer arm of the Kashyyyk system, a part of the Mytaranor sector in the Slice portion of the Mid Rim. The planet had eight moons and held the sixth orbital position around the star Kashyyyk.

Alderath.title: Alderath (disambiguation)
Alderath.lead: Alderath may refer to one of the following:

Alee.title: Alee
Alee.lead: Alee was a primarily agricultural world located in the Alee system, a part of Hutt Space in the Slice. It was situated on the Ilosian Spur hyperlane, which connected it to the Tal Nami system as well as the Boz Pity system in the Mid Rim.

Aldereen.title: Aldereen system/Legends
Aldereen.lead: The Aldereen system was located within the Trailing Sectors portion of the Inner Rim. The system was home to the Aldereenian sentient species.

Albata Ing.title: Albata Ing
Albata Ing.lead: Albata Ing was a terrestrial world located in the third position of the Felucia system, a star system located in the Outer Rim Territories' Thanium sector. During the Clone Wars, this area of space was contested over by the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Alderbathe.title: Alderbathe (disambiguation)
Alderbathe.lead: Alderbathe may refer to one of the following:

Alcrue.title: Alcrue
Alcrue.lead: Alcrue was the third planet orbiting the star Sriluur in the Sriluur system. Located in the Tharin sector of the Outer Rim, it was a searing rock.

Aldorus IV.title: Aldorus IV
Aldorus IV.lead: Aldorus IV was a mining planet in the Aldorus system.

Aldorus VI.title: Aldorus VI
Aldorus VI.lead: Aldorus VI was a green gas giant in the Aldorus system.

Aleen Minor.title: Aleen Minor/Legends
Aleen Minor.lead: Aleen Minor, often inaccurately referred to as just Aleen, was a temperate planet located in the Inner Rim Territories. A colony world of the Aleena species, Aleen Minor was often mistaken as the species' homeworld.

Aldo Spachian Comet.title: Aldo Spachian Comet
Aldo Spachian Comet.lead: The Aldo Spachian Comet was a comet captured between the two stars of the Aldo Spachian system. The beauty of the comet was legendary and so spectacular that many pilots risked death by piloting between the stars in order to approach and observe the comet.

Alderaanian graveyard.title: Alderaanian Graveyard
Alderaanian graveyard.lead: The Alderaanian Graveyard, known as the Graveyard of Alderaan to smugglers, was an asteroid field in the Alderaan system created by the destruction of Alderaan. Under the Galactic Empire, the graveyard was held under a blockade until the Empire's defeat at the Battle of Endor. After the battle the Alderaan Flotilla accessed the graveyard, looking for relics of Alderaan in the asteroids. The flotilla, carrying the survivors of Alderaan, was gifted the remains of the Death Star, to build a station in the graveyard.

Alaspin.title: Alaspin
Alaspin.lead: Alaspin was a location where a faintly poisonous variety of wine was produced. It was located in the Alaspin system of the Suolriep sector within the Outer Rim Territories and the Slice, falling within grid square S-8 of the Standard Galactic Grid. By 34 ABY, the sommelier Derla Pidys sold the wine from Alaspin.

Almas.title: Almas

facts.affiliation: New Sith Empire, Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire

Almas.lead: Almas was a terraformed planet in the Cularin system. Its moon, Dorumaa, was a captured satellite, which underwent its own terraforming.

Aleen.title: Aleen/Legends

facts.terrain: Surface:, Rocky mesas and buttes, Desert plains, Isolated forests, Underworld:, Geological and arboreal root caverns, Luminescent vegetation groves

Aleen.lead: Aleen was a planet located in the Mid Rim that contained two unique environs: the surface world inhabited by the Aleena and the Underworld, the domain of the Kindalo.

Almania.title: Almania
Almania.lead: Almania was a cold and windy planet located in the Almanian system in the Outer Rim Territories. It had three moons, Pydyr, Auyemesh, and Drewwa.

Allyuen.title: Allyuen/Legends
Allyuen.lead: Allyuen was a remote mining world in the Allyuen system, located in the Greater Javin of the Outer Rim Territories.

Algarian.title: Algarian
Algarian.lead: Algarian was a planet in the Mid Rim's Dufilvian sector. It was raided by the Galactic Empire, which was attempting to defeat all Alliance support on-planet.

Alluuvia.title: Alluuvia

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Metharian Nebula Territories

Alluuvia.lead: Alluuvia was a planet that was located in the Elrood sector. The mining on the planet conducted by Radell Mining Corporation was overseen by an ecologically-mindful Ithorian.

Alk'Lellish III.title: Alk'Lellish III

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire

Alk'Lellish III.lead: Alk'Lellish III was a planet in the Alk'Lellish system of the Sumitra sector. It was the homeworld of the Lellish, as well as the dangerous carnivore known as the ketrann. Wilek Nereus hunted the ketrann at one point.

Aleron.title: Aleron
Aleron.lead: Aleron was a smog-covered planet in Tapani sector's Freeworlds Territory. It had domed canyon cities and underground cities. Its crust and mantle were rich in valuable minerals and ores. Discovered during the Twelve Kingdoms Era of the Tapani Empire, the world was colonized by Humans from Gilliana. Aleron was the headquarters of Aleron Trade Cooperative, Macander Heavy Ores, and LIN Corporation. With their hold of three major corporations, Aleron was given a voting member of the League of Tapani Freeworlds.

Alliga.title: Alliga

facts.affiliation: Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire

Alliga.lead: Alliga was a planet located in the Outer Rim Territories' Phelleem sector. It was the homeworld of the Holwuff species. As the Separatist Crisis began to threaten galactic unity, Senator Wodrata pledged loyalty to the Confederacy of Independent Systems at Geonosis, days before the outbreak of the Clone Wars. A member of the Separatist Council, Wodrata allowed General Grievous' droid army to use Alliga as a staging area for the Outer Rim Sieges. Shortly before the Siege of Saleucami, Alliga was host to the Separatist Council as they plotted their war games.

Almak.title: Almak/Legends
Almak.lead: Almak was a terrestrial world located in the Almak system, a part of the Mid Rim's Almak sector. It was the homeworld of the sentient Leffingite species and shared its name with the fruit known as the Almakian apple.

Algor.title: Algor

facts.affiliation: Kingdom of Cron, Xim's Empire, Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire

Algor.lead: Algor was a planet in the Algor system of the Tion Cluster famous as a homeworld of pirates, smugglers, and lawyers. The Algorian people were known for their disputatiousness, which became the subject of humor throughout the Tion Cluster. It was the homeworld of Shamus Falconi. Once part of the original Kingdom of Cron, it was absorbed into Xim's Empire before it collapsed in 25,096 BBY, though unlike many worlds in the Tion, the Algorians were not especially proud of their integration into the empire.

Allandor.title: Allandor system/Legends
Allandor.lead: The Allandor system was star system located within the Freeworlds Territory border region of the Tapani sector in the Colonies region of the galaxy, and was situated between the Neona and Sheva systems.

Alisandor.title: Alisandor system/Legends
Alisandor.lead: The Alisandor system was a star system located within the Freeworlds Territory region of the Tapani sector, on the Shapani Bypass.

Algarra II.title: Algarra II
Algarra II.lead: Algarra II was a planet in Algarra system the Outer Rim Territories on which Tord Gamb engaged in confidence schemes, contributing to a 25,000-credit bounty placed on him by the New Republic.

Allanteen Six.title: Allanteen VI/Legends

facts.region: Expansion Region, The Slice, Trailing Sectors
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Corellian Hegemony, Darth Revan's Sith Empire, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Allanteen Six.lead: Allanteen VI, or Allanteen Six, also referred to simply as Allanteen, was a planet in the Allanteen system in the Tynna sector of the Expansion Region. it was the site of the Allanteen Six shipyards.

Alina.title: Alina
Alina.lead: Alina was the fourth planet orbiting the star Teth in the Teth system. Located in the Baxel sector of the Outer Rim Territories, it was a terrestrial world.

Alland.title: Alland
Alland.lead: Alland was a planet located in the Core Worlds. It was situated on Metellos Trade Route.

Algunnis asteroid belt.title: Algunnis asteroid belt
Algunnis asteroid belt.lead: A large asteroid belt orbited the Algunnis binary star in the Algunnis system.

Allst Prime.title: Allst Prime
Allst Prime.lead: Allst Prime was a backwater planet in the Mid Rim Territories where Governor Magé rule over an impoverished population during the Galactic Empire's reign. Between 2 BBY and 1 BBY, the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry was deployed into Allst Prime to destroy the Imperial outpost there. During the battle, the rebel soldier, secretly a bounty hunter, Brand rescued one of her comrades and then joined Captain Micha Evon to incapacitate Magé at her headquarters. Brand then intended to collect the bounty on Evon, but the captain convinced her to stay with the 61st.

Allanteen.title: Allanteen VI
Allanteen.lead: Allanteen VI, or simply Allanteen, was an astronomical object located in the Expansion Region, on the Corellian Run and the Shipwrights' Trace hyperspace routes. It was the site of a shipyard that was a major producer of the Galactic Empire's starships. Rebel agents based around Allanteen VI reported to General Airen Cracken of the Rebel Alliance on the shipyard's production. General Crix Madine considered the shipyard a potential target for a rebel campaign if another campaign, Operation Ringbreaker, was successful.

Alpheridies.title: Alpheridies/Legends

facts.population: Historic (Great Sith War): 1 million, 90% Miraluka, 7% Alpheridian, 3% Other species
facts.government: Oligarchy, Government Council, Twenty three representatives
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Exar Kun's Sith Empire, Darth Revan's Sith Empire, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Alpheridies.lead: Alpheridies was a planet in the Abron system, homeworld of the Alpheridians, and the adopted homeworld of the Miraluka.

Altawar.title: Altawar
Altawar.lead: Altawar was the homeworld of the Corragut species, located in the Altawar system of the Corellian sector.

Altarrn.title: Altarrn

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Imperial Remnant, Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire

Altarrn.lead: Altarrn was a planet located in the Altarrn system within the Glythe sector. It was the homeworld of the rare spidery nightgliders.

Alsakan.title: Alsakan/Legends

facts.affiliation: Infinite Empire, Killiks, Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong Empire, Galactic Federation of Free Alliances

Alsakan.lead: Alsakan was an ecumenopolis world in the Alsakan system in the Core Worlds. A Core Founder on the Perlemian Trade Route, Alsakan was an ancient, wealthy world that had been a major political player for centuries, and was responsible for the seventeen Alsakan Conflicts that had been fought with Coruscant over the nature and shape of the early Galactic Republic.

Altor 14.title: Altor 14

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories; The Slice, The Slice

Altor 14.lead: Altor 14 was a planet in the Zoraster sector, and the homeworld of the Avogwi and Nuiwit. It was subjugated by the Galactic Empire.

Althir III.title: Althir III

facts.affiliation: Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders, Darth Revan's Sith Empire, Zsinj's Empire, Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire

Althir III.lead: Althir III, or Althir, was a remote, independent planet in the Althir system that was located outside of the borders of the Galactic Republic. It had a system of rocky planetary rings.

Altrax.title: Altrax
Altrax.lead: Altrax was a frozen planet, and the eighth planet in the Atrig system. It was incapable of supporting life.

Alorthas.title: Alorthas

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Metharian Nebula Territories

Alorthas.lead: Alorthas was the second planet in the Derilyn system. It was a hot, rocky wasteland that was inundated with signs of technological activity around the time of the Galactic War.

Altair 9.title: Altair 9
Altair 9.lead: Altair 9 was a dark, swampy planet in the Altair system of the Outer Rim Territories.

Alurion.title: Alurion

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories; New Territories, New Territories

Alurion.lead: Alurion was a planet located in the Outer Rim Territories' Raioballo sector. The world was covered in vast tar pits. During the Yuuzhan Vong War, the Raioballo sector lay along the initial invasion path of the Yuuzhan Vong resulting in their conquest of many of the worlds. Cut off from Republic assistance, Alurion sat behind enemy lines until the end of the war.

Altratonne.title: Altratonne
Altratonne.lead: Altratonne was a planet in the Altratonne system, orbiting the star Altratonne Prime.

Altora.title: Altora
Altora.lead: Altora was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Dalonbian sector. It had a warm climate in its southern regions, and plains and savannahs on its surface. Those grasslands were home to the reptilian predators known as altagaks. The creatures hunted herd animals kept by the planet's ranchers, causing the latter to post large bounties on altagak hides.

Altier.title: Altier
Altier.lead: Altier was an astronomical object located in the Altier system, a part of the Altier sector in the Slice portion of the Expansion Region.

Altyr V.title: Altyr V

facts.affiliation: Confederacy of Independent Systems, New Republic, Galactic Federation of Free Alliances, Confederation

Altyr V.lead: Altyr V was the fifth planet in the Altyr system.

Altair 3.title: Altair 3
Altair 3.lead: Altair 3 was a planet in the Altair system.

Alou Belt.title: Alou Belt
Alou Belt.lead: The Alou Belt was an asteroid belt that occupied the second orbital position around the yellow star Baralou within the Baralou system of the Outer Rim Territories' Varada sector.

Aloxor.title: Aloxor/Legends
Aloxor.lead: Aloxor was a planet that applied for Galactic Alliance membership in 44 ABY. It missed being the fourteenth planet to submit the request by eighteen and a half standard seconds.

Altunna.title: Altunna
Altunna.lead: Altunna was a planet that was the source of nectar enjoyed by both Gilad Pellaeon and Feena D'Asta.

Alpinn.title: Alpinn
Alpinn.lead: Alpinn was a planet located in the Outer Rim Territories where Lyra Erso searched for kyber crystals. Alpinn reflected light in realspace due to the remnants of ancient mineral seas. When these seas dried up eons before the Imperial Era, they left extensive areas of sedimentary rock and crystallized elements, which covered much of the planet's primary landmass in white.

Aloxl.title: Aloxl/Legends
Aloxl.lead: Aloxl was a planet located in the Deep Core of the galaxy.

Ambria.title: Ambria/Legends

facts.population: Historic: 1 to 4 at the time of the Great Sith War
facts.affiliation: Old Sith Empire, Order of the Sith Lords, Jedi Order, Galactic Republic

Ambria.lead: Ambria, also referred to as Stenness, was a great ringed world in the Ambria system, located in the Stenness Node of the Inner Rim.

Ammuud.title: Ammuud/Legends

facts.government: Mors, House Glayyd, Reesbon clan, Tikeris clan, Owphrin clan, Melchett clan, Almowri clan, Odoon clan

Ammuud.lead: Ammuud was a planet in the Corporate Sector's Kumasi system that was governed by seven feudal clans, each of which was descended from one of seven colony ships that departed from Thokos around 10,000 BBY. Although Ammuud was settled as a peaceful religious retreat, the seven clans eventually forgot their nonviolent ways and began millennia of constant warfare that racked the world. Around 100 BBY, the seven clan Mors managed to come together and forge a peace, instituting a new code of law called the Code of Ammuud that greatly regulated the planet's previously chaotic society.

Ampliquen.title: Ampliquen
Ampliquen.lead: Ampliquen was a terrestrial planet located in the Outer Rim Territories. Located in the Meridian sector, it was found in one of the Chorios systems known also as Ampliquen.

Alzar.title: Alzar

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Mandalorian Empire, Sith Empire, Brotherhood of Darkness, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Zsinj's Empire …

Alzar.lead: Alzar was a planet located in the Thanium sector of the Outer Rim Territories. The Alzarian homeworld, the world was devastated during the Stenax Massacres of 4 ABY.

Amorris.title: Amorris

facts.affiliation: Cavrilhu Pirates, Galactic Empire, Thrawn's confederation

Amorris.lead: Amorris was a small terrestrial planet located in the Amorris system of the Outer Rim Territories' Quelii sector. It contained the home base of the Cavrilhu Pirates before they abandoned the site in 19 ABY. At one point, a New Republic Intelligence officer was stationed on the planet and reported the activities of the pirates to the New Republic.

Amorphiia.title: Amorphiia

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Amorphiia.lead: Amorphiia was a planet located in the Amorphiia system of the Mid Rim of the galaxy. It was the homeworld of the Amorphiians.

Amrap.title: Amrap
Amrap.lead: Amrap was a planet in the Atrig system. It was a desert planet but was capable of supporting life.

Amthau.title: Amthau
Amthau.lead: Amthau was the third planet in the Genesia system. The surface was dominated by rocky canyons, which spoke of the water which used to run across the planet's surface. This made the terraforming project much easier. When the terraforming was complete, Amthau became a favorite vacation spot for the wealthy inhabitants of the planet Genesia.

Alvor.title: Alvor

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Metharian Nebula Territories

Alvor.lead: Alvor was the fourth planet in the Kidron system. It was a gas giant with thirteen satellites.

Alvorine.title: Alvorine

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Alvorine.lead: Alvorine was a planet located in the Yminis sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Amarin.title: Amarin

facts.affiliation: Livien League, Xim's empire, Jaminere Marches

Amarin.lead: Amarin was an Outer Rim Territories world located in the Tion Cluster's Allied Tion sector. By around 25,130 BBY, it was ruled by the Livien League and was the site of a League victory over the forces of the Kingdom of Cron. Amarin was later part of the empire of the Cronese ruler Xim, who expanded and constructed palaces there and on Argai and Raxus Prime. After Xim's death, Ammarin was part of the Jaminere Marches; over time, it became a busy agriworld despite also preserving the forests from the world's Xim-era service as a hunting reserve.

Amfar.title: Amfar/Legends
Amfar.lead: Amfar was an aquatic vacation planet located in the Inner Rim.

Anantapar.title: Anantapar/Legends

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Western Reaches, Greater Javin
facts.sector: Javin sector (prior to c. 400 BBY), Anoat sector (c. 400 BBY—), Yarith sector (generations after c. 400 BBY)

Anantapar.lead: Anantapar was a tropical Outer Rim Territories waterworld located in the Yarith sector. Situated on the Corellian Trade Spine hyperlane, it had a primitive ecosystem that was based around shellfish and featured relatively small creatures.

Amador.title: Amador
Amador.lead: Amador was a planet located in the Chalenor system of the Expansion Region's Immalia sector, and was orbited by at least one moon named Mayvitch 7. Situated in the Northern Dependencies, Amador lay at the junction of a hyperlane that connected the Coth Fuuras system and the planet Nessem and a second route that linked it to the Drearia system.

Amaltanna.title: Amaltanna/Legends

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories; New Territories, New Territories
facts.affiliation: Argazdan Redoubt, Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems

Amaltanna.lead: Amaltanna was a rocky planet with at least three suns and one moon located in the Outer Rim Territories' Kanz sector.

Amar.title: Amar
Amar.lead: Amar, also known as Amara, was the homeworld of the Amaran species in the Amar system.

Alzaris.title: Alzaris

facts.terrain: Arid plains, Muddy plains, Low reliefs

Alzaris.lead: A small and ingrate planet, Alzaris had a very low population, concentrated around a very small open field which served as a spaceport and some massive greenhouses. The planet is constantly bathed in the reddish light of its dying star.

Amethia Prime.title: Amethia Prime
Amethia Prime.lead: Amethia Prime was a planet located in the galaxy's Inner Rim. It had at least one large ocean which was spotted with volcanoes. During the Age of the Empire, crime lord Big String based his operations on an island fortress there.

Ammon IV.title: Ammon IV
Ammon IV.lead: Ammon IV was a hot, barren planet located in the Ammon system in the Ciutric sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Alzoc.title: Alzoc III
Alzoc.lead: Alzoc III, also known as Alzoc, was a frozen planet located in the Sujimis sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories that was the homeworld of the Talz species. The world was taken over by the Galactic Empire due to its exploitable mineral wealth. The pilot Praz Fateer was described as being the fastest on Alzoc III by a barker aboard the Frander's Bay space station. The Mandalorian bounty hunter Din Djarin was involved in a job on Alzoc III at some point before 9 ABY.

Ando.title: Ando/Legends

facts.terrain: Open saltwater oceans, Swampy islands, Small rocky islands and rocky outeroppings, Rainforests
facts.language: Aqualish/Andoan its and slightly different dialects, Galactic Basic Standard
facts.government: Regional government: First Minister, Imperial Military administration: prefect, later governor
facts.affiliation: Divided ethnic authorities, Aqualish temporary alliance, Galactic Republic (guardianship), Confederacy of Independent Systems (as a sovereign force) …

Ando.lead: Ando was an oceanic planet located in the Ando system of the Mid Rim. It was also the homeworld of the Aqualish species.

Anaxes.title: Anaxes/Legends

facts.affiliation: Azure Imperium, Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Galactic Federation of Free Alliances, Fel Empire, Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire

Anaxes.lead: Anaxes was a fortress world located on the Perlemian Trade Route in the Axum system of the Core Worlds. Known as the "Defender of the Core", for millennia it was the site of the Republic Navy's primary fleet base and War College. It was considered the site of naval power, tradition and prestige by both the Galactic Republic and the Galactic Empire. Anaxes shared its sun, Solis Axum, with Selgon, Grastes, Axum, Urfon, Phlors Rex, Phlors Regina, and Ichium.

Ando Prime.title: Ando Prime/Legends

facts.terrain: Frozen lakes, Frozen rivers, Glaciers, Ice sheets, Mountains
facts.affiliation: Order of Dai Bendu, Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong

Ando Prime.lead: Ando Prime was a planet in the Mid Rim. It was a snow-covered—yet hospitable—planet. It was the third planet in the Ando system.

Andara.title: Andara/Legends
Andara.lead: Andara was the largest planet in the Andaran system, a star system in the Core Worlds.

Andosha II.title: Andosha II

facts.region: Mid Rim, The Slice, Trailing Sectors
facts.affiliation: Spiverelda, Andoan Free Colonies, Galactic Republic

Andosha II.lead: Andosha II was an Aqualish colony world located in the Mid Rim's Lambda sector, on the Corellian Run hyperlane. It was a part of the Andoan Free Colonies, which during the last century of the Galactic Republic struggled against the Aqualish of the planet Ando and the worlds it held influence over. As part of that struggle, the Andoan-affiliated Harch Trench led raids against Andosha II.

Angratha.title: Angratha

facts.affiliation: Ancient Houses of the Senex-Juvex, Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire

Angratha.lead: Angratha was a Mid Rim planet located in the Senex sector.

Anemcoro.title: Anemcoro

facts.affiliation: Galactic Empire, Pentastar Alignment, Imperial Remnant

Anemcoro.lead: Anemcoro was a colony world located in the Anemcoro system of the Outer Rim Territories' Albarrio sector.

Andooweel.title: Andooweel/Legends
Andooweel.lead: Andooweel was an Outer Rim planet in the Andooweel system of the Arkanis sector, located on the Triellus Trade Route.

Andando.title: Andando
Andando.lead: Andando was the innermost planet of the Ando system, a star system located within the Lambda sector of the galaxy's Mid Rim and the Slice region. Ando's sister planet, it orbited the star Ando and had no moons. Andando was ravaged in the aftermath of an Aqualish war several decades after the species discovered space travel. They systematically stripped the planet of its resources and blasted its surface into molten rock, rendering Andando uninhabitable.

Andra.title: Andra
Andra.lead: Andra was a planet in the Carida system. Like all planets in the Carida system, Andra was destroyed when the Jedi apprentice Kyp Durron launched a missile from the Sun Crusher.

Andinri.title: Andinri
Andinri.lead: Andinri was a gas giant in the Carida system, a star system in the Colonies region of the galaxy. Andinri was the sixth and farthest planet in the system from the star Caridan, and Andinri was orbited by twenty moons.

Anic.title: Anic
Anic.lead: Anic was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Anic system, a part of the Xan sector in the Slice portion of the Mid Rim. At some point not long before a point in 2 ABY, the mine survival instructor and Rebel Alliance member Larq Thur perished as part of the Lijarak Mines Incident that took place on Anic.

Anarak IV.title: Anarak IV

facts.affiliation: Mandalore, Sith Empire, Galactic Empire, Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire

Anarak IV.lead: Anarak IV was an Outer Rim planet located in the Anarak system of the Wyl sector.

Ananuru.title: Ananuru
Ananuru.lead: Ananuru was a location in the galaxy where the crime lord Hamnet attempted to bid on an Imperial virus formula from Hakon deVille.

Andowyne.title: Andowyne
Andowyne.lead: Andowyne was a Force-imbued planet located in the Kathol Rift. It was the home planet of the Brownie, Daikini, Nelwyn and possibly midi-chlorian life forms. The planet was forgotten for many years by the galaxy at large, but was later rediscovered by Jedi historians in the Jedi Archives.

Ancathia.title: Ancathia system/Legends
Ancathia.lead: The Ancathia system was located in the Albarrio sector, in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was home to the Ancathian funge-flower plant.

Andalia.title: Andalia system/Legends
Andalia.lead: The Andalia system was located in the Lorelli Reach, an area of the Hapes Cluster in the Slice portion of the Inner Rim. It was connected by the hyperlane known as the Lorell Route to the Lorell and Sennex systems. The Andalia system was the origin point of the article of clothing known as the Andalian cloak as well as the Andalian tapestry.

Andelich.title: Andelich
Andelich.lead: Andelich was a gas giant located in the Honoghr system.

Anaxes asteroid belt.title: Anaxes asteroid belt
Anaxes asteroid belt.lead: The Anaxes asteroid belt, also known as the Anaxes asteroid ring, was an asteroid field located in the Azure sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. It was created when a cataclysmic event destroyed the planet Anaxes after the end of the Clone Wars. One of its asteroids, the planetoid PM-1203, housed Fort Anaxes, an abandoned Galactic Republic military installation that had been located on Anaxes' surface during the Clone Wars.

Andelm IV.title: Andelm IV
Andelm IV.lead: Andelm IV, also known simply as Andelm, was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories. During the Galactic Civil War, the planet was ruled by Jaum, a crime lord.

Anoat.title: Anoat/Legends

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Western Reaches, Greater Javin

Anoat.lead: Anoat was one of three habitable planets in the Anoat system of the Anoat sector, located in the Greater Javin of the Outer Rim. It was located between the Hoth system and the Bespin system.

Annaj.title: Annaj/Legends

facts.sector: Zuma sector, Inner Zuma Region, Moddell sector

Annaj.lead: Annaj, known as Cannij Barr by the Ayrou, was a planet in the Inner Zuma Region and the capital of the Moddell sector.

Antar.title: Antar/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire, Galactic Federation of Free Alliances

Antar.lead: Antar was a gas giant in the Prindaar system, surrounded by six moons, four of which supported life.

Ansion.title: Ansion/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Malarian Alliance, Galactic Empire, Imperial Remnant, Thrawn's confederation, Yuuzhan Vong empire, New Republic, Imperial Remnant

Ansion.lead: Ansion was a grassland planet in the Mid Rim near Vortex and Bilbringi, located on the Namadii Corridor.

Anteevy.title: Anteevy/Legends

facts.affiliation: Mandalorians, Sith Empire, Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Zsinj's Empire, Yuuzhan Vong empire …

Anteevy.lead: Anteevy was a frigid ice world locked in a perpetual winter. Located in the Mid Rim's Esuain sector, the planet orbited a star in the Anteevy system.

Anoth.title: Anoth/Legends
Anoth.lead: Anoth was a planet located in Wild Space. The world was shattered at some point during an unknown cataclysm, but remained largely together due to its gravitational pull.

Ankus.title: Ankus/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Empire, Imperial Remnant, Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire

Ankus.lead: Ankus was a planet on the borders of the Mid Rim near the Unknown Regions.

Antemeridias.title: Antemeridias

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, The Slice, Trans-Hydian
facts.affiliation: Galactic Empire, Moff Tol Getelles, New Republic, Imperial Remnant

Antemeridias.lead: Antemeridias was the capital of the Antemeridian sector. Located in the Outer Rim Territories, it was located along the Perlemian Trade Route.

Antared III.title: Antared III
Antared III.lead: Antared III was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Antared system, a part of the Esstran sector in the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. During the Galactic Civil War, it hosted the hideout of Yesgar, the leader of a group of pirates.

Anobis.title: Anobis
Anobis.lead: Anobis was a terrestrial planet located into the Anobis system of the Bright Jewel sector in the Mid Rim Territories. It was located near Ord Mantell and was primarily known as an agriworld and a mining colony, providing major foodstuffs to the nearby and more distant star systems.

Ank Ki'Shor.title: Ank Ki'Shor

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Greater Tion, Trans-Hydian, The Slice

Ank Ki'Shor.lead: Ank Ki'Shor was a manufacturing world located in the Ank Ki'Shor system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Indrexu sector. Situated within the historical Greater Tion region, it lay on the Perlemian Trade Route super-hyperroute, which connected it to the Estaria and Janodral Mizar systems and served as the boundary between the regions known as the Trans-Hydian and the Slice. The inhabitants of Ank Ki'Shor were not particular as to who they did business with, and during the early years of the Rebel Alliance's existence the world became a key supplier of that organization.

Antipose IX.title: Antipose IX
Antipose IX.lead: Antipose IX was an Outer Rim Territories celestial body located in the Centrality sector. The pleasure yacht Arleen made year-long tours from the Oseon system to Antipose IX and the planet Antipose XII.

Antipose.title: Antipose
Antipose.lead: Antipose was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Centrality sector. It had a single city where the former pirate Raskar set up a system of gladiatorial contests that had a power gem, a rare artifact that Raskar had in his possession, as their ultimate prize. In 0 ABY, the smugglers Han Solo and Chewbacca were tasked by the Rebel Alliance with obtaining a power gem for its disabling effect on starship deflector shields. The pair traveled to the Junkfort Station shadowport to acquire leads, and an agent of Raskar's pointed them to Antipose.

Antamont.title: Antamont
Antamont.lead: Antamont was a nonindustrial, mountainous planet in the Antamont system of the Meridian sector.

Ankori-7.title: Ankori-7
Ankori-7.lead: Ankori-7 was a planet located within the Ankori system of the Expansion Region.

Annamar.title: Annamar

facts.affiliation: Unidentified manufacturing company, Alliance to Restore the Republic

Annamar.lead: Annamar was a planetoid with a breathable atmosphere located within a vast asteroid field.

Annamar asteroid field.title: Annamar asteroid field
Annamar asteroid field.lead: A vast asteroid field lay at some point along the Corellian Trade Spine. At the center of the asteroid field lay the planetoid Annamar. During the Galactic Civil War, elements of the Alliance to Restore the Republic conducted raids on Imperial convoys along the Corellian Trade Spine, striking from within the asteroid field.

Anthan Prime.title: Anthan Prime
Anthan Prime.lead: Anthan Prime, also known as Anthan, was a gas giant located in the Anthan system of the Outer Rim Territories' Braxant sector. It was connected by hyperspace route to the planets Bastion and Bescane. Above the planet floated the Anthan Spire, a city used as a vacation resort for the incredibly rich.

Ankhural.title: Ankhural
Ankhural.lead: Ankhural was a planet in the system of the same name in Hutt Space. It had one city which was protected by a ray shield to hold off giant clouds of dust from the silicon fields. In 3 ABY, the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry took refuge at abandoned podracing track for repairs on its headquarters, the CR90 corvette Thunderstrike.

Annoo.title: Annoo system
Annoo.lead: The Annoo system was a star system in the Tharin sector of the Outer Rim Territories and the Slice in Standard Galactic Grid square S-8. It was connected by a hyperspace route to the Boonta system and the Junkfort Station system.

Aralia.title: Aralia/Legends

facts.terrain: Rocky coasts, Grassy inland steppes, Mountain jungles

Aralia.lead: Aralia was a tiny, semi-tropical world located in the Andron system of the Outer Rim's Antemeridian sector.

Arabanth.title: Arabanth
Arabanth.lead: Arabanth was a planet in the Interior Region of the Hapes Cluster.

Aradian.title: Aradian

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories; Tion Cluster, The Slice
facts.affiliation: Xim's empire, Ancient Union of Desevro & Tion, Kingdom of Barseg, Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire

Aradian.lead: Aradian was the third planet in the Lianna system known for its repulsorlift technology. The planet had an atmosphere mildly poisonous to most aliens, and it was orbited by three moons.

Aram.title: Aram

facts.sector: Brak sector, part of the Aramand Cluster

Aram.lead: Aram was the tropical homeworld of the Aramandi species. Located in the Aramand Cluster in the Brak sector; it was orbited by a lone moon. It possessed a higher than average gravity, which caused the Aramandi to be short and stout.

Anx Minor.title: Anx Minor/Legends
Anx Minor.lead: Anx Minor was an astronomical object located in the Anx Minor system, a part of the Raioballo sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was situated on the hyperlane known as the Veragi Trade Route, which connected it to the Sinsang system as well as the Ord Trasi system in the Relgim sector. Another hyperspace route connected Anx Minor to Gravlex Med, the homeworld of the sentient Anx species that at one point colonized neighboring star systems in the Anx Space region.

Antiquity.title: Antiquity
Antiquity.lead: Antiquity was a Mid Rim planet located in the Senex sector.

Arapia.title: Arapia
Arapia.lead: Arapia was the Kadri'Ra adoptive homeworld. It was located in the Arapia system.

Aphran IV.title: Aphran IV
Aphran IV.lead: Aphran IV was a warm planet in the Inner Rim's Aphran system. Located along the Namadii Corridor, Aphran IV was situated between Bilbringi and Carratos.

Aquaris.title: Aquaris/Legends

facts.language: Historic:, Chuhkyvi, Modern:, Galactic Basic Standard
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Alliance to Restore the Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Aquaris.lead: Aquaris was an inhabited aquatic planet located in the Cvetaen system of the Expansion Region's Sumitra sector. Devoid of any landmasses, the planet was one large ocean.

Anzat.title: Anzat/Legends

facts.region: Mid Rim; The Slice, The Slice
facts.affiliation: Sith Empire, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Greater Maldrood, Imperial Remnant, Yuuzhan Vong empire, Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire

Anzat.lead: Anzat was a legendary Mid Rim world located near the Perlemian Trade Route.

Aquilae.title: Aquilae
Aquilae.lead: Aquilae was an ancient Duros colony planet located along the Hydian Way in the Colonies region.

Arah asteroid belt.title: Arah asteroid belt
Arah asteroid belt.lead: The Arah asteroid belt, also known as the Belt of Arah, was an asteroid belt in the Dreighton Nebula of the Arah system, within the Dantus sector in the Outer Rim.

Apliria.title: Apliria
Apliria.lead: Apliria was a Rebel safe world in Wild Space. Lieutenant Deeve conducted much of the preliminary scouting on the planet during the course of the Galactic Civil War.

Antmuel VI.title: Antmuel VI
Antmuel VI.lead: Antmuel VI was a world that occupied the sixth orbital position within the Antmuel system, a part of the Chopani sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories.

Aquella.title: Aquella
Aquella.lead: Aquella was a Mid Rim world located in the Senex sector. By 3643 BBY, an aristocrat residing on Aquella offered valuable items as dowry to anyone who would marry his cousin. Aquella was colonized by Human settlers at one point; however, the colony was lost by the time the Senex-Juvex region came under the rule of the aristocratic Ancient Houses. The Aquellans, the descendants of the original colonists, were a culture notable for their rituals involving the dyeing and tattooing of young males' bodies.

Antipose XII.title: Antipose XII
Antipose XII.lead: Antipose XII was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Centrality sector. It had violet skies, and its native inhabitants used the word "dubesor" as an insult. The pleasure yacht Arleen made year-long tours from the Oseon system to the celestial body Antipose IX as well as Antipose XII. When the gambler and freighter captain Lando Calrissian at one point used "dubesor" as a pre-designated password, it made him wonder what the natives of Antipose XII were doing that night.

Arami.title: Arami
Arami.lead: Arami was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Galov sector. A part of the area dominated by the Hutt species as well as controlled by the Galactic Empire, Arami was one of three worlds where the Hutt holiday known as Boonta's Eve was celebrated, with the festivities including the Boonta Races.

Apatros.title: Apatros/Legends

facts.affiliation: Outer Rim Oreworks Company, Galactic Republic

Apatros.lead: Apatros was a desolate world in the Apatros system of the Savareen sector, located in the Outer Rim Territories under the jurisdiction of the Galactic Republic. As of 1003 BBY, Apatros fell under the direct control of the Outer Rim Oreworks Company, which maintained a cortosis mine on the planet. Apatros was notable for being the homeworld of Darth Bane, the Dark Lord of the Sith who worked in the cortosis mines for ten years before joining the Sith army during the New Sith Wars.

Anturus.title: Anturus
Anturus.lead: Anturus was a planet located in the Anturus system of the Senex sector, in the Mid Rim of the galaxy. It was the homeworld of House Picutorion.

Antolus I.title: Antolus I
Antolus I.lead: Antolus I was a planet located in the Sarka sector of the Mid Rim.

Arden.title: Arden
Arden.lead: Arden was the fourth planet and the only gas giant in the Bakura system. It was named after Deredith Arden, the founder of Bakura. Arden was orbited by seven moons.

Arda-2.title: Arda II

facts.affiliation: Xim's empire, Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders, Darth Revan's Sith Empire, Neutral, Alliance to Restore the Republic, Zsinj's Empire, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Arda-2.lead: Arda II, also spelled Arda-2, and also known simply as Arda, was an industrial world located in the Arda system, a part of the Back Reach area of the Gordian Reach sector within the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The hyperlane known as the Ardan Cross connected it to the Feldwes and Kalishik systems, and another hyperlane linked it to the Capella system.

Argai.title: Argai

facts.affiliation: Kingdom of Cron, Kingdom of Argai, Xim's empire, Jaminere Marches, Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire

Argai.lead: Argai was a planet located in the Cronese Mandate of the Outer Rim. It was best known for having been the homeworld of the ancient pre-Republic conqueror Xim the Despot, and the first capital of his empire.

Arcan IV.title: Arcan IV

facts.routes: Perlemian Trade Route, Greater Cronese Arc
facts.affiliation: Xer's Empire, Xim's Empire, Kingdom of Cron, Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire

Arcan IV.lead: Arcan IV, sometimes known simply as Arcan, was a planet located within the Tion Cluster of the Outer Rim Territories.

Argavat.title: Argavat
Argavat.lead: Argavat was a planet within the Argavat system, in the Colonies region of the galaxy.

Archae Teuthis.title: Archae Teuthis
Archae Teuthis.lead: Archae Teuthis was the Sulituan homeworld. It was covered in deep oceans and the Sulituans lived in large float-cities built of phrnnoc, a type of coral.

Arcopola.title: Arcopola
Arcopola.lead: Arcopola was a world located in the Arcopola system of the Spadja sector, a part of the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the sister world of the terrestrial planet Gambolla and was the site of the location Greccia. In 2 ABY, the famous jatz musician Fitz Roi gave a rare Outer Rim concert during the Arcopola Baas Music Festival at Arcopola. Later that week, on the date 37:8:14, the Galactic Resorts correspondent Tanda Marelle reported on the concert from Greccia.

Arcadia.title: Arcadia
Arcadia.lead: Arcadia was the volcanic second planet in the Sacorrian system. It was orbited by a single moon.

Arganu.title: Arganu
Arganu.lead: Arganu was a planet in the Tasar system. It was close to the star and the heat and radiation made it uninhabitable. Despite have rich mineral deposits, it was impractical to set up mining operations.

Arda-3.title: Arda III
Arda-3.lead: Arda III was an industrial world located in the Arda system, a part of the Back Reach area of the Gordian Reach sector within the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The hyperlane known as the Ardan Cross connected it to the Feldwes and Kalishik systems, and another hyperlane linked it to the Capella system. The planet was sparsely populated.

Arda-1.title: Arda I
Arda-1.lead: Arda I was a planet located in the Arda system, a part of the Back Reach area of the Gordian Reach sector within the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The hyperlane known as the Ardan Cross connected it to the Feldwes and Kalishik systems, and another hyperlane linked it to the Capella system.

Arcura.title: Arcura
Arcura.lead: Arcura was an Imperial world in the Arcura system. Reina Gale once sought to pull a con job on the planet, but was hindered by AT-ATs.

Arat Fraca.title: Arat Fraca
Arat Fraca.lead: Arat Fraca was a planet located in the Arat Fraca system of the Colonies. The Star Morning suddenly reappeared over Arat Fraca a year after leaving Motexx for Gowdawl. Arat Fraca was two sectors away from Motexx. From Arat Fraca, the Star Morning proceeded to Darepp, where it landed.

Archais.title: Archais
Archais.lead: Archais was a celestial body located in the Archais system. It was situated in the Interior Region, an area of the Hapes Cluster in the Slice portion of the Inner Rim. Archais lay on the Gallinore Reach hyperspace route, which connected it to the Lalmy'ash and Selab systems, and featured seas on its surface.

Argai Minor.title: Argai Minor/Legends
Argai Minor.lead: Argai Minor, also known as Argai, was a Colonies planet located in the Haldeen sector. When the Galactic Republic exploration and colonization vessel Outbound Flight was launchd in 27 BBY, Argai Minor was one of the stops on its shakedown cruise through Republic space.

Ardru.title: Ardru
Ardru.lead: Ardru was a planet located in the Iseno sector of the Inner Rim.

Arbular.title: Arbular
Arbular.lead: Arbular was an astronomical object located in the Arbular system, a part of the Lambda sector in the Slice portion of the Mid Rim. During the Andoan Wars—fought from 57 BBY to 39 BBY between the Spiverelda, the group of worlds colonized by the Aqualish species and being under the influence of the Aqualish homeworld, Ando, and the fifteen Aqualish-settled planets known as the Andoan Free Colonies—the forces of the Spiverelda prevailed over those of the Free Colonies at an engagement at Arbular.

Archenar asteroid field.title: Archenar asteroid field
Archenar asteroid field.lead: The Archenar asteroid field was an asteroid field located in the Mid Rim. During the Cold War between Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire, the Archenar asteroid field was the theater of a battle concluded with a Republic victory.

Arbooine.title: Arbooine/Legends
Arbooine.lead: Arbooine was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories, inhabited by the Sathari species. Quolas was a tree-city on the planet. During the Galactic Civil War, the Galactic Empire believed there were Rebel Alliance bases located among the forest.

Arda.title: Arda
Arda.lead: Arda was an astronomical object located in the Gordian Reach of the regions known as the Outer Rim Territories and New Territories. The celestial body was situated in grid square Q-6 on the Standard Galactic Grid.

Arkania.title: Arkania/Legends

facts.terrain: Canyons, Icy mountains and cliffs, Tundra
facts.affiliation: Old Sith Empire, Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Yuuzhan Vong empire, Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire

Arkania.lead: Arkania was the adopted homeworld of the Arkanian species. It was covered with tundra and rich in diamonds and other precious minerals, which the Arkanians mined to further their offworld connections and master their technology. Arkanian cities were designed to keep the cold out and were mostly completely enclosed. Off-world visitors rarely had to deal with the frigid conditions of the planet. Many citizens were miners.

Aris.title: Aris/Legends
Aris.lead: Aris was a planet in the Albarrio system of the Albarrio sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was a world of rainforests, and home to the monkey-like scavenger known as the Wok-Wok. It served as the sector capital of the Albarrio sector, and was a stop along the Relgim Run. It had no native intelligent life, but had been colonized.

Argovia.title: Argovia
Argovia.lead: Argovia was a planet of stormy, misty, marshy wetlands in the Endocray sector, rich in minerals and ores. It was the location of an Imperial sensor network complex that analyzed data from thousands of sensor buoys, ships, and probe droids in the sector. To protect both the sensor complex and the valuable ore, the mining companies and the Empire mutually restricted any non-personnel from immigrating to the planet.

Argazda.title: Argazda/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Argazda.lead: Argazda was the Argazdan homeworld. Around the time of the Mandalorian Wars, local Provisional Governor Myrial and her followers the Myrialites rebelled against the Galactic Republic, establishing the Argazdan Redoubt. They conquered neighboring worlds throughout the Kanz sector, including Lorrd. These events were known as the Kanz Disorders, lasting from 3970 BBY–3670 BBY. This conflict resulted in the deaths of more than five billion until combined Republic/Jedi efforts under Lorrdian Jedi Master Mari-Elan Nora overthrew the Myrialites.

Aridus.title: Aridus/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Aridus.lead: Aridus was a desert planet in the Expansion Region and the homeworld of the reptilian Chubbit species.

Arorua.title: Arorua
Arorua.lead: Arorua was a jungle planet home to fierce monsters spawned from Sith sorcery, such as the squollyhawlk and the silan.

Argoon.title: Argoon

facts.affiliation: Back Spiral, Tion Hegemony, Galactic Empire

Argoon.lead: Argoon was an Outer Rim planet in the Argoon system, near Pakuuni. It was the site of an Imperial manufacturing facility abandoned after numerous Rebel attacks.

Arodoni.title: Arodoni
Arodoni.lead: Arodoni was a gas giant in the Dathomir system, located in the Quelii sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It occupied the eighth orbital position around the star Domir and was orbited by eighteen moons.

Arjus.title: Arjus
Arjus.lead: Arjus was the first planet in the Desev system. It was a huge gas giant that was orbited by 38 moons.

Armath.title: Armath
Armath.lead: Armath was a terrestrial planet located in the Mikaster sector's Armath system, which was situated in the Trailing Sectors portion of the Expansion Region. In 15 BBY, Ambassador Zell of the planet Majoor went on an important peace mission to Armath, accompanied by a convoy of starships.

Arkanis.title: Arkanis/Legends
Arkanis.lead: Arkanis was the sector capital of the Arkanis sector. It was inhabited by Humans such as Devon Fuller. It was the capital of the Arkanis Regency, which included the ancient Empress Teeda. The planet was part of the Galactic Empire. It was the location of Vensenor Flight Academy.

Aris V.title: Aris V
Aris V.lead: Aris V was a planet in Parmel sector chosen as a possible base of operations for the Laramus Base Irregulars after they left Laramus Base.

Argo-6.title: Argo-6
Argo-6.lead: Argo-6 was a terrestrial astronomical object, the climate of which featured several seasons. All members of a family residing on the celestial body maintained miniature farms in their mouths, which helped provide them with sustenance. The farm in the mouth of one member of the family contained fields of alfalfa, chicken coops, and a complex irrigation system.

Arrakan.title: Arrakan
Arrakan.lead: The indigenous Battrachs maintained a floating harbor at a coral-like island, where starships landed in moored giant bivalves, which then closed their shells and carried the craft to the underwater capital city, Kearleonis. Animals could travel underwater in giant jellyfish. The Battrachs, the bivalves, and the jellyfish were all genetically engineered by the indigenous Duors, who themselves believed they had been made by a millennium-old Leviathan named Kithnarrock.

Arporatal-Lanin.title: Arporatal-Lanin
Arporatal-Lanin.lead: Arporatal-Lanin was a rugged world located in the Arporatal-Lanin system of the Juvex sector, a part of the Senex-Juvex region in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim. A hyperlane connected it to the Thull's Vault system. Arporatal-Lanin's surface featured jagged, tumbled ranges of mountains as well as deep, forested valleys.

Aridka.title: Aridka
Aridka.lead: Aridka was a rocky planet that served as a battleground between Galactic Republic and Separatist forces during the Clone Wars. The planet was covered in abandoned cities, which were surrounded by cliffs and the ruins of temples and obelisks. At least two types of flora grew on the planet, in the crevices of the cliffs as well as in the city.

Argul.title: Argul

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems

Argul.lead: Argul was a planet located in the Mid Rim along the Corellian Trade Spine, near to Cerea and Belsavis.

Arkuda.title: Arkuda
Arkuda.lead: Arkuda was a rocky world located in the Arkuda system. It was situated in the Loop Worlds area of the Gordian Reach sector within the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The hyperlane known as the Junction-Tierell Loop connected Arkuda to the Gulvitch system and the Vallusk Cluster. Starships traveling along the hyperspace route frequently stopped at the Vallusk Cluster to recalibrate their navigation computers prior to making the jump to Arkuda. Arkuda was also linked by the Korphir Trace to the Korphir system.

Arkinnea.title: Arkinnea
Arkinnea.lead: Arkinnea was a planet that was located in the Axion sector in the Expansion Region of space. The planet suffered at the hands of the Separatists and at the end of the Clone Wars, it was overrun with refugees. The local militia was very hostile to refugees, in particular to those that might affiliated with the CIS. Despite promises to said refugees to offer them land on Arkinnea to start their lives anew, the militia systematically murdered many refugees by loading them onto ships, then dumping them out hundreds of feet in the air to their deaths.

Arieli.title: Arieli
Arieli.lead: Arieli was an Expansion Region planet under the Galactic Empire's rule. After a local insurgency sabotaged the Imperial Arquitens-class light cruiser Peacemaker there, the cruiser began firing on the world's municipal buildings. The light freighter Mighty Oak Apocalypse did a supply run to the planet during the Galactic Civil War.

Arzid.title: Arzid
Arzid.lead: Arzid was a planet in the Calaron sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was inhabited by forests of giant macaab mushrooms, tentacle-bushes, and by the dangerous arachnor that feasted on the mushrooms as part of their diet.

Artus Prime.title: Artus Prime
Artus Prime.lead: Artus Prime was a terrestrial planet located in the Artus system of the Kwymar sector in the Outer Rim Territories. The planet primarily served as a mining colony, which was known for its Artusian crystals which could also be used in the construction of lightsabers.

Asation.title: Asation
Asation.lead: Asation was the major port world of the Gree Enclave and was home to the Crafter caste of the Gree.

Ashas Ree.title: Ashas Ree/Legends
Ashas Ree.lead: Ashas Ree was a terrestrial planet in the Ashas Ree system, located in the Sith Worlds region of the Outer Rim Territories' Esstran sector. It was situated deep within the Sith Empire, in which it was considered a lesser world.

Aruza.title: Aruza/Legends
Aruza.lead: Aruza was a planet orbited by five moons of pale shades of tan, silver, and green. The planet was home to the peaceful Aruzans, an even-tempered society that abhorred violence. By 3 ABY, Aruza had not experienced a murder for over one hundred of their years. They were small people with light blue skin and very dark blue hair.

Ashes of Korr.title: Ashes of Korr

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories; Stygian Caldera, Trans-Hydian

Ashes of Korr.lead: The Ashes of Korr were a debris belt at the edge of the Horuset system.

Ash.title: Ash
Ash.lead: Ash was the second planet of the Belgaroth system, located in the Core Worlds of the galaxy. Illuminated by binary stars Matanya A and Matanya B, Ash was a searing world with no moons.

Arro.title: Arro
Arro.lead: Arro was the first planet of the Dathomir system, a part of the Quelii sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories. A hot world made of molten rock, it had no moons and orbited the star Domir.

Asamin.title: Asamin system/Legends
Asamin.lead: The Asamin system was a Mid Rim star system located in the Strabin sector. A notable spice production point, it was where the Human Zayl Braith was born to a wealthy family of merchants. Braith eventually became a smuggler operating in the star system and elsewhere, and, when she later worked as part of a criminal syndicate, she ultimately left the organization after it began working against the interests of her former partners in the Asamin system. A decade later, the system was part of the New Republic.

Asher III.title: Asher III
Asher III.lead: Asher III was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Asher system, a part of the Sprizen sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories. During the Galactic Civil War, the Rebel Alliance maintained a cell on Asher III. When the pilot Delt Nerris, who was sympathetic to the Alliance, hijacked the Corellian Security Force starship Nova Whisper, the vessel was turned over to the Rebels. The Alliance cell on Asher III subsequently used Nova Whisper as a medical transport.

Ashash.title: Ashash
Ashash.lead: Ashash was a waterworld located in the Ashash system, a part of the Zarracina sector in the Trailing Sectors portion of the Expansion Region. It was home to a species of creature that could emit a harmful gas from its body—an aspect in which the creature was similar to the stinkfish of the Outer Rim Territories planet Sedri.

Arthon.title: Arthon/Legends
Arthon.lead: Arthon was a planet located within the Ottega sector of the Mid Rim.

Arramanx.title: Arramanx
Arramanx.lead: Arramanx was an urban world located in the Arramanx system. It was a part of the Cronese Mandate sector of the Tion Cluster, within the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. Arramanx was situated between the Duinarbulon and Pasmin systems on the Greater Cronese Arc hyperlane, while the hyperspace route known as the Kismaano Bypass linked it to the Gadon system.

Arsteni.title: Arsteni
Arsteni.lead: Arsteni is a planet in the Arsteni system.

Arrissa's Field.title: Arrissa's Field
Arrissa's Field.lead: An iron asteroid field in the Naboo system, Arrissa's Field was named after the pirate Arrissa n'Osnyi. Pirates often used the field to launch strikes on passing freighters, hidden within the asteroid field and covered by the nearby Obligon Nebula. Following the rise of Palpatine, Imperial forces patrolled the area in an attempt to keep pirates away for good.

Artorias.title: Artorias
Artorias.lead: Artorias was a peace-loving Outer Rim planet with few defenses. In 25 ABY, during the onset of the Yuuzhan Vong War, the world was invaded and conquered by the eponymous extragalactic race.

Artesia.title: Artesia
Artesia.lead: Artesia was a planet located within the Artesia system, a part of the Hangshan sector in the galactic regions known as the Slice and the Expansion Region. The Artesian space collage art form originated on the planet.

Arrochar.title: Arrochar

facts.affiliation: Alliance to Restore the Republic, Galactic Empire

Arrochar.lead: Arrochar was a planet on the edges of Hutt Space, located near Mon Calamari and ruled by a traditional monarchy. For long time it remained away from the central politics in the Galaxy, being a recluse planet, as the inhabitants would say, private. Around the time of the Battle of Yavin, the royalty of the planet was eager to enter a "Community of Planets" and saw the Rebellion as a way to fulfill its desires, so, in the first year after the battle, the crown prince of Arrochar offered asylum to the Rebel Alliance, in exchange for Princess Leia Organa's hand in marriage.

Artus Five.title: Artus Five
Artus Five.lead: Artus Five was a lifeless gas giant in the Artus system of the Kwymar sector in the Outer Rim Territories. Following the destruction of Dominator, Darth Jadus faked his death and choose the orbit of Artus Five as a place to hide his secret dreadnought.

Arreyel.title: Arreyel

facts.affiliation: Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire

Arreyel.lead: Arreyel was a small blue-and-white planet located in the Arreyel system within the Inner Rim.

Askaj.title: Askaj/Legends
Askaj.lead: Askaj, also called Askaji, was the home planet of the Askajians in the Outer Rim Territories, far off the Rimma Trade Route. The planet had one moon, the Moon Lady, whom the people worshiped as a deity.

Askaji.title: Askaj/Legends
Askaji.lead: Askaj, also called Askaji, was the home planet of the Askajians in the Outer Rim Territories, far off the Rimma Trade Route. The planet had one moon, the Moon Lady, whom the people worshiped as a deity.

Asmeru.title: Asmeru/Legends

facts.terrain: Ice-capped mountain ranges, Arid plateaus, Cultured terraced hillsides
facts.affiliation: Ancient Houses, House Vandron, House Elegin, Nebula Front

Asmeru.lead: Asmeru was a planet in the Senex sector of the Mid Rim, on the border with the Hadar sector.

Ast Kikorie.title: Ast Kikorie/Legends

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories; Inner Zuma Region

Ast Kikorie.lead: Ast Kikorie, also called "Down Below," was a planet in the Moddell sector located in the Outer Rim Territories of the galaxy. It was a Galactic Republic astrocartographic research outpost with a ring of orbiting telescopes connected to Kikorie City by a skyhook. The planet was abandoned by the Republic at the onset of the Clone Wars in 22 BBY.

Athiss.title: Athiss/Legends

facts.affiliation: Old Sith Empire, Reconstituted Sith Empire, Tomb Dwellers

Athiss.lead: Athiss was the second planet in the Loro Babis system of the Outer Rim Territories. It was located on the Descri Wris and was close to Korriz and Ziost. The planet was a Sith sanctuary that held the sanctuary of Vodal Kressh, a powerful Sith Lord and among the most renowned alchemists the Empire had ever known.

Asimuse.title: Asimuse

facts.region: Core Worlds, Northern Dependencies, The Slice, Arrowhead

Asimuse.lead: Asimuse was the fifth planet of the Chandrila system, which was located in the Bormea sector of the Ringali Shell in the Core Worlds. One of three gas giants in the system, the planet orbited the star Chandrila and was itself circled by nine moons. The entirety of the Chandrila system lay on the Perlemian Trade Route, which separated the Northern Dependencies from the Arrowhead portion of the Slice.

Atloran.title: Atloran
Atloran.lead: Atloran was the third planet in the Panto system. It was a barren, lifeless sphere of a world, but nevertheless was known for its zero-gravity campgrounds and amusement parks. There were seven zero-gee camps around the spaceport and they catered to aliens who had special gravity needs or humanoid species who wanted to enjoy the challenge and benefits of no gravity.

Asran.title: Asran system/Legends
Asran.lead: The Asran system was a star system located in the Brak sector within the Expansion Region of the galaxy. It was a source of high-quality prismatic crystals for Lant Mining Corporation. It contained at least three planets which were sites of LMC mining operations.

Atapap I.title: Atapap I
Atapap I.lead: Atapap I was part of the Atapap system in the Inner Rim. At the dawn of the Old Republic, centuries before the rise of the Galactic Empire, it was, along with Fadden and Aquilae, settled by colonists of the Duros species, which was native to the Core Worlds planet Duro.

Ather.title: Ather
Ather.lead: Ather was a manufacturing world located in the Ather system, a part of the Atravis sector in the Western Reaches portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The distance between Ather and the Tamarin sector's Dravian Starport could be traversed in two days using a starship equipped with a Class 1 hyperdrive.

Asrat.title: Asrat
Asrat.lead: Asrat was a planet where the Holy Children of Asrat were worshiped. The Children opposed the New Order and were targeted for assassination by the Galactic Empire. Dengar left service as an Imperial assassin rather than kill the Children.

Asmall.title: Asmall
Asmall.lead: Asmall was an astronomical object in the Inner Rim. By 7 ABY, this important manufacturing center was allied with the New Republic, who had established a defense net around it; the thief Tord Gamb stole information about the net, making him a fugitive wanted by New Republic Intelligence.

Ashkas-kov.title: Ashkas-kov
Ashkas-kov.lead: Ashkas-kov was a planet in Shelsha sector. It was situated along a minor trade hyperroute.

Atchorb.title: Atchorb
Atchorb.lead: Atchorb was a world located in the Atchorb system of the Corporate Sector, a part of the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The hyperlane known as the Shaltin Tunnels linked Atchorb to the D'ian and Ulicia systems, while the Authority Guardian Corridor connected it to the Hiit and Tothis systems.

Asuin.title: Asuin
Asuin.lead: Asuin was a frost-covered planet located in Hutt Space that was populated by wampas. While the surface was besieged by icestorms, there were underground caverns filled with lava.

Atoa.title: Atoa/Legends
Atoa.lead: Atoa was a little-known ice planet in the Atoan system, in the Ghost Nebula. It was the homeworld of the near-Human Atoans.

Atoan tar-pit planet.title: Atoan tar-pit planet
Atoan tar-pit planet.lead: A planet located in the Atoan system, in the Ghost Nebula, was covered by tar pits generating oceans of boiling tar. It was inhabited by Atoans from the neighboring planet of Atoa.

Atoan crystal planet.title: Atoan crystal planet
Atoan crystal planet.lead: This planet located in the Atoan system, in the Ghost Nebula, was covered by crystals. It was inhabited by Atoans from the neighboring planet Atoa.

Assorhan.title: Assorhan
Assorhan.lead: Assorhan was the homeworld of the Assorhian species.

Atollon.title: Atollon

facts.terrain: Historic, Ancient seas, Modern, Caverns, Coral formations, Rocks, Deserts, Mesas

Atollon.lead: Atollon was a remote planet in the Lothal sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was known to the ancient peoples of the sector and was depicted in their artwork. The only known inhabitant was the Bendu, a mysterious Force wielder. In the third year before the Battle of Yavin, the rebels of Phoenix Cell established a base there after receiving intel from rebel astromech Chopper and AP-5, an inventory droid formerly in service to the Empire.

Athulla.title: Athulla
Athulla.lead: Athulla was a planet located in the Jinata system in the Core Worlds.

Ator.title: Ator/Legends
Ator.lead: Ator was a Core Worlds planet located just inside the Horizon boundary of the Deep Core that featured urban terrain. Around 4200 BBY, pilgrims from Ator colonized the Outer Rim Territories world Arkanis, which eventually became the capital of the small Arkanis Regency empire. Millennia later, the moisture farmer Cliegg Lars left his family's homestead on the planet Tatooine and settled on Ator. There, Cliegg married Aika and had a son, Owen, but after Aika's unexpected death, Cliegg returned to Tatooine with Owen.

Aurea.title: Aurea

facts.terrain: Temperate and tropical forests, Desert plains, Mountains, Oceans

Aurea.lead: Aurea was a planet, located in the Aurea system, well known for its expert artisans, gathered in the Aurean Glassworkers Guild. The skilled glass workers of the planet were known to make objects of outstanding beauty; luxury vessels that were considered nearly priceless. Further, if one of the vessels was broken, they were known to recreate the object with an even greater beauty than before.

Atrisia.title: Atrisia/Legends

facts.region: Core Worlds, Core Worlds Security Zone (137 ABY), Southern Core
facts.affiliation: Atrisian Empire, Atrisian Commonwealth, Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire

Atrisia.lead: Atrisia, also known as Kitel Phard, was a terrestrial planet located in the Core Worlds sector known as the Atrisian Commonwealth. It lay on the Giju Run hyperlane and was the homeworld of the creature known as the shredder bat. Locations on the planet included the city of Jar'Kai and the Atrisian Imperial Historical Library.

Atrivis 7.title: Atrivis 7
