Atrivis 7.lead: Atrivis 7 was a planet in the Atrivis sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Populated by Humans, it experienced some domestic conflicts known as range wars. Atrivis 7 was the homeworld of Sheeka Tull, who eventually became a resistance fighter with the guerrilla group Desert Wind located on Ord Cestus during the Clone Wars.

Atzerri.title: Atzerri/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire, Galactic Federation of Free Alliances, Confederation

Atzerri.lead: Atzerri was a tradeworld in the Inner Rim, near the Hydian Way. This planet was a member of the Association of Free Trade Worlds and only had as much government as necessary to stave off total chaos.

Atraken.title: Atraken/Legends

facts.terrain: Caves, Craters, Mountainous, Oceans (prior to the Clone Wars); poisonous water (following the Battle of Atraken)
facts.affiliation: Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Republic

Atraken.lead: Atraken was a doonium rich planet conquered by the Confederacy of Independent Systems. The Galactic Republic tried to liberate it in 22 BBY and were only successful through a series of strikes called Operation Katabatic nearly a year later. The Separatists engaged in a "poisoned well" policy, releasing a biochemical plague into the planet's water table that killed 90% of the population. The survivors mostly relocated to Trilos, if not to other neighboring worlds. Thrynka Padaunete blamed the disaster on the Jedi.

Attahox.title: Attahox/Legends

facts.affiliation: Sith Empire (Great Sith War), Torgaigne, Confederacy of Independent Systems

Attahox.lead: Attahox was a world in the Expansion Region near Daalang.

Atterol.title: Atterol
Atterol.lead: Atterol was a celestial body in the Atterol system. It was near Atterol that the Battle of Atterol took place during the Galactic Civil War.

Atrivis.title: Atrivis
Atrivis.lead: Atrivis was a planet in the Generis system located in the Outer Rim sector of the same name. Homack, a starfighter pilot for the Alliance to Restore the Republic, was shot down over the planet and pursued by Imperial Storm commandos.

Aaron.title: Auren
Aaron.lead: Auren was a moon of Ingo, located within the Ingo system of the Mid Rim. It was home to a facility operated by the Fromm Gang, a crime family headquartered on the planet Annoo. The multi-level facility was involved in mining, research, and other activities. The droids C-3PO and R2-D2 were imprisoned in the complex, but they escaped and made their way to a higher story, where Thall Joben and Jord Dusat rescued them.

Atorra.title: Atorra
Atorra.lead: Atorra was a planet located in the Atorra system. It was situated in the Back Reach area of the Gordian Reach sector, within the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The planet was connected by the Ardan Cross hyperlane to the Troos and the Chenowei systems.

Aurimaus.title: Aurimaus
Aurimaus.lead: Aurimaus was an astronomical object located in Wild Space's Aurimaus system. At some point during the Galactic Civil War, the Galactic Empire's Tempest Force unit, which included stormtrooper Hume Tarl, participated in a military operation at Aurimaus.

Aur IX.title: Aur IX
Aur IX.lead: Aur IX was a spherical diamond the size of a terrestrial world. It occupied the ninth orbital position in the Colonies' Aur system. The diamond was believed to have at some point formed the core of a gas giant–type planet, and the creation of the free-floating sphere was widely attributed to members of the Celestial species, which had disappeared from the galaxy by 30,000 BBY. Aur IX, Aur X—a similar spherical object in the Aur system's tenth orbit—and the cloud of diamond fragments occupying the eleventh orbit were collectively known as the Aur Diamonds.

Aur X.title: Aur X
Aur X.lead: Aur X was a planet located in the Aur system near the Colonies planet Phu. The planet occupied the tenth orbital position within its star system and consisted of a giant diamond the size of a terrestrial world. It was believed that Aur X, as well as Aur IX another diamond planet in the same system, were originally the cores of gas giants. Along with the cloud of diamond fragments that occupied the eleventh orbital position in the Aur system, the planets were collectively known as the Aur Diamonds, and thought to have been creations of the ancient Celestial species.

Kitel Phard.title: Atrisia
Kitel Phard.lead: Atrisia, also known as Kitel Phard, was a Core Worlds celestial body featuring brush on its surface. Atrisian mythology included the demigod Wapoe, and at some point, the celestial body was ruled over by the Atrisian Emperors. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, Atrisia was the site of the Royal Academy of Arts, in which the aristocrat Resinu Santhe-Caltra was at one point enrolled. The human Calum Gram worked as a search and rescue pilot for the Wilderness Preserve service on Atrisia.

Auratera.title: Auratera/Legends

facts.population: 500,000 (historic):, 55% Human, 10% Twi'lek, 10% Duros, 10% Ithorian, 5% Iktotchi, 10% Other, 5 million (historic)

Auratera.lead: Auratera was a terrestrial planet located in the Outer Rim Territories located in one of the oldest settled areas of the civilized galaxy.

Atravis.title: Atravis system
Atravis.lead: The Atravis system was located in the Atravis sector of the Outer Rim Territories and the Western Reaches. It was also situated in the grid square L-19 of the Standard Galactic Grid. The super-hyperroute known as the Hydian Way connected the Atravis system to the Rutan and Shumavar systems.

Atterra Bravo.title: Atterra Bravo
Atterra Bravo.lead: Atterra Bravo was a planet located in the Atterra system within the Outer Rim Territories. The Firestone Islands were located on Atterra Bravo. It had a sister planet named Atterra Alpha and both were surrounded by a thick asteroid belt.

Atterra Primo.title: Atterra Primo
Atterra Primo.lead: Atterra Primo was a gas giant located in the Atterra system within the Outer Rim Territories.

Atterra Alpha.title: Atterra Alpha
Atterra Alpha.lead: Atterra Alpha was a planet located in the Atterra system within the Outer Rim Territories that was controlled by the First Order

Axum.title: Axum

facts.affiliation: Infinite Empire, Azure Imperium, Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Axum.lead: Axum was a temperate world located in the Axum system. It had two moons.

Axxila.title: Axxila/Legends

facts.routes: Axxila–Tangrene hyperlane, Celanon Spur, Spurs of Celanon
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Darth Revan's Sith Empire, Brotherhood of Darkness, Ciutric Hegemony, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Zsinj's Empire …

Axxila.lead: Axxila was a planet in the D'Astan sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Azameen.title: Azameen
Azameen.lead: Azameen was the fourth planet from the star Zug in the Zug system. It was an arid terrestrial world that had two natural satellites and was the last planet before the asteroid belt of its star system.

Avirandel.title: Avirandel
Avirandel.lead: Avirandel was a barren, rocky planet in the Alderaan system. It had one moon.

Avishan.title: Avishan
Avishan.lead: Avishan was a frigid planet in the Alderaan system.

Azbrian.title: Azbrian
Azbrian.lead: Azbrian was an agricultural world of sweeping plains and grasslands, dotted with farms that raised the eight-legged herd animals known as dray beasts. One such farm was owned by Condren Foreck, a potential suitor to Lando Calrissian., It played a minor part in the Yuuzhan Vong War as a base for the New Republic/Galactic Alliance. After the war the Galactic Alliance abandoned the base. It was never a part of the Alliance until after the war. The Prime Minister of the planet decided to join the Alliance, so he sent two senators to Coruscant to the Galactic Alliance Senate.

Azure.title: Azure/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems

Azure.lead: Azure was a diminutive blue Mid Rim world at a non-strategic location where most of the landmass was taken up by a clandestine Galactic Republic spaceport. The planet was part of a Azure system and had no moons nor any useful resources. It was commanded by General Solomahal until conquered by the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.

Avon.title: Avon

facts.region: Mid Rim, The Slice, Trailing Sectors

Avon.lead: Avon was a planet in the same system as Radnor. Its inhabitants were the Avoni. Avon was, for the most part, distrusted by the Radnorans. In the years following the Battle of Naboo, Avon sent a fleet of warships to invade and occupy Radnor, in revenge for the Radnorans not selling them a deadly new bioweapon that they developed. However, with intervention from the Jedi, their attempts were short-lived.

Aztubek.title: Aztubek/Legends

facts.sector: Greater Javin, Javin sector, Mugaari Space

Aztubek.lead: Aztubek was a wealthy but little-developed planet lying along the Corellian Trade Spine in the Javin sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was originally one of the eleven member worlds of Mugaari Space prior to Galactic Republic intervention, which reshaped the region's power structure. Aztubek became home to many corporate complexes, catering to workers who commuted from neighboring Javin, the sector capital.

Azna.title: Azna
Azna.lead: Azna was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Demetras sector. During the Galactic Civil War, it served as a stopping point in the popular interstellar race known as the Dahvil-Fodro Hyperspace Promenade, and the event drew many spectators there despite the racing being illegal in the Azna system. As part of one such event, racer and undercover Rebel Alliance agent Siro Simito and his rival Seeg both visited Azna, where the former punched the latter in the face.

Axtria.title: Axtria
Axtria.lead: Axtria was a planet located in the Axtria system within the Core Worlds. It had a toxic atmosphere in which Humans required a breath mask.

Averill.title: Averill
Averill.lead: Averill was a mining world in the Averill system where the Galactic Empire discovered a rich quadrenium lode beneath the crust; quadrenium was refined for starship construction. The native Humans were originally divided into autonomous mine-clans dwelling in inherited mineholds. After the Empire nationalized the local mining operations, a preventable mining accident crippled Selby Jarrad's father. Selby and her cousin failed to create a resistance cell on the planet, so Selby joined New Republic Intelligence.

B'Knos.title: B'Knos
B'Knos.lead: B'Knos was an asteroid mining colony located within the Abran asteroid belt in the Abran system. The system was sometimes called the B'Knos system after this colony.

Axion.title: Axion

facts.affiliation: Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire

Axion.lead: Axion was a Human colony planet purchased by the Colicoids prior to the Clone Wars. It was then that it became a research and development center for the Confederacy of Independent Systems. The Battle of Axion took place there in 22 BBY, four months after the First Battle of Geonosis. Years later, pirate Reginald Barkbone escaped the Imperial Royal Guards by flying away in the midst of the destruction caused by a limpet mine he had attached to a power droid.

Aylayl.title: Aylayl
Aylayl.lead: Aylayl was a verdant planet that was located within the Aylayl system of the galaxy's Hutt Space region and lay on the hyperlane called the Hollastin Run, which connected it to the worlds of Hollastin and Tsyk.

Austan Asteroid Cluster.title: Austan Asteroid Cluster
Austan Asteroid Cluster.lead: The Austan Asteroid Cluster was an asteroid belt located in the Arkanis sector. It was the site of mining operations and resorts. During the Clone Wars, it was the site of a skirmish between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Avenelle.title: Avenelle

facts.region: Mid Rim, Kashyyyk Region, The Slice

Avenelle.lead: Avenelle was a planet in the Lantillian sector. It was a luxurious world known as a place to rest while traveling along the Lesser Lantillian Route or for retirement.

Avidich.title: Avidich/Legends
Avidich.lead: Avidich was a planet located in the Avidich system in the Unknown Regions within the core territory of the Chiss Ascendancy. It was located on the Vagaari Corridor, a hyperlane that ran through the Unknown Regions. Avidich was a mountainous world with peaks that were considered impressive. The planet was used by the Chiss species to cultivate edible lichens.

Ayceezee.title: Ayceezee
Ayceezee.lead: Ayceezee was an inhabited world in the galaxy with rolling walkways and a university as of 44 ABY. Former Wraith Squadron member Voort saBinring retired there as a mathematics professor until re-recruited by Garik Loran in 44 ABY.

Avernio Three.title: Avernio Three
Avernio Three.lead: Avernio Three was a world located in the galaxy. At some point before roughly 6000 BBY, the planet was chosen by the unidentified Iokath species as one of the testing sites for their weapons and Avernio Three's unique civilization was assaulted with the destructive force of Iokath weaponry.

Bakura.title: Bakura/Legends

facts.terrain: Forests, Plains, Mountains, Small seas, Rivers, Valleys
facts.affiliation: Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Alliance of Free Planets, New Republic, Galactic Federation of Free Alliances

Bakura.lead: Bakura, known in Ssi-ruuvi as Xwhee, was a rich, green and blue planet in the Bakura system of the Shiritoku Spur, located in Wild Space, and was the homeworld of the indigenous Kurtzen and isolated human colonizers known as Bakurans. The native language of Kurtzen was spoken alongside Basic.

Bakarr.title: Bakarr
Bakarr.lead: Bakarr was a frozen planet in the Katorrs system. It was the third planet from its sun.

Bak.title: Bak
Bak.lead: Bak was the airless, rocky first planet in the Bakura system. It was covered with rivers of lava and nearly molten rock.

Bakura-5.title: Bakura-5
Bakura-5.lead: Bakura-5, also known simply as Planet 5, was a barren planet in the Bakura system.

Bacrana.title: Bacrana/Legends
Bacrana.lead: Bacrana was the sector capital of Brak sector at the height of the New Order.

Bakura-6.title: Bakura-6
Bakura-6.lead: Bakura-6, also known simply as Planet 6, was a barren, ice-covered planet in the Bakura system. It was the site of a small Bakuran colony that was destroyed by the Ssi-ruuk during the battle of Bakura.

Bala.title: Bala
Bala.lead: Bala, a ball of searing rock, was the innermost planet of the Aramand system. Despite its inhospitable environment, the Aramandi managed to establish a colony on the surface of the planet.

Bakura-7.title: Bakura-7
Bakura-7.lead: Bakura-7, also simply known as Planet 7, was the seventh planet of the Bakura system.

Bakura-8.title: Bakura-8
Bakura-8.lead: Bakura-8, also known simply as Planet 8, was the eighth planet of the Bakura system. It was an ice planet.

Ba'Har.title: Ba'Har

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Metharian Nebula Territories

Ba'Har.lead: Ba'Har was a planet located within the Coyn system of the Outer Rim Territories. The name "Ba'Har" meant "Battle Blade" in the Coynite language. Ba'Har was a multicolored gas giant with a small band of rings, the remains of a moon torn apart by gravitational stresses.

BABYgnon.title: BABYgnon
BABYgnon.lead: BABYgnon, alternatively known as Babygnon, was a gas giant–type planet that had eight moons and occupied the fifth orbital position around its sun, Domir, in the Dathomir system, a part of the Quelii sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories.

Bakkah.title: Bakkah
Bakkah.lead: Bakkah was a desert planet located in the Bakkah system, in the Thrasybule sector of the Outer Rim.

Baffop.title: Baffop
Baffop.lead: Baffop was a planet located in the Baffop system, a part of the Tamarin sector in the Outer Rim Territories. In 32 BBY, the Human male Anselm was born at Baffop. At some point before the Battle of Yavin, the forces of the Galactic Empire ravaged Baffop, leading to extensive civilian casualties. After witnessing the devastation of his homeworld, Anselm became a member of the Rebel Alliance, which opposed the Empire. By the time of Imperial Grand Admiral Thrawn's campaign against the New Republic in 9 ABY, Baffop was situated in space either conquered by or allied with Thrawn's confederation.

Babbadod.title: Babbadod
Babbadod.lead: Babbadod was a colony world of the Inner Rim located on the Hydian Way between the planet Chardaan and the Itani Nebula. In the early years of the New Republic, the planet Babbadod was visited by the Koqus liner Star Morning, which was owned by the fleeing Fallanassi religious order.

Babali.title: Babali
Babali.lead: Babali was a tropical planet with an Obroan Institute research base headed by Kroddok Stopa until his death on Brath Qella.

Bal'demnic.title: Bal'demnic/Legends

facts.terrain: Vast azure oceans, Rocky tropical islands

Bal'demnic.lead: Bal'demnic was an ocean planet adorned with rocky tropical islands in the Bak'rofsen system of the Auril sector, located within the Outer Rim Territories. The hostility of its native Kon'me species, together with its extremely harsh climate, discouraged most people from ever visiting the planet, despite the beauty of its giant rock cliffs, pristine beaches, and vast azure oceans. It was mostly of interest to cartographers, xenobiologists, and fisherfolk, until knowledge of the planet's rich deposits of cortosis ore fell into the hands of Sith Lords Darth Tenebrous and Darth Plagueis.

B-Foroon.title: B-Foroon
B-Foroon.lead: B-Foroon was a mucky world located in the B-Foroon system, a part of the Arkanis sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was situated on the Triellus Trade Route hyperlane, which linked it to the A-Foroon and C-Foroon systems.

B'nish.title: B'nish
B'nish.lead: B'nish was a planet in the galaxy. The Human girl First was held there as a slave until her escape around 41.5 ABY. The B'nishi were native to the world.

B'trilla.title: B'trilla
B'trilla.lead: B'trilla was a foggy world located in the B'trilla system. It was situated in the Back Reach area of the Gordian Reach sector within the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The hyperlane known as the Ardan Cross connected it to the Chenowei and Feena systems. B'trilla was the homeworld of the sentient B'trillan species and was heavily populated.

B'ankora homeworld.title: B'ankora homeworld
B'ankora homeworld.lead: The homeworld of the B'ankora species was a planet in the galaxy. At some point before around 1300 BBY, the planet suffered a cataclysmic collision with a meteor. In response the surviving B'ankora were given a piece of grass land on the Galactic Republic's capital Coruscant and were ultimately granted the land by by Supreme Chancellor Chasen Piian to use in perpetuity so they could resume their sedentary lifestyle with humble homes, fields, and trails, which became known as the B'ankor Refuge.

Balmorra.title: Balmorra/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Sith Empire, Rift Alliance, Trade Federation, Techno Union, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, New Republic …

Balmorra.lead: Balmorra was a factory world that was located within the Balmorra system, situated in a strategic position between the Colonies and the border of the Core Worlds. Due to its intense industrial manufacturing, it was known as one of the most important foundry worlds in the Republic's space, where some of the most advanced weaponry and battle droids were constantly produced throughout most of the planet's history.

Bandomeer.title: Bandomeer/Legends

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, New Territories, Trans-Hydian
facts.population: 718 million:, 60% Human, 20% Meerians, 10% Arcona, 5% Imbats, 3% Phindians, 2% other
facts.language: Galactic Basic Standard, Meerian language, Ithorese
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Zsinj's Empire, Imperial Remnant, Yuuzhan Vong empire, Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire

Bandomeer.lead: Bandomeer was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories, on the Braxant Run. It was known for its high concentration of ionite, as well as the many predators lurking in its wildernesses. The planet's surface was roughly divided in half by a huge landmass and the Great Sea of Bandomeer.

Balfron.title: Balfron/Legends
Balfron.lead: Balfron was a small terrestrial planet located in the Dolomar sector in the Core Worlds of the galaxy. It had several casinos where planets could be won or lost in a game of sabacc, including The High Stakes Casino, where Han Solo arranged for Lando Calrissian to meet the Tonnika sisters as part of an elaborate prank.

Balamak.title: Balamak/Legends

facts.affiliation: Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Greater Maldrood

Balamak.lead: Balamak was an important agriworld located in the Mid Rim's Taldot sector on the Great Kashyyyk Branch hyperlane. During the early stages of the Clone Wars, Balamak lay in space controlled by the Confederacy of Independent Systems. A Confederate flotilla containing the experimental CIS Jammer Prototype starship was deployed over Balamak during that conflict, disrupting communications in the Taldot sector.

Ban-Satir II.title: Ban-Satir II
Ban-Satir II.lead: Ban-Satir II was a planet located within the Ban-Satir system in the Corporate Sector of the Outer Rim region of the galaxy. Through Ban-Satir II ran the Tingel Route hyperspace lane, which connected the planet with the worlds of Issagra and Gaurick.

Balowa.title: Balowa
Balowa.lead: Balowa was a planet in the Mid Rim's Balowa system whose primary terrain was rainforest. This planet was the location of a duel in which the Sith Lord Kaox Krul and Jedi Knight Crian Maru, along with her Padawan, Dree Vandap, were killed in 1000 BBY, shortly before the start of the Ruusan campaign.

Balosar.title: Balosar/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire

Balosar.lead: Balosar was a planet in the Core Worlds, and home to the Balosar species. It was a polluted, poverty-stricken world of grimy factories and downtrodden people, and a place where tourism was discouraged. Such an environment encouraged many of the native Balosars to become criminals.

Baltimn.title: Baltimn
Baltimn.lead: Baltimn was an Outer Rim planet. It was here that Ephaan Kenzon established the School of Hidden Wisdom, the only dueling academy to survive the Clone Wars and the rise of Emperor Palpatine. Despite its pleasant environment, Baltimn's remote location made it inaccessible for many tourists.

Banvhar Station.title: Banvhar Station
Banvhar Station.lead: Banvhar Station was the asteroid headquarters of the Banvhar Combine asteroid miners. Due to the fact that they were located near Trade Federation spaceways, their minerals were stolen by the CIS during the Clone Wars, and even some of the residents were used as target practice for General Grievous's droid army. Because of this, the remaining miners bore a great hatred against the cyborg general. They even assisted a group of Jedi deserters to locate Grievous and sneak into enemy territory and assassinate the General.

Baltizaar.title: Baltizaar/Legends
Baltizaar.lead: Baltizaar was a Mid Rim planet and was part of the Galactic Republic in the years before the Clone Wars. It was located in the Corthenia sector.

Bancar.title: Bancar
Bancar.lead: Bancar was a celestial body located in the Bancar system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Rayter sector. Around the time of the Battle of Yavin, Nak Farool, Special Assistant to the Galactic Empire's Moff Nile Owen of the Rayter sector, dispatched an Imperial II-xC Maintenance/Broadcast Ship from the planet Narg on a mission to the Laim system. The ship's crew stored a flight plan for a return trip to Narg into the computer system of the vessel, and while the ship was in the Laim system, a flight plan for further transit to Bancar was also being calculated.

Bandonia.title: Bandonia
Bandonia.lead: Bandonia was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Bandonian system. It was a part of the Arrowhead, or the Slice portion of the Core Worlds. Bandonia shared its name with the disease known as the Bandonian Plague.

Balanor.title: Balanor
Balanor.lead: Balanor was the rainforest planet in the Noonian sector of the Outer Rim Territories in the galaxy. Balnanor was the homeworld of the Force mite.

Balis-Baurgh.title: Balis-Baurgh
Balis-Baurgh.lead: Balis-Baurgh was a planet in the Mid Rim's Balis-Baurgh system and the only planet in the system that could sustain life.

Bantu.title: Bantu (disambiguation)
Bantu.lead: Bantu may refer to one of the following:, ==Canon==, The Bantu system, a Star system in the Core Worlds., ==Legends==, The Bantu system, a star system in the Core Worlds, The rainbow sunsets of Bantu, a weather phenomenon originating in the Bantu system

Bannakon.title: Bannakon
Bannakon.lead: Bannakon was a gas giant in the Dantooine system, located in the Raioballo sector of the Outer Rim.

Balith.title: Balith/Legends
Balith.lead: Balith was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Galactic Republic's Balith system. It was situated in the Northern Dependencies portion of the Inner Rim on the Vaathkree Trade Corridor hyperspace route.

Balnab.title: Balnab/Legends
Balnab.lead: Balnab was a planet close to the world of Patitite Pattuna.

Balionn-Gur's planet.title: Balionn-Gur's planet
Balionn-Gur's planet.lead: The Sith Lord Balionn-Gur conquered a planet during the Cold War between the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic and set out to rule it through law and order rather than fear. Thus, he hired diplomats to convince the populace of his intentions.

Bamayar IX.title: Bamayar IX
Bamayar IX.lead: Bamayar IX was a gas giant formed of emerald- and turquoise-colored gas clouds. Between 7 BBY and around 5 BBY, the trainee pilot Bodhi Rook skillfully flew a Nu-class transport through the clouds of Bamayar IX with a number of his classmates in the Galactic Empire's Terrabe Sector Service Academy aboard. When escaping the Death Star superweapon's blast on the moon Jedha in 1 BBY, Rook vividly imagined his flight through Bamayar IX when watching the storm of the blast's shockwave.

Barab I.title: Barab I/Legends

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories; The Slice, The Slice
facts.terrain: Modern:, Smoldering craters, Bubbling lava plains, Steaming seas, Historic:, Rocky badlands, Caves
facts.population: 1.4 billion (100% Barabel), 1 billion to 10 billion (c. 25 ABY)
facts.affiliation: Galactic Empire, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire, Galactic Federation of Free Alliances

Barab I.lead: Barab I was a dark, murky planet in the Barab system of the Albanin sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Located along the Triellus Trade Route, the planet was largely avoided by spacers due to the fearsome natives known as the Barabel.

Barhu.title: Barhu
Barhu.lead: Barhu was the first planet from the single star of the Churba system. It was a high-temperature, rocky world that was considered to have no civilized purpose.

Baralou.title: Baralou

facts.government: Solitary tribes (Multopos), Feudal and solitary tribes (Krikthasi)

Baralou.lead: Baralou was a planet in the Varada sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of the Krikthasi and the Multopos.

Barab II.title: Barab II
Barab II.lead: Barab II was the second planet in the Barab system. It was little more than a frozen ball of rock and ice.

Barab III.title: Barab III
Barab III.lead: Barab III was a planet in the Barab system. A gas giant composed of nitrogen, Barab III was the outermost planet in the system, which also contained the Barabel homeworld of Barab I. It was orbited by 34 moons.

Barenth.title: Barenth

facts.region: Expansion Region, Outer Expansion Zone, Northern Dependencies

Barenth.lead: Barenth was an Expansion Region world located in the Drannik sector. During the Waymancy Storm of 7811 BBY, its civilian population saw a near complete evacuation by the Galactic Republic as part of the defense of the world against the Signatories of Waymancy, with the Republic losing an entire battle group during the effort.

Baramorra.title: Baramorra
Baramorra.lead: Baramorra was a temperate, dreary, rainsoaked Galactic Empire planet governed by Admiral Llon Banjeer's nephew, the "Boss". He employed bounty hunters such as Jahnar-Kooda to keep the populace in line; when the planet's elders objected, he had them killed. The Boss was funded by Grappa the Hutt; when this was revealed, the Boss was executed as a traitor by Kir Kanos.

Baradas II.title: Baradas II
Baradas II.lead: Baradas II was the second planet in the Baradas system. The planet was ruled by Baron Rovan Tresario who founded the Tresario Bounty Hunters Guild, an organization of bounty hunters whom hunted down pirates.

Baraboo.title: Baraboo

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Baraboo.lead: Baraboo was a planet in the Core Worlds, along the Hydian Way. This world was the site of the Institute for Sentient Studies, which contained the most comprehensive collection of neurological models in the galaxy. From this world came a species of aquatic beings known as the biomold.

Bardo Verwen.title: Bardo Verwen
Bardo Verwen.lead: Bardo Verwen was an asteroid field in the Tobali system, orbiting the star Tor. It separated the star system, with the planet Rhen Var's orbit taking its course on the side closest to the sun, and the two gas giants of the system had orbits on the far side of the asteroid belt.

Bara.title: Bara
Bara.lead: Bara was the first planet orbiting the star Prael in the Japrael system. Located in the Japrael sector of the Inner Rim, it was a scorched ball.

Baratia.title: Baratia
Baratia.lead: Baratia was the first planet orbiting the star Julevia in the Julevian system. Located in the Dalonbian sector of the Outer Rim Territories, it was a molten rock.

Barbilly.title: Barbilly
Barbilly.lead: Barbilly was the sixth planet orbiting the star Utapau in the Utapau system. Located in the Tarabba sector of the Outer Rim Territories, it was a gas giant.

Barcaria.title: Barcaria
Barcaria.lead: Barcaria was a planet located in the Barcaria system, a part of the Sombure sector of the Mid Rim. It was the origin point of the commodity known as Barcarian claw salt.

Barancar.title: Barancar

facts.affiliation: Kingdom of Cron, Xim's Empire, Galactic Empire

Barancar.lead: Barancar was a planet located within the Tion Cluster. It was a part of the Kingdom of Cron, and was eventually conquered by Xer VIII. It was the site of numerous shipyards under Xim's Empire, which were used construct starships. By the Imperial Era, however, millennia of war and decay had left most of the yards derelict, but fitful industry still struggled along. Many of the ancient docks had become the lairs of smugglers and outlaws.

Barbeen.title: Barbeen (disambiguation)
Barbeen.lead: Barbeen may refer to one of the following:, ==Canon==, The Barbeen system, ==Legends==, The Barbeen system, The Brothers of Barbeen

Bar Neth.title: Bar Neth
Bar Neth.lead: Bar Neth (also spelled Bar-Neth) was a former desert planet located in the Bar Neth system, a quinary star system positioned in the Albarrio sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. By the year 4.3 ABY, Bar Neth had been turned into a "Natural Wonderland" with bountiful farmlands. As a result of its ambitious terraforming process, Bar Neth was considered pleasant to live in and was hugely apealing for galactic tourists. At that time, trips to Bar Neth were organized by the Star Tours travel agency as part of their Frontier Vacation Package.

Bardotta.title: Bardotta/Legends
Bardotta.lead: Bardotta was a planet located in the Colonies' Bardotta system that was ruled by the much beloved Queen Julia during the Clone Wars. Its inhabitants were reputed for their mysticism and attention to spiritual matters.

Bar'leth.title: Bar'leth
Bar'leth.lead: Bar'leth was a planet located in the galaxy's Core Worlds, in grid square M-10 on the Standard Galactic Grid. The University of Bar'leth and the Museum of Bar'leth were located on Bar'leth., In the time before the founding of the Galactic Republic, Bar'leth was the hiding place of the Ascendant, until the Sith Darkseekers tracked down and destroyed the cult in their Tomb of the Spark Eternal. In the following years, the Museum of Bar'leth was built over the site of the tomb, its secrets all but forgotten.

Barab.title: Barab I
Barab.lead: Barab I, also known simply as Barab, was an irradiated planet in the Barab system in the Albanin sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was located along the Triellus Trade Route between Teth and Dubrava, in grid square U-12 on the Standard Galactic Grid and was the homeworld of the Barabel species.

Bastion.title: Bastion/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Pentastar Alignment, Imperial Remnant, Yuuzhan Vong empire, Fel Empire …

Bastion.lead: Bastion, originally Sartinaynian, was an industrialized planet located in the Sartinaynian system in the Outer Rim Territories of the galaxy, and was the capital world of the Imperial Remnant, a statelet established from the former Galactic Empire. Bastion was located in the Braxant sector at the terminus of the trade route known as the Braxant Run.

Baroonda.title: Baroonda/Legends
Baroonda.lead: Baroonda was a planet of varied geography. It was host to several podracing tracks which passed through many diverse locations, including volcanoes, swamps, wide, sandy beaches, spectacular waterfalls, thick jungles, sulfur geyser fields, and plateau-top cities. It had some inhabited moons.

Barnaba.title: Barnaba
Barnaba.lead: Barnaba was a warm, mountainous planet in Barnaba Province. It was an important exporter of agricultural produce in the Tapani sector.

Baros.title: Baros
Baros.lead: Baros was a planet located in the Baros system in the Dominus sector. An Outer Rim world on the farthest reaches of the Slice, the planet was home to the Brubb species. It had a high gravity, was frequented by windstorms, and possessed infertile growing soil. In 9 ABY, it was one of the New Republic worlds taken over by Grand Admiral Thrawn during his campaign against the New Republic.

Baroli.title: Baroli/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Baroli.lead: Baroli was a planet inhabited by blue-haired Humans, and known for its many interesting moons.

Barundi.title: Barundi
Barundi.lead: Barundi was the homeworld of the Barundi species. The natives of Barundi were taken from their homeworld thousand of years before the Battle of Yavin and were deposited on an unnamed planet in Wild Space. There, they worshiped the Yavin Vassilika.

Basilisk.title: Basilisk

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Mandalorian Crusaders, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Basilisk.lead: Basilisk was a Core world in the Arrowhead of the Slice, near Coruscant.

Bassadro.title: Bassadro

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems

Bassadro.lead: Bassadro was a mining world with glassy crags on its dormant volcanoes. It was devastated in a battle in which it was taken from the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars by Empatojayos Brand.

Baskarn.title: Baskarn
Baskarn.lead: Baskarn was a planet in the Outer Rim. The planet was inhabited by the large, green-furred, Force-sensitive Yrashu. The planet was also home to the dangerous Razor trees. Baskarn was the site of the Battle of Baskarn in which the indigenous Yrashu instinctively fought the Galactic Empire, as they could sense its ties to the dark side of the Force. In the events leading up to the battle, a group of Rebels were adopted into a Yrashu tribe and went through a momu, in which they were taught jungle survival according to the Yrashu way.

Barmasel.title: Barmasel
Barmasel.lead: Barmasel was a gas giant in the Dathomir system, a part of the Quelii sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The planet occupied the sixth orbital position around the star Domir and was orbited by thirteen moons.

Basho.title: Basho

facts.region: Core Worlds, Ringali Shell, The Slice, Arrowhead

Basho.lead: Basho was the fifth planet in the Rhinnal system. It was a frigid ice planet and the last one before the asteroid field.

Barkhesh.title: Barkhesh/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Barkhesh.lead: Barkhesh was a planet located in the Seitia sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Basteel.title: Basteel/Legends
Basteel.lead: Basteel was a temperate, bleak planet where Slique Brighteyes hid from Admiral Mir Tork and Doctor Leonis Murthé. Not long after the Battle of Endor, Slique hired Boba Fett to kill Mir and Leonis for 100 credits. Fett returned with their heads just before Slique died.

Barison.title: Barison
Barison.lead: Barison was a water world along the Feena Run in the Gordian Reach. It supplied fish, seafood, and kelp to worlds in the Back Reach. Its inhabitants were known as the Barisoni. For religious reasons, many of the Barisoni had renounced technology.

Barpine.title: Barpine
Barpine.lead: Barpine was a planet with shipyards used as the headquarters of the rogue Imperial Lieutenant Lon Donell. Donell engaged in piracy against the New Republic from the bridge of the Immobilizer 418 cruiser Detainer, of which Donell had usurped command. The surface of the planet contained a large prison facility for the crews of the starships that Donell captured. Barpine was located in the Barpine system of the Outer Rim Territories.

Barseg.title: Barseg

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Tion Cluster, The Slice
facts.affiliation: Kingdom of Barseg, Three Allied Kingdoms, Xer's Empire, Xim's Empire, Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire

Barseg.lead: Barseg was a planet located in the Tion Cluster of the Outer Rim Territories, along the Perlemian Trade Route.

Barlok.title: Barlok/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Corporate Alliance, Confederacy of Independent Systems

Barlok.lead: Barlok was a planet in the Barlok system of the Marcol sector, between three and six days of hyperspace travel from Coruscant, and was also a member world of the Galactic Republic. It was known for tisvollt forests, inhabited by the indigenous Karfs; its agricultural produce, including delicious prisht fruit; its sprawling Patameene District, including the Starbright hotel, Panky's restaurant, and the Covered Brush housing ring; and its mines, the ownership of which was a point of dispute between the guilds of the indigenous Brolfi and the Corporate Alliance, including the Mining Guild.

Basarais.title: Basarais
Basarais.lead: Basarais was a planet in the Expansion Region. During the Black Fleet Crisis, outside Basarais, a children’s counting rhyme was known that went, «If I had a fat toe, a short toe, a black toe, a new toe, I would know where to go».

Bastatha.title: Bastatha
Bastatha.lead: Bastatha was a planet in the Bastatha system of the Inner Rim. Independent from the New Republic in the years following the Galactic Civil War, Bastatha became a haven for organized crime, and the Kajain'sa'Nikto crime lord Rinnrivin Di ran his cartel on the planet. Bastatha's surface was superheated by its red giant star, forcing all life on the planet, except for some bacteria, to live in underground caverns and tunnels. Due to the heat, residents of Bastatha preferred chilled foods.

Bars Barka.title: Bars Barka
Bars Barka.lead: Bars Barka was a planet located in the Bars Barka system, a part of the Barsa sector in the New Territories portion of the Mid Rim. It was linked via hyperlane to the Varvva system.

Batorine.title: Batorine
Batorine.lead: Batorine was the forested homeworld of the Blood Carver species. It joined the Galactic Republic in 110 BBY.

Belgaroth.title: Belgaroth

facts.terrain: Inhospitable mountains, with an occasional hill, plain, or valley, Urban, Rocky deserts
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Zero Command, New Republic

Belgaroth.lead: Belgaroth was a remote planet that was located within the Core Worlds region of the galaxy, situated near the Rimma Trade Route. The planet was used by the Galactic Empire to test new weapons and combat maneuvers. It was also the homeworld of the droidbreaker, a species of hulking creatures that fed on plasteel and refined metals.

Belderone.title: Belderone/Legends

facts.affiliation: Xim's empire, Galactic Republic, Darth Revan's Sith Empire, Galactic Empire, Greater Maldrood, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire, Galactic Alliance

Belderone.lead: Belderone, originally known as Vartholium, was the sector capital of Belderone sector in the Outer Rim Territories. Located on the Salin Corridor, Belderone had two inhabited moons.

Belasco.title: Belasco/Legends
Belasco.lead: Belasco was a planet in the Expansion Region of the galaxy.

Belazura.title: Belazura

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Corellian Hegemony, Galactic Empire

Belazura.lead: Belazura was a Galactic Republic member world, and one of the most visually stunning planets in the galaxy. Belazura was directly represented in the Galactic Senate.

Bedara.title: Bedara
Bedara.lead: Bedara was a planet in the Carida system. Like all planets in the system, it was destroyed, when Jedi apprentice Kyp Durron unleashed the Sun Crusher there.

Begeren.title: Begeren

facts.affiliation: Old Sith Empire, Galactic Republic, Reconstituted Sith Empire

Begeren.lead: Begeren was a planet in the Sith Worlds region of the Outer Rim Territories. It was originally part of the Sith Empire, which constructed enormous monuments dedicated to notable Sith on the planet's surface—a project that cost the lives of an estimated hundred thousand slaves. Following the Empire's defeat in the Great Hyperspace War, Begeren was claimed by the Galactic Republic. The Republic allowed the construction of a gemstone quarry at the expense of the Sith statues, which fell into ruin. In 3678 BBY, the planet was seized by a revived Sith Empire.

Beckoning Call Starr 3.title: Beckoning Call Starr 3
Beckoning Call Starr 3.lead: Beckoning Call Starr 3 was the third planet of the Beckoning Call Starr system, located in the Slice portion of the Inner Rim. The planet had a reputation for beautiful women, with which the smuggler Han Solo was familiar.

Beauchen.title: Beauchen/Legends
Beauchen.lead: Beauchen was the site of a New Republic penal colony.

Bavva.title: Bavva/Legends
Bavva.lead: Bavva was a colony world of the gold-skinned Nothoiin species. Located on the Nothoiin Corridor in the Outer Rim Territories' Anoat sector, Bavva exported a foul-tasting ale distilled from moss that Lutrillians loved and Humans hated. Sergeant Taray, a Nothoiin member of the Cloud City Wing Guard, grew up in Bavva's lawless Kaniti province.

Belgaroth asteroid belt.title: Belgaroth asteroid field/Legends
Belgaroth asteroid belt.lead: The Belgaroth asteroid field was an asteroid belt located in the Belgaroth system in the Core Worlds, between the first two orbits of the star system and its outer planets.

Bengali.title: Begali Uprising
Bengali.lead: The Begali Uprising, also known as the Bengali Uprising, was an uprising led by the world Begali against the Echani Command, the female council that governed a confederation of six Echani-dominated planets known as the Six Sisters that began in the year 1154 BBY. Begali was joined in revolt by the Thyrsians, an Echani subspecies from the planet Thyrsus, another of the Six Sisters.

Belderone sector prison asteroid.title: Belderone sector prison asteroid
Belderone sector prison asteroid.lead: A prison asteroid was located in the Belderone sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. Gang leaders Lemo and Sanda were incarcerated there after being captured by bounty hunters in the Keyorin system. Han Solo and Luke Skywalker traveled to the asteroid prison to obtain information on the location of a Dancing Goddess statue Lemo and Sanda had in their possession.

Bedlam.title: Bedlam/Legends
Bedlam.lead: Bedlam was a rocky Mid Rim planet located near the Bedlam Pulsar. The Bedlam Institution for the Criminally Demented was located on the planet. As of 67 BBY, its only direct transport connections were to Felucia, Caluula, and Abraxin.

Baummu.title: Baummu
Baummu.lead: Baummu was a planet located in the Shadola sector of the Outer Rim. It was violently attacked during the Galactic Civil War by Imperial forces led by Captain Briera. Briera was later known as the "Butcher of Baummu".

Be'ekk.title: Be'ekk
Be'ekk.lead: Be'ekk was a planet in the Cholganna system of the Outer Rim Territories. It orbited the star Chol, with three smaller planets orbiting more closely than it, Ryien, Cholganna and Chol. It was brown in color and had a ring. The Cholganna system was partially engulfed by the Chol Nebula, and the planets in the Star system passed through the nebula during their orbit.

Bator Bai.title: Bator Bai
Bator Bai.lead: Bator Bai was an ice world located in the Bator Bai system of the Senex sector, a part of the Senex-Juvex region in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim. It was linked by a hyperlane to the Kalgo and Suliana systems.

Batonn.title: Batonn
Batonn.lead: Batonn was a planet located in the Batonn sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, Admiral Thrawn was victorious in the Batonn insurgency, which led to the Emperor promoting him to Grand Admiral.

Batuu.title: Batuu

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Galactic Frontier, Western Reaches
facts.language: Galactic Basic Standard, Huttese, Rhodese, Twi'leki

Batuu.lead: Batuu was a remote terrestrial planet on the edge of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories, in the Batuu system of the Trilon sector. Batuu's surface was covered in jungles, oceans, and the petrified remains of ancient trees, referred to by the local Batuuans as "spires," which towered over the planet's landscapes. Millennia before the rise of the Galactic Empire and prior to the invention of hyperspace travel, Batuu was a popular stopping point for those traveling to Wild Space and the Unknown Regions.

Belkadan.title: Belkadan/Legends

facts.affiliation: Infinite Empire, Sith Empire, Praetorite Vong

Belkadan.lead: Belkadan was a forested planet located in the Dalonbian sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was a world of tall dalloralla trees and small natural bodies of water.

Bellassa.title: Bellassa/Legends

facts.terrain: Forested mountains, Foothills, Plains, Bluffs, Meadows, Lakes

Bellassa.lead: Bellassa was a thriving, peaceful world during the final days of the Republic. The planet's capital was Ussa, a pleasant city with seven large, tranquil lakes. After the rise of the Galactic Empire, Obi-Wan Kenobi went to Bellassa after learning on Tatooine that one former Jedi survived the purge: Ferus Olin.

Belnar.title: Belnar/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Belnar.lead: Belnar was a Colonies planet. A temperate world with large swamps on its surface, it was the homeworld of the sentient Khil species. Although the Khil developed large, Core-inspired cities on Belnar, the rest of the planet was left untouched, and even the urban centers featured marshy parks and swamps. Such areas in the cities served as convenient feeding sites for the Khil, whose diet consisted of organic particles filtered from the air via special organs.

Belsavis.title: Belsavis/Legends

facts.affiliation: Infinite Empire, Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire

Belsavis.lead: Belsavis, also known as Plawal, was a planet in the Ninth Quadrant, a region of the Bozhnee sector. Ice-covered, its average temperature was in the -50s. It was located on the edge of the Senex sector, at one end of the Belsavis Run.

Benja-Rihn.title: Benja-Rihn
Benja-Rihn.lead: Benja-Rihn was a planet in the Mid Rim. In its Temple of Tet-Ami was the Orb of Passage. At some point, Mace Windu traveled back in time using the Orb and saved Carthas from insectoids.

Belthu.title: Belthu
Belthu.lead: Belthu was a unaligned Outer Rim Territories world located near the territory of Warlord Zsinj. A wealthy planet being controlled by a coalition of mining companies led by corporate executives, it had a durasteel foundry that was owned by an alias of Zsinj. The facility was eventually destroyed by Wraith Squadron and the New Republic.

Belshar Othacuu.title: Belshar Othacuu
Belshar Othacuu.lead: Belshar Othacuu was a Mid Rim astronomical object located in the Belshar sector. During the Galactic Civil War, a covert installation of the Galactic Empire's Commission for the Preservation of the New Order was established there, with a convoy of military supplies scheduled to be transported to the facility. Between 12 ABY and 13 ABY, Belshar Othacuu was part of the New Republic.

Beneris.title: Beneris
Beneris.lead: Beneris was a planet in the Atrig system. It was a barren rock incapable of supporting life.

Bendone.title: Bendone
Bendone.lead: Bendone was the homeworld of the Howler Tree People.

Bengat.title: Bengat
Bengat.lead: Bengat was an oceanic world where the Aruzan female Manaroo once danced in competitions. She also rafted the planet's stormy waters in between her participation in these events.

Beltrix III.title: Beltrix III
Beltrix III.lead: Beltrix III was a factory planet in the Beltrix system, one of the Six Local Systems. It was the site of the Rebel headquarters in the Six Local Systems and also the headquarters of the Holstrum Talent Agency, a front for Rebel recruitment in which Alliance Intelligence Agent Keth Beamis worked as a talent scout. The cell on Beltrix III was established by Tet Tramys, Tendis Ancum, and Jioie Ancum.

Belsmuth II.title: Belsmuth II
Belsmuth II.lead: Belsmuth II was a planet in the Belsmuth system of the Outer Rim. It had an Imperial technical university which warlord Zsinj converted into a pilot training academy. To confuse Zsinj as to the location of Han Solo's task force, Rogue Squadron and Nova Squadron assaulted the academy.

Bellis IV.title: Bellis IV
Bellis IV.lead: Bellis IV, also known as Bellis Four, was a planet in the Bellis system of Demetras sector. Prior to the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire, Bellis IV was the sight of a conflict but was ultimately freed, in large part due to the actions of the Jedi Ngani Zho.

Bendeluum.title: Bendeluum/Legends

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Western Reaches, Greater Javin
facts.sector: Javin sector (prior to c. 400 BBY), Anoat sector (c. 400 BBY—)

Bendeluum.lead: Bendeluum was an Outer Rim Territories world situated in the Anoat sector. Originally settled by the Galactic Republic, it eventually became a minor competitor to the nearby megaworld Gerrenthum and had a thriving criminal underworld that influenced every aspect of its commerce. Many of Bendeluum's crime syndicates originated with the Nothoiin species.

Belukat.title: Belukat
Belukat.lead: Belukat was a planet in the Belukat system of the Expansion Region ruled by kings. It was said that Belukat's royal tomb builders were killed by the kings so that they would not be able to divulge the tomb's secrets to robbers.

Belovia.title: Belovia system/Legends
Belovia.lead: The Belovia system was a star system located within the Expansion Region of the galaxy. Belovians were native to the system.

Bendii.title: Bendii
Bendii.lead: Bendii was a planet located in the Seitia sector of the Outer Rim. From space, Bendii appeared as a blue orb. Around six months after the Battle of Yavin, Han Solo, Leia Organa and Chewbacca fled Imperial and bounty hunter pursuit above Bendii while ferrying supplies for the Rebel Alliance aboard the Millennium Falcon.

Bengely Four.title: Bengely Four
Bengely Four.lead: Bengely Four was a world in the galaxy that was settled by a group of Kitonaks. During the Cold War, the Kitonak colonists began to rapidly undergo a series of benign genetic mutations, the source of which was traced to a viral infection augmented by a rare chemical in the colony's air supply.

Belladoon.title: Belladoon
Belladoon.lead: Belladoon was a world located in the Myto sector's Belladoon system within the Outer Rim Territories and the New Territories regions. Situated within grid square K-3 of the Standard Galactic Grid, it lay along the Veragi Trade Route hyperlane between the astronomical objects Dantooine and Dubrillion. Belladoon contributed to the Galactic Empire's military by 5 ABY, during the Galactic Civil War between the Empire and the New Republic.

Benetage.title: Benetage/Legends
Benetage.lead: Benetage was a planet within the Outer Rim Territories of the galaxy.

Bestine IV.title: Bestine IV/Legends

facts.terrain: Sparse rocky islands, Oceans, Shallow seas
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire, Galactic Federation of Free Alliances

Bestine IV.lead: Bestine IV, or simply Bestine, was an aquacultural planet in the Inner Rim, along the Corellian Trade Spine. Nearly all of its surface was covered by a vast ocean, but there were many rugged islands spread across the planet. The original population struggled for years atop the planet's Island Spires to create an island paradise. As time passed, the planet was more widely known for its ship repair and construction industry, which eventually caught on with the Galactic Empire, who constructed large naval shipyards.

Berchest.title: Berchest/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Berchest.lead: Berchest was a major tourist destination, and later a trading planet, in the Anthos sector of the Inner Rim. It was an extremely beautiful world whose highly saline seas and strong tides result in immense crystal deposits on the planet's shores that the native Berchestians sculpted into entire cities. One of these cities was Calius saj Leeloo, or the City of Glowing Crystal. It was carved entirely from one massive crystal that was created over the centuries from salt deposits from the adjacent Leefari Sea and was considered one of the Twenty Wonders of the Galaxy.

Bescane.title: Bescane/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Pentastar Alignment, Imperial Remnant

Bescane.lead: Bescane was a planet near Dantooine, run by Galentro Heavy Works. A cool, temperate world, it was overpopulated and covered in factories, its natural environment destroyed.

Berrun.title: Berrun
Berrun.lead: Berrun was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Berrun system, a part of the Slice portion of the Colonies. By the time of the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire, the Republic maintained a detention facility on Berrun. After being convicted of war crimes as a result of targeting the families of their Imperial targets, the members of the Republic Special Forces squad known as the Surgeons served out their life sentences in the prison.

Berri.title: Berri
Berri.lead: Berri was a planet in the Inner Rim. It was a hot, smog-shrouded world with high gravity and a dense atmosphere. It was the homeworld of the Berrite species, which evolved to become master foragers due to its few natural food sources. There was a lack of galactic trade with Berri, and its inhabitants cultivated a heavy, hand-crafted industry that harnessed power from natural geothermic energies.

Bessimir.title: Bessimir
Bessimir.lead: Bessimir was a planet in the Galactic Core, 15 parsecs from Coruscant. Two natural satellites orbited Bessimir.

Berrol's Donn.title: Berrol's Donn/Legends
Berrol's Donn.lead: Berrol's Donn, also known as the Donn, was a celestial body located in the Outer Rim Territories' Kriz sector, on the Corellian Trade Spine hyperlane. It was situated outside the borders of the Galactic Republic and the Galactic Empire, and eventually it served as the site of a Rebel Alliance base. It also featured a town, a restaurant, and a bar called Sangorn's Net.

Beta Olikark.title: Beta Olikark
Beta Olikark.lead: Beta Olikark was a planet in the Outer Rim, at the tip of a galactic arm on the other side of the galaxy from the Rayter sector. Its natural stones had intricate patterns and were exported to other worlds for flooring. On one occasion, a diplomat for the New Republic, Kare Fontin was escorted to the planet from Coruscant by New Republic agents.

Besberra.title: Besberra
Besberra.lead: Besberra was an astronomical object located in the Besberra system in the Cegul sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It hosted a gladiatorial arena where the Houk gladiator Torog fought to the death.

Beta Rhama.title: Beta Rhama
Beta Rhama.lead: Beta Rhama was an Outer Rim planet in the Dalchon sector, on the same hyperroute as Nimba Five.

Berea.title: Berea

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Metharian Nebula Territories
facts.affiliation: Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire

Berea.lead: The primary planet in the Berea system in the Elrood sector, Berea was a rocky, mountainous world which was owned and operated by Imperial Mining, Ltd.. Berea was often besieged by hail storms and violent winds, and the nighttime temperature often dropped below freezing. It lay in Confederacy of Independent Systems controlled space during the Clone Wars. Many Imperial prisoners captured during the Galactic Civil War were sent to labor camps on Berea. Wilek Nereus and Conn Doruggan served the Galactic Empire on Berea before being reassigned to Bakura.

Benon.title: Benon
Benon.lead: Benon was a planet in the Delantine system. It was the closest planet to Delantine itself. The Imperials were supposed to think Trux Zissu fled to Benon after abandoning the Timespan.

Berason.title: Berason
Berason.lead: Berason was a Mid Rim mining world located in the Eclorar sector. During the Galactic Civil War, Berason—the inhabitants of which politically opposed the Galactic Empire—was subjected to an Imperial blockade that cut off the world's sources of food and medical supplies. Eventually, a Rebel Alliance force led by Airen Cracken ran the blockade, performing a strike against Berason's Imperial base and paving way for an Alliance convoy to bring supplies to the world.

Bestal Three.title: Bestal Three
Bestal Three.lead: Bestal Three was a jungle planet in the Outer Rim Territories' Varada sector. Its flora included the vortal tree, the seeds of which had medicinal properties. During the Galactic Civil War, the entrepreneur Alara Fax secured the rights for her company, Fax Ventures, to mine the asteroids of the nearby Kadal Asteroid Field and process the extracted ores on Bestal Three. The asteroid mining also served as cover for the manufacture of efficient medpacs from stimulants derived from the vortal tree seeds.

Beris.title: Beris

facts.affiliation: Galactic Federation of Free Alliances, Confederation

Beris.lead: Beris was a minor planet in the Mid Rim seceded from the Galactic Alliance during the Second Galactic Civil War.

Besero.title: Besero/Legends
Besero.lead: Besero was a mining world situated in the Deep Core's Besero system. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, Besero was the site of pitch-black lumni-mines, with dark rumors and mutterings spreading about the world. By the time of the Galactic Civil War between the Empire and the Rebel Alliance, the Tagge Mining Corporation caused many problems for the bureaucrats of Besero.

Beshka.title: Beshka
Beshka.lead: Beshka was a planet in the Outer Rim's Aparo sector.

Bestine.title: Bestine IV

facts.terrain: Caves, Cliffs, Island spires, Hills, Plains
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Bestine.lead: Bestine IV was a water-covered planet located in the Inner Rim Territories' Bestine system. One of the key members of the Galactic Republic by the time of the High Republic Era, it served primarily as an agricultural world, hosting starship manufacturing facilities as well. Bestine was also part of a lommite ore shipping route that connected the planet Eriadu to the Core Worlds. During the rise of the Separatist Alliance, the Separatist leader Count Dooku expressed threats to the security of the lommite shipping route via Bestine to Eriadu's governor, Wilhuff Tarkin.

Bespin.title: Bespin/Legends

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories; Greater Javin, Western Reaches
facts.sector: Anoat sector; Ivax Nebula; Ison Corridor
facts.affiliation: Neo-Bespinians, Galactic Republic, Brotherhood of Darkness, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Empire Reborn/Reborn …

Bespin.lead: Bespin was a gas giant in the Bespin system of the Anoat sector on the Ison Corridor in the Greater Javin region of the Outer Rim Territories. It was also a major source of tibanna gas, which was refined for production and transport in numerous mining operations including Cloud City and Tibannopolis. It was home to several million individuals, including Humans, Ugnaughts, and Lutrillians.

Ber de Val.title: Ber de Val
Ber de Val.lead: Ber de Val was a planet located in the Ber de Val system within the Colonies region. It is home to a non-sentient species of hyperactive rodents.

Biitu.title: Biitu

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Pentastar Alignment, Imperial Remnant

Biitu.lead: Biitu was the Biituian homeworld in the Cassandran Worlds region.

Betshish.title: Betshish
Betshish.lead: Betshish was a planet located in the Gordian Reach along the Pinooran Spur between Mogoshyn and Kli'aar. It was the homeworld of a sentient species. Betshish was discovered by a scout, Lile Gorsek, but his claim to the world had to be abandoned when the sentient species was discovered on landing. While it was interdicted by the Galactic Empire, the world escaped exploitation.

Bextar.title: Bextar

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories; Imperial Space, New Territories
facts.affiliation: Velcar Free Commerce Zone, Galactic Empire, Pentastar Alignment, Imperial Remnant, Fel Empire, Empire-in-exile

Bextar.lead: Bextar was one of four gas giants in the Velcar Free Commerce Zone's Bextar system. It was the site of several Amber Sun Mining Corporate gas mines. Amber Sun imported Entymal slaves as miners.

Bethal.title: Bethal

facts.affiliation: House Pelagia, Tapani Empire, Tapani Federation, Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire

Bethal.lead: Bethal was a planet located in Pelagia Province of the Tapani sector in the Colonies region. It was the primary planet in the Bethal system. It housed the headquarters of Bethal AgriCorp, and its main export was apocia hardwood timber. An infestation of greddleback termites caused the economy of the planet - which was based on apocia hardwood timber - to go under. Imperial Moff Tendd declared the planet a disaster world, and helped bring Imperial funds to the planet in an effort to restore the apocia.

Bezim.title: Bezim
Bezim.lead: Bezim was a planet in the Mid Rim. The native Bezim joined with the people of Junction V, Delaluna, and Vicondor to build the Station 88 Spaceport. This coalition of planets chose to remain loyal to the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.

Betal.title: Betal
Betal.lead: Betal was a Wild Space astronomical object located in the Betal system. It was the origin point of the group known as the Poraskors, who reportedly wove neural-web reflex threads by hand. Betal was mentioned in Cracken's Rebel Field Guide, a datafile authored by General Airen Cracken that documented various pieces of equipment utilized by agents of the Rebel Alliance.

Bethars.title: Bethars
Bethars.lead: Bethars was a celestial body located in the Bethars system, a part of the Emmo sector of the Core Worlds. The Human Kant Aryon, who was the son of a baron and a baroness and was age thirty-two by the time of the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Rebel Alliance, hailed from Bethars.

Biivren.title: Biivren
Biivren.lead: Biivren was a planet located in the Expansion Region's Biivren sector. An industrial world controlled by the Galactic Empire, it was the site of a large zone of factories and refineries that gradually contaminated the planet's water supply.

Biewa.title: Biewa
Biewa.lead: Biewa was an industrial planet in the Corporate Sector used as the headquarters of the Corporate Sector Authority Picket Fleet. It was a relatively poor world, and the Biewans spent what few credits they had on clothing, shelter and food.

Bianas.title: Bianas system/Legends
Bianas.lead: The Bianas system was in the Tapani sector, in the Colonies region of the galaxy. It was located in the Mecetti Province, on the Procopian Shipping Lane.

Betolio.title: Betolio system/Legends

facts.affiliation: Tapani Noble Houses, Pelagia Province, Calipsa Province

Betolio.lead: The Betolio system was in Tapani sector, in the Colonies region of the galaxy. Located in the Pelagia Province until it was seized by the Calipsa Province, it was located between the Setolio system and the Netolio system.

Bhuna Sound.title: Bhuna Sound/Legends
Bhuna Sound.lead: Bhuna Sound was a Mid Rim planet which joined the New Republic shortly after the Battle of Endor. To help in the planet's rebuilding efforts, the New Republic sent a freighter, the Dewback's Burden, to bring supplies to Bhuna Sound. However, the vessel was attacked by the TIE Pirates, who captured the transport.

Bettok.title: Bettok
Bettok.lead: Bettok was an astronomical object located in the Bettok system, a part of the Velcar sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The Human TIE fighter pilot Creb of the Galactic Empire was born at Bettok in 20 BBY.

Bevell Three.title: Bevell Three
Bevell Three.lead: Bevell Three was the third planet in the Bevell system. Jai Raventhorn led a Rebel team to this planet to capture four Imperial agents, but the mission was compromised: only Jai escaped. The four Infiltrators commandos who died included Leong. As a propaganda measure rather than a reward, Jai was promoted to Master Sergeant.

Betha II.title: Betha II

facts.climate: Temperate (original), Dry (after it was swept dry)

Betha II.lead: Betha II was a barren, dry low-gravity planet covered in yellow-orange rock with very little atmospheric moisture. The planet was located in the Betha system in Corva sector, at the midpoint of the Daranc Run.

Bettel asteroid drift.title: Bettel asteroid drift

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Greater Javin, Western Reaches

Bettel asteroid drift.lead: The Bettel asteroid drift was located near the Hoth system. It was used as a stopover point for Imperial fleets in 3 ABY.

Bheriz.title: Bheriz

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, The Slice, Hutt Space (Clone Wars)

Bheriz.lead: Bheriz was an Outer Rim Territories celestial body located in the Bheriz sector. The local Bherizians produced processed granules of the commercially important mineral teniline. In 22 BBY, the viceroy of Bheriz negotiated a deal with the crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure in which Bheriz would exchange half its annual teniline output for access to Hutt-controlled hyperspace routes.

Bid'jerma.title: Bid'jerma
Bid'jerma.lead: Bid'jerma was a planet located in the Prefsbelt sector of the Outer Rim.

Bezha Two.title: Bezha Two
Bezha Two.lead: Bezha Two was a Core Worlds planet. It was inhabited by several nations and became one of the founding members of the Galactic Republic upon that government's establishment in 25,053 BBY. At some point during the early history of the Republic, Bezha Two became lost to the government, supposedly as a result of a supernova. The inhabitants of the planet, which in reality remained intact and habitable, retained recollections of the early Republic during the subsequent years.

Bhargebba Six.title: Bhargebba Six
Bhargebba Six.lead: Bhargebba Six was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Bhargebba system, a part of the Esstran sector in the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was a part of the Sith Worlds, a region surrounded by the nebulosity known as the Stygian Caldera, and was connected via the Descri Wris hyperlane to the Nfolgai and Svolten systems.

Bimmisaari.title: Bimmisaari/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Hutt Empire, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Greater Maldrood, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire …

Bimmisaari.lead: Bimmisaari was the capital planet of the Halla sector and the homeworld of the Bimm species, as well as the adopted homeworld of a near-Human race of the same name who settled the planet in 2000 BBY. The planet was directly represented in the Galactic Senate and allowed a RRM settlement in 22 BBY, prior to the Clone Wars. During the Clone Wars the planet was located within Separatist-contested space and Hutt Space. It escaped most of the turmoil of the Clone Wars and Imperial repression thanks to its remote location.

Blenjeel.title: Blenjeel
Blenjeel.lead: Blenjeel was a desert planet between Ando and Kothlis, located far from the major hyperlanes. It was inhabited by enormous sand burrowers, which emerged quickly from the ground to devour unsuspecting prey. The terrain of Blenjeel was comprised mostly of wide deserts, noted for the unusual consistency of the sand, which shifted over time. Rocky outcroppings which were stable one day seemed to sink into the sand the next. These shifts were mostly attributed to the movements of the sand burrowers.

Bimmiel.title: Bimmiel/Legends

facts.terrain: Desert, Wasteland, Ice caps on the poles
facts.affiliation: Jedi Order, Praetorite Vong, Galactic Empire

Bimmiel.lead: Bimmiel was a planet in an elliptical orbit around its primary star in the MZX33291 system. The fifth planet in the system, it was named after Bimmiel, the Imperial scout who rediscovered it. As the planet neared the sun, its ice caps melted, triggering an increase in moisture and plant growth. The heat brought the native shwpi out of hibernation to multiply. Since the carnivorous slashrats could not adapt to the heat, they retreated to the polar regions of the planet.

Bilbringi.title: Bilbringi
Bilbringi.lead: Bilbringi was a world located in the Inner Rim Territories. It was home to the Bilbringi shipyards, a facility which dismantled the Separatist dreadnought Lucid Voice within a year after the end of the Clone Wars. Jedi Master Jora Malli was considered by his Padawan Reath Silas to have an insatiable craving for Bilbringi food. The smuggler Han Solo was fond of Bilbringi food too, and shared cheesy meat pies with pepper from Bilbringi with his wife, Leia Organa, at their home on Hosnian Prime twenty-four years after the Battle of Endor.

Bilbringi VII.title: Bilbringi VII
Bilbringi VII.lead: Bilbringi VII was a planetoid in the Bilbringi system which constituted a part of the Inner Rim region of the galaxy. The planetoid was also considered to be one of the largest asteroids in the star system. The Namadii Corridor hyperlane linked the Bilbringi system to the worlds of Dorin and Palanhi. Bilbringi VII had no atmosphere, yet it was home to the crystal barnacle species.

Biolag.title: Biolag
Biolag.lead: Biolag was the second planet in the Corulus system. It was a gas giant orbited by seven moons.

Biosh.title: Biosh
Biosh.lead: Biosh was a planet in the Hoth system. The second world in the system, Biosh was a barren ball of rock. It had little to any atmosphere and no life.

Bilagen.title: Bilagen
Bilagen.lead: Bilagen was the fourth planet in the New Plympto system.

Bilios.title: Bilios
Bilios.lead: Bilios was a planet in the Bilios system of the Tapani sector's Melantha Province. The Justice Action Network once maintained a base on the planet.

Binaros.title: Binaros
Binaros.lead: Binaros was a planet located in the Kathol Outback.

Blair Cluster.title: Blair Cluster/Legends
Blair Cluster.lead: The Blair Cluster was a vast asteroid field in the Airam sector, located in the Outer Rim region of the galaxy.

Birgis.title: Birgis
Birgis.lead: Birgis was a terrestrial world in the Dalonbian sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It lay in the path of the extragalactic Yuuzhan Vong species during their invasion of the galaxy.

Binquaros.title: Binquaros

facts.affiliation: Confederacy of Independent Systems, Separatist holdouts, Galactic Empire

Binquaros.lead: The planet of Binquaros was located in the Ciutric sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Birix.title: Birix
Birix.lead: Birix was a world that Prudii Skirata went on a mission to during the Clone Wars, to destroy a Separatist reactor.

Birsingrial.title: Birsingrial
Birsingrial.lead: Birsingrial was a Core Worlds planet known for its jewel-caves. Besany Wennen's family once went there on a vacation when she was about ten years old.

Blaudu Sextus.title: Blaudu Sextus
Blaudu Sextus.lead: Blaudu Sextus was a planet which primarily served as a mining colony to its inhabitants, which included Octusi servants. In 44 ABY, the servants were priming for a revolt, and Galactic Alliance Chief of State Natasi Daala ordered for a group of Mandalorian mercenaries to quell the uprising.

Blaudu Octus.title: Blaudu Octus
Blaudu Octus.lead: Blaudu Octus was a planet in the Regulan system, near Blaudu Sextus. It was home to the Octusi species, a semi-sentient species who lived as willing servants to the people of Blaudu Sextus until Freedom Flight stirred a revolt amongst the Octusi in 44 ABY.

Blackfel.title: Blackfel
Blackfel.lead: Blackfel was a moon located in the Blackfel system, within the Greater Plooriod sector of the galaxy's Expansion Region. The entire moon was a training facility for the Galactic Empire.

Bilzen.title: Bilzen
Bilzen.lead: Bilzen was a planet in the Bilzen system of Wild Space that featured mountains and at least one frozen cavern, which contained giant icicles. In 3 BBY, Jedi Kanan Jarrus traveled there with his apprentice Ezra Bridger in their shuttle, the Phantom, to practice the latter's connection to the Force. However, their training was interrupted when the Seventh Sister and the Fifth Brother, two Jedi hunters serving in the Galactic Empire's Inquisitorius, confronted them.

Birren.title: Birren
Birren.lead: Birren was a small, quiet Inner Rim planet that was originally settled by both Alderaanian and Arkanisian explorers. After the destruction of Alderaan, it was one of the few places where candlewick flowers still grew naturally.

Bogden.title: Bogden/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Zsinj's Empire, New Republic

Bogden.lead: Bogden was a many-mooned world located in the Inner Rim, along the Hydian Way, between Arkania and Ploo.

Boonta.title: Boonta/Legends

facts.affiliation: Hutt Empire, Xim's Empire, Hutt Cartel, Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders, Brotherhood of Darkness, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire …

Boonta.lead: Boonta, formerly known as Ko Vari, was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories that had been colonized by the Hutts long ago. Despite it being a devastated world, Boonta was famous in the galaxy for its podracing and speeder races.

Bnach.title: Bnach
Bnach.lead: Bnach was a hot, desolate prison planet that housed an global Imperial penal camp, and was renowned for its deadly rock quarries. Prisoners forced to labor in these quarries were said to survive no more than a year.

Boordii.title: Boordii
Boordii.lead: Boordii was a temperate planet in the Sumitra sector. Its central source of income came from smugglers transporting contraband offworld. After the death of King Alaric the whole sector including this planet, left the Galactic Republic and joined the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Bodrin.title: Bodrin

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Metharian Nebula Territories

Bodrin.lead: Bodrin was a rocky, mountainous planet in Elrood sector's Bodrin system on the Elrood-Derilyn Trade Route. Its poor inhabitants worked for the Elrood Quarry Corporation. The bodrite mines operated at full capacity during the summer. During the five local winter months, the mines were forced to shut down. Individuals could not carry weapons on Bodrin, small towns were closely knit and crime was rare. During the Clone Wars, Bodrin lay within Separatist space. The Shining Comet was headed to this planet with a group of miners when it was attacked by Consolidations Unlimited.

Bnar VII.title: Bnar VII
Bnar VII.lead: Bnar VII was an astronomical object located in the Bnar system, a part of the Braxant sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The decades-long career of the Noehon slaver Tir'uh saw her operate within an area of the galaxy spanning from Bnar VII, in the northern section of the galaxy, to Kessel, a planet in the galaxy's eastern portion.

Blyte.title: Blyte system/Legends
Blyte.lead: The Blyte system was in the Tapani sector of the Colonies region of the galaxy. It was located in the sector's Mecetti Province, near the Tumus system.

Bolad.title: Bolad
Bolad.lead: Bolad was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Bolad system, a part of the Tharin sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The Annoo-dat Blue crime lord Sise Fromm, based out of the planet Annoo, maintained a vacation palace on Bolad until the residence was destroyed by Fromm's son, Tig, at some point by 15 BBY.

Blimph.title: Blimph
Blimph.lead: Blimph was a Mid Rim gas giant in the Blimph system. One of its moons was Blimph 3, which was strategically important to the Rebel Alliance due to trading with the Jokhalli.

Bomis Koori IV.title: Bomis Koori IV

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Corporate Alliance, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Prentioch's Dominion

Bomis Koori IV.lead: Bomis Koori IV was a planet in the Mid Rim, and was the main gathering point of Corporate Alliance defensive forces on the surrounding worlds during the Clone Wars.

Bompreil.title: Bompreil
Bompreil.lead: Bompreil was located within the Demetras sector of the Outer Rim Territories, in the Bompreil system.

Bogden 3.title: Bogden 3

facts.affiliation: Jedi Order, Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Bounty Hunters' Guild

Bogden 3.lead: Bogden 3, or Bogden Three, was one of the twenty moons of Bogden, a planet located in the Inner Rim.

Bootana Shagplan.title: Bootana Shagplan
Bootana Shagplan.lead: Bootana Shagplan was a world located in the Bootana Shagplan system, a part of the Bootana Hutta area in the Hutt Space portion of the Slice. It was connected by a hyperlane to the Elgit and Langoona systems and shared its name with the Huttese words "bootana" and "shag," which meant "garden" and "slave," respectively.

Bonagal.title: Bonagal
Bonagal.lead: Bonagal was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories' Mandalore sector. Located within the Mandalore system, Bonagal occupied the seventh orbit around the system's star, Mandalore, between the orbits of Mandallia and Shukut. A gas giant, Bonagal was surrounded by thirty-four moons.

Boranda.title: Boranda/Legends
Boranda.lead: Boranda was a celestial body located in the Boranda system, a part of the Manda sector in the Slice portion of the Mid Rim. It was situated between the Holess and Manda systems on the Manda Merchant Route hyperlane.

Bogoa.title: Bogoa
Bogoa.lead: Bogoa was a planet covered in spires of durable coral, which could be used as ship-building materials. During the Clone Wars, the planet was under the protection of the Galactic Republic.
