Its coral made it a target for the Confederacy of Independent Systems, which battled the Galactic Republic for three long days and nights for control of the coral world.

Boledge.title: Boledge
Boledge.lead: Boledge was a planet located in the Inner Rim. Boledge Downport was the planet's spaceport.

Bomis Koori.title: Bomis Koori system
Bomis Koori.lead: The Bomis Koori system was a star system located in the galaxy's Mid Rim, situated on the Corellian Trade Spine.

Boothi XII.title: Boothi XII
Boothi XII.lead: Boothi XII was a planet located in the galaxy. During her time at the University of Bar'leth, Chelli Lona Aphra explored a subterranean vault on Boothi XII, hoping to discover artifacts that would further her career as an archaeologist. However, when exploring the vault, she found nothing of value.

Bogo Rai.title: Bogo Rai
Bogo Rai.lead: Bogo Rai was an astronomical object located within the territory of the Unknown Regions' Chiss Ascendancy nation. It was situated in grid square E-8 of the Standard Galactic Grid, within the Bogo Rai system.

Bothawui.title: Bothawui/Legends

facts.routes: Bothan Run, Kaaga Run, Manda Merchant Route, Reena Trade Route
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Exar Kun's Sith Empire, Galactic Empire, Alliance of Free Planets, New Republic, Galactic Federation of Free Alliances, Confederation …

Bothawui.lead: Bothawui () was a cosmopolitan planet, located in the center of Bothan Space in the Mid Rim. It was the homeworld of the Bothan race as well as a major hub for information trafficking. It was also the center of the Bothan Spynet, widely agreed upon to be the best network of information gathering in the galaxy. The Imperial name for the planet was Bothawui Proper.

Borleias.title: Borleias/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire, Galactic Alliance, Imperial Remnant

Borleias.lead: Borleias was the fourth and only inhabited planet in the Pyria system. It was located in the Colonies, at the edge of the Galactic Core and along the Namadii Corridor.

Bosthirda.title: Bosthirda/Legends

facts.affiliation: Sith Empire, Reconstituted Sith Empire, Prophets of the Dark Side

Bosthirda.lead: Bosthirda was a planet of the Sith Empire, close to Korriban and Dromund Kaas, and was located on the Kamat Krote.

Bosph.title: Bosph/Legends
Bosph.lead: Bosph was the homeworld of the Bosph species. Located in the Bosph sector, it was discovered by the Republic several decades before the rise of the Empire. Due to the Bosphs' Force-sensitivity, Moff Harsh bombarded the planet. The Bosphs went into denial, pretending the bombardment had never occurred; though in reality, the planet was almost completely destroyed. After this, the planet itself was covered in grassy plains broken by the scars of turbolaser fire.

Borosk.title: Borosk/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Pentastar Alignment, Imperial Remnant, Fel Empire, Empire-in-exile, Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire

Borosk.lead: Borosk was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories, one of a number of worlds along the frontier of Imperial Space fortified as strongpoints against the New Republic in the last years of the Galactic Civil War. A relatively small world, its defenses included orbiting ion minefields and planetary shields, plus heavy planetary-defense turbolasers and ion cannon batteries. It was located near Yaga Minor.

Borgo Prime.title: Borgo Prime/Legends

facts.affiliation: Infinite Empire, Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Imperial Remnant, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Borgo Prime.lead: Borgo Prime was an asteroid that served as a shadowport in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories.

Borlov.title: Borlov
Borlov.lead: Borlov was the homeworld of the feudal Borlovian species.

Borkeen Belt.title: Borkeen Belt
Borkeen Belt.lead: The Borkeen Belt, also known as the Borkeen asteroid belt, was a dangerous asteroid belt situated in the Outer Rim Territories' Belsmuth sector. It was home to an eighty-meter-long exogorth that was discovered by 22 BBY by scientists from the University of Sanbra. At some point after the formation of the Galactic Empire, the author Rogar Farnoster wrote the novel The Slug Named Grendel, which mentioned both the Borkeen Belt and Grendel, a giant exogorth living therein that was also the subject of a pilot legend.

Botajef.title: Botajef/Legends

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, New Territories, Trans-Hydian
facts.routes: Hydian Way, Salin Corridor, Sprizen End Run
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Darth Revan's Sith Empire, Brotherhood of Darkness, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Zsinj's Empire, Imperial Remnant …

Botajef.lead: Botajef was a planet located in the Belsmuth sector of the Outer Rim Territories, known for its shipyards.

Bordal.title: Bordal
Bordal.lead: Bordal was an Outer Rim planet in the Taroon system. It was one of two habitable planets in the system, and its primary inhabitants were Humans.

Borao.title: Borao

facts.affiliation: Yuuzhan Vong empire, RePlanetHab, Galactic Federation of Free Alliances

Borao.lead: Borao was a world within the Inner Rim that was located between Coruscant and Ramodi. Its surface was covered in yorik coral spires and forests after its Vongforming and abandonment by the Yuuzhan Vong. It was adopted as the new home world of the Ithorians, along with Felucia, Öetrago and the worlds of the Upell system after the devastation of Ithor, under the Galactic Alliance.

Borkyne.title: Borkyne
Borkyne.lead: Borkyne was location that shared its name with the Borkyne system of the Bes Ber Bikade sector in the Expansion Region. In 2 ABY, Captain Dagon Niriz claimed that Jodo Kast needed an Imperial pardon for a mess made on Borkyne.

Borcorash.title: Borcorash
Borcorash.lead: Borcorash was a planet with incredibly beautiful sunsets with an ever-shifting array of colors brought about by atmospheric conditions. It was the blufferavian homeworld. The planet was the location of the high-tech Resinem Entertainment Complex. The bombing of a neighboring rival casino shortly before the Battle of Endor damaged the Complex's west wall, which was further damaged by erosion. The Complex was run by Mazzic. The Mistryl sent Karoly D'ulin to recover Shada D'ukal from the Complex. Shada defeated and escaped from Karoly, fleeing to Coruscant.

Bormter.title: Bormter
Bormter.lead: Bormter was a Wild Space planet that was home to the four-armed reptiloid Bormterran species. Following the Battle of Endor, Moff Delurin broke with the Galactic Empire and declared himself a warlord, conquering Bormter with his warship, the Galaxy Dragon. Delurin used Bormter as a base and recruited Bormterrans to serve in the dragon trooper military unit.

Borga.title: Borga
Borga.lead: Borga was a terrestrial astronomical object that featured swamps and was located in the Borga system, a part of the Yminis sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. In 15 BBY, the Fromm Gang leader Tig Fromm thought about vacationing on Borga after a plan of his failed, speculating that its swamps were nearly habitable during that time of year.

Bory.title: Bory
Bory.lead: Bory was an airless rock planet with no moons that occupied the second closest orbital position to the star Asar. It was located within the Ilum system, a part of the Unknown Regions' 7G sector.

Boriin.title: Boriin
Boriin.lead: Boriin was a planet in the Boriin system of the Inner Rim of the galaxy that prohibited skilled metalsmiths from leaving its territories.

Boro-borosa III.title: Boro-borosa III

facts.affiliation: Infinite Empire, Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Hutt Empire

Boro-borosa III.lead: Boro-borosa III was a planet in the Boro-borosa system with three suns. The system was a minor Garonnin possession with mining operations in three asteroid belts and the planetary ring. It was rumored to be home to a fabled lost treasure left by Hutt Royalty or the Rakatan Infinite Empire.

Bosch.title: Bosch system/Legends
Bosch.lead: The Bosch system was a part of the Core Worlds. Between 16 ABY and 17 ABY, it, as well as a total of five inhabited planets and approximately one billion citizens, was represented in the New Republic Senate by Senator Tuomi. While challenging the authority of the New Republic's Chief of State Leia Organa, Tuomi rhetorically asked why should the former inhabitants of Organa's homeworld, the Alderaan system's destroyed planet Alderaan, have the same voting rights in the Senate as the Bosch system.

Boruga.title: Boruga
Boruga.lead: Boruga was a planet located in the Core Worlds.

Boz Pity.title: Boz Pity/Legends

facts.region: Mid Rim, Kashyyyk Region, The Slice
facts.affiliation: Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Republic, Alliance to Restore the Republic, Greater Maldrood, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Boz Pity.lead: Boz Pity was a planet in the Boz Pity system of the Mid Rim. It was home to the sentient Gargantelle species, noted for their large stature. When the planet was discovered at some point before the end of the Ductavis Era, the Hutts attempted to enslave the species. After the Gargantelles repelled seven invasions and four diplomatic missions, the Hutts convinced the Electric Caliphs of Boz Pity's neighbor world Mourn to exterminate the species. The Gargantelles were slowly driven to extinction over the next decade, but erected a substantial amount of enormous gravestones to their fallen.

Brachnis Chorios.title: Brachnis Chorios
Brachnis Chorios.lead: Brachnis Chorios was a cold, greenish-lavender planet on the outer edge of the Chorios systems, far from the triple stars and deep within the Meridian sector.

Brath Qella.title: Brath Qella
Brath Qella.lead: Brath Qella, known as Maltha Obex by the time of the Galactic Empire, was a planet in the Mieru'kar sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld to the Qella and their predecessors, the Ahra Naffi. It was located five days from N'zoth and eight days from Coruscant with a standard hyperdrive.

Boztrok.title: Boztrok
Boztrok.lead: Boztrok was an Outer Rim world on the Hydian Way just outside Corporate Sector.

Branteez.title: Branteez
Branteez.lead: Branteez was a terrestrial world located in the Branteez system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Tolonda sector. At some point by the date 38:1:15, a Shrine of Kooroo, one of a number of stone structures of mysterious origins found on several Outer Rim worlds, had been uncovered on Branteez—a fact which the investigative reporter Andor Javin noted in a TriNebulon News report issued on that date.

Bresan.title: Bresan
Bresan.lead: Bresan was one of three primary planets in the Pimbrellan League. It was not as hospitable as nearby Dolstan. Its atmosphere could not sustain most humanoid life. Sealed dome cities were built in underground cave systems. Profits from trade with Dolstan were used to support life support facilities.

Bresallis.title: Bresallis
Bresallis.lead: Bresallis was a planet located within the Bresallis system, which was located in the Cadma sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was plagued by a criminal underworld run by the Hutts. Ambassador Walads opposed the Hutts, trying to disrupt their businesses. He was about to make a speech to the government on the subject when the Hutts hired Brahle Logris to assassinate him.

Bresnan.title: Bresnan
Bresnan.lead: Bresnan was a planet in the Wellte-ir system of the Mid Rim, in the Trax sector.

Bresnia.title: Bresnia
Bresnia.lead: Bresnia was a planet located in the Tandon sector of the Mid Rim.

Breeka.title: Breeka
Breeka.lead: Breeka was a dry desert world. One of this world's native animals was a distant cousin to the dewbacks of Tatooine.

Bragkis.title: Bragkis
Bragkis.lead: Bragkis was a gambling planet with a million-credits minimum betting parlor once visited by Han Solo.

Branth.title: Branth
Branth.lead: Branth was an industrial planet of the Galactic Republic that manufactured droids. However, after the rise of the New Order, the Galactic Empire's heavy demand for droids polluted the planet until it had to be abandoned. It was the only planet in the system containing it. It was impossible to discern any land masses from space due to the thick, sullen, gray smog in the planet's atmosphere. The air on the planet was extremely warm and damp, and it was extremely hard to tell whether it was raining at all due to the thick mist.

Brembo.title: Brembo
Brembo.lead: Brembo was a terrestrial planet whose surface consisted of volcanic rock. It was located in the Thanium sector's Felucia system, found in the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. Brembo occupied the second orbital position around the star Felix and had no moons.

Brachi.title: Brachi
Brachi.lead: Brachi was a planet located within the Brachi system of the Outer Rim Territories and the home to the Brachian Beastlord.

Breshig.title: Breshig
Breshig.lead: Breshig was an Outer Rim Territories world situated in the Mandalore sector. Home to the trill beast creatures, it became a part of space controlled by the Mandalorian warrior culture. During the build-up to the Mandalorian Wars of 3976 BBY–3960 BBY, Mandalorian warships were constructed at Breshig. The world's role in the Mandalorian history was eventually noted in Vilnau Teupt's 412th Proceedings of Galactic Anthropology and History keynote address in 24 ABY.

Brazadann.title: Brazadann
Brazadann.lead: Brazadann was a planet located in the Outer Rim, and the twin of the planet Oriadann.

Breta Yaga.title: Breta Yaga
Breta Yaga.lead: Breta Yaga was an astronomical object located within the Breta Yaga system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Mieru'kar sector. Several art pieces called flatsculps that were produced by a non-Human species originated on Breta Yaga. The flatsculps were stored in the Mount Tantiss complex on the Ojoster sector planet Wayland by the time of the facility's destruction in 9 ABY. The New Republic historian Voren Na'al later mentioned Breta Yaga in his journal.

Botor.title: Botor
Botor.lead: Botor was a planet located in the galaxy's Core Worlds that was home to the pirate faction known as the Flesh Mongers during the Republic Era. The youngling Lo was from Botor.

Bovo Yagen.title: Bovo Yagen
Bovo Yagen.lead: Bovo Yagen was a former Imperial captain who fled the Empire with his wife and four sons. After a period of wandering, the family landed on a planet with a humanoid species. Proving their good intentions to the natives, the family was allowed to settle on the world. Over time, more Humans fleeing the Empire arrived, forming a small outpost. By the time Yagen passed away, the planet bore his name.

Brodo Asogi.title: Brodo Asogi

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Imperial Remnant

Brodo Asogi.lead: Brodo Asogi, also known as the Green Planet, was a planet that was the homeworld of the Asogian species. It was located near the border of the Outer Rim Territories and Wild Space, nearby Kalee and Huk.

Bryndar.title: Bryndar
Bryndar.lead: Bryndar was a planet that, during the Clone Wars, was in the middle of an ice age. That, along with its remoteness, made it the perfect spot for individuals such as smugglers to hide, which is what Flynn Kybo, B'dard Tone and Codi Ty did during their hunt for General Grievous.

Brosi.title: Brosi
Brosi.lead: Brosi was the homeworld of the Brosin species, in the Thandon Cluster, a remote place in the Corporate Sector. It was the fourth planet in the Dostra system, and one of the few homeworlds within the Corporate Sector.

Brigia.title: Brigia/Legends

facts.language: Galactic Basic Standard, Previously: Brigian language
facts.affiliation: Back Spiral, Kingdom of Cron, Xer's Empire, Xim's Empire, Honorable Union of Desevro & Tion, Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems …

Brigia.lead: Brigia was a planet in the Tion Hegemony of the Outer Rim, and the Brigian homeworld.

Bryexx.title: Bryexx
Bryexx.lead: During the Galactic Civil War, it was led by Governor Yndis Mylore, who was also Moff of the sector.

Broest.title: Broest/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Broest.lead: Broest was an agriworld in the Galactic Core, on the Ag Circuit. It was controlled by Salliche Ag Corporation.

Bretta.title: Bretta
Bretta.lead: Bretta was a location in the Bretta system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Ojoster sector. On the date 36:1:16, a news report by Cynabar's InfoNet mentioned it as the last known heading for the Human smuggler Bettle and her partner Jaxa, who had returned from a profitable run to territories beyond the Corporate Sector with large amounts of canta salt and havao tabacc in the cargo holds of their starship, the Mallixer, albeit with the craft also needing repairs.

Brochiib.title: Brochiib
Brochiib.lead: Brochiib was a Trianii colony planet in Trianii Space. Trianii Rangers Atuarre and Keeheen stopped thionarx dealers on the planet.

Bseto I.title: Bseto I
Bseto I.lead: Bseto I was the first planet orbiting the white dwarf Bseto of the Mid Rim. It was a rocky, desert planet, and located in the Bseto system.

Buamlon Central.title: Buamlon Central
Buamlon Central.lead: Buamlon Central was a planet located in the system of the same name, situated in the Esstran sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was a dangerous world, and was staked by Barosa Warren, a scout serving with the Republic Survey Corps.

Bryx.title: Bryx
Bryx.lead: Bryx was a planet in the Bryx sector of the Mid Rim.

Brolsam.title: Brolsam
Brolsam.lead: Brolsam was a planet within the system of the same name in the Kathol sector of the Outer Rim Territories. An agriworld, it was located on a branch off the Trition Trade Route, between the sector capital Kal'Shebbol and Torize. Although its distance from the sector's major trade route hampered its economic growth, Brolsam developed an industry based primarily around agriculture due to the presence of a significant community of Fefze swarms. The planet also gained a reputation as an artist's retreat.

Bri'ahl.title: Bri'ahl
Bri'ahl.lead: Bri'ahl was a planet located in the Bri'ahl sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was inhabited by the Bri'ahls.

Bridgeworld.title: Bridgeworld Lost
Bridgeworld.lead: Bridgeworld Lost was a painting created after 104 ABY set during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems, which lasted from 22 BBY to 19 BBY. It depicted a group of Skakoans—a species associated with the Techno Union, a member organization of the Confederacy—surrounded by blaster-wielding clone troopers of the Grand Army of the Republic. The background of the painting contained bridge cities and three Munificent-class star frigates.

Briston.title: Briston
Briston.lead: Briston was a planet near Teardrop, in the Shelsha sector.

Bronsoon.title: Bronsoon
Bronsoon.lead: Bronsoon was a trading port on the original Gordian Reach founded by Human colonists from the Core in ancient times. Bronsoonians had strict rules about gender relations, with laws governing everything from marriage between casts to making eye contact and who could walk where. Inevitably, Bronsoonian drama was all about forbidden love between different casts. A slow, little-used route connected Bronsoon with the Maridun system.

Brint-wo.title: Brint-wo
Brint-wo.lead: Brint-wo was a large ringed planet that was orbitted by the Brint-wo Colony.

Bruss.title: Bruss

facts.region: Mid Rim, Kashyyyk Region, The Slice

Bruss.lead: Bruss was the first planet in the Boz Pity system.

Buchich.title: Buchich
Buchich.lead: Buchich was a planet located in the Buchich system, a part of the Calamari sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was linked by a hyperlane to the Krinemonen system.

Brightday.title: Brightday
Brightday.lead: A celestial body located in the Inner Rim, Brightday was the site of the Second Battle of Brightday during the 7811 BBY conflict known as the Waymancy Storm. In addition, more than a decade before the Clone Wars, the commanding officer Darsius deployed a line of cruisers at Brightday. Between 12 ABY and 13 ABY, Brightday was a part of the New Republic.

Byss.title: Byss/Legends

facts.region: Deep Core, Deep Core Security Zone
facts.terrain: Urban sprawls, Plateau reserves, Canyons, Lakes
facts.affiliation: Infinite Empire, Galactic Empire, Dark Empire, Imperial Remnant

Byss.lead: Byss was a planet in the Deep Core, near the center of the galaxy, discovered no earlier than 45 BBY. A local day lasted 31 standard hours, and a local year lasted 207 local days. It was the endpoint of the Byss Run.

Caamas.title: Caamas/Legends

facts.terrain: Historic:, Forests, Steppes, Hills, Modern:, Barren, rocky wasteland, Jungle
facts.affiliation: Infinite Empire, Herglic Trade Empire, Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Galactic Federation of Free Alliances

Caamas.lead: Caamas was a highly populated and marsh-covered Core World in the Cirius system, the second planet orbiting the star Cirius. It was notable for the devastation it suffered during an Imperial orbital bombardment which destroyed its ecosystem and nearly wiped out the native Caamasi.

Budpock.title: Budpock

facts.affiliation: Grissmath Dynasty, Galactic Empire, Alliance to Restore the Republic, New Republic

Budpock.lead: Budpock was a long time supporter of the Rebel Alliance and a New Republic-aligned planet in the Meridian sector. However, the world was also a haven for pirate gangs. Many of these groups were provoked by Dzym to attack neighboring Ampliquen, breaking the truce between Budpock and Ampliquen.

C-Foroon.title: C-Foroon

facts.affiliation: Hutt Cartel, Besadii kajidic, Gardulla the Elder's criminal empire, Jabba Desilijic Tiure's criminal empire, Desilijic kajidic

C-Foroon.lead: C-Foroon was a planet in the Arkanis sector of the Outer Rim.

Bunduki.title: Bunduki/Legends
Bunduki.lead: Bunduki was a planet in the Pacanth Reach. It was home to the Followers of Palawa, who developed the martial art of Teräs Käsi. Many of the Followers, including Arden Lyn, fell to the dark side of the Force and joined the Legions of Lettow. The planet was conquered by the Epicanthix.

Bundim.title: Bundim
Bundim.lead: Bundim was a planet in Trax sector where the Rebel Alliance lost the Battle of Heg. Commander Resner believed that Bundim was base of operations for the Alliance forces that began rebelling in Trax Sector, shortly after the Battle of Yavin. The planetary government secretly attempted to remove the Imperial presence from the planet, but an inside source alerted the Empire to Bundim's plans.

Byblos.title: Byblos/Legends
Byblos.lead: Byblos was a planet in the Colonies known for its technological advances. Byblos also made a name for itself through the company BlasTech Industries, which was founded during the era of the Old Republic. At the time of the Galactic Empire, the planet was considered one of the busiest and most important planets in the Colonies. However, Byblos was affected by the suppression of several alien species that were declared slaves by the Empire.

Butler's Cove.title: Butler's Cove
Butler's Cove.lead: Butler's Cove was a previously uninhabited planet in the Stribos system of the Core Worlds. The planet was chosen by Soron Hegerty as a refuge for the Ssither that managed to escape from the Demophon system. Unrecorded in Imperial records, it was named for the pirate who discovered it. He hoped to use the planet as a base from which to raid the Demophon system, but was killed on his first raid. All additional information on the planet perished with him.

Burska.title: Burska
Burska.lead: Burska was a little-known tundra planet located in the Mid Rim's freestanding subsectors. It had frequent, large-diameter hail and was home to a thick-hided, passive offshoot of the gundark species.

Caarimon.title: Caarimon
Caarimon.lead: Caarimon was a warm and steamy planet in the Outer Rim Territories.

Caaraz.title: Caaraz
Caaraz.lead: Caaraz was a tide-locked, tectonically active planet in the Outer Rim. Its night-side was frozen with glaciers. Its day-side was scorching. In between was a thin, habitable region in which the Ranth race evolved. Both sides of the planet were tectonically active as well, allowing subterranean gases, lava, and steam to escape into the atmosphere. The Galactic Empire discovered the world while looking for Rebel bases, and later mined the planet. Two moons also provided illumination to the night-side of the planet.

Caamor.title: Caamor
Caamor.lead: Caamor was the third planet in the Cirius system. It was a frozen ball of rock, and was orbited by a single moon.

Burnin Konn.title: Burnin Konn/Legends

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Western Reaches, Greater Javin
facts.sector: Javin sector (prior to c. 400 BBY), Anoat sector (c. 400 BBY—)

Burnin Konn.lead: Burnin Konn was an Outer Rim Territories mining planet located in the Anoat sector. It possessed rich deposits of various ores and was one of the four Mining Worlds controlled by the Figg family's corporate interests. Burnin Konn's native plants had all been stripped by the mining operations on the world.

Bulwark.title: Bulwark
Bulwark.lead: Bulwark was a planet located in the Bulwark system of Wild Space. During the Galactic Civil War, Bulwark served as a Alliance to Restore the Republic safe world—a designated planet where people connected with the Alliance could live free of oppression from the Galactic Empire. It was also among the few sites to which the Rebel Alliance allocated one of their v-150 Planet Defender ion cannons.

Bursoll II.title: Bursoll II
Bursoll II.lead: Bursoll II was a Wild Space planet whose flora included the rurylis flower. Upon the planet's discovery, the SoroSuub Corporation wished to use in manufacturing a rare radioactive mineral bountifully present on Bursoll II.

Burcana.title: Burcana
Burcana.lead: Burcana was the fifth planet of the Bestine system located in the Inner Rim Territories. It had four moons and its surface was frozen.

Cadannia.title: Cadannia
Cadannia.lead: Cadannia was a planet in the Mid Rim region of the galaxy presumably completely, or mostly covered in dense jungles or forests that produced some of the galaxy's strongest toxins.

Bundil.title: Bundil
Bundil.lead: Bundil was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories. During the Galactic Civil War, it was orbited by the Imperial XQ2 Platform Bundil II, where Rebel prisoners from Hoth were brought.

Buoyant.title: Buoyant
Buoyant.lead: Buoyant was an Inner Rim planet that was terraformed by a sentient species millennia before 54 BBY. The alterations made to Buoyant by the terraformers included an increased rotation rate as well as lush vegetation and imported animals, among them a long-necked herd quadruped.

Bureaucratosis.title: Bureaucratosis
Bureaucratosis.lead: Bureaucratosis was an entity in the galaxy that was represented by the Human Senator Yaun in the Senate of the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars of 22 BBY to 19 BBY and the Galactic Empire's Imperial Senate around 0 ABY.

Cadomai Prime.title: Cadomai Prime/Legends

facts.terrain: Tundra plains, Subterranean caverns, Mountains, Canyons
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire

Cadomai Prime.lead: Cadomai Prime, also known as simply Cadomai, was a planet located in the Outer Rim Territories' Catarlo sector, along the northern end of the major hyperlane known as the Hydian Way. A frigid world with intolerably cold winters, Cadomai's tundra plains were home to the Snivvians, a species renowned for its art. Cadomai held a large system of subterranean caverns, where the Snivvians made their homes during the subfreezing winters. The world possessed a single moon and was part of the Cadomai system.

Cal-Seti.title: Cal-Seti/Legends
Cal-Seti.lead: Cal-Seti was a planet located in the Core Worlds and was several sectors from N'zoth. It was at the intersection of the Agricultural Circuit and the Metellos Trade Route.

Cadinth.title: Cadinth

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Tion Cluster, The Slice
facts.affiliation: Kingdom of Cadinth, Three Allied Kingdoms, Xer's Empire, Xim's empire, Kingdom of Cron, Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire

Cadinth.lead: Cadinth was one of the original worlds in the Kingdom of Cron, and later Xim's empire. At the time of the Galactic Empire, Cadinth was a wealthy port and desert world in the Allied Tion sector. Its natural beauty was destroyed by industrialization, as was that of its neighbor, Lianna, leaving deserts of black sands and howling winds. Scattered in the wastes were the ruins of ancestral civilizations. Its population was concentrated in gloomy, sharp-featured cities that self-consciously evoked the distant past.

Calipsa.title: Calipsa
Calipsa.lead: Calipsa was a planet located in the Calipsa Province of the Tapani sector. From space, it was a dull, brown, almost lifeless world. Calipsa was a brown world of little vegetation, rich in natural ores. It was dominated by mining operations which caused much air pollution and hazy air, not entirely suitable for Human consumption. The raw materials mined from the systems of the Calipsa Province were shipped to Calipsa where they were processed into alloys for export. One of its few untouched wildernesses was the Crystal Forest.

Cadezia.title: Cadezia
Cadezia.lead: Cadezia was an Outer Rim planet in the same system as Trulalis and Issor. It was a prosperous technology and business world.

Calipp.title: Calipp
Calipp.lead: Calipp was a gas giant–type planet with twelve moons that was located in the Faarlsun system, a part of the Parthovian Cluster in Wild Space. The planet occupied the sixth and outermost orbit around its star, the yellow-white Faarlsun.

Calabosh-2.title: Calabosh-2
Calabosh-2.lead: Calabosh-2 was an astronomical object located in the Calabosh system, a part of the Expansion Region's Arc d'Stot sector. During the Galactic Civil War, it was the site of the main headquarters of the weapons manufacturer Caliban. The Human Corman Jeihn, who hailed from Calabosh-2, was employed with Caliban as a security guard at the time.

Calfa-5.title: Calfa-5
Calfa-5.lead: Calfa-5 was a planet that orbited a single star, which baked its desert moons.

Calline I.title: Calline system's first planet
Calline I.lead: The first planet of the Calline system orbited so close to the primary, it was hazardously hot and uninhabitable. The world had a dense metal core, making it, in theory, suitable for mining with extensive precautions. Calline I was surveyed by Rebel Alliance scouts searching for possible alternate bases around 2 ABY.

Calline III.title: Calline system's third planet
Calline III.lead: The third planet of the Calline system was a gas giant planet. It had no moons. Trace amounts of industrial grade gases were in its atmosphere.

Callonia.title: Callonia
Callonia.lead: Callonia was a planet in the Fakir sector of the Colonies. The GX1 Short Hauler, Long Shot, originally belonging to an Imperial admiral, was stolen by Reekeene's Roughnecks at Callonia's spaceport.

Calonica.title: Calonica
Calonica.lead: Calonica was an Expansion Region celestial body located in the Vensensor sector. During the Galactic Civil War it was the site of a Galactic Empire capital that was surrounded by fifty thousand buried LX-2 comlink mines. At one point, the Rebel Alliance managed to remotely deactivate the mines and then proceeded to steal the explosive charges from more than ninety percent of them, a fact that eventually led to the development of the LX-4 proton mine.

Calgon.title: Calgon
Calgon.lead: Calgon was a terrestrial celestial body situated in the Calgon system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Meridian sector. At some point during the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Rebel Alliance, a team of Rebel operatives unsuccessfully attempted to use stealth in approaching a target on Calgon. Later, one of the agents compared the incident to the team's plan of infiltrating an Imperial asteroid base by using grav-bikes, to which their fellow operative replied that they were not to blame for the events on Calgon.

Caloma.title: Caloma
Caloma.lead: Caloma was the sixth planet orbiting the star of Prael in the Japrael system. Located in the Japrael sector of the Inner Rim, it was a gas giant.

Cairns.title: Cairns
Cairns.lead: Cairns was the third planet orbiting the star Bright Jewel in the Bright Jewel system. Located in the Bright Jewel sector of the Mid Rim, it was a terrestrial world.

Cademimu V.title: Cademimu V
Cademimu V.lead: Cademimu V, also simply referred to as Cademimu, was a planet in the Cademimu sector along the Celanon Spur.

Caillte.title: Caillte
Caillte.lead: Caillte was the seventh planet of the Luire system, in the Mid Rim.

Calcoraan.title: Calcoraan
Calcoraan.lead: Calcoraan was a planet located in the Calcoraan system in the Inner Rim. It was entirely covered by an ocean made out of chromyl chloride, which gave the planet its blood red color, mixed with several other acids, making it uninhabitable. However, substances in both the planetary ocean and the ocean floor had uses in manufacturing, resulting in the construction of multiple space stations in Calcoraan's orbit. Count Denetrius Vidian had a storage facility orbiting this planet.

Cala.title: Cala

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Loyalists, Berch Teller's rebel cell

Cala.lead: Cala was a male Koorivar and an operations specialist. Five years after the formation of the Galactic Empire, Cala was part of a rebel cell led by Berch Teller. He participated in the theft of the Carrion Spike, personal starship of Imperial Governor Wilhuff Tarkin. Cala subsequently participated in a Berch Teller's insurgent campaign against the Empire. The insurgents were defeated by Tarkin at the Battle near the Gulf of Tatooine.

Cadomai.title: Cadomai Prime
Cadomai.lead: Cadomai Prime, also known as simply Cadomai, was a planet located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories, situated along the Hydian Way that was the homeworld of the Snivvian species. The winters of Cadomai Prime were very harsh for the Snivvians to survive, during which they spent the time in underground caverns in artistic pursuits. Some did escape the icy tundras to become bounty hunters offworld.

Canyon.title: Canyon
Canyon.lead: Canyon was a planet of arid mountains and plains in the Expansion Region, near Moorja.

Cantras Gola.title: Cantras Gola

facts.affiliation: Galactic Empire, Pentastar Alignment, New Republic

Cantras Gola.lead: Cantras Gola was a planet in the Perinn sector. It was a corporate planet controlled by PowerOn Conglomerate. During the Thrawn campaign, it decided to leave the Pentastar Alignment and join the New Republic. The Alignment threatened to kill the children of the ambassador of Cantras Gola if he had any sort of meeting with the New Republic. The children had been taken by slavers to Gabredor III. They were rescued by a Red Moons mercenary grup, allowing Cantras Gola to resume joining the New Republic.

Caluula.title: Caluula/Legends

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Greater Tion, Tion Cluster
facts.routes: Giblim Route, Lesser Cronese Arc, Tion Trade Route
facts.species: None, Historic:, Winged-star, Yuuzhan Vong, Chazrach, Human
facts.affiliation: Back Spiral, Xer's Empire, Xim's Empire, Tion Hegemony, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Caluula.lead: Caluula was a planet that made up part of the Kingdom of Cron and later Xim's Empire during the Pre-Republic era. After the empire's collapse, Caluula became part of the Tion Hegemony. Near the end of the Yuuzhan Vong War, the Yuuzhan Vong conquered the planet and sent many of its defenders to Coruscant for sacrifice. The planet was the site of a battle between the Yuuzhan Vong and the Galactic Alliance.

Canoliss IV.title: Canoliss IV
Canoliss IV.lead: Canoliss IV was a planet located within the Canoliss system of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of the Cannolite species.

Cantros 7.title: Cantros 7
Cantros 7.lead: Cantros 7, or simply Cantros, was a planet located within the Cantros system of the Outer Rim Territories' Saijo sector.

Caprioril.title: Caprioril

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Caprioril.lead: Caprioril was a planet located in the Core Worlds, near Chandrila. It was the site of the infamous Caprioril Massacre.

Canastra IV.title: Canastra IV
Canastra IV.lead: Canastra IV was a Core Worlds celestial body with coastal oceans on its surface. It was home to the amphibian herbivore known as the two-headed tortuce. On Canastra IV, several varieties of the creature existed that led different lifestyles. By the time of the Galactic Empire, the two-headed tortuce was hunted as a gourmet food source due to being seen as a delicacy throughout the Core Worlds.

Calus.title: Calus
Calus.lead: Calus was a planet in the Calus system of the Inner Rim, near Bestine IV. Sweet-sand cookies were made on Calus. It was located at the end of Keller's Void, opposite Wroona.

Camden.title: Camden
Camden.lead: Camden was a terrestrial planet located in the Camden system, a part of the Morshdine sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories. A hyperlane connected it to the Edusa and Vandyne systems.

Camos.title: Camos
Camos.lead: Camos was the sixth and most distant planet in the Utos system. It was a gas giant orbited by 31 moons.

Caloria.title: Caloria/Legends
Caloria.lead: Caloria was an astronomical object located in the Reena Province of the Tapani sector. It lay on the hyperlane known as the Caloria Run, which connected it to the Canti and Tanger systems.

Camus IV.title: Camus IV
Camus IV.lead: Camus IV was the fourth planet in the Camus system of the Illisurevimurasi sector, located within the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. Sometime prior to the Battle of Hoth in 3 ABY, the smugglers Han Solo and Chewbacca once vacationed on Camus IV, but Solo became seasick while floating among the planet's ocean waves.

Candoria.title: Candoria
Candoria.lead: Candoria was a depopulated planet located in the Colonies region of the galaxy.

Camillo.title: Camillo
Camillo.lead: Camillo was a hothouse planet with a toxic atmosphere, located in the Dantooine system, which in turn was found within the Raioballo sector of the Outer Rim.

Camooine.title: Camooine
Camooine.lead: Camooine was a terrestrial planet with three moons that occupied the third orbital position around the star Dina. It was located in the Dantooine system, a part of the Raioballo sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories. Along with the rest of its star system, Camooine was situated at the endpoint of the Myto's Arrow hyperspace route, which linked it to the Angor system, while the Veragi Trade Route connected it to the Ahakista and Sinsang systems.

Canterse Spread.title: Canterse Spread
Canterse Spread.lead: The Canterse Spread was an asteroid belt rotating around the star Julevia in its third orbit. Positioned between the planets Proxida and Gologry, it was located in the Julevian system, in the Dalonbian sector of the Outer Rim.

Capella.title: Capella
Capella.lead: Capella was a mining world located in the Capella system. It was situated in the Back Reach area of the Gordian Reach sector within the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. Capella was linked via hyperlane to the Arda and Little Capella systems. It was the origin point of Capellan turg-roots. Mining operations there were mostly carried out by droids and robominers manufactured by the inhabitants of the Arda system.

Candovant.title: Candovant
Candovant.lead: Candovant was a planet in the Candovant system of the Colonies region of the galaxy, situated along the Hydian Way and home to the Candovantan species. In the aftermath of the Battle of Endor in 4 ABY, the Galactic Empire targeted Candovant as part of Operation: Cinder, attempting to destroy the world after the death of Emperor Palpatine. The world ultimately saw the devastation of civilizations at the hands of Imperial fleets. Thirty years after the Battle of Endor, Candovant was a member world in the New Republic, where it was represented by Zygli Bruss in the Galactic Senate.

Camson.title: Camson
Camson.lead: Camson was a desert planet in the Camson system in the Abrion sector of the Outer Rim Territories that had at least one city.

Cantonica.title: Cantonica
Cantonica.lead: Cantonica was a desert planet in the Cantonica system within the Corporate Sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. The planet was home to the casino city Canto Bight, which was a destination for wealthy tourists, gamblers, and war profiteers. During the First Order-Resistance War in 34 ABY, the Resistance operatives Finn, Rose Tico, and BB-8 traveled to Cantonica on a mission to recruit the Master Codebreaker to disable the First Order's hyperspace tracker.

Carida.title: Carida/Legends

facts.terrain: Forests, Deserts, Glacier, Jungles, Arctic tundra
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire

Carida.lead: Carida, originally known as Ord Carida, was a planet of the Colonies region of the galaxy, near the Perlemian Trade Route, and the homeworld of the Caridan race.

Cardooine.title: Cardooine/Legends

facts.affiliation: Alliance to Restore the Republic, Galactic Empire

Cardooine.lead: Cardooine was a planet in the Jospro sector of the Outer Rim., It was where the Rebel Alliance built A-wings used in the Battle of Endor. It was also the home of Fijisi wood, used in sections of the Imperial Palace on Coruscant and other high-class buildings. Less pleasantly, the disease Cardooine Chills also originated on this planet.

Capza.title: Capza

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories; Imperial Space, New Territories
facts.affiliation: Velcar Free Commerce Zone, Galactic Empire, Pentastar Alignment, Imperial Remnant, Fel Empire, Empire-in-exile

Capza.lead: Capza was a lush, tropical planet in the Velcar Free Commerce Zone. It was also home to Commerce Master Commissioner Gregor Raquoran.

Caramm V.title: Caramm V/Legends
Caramm V.lead: Caramm V was the beautiful fifth planet of the Talcene sector's Caramm system, part of the Slice portion of the Mid Rim.

Carosi IV.title: Carosi IV
Carosi IV.lead: Carosi IV was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories destroyed by the expansion of the star Carosi into a red giant. The indigenous Carosites had fled the planet beforehand to Carosi XII.

Cari.title: Cari
Cari.lead: Cari was a gas giant that was located within the Carida system in the Colonies region of the galaxy. Like all planets in the Carida system, it was destroyed by the renegade Jedi student Kyp Durron, who used a superweapon known as the Sun Crusher to cause its primary star to go Supernova.

Carosi V.title: Carosi V
Carosi V.lead: Carosi V was a planet in the Carosus system. It was considered a prime candidate for colonization, until it was destroyed in the expansion of the star Carosi into a red giant.

Carosi IX.title: Carosi IX
Carosi IX.lead: Carosi IX was a planet in the Carosus system. It was a gas giant with six moons.

Carnth.title: Carnth
Carnth.lead: Carnth was a Mid Rim world located in the M'shinni sector. During the Galactic Civil War, the Galactic Empire's prefect on Carnth promised the farmers of a local village substantial rewards for remaining loyal to the Empire, which hampered the Rebel Alliance's efforts to establish a small base at the settlement. Eventually, Airen Cracken led a Rebel force in an assault on the village that ultimately resulted in the settlement aligning itself with the Alliance.

Carba Asteroid Belt.title: Carba Asteroid Belt
Carba Asteroid Belt.lead: The Carba Asteroid Belt was a particularly dense, large and dangerous to navigate asteroid field in the Bacrana system. It occupied the third orbit between the planets of Bacrana and Tomik.

Caprol.title: Caprol
Caprol.lead: Caprol was the second planet in the Vaxal system. It was a moonless, barren rock.

Carbos Thirteen.title: Carbos Thirteen
Carbos Thirteen.lead: Carbos Thirteen was a planet around which a space battle between Admiral Nek Bwua'tu and the Corellian and Bothan fleets of the Confederation was conducted during the weeks that followed the Second Battle of Fondor. Admiral Bwua'tu managed to ensnare both opposing fleets near the planet, eliminating a large percentage of the warships that supported the Confederation.

Carnovia.title: Carnovia
Carnovia.lead: Carnovia was a humid waterworld located in the Carnovia system, a part of the Hutt Space portion of the Slice. The Kaaga Run hyperlane linked it to the Circumtore and Nar Kaaga systems. The depths of Carnovia were inhabited by gigantic creatures known as the Carnovian eels. On that world, many beings enslaved by members of the Hutt species worked at pens where young Carnovian eels were raised due to the Hutts considering them delicacies. Besides eel farming, Carnovia was also known for the production of foodstuffs in general.

Carlania.title: Carlania system/Legends
Carlania.lead: The Carlania system was located in the Interior Region, an area of the Hapes Cluster in the Slice portion of the Inner Rim. It was connected via hyperlanes to the Arabanth and Ediorung systems. The Carlania system was the origin point of Carlanian volcanic pipes.

Carcel.title: Carcel
Carcel.lead: Carcel was a planet located in the Expansion Region, and was described by Tobb Jadak as a miserable piece of rock. Carcel had a prison that Jadak and Flitcher Poste visited Rej Taunt in.

Carlac.title: Carlac/Legends
Carlac.lead: Carlac was a peaceful, snow-covered planet in the Outer Rim Territories. A town inhabited by members of the Ming Po culture existed on the planet during the Clone Wars. However, that village was burned to the ground by Death Watch, a radical Mandalorian Terrorist group.

Carlix's Folly.title: Carlix's Folly
Carlix's Folly.lead: Carlix's Folly was one of the many planetary haunts of Captain Ellin Lah and her crew from Woebegone frequented.

Carnelion IV.title: Carnelion IV
Carnelion IV.lead: Carnelion IV, also known simply as Carnelion, was an icy planet located in the Carnelion system in Wild Space. Generations before the Invasion of Naboo, a war was fought by the people of the planet, which resulted in their demise, and placed a sea of toxic gas over the remains of their civilization. Between the war's destruction and the dense debris field surrounding the planet, no one ever visited the world.

Cardota.title: Cardota
Cardota.lead: Cardota, also known as Hosnian Cardota, was one of the five planets that made up the Hosnian system, in the Core region of the galaxy. The system, including Cardota, was destroyed by the First Order in 34 ABY.

Castell.title: Castell/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Yuuzhan Vong empire, Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire

Castell.lead: Castell was a terrestrial planet located along the Perlemian Trade Route in the Colonies region of the galaxy. The homeworld of the Gossam, Castell was a major foundry planet for the Commerce Guild.

Cathar.title: Cathar/Legends
Cathar.lead: The Cathar were a species of feline, bipedal humanoids native to Cathar, a planet of savannas and rough uplands. They were known for their loyalty, passion, and temper. Quick and powerful, they were considered great warriors and dedicated, efficient predators.

Cassander.title: Cassander

facts.affiliation: Galactic Empire, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire, Galactic Alliance (likely)

Cassander.lead: Cassander – originally known as Cassander's Star – was the chief planet of the Cassandran sectors. It was the sector capital of Cassander sector under the New Order, and it was on the Braxant Run.

Cartao.title: Cartao/Legends
Cartao.lead: Cartao was a planet in the Prackla sector. The siviviv vine was native to Cartao, and it was the homeworld of the Cranscoc.

Carratos.title: Carratos

facts.affiliation: Pirates, Galactic Empire, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Carratos.lead: Carratos was a planet in the Inner Rim, roughly forty parsecs from Coruscant.

Carosi XII.title: Carosi XII

facts.affiliation: Alliance to Restore the Republic, New Republic

Carosi XII.lead: Carosi XII was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories colonized by the Carosites in 200 BBY after the destruction of Carosi IV. It was best known as a center of healing and tourism, attracting numerous and diverse visitors due to its location along a prominent trade route. Because it was also one of the few worlds to openly support the Rebel Alliance, Carosi XII also served as a safe-haven for free-traders and Alliance and New Republic agents.

Carrivar.title: Carrivar
Carrivar.lead: Carrivar was an astronomical object in the Unknown Regions' Carrivar system. The sentient species Hemes Arbora was native to Carrivar but eventually abandoned the celestial body. The Hemes Arbora migrated first to the planet Umaren'k in the Umaren'k system and later to the planet Osseriton. In 80 BBY, Succate, a chronicler from Carrivar, assembled the largest collection of information on the Sorcerers of Rhand, a group of beings who believed in the philosophical concept known as the Dark.

Carosi VI.title: Carosi VI
Carosi VI.lead: Carosi VI was a planet in the Carosus system. Originally the sixth orbit in the system, it became the first following the expansion of the star Carosi into a red giant and the subsequent destruction of system's first five planets. Prior to the expansion, it was considered to be a world suitable for terraforming, but Carosi's expansions burned away any life-sustaining potential.

Carosi VII.title: Carosi VII
Carosi VII.lead: Carosi VII was a planet in the Carosus system. Following the expansion of Carosi into a red giant, Carosi VII became a hot, swampy planet that was deemed suitable for colonization by the Carosites at a later date. It was orbited by a single moon.

Carosi VIII.title: Carosi VIII
Carosi VIII.lead: Carosi VIII was a planet in the Carosus system. It was a hot, jungle planet deemed suitable for future Carosite colonization efforts. It had two moons.

Carosi X.title: Carosi X
Carosi X.lead: Carosi X was the tenth planet in the Carosus system of the Outer Rim Territories. Carosi X was a gas giant in orbit around the star Carosi. The planet had ten moons. When the Carosus system's sun expanded to become a red giant at around 200 BBY, it consumed the five innermost worlds in the system. Because of this, Carosi X became the fifth planet in the Carosus system.

Carosi XI.title: Carosi XI
Carosi XI.lead: Carosi XI was a planet in the Carosus system. It was a gas giant with fifteen moons.

Casna Aure.title: Casna Aure
Casna Aure.lead: Casna Aure was the ninth planet in the Kamino system. It was a gas giant orbited by 28 moons.

Casna Besh.title: Casna Besh
Casna Besh.lead: Casna Besh was the tenth planet in the Kamino system. It was an enormous gas giant orbited by a staggering 43 moons and captured wandering comets and asteroids at a rate of roughly two every millennium.

Casfield 6.title: Casfield 6
Casfield 6.lead: Casfield 6 was a planet in the Casfield system. Incoming starship traffic was managed by droids. A six-ship collision resulted in the death of the 6,000 year old Queen of the Offens.

Carsanza.title: Carsanza
Carsanza.lead: Carsanza was a minor industrial world located in the Carsanza system of the Juvex sector, a part of the Senex-Juvex region in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim. Hyperlanes connected Carsanza to the Malador, Valorsi, and Zyluria systems. Like the rest of the Senex-Juvex worlds, Carsanza was under the control of the region's aristocratic Ancient Houses.

Cataalda.title: Cataalda
Cataalda.lead: Cataalda was a planet in a seldom-traveled part of the Mid Rim.

Casparar.title: Casparar
Casparar.lead: Casparar was the second planet orbiting the star Stisste in the Saleucami system. Located in the Suolriep sector of the Outer Rim Territories, it was an aquatic world.

Carto Asteroid Belt.title: Carto Asteroid Belt
Carto Asteroid Belt.lead: The Carto Asteroid Belt was an asteroid belt in the Expansion Region.

Carreras Minor.title: Carreras Minor
Carreras Minor.lead: Carreras Minor was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories. In 138 ABY, an ice mining platform was operational on the planet's ring.

Cato Neimoidia.title: Cato Neimoidia/Legends

facts.affiliation: Neimoidian Inner Circle, Galactic Republic, Trade Federation, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Separatist holdouts (briefly), Galactic Empire, New Republic …

Cato Neimoidia.lead: The oldest of the Neimoidian purse worlds, Cato Neimoidia was the location of Nute Gunray's secret redoubt. The planet was near the Neimoidian homeworld of Neimoidia, also in the Colonies region.

Cerea.title: Cerea/Legends

facts.routes: Cerean Reach, Great Gran Run, Spar Trade Route
facts.terrain: Farmland, Forests, Rolling hills, Rural villages
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire, Galactic Alliance Remnant

Cerea.lead: Cerea was a planet located in the Mid Rim region of the galaxy. The homeworld of the Cerean species, Cerea was notable for its inhabitants' harmonious relationship with nature. Technology and pollution were frowned upon by the conservative government, a major point in the planet's decision not to join the Galactic Republic. The Cerean population mainly lived in giant buildings that took up a minimum of space, allowing the remainder of the planet's area to be employed as farmland.

Centares.title: Centares/Legends

facts.routes: Perlemian Trade Route, Triellus Trade Route
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Greater Maldrood, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Centares.lead: Centares was a planet in the Maldrood sector of the Mid Rim. It had a temperate climate and no moons.

Cattamascar.title: Cattamascar
Cattamascar.lead: Cattamascar was a planet in the Bakura sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Celanon.title: Celanon/Legends

facts.routes: Celanon Spur, Hydian Way, Spurs of Celanon
facts.population: 26 million (permanent), up to 40 million additional transients, 10 million to 100 million (c. 25 ABY)
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders, Darth Revan's Sith Empire, Brotherhood of Darkness, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire …

Celanon.lead: Celanon was an important spaceport on the Celanon Spur, in the Outer Rim Territories, and was the Nalroni homeworld.

Ceriun.title: Ceriun
Ceriun.lead: Ceriun was a terrestrial world that was located in the Ceriun system of the Outer Rim Territories. Around 1000 BBY, a tattooed Sith journeyed to the planet to retrieve a Sith holocron that had been taken there by a Jedi.

Celegia.title: Celegia

facts.region: Expansion Region, The Slice, Exploitation Region (c. 17,000 BBY)
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Grand Companies, Galactic Empire

Celegia.lead: Celegia was an Expansion Region world of raging seas. Its atmosphere was rich in the toxic cyanogen gas, and it was the homeworld of the sentient Celegians. Due to oxygen being lethal to the Celegians, they had to use special life support chambers when traveling off-world. Celegia had become a part of the Galactic Republic by approximately 17,000 BBY and was a member of the Galactic Empire in 17 BBY.

Caursito.title: Caursito
Caursito.lead: Caursito was a planet in the Colonies that Lieutenant Mavron stopped at to pick up a copy of the TriNebulon News on his way back to the Star Destroyer Chimaera during the Caamas Document Crisis.

Cavas.title: Cavas/Legends

facts.routes: Commenor Run, Hydian Way, Brentaal–Denon Route, Corsin Run, Perlemian Trade Route

Cavas.lead: Cavas was the sixth planet in the Brentaal system. It was a gas giant orbited by only two moons.

Cauper.title: Cauper system/Legends
Cauper.lead: The Cauper system was a star system located in the Tapani sector's Melantha Province, between the Ricaldi and Bilios systems.

Cejansij.title: Cejansij

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Cejansij.lead: Cejansij was the Cejansiji homeworld. It was known for its canyon dwellings.

Cessed.title: Cessed
Cessed.lead: Cessed was the planet closest to the sun in the Csilla system, which was located within Chiss Space in the Unknown Regions. It was uninhabited due to the searing hot temperatures emanating from the sun.

Celen.title: Celen
Celen.lead: Celen was a planet in the Halla sector of the Mid Rim of The galaxy. A terrestrial world with a Human population, they raised nerfs as well as banthas.

Cel Amiin.title: Cel Amiin
Cel Amiin.lead: Cel Amiin was a remote planet in the Expansion Region of the galaxy that defied Emperor Palpatine shortly after the formation of the Galactic Empire. Like the other worlds that refused to cooperate, Cel Amiin suffered an unspecified devastation as a result.

Caulus Tertius.title: Caulus Tertius
Caulus Tertius.lead: Caulus Tertius was a planet located in the Inner Rim. No life existed on the planet, although there was evidence to suggest it once supported life. An ophidian grotesque sculpture had been discovered at some point in galactic history, which had been much older than the one found on Coruscant. This sculpture, alongside its Coruscanti counterpart, were later mentioned by Dr. Insmot Bowen in a debriefing in 1 BBY on Coruscant, where he mentioned that it might have been one of the remaining hints to the Celestials.

Catlia.title: Catlia
Catlia.lead: Catlia was a planet that was located within the Catlia system, in the Chiss Space area of the galaxy's Unknown Regions. It was connected by the Phalanx Route hyperlane to the planet Cormit. Catlia was an outlying colony of the sentient Chiss species, and was home to one of the Ruling Families that ruled over the Chiss Ascendancy, the government of the Chiss.

Celwis.title: Celwis/Legends
Celwis.lead: Celwis was a planet of the Chiss Ascendancy in the Celwis system of the Unknown Regions. It was located on the Vagaari Corridor, a hyperlane that ran through the Unknown Regions. Celwis was once regularly attacked by alien aggressors, but it eventually became a demonstration of Chiss military strength shortly after the formation of the Chiss Expansionary Defense Force.

Caulbon.title: Caulbon
Caulbon.lead: Caulbon was an astronomical object located in the Caulbon system, a part of the Western Reaches portion of the Inner Rim. Around 17,000 BBY, it was situated outside of the borders of the Galactic Republic and was a part of Herglic Space, territory that fell under the control of the Herglic species of the Giju system.

Ceitia Five.title: Ceitia Five
Ceitia Five.lead: Ceitia Five was a planet located within the Mid Rim. In 138 ABY, Darth Wredd attacked and killed a One Sith member who had infiltrated the legislature of the Galactic Federation Triumvirate on the planet.

Chad.title: Chad/Legends
Chad.lead: The planet Chad (also known as Chadra or Chad III) was the homeworld of the Chadra-Fan race. It was in the Outer Rim Territories, more specifically in the Slice.

Chandrila.title: Chandrila/Legends

facts.region: Core Worlds, Ringali Shell, Northern Dependencies, The Slice, Arrowhead, Sector 3
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Brotherhood of Darkness, Galactic Empire, Alliance to Restore the Republic, Alliance of Free Planets, New Republic

Chandrila.lead: Chandrila was an agriworld located in the Chandrila system of the Core Worlds' Bormea sector. The planet had two continents and two moons—Chandra and Chandrakant—and lay on the Perlemian Trade Route. The world was relatively rural, though it had 1.2 billion residents and was home to several cities.

Ch'hodos.title: Ch'hodos
Ch'hodos.lead: Ch'hodos was a rocky desert planet that orbited a red sun within the Outer Rim Territories' Sith Worlds region. Ch'hodos was considered a lesser world of the Sith Empire and served as the central base of the Sith Lord Shar Dakhan by the year 5000 BBY.

Chalcedon.title: Chalcedon/Legends
Chalcedon.lead: Chalcedon was a planet in Tashtor sector of the Mid Rim.

Champala.title: Champala/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Alliance of Free Planets, New Republic, Galactic Federation of Free Alliances

Champala.lead: Champala, also called "Chagria," was a planet in the Inner Rim and the homeworld of the Chagrian people. Most of its starports were high and dry on plateaus, but its cities were submerged at high tide. It was a popular resort world.

Challon.title: Challon
Challon.lead: Challon was a planet in the Core Worlds that remained neutral during the Galactic Civil War. While on Challon, Leia Organa tried to convince local Governor Tchai to support the Rebel Alliance. Organa was forced to kill Giles Durane, her "weapons master," in self-defense.

Chalacta.title: Chalacta/Legends

facts.terrain: Jagged mountains, Dry and dusty valleys
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Hutt Cartel, Brotherhood of Darkness, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Chalacta.lead: Chalacta was a Mid Rim planet, homeworld of the Chalactan Adepts.

Chamble.title: Chamble/Legends
Chamble.lead: Chamble was a planet in the Mid Rim where Bansche Tech was headquartered. After the Battle of Yavin, the corporation was nationalized by the Empire, dealing a heavy blow to the Ralltiir Exchange.

Cesya.title: Cesya system/Legends
Cesya.lead: The Cesya system was a star system located in the Tapani sector's Cadriaan Province, between the Listoria and Achillea systems.

Chandaar.title: Chandaar

facts.affiliation: Kingdom of Cron, Xer's Empire, Xim's empire, Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire

Chandaar.lead: Chandaar was the throneworld of the Kingdom of Cron following the death of Xim the Despot, it had been conquered by Xim's father. Many years later, it became capital of the Cronese Mandate under the Galactic Empire and was the headquarters of numerous Cronese mining companies. It was known as the "Jewel of the Tion", but by the time of the Galactic Civil War, the Cronese Kings were mere figureheads and the planet was a polluted urban world, covered with both decaying cities and ancient ruins.

Chaasch.title: Chaasch
Chaasch.lead: Chaasch was the eighth planet in the Suolriep system. Its eighth moon was New Kisge.

Chabosh.title: Chabosh

facts.affiliation: Alliance to Restore the Republic, Galactic Empire

Chabosh.lead: Chabosh was a planet located in the Chabosh system within the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. The planet was the site of the Battle of Chabosh where Sith Lord Tulak Hord, his apprentice Ortan Cela, and their Dashade Shadow Killers Khem Val and Veshikk Urk led Sith Empire to victory over the rebel and Jedi forces stationed on the planet following the Battle of Yn. It was during this battle that Tulak Hord performed a ritual that allowed him to draw the strength of his enemies into himself.

Chaastern 4.title: Chaastern 4
Chaastern 4.lead: Chaastern 4 was a planet in the Shelsha sector. By 0.5 ABY it was home to one of the only two remaining Imperial army garrisons in the sector, the other being located on Minkring.

Chanosant.title: Chanosant
Chanosant.lead: Chanosant was a world in the Expansion Region's Chanosant system. During the Clone Wars, it was the site of a Separatist convention which was attended by Count Dooku and held during the Clone Wars. Dooku and Kob Mondray attended it and tried to use it to rally more support for the CIS.

Chaitun.title: Chaitun
Chaitun.lead: Chaitun was the first planet orbiting the star Sriluur in the Sriluur system. Located in the Tharin sector of the Outer Rim, it was a searing rock.

Chandel.title: Chandel
Chandel.lead: Chandel was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories, specifically at Standard Galactic Grid square N-6. It lay within the Chandel system of the Ojoster sector, which was also a part of the New Territories. Chandel had water covering its surface and appeared blue from space. Bev Kranti clams, which produced valuable pearls, could be found buried in the seabed beneath Chandel's ocean.

Chaaktil.title: Chaaktil
Chaaktil.lead: Chaaktil was a desert planet located in the Chaaktil system in the Inner Rim, in grid square N-14 on the Standard Galactic Grid. It had many cities, such as Chaako City. The bounty hunter Bazine Netal grew up on Chaaktil, where she learned a range of deadly martial arts at Delphi Kloda's combat school. Chaaktil was also the homeworld of Vi Moradi.

Chagar IX.title: Chagar IX
Chagar IX.lead: Chagar IX, also known as Chagar, was a world located in the Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of stormtrooper Sergeant Kreel, and fell under the control of the Galactic Empire in Kreel's youth.

Chal Hudda.title: Chal Hudda
Chal Hudda.lead: Chal Hudda was a marsh-covered planet of the Outer Rim Territories that had a soupy green atmosphere. Because its natural resources held use for almost no life-forms except the native Chalhuddans, that world was of interest to virtually no one else. In 3 BBY, Princess Leia Organa of Alderaan traveled to Chal Hudda on a mercy mission.

Charny.title: Charny
Charny.lead: Charny was the second planet orbiting the star Hoth's Brand in the Ruusan system. Located in the Teraab sector of the Mid Rim, it was a terrestrial world.

Charubah.title: Charubah

facts.region: Inner Rim; Transitory Mists, The Slice

Charubah.lead: Charubah was a technology-oriented planet located within the Hapes Cluster, and famed for their Guns of Command designed by Royal Armaments Guild of Charubah.

Chazwa.title: Chazwa/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire

Chazwa.lead: Chazwa was a cold planet in the Chazwa system of the Orus sector, located in the Inner Rim. Its location along a popular freighter traffic route made it an ideal shipping center for all sorts of goods. As such, heavy freighter traffic within the system was not an uncommon sight. However, the abundance of valuable merchandise moving through the system lent itself to strong influence by smugglers.

Charmath.title: Charmath
Charmath.lead: Charmath was a planet in the Farrfin sector of the Galactic Core with one of the galaxy's most complete historical archives.

Charros IV.title: Charros IV/Legends

facts.routes: Great Kashyyyk Branch, Lesser Lantillian Route
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Trade Federation, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Greater Maldrood, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Charros IV.lead: Charros IV, also referred to simply as Charros, was an arid planet in the Mid Rim with high plateaus, snow-capped mountains, and black-water lakes.

Chardaan.title: Chardaan/Legends

facts.routes: Hydian Way, Itani Run, Shipwrights' Trace
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Corellian Hegemony, Darth Revan's Sith Empire, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Chardaan.lead: Chardaan was an Inner Rim world that lay at the intersection of the Hydian Way and Shipwrights' Trace. The planet was orbited by the Chardaan Shipyards.

Chel.title: Chel
Chel.lead: Chel was a terrestrial planet in the Deep Core's Beshqek system. It occupied the first orbital position around the star Beshqek, had a barren rock surface and no moons.

Chav.title: Chav
Chav.lead: Chav was the tenth and last planet of the Dathomir system, a part of the Quelii sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories. A world made of barren rock, it had two moons and orbited the star Domir.

Cheelit.title: Cheelit/Legends
Cheelit.lead: Cheelit was a planet in the Cheelit system, located in the Mid Rim's Semagi sector along the Cerean Reach. Cheelit was home to the J'feh, a race of sentient cephalopods that lived within large, floating globes. Cheelit's ornate Hive Palace was the home of the Lady Dhol during the era of the Galactic Civil War, until Dhol hired the Guild of Vindicators assassin Clat the Shamer to kill the Sith Lord Darth Vader during a game of firepath—Vader anticipated her treachery and killed them both.

Chateuse VII.title: Chateuse VII
Chateuse VII.lead: Chateuse VII was a world located in the Tungra sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Charenthoth.title: Charenthoth
Charenthoth.lead: Charenthoth was a celestial body located in the Charenthoth system, a part of the Slice portion of the Colonies. During the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Rebel Alliance, the Battle Chant of the Alliance's Legion of Alderaan military unit mentioned the Rebels fighting the Imperial forces "in the night of Charenthoth," among other locales.

Charis.title: Charis
Charis.lead: Charis was a planet in the system of the same name on the Trition Trade Route in the Kathol sector of the Outer Rim Territories. An important industrial base for the sector, the population of the planet staged an uprising against the local Imperial warlord—Moff Kentor Sarne—and his forces in 4 ABY. Sarne's forces assaulted the world, laying waste to many of the major cities and reducing the planetary population from one billion to 850 million.

Chasin.title: Chasin
Chasin.lead: Its government was among the first to throw its support behind Corellia in 40 ABY during the Second Galactic Civil War.

Chekria.title: Chekria
Chekria.lead: Chekria was a planet that was the target of attacks by pirates.

Cheeyoom Matee.title: Cheeyoom Matee
Cheeyoom Matee.lead: Cheeyoom Matee was a planet home to a Rebel base. It was located in the Core Worlds.

Charon homeworld.title: Charon homeworld
Charon homeworld.lead: The homeworld of the Charon species was located in otherspace. It was located near a massive black hole.

Charra.title: Charra/Legends
Charra.lead: Charra was a planet in the Expansion Region that produced caf.

Chashima.title: Chashima
Chashima.lead: Chashima was a temperate and forested planet with fields of drymoss in the Chashima system of the Auril sector. During the Yuuzhan Vong War, the extragalactic Yuuzhan Vong set up a research facility for shapers working on the commbuzzer, a type of beetle designed to home in on comlink transmissions. The facility was sabotaged in 29 ABY by Wraith Squadron, but the operation came at the cost of Wraiths Estoric Sandskimmer and Hohass Ekwesh.

Charros.title: Charros IV

facts.routes: Great Kashyyyk Branch, Zeltros–Junkfort Station hyperlane
facts.affiliation: Galactic Empire, Alliance to Restore the Republic, New Republic

Charros.lead: Charros IV was a planet in the Mid Rim Territories' Numesira sector. It was the site of the Xi Char Cathedral factories, where members of the Xi Charrian species produced the Vulture-class starfighter "vulture droid." During the Galactic Civil War, the Rebel Alliance was forced to retreat from Charros IV, expecting the Galactic Empire to soon retake the world.

Chasmeene.title: Chasmeene
Chasmeene.lead: Chasmeene was a planet that was punished for failing to meet Imperial quotas by the irradiation of vast swaths of its farmland. As a result, it was stricken by famine for years. In 3 BBY, Princess Leia Organa of Alderaan undertook a relief mission to the planet and brought food, seeds, and agricultural equipment. She instructed R2-D2 to collect scans of the planet to prove its devastation was the Empire's fault. The droid also collected additional data to back up the scans taken, which Organa transferred to several datacards.

Cholganna.title: Cholganna/Legends

facts.climate: Cool in the north, Warm in the south

Cholganna.lead: Cholganna was a planet best known for its cool forests and dangerous creatures. It was home to the nexu, a predatory feline. Animals such as the arboreal octopus and the bark rat were also plentiful on the planet. Both were known prey of the nexu.

Chorax.title: Chorax
Chorax.lead: Chorax was a planet in the Rachuk sector, which lay between Commenor and Talasea. It was the sole planet of the Chorax system, a haven for pirates and smugglers.

Chroma Zed.title: Chroma Zed

facts.affiliation: Galactic Empire, Diversity Alliance, New Republic, Cooperative Council of Independent Planetary Governments

Chroma Zed.lead: Chroma Zed was a terrestrial planet located in the Maerdocian sector of the galaxy's Mid Rim. Home to the wormlike humanoid Chromans, who lived in moist mountain burrows near water, the planet featured some of the most magnificent amphitheater facilities, including one with twin waterfalls.

Chortose.title: Chortose/Legends
Chortose.lead: Chortose was an astronomical object located in the Chortose system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Rseik sector. It was the homeworld of the sentient Chortose species, including the engineer and starship mechanic Porgo Goo.

Chibias.title: Chibias/Legends
Chibias.lead: Chibias was a Mid Rim world near Sibisime.

Chirgay.title: Chirgay
Chirgay.lead: Chirgay was an ice planet located in the Dathomir system, a part of the Quelii sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories. A cold planet, it occupied the ninth orbital position around its star, Domir. It was itself circled by one moon.

Chrellis.title: Chrellis
Chrellis.lead: Chrellis was a tiny planetoid located in the Chrellis system, a part of the Lahara sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories. Following the foundation of the Rebel Alliance in 2 BBY, the first base of the Alliance High Command, named Chrellis Base, was established on the planetoid under the command of the Human General Jan Dodonna.

Choi.title: Choi
Choi.lead: Choi was a world located in the Inner Rim. It was the homeworld of the Choi species.

Chromovon.title: Chromovon
Chromovon.lead: Chromovon was a planet that contained an Imperial prison.

Chennis.title: Chennis
Chennis.lead: Chennis was a planet in the Expansion Region that had lost its bacta manufacturing capability.

Christophsis.title: Christophsis/Legends

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, The Slice, Trailing Sectors
facts.affiliation: Confederacy of Independent Systems, Retail Caucus, Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire

Christophsis.lead: Christophsis was a crystalline world in the Outer Rim Territories' Savareen sector. Orbited by a single moon amongst the mineral-rich asteroids of the Christoph system, Christophsis was for a time a target for stray rocks because of its closeness to various asteroid belts, but the planet was refined by Tepasi nobles around 600 BBY, and later by the world's native Christophsian inhabitants, who originated as Humans from the Core. Christophsis was eventually protected from the asteroids and transformed into the center of a mining hub.

Chokan.title: Chokan
Chokan.lead: Chokan was a planet on the Gamor Run in the Mid Rim's Maerdocian sector.

Chem.title: Chem
Chem.lead: Chem was the seventh planet orbiting the star Utapau in the Utapau system. Located in the Tarabba sector of the Outer Rim Territories, it was a gas giant.

Cheravh.title: Cheravh
Cheravh.lead: Cheravh was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories' Mandalore sector, located within the Cheravh system. Like most worlds contained within the surrounding sector, Cheravh was covered in hard frontier country, and came under the control of the Mandalorians following their expanding conquest of the sector during their time as Mandalorian Crusaders.

Chenowei.title: Chenowei
Chenowei.lead: Chenowei was a terrestrial world located in the Chenowei system. It was situated in the Back Reach area of the Gordian Reach sector, within the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The hyperlane known as the Ardan Cross connected it to the Atorra and B'trilla systems, while a smaller hyperspace route linked it to the Elamposnia system. A simple, rustic world, Chenowei was dominated by Human members of the anti-technological Church of the Light religion.

Choah Belt.title: Choah Belt/Legends
Choah Belt.lead: Choah Belt was an asteroid belt in the Mortex sector of the Outer Rim Territories. During the Galactic War, it was rumored that the long-dead crime lord Shisha Mor had used one of the asteroids as a hideout. The Alliance to Restore the Republic maintained a fuel refinery in the asteroid field until shortly after the Battle of Yavin. The Galactic Empire discovered its location and destroyed it, forcing the Alliance to try and hijack the Black Ice.

Chirrion.title: Chirrion (disambiguation)
Chirrion.lead: Chirrion may refer to one of the following:

Chol.title: Chol
Chol.lead: Chol was a planet in the Cholganna system of the Outer Rim Territories. It orbited the star Chol, with three larger planets orbiting further away than it, Cholganna, Ryien and Be'ekk. It was brown in color. The Cholganna system was partially engulfed by the Chol Nebula, and the planets in the Star system passed through the nebula during their orbit.

Chiron.title: Chiron

facts.affiliation: Galactic Empire, Imperial Military, Imperial Officer Corps

Chiron.lead: Chiron was a lieutenant of the Galactic Empire, stationed at the Academy for Young Imperials on Lothal. He was an enthusiastic officer who would often lead cadets in song during morning runs. Chiron took a special liking to one such cadet the Academy, Zare Leonis, believing him to be a fine example of a model officer and often tried to protect Leonis from the more officious bureaucrats within the Academy.

Chosper.title: Chosper system
Chosper.lead: The Chosper system was a star system located in the Hapes Cluster of the Inner Rim Territories. It was situated in grid square O-9 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

Cinnatar.title: Cinnatar

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, New Territories, Trans-Hydian

Cinnatar.lead: Cinnatar was a planet located in the Sorrus system of the Outer Rim Territories. It was ruled by a Republic governor.

Chrona.title: Chrona/Legends

facts.terrain: Plains, Forested mountain ranges, Humid equatorial belt

Chrona.lead: Chrona was an agriworld in the Inner Rim, near the Vaathkree Trade Corridor. Banthas were raised and primacale crops were grown on the planet. During the final days of the Galactic Republic, chronamite was discovered on the planet.

Circarpous IV.title: Circarpous IV

facts.affiliation: Sith Empire, Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Circarpous IV.lead: Circarpous IV, often called simply Circarpous, was a planet in the Expansion Region, one of the financial capitals of the region.

Churruma.title: Churruma

facts.affiliation: Churruma natives, Galactic Empire, Pentastar Alignment, Imperial Remnant

Churruma.lead: Churruma was a planet with deposits of valuable metals that was located within the Velcar sector of the Outer Rim Territories. During the Galactic Civil War, the Galactic Empire mined Churruma's metals and captured the shaman Chrech Estha, a respected leader of the planet's natives who possessed a carved stick that served as a powerful political and religious symbol on his homeworld. The return of Estha and the stick to Churruma sparked a rebellion that ended the Empire's presence on the planet.

Cilpar.title: Cilpar
Cilpar.lead: Cilpar was an agriworld in the Colonies, nearly covered in mountains, jungles, and forests. It was characterized by the near-indestructible ancient temples scattered across the surface. Local flora and fauna included the predatory ronk.

Chule.title: Chule

facts.region: Mid Rim, Kashyyyk Region, The Slice

Chule.lead: Chule was the second planet in the Bissillirus system. It was a cold planet with no geological activity, covered in oceans and barren plains. Its local day lasted 49 standard hours; its year lasted 145 local days.
