Cificap VIII.title: Cificap VIII
Cificap VIII.lead: Cificap VIII was a planet in the Cificap system. After the Battle of Yavin, the Rebel Alliance freed Habassa slaves from the Galactic Empire near that planet, before the slaves could be loaded onto the Mayhem.

Circarpous I.title: Circarpous I
Circarpous I.lead: Circarpous I was the first planet orbiting the star Circarpous Major in the Circarpous system. Located in the Circarpous sector of the Expansion Region, it was a scorched ball.

Circarpous II.title: Circarpous II
Circarpous II.lead: Circarpous II was the second planet orbiting the star Circarpous Major in the Circarpous system. Located in the Circarpous sector of the Expansion Region, it was a hostile hothouse.

Circarpous III.title: Circarpous III
Circarpous III.lead: Circarpous III was the third planet orbiting the star Circarpous Major in the Circarpous system. Located in the Circarpous sector of the Expansion Region, it was a terrestrial world.

Circarpous VI.title: Circarpous VI
Circarpous VI.lead: Circarpous VI was the sixth planet orbiting the star Circarpous Major in the Circarpous system. Located in the Circarpous sector of the Expansion Region, it was a gas giant.

Circarpous VII.title: Circarpous VII
Circarpous VII.lead: Circarpous VII was the seventh planet orbiting the star Circarpous Major in the Circarpous system. Located in the Circarpous sector of the Expansion Region, it was a gas giant.

Circarpous VIII.title: Circarpous VIII
Circarpous VIII.lead: Circarpous VIII was the eighth planet orbiting the star Circarpous Major in the Circarpous system. Located in the Circarpous sector of the Expansion Region, it was a gas giant.

Circarpous IX.title: Circarpous IX
Circarpous IX.lead: Circarpous IX was the ninth planet orbiting the star Circarpous Major in the Circarpous system. Located in the Circarpous sector of the Expansion Region, it was a barren rock.

Chuzalla.title: Chuzalla
Chuzalla.lead: Chuzalla was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Tammuz sector. It had a significant population of dangerous criminals and was the site of the spaceport city Zallakesh. In 15 BBY, the Tammuz-an Prince Coby, accompanied by the Human Jann Tosh and the droids C-3PO and R2-D2, was forced to transfer to a connecting flight in Zallakesh while traveling between the worlds Tammuz-an and Raithal.

Cimarosa.title: Cimarosa
Cimarosa.lead: Cimarosa was the homeworld of the Human Von Longo and his two sons, Kale Longo and Trig Longo. They lived on the world until sometime in 1 BBY, when they were arrested by the Galactic Empire, and placed on the prison barge Purge.

Cilare.title: Cilare
Cilare.lead: Cilare was an ice planet where the crime lord Tayand lived.

Cioral.title: Cioral/Legends
Cioral.lead: Cioral was a planet of the Chiss Ascendancy in the Unknown Regions and was located in the Cioral system. It was home of the House Csapla, one of the Chiss Ruling Families; therefore, as with many other homeworlds of Ruling Families, Cioral was located on the Path of the Houses, a hyperlane in the Ascendancy's core territory. Cioral was also a heavily urbanized planet from which a half-dozen Chiss agricultural colonies were overseen.

Ciratu Spheres.title: Ciratu Spheres
Ciratu Spheres.lead: The Ciratu Spheres were a group of six spherical objects which orbited the star Ciratu in the Ciratu system, which was a part of the Immerian Outback sector in the Expansion Region and Trailing Sectors, far from any trade routes. Composed of rock and iron, each sphere was filled with twisting tunnels. It was rumored that some scouts who had ventured into the spheres discovered wondrous machinery, while others were mysteriously altered by processes they could not remember. Some scouts were said to have never returned at all.

Cioran.title: Cioran
Cioran.lead: Cioran was a planet located in the Saavin system, a part of the Southern Core portion of the Core Worlds. During the Galactic Civil War, the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Ravenous monitored the traffic around Cioran.

Circumtore.title: Circumtore/Legends

facts.routes: Gamor Run, Hollastin Run, Kaaga Run
facts.population: Local average of 100 to 500 million (25 ABY)

Circumtore.lead: Circumtore was a ring-shaped artificial planetoid located in the star system of the same name in Hutt Space. Discovered by the main galactic community by the Rianitus Period, Circumtore fell within the space controlled by the Hutt species into the reign of the Galactic Empire. Colonized by the Shell Hutts at some period, the planetoid was visited by a group of bounty hunters under the lead of Boba Fett in 1 ABY after they tracked the Lyunesi Oph Nar Dinnid and his bounty there.

Ciutric IV.title: Ciutric IV

facts.affiliation: Brotherhood of Darkness, Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Prince-Admiral Krennel's Ciutric Hegemony, Imperial Remnant …

Ciutric IV.lead: Ciutric IV, commonly known just as Ciutric, was the capital planet of the Ciutric Hegemony. The planet had at least two moons, and was subject to frequent yet brief periods of torrential downpour.

Coachelle Prime.title: Coachelle Prime/Legends
Coachelle Prime.lead: Coachelle Prime was a Mid Rim planet situated in the Terr'skiar sector. It was situated on the Ootmian Pabol hyperlane between the Terr'skiar and Ota systems before that route's Coachelle-Ota segment was severed by a supernova. A minor trade world, Coachelle Prime was the homeworld of the sentient, lagomorphic Lepi species, members of which lived in vast underground warrens. The Lepi smuggler Jaxxon was born on Coachelle Prime and eventually stole away from his homeworld aboard a freighter.

Clantaano III.title: Clantaano III
Clantaano III.lead: Clantaano III, also known as Clantaano, was a desert planet located within the Outer Rim Territories' Albanin sector. It was the homeworld of the nomadic and violent Clantaani species. The Clantaani gunman Longo Two-Guns and his cousins were born on Clantaano III, and they gave rise to a gang of Clantaani criminals that moved offworld by 32 BBY.

Cirrus.title: Cirrus
Cirrus.lead: Cirrus was a Outer Rim world orbiting two orange suns. It had golden seas and lovely cities, including the capital Ciran near a bay. It was the homeworld of Talesan Fry and his parents.

Cirus II.title: Cirus II
Cirus II.lead: Cirus II was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories that was a mining world for syntonium. Lex was a mine operator there.

Clascvoria.title: Clascvoria
Clascvoria.lead: Clascvoria was a planet in the Ralltiir system. It was controlled by the Esselian Empire up until its collapse following the Clone Wars.

Coachelle Belt.title: Coachelle system/Legends
Coachelle Belt.lead: The Coachelle system was situated in the Mid Rim's Terr'skiar sector. A part of the Silly Rabbit constellation, it contained five planets, among which was Coachelle Prime. The latter was the homeworld of the sentient Lepi species, including the smuggler Jaxxon. At some point, the Lepi colonized all the worlds of the Coachelle system as well as most of its asteroid belt, and Jaxxon eventually departed his homeworld aboard a freighter.

Coachelle III.title: Coachelle system/Legends
Coachelle III.lead: The Coachelle system was situated in the Mid Rim's Terr'skiar sector. A part of the Silly Rabbit constellation, it contained five planets, among which was Coachelle Prime. The latter was the homeworld of the sentient Lepi species, including the smuggler Jaxxon. At some point, the Lepi colonized all the worlds of the Coachelle system as well as most of its asteroid belt, and Jaxxon eventually departed his homeworld aboard a freighter.

Coachelle IV.title: Coachelle system/Legends
Coachelle IV.lead: The Coachelle system was situated in the Mid Rim's Terr'skiar sector. A part of the Silly Rabbit constellation, it contained five planets, among which was Coachelle Prime. The latter was the homeworld of the sentient Lepi species, including the smuggler Jaxxon. At some point, the Lepi colonized all the worlds of the Coachelle system as well as most of its asteroid belt, and Jaxxon eventually departed his homeworld aboard a freighter.

Coachelle V.title: Coachelle system/Legends
Coachelle V.lead: The Coachelle system was situated in the Mid Rim's Terr'skiar sector. A part of the Silly Rabbit constellation, it contained five planets, among which was Coachelle Prime. The latter was the homeworld of the sentient Lepi species, including the smuggler Jaxxon. At some point, the Lepi colonized all the worlds of the Coachelle system as well as most of its asteroid belt, and Jaxxon eventually departed his homeworld aboard a freighter.

Circarpous XIV.title: Circarpous XIV
Circarpous XIV.lead: Circarpous XIV was the fourteenth and outermost planet in the Circarpous system. Its fifth moon had extensive volcanic activity which kept it warm and habitable.

Circarpous X.title: Circarpous X
Circarpous X.lead: Circarpous X was a frozen planet in the Circarpous system with a traffic monitoring station.

Circarpous XII.title: Circarpous XII
Circarpous XII.lead: Circarpous XII was the twelfth planet in the Circarpous system with a small colony of Rebel Alliance sympathizers.

Clendor.title: Clendor
Clendor.lead: Clendor was a planet in the Inner Rim, near Taanab.

Coccia.title: Coccia
Coccia.lead: Coccia was a terrestrial planet, located in the Felucia system of the Thanium sector, part of the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. Coccia occupied the first orbital position around the star Felix and had one moon. The planet featured a hot environment and had a surface of scorched rock.

Circarpous XI.title: Circarpous XI
Circarpous XI.lead: Circarpous XI was the eleventh planet orbiting the star Circarpous Major in the Circarpous system. Located in the Circarpous sector of the Expansion Region, it was a gas giant.

Circarpous XIII.title: Circarpous XIII
Circarpous XIII.lead: Circarpous XIII was the thirteenth planet orbiting the star Circarpous Major in the Circarpous Major system. Located in the Circarpous sector of the Expansion Region, it was a barren rock.

Clariv.title: Clariv

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, The Slice, Tion Cluster

Clariv.lead: Clariv was a world located in the Clariv system. It was a part of the Back Spiral area of the Tion Hegemony sector, which was situated in the Tion Cluster within the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. Clariv lay between the Erediss and Rudrig systems on the hyperlane known as the Tion Trade Route.

Cobal.title: Cobal
Cobal.lead: Cobal was a planet where a small group of Jedi had settled. These Jedi wore unique robes, appearing like casual clothing that was patterned brown and turquoise with one sleeve being larger than the other. Their lightsabers were known to shoot sparks erratically, due to the turqoise unique crystals mined on Cobal., During the Clone Wars, replications of their robes and lightsabers were available to Jedi Knights.

Citlik IV.title: Citlik IV
Citlik IV.lead: Citlik IV was a planet in the Citlik sector of the Expansion Region.

Ciutric.title: Ciutric system
Ciutric.lead: The Ciutric system was a star system located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories.

Codia.title: Codia (disambiguation)
Codia.lead: Codia may refer to one of the following:

Cona.title: Cona/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire, Galactic Alliance, Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire

Cona.lead: Cona, also known as Arcona, was an arid, desert world which orbited the blue giant Teke Ro, located in the Teke Ro system of the Inner Rim. The homeworld of the serpent-like Arcona species, Cona had a minimal water supply due to a geological catastrophe early in its history.

Concord Dawn.title: Concord Dawn/Legends
Concord Dawn.lead: Concord Dawn was an agricultural frontier world in the Mandalore sector of the Outer Rim Territories. The planet had strong ties to the Mandalorians; its population shared many Mandalorian values, and genetic markers specific to the natives of Concord Dawn were present throughout the Mandalorian populace. Concord Dawn was a flashpoint for the Mandalorian Civil War in 58 BBY, when the Death Watch of Tor Vizsla scattered the True Mandalorians of Mandalore Jaster Mereel, a native of Concord Dawn.

Commenor.title: Commenor/Legends

facts.routes: Commenor Run, Quellor Run, Trellen Trade Route
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire, Galactic Federation of Free Alliances, Confederation, Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire

Commenor.lead: Commenor was a planet in the Commenor system of the Colonies, just outside of the Core Worlds.

Colla IV.title: Colla IV/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire, Galactic Federation of Free Alliances

Colla IV.lead: Colla IV, or simply Colla, was the home planet of the insectoid Colicoid species, makers of the droideka, Annihilator droid, buzz droid, and the droid tri-fighter. Its starship engineers were known for ingenuity rather than style.

Colunda Prime.title: Colunda Prime
Colunda Prime.lead: Colunda Prime was an astronomical object located in the Colunda Prime system. It constituted a part of the Colunda sector, a subsector of the Phelleem sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. Senator Char Bibbeck, who represented a sector in the Galactic Republic's Senate, hailed from Colunda Prime.

Columex.title: Columex/Legends

facts.affiliation: Xim's Empire, Galactic Republic, Commonality, Brotherhood of Darkness, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Greater Maldrood …

Columex.lead: Columex, originally known as Nardolin, was a trade planet located in relative proximity to the Vorzyd Cluster of the Outer Rim Territories, on the Perlemian Trade Route.

Comkin V.title: Comkin V
Comkin V.lead: During the early days of the New Republic, Comkin V was controlled by Warlord Zsinj. It was the site of a battle during the Zsinj campaign.

Columus.title: Columus/Legends
Columus.lead: Columus was a planet in the Core Worlds's Columus system and the homeworld of the Columi species. A low-gravity, geologically-stable planet, Columus lacked any geographic features and possessed a shallow soil layer, causing its native plants to form horizontal root systems. The Columi species evolved to sentience remarkably early in the history of the galaxy, achieving interstellar travel by the year 100,000 BBY.

Comra.title: Comra/Legends

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Dead Zone, New Territories

Comra.lead: Comra was a planet located in the Prefsbelt sector, within the Dead Zone of the Outer Rim Territories.

Colsa.title: Colsa
Colsa.lead: Colsa was a barren, rocky planet, second in the Dostra system in Corporate Sector. It had one moon.

Colavas.title: Colavas
Colavas.lead: Colavas was a gas giant planet with sixteen moons, in the Colavas system.

Colavas Minor.title: Colavas Minor
Colavas Minor.lead: Colavas Minor was a gas giant planet with eight moons, in the Colavas system.

Colavas Tertiary.title: Colavas Tertiary
Colavas Tertiary.lead: Colavas Tertiary was a planet in the Colavas system. A gas giant orbited by nine moons, Colavas Tertiary was the fourth planet in the system.

Cols.title: Cols/Legends
Cols.lead: Cols was an ocean planet known for the oceanic region of Harvest Bay, which served as the main breeding ground for the kalaides.

Colsassa.title: Colsassa
Colsassa.lead: Colsassa was the fourth planet orbiting the binary stars Adega Prime and Adega Besh in the Adega system. Located in the Auril sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories, it was a gas giant orbited by eleven moons collectively known as the Colsassan moons.

Condular.title: Condular
Condular.lead: Condular was a celestial body located in the Condular system, a part of the Southern Core portion of the Core Worlds. It was situated between the Chasin and Gandeal systems on the Corellian Trade Spine super-hyperroute. Condular was home to the Grand Astrocartographic Institute, which was active at least several years prior to the Black Fleet Crisis of 16 ABY–17 ABY.

Cono.title: Cono
Cono.lead: Cono was the innermost planet of the Bestine system located in the Inner Rim Territories. Cono had no moons, and its surface was covered with scorched rocks.

Colstev.title: Colstev
Colstev.lead: Colstev was a small, rocky planet in the Stewjon system. It was the homeworld of Jin-Rio Akabi.

Colossus.title: Colossus

facts.affiliation: Galactic Empire, Imperial Navy, Ace Squadron, First Order, First Order Navy, Resistance, Team Colossus, Citizens' Fleet

Colossus.lead: The Colossus was a mobile starship refueling station on the ocean planet Castilon in the Western Reaches of the Mid Rim. It was operated by Captain Imanuel Doza, who resided in the station's upper levels with his daughter Torra. The Colossus was defended by a squadron of skilled pilots, known as Ace Squadron, and was also home to many other individuals such as Jarek Yeager, who owned a repair shop on the station.

Colla.title: Colla
Colla.lead: Colla was a commentator on Gundark's Gear Datalog during the early years of the New Republic. Commenting on the entry for Mandroxan Exports' Defense Weapon EDWX-843, Cholla noted that the weapon was good for disabling a target droid and recovering any information needed.

Cophrigin V.title: Cophrigin V
Cophrigin V.lead: Cophrigin V was the fifth planet of the Cophrigin system, an uninhabited star system among the Ash Worlds sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Corfai.title: Corfai
Corfai.lead: Corfai was a planet in the Corellian sector of the Core Worlds.

Contruum.title: Contruum/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Exar Kun's Sith Empire, Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders, Darth Revan's Sith Empire, Galactic Empire, New Republic …

Contruum.lead: Contruum was a planet in the Mid Rim, and was the most developed planet in the dense system of inhabited worlds that made up the Contruum system.

Cordes.title: Cordes
Cordes.lead: Cordes was an Imperial-controlled planet in the Inner Rim.

Corann.title: Corann

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire

Corann.lead: This industrialized world was located along the edge of the Core Worlds, and was a target of Separatist activities during the early stages of the Clone Wars.

Corbos.title: Corbos
Corbos.lead: Corbos was an Outer Rim planet near the Yavin system which was rich in ores. It had "Black Rain Seasons" which saw whole sections of the planet become uninhabitable due to massive thunderstorms.

Coriallis.title: Coriallis
Coriallis.lead: Coriallis was a New Republic planet in the Core Worlds near Coruscant.

Coorimbus IV.title: Coorimbus IV

facts.affiliation: House Calispa, Tapani Empire, Tapani Federation

Coorimbus IV.lead: Coorimbus IV was a gas giant in the Coorimbus system in Tapani sector where House Calipsa secretly acquired corusca gems.

Conus.title: Conus
Conus.lead: Conus was the third planet in the Geonosis system.

Cor II.title: Cor II system/Legends
Cor II.lead: The Cor II system was a star system located in the Tapani sector's Barnaba Province, on the Cor Lane.

Cor I.title: Cor I system/Legends
Cor I.lead: The Cor I system was a star system located in the Tapani sector's Barnaba Province, on the Cor Lane.

Contruum Six.title: Contruum Six
Contruum Six.lead: Contruum Six was a planet in the Contruum system.

Coomputu.title: Coomputu
Coomputu.lead: Coomputu was the fourth planet in the Outer Rim Garnib system. It was a frigid and rocky world, orbited by one moon.

Corjain.title: Corjain
Corjain.lead: The planet Corjain was located within the system of the same name in the Kathol sector of the Outer Rim Territories, just off the Trition Trade Route. Barely habitable, the planet supported a large mining industry, with all settlements located deep underground. During the Galactic Civil War, the planet was also the location of a secret outpost maintained by the Bothan Spynet.

Copperline.title: Copperline
Copperline.lead: Copperline was a world of poor farmers that was plagued by pirates for decades. In 18 BBY, the Imperial Navy and Army, including at least one unit of stormtroopers, cleaned out the pirates in a five-month-long operation.

Coonee.title: Coonee/Legends
Coonee.lead: Coonee was a planet located in the Expansion Region. Han Solo, who was in his teens, and Chewbacca traveled to Coonee where they herded coldppedas, fifteen-footed scaled domestic animals, for three years.

Cor III.title: Cor III system/Legends
Cor III.lead: The Cor III system was a star system located in the Tapani sector's Barnaba Province, on the Cor Lane.

Copero.title: Copero/Legends

facts.affiliation: Chiss Ascendancy, Mitth family, House Inrokini

Copero.lead: Copero was a planet of the Chiss Ascendancy in the Unknown Regions. It was the location of the Chiss' largest shipyard.

Corips.title: Corips (disambiguation)
Corips.lead: Corips may refer to one of the following:

Corulag.title: Corulag/Legends

facts.population: 15 billion:, 98% Human, 2% other, 10 billion during Yuuzhan Vong War
facts.government: House of Citizens (officially), Imperial governorship (de facto)
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Quintad, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire, Galactic Federation of Free Alliances

Corulag.lead: Corulag (pronounced /'kʊɹalæg/) was a populated terrestrial planet located on the Perlemian Trade Route in the Corulus system in the Bormea sector, part of the Ringali Shell. It was the endpoint of the Corulag-Jatir Hyperroute. The planet boasted urban sprawls with the underdeveloped areas filled with bamboo forests.

Corsin.title: Corsin/Legends

facts.routes: Corsin Run, Mandalorian Road, Hydian Way, Vaathkree Trade Corridor
facts.affiliation: Infinite Empire, Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Zsinj's Empire, Thrawn's confederation, New Republic, Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire

Corsin.lead: Corsin was a beautiful Expansion Region planet located in the Greater Plooriod sector. Situated at the junction of the Hydian Way and Vaathkree Trade Corridor hyperspace routes, it had a warm climate in its tropical regions and was home to the large aquatic mammal selligore. The creatures fed on plants as well as small fish and plankton, and the Tinn'lyi nation, native to the planet's Tinn'lyi Islands, maintained a symbiotic relationship with them where the selligores were given gathered plants to eat in exchange for helping catch fish in large nets they dragged behind them.

Corstris.title: Corstris
Corstris.lead: Corstris was a heavily-forested planet in the Quelii sector of the Outer Rim.

Corroth.title: Corroth
Corroth.lead: Corroth was a planet known for its duelists, such as Matta Tremayne.

Corlass.title: Corlass

facts.affiliation: Kingdom of Cron, Kingdom of Argai, Xim's Empire, Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire

Corlass.lead: Corlass was a planet of pirates, both seafaring and spacefaring. Located within the Outer Rim Territories, it was one of the original member-worlds of the Kingdom of Cron. It was absorbed into Xim's empire, and the Despot used many former Corlassi pirates as the captains of his warships.

Cortina.title: Cortina
Cortina.lead: Cortina was a planet directly represented in the New Republic Senate. Its government attempted to push its application to the New Republic through, thinking itself superior, but eventually calmed down and earned membership.

Cortella.title: Cortella
Cortella.lead: Cortella was a Core Worlds planet ruled by a monarchy. In 25 BBY, the Human Jedi Knights Obi-Wan Kenobi and Siri Tachi impersonated the king and queen of Cortella in order to infiltrate the elite Leadership School on the planet Andara. During a meeting with the school's president, in which they negotiated a permission to carry out a tour of the establishment, the Jedi pretended to be interested in sending their son to attend the school.

Corphelion.title: Corphelion

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Corphelion.lead: Corphelion was an Expansion Region asteroid rimward of Phindar with numerous holiday resorts where honeymooners and tourists went to see the system's beautiful comets. It was the sight of the Battle of Corphelion during the New Sith Wars. Corphelion later fell under control of the Galactic Empire, and the New Republic.

Coronar.title: Coronar
Coronar.lead: The planet Coronar was the site of an Imperial Intelligence base during the Galactic Civil War. After the Empire's destruction of the Alliance to Restore the Republic base on Dankayo, several datapacks were recovered from the ruins. They were consigned for analysis on Coronar aboard the Imperial Armored Transport Elusive, but the shipment was intercepted by Alliance agents, and Elusive was destroyed.

Corva.title: Corva
Corva.lead: Corva was a planet in Corva sector's Galaan system. The Galactic Republic established a colony on the planet which was wiped out by clodhoppers which arrived in a grain shipment from Naboo. The clodhoppers ate all the vegetation on Corva as well as 87% of the colonists.

Corri.title: Corri
Corri.lead: Corri was a gas giant in the Outlier systems of the Corellian sector.

Corva Yag.title: Corva Yag/Legends
Corva Yag.lead: Corva Yag was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Rseik sector. By 214 BBY, the Hajara gang of pirates established a presence on Corva Yag, raiding Kett Shipping convoys traveling across the Little Minos Run hyperlane.

Coruscul.title: Coruscul
Coruscul.lead: Coruscul was a world situated in the Core Worlds. It was the site of a hidden stronghold at one point used by the Order of the Silver Jedi sect of the Jedi Order. After he was liberated from a dead-in-space starship at some point during the New Republic's existence, the dark side of the Force–affiliated being known as the Force vampire began travelling to Coruscul in order to destroy the stronghold there.

Corutarn.title: Corutarn
Corutarn.lead: Corutarn was a celestial body located in the Corutarn system, which was a part of the Arrowhead, or the Slice portion of the Core Worlds. The Human Major Perrn of the Galactic Empire, who was born around 32 BBY, hailed from Corutarn.

Corlax 4.title: Corlax 4

facts.affiliation: Kingdom of Cron, Xim's Empire, Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire

Corlax 4.lead: Corlax 4, or simply Corlax, was a planet located within the Allied Tion sector of the Outer Rim Territories. An unremarkable industrial world, during the Clone Wars almost 300 million Humans inhabited the planet, working mostly as laborers.

Cornwall.title: Cornwall
Cornwall.lead: Cornwall was a planet embroiled in a civil war between two rival clans. Qell Tepine, a member of the Star's Nova mercenary force, was implicated in the war.

Coruschal.title: Coruschal
Coruschal.lead: Coruschal was a city world located in the Coruschal system, a part of the Negs portion of the Core Worlds. It was home to the prominent munitions manufacturing company Coruschal WeaponWorks until, at one point, the planet fell into civil disarray. By the time of the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Rebel Alliance, Coruschal had become a decaying urban sprawl. Various factions at war with each other fought in the planet's streets, with the fighting having cut off contact with the rest of the galaxy.

Corlaasi.title: Corlaasi
Corlaasi.lead: Corlaasi was an astronomical object located in the Minos Cluster of the Outer Rim Territories. It was situated along the Rimma Trade Route and served as a gateway to the Dravin Cut.

Cormit.title: Cormit/Legends
Cormit.lead: Cormit was a planet of the Chiss Ascendancy in the Unknown Regions. Cormit was located near the border of the Ascendancy's core territory in the Cormit system and at the intersection of two hyperlanes, the Vagaari Corridor and the Phalanx Route. The planet was the location of one of the two major Chiss Expansionary Defense Force bases.

Cortilium Major.title: Cortilium Major
Cortilium Major.lead: Cortilium Major was an astronomical object located in the Cortilium Major system, a part of the Eucer sector of the Mid Rim. During the Tionese War, waged between the Galactic Republic and the Honorable Union of Desevro & Tion, Cortilium Major was situated in the region known as the Divide and was settled by Republic colonists.

Coyn.title: Coyn

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Metharian Nebula Territories
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire

Coyn.lead: Coyn was a planet in the Coyn system and the homeworld of the Coynites. It was located in Elrood sector, where the Coyn Route met the Elrood-Derilyn Trade Route. The capital was the city of En'Tra'Tal, or "King-City". Forests, marshes, and plains broken by simple mountain ranges covered this beautiful planet. Coyn was defended by their space fleet, Coyn'Skraj'Ha.

Corvis Minor III.title: Corvis Minor III
Corvis Minor III.lead: Corvis Minor III was a semi-arid world in the Corvis Minor system and the Ciutric Hegemony with temperate zones at its poles which produced exotic xenobiological products sold as luxury commodities.

Corvis Minor IV.title: Corvis Minor IV
Corvis Minor IV.lead: Corvis Minor IV was a water-rich tropical planet in the Ciutric Hegemony. It produced exotic xenobiological products sold as luxury commodities. It was guarded by the Aspiration.

Corvanni IV.title: Corvanni IV
Corvanni IV.lead: Corvanni IV was an astronomical object that occupied the fourth orbital position in the Corvanni system, a part of the Neshig sector in the Slice portion of the Inner Rim. It was located near the Vorsia system, the origin point of the Vorsian crystal.

Crakull.title: Crakull
Crakull.lead: Crakull was a planet located within the Crakull system of the Unknown Regions. It was home to the sentient Croke species. The Croke were diminutive in size, and had multiple legs as well as a natural ability to disguise themselves behind illusions.

Coveway.title: Coveway
Coveway.lead: Coveway was a harsh Outer Rim Territories planet situated in the Koradin sector. Colonized by the time of the reign of the Galactic Empire, it eventually became home to the Human Jak Bremen, who eventually became a constable of the village he resided in and started a family.

Corvis Minor V.title: Corvis Minor V
Corvis Minor V.lead: Corvis Minor V in the Corvis Minor system was a planet orbited by six moons, including Distna. It was a gray-orange gas giant located near an asteroid belt.

Crella.title: Crella system/Legends
Crella.lead: The Crella system was a star system located in the Tapani sector's Barnaba Province, on the Cor Lane.

Cranan 12.title: Cranan 12
Cranan 12.lead: Cranan 12, or simply Cranan, was a planet in the Arkanis sector of the Outer Rim.

Cridark II.title: Cridark II
Cridark II.lead: Cridark II was a planet in the Cridark system. It was part of the Empire and the homeworld of Denno Yanglan.

Council.title: Council (disambiguation)
Council.lead: A council is a group of people, staffed by councilors and usually those possessing some form of governing power.

Cotellier.title: Cotellier/Legends
Cotellier.lead: Cotellier (ko-tell-yi-err) was a desert mining planet in the Rseik sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Credquant.title: Credquant
Credquant.lead: Credquant was the first planet orbiting the binary stars Toydar and Little Toydar in the Toydaria system. Located in Hutt Space of the galaxy, it was a gas giant.

Cosia.title: Cosia/Legends
Cosia.lead: Cosia was a celestial body located in the Cosia system of the Deep Core. It was the homeworld of the Cosian Jedi Master Tera Sinube, who utilized a sabercane with a Cosian wood hilt.

Critoki.title: Critoki system/Legends
Critoki.lead: The Critoki system was located in the Esstran sector, in the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was home to the sentient species known as the Critokians.

Craci.title: Craci
Craci.lead: Craci was a planet located in the Craci system in the Corporate Sector of the Outer Rim Territories. The planet was the home of the Cracian thumpers, a species used frequently as mounts by scouts. Controlled by the Corporate Sector Authority by the time of the Battle of Yavin, the planet had spaceports that experienced high levels of activity due to the agriculture and industry of the five worlds that were also located within the same system.

Couronne.title: Couronne/Legends
Couronne.lead: The planet Couronne was the namesake of the Couronne system in the Couronne sector, located within the Slice portion of the Expansion Region. It was the homeworld of the humanoid Imzig species.

Coyerti.title: Coyerti
Coyerti.lead: Coyerti was a planet in the Mid Rim, and was the home of the Coyerti species. Due to its rich plant and animal life, it served as a military research outpost for biological weapons. It was the location of a conflict between the Rebel Alliance and the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War.

Cosmatanic Steppes gas giant.title: Cosmatanic Steppes gas giant
Cosmatanic Steppes gas giant.lead: A gas giant was located in the Cosmatanic Steppes system within the Grohl sector of the Outer Rim Territories and the Slice. It was situated in grid square R-16 of the Standard Galactic Grid. The hyperspace route known as the Triellus Trade Route connected it to the celestial bodies Molavar and Tatooine. The gas giant planet lay in a system with at least three stars, and the Cosmatanic Steppes, a habitable layer of mantle, was suspended above the world.

Courtsilius.title: Courtsilius
Courtsilius.lead: Courtsilius was one of the five planets that orbited the sun of the Hosnian system, in the Core region of the galaxy. Large hexagonal and circular city structures covered significant swathes of the planet, and glowed red and blue from orbit.

Csilla.title: Csilla/Legends

facts.routes: Path of the Houses, Vagaari Corridor

Csilla.lead: Csilla, the homeworld of the Chiss, was a cold world of glaciers and snowy wastes located deep within Chiss Space, and served as the capital of the Chiss Ascendancy.

Cularin.title: Cularin/Legends

facts.affiliation: Trade Federation, Metatheran Cartel, Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Cularin.lead: Cularin was a planet in the Cularin system. It had two moons, the molten Rennokk and the barren Tilnes. The planet was known for its exotic hardwoods, especially the ch'hala tree. The whole planet was considered strong in the Force.

Cybloc.title: Cybloc
Cybloc.lead: Cybloc, also known as Cybloc Prime, was a greenish planet orbiting the star Erg Es 992 in the Meridian sector. During the Clone Wars there was a space station in orbit over the planet. Darth Maul and his brother Savage Opress broke into the space station and stole some credits. One of its moons, Cybloc XII, housed a New Republic trade base. However, the region was purged during the Death Seed incident.

Crollia.title: Crollia

facts.routes: Corellian Trade Spine, Corellian Run, Secure Route ID-5N, Trade Route X143

Crollia.lead: Crollia was the sixth planet in the Corellian system; it was a barren, rocky world, unable to sustain life, and possessed no moons. Crollia and the other lifeless world in the star system, Soronia, were both located on the fringes of the system, and were believed to have naturally formed in orbit around the star Corell—unlike the other five worlds, which were placed in the system through the use of Centerpoint Station.

Crondre.title: Crondre/Legends
Crondre.lead: Crondre was a small, icy world located in the Dufilvian sector of the Mid Rim. Its surface consisted of icy glaciers.

Culroon III.title: Culroon III/Legends
Culroon III.lead: Culroon III was a planet in the Culroon system, located in Wild Space.

Criton's Point.title: Criton's Point

facts.affiliation: Velcar Free Commerce Zone, Galactic Empire, Pentastar Alignment

Criton's Point.lead: Criton's Point was a quarantined planet in the Myto sector. Its Library of Xer was built 26,000 BBY. Not much was known of the planet, but many historians had expressed interest in gaining access to the Imperial-controlled library.

Cyborrea.title: Cyborrea/Legends
Cyborrea.lead: Cyborrea was a heavy-gravity planet that was located within Hutt Space region of the the galaxy, on the hyperlane called the Sisar Run. It was the homeworld of both the sentient Cyborreans and the dog-like nek beasts. Cyborrea was a part of the Hutt Empire around the year 25,100 BBY, with Cyborreans serving in the armies of the Hutt species during that time. More than thirteen millennia later the Galactic Republic sent a battle-fleet toward Cyborrea during one of the Republic's crusades against the Hutts.

Crytal Nest.title: Crytal Nest
Crytal Nest.lead: Crytal Nest was a Wild Space planet that was the homeworld of the sentient Shashay species. During the existence of the Galactic Republic and the Galactic Empire, the Shashay explored and traded with other star systems, but later into the Empire's reign, the species became more reclusive. They kept the location of Crytal Nest a closely guarded secret, and the Rebel Alliance eventually attempted to negotiate a treaty with the Shashay that would allow for the establishment of a base there.

Crustai.title: Crustai
Crustai.lead: Crustai was the second planet of the Crustai system in the Unknown Regions. It was part of the Chiss Ascendancy.

Cygnus B.title: Cygnus B system
Cygnus B.lead: The Cygnus B system, also referred to as the Cygnus system, was located in the Esaga sector, a part of the Slice portion of the Mid Rim. The system shared its name with the starship manufacturer Cygnus Spaceworks.

Cujicor.title: Cujicor
Cujicor.lead: Cujicor was a planet in the Pakuuni sector of the Outer Rim.

Cryon.title: Cryon
Cryon.lead: Cryon was a celestial body located in the Cryon system, a part of the Meram sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories.

Crovna.title: Crovna
Crovna.lead: Crovna was a planet in Senex sector that was home to the Peven Auction House; and Birtraub Brothers Storage and Reclamation Center, located near the main spaceport on the planet, which was a front for the Birtraub Brothers' criminal activities.

Crystan V.title: Crystan V
Crystan V.lead: Crystan V was an object located in the Deep Core. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, it was inhabited by a little green beings.

Csorb.title: Csorb
Csorb.lead: Csorb was a planet in the Csilla system, which was located in Chiss Space in the Unknown Regions.

Csaus.title: Csaus/Legends
Csaus.lead: Csaus was a planet located in the Csaus system in the core territory of the Chiss Ascendancy in the Unknown Regions. It was home of the House Inrokini, one of the Chiss Ruling Families. Like other homeworlds of Ruling Families, Csaus was located on the Path of the Houses, a hyperlane that ran through the Ascendancy. The planet was the Ascendancy's hub of sciences and communications.

Curreck.title: Curreck
Curreck.lead: Curreck was a planet located in Outer Rim Territories. Captain Darren T. Weeb was a native of the planet.

Crucival.title: Crucival
Crucival.lead: Crucival was an Old Tionese colonial backwater planet in the Outer Rim and the homeworld of Hazram Namir. Imperial defector Governor Everi Chalis considered settling there to avoid being found by the Galactic Empire. The world was almost constantly wracked by war between various factions, including the Malkhanis and their successors, the Opaline Creed.

Crul.title: Crul
Crul.lead: Crul was a planet located in the galaxy's Mid Rim that was covered in warm, shallow, and salty seas and lagoons. It was the homeworld of two sentient species: the Crolutes, who were exclusively male, and the Gilliands, who were exclusively female.

Dac.title: Dac/Legends

facts.routes: Overic Griplink, Minntooine Spur, Tidal Circuit
facts.population: 0 (after the Genocide on Dac), 27 billion (before the Genocide on Dac), 60% Quarren, 39% Mon Calamari, 1% Other, Historic: 27.5 billion, 49% Quarren …
facts.species: Mon Calamari, Quarren, Whaladon, Amphi-Hydrus, Moappa, Knowledge Bank
facts.language: Mon Calamarian, Quarrenese, Galactic Basic Standard
facts.affiliation: Mon Calamari Council, Galactic Republic, Quarren Isolation League, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Mon Calamari Resistance …

Dac.lead: Dac, as it was called in Mon Calamarian, Quarrenese, and Basic, also known as Mon Calamari, and sometimes simply called Calamari or Mon Cala, was a planet in the Calamari system of the Calamari sector, located in the Outer Rim. It was home to a wealth of sentient species: the Mon Calamari, the Quarren, the Moappa, the Amphi-Hydrus, and the Whaladons. Mon Calamari was the name given to the planet by Human explorers from the Galactic Republic who first discovered and revealed the world to the rest of the galaxy. The native species referred to the planet as Dac.

D'vouran.title: D'vouran
D'vouran.lead: D'vouran was a living free-floating planet in the galaxy that devoured anything it came in contact with.

Da Soocha.title: Da Soocha

facts.affiliation: Hutt Empire, New Republic, Anjiliac Clan

Da Soocha.lead: Da Soocha was a water-covered planet in the uncharted Cyax system in Hutt Space.

Dachat.title: Dachat

facts.affiliation: Alsakan (during the Fifth Alsakan Conflict), Nelori Marauders

Dachat.lead: Dachat was a planet in the area of the Core Worlds containing the Hyabb-Twith Corridor. The Nelori Marauders had a base on the planet which allowed them to prey upon both the populations on Hyabb and Twith. The base was destroyed by the Jedi in 4050 BBY.

Cyphar.title: Cyphar/Legends
Cyphar.lead: Cyphar was a planet in the Mid Rim between Nkllon and Belsavis, defended by the Galactic Republic from the Confederacy of Independent Systems in 22 BBY during the Clone Wars.

D'rinba IV.title: D'rinba IV
D'rinba IV.lead: D'rinba IV was a world located in the Sombure sector of the Mid Rim.

Cyrillia.title: Cyrillia/Legends

facts.affiliation: Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire

Cyrillia.lead: Cyrillia was the homeworld of the Cyrillians, in the Expansion Region of the galaxy. It was a very industrialized world where Serv-O-Droid, Inc. constructed its DUM pit droids in large quantities.

Cyimarra.title: Cyimarra
Cyimarra.lead: Cyimarra was a terrestrial planet located in the Mid Rim's Senex sector. The homeworld of the the aristocratic House Araba, its surface featured cities interspersed among woodlands and mountains as well as a sea.

Daalang.title: Daalang/Legends

facts.routes: Bothan Run, Gamor Run, Trax Tube
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Exar Kun's Sith Empire, Darth Revan's Sith Empire, Hutt Cartel, Brotherhood of Darkness, Confederacy of Independent Systems, New Republic …

Daalang.lead: Daalang was a world on the Gamor Run in the Mid Rim, near Attahox.

DNX-N1.title: DNX-N1
DNX-N1.lead: DNX-N1 was a planet located within the Wild Space DNX-N1 system. Charted but largely unexplored, it was the homeworld of the sentient gaseous species known as the Filar-Nitzan.

D'Skar.title: D'Skar

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Metharian Nebula Territories

D'Skar.lead: D'Skar was a planet located within the Coyn system of the Outer Rim Territories and a rocky wasteland. The name of the planet meant "dagger" in the language of the Coynites and lent its name to a weapon.

D'pur.title: D'pur
D'pur.lead: D'pur was the seventh planet orbiting the star C'rel in the N'zoth system within the Koornacht Cluster of the Core Worlds. It was the only gas giant in the system.

Dadrus.title: Dadrus
Dadrus.lead: Dadrus was a gas giant that was orbited by five moons. It was the third planet in the Marcellus system, which resided in the Marcellus Nebula. Dadrus circled the yellow sun Marcellus. The gas giant, along with the rest of the Marcellus system, was located in the Meerian sector of the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories.

Da'nor.title: Da'nor
Da'nor.lead: Da'nor, also known as Planet X, was a planet in the Delantine system, near Romm. It orbited three stars and thus went through four seasonal changes each day. Stuart Zissu, C-3PO, 4B-X, and R2-D2 crashed on the planet in Escape pod 4. They were rescued from the planet by Granit. From Da'nor, Stuart was ordered to go to Romm. The language N'or was spoken on the planet. It was homeworld to large predatory birds and flying lizards.

Aracara.title: DVL-181
Aracara.lead: DVL-181, nicknamed the Quagmire and the Slime Pit, was a Rebel Alliance starfighter base built on a remote swampy planet. It was formerly known as the Aracara Testing Facility and was used as a corporate weapons and material testing zone. When it proved to be unprofitable, it was abandoned.

Daermor.title: Daermor
Daermor.lead: Daermor was a planet from the Daermor system. In 0 ABY, Auditor-General Fiolla conducted an audit there.

D'ian.title: D'ian
D'ian.lead: D'ian, also known as Sen III, was the third planet located in the D'ian system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Corporate Sector. It was situated at the intersection of the hyperlanes known as the Hydian Way, which linked it to the Bonadan and Lythos systems, and the Shaltin Tunnels, which connected to the Atchorb and Etti systems.

D'Nile.title: D'Nile system/Legends
D'Nile.lead: The D'Nile system was located in the Hertae sector, a part of the Slice portion of the Mid Rim.

Cyrkon.title: Cyrkon
Cyrkon.lead: Cyrkon was a toxic planet located in the Outer Rim Territories, on the edge of Hutt Space. In the aftermath of the Battle of Yavin, Lieutenant Caluan Ematt of the Alliance to Restore the Republic went into hiding on Cyrkon after escaping an ambush by the Galactic Empire on Taanab.

Czerialus.title: Czerialus
Czerialus.lead: Czerialus was a planet in the Czerialus system in the Kailion sector of the Expansion Region that was the homeworld of the Czerialan species. During the Imperial Era, the planet was under Imperial control and the Xoczuko family sought to return after being disheartened on Corellia, unaware of the Empire's control on the planet.

Dagobah.title: Dagobah/Legends

facts.affiliation: Confederacy of Independent Systems, Alliance to Restore the Republic, New Republic, Jedi Order

Dagobah.lead: Dagobah (/'deɪgəbə/; ) was an Outer Rim planet in the Dagobah system. A remote world of swamps and forests, it served as a refuge for Jedi Grand Master Yoda during his exile after the events of Order 66 had taken place.

Dalron Five.title: Dalron Five
Dalron Five.lead: Dalron Five was a planet that was devastated during the long Siege of Dalron Five, in which the Galactic Empire used strategies first devised by Jan Dodonna.

Dakshee.title: Dakshee
Dakshee.lead: Dakshee was a planet located in the Barma sector of the Colonies. It was the capital of its sector. Dakshee was marked by constant unrest under the rule of the Galactic Empire.

Daltarra.title: Daltarra

facts.affiliation: Alliance to Restore the Republic, Galactic Empire

Daltarra.lead: Daltarra was a planet in the Pakuuni sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Dagu.title: Dagu
Dagu.lead: Dagu was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Dagu system, a part of the Instrop sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. During the Clone Wars, nine months after the conflict's opening Battle of Geonosis, it was the site of a revolt and a battle between the forces of the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Dagary Minor.title: Dagary Minor
Dagary Minor.lead: Dagary Minor was a celestial body located in the Dagary Minor system, a part of the Northern Dependencies portion of the Inner Rim. By 3976 BBY, it was situated within the area of the galaxy that had been widely explored by the Galactic Republic and was known as the "civilized galaxy." A battle of the Mandalorian Wars was fought on Dagary Minor in 3963 BBY between the Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders and the military forces of the Republic, the latter of which included the soldier Xaart as well as the Jedi Knight eventually known as the Jedi Exile.

Daimla.title: Daimla
Daimla.lead: Daimla was a terrestrial world located in the Daimla system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Kallea sector. It was the homeworld of the sentient Daimlo species.

Dagro.title: Dagro

facts.affiliation: Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Republic

Dagro.lead: Dagro was a remote planet and a noted agriworld in the years leading up to the Clone Wars.

Dakuyl.title: Dakuyl
Dakuyl.lead: Dakuyl was a planet located within the Verkuyl system of the Outer Rim Territories where alazhi was grown. It was in the same system as Verkuyl and a secondary bacta production was begun on the planet, but halted after the Battle of Endor.

Dalastine.title: Dalastine IV
Dalastine.lead: Dalastine IV, also known simply as Dalastine, was a gloomy planetoid located in the Dalastine system of the Inner Rim. The Alliance to Restore the Republic maintained a starfighter base on Dalastine IV which operated Skipray blastboats.

Dagelin Minor.title: Dagelin Minor
Dagelin Minor.lead: Dagelin Minor was an Outer Rim Territories celestial body located in the Cadma sector. A shipment of the flying rodents known as Bogan's brown nafen was at one point imported there for the purposes of combating an infestation of dhuru flies. The nafen, however, caused an outbreak of the Hardan plague that wiped out ninety-eight percent of the local population. In response, Imperial Senator Leia Organa visited Dagelin Minor on a mercy mission.

Dakot Seven.title: Dakot Seven
Dakot Seven.lead: Dakot Seven was a planet in the Dakot system of the Mortex sector. An academically-minded world, it was the location of Dakot Tech, an Imperial Technical Branch Outpost. It was the site of the Battle on Dakot Seven.

Dalos IV.title: Dalos IV
Dalos IV.lead: Dalos IV was a hot, humid planet of shallow oceans in the Outer Rim's Nilgaard sector. It had a single rainforest continent, Kavila, and the planet was 7,000 kilometers in diameter. It was originally a penal colony. Due to the planet being largely ignored by the Galactic Empire, it became home to many beings fleeing persecution. The local architecture was old-fashioned, but the technology was of modern levels. Voyager's Rest was located on Kavila. A popular local sport was Trophy Chase, in which the locals rode nephs. The planet's Governor-General was Lira Rimrunner.

Dahvil.title: Dahvil
Dahvil.lead: Dahvil was an Outer Rim Territories world located in the Rayter sector. A member of the Galactic Republic, it was the homeworld of Jake Sirrom, a Human Wing Guard of the planet Bespin. During the Galactic Civil War, Dahvil served as the starting point of the Dahvil-Fodro Hyperspace Promenade, a popular interstellar racing route. The racer and undercover Rebel Alliance operative Siro Simito once participated in the race, and at the event's staging area on Dahvil, he picked up from his fellow Rebel agent Kaini a data module for secret delivery to the celestial body Fait d'Fait.

Dalicron-4.title: Dalicron-4
Dalicron-4.lead: Dalicron-4, also referred to as simply Dalicron, was a remote, little-noticed planet far in the Outer Rim Territories. Although the world possessed a diverse and vibrant ecosystem, it was home to no more than 1,000 inhabitants, the descendants of colonists from the Galactic Republic. These citizens established and maintained an agrarian society that relied on barter and trade. The people of Dalicron-4 were suspicious of outsiders. Dalia, with a population of about 100, was the largest settlement. The world was known for its unpredictable and ferocious weather patterns.

Daimar.title: Daimar

facts.affiliation: Lamont Dynasty of Daimar, Galactic Republic

Daimar.lead: Daimar was a planet located in the Mid Rim.

Dahgee.title: Dahgee
Dahgee.lead: Dahgee was a planet where unique lightsaber crystals were mined. A small group of Jedi with unique robes also lived there. The lightsaber crystals on Dahgee gave their lightsabers a strange, zigzagging blade with a black core, almost like a tree branch.

Dagmar II.title: Dagmar II
Dagmar II.lead: Dagmar II was a planet in the Dagmar system and the seat of the Imperial Governor of Dagmar where his palace was located.

Dalandae.title: Dalandae
Dalandae.lead: Dalandae was a celestial body located in the Dalandae system of the Colonies. The Human Rebel Alliance pilot John D. Branon hailed from Dalandae.

Daminia.title: Daminia
Daminia.lead: Daminia was a desert world located in the Daminia system, a part of the Perkell sector in the Trans-Hydian portion of the Mid Rim. The damind lightsaber crystals could be found there.

Damonite Yors-B.title: Damonite Yors-B
Damonite Yors-B.lead: Damonite Yors-B was a cold, icy planet in the Meridian sector that was a possible location of Princess Leia during her kidnapping nine years after the Battle of Endor.

Danteel.title: Danteel
Danteel.lead: The planet Danteel was the capital of the Emmo sector.

Danoor.title: Danoor
Danoor.lead: Danoor was a planet in the Nah'Malis system located within the Kathol Outback.

Danalbeth.title: Danalbeth
Danalbeth.lead: Danalbeth was a water world located in the Danalbeth system, a part of the Teraab sector in the Slice portion of the Mid Rim. It was postulated by some scientists that Danalbeth was the homeworld of the Graygl, a species of aquatic sentients.

Dandelo.title: Dandelo
Dandelo.lead: Dandelo was a planet inhabited by spotted jugadoos and a sentient, primitive avian species known as Fuzzums.

Daluuj.title: Daluuj/Legends

facts.terrain: Barren canyons, Mud lake, Muddy slopes
facts.affiliation: Hutt Space, Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire

Daluuj.lead: Daluuj was a lightly populated Outer Rim planet covered with barren canyons and muddy slopes.

Dandalas.title: Dandalas
Dandalas.lead: Dandalas was a planet located in the Farlax sector of the Core Worlds.

Danar.title: Danar
Danar.lead: Danar was a planet located within the Vernet system of the Expansion Region. It was a planet full of many vast red deserts.

Dankayo.title: Dankayo/Legends
Dankayo.lead: Dankayo was a world in the Colonies on the Shwuy Exchange with a Alliance to Restore the Republic administrative base, known as Dankayo Base, that served three sectors for purposes of coordination and records. Part of the area within its purview was Ralltiir sector.

Damualer Triac.title: Damualer Triac
Damualer Triac.lead: Damualer Triac was a planet located in the Damualer Triac system of the Inner Rim of the galaxy. The Millennium Oak grew on the world. Jedi Master Haaran Balmor retired to Damualer Triac with his second wife, Hannah Balmor. Haaran and Jedi Hart Daele, who was seven kiloparsecs away in the Samarine Province, played several games of Divoran Holochess over a forty-year period via Projective Telepathy.

Danadine.title: Danadine
Danadine.lead: Danadine was a world located in the Danadine system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Dail sector. Around 10 ABY, it served as the homeworld of Relekin Confidential, a collection agency that constituted a part of the Tenloss Syndicate.

Danchian Prime.title: Danchian Prime
Danchian Prime.lead: Danchian Prime was a planet in the Outer Rim's Dail sector. The bounty hunter Milko claimed to have a family on Danchian Prime, despite being a droid.

Daluba.title: Daluba
Daluba.lead: Daluba was a world ruled by the tyrant Tonkoss Rathba, until Rathba was thwarted by Leia Organa Solo during the time of the New Republic.

Dancreti.title: Dancreti
Dancreti.lead: Dancreti was a planet of tropical jungles and swamps. Its year in local days was 333 days. It was famous for its small animals called the sanl'jek.

Dandrian.title: Dandrian
Dandrian.lead: Dandrian in the Dandrian system was called the "crossroads of the galaxy". It had a single sun and was orbited by the Dandrian's Ring of asteroids, the remnants of a moon that struck the planet during formation. It had a thick atmosphere, flat marshes, and tropical grass, but no trees. It was located between Tatooine and Yavin, and between Bespin and Dantooine. It was inhabited by indigenous bonecrushers as well as Humans and Gamorreans.

Danos V.title: Danos V
Danos V.lead: Danos V was an astronomical body in the Danos system of the Outer Rim Territories' Shadola sector. Sting insects that were said to be large in comparison to other insects in the galaxy could be found on Danos V.

Damendine.title: Damendine system/Legends
Damendine.lead: The Damendine system was a part of the Calamari sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It lay between the Krinemonen and Pinperu systems on the Tidal Circuit hyperlane.

Daltarri.title: Daltarri
Daltarri.lead: The planet Daltarri was a terrestrial world located in the galaxy. It was covered in plant life which was the home of the plant-based Daltarri species.

Dandoran.title: Dandoran

facts.affiliation: Hutt Clan, Alliance to Restore the Republic, Galactic Empire

Dandoran.lead: Dandoran was a lush and watery planet located in the Doran system, within Hutt Space. Throughout history, it was often used to hide cartel smuggling operations. It was covered in crystal clear lakes and pristine forests.

Dantooine.title: Dantooine/Legends

facts.routes: Coruscant–Dantooine hyperlane, Myto's Arrow, Veragi Trade Route
facts.terrain: Ocean, Savanna, Mountain, Steppes, Rivers, Grasslands
facts.population: 1,000 (modern), 100% Dantari, 334,000 (Galactic Civil War era), 35% Human, 18% Dantari, 47% Other species, 2 million (historic)
facts.language: Galactic Basic Standard, Dantarian, Previously Yuuzhan Vong
facts.affiliation: Dantaris, Infinite Empire, Galactic Republic, Jedi Order, Darth Revan's Sith Empire, Khoonda, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire …

Dantooine.lead: Dantooine was a pleasant world of pastel grasslands dotted with trees, rivers and lakes, located in the Raioballo sector of the Outer Rim (at an endpoint of Myto's Arrow, the other endpoint being in the Obtrexta sector); however, the planet itself was still rather far-removed from most galactic traffic. Dantooine was home to a small population of peaceful Human settlers, largely engaged in agriculture and inhabiting single-family dwellings within small communities, some with larger land holdings.

Danuta.title: Danuta

facts.affiliation: B'omarr Order, Smugglers, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Danuta.lead: Danuta was a dull, barren brown planet in the Colavas system, thinly populated mostly by miners and hardscrabble farmers. Trid was the planet's de facto capital.

Darlyn Boda.title: Darlyn Boda/Legends

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Greater Javin, Western Reaches
facts.routes: Corellian Trade Spine, Lutrillia–Darlyn Boda trade route

Darlyn Boda.lead: Darlyn Boda was a criminal trading planet and shadowport originally settled by the Galactic Republic, in the distant Darlyn Boda system of the Anoat sector, located at the far end of the Corellian Trade Spine in the Outer Rim Territories. Known for its humid, twisting jungles, bubbling mud pits, and hanging clouds of steam, Darlyn Boda was a place where the credit was king, a lawless world complementing the Greater Javin region in which it rested, an area of space negatively publicized for its pirate activity.

Dar'Or.title: Dar'Or
Dar'Or.lead: Dar'Or, also known as OM973, was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Jospro sector. Its land surface was primarily covered in forests of two-hundred-meter-tall waza trees. The forests, which had multiple floor-like levels, were home to the predatory indola tree-sloths as well as the sentient flying primates Ri'Dar.

Darada.title: Darada
Darada.lead: Darada was a planet on the edge of the Core Worlds. Jev Sunrider was a Jedi Watchman of Darada. His grandson, Andur Sunrider, spent the first nineteen years of his life there.

Datar.title: Datar/Legends
Datar.lead: Datar was the homeworld of the Ghostling species. Its princess was kidnapped by slavers in 32 BBY, though she and several other Ghostling children were rescued by Anakin Skywalker.

Darlon.title: Darlon
Darlon.lead: Darlon was a celestial body located in the Darlon system of the Mid Rim's Eucer sector. Senator Jonas Wallen, who represented a sector in the Galactic Republic's Senate, hailed from Darlon.

Daroon.title: Daroon
Daroon.lead: Daroon was a planet represented in the Imperial Senate by Alku Vordu.

Darepp.title: Darepp
Darepp.lead: Darepp was a planet located in the Southern Core portion of the Colonies. It was located near the Foless Crossroads.

Danzer.title: Danzer
Danzer.lead: Danzer was a planet in the Essesia system. It was a smaller-than-average gas giant with two moons.

Darkon III.title: Darkon III
Darkon III.lead: Darkon III was a planet of the Darkon system, within the Chaama sector, in the Mid Rim and Northern Dependencies regions of the galaxy. In 0 BBY, the corporate criminal Linkaas requested that his employee, the smuggler Dannen Lifehold, make a stop in Darkon III, before proceeding to his destination, the planet Dohu VII. This was in order for Linkaas to gain time to organize a trap on Dohu VII for the smuggler.

Dartessex IV.title: Dartessex IV
Dartessex IV.lead: Dartessex IV was a celestial body located in the Dartessex system, a part of the Slice portion of the Inner Rim. The home offices of House Renliss, a chapter house of the Bounty Hunters' Guild, were located at Dartessex IV, leading to the celestial body being considered the homeworld of the house. Dartessex IV was listed as the Renliss headquarters in an entry for the house included in the Bounty Hunters Guild Handbook.

Dargulli.title: Dargulli/Legends
Dargulli.lead: Dargulli was a planet in the Kether system in the Inner Rim.

Darsie.title: Darsie
Darsie.lead: Darsie was a backwater planet in between Commenor and Phorliss.

Daslkehnt.title: Daslkehnt
Daslkehnt.lead: Daslkehnt was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories.

Danton VI.title: Danton VI
Danton VI.lead: Danton VI was a transitional planet under the control of the Galactic Empire, and a leading weapons manufacturer for the Imperial cause. Weapons were shipped off-planet daily from its numerous manufacturing plants. Like any weapons manufacturing planet, it had a large complement of stormtroopers to guard the assembly facilities.

Daruvvia.title: Daruvvia system/Legends
Daruvvia.lead: The Daruvvia system was located in the Lorelli Reach, an area of the Hapes Cluster in the Slice portion of the Inner Rim. It was connected by the hyperlane known as the Lorell Route to the Ket and Sennex systems.

Dasoor.title: Dasoor/Legends
Dasoor.lead: Dasoor was a world located in the Dasoor system of the Agarix sector, a part of the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim. A hyperlane known as the Agarix Trade Route connected it to the Umthyg system of the nearby Juvex sector.

Daronak.title: Daronak
Daronak.lead: Daronak was a terrestrial planet located in the Daronak system, a part of the Phelleem sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the site of Channoga Boulevard.

Darvannis.title: Darvannis
Darvannis.lead: Darvannis was a desert planet in the galaxy where the Hutt Cartel ostensibly built up its military forces during the Galactic War. When the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire attempted to intervene, they found the renegade Dread Master Styrak attempting to gather the forces at Darvannis to serve the Masters' Dread Host instead. After Styrak's defeat in battle, the Eternal Empire occupied Darvannis, where they produced Skytroopers and advanced GEMINI units to ensure their conquest of the galaxy.

Dathomir.title: Dathomir/Legends

facts.species: Dathomirian, Kwa (historically), Kwi (Subspecies of the Kwa)
facts.affiliation: Kwa holdings, Infinite Empire, Paecian Empire, Drackmarians, Brotherhood of Darkness, Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire …

Dathomir.lead: Dathomir was a remote, obscure and dangerous planet in the Outer Rim Territories. It was inhabited by Force-sensitive Humans known as the Witches of Dathomir, along with their evil counterparts, the Nightsisters. It was also the homeworld of the dreaded rancors. Dathomir was the site of numerous battles throughout galactic history.

Deko Neimoidia.title: Deko Neimoidia/Legends

facts.affiliation: Trade Federation, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Republic

Deko Neimoidia.lead: Deko Neimoidia was a wealthy Colonies planet that was a purse world of the Neimoidian species. By the time of the Clone Wars, it was the possession of the Trade Federation and the Confederacy of Independent Systems. The Galactic Republic laid siege to the planet near the end of that conflict, with the Jedi-led offensive eventually resulting in the devastation and capture of the world.

Davnar II.title: Davnar II/Legends
Davnar II.lead: Davnar II, or simply Davnar, was a little-known planet in the Davnar system of the Kanchen sector, located in the Core Worlds.

Delassin VI.title: Delassin VI
Delassin VI.lead: Delassin VI was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Calaron sector. It had oceans on its surface, and primitive seagoing vessels plied the waters of the planet's Diniz and Zehr Seas. The Vodran Xenon Nnaksta found work as a longshoreman at the docks servicing the Delassin VI sea vessels by 22 BBY and enjoyed handling cargo there until his career path took him off-world again.

Daver Kuat.title: Daver Kuat
Daver Kuat.lead: Daver Kuat was the third planet in the Kuat system.

Delanoth.title: Delanoth
Delanoth.lead: Delanoth was a tiny gas giant in the Prakith system of the Deep Core's Sector 5. The planet occupied the fourth orbital position around the star Prak and had eight moons.

Delantine.title: Delantine

facts.affiliation: Galactic Empire, Alliance to Restore the Republic

Delantine.lead: Delantine was a planet in the Delantine system. The Alliance sent Granit to Delantine to bolster Rebel sympathy. Trux Zissu was chosen to be the Governor of Delantine by the Alliance after the Battle of Yavin. Trux and his son Stuart Zissu traveled to the Delantine system from Yavin 4 with C-3PO, 4B-X, and R2-D2 in Timespan, but the ship was disabled by an Imperial warship when it reached the system. Trux gave himself up to the Imperials, buying Stuart time to escape to the surface of Da'nor in Escape Pod 4 with the droids.

Dega.title: Dega

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Metharian Nebula Territories

Dega.lead: Dega was a planet in the Dega system of the Elrood sector. Its local day was 19 standard hours long; its year was 295 local days long. The planet was covered in rocky wastelands. It hosted a Radell Mining Corporation mining colony. During the early years of the Galactic Empire, the world's minerals and ores ran dry. The colony was abandoned, leaving behind a polluted planet. The old mines became smugglers' refuges.

Delari Prime.title: Delari Prime
Delari Prime.lead: Delari Prime was a planet in the Delari system of Corva sector, orbiting twin stars. It suffered an asteroid collision thousands of years before the Galactic Civil War, pushing the planet to an orbit closer to the stars, making the planet a desert world. An Imperial relay station was established on Delari Prime, which was abandoned after the Battle of Endor and became the home of New Republic archaeologist Dr. Oron.

Daupherm.title: Daupherm/Legends
Daupherm.lead: Daupherm was the capital world of the Daupherm Planet States. It was located in the Core Worlds, close to the Deep Core.

Davirien.title: Davirien
Davirien.lead: Davirien was a jungle planet in the Corporate Sector owned by the Chiewab Amalgamated Pharmaceuticals Company. Chiewab used the planet for research, and also permitted the Galactic Empire to use the planet for training missions.

DeGerrillion.title: DeGerrillion
DeGerrillion.lead: DeGerrillion was a planet located in the Tamarin sector of the Outer Rim Territories where criminals Marg Sonat and Pari' Notgoth were almost killed.

De'nel.title: De'nel system
De'nel.lead: The De'nel system was a star system in the Brak sector of the Expansion Region where viper probe droids were deployed during Project Swarm.

Delacrix.title: Delacrix/Legends

facts.affiliation: Xim's Empire, Hutt Cartel, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Delacrix.lead: Delacrix was a planet located within the Calaron sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Originally known as Duinihiim, it was absorbed into Xim's empire as he expanded his borders from the Kingdom of Cron. Histories of the planet talked about the ancient Hutts, previous to their civil war, with horror and fear. During the Fourth Pius Dea Crusade, the Pius Dea-controlled Galactic Republic launched assaults on Delacrix and other planets to the north of Hutt Space.

Decepino.title: Decepino
Decepino.lead: Decepino was the fifth planet orbiting the star Stisste in the Saleucami system. Located in the Suolriep sector of the Outer Rim Territories, it was a gas giant.

Deel.title: Deel
Deel.lead: Deel was the molten first planet of the Neimoidia system of the galaxy's Colonies region, where it orbited the star Nen.

Deadon.title: Deadon (disambiguation)
Deadon.lead: Deadon may refer to one of the following:

Daxam IV.title: Daxam IV
Daxam IV.lead: Daxam IV, also referred to simply as Daxam, was a cold, desert planet in the Outer Rim Territories, at the edge of the binary star system of the same name. It was connected by hyperspace route to Rior and Azzameen Station, and was also near the planet Pamarthe. Consequently, many Pamarthen pilots were recruited to work there.

Dela.title: Dela
Dela.lead: Dela was a female who was the sister of Lindon Javes. At some point, they were killed during hazardous maneuvers. By 4 ABY, they were mentioned on Javes' Imperial record.

Delaya.title: Delaya/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Alderaanian Resistance, Alliance to Restore the Republic, Alliance of Free Planets, New Republic …

Delaya.lead: Delaya was the third planet from the star Alderaan in the Alderaan system., It was the sister world of Alderaan before the latter's destruction by the first Death Star.

Dellalt.title: Dellalt/Legends

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Greater Tion, Tion Cluster
facts.affiliation: Xim's Empire, Galactic Republic, Brotherhood of Darkness, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Dellalt.lead: Dellalt was a planet in the Tion Hegemony.

Demar.title: Demar

facts.government: Lant Mining Corporation ownership and administration

Demar.lead: Demar was the fourth planet of the Demar system.

Delrakkin.title: Delrakkin/Legends
Delrakkin.lead: Delrakkin was the only planet in the Delrakkin system capable of sustaining life. Home to the reptilian Delrakkin, the world was covered with mountain ranges and jungles, as well as a perpetual cloud cover that provided it with incessant storms and rain. Delrakkin City was the only civilized location on the planet and was home to the Delrakkin, until the Galactic Empire invaded.

Demophon.title: Demophon

facts.population: 22 BBY:, 35 million, Galactic Civil War:, 43 million
facts.government: Demophon Council, Imperial Overlord with an advisory council

Demophon.lead: Demophon was a planet in the Core Worlds, the primary planet of the Demophon system. The planet had two continents, Junno and Klis, which were surrounded by a vast ocean. It was named for Alres Demophon, one of the founders of the Republic Scout Service.

Delphon.title: Delphon/Legends
Delphon.lead: Delphon was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories, near the Ison Corridor. It was headquarters of the Black Hole Gang, which the Galactic Empire attempted to wipe out. The planet was represented in the Imperial Senate by Ilov Maas.

Delderaan.title: Delderaan
Delderaan.lead: Delderaan was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Delderaan system, a part of the Noonian sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories. Long before the Galactic Civil War, Delderaan's northern regions were home to several tribes that had primitive art. The gas giant–type planet Yavin Prime, due to its multi-colored bands of atmospheric gas, resembled an intricate ball of yarns woven by artists of the Delderaan tribes and thrown into the night sky.

Delemede.title: Delemede/Legends
Delemede.lead: Delemede was an Outer Rim Territories astronomical object located in the Rseik sector. Overseen by a Galactic Republic governor, Delemede was struck by a plague around 3643 BBY. At that time, the governor refused to provide medical aid to Sith Empire refugees on Delemede, but he eventually changed his mind.

Demesel.title: Demesel/Legends
Demesel.lead: Demesel was a planet of grassy plains in the Meram sector, presumably in the Demesel system. Its local day was 22 standard hours long; its year was 285 local days long. It was a trading hub of the Outer Rim settled by a consortium of Galactic Core businesses. With the beginning of the Galactic Civil War, the planet lost its importance, becoming a backwater. It became the headquarters of the Glasfir Ring, which took over the local underworld, eliminating Hutt competition. The local government was coerced by Glasfir'a'lik to leave the crime ring alone.

Denab.title: Denab/Legends
Denab.lead: Denab was a planet in the Sluis sector of the Outer Rim. During the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire, the planet was the site of a malfunctioning device built by the Rakata species that began generating new species of plants and animals.

Delrian.title: Delrian/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Delrian.lead: Delrian was a prison world in the Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire and New Republic. It was the second planet in its system.

Demonsgate.title: Demonsgate
Demonsgate.lead: Demonsgate, also known as NCW-86, was a planet in the Outer Rim's Kathol Rift, near Yvara. From space the planet often appeared to be engulfed in flames due to the volcanic activity bleeding ionized particles into the atmosphere that interacted with debris attracted from the Rift. In reality, Demonsgate possessed a biosphere full of life including many indigenous, non-sapient life forms.

Delle II.title: Delle II
Delle II.lead: Delle II was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Colonies' Delle system, which contained massive farm worlds. It was situated between the Neuvia and Yabol Opa systems and the Core Worlds' Ralltiir system on the Perlemian Trade Route super-hyperroute, which served as the dividing line between the Northern Dependencies and the Slice.

Demigue.title: Demigue
Demigue.lead: Demigue was a planet distant from Gascon, connected to it by the dangerous trade route known as the Demigue Terror.

Deminol.title: Deminol
Deminol.lead: Deminol was a terrestrial world located in the Deminol system of the Juvex sector, a part of the Senex-Juvex region in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim. The Senex-Juvex Loop hyperlane linked it to the Anstares and Ossiathora systems.

Deltooine.title: Deltooine
Deltooine.lead: Deltooine was a world in the Corporate Sector. It was home to a Corporate Sector Authority military base used to monitor Farana and Wild Space. It was part of the Tertiary Solenbaran hyperlane.

Deltron.title: Deltron/Legends
Deltron.lead: Deltron was a planet in the galaxy's Inner Rim. It was best known for its spice wine.

Delle.title: Delle (disambiguation)
Delle.lead: Delle may refer to one of the following:

Delphon IV.title: Delphon IV

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Greater Javin, Western Reaches

Delphon IV.lead: Delphon IV was a planet located in the Anoat sector of the Outer Rim.

Delphon 7.title: Delphon 7

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Greater Javin, Western Reaches

Delphon 7.lead: Delphon 7 was a planet located in the Anoat sector of the Outer Rim.

Dentaal.title: Dentaal/Legends
Dentaal.lead: Dentaal was a planet in the Core Worlds. Its population was eradicated by an outbreak of the Candorian plague during the Galactic Civil War.

Deralia.title: Deralia
Deralia.lead: Deralia was a planet that was located in the Outer Rim Territories of the galaxy. After the Jedi captured the Sith Lord Darth Revan, the Jedi Council of Dantooine used the Force to heal the severe damage to Revan's mind, which he sustained after being betrayed by his apprentice, Darth Malak. But instead of restoring him, the Council opted to reprogram Revan by inserting an artificial personality into his vulnerable mind.

Derra IV.title: Derra IV/Legends
Derra IV.lead: Derra IV, or Derra Four, also known simply as Derra, was a planet in the Derra system of the Mikaster sector, located in the Expansion Region. It was a minor world of little value and had been relatively overlooked by the Empire early in the Galactic Civil War. This made it an ideal site for Rebel Alliance operations.

Deneba.title: Deneba/Legends
Deneba.lead: Deneba was a reddish-orange Mid Rim planet on the Gamor Run, in the Deneba system. It hosted the Conclave at Deneba in 3997 BBY atop Mount Meru, which was disrupted by the Krath. The Krath killed Arca Jeth during their attack. Deneba was the homeworld of the Deneba bush.

Denevar.title: Denevar
Denevar.lead: Denevar was a planet. During the Galactic Civil War, the planet was controlled by Imperial Prefect Adar.

Denbalen.title: Denbalen
Denbalen.lead: Denbalen was the fourth planet in the Goroth system. It was a gas giant with a 147,100-kilometer diameter. Its seven moons included P'Chek, and the moons were orbited by the remains of an ancient fleet.

Denava.title: Denava
Denava.lead: Denava was a gas giant with six moons. It was the third planet in the Goroth system. It measured 153,050 kilometers in diameter and had strong magnetic and radio fields. The upper atmosphere was home to a beldon-like species of gas-filled creatures.

Dennaskar.title: Dennaskar
Dennaskar.lead: Dennaskar was a forest planet located in the Mid Rim.

Derr.title: Derr
Derr.lead: Derr was a frigid ice planet in the Demophon system with a single moon. It was destroyed when its star went supernova.

Denubba.title: Denubba
Denubba.lead: Denubba was the location where General Maxine Baytor participated in the battle of Denubba. It was located in the Mid Rim.

Denuhi-Eight.title: Denuhi-Eight
Denuhi-Eight.lead: Denuhi-Eight was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Denuhi system, a part of the Greater Plooriod sector in the Northern Dependencies portion of the Expansion Region. It was home to a population of the sentient Baragwin species, members of which tended to be cautious but friendly.

Dersonn III.title: Dersonn III
Dersonn III.lead: Dersonn III was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Dersonn system, a part of the Tammuz sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. At one point, the Wookiee bounty hunter and enslaver Hanharr, who had previously been enslaved himself and harbored a hatred for other living beings, particularly Humans, caused the destruction of the population of Dersonn III. He also survived a freighter crash on the celestial body, a fact that was witnessed by the Human bounty hunter Mira.

Dennogra.title: Dennogra/Legends

facts.affiliation: Xim's empire, Confederacy of Independent Systems

Dennogra.lead: Dennogra, formerly known as Tialvai, was an arid world in the Outer Rim Territories. One of its cities, Zio Snaffkin, was the home of Sprool the Trader.

Denusia.title: Denusia system/Legends
Denusia.lead: The Denusia system was located within the Trailing Sectors portion of the Inner Rim. The system was home to the creature known as the Denusian squirmer.

Derellium.title: Derellium
