facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Greater Tion, Tion Cluster, The Slice
facts.routes: Greater Cronese Arc, Indrexu Route, Lesser Cronese Arc
facts.affiliation: Kingdom of Cron, Xer's Empire, Xim's empire, Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire

Derellium.lead: Derellium was a planet located within the Cronese Mandate of the Outer Rim Territories.

Denebia.title: Denebia
Denebia.lead: Denebia was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Denebia system of the Senex sector, a part of the Senex-Juvex region in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim. Situated near the sector's area known as the Tangles, it was connected to the Anturus and Kalgo systems by the hyperlane known as the Senex-Juvex Loop, while another hyperspace route linked it to the Suliana system.

Derenzil.title: Derenzil/Legends
Derenzil.lead: Derenzil was a swamp planet located in the galaxy. Prior to the Clone Wars, it was the site of a brief civil war during which the Geonosians manufactured and supplied sonic weapons that had been specialized for aquatic environments to both sides.

Denova.title: Denova
Denova.lead: Denova was a planet in the Ojoster sector that consisted mostly of woods and high peaked mountains. Ancient ruins were noted to be present on the surface though details on them were largely undocumented. It was discovered during the Cold War by the Galactic Republic, who first scouted the world. This led to the discovery of extensive deposits of the ore known as baradium. In order to control this resource, the Republic hired a mercenary army due to manpower shortages in the Republic Military.

Dermos.title: Dermos
Dermos.lead: Dermos was a planet in the Belsmuth sector of the Outer Rim Territories. A group of insurgents planning a raid on Dermos were apprehended by the Imperial Security Bureau in 3 ABY. When New Republic pilot Wedge Antilles went missing in 4 ABY, Ensign Ardin Deltura suggested Antilles might be at Dermos.

Denash.title: Denash
Denash.lead: Denash was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories' Batonn sector. During the Imperial Era, it was governed by Governor Wistran. The planet was home to an insurgent movement. During the Batonn sector insurgency, the Denash insurgents were defeated by Admiral Kinshara.

Devaron.title: Devaron/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Corellian Hegemony, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Alliance to Restore the Republic

Devaron.lead: Devaron was the home world of the Devaronians. It was located in the Colonies, near the Corellian Trade Spine. It was a planet of low mountains and deep valleys linked by thousands of rivers. The planet had strict capital punishment and a matriarchal government.

Deyer.title: Deyer/Legends
Deyer.lead: Deyer was one of three habitable, but inhospitable, planets in the Anoat system of the Anoat sector, located in the Greater Javin of the Outer Rim. It was a colony world consisting primarily of oceans and was composed of floating raft cities, including the city of Feiya, and terraformed lakes. It featured abundant aquatic life.

Despayre.title: Despayre
Despayre.lead: Despayre, originally known as Horuz, was a planet in the Horuz system in the Outer Rim Territories, that served as a massive penal and slave world for the Galactic Empire and as a location where the first Death Star was constructed and completed, after being relocated many times to avoid Alliance to Restore the Republic.

Diamal.title: Diamal
Diamal.lead: The Diamala (singular Diamal) were a species from the planet Diamal, in the Core Worlds, who, along with their rivals the Ishori, became prominent during the crises over the Caamas Document and the apparent return of Grand Admiral Thrawn. Diamala were recognizable by their leathery skin, white manes, and fan-shaped ears, which they could move independently to gesture with. The Diamala temperament was generally calm and unemotional, with a strong sense of personal pride. They had extensive financial and business holdings, which they attributed to hard work rather than luck.

Di'tai'ni.title: Di'tai'ni
Di'tai'ni.lead: Di'tai'ni was the home of the Tai'ni, as well as many non-Tai'ni resident workers. It was two systems away from the Both system.

Desevro.title: Desevro/Legends

facts.terrain: Decaying urban sprawl, Mountains, Tundra, Swamps
facts.affiliation: Livien League, Xim's Empire, Honorable Union of Desevro and Tion, Sith Empire, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire

Desevro.lead: Desevro was a heavily urbanized, ancient planet in the Tion Hegemony.

Destrillion.title: Destrillion

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Pentastar Alignment, Imperial Remnant, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Destrillion.lead: Destrillion was a planet in the Dubrillion system of the Outer Rim Territories, in close proximity to Dubrillion and the asteroids of Lando's Folly. It was a barren world with a turbulent atmosphere, and appeared brown and dirty from space. It also contained various energy tunnels as well as an energy field containing a tibanna gas platform.

Deysum III.title: Deysum III

facts.region: Mid Rim, Kashyyyk Region, The Slice

Deysum III.lead: Deysum III was a planet in the Deysum system of the Trax sector.

Deylerax.title: Deylerax
Deylerax.lead: Deylerax was a Mid Rim world, the homeworld of the near-Human Enu race.

Di'wor.title: Di'wor
Di'wor.lead: Di'wor was a planet that was located in Di'wor system, in the Morshdine sector of the Outer Rim region of the galaxy. The planet's singfruit groves' pollination season attracted many tourists.

Devato.title: Devato

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories; Tion Cluster, The Slice

Devato.lead: Devato was the first planet in the Lianna system.

Devon Four.title: Devon Four
Devon Four.lead: Devon Four was a planet aligned with the Galactic Republic. Several years before the Clone Wars broke out, the government of the planet—members of a religious sect—refused to pay taxes. The planet was subsequently embargoed by the Republic, which even prevented medicine being delivered to the planet during an outbreak of plague. Smugglers organized by Sheeka Tull later broke the embargo.

Desargorr.title: Desargorr
Desargorr.lead: Desargorr was a mountainous world located in the Desargorr system. It was a part of the Allied Tion sector of the Tion Cluster, situated within the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories.

Diado.title: Diado

facts.affiliation: Confederacy of Independent Systems, Separatist holdouts

Diado.lead: Diado was a snow-covered world in the Mid Rim.

Dexus-12.title: Dexus-12
Dexus-12.lead: Dexus-12 was a world in a trinary Colonies system.

Desten.title: Desten
Desten.lead: Desten was an airless rock planet with five moons that occupied the fifth orbital position around the star Abo. It was located within the Lehon system, a part of the Unknown Regions' area known as the Tempered Wastes.

Devil's Asteroid.title: Devil's Asteroid
Devil's Asteroid.lead: Devil's Asteroid was an Outer Rim Territories asteroid located within the star system of the same name.

Diab.title: Diab
Diab.lead: Diab was a planet located within the Diab system of the Wild Space. Its sixth moon was orbited by the secret Jedi prison known as the Prism. Diab's electrical storms wreaked havoc with sensors and no transmissions were allowed in or out of the prison.

Desultori.title: Desultori
Desultori.lead: Desultori was a location in the Yde system. It contained the University of Desultori and was home to famed author Aanxi Raanxi Laanxi.

Deysum.title: Deysum system
Deysum.lead: The Deysum system was a star system located in the Mid Rim Territories and the Slice, within the Trax sector. Situated in grid square Q-10 on the Standard Galactic Grid, the Deysum system was connected via the Trax Tube hyperspace route to the planet Randon and the Uogo'cor system.

Dimok.title: Dimok/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Galactic Federation of Free Alliances

Dimok.lead: Dimok was a planet located in the Sepan system, a part of the Sepan sector in the Slice portion of the Expansion Region.

Disim.title: Disim
Disim.lead: Disim was a planet in the Epidimi system, discovered 5000 BBY by the Republic, which crossbred its native avians with those of Iri, resulting in the Tarongs, whom drove their mother species on both worlds extinct.

Djurmo.title: Djurmo
Djurmo.lead: Djurmo was a blasted volcanic world located in the Djurmo system, a part of the Strabin sector in the New Territories portion of the Mid Rim. It was the homeworld of the sentient reptilian Huralok species, members of which spoke the Huralok language and became well-known during the reign of the Galactic Empire for piracy. Redkihl Rokk was a Huralok pirate from Djurmo.

Dilonexa XXIII.title: Dilonexa XXIII
Dilonexa XXIII.lead: Dilonexa XXIII was a large agriworld located in the Outer Rim Territories' Centrality sector. Each year the planet exported billions of tons of agricultural products, and it served as the Centrality's main producer of foodstuffs, with orbital weather-control satellites helping disperse the local city-sized tornados. Due to Dilonexa XXIII lacking heavy metals in its geological makeup, its inhabitants, the Dilonexicans, developed an allergic reaction to foods that contained high quantities of trace metals.

Dlor 3.title: Dlor 3
Dlor 3.lead: Dlor 3 was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Dlor system, a part of the Mid Rim's Dononter sector. Around 2 ABY, the Secure Passage seminar was scheduled to take place on Dlor 3. The Morellian scout and the founder of the Galactic Outdoor Survival School, Barosa Warren, planned to attend the seminar.

Dilbana.title: Dilbana

facts.affiliation: Hutt Cartel, Desilijic kajidic, Besadii kajidic

Dilbana.lead: Dilbana was a planet in the Baxel sector of the Outer Rim. Located along the Triellus Trade Route, the planet was under a de facto rulership overseen by Jiliac Desilijic Tiron. This form of rule ended with the Hutt Lord's death at the hands of Durga Besadii Tai.

Dithanune.title: Dithanune
Dithanune.lead: Dithanune was a planet located in the Dithanune system, a part of the Bortele sector in the Slice portion of the Mid Rim. It was home to the lethal predator known as the needle beast, which the Defel miner and undercover Rebel Alliance spy and saboteur Thar'quan once encountered by the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Dix'thaar.title: Dix'thaar
Dix'thaar.lead: Dix'thaar was a planet in the Inner Rim of the galaxy, host to a Rebel Alliance cell during the Galactic Civil War.

Dinlo.title: Dinlo
Dinlo.lead: Dinlo was a forest planet in the Dinlo system. It was the site of a rescue mission undertaken by Jedi Knight Etain Tur-Mukan to rescue a thousand clone troopers during the Clone Wars.

Dica.title: Dica
Dica.lead: Dica was a toxic planet where Qymaen jai Sheelal, better known as General Grievous, was believed to have murdered a Dark Jedi who carried Bane's Heart.

Diorda.title: Diorda
Diorda.lead: Diorda was a planet in the Mid Rim that contained a secret Separatist weapons factory. During the Clone Wars, Luminara Unduli was assigned to investigate the secret factory, and after a duel in Mondo-Mod the Hutt's Arena of Doom, Luminara received the coordinates of the weapons factory, and presumably used them to destroy it.

Dirha.title: Dirha
Dirha.lead: Dirha was a gritty industrial planet that was located within the Dirha system of the galaxy's Hutt Space region and lay on the hyperlane called the Sisar Run, which connected it to the world of Cyborrea and the Sespe system.

Diyu.title: Diyu
Diyu.lead: Diyu was a planet that was located within the Diyu system of the galaxy's Hutt Space region and lay on the hyperlane called the Shag Pabol, which connected it to the Rorak system and the world of Ylesia.

Dioll.title: Dioll
Dioll.lead: Dioll was a rocky planet located in the Dioll system of the Juvex sector, a part of the Senex-Juvex region in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim. The Kassido Bypass hyperlane linked it to the Kardura and Thermon systems.

Ding Briar.title: Ding Briar
Ding Briar.lead: Ding Briar was a gas giant–type planet with eighteen moons that occupied the eighth orbital position around the star Abo. It was located within the Lehon system, a part of the Unknown Regions' area known as the Tempered Wastes.

Doan.title: Doan
Doan.lead: Doan was a small planet in the Outer Rim Territories whose sole economy was focused on mining. It was ruled by a group of nobles, the Doan Royal House, while most of its population were miners who lived in poverty.

Dibrook.title: Dibrook
Dibrook.lead: Dibrook was an uninhabitable planet in the Albarrio sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Divac 7.title: Divac 7
Divac 7.lead: Divac 7 was a location in the Outer Rim Territories and the place where the Imperial trooper Lonkin had distinguished himself in service, earning the title of hero.

Dinwa Prime.title: Dinwa Prime
Dinwa Prime.lead: Dinwa Prime was a planet in the Inner Rim Territories that was occupied by the Galactic Empire. Imperial atrocities committed on the world by 18 BBY were cited in anti-Imperial broadcasts sent from the planet Lothal that year. In 6 BBY, Dinwa Prime's planetary governor was killed by what Imperial sources claimed was a locally-sponsored rebel. As a result, the planet was made a firing range for the Imperial Navy starships passing along the nearby Hydian Way.

Dinzo.title: Dinzo
Dinzo.lead: Dinzo was a planet located in the Dinzo system in the Msst sector of the Mid Rim Territories.

Donadus.title: Donadus
Donadus.lead: Donadus was an astronomical object located in the Donadus system, a part of the Inner Rim's Bamula sector. It shared its name with the sentient species Donadi.

Dolomar.title: Dolomar

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Dolomar.lead: Dolomar was the sector capital of Dolomar sector. The mostly Human population lived underground to avoid the bitter cold. The largest of these underground complexes, Diflu, was located in the northernmost mountains of the planet, the L'tiri Peaks. The local day lasted 45 standard hours. The local year lasted 224 local days. Its hydrosphere was mostly solidified as glaciers and snow.

Doneer'so.title: Doneer'so
Doneer'so.lead: Doneer'so was the primary planet of the Doneer'so system in the Fakir sector of the Bakchou arm. It was the homeworld of the insectoid Doneer race. During the Galactic Civil War, Doneer'so served as the sector capital for the Galactic Empire, who established their headquarters in the Sotak'vik clan-city. The Empire maintained a deflector shield and nuclear-damping system over their sector capital, and the use of Sotak'vik engendered fanatic loyalty to the Empire in the Sotak city-clan.

Dohu VII.title: Dohu VII
Dohu VII.lead: Dohu VII was the seventh of eight planets in the Dohu system. It was the homeworld of the mineral-based species called the Silika. Linkaas Corporation had a warehouse near Docking Bay 71 in Skagras.

Dom-Bradden.title: Dom-Bradden/Legends
Dom-Bradden.lead: Dom-Bradden, also known as Bradden, was a planet in the Outer Rim. It was the home planet of the Affytechans, a race of sentient botanicals.

Dolis 3.title: Dolis 3
Dolis 3.lead: Dolis 3 was a snowy Imperial Remnant planet in the Outer Rim Territories, in the influence of Yaga Minor.

Dohlban.title: Dohlban
Dohlban.lead: Dohlban was a terrestrial planet located in the Dohlban system, a part of the Dohlbani sector in the Slice portion of the Mid Rim. The Kaaga Run hyperlane connected it to the Void Station in the Bothan sector and the Nar Kaaga system in Hutt Space.

Doli.title: Doli
Doli.lead: Doli was a planet in the Outer Rim rumored by 39 BBY to be the location of a Sith holocron.

Domgrin.title: Domgrin
Domgrin.lead: Domgrin was a planet that was located within the Domgrin system, a part of the Prefsbelt sector in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. It was located relatively close to the planet Gonmore.

Dolucar.title: Dolucar

facts.region: Core Worlds, Northern Dependencies, The Slice, Arrowhead

Dolucar.lead: Dolucar was the sixth planet of the Chandrila system, located in the Bormea sector of the Ringali Shell region of the Core Worlds. Dolucar was a gas giant and orbited the star Chandrila. Twelve moons circled the planet, the most of any planet in the system. The entirety of the Chandrila system lay on the Perlemian Trade Route, which served as a dividing line between the Northern Dependencies and the Arrowhead portion of the Slice.

Dolstan.title: Dolstan
Dolstan.lead: Dolstan was one of the planets of the Pimbrellan League. It was the planet originally settled by the Pinacists, and was dominant in League politics. It was a dry planet, covered in savannas, deserts and land-locked salt lakes. The land was fertile, and Dolstan provided much of the food for the League.

Don I.title: Don I system/Legends
Don I.lead: The Don I system was in the Freeworlds Territory of the Tapani sector, near the Lusk system.

Don II.title: Don II system/Legends
Don II.lead: The Don II system was in the Freeworlds Territory of the Tapani sector, near the Lusk system.

Doaskin.title: Doaskin
Doaskin.lead: Doaskin was a planet located in the Doaskin system, a part of the Bruanii sector in the Western Reaches portion of the Outer Rim Territories. During the early years of the reign of the Galactic Empire, which began in 19 BBY, it served as the Tagge Company's primary base for operations in the Greater Javin region. By the time not long after the Battle of Hoth of 3 ABY, Planet Dreams, Incorporated had custom-developed and sold to the House of Tagge a compound at Doaskin, with the company's primary saleswoman Treva Horme being credited with seeing the deal through.

Dodz.title: Dodz
Dodz.lead: Dodz was a small, barren Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Zoraster sector. It featured extensive crystal caverns, and at some point a profitable crystal mining industry developed on the planet, with the local community being governed by the Citizen's Council of Dodz. However, power on Dodz was eventually usurped by the tyrannical Governor Kugg, who used the combat droid Destroyer to coerce the local merchants into paying heavy taxes.

Doma.title: Doma
Doma.lead: Doma was a scorched planet in the Dantooine system, located in the Raioballo sector of the Outer Rim.

Dolla.title: Dolla/Legends
Dolla.lead: Dolla was an astronomical object located in the Dolla system, a part of the Videnda sector in the Western Reaches portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was situated at the junction of the hyperlanes known as the Nothoiin Corridor, which connected it to the Bavva system in the Anoat sector and the Eriadu system of the Seswenna sector, and the Anturi Reach, which linked it to the Senex sector's Yetoom system.

Dolva Prime.title: Dolva Prime/Legends
Dolva Prime.lead: Dolva Prime was a planet located in the Semagi sector of the Mid Rim. Boba Fett ambushed Edo and Rolu Strom in the Old Hallet prairie of Dolva Prime in 2 ABY in order to recover a fake Arachedron sculpture.

Dominus III.title: Dominus III
Dominus III.lead: Dominus III was a terrestrial planet of the Dominus sector, in the Outer Rim Territories. When seen from space, the planet had a blue halo, and one could distinguish oceans and landmasses.

Doornik-319.title: Doornik-319
Doornik-319.lead: Doornik-319 (also Morning Bell, Morning's Bell and Preza) was a planet in the Doornik-319 system. The planet was known to the Kubaz as Morning's Bell and to the Yevetha as Preza. Originally a Kubaz colony world, it was taken over by the Yevetha during the Great Purge, during which the Yevetha wiped out the Kubaz colonists.

Doniphon.title: Doniphon

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, New Territories, Trans-Hydian

Doniphon.lead: Doniphon was a planet in the Outer Rim's Kwymar sector, in the system of the same name. Doniphon was invaded by the Galactic Empire in 17 BBY, during the Empire's suppressions of rebel activity in the sector. An Imperial platoon succeeded in rooting out Doniphon's dissidents, although promising stormtrooper commander Beilert Valance suffered grave wounds in the process.

Dor Nameth.title: Dor Nameth
Dor Nameth.lead: Dor Nameth was a distant planet located in the Dor Nameth system, a part of the Bright Jewel sector in the New Territories portion of the Mid Rim. The planet was situated on the Celanon Spur hyperlane, which connected it to the Qiilura and Korvaii systems. Dor Nameth was the homeworld of Brangus Glee, an elder of a dexterous species of renowned travelers. By 12 ABY, the planet fell within the borders of the New Republic.

Dordolum.title: Dordolum
Dordolum.lead: Dordolum was a planet located in the Colonies Region of the galaxy. Its population included individuals from a number of sentient species, such as Aqualish, Barabels, Bothans, Duros, Humans and Ishori. A short distance from a spaceport on the planet was a plaza that contained the Stand of Public Expression. The plaza was lined with paved pathways and flowerbeds, and was bordered by the Bothan-owned Solferin Shipping Company.

Donovia.title: Donovia/Legends
Donovia.lead: Donovia was a planet located in the Donovia system, a part of the Hali sector in the Slice portion of the Expansion Region. It featured rugged terrain and rainy seasons.

Doornik-207.title: Doornik-207
Doornik-207.lead: Doornik-207 was a planet located witnin the Koornacht Cluster in the Core Worlds. The planet was colonized by the Corasgh, settled under the Galactic Empire. However, it was wiped out by the Yevetha during the Great Purge, whereupon the Yevetha colonized the world.

Doornik-628A.title: Doornik-628A
Doornik-628A.lead: Doornik-628A was the first planet in the Doornik-628 system, located in the Farlax sector. It was a part of the Koornacht Cluster, itself a region of the Negs portion of the Core Worlds. One of the three gas giants in the system, which was centered around the star Doornik-628, Doornik-628A was orbited by three moons.

Doornik-628B.title: Doornik-628B
Doornik-628B.lead: Doornik-628B was the second planet in the Doornik-628 system, which was located in the Farlax sector, a part of the Negs portion of the Core Worlds. The planet orbited the star Doornik-628 and was itself circled by a single moon. Doornik-628B, like its neighbor Doornik-628C, featured acidic clouds.

Doornik-628C.title: Doornik-628C
Doornik-628C.lead: Doornik-628C was the third planet in the Doornik-628 system. Its core was surrounded by acidic clouds, and it had no natural satellites.

Doornik-628F.title: Doornik-628F
Doornik-628F.lead: Doornik-628F was the sixth planet in the Doornik-628 system, located in the Farlax sector, which was in turn a part of the Koornacht Cluster, a region of the Negs portion of the Core Worlds. The system was centered around the star Doornik-628. Doornik-628F was a gas giant and was circled by eleven moons.

Doornik-628G.title: Doornik-628G
Doornik-628G.lead: Doornik-628G was a gas giant in the Doornik-628 system.

Doornik-628H.title: Doornik-628H
Doornik-628H.lead: Doornik-628H was a planet in the Doornik-628 system.

Dor.title: Dor

facts.sector: Zuma sector; Moddell sector; Outer Moddell systems

Dor.lead: Dor was the fourth planet in the Endor system.

Donoa.title: Donoa
Donoa.lead: Donoa was the eighth planet in the Kamino system. It was orbited by 17 moons.

Dorcin.title: Dorcin
Dorcin.lead: Dorcin was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories, on or near the Rimma Trade Route. It was a Dorcin trader who traded the Squibs starship technology in exchange for mineral rights to a frozen waste on Skor II.

Dononter Minor.title: Dononter Minor
Dononter Minor.lead: Dononter Minor was a world located in the Dononter Minor system, a part of the Mid Rim's Dononter sector. Dononter Minor had a Type I breathable atmosphere, and it was the homeworld of the plant known as the widowmaker, which could be used as a weapon.

Dorajan.title: Dorajan
Dorajan.lead: Dorajan was a planet in the Mid Rim within Lannik Space, densely covered in jungle. Around 3–4 ABY, the ship of the smuggler Platt Okeefe was shot down by TIE fighters from an Imperial orbital outpost as she attempted to flee with an unlicensed shipment of heavy blasters of Imperial manufacture. Okeefe was forced to land her ship in the jungle of Dorajan and hurriedly begin repairs, fearing that her location could soon be detected by a Star Destroyer in orbit, which might then dispatch a heavily-armed someone to collect her.

Dontamo.title: Dontamo
Dontamo.lead: Dontamo was a planet in the Radiant One system, near Alba-16. It was a jungle world in 19 BBY and it was where Ferus Olin and Clive Flax were held in captivity at Dontamo Prison for crimes against the Galactic Empire. The prisoners were compelled to work in a factory building parts of the first Death Star.

Dorande.title: Dorande
Dorande.lead: Dorande was the homeworld of the Dorande race, who tried to conquer the planet R-Duba. This plan was foiled by C-3PO and R2-D2, however.

Doreen.title: Doreen
Doreen.lead: Doreen was a waterworld located in the Doreen system of the Senex sector, a part of the Senex-Juvex region in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim. Situated near the Tangles area of the sector, the planet was linked via hyperlanes to the Kalgo and Usnia systems. The surface of Doreen featured gentle waters and scattered islands.

Dorin.title: Dorin/Legends

facts.routes: Celanon Spur, Dorin Run, Namadii Corridor
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Brotherhood of Darkness, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire, Imperial Remnant, Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire

Dorin.lead: Dorin was a dark and dusty planet in the Expansion Region. It was the homeworld of the Kel Dors, with an atmosphere of a unique gas and helium.

Draethos.title: Draethos/Legends
Draethos.lead: Draethos were a predatory humanoid species from the planet Draethos, notable for their long natural lifespans.

Dosuun.title: Dosuun
Dosuun.lead: Dosuun was a planet located in the Dosuun system in Wild Space of the galaxy. From space, the planet could be seen to possess varied terrain and several seas. It also had at least one area of hilly temperate grassland.

Douglas III.title: Douglas III
Douglas III.lead: Douglas III, the third planet of the remote Douglas system, was a member of the Centrality region of the Outer Rim Territories. Far from the Galactic Core and of little interest to the rest of the galaxy, Douglas III was made famous by the game hunter Mendel Douglas, who failed to return from the planet during a quest to acquire the hide of Douglas III's elusive native jackelope. The planet later attracted pirates and black-marketeers.

Drackmar.title: Drackmar

facts.affiliation: Drackmarians, Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders, Galactic Empire, Zsinj's Empire, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Drackmar.lead: Drackmar was the Drackmarian homeworld, located in the Drackmar system, in the Quelii sector of the Outer Rim Territories. The atmosphere of Drackmar was composed of methane, requiring native Drackmarians to wear special methane helmets when traveling off-world. On the other hand, oxygen-breathing species could use environmentally-sealed vehicles, such as the Orbitblade-2000, to visit the planet.

Draenell's Point.title: Draenell's Point

facts.region: Mid Rim, Kashyyyk Region, The Slice

Draenell's Point.lead: Draenell's Point was an agriworld in the Trax sector in the Mid Rim. The planet supplied food to both sides during the Galactic Civil War.

Dra III.title: Dra III
Dra III.lead: Dra III was a planet in the Outer Rim's Wyl sector that was known for its dangerous wildlife. Groundquakes and severe storms were commonplace on Dra III, and the weather, combined with high gravity, created strong and powerful fauna. Sport hunters frequently visited the world looking for trophies—the six-legged predator known as the nashtah was the most famous of Dra III's native beasts, and was sometimes used as guard beasts offworld.

Dornea.title: Dornea/Legends
Dornea.lead: Dornea was the homeworld of the Dornean species. The planet was located in the Dornean system of the Dominus sector, which bordered the Calamari sector out on the Slice.

Dorriella.title: Dorriella
Dorriella.lead: Dorriella was a terrestrial world located in the Dorriella system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Wazta sector. A family with three children, including the Human girl Shanna Kinn, lived there, with Kinn spending time with her two older brothers and learning to repair starships as a result.

Dorlon II.title: Dorlon II
Dorlon II.lead: Dorlon II was a barren planet near Carida. It was an extremely volcanic world covered in sulfur, ash, and lava. From space it had the look of a colorful mosaic of black, tan, yellow.

Dorella.title: Dorella

facts.sector: Tapani sector, Freeworlds Territory, Three Ellas
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Tapani Empire, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Dorella.lead: Dorella was a planet in the Dorella system in the Tapani sector. It was one of the Freeworlds Territory and one of the Three Ellas. It had a liberal government that was looser about crime and smuggling than most Tapani worlds.

Dorlo.title: Dorlo
Dorlo.lead: Dorlo was a planet located in the Atravis sector of the Outer Rim Territories and was controlled by the Galactic Empire.

Drall.title: Drall/Legends
Drall.lead: The Drall were a small, furry, and highly intelligent species found on Drall in the Corellian system. They were descended from burrowing mammals and they were extremely diligent record-keepers, and it was said that they had recorded every trivial event since the dawn of intelligence. Libraries were among their greatest forms of entertainment, as were story-telling sessions called Ta'sharr.

Dorsis.title: Dorsis
Dorsis.lead: Dorsis was a Core world in the Corellian sector sometimes referred to as "Mini-Coruscant."

Drannik.title: Drannik
Drannik.lead: Drannik was a planet in the Expansion Region. It was a member world of the New Republic and was represented in the New Republic Senate.

Dractu.title: Dractu
Dractu.lead: Dractu was a peaceful, undeveloped planet in the Mid Rim, within the borders of Lannik Space, but far from any hyperlanes. It was the homeworld of the Dractuvian people. According to Jedi Knight Obi-Wan Kenobi, the planet had the worst food in the galaxy.

Draboon.title: Draboon/Legends
Draboon.lead: Draboon was a Mandalorian planet located within the Mandalore sector, in the region of the galaxy known as the Outer Rim Territories. Situated within the eponymous Draboon system, Draboon was a source of high-quality lapis.

Dramassia.title: Dramassia
Dramassia.lead: Dramassia was a densely-populated urban planet located in the Dramassia system of the Juvex sector, a part of the Senex-Juvex region in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim. It lay on the hyperlane known as the Agarix Trade Route, which connected it to the Pieldi and Umthyg systems. Dramassia was the point of origin of the material known as Dramassian shimmersilk, which was already encountered offworld around 3643 BBY.

Doshan.title: Doshan

facts.region: Expansion Region, Outer Expansion Zone, Northern Dependencies

Doshan.lead: Doshan was an Expansion Region world situated in the Drannik sector. It was the homeworld of Doshan blood worms. A raider from Doshan once injured Galactic Republic Chief Sergeant Saens Sukko during a mission to collapse the Clowse Glowstack structure as part of the Waymancy Storm conflict. Later, during the reign of the Galactic Empire, a group of Trandoshans attacked Imperial colonists on Doshan. In response, the Empire's 501st Legion carried out an operation on the world, including an attack against a Trandoshan nest near the Arakka waterway.

Dressel.title: Dressel/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Alliance to Restore the Republic, Alliance of Free Planets, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire …

Dressel.lead: Dressel was the homeworld of the Dressellians and primary world of the Dressel system.

Drogheda.title: Drogheda/Legends
Drogheda.lead: Drogheda was a planet in the Mid Rim Teraab sector that was rich in ore and had a strong mining industry as of the Galactic Civil War. Drogheda was ruled by a monarchy until 4 ABY, when a popular revolutionary front overthrew the reigning Queen Sarna with the intention of installing a democratic government. Sarna was transported into exile by Rebel Alliance hero Lando Calrissian, who played a role in the revolution.

Drexel II.title: Drexel II
Drexel II.lead: Drexel II, also called the "water world of Drexel II," lacked a proper name. It was an ocean-covered planet. The sentient Inleshat species were once indigeonous to the planet. C-3PO aided the Rebel Alliance on Drexel II during the period of 0 ABY and 3 ABY. During the Yuuzhan Vong invasion, a group of Gluss'sa'Nikto established a colony on Drexel II.

Dremulae.title: Dremulae
Dremulae.lead: Dremulae was a terrestrial planet in the Deep Core and was known for the natural beauty of its Sea of Translucency and for its popular wealthy resort.

Draukyze.title: Draukyze
Draukyze.lead: Draukyze was a planet in the Draukyze system of the Thanium sector.

Drog II.title: Drog II
Drog II.lead: Drog II was a Human-inhabited planet in Corporate Sector's Drog system.

Dreffon IV.title: Dreffon IV
Dreffon IV.lead: Dreffon IV was an astronomical object located in the Colonies' Dreffon system. The distance between Dreffon IV and the Outer Rim Territories' Dravian Starport could be traversed in sixteen days using a starship equipped with a Class 1 hyperdrive.

Draria.title: Draria

facts.region: Expansion Region, Outer Expansion Zone, Northern Dependencies

Draria.lead: Draria was a celestial body located in the Draria system. It was a part of the Expansion Region's Lostar sector, being located both in the Outer Expansion Zone sub-region and the Northern Dependencies portion of that region. Draria lay between the Adin and Viga systems on the super-hyperroute known as the Hydian Way, specifically the segment that was known as the Corsin Run before being incorporated into the larger hyperspace route by approximately 3693 BBY.

Dravione.title: Dravione

facts.routes: Cadinth Run, Desevran Trace, Indrexu Route

Dravione.lead: Dravione was an Outer Rim Territories world located in the Tion Cluster's Allied Tion sector. At some point between approximately 25,150 BBY and 25,130 BBY, it was seized by the expanding Kingdom of Argai led by the pirate chieftain Xer VIII. Under the reign of Xer's son, Xim, Dravione was the site of several aeries built atop mountain peaks that were frequented by the younger ruler and his court. Millennia later, Dravione was an agricultural world on which the still-preserved aeries were at one point visited by the traveling merchant, philosopher, and historian Bleys Harand.

Dreve.title: Dreve
Dreve.lead: Dreve was a celestial body located in the Dreve system, a part of the Northern Dependencies portion of the Inner Rim. By approximately 10 ABY, when the corrupt constable Vexan, who was under the employ of the loan shark Sires Vant of the planet Andasala of the Outer Rim Territories, encountered the individual Reshig at a spaceport at night, the latter, who was in debt to Vant, claimed that they were meeting an "old friend" who was supposedly arriving on a shuttle from Dreve.

Drog VI.title: Drog VI
Drog VI.lead: Drog VI was a trade world in the Corporate Sector's Drog system. Etti ran several hunting lodges on the planet.

Dreighton.title: Dreighton
Dreighton.lead: Dreighton was a desert planet littered with rocks. There was an Imperial facility located on the planet. Below it, the Galactic Empire built a huge network of pipe lines and mining tunnels spanning kilometers beneath the surface.

Dreizan.title: Dreizan
Dreizan.lead: Dreizan was the homeworld of Imperial commander Rezi Soresh.

Drearia.title: Drearia/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Drearia.lead: Drearia was an Inner Rim world situated on the Hydian Way hyperlane. Sharing its name with the Drearian Defense Conglomerate, Drearia was a member of the Galactic Republic and later the Galactic Empire, for which it served as a fortress world. The world saw two clashes between Imperial and New Republic forces during the Galactic Civil War, and, in 10 ABY, the Mandator III-class dreadnought Aculeus was lost at Drearia due to Imperial in-fighting.

Drexel.title: Drexel/Legends
Drexel.lead: Drexel was the lone planet in the Drexel system. It was a water world, home to the sentient Sea-dragons.

Drezzi.title: Drezzi
Drezzi.lead: Drezzi was a planet in the Drezzi system of the Outer Rim's Esstran sector that was ruled by a monarchy. At some point before 3954 BBY, the Sith Empire conquered Drezzi, and the husband of Drezzi's Queen Ressa was killed by the Dark Councilor Darth Nyriss. In gratitude for Nyriss' decision to spare her life and those of her children, Ressa sent a decorative holoprojection to the Sith Lord that was displayed in Nyriss's residence.

Dressellian Asteroid Belt.title: Dressellian Asteroid Belt
Dressellian Asteroid Belt.lead: The Dressellian Asteroid Belt was an asteroid belt located in the Dressel system. In 200 BBY, a group of Bothan scouts explored the system, but discovered that Dressel was already inhabited. They settled in this asteroid belt instead. The system would remain out of galactic affairs until 10 BBY, when it was occupied by the Galactic Empire.

Drash-So.title: Drash-So
Drash-So.lead: Drash-So was a planet located in the Selvatas system of the Outer Rim Territories. During the Second Imperial Civil War, the One Sith ran a prison labor camp on the planet. Ania Solo and Ramid were two of the inmates there. The camp was liberated by the Empire-in-Exile at the end of the war.

Dreena.title: Dreena

facts.affiliation: Ghorman Front, Alliance to Restore the Republic, Massassi Group

Dreena.lead: Dreena was a Ghorman human member of the Ghorman Front, a rebel group that opposed the Galactic Empire on the planet Ghorman. In 2 BBY, when the Empire opened the previously barricaded Palmo Plaza, Dreena was one of hundreds to enter the area to protest. When the Empire began to massacre the citizens, Dreena fled and broadcast a signal on the radio, pleading for help. Dreena and the rebel Wilmon Paak, whose lower leg was injured, later escaped Ghorman and went to the Axis network safehouse on the planet Coruscant. Dreena would later live with Paak at the Alliance's base on the moon Yavin 4.

Dubrillion.title: Dubrillion/Legends

facts.language: Galactic Basic Standard, Formerly: Yuuzhan Vong
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Pentastar Alignment, Imperial Remnant, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire, Fel Empire …

Dubrillion.lead: Dubrillion was a planet in the Dubrillion system with beautiful oceans and lush, green continents, a sky dotted with fluffy, white clouds. It was the sister-world of Destrillion.

Dromund Ixin.title: Dromund Ixin
Dromund Ixin.lead: Dromund Ixin was a barren planet with no moons occupying the first orbital position around the star Dromund within the Dromund system. The star system was located within the Outer Rim Territories' Esstran sector, within a region known as the Sith Worlds.

Dromund Kalakar.title: Dromund Kalakar

facts.affiliation: Sith Empire, Prophets of the Dark Side, Galactic Empire

Dromund Kalakar.lead: Dromund Kalakar was a gas giant in the Dromund system. Its shipyards produced the VX-9 Mailoc gunship and F-T2 Quell, FT-3C Imperium and F-T6 Rycer strike fighters for the Sith Empire.

Dromund Kaas.title: Dromund Kaas/Legends

facts.population: Pre–Cold War: Millions, 10 ABY: 10,000 (70% Human, 30% other)
facts.affiliation: Old Sith Empire, Reconstituted Sith Empire, Prophets of the Dark Side, Galactic Empire

Dromund Kaas.lead: Dromund Kaas was the third planet in the Dromund system, a star system in the Sith Worlds region of the Outer Rim Territories's Esstran sector. Originally a colony of the Sith Empire, its location was lost by the time of the Great Hyperspace War with the Galactic Republic, but the Sith Emperor led his people on a twenty-year odyssey that ended with the rediscovery of Dromund Kaas in 4980 BBY.

Dromund Fels.title: Dromund Fels

facts.affiliation: Old Sith Empire, Reconstituted Sith Empire

Dromund Fels.lead: Dromund Fels was an arid planet that occupied the fourth orbit around the star Dromund in the Dromund system, a star system in the Sith Worlds within the Outer Rim Territories's Esstran sector. Orbited by one moon, the planet was under the control of the Old Sith Empire before its collapse, and the reconstituted Empire carried out a number of archaeological excavations on Dromund Fels thousands of years later.

Dromund Tyne.title: Dromund Tyne
Dromund Tyne.lead: Dromund Tyne was a barren planet with no moons occupying the fifth orbital position around the star Dromund within the Dromund system. The star system was located within the Outer Rim Territories' Esstran sector, within a region known as the Sith Worlds.

Drongar.title: Drongar/Legends

facts.terrain: Jungles, Rainforests, Bota fields, Swampland, Savannas
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems

Drongar.lead: Drongar was a mostly uninhabitable tropical planet in the Outer Rim Territories, with the native airborne spores causing death to those who were not protected from them. The climate was characterized by common monsoons with devastating electrical storms, soaring temperatures, and humidity over 90%. There was also a large atmospheric oxygen content. The planet had two small moons and was located in its system with another three planets. Natural features of Drongar included the Sea of Sponges, Great Jasserak Swamp and the Qarohan Steppes.

Dubrava.title: Dubrava/Legends
Dubrava.lead: Dubrava was a planet where Jal Te Gniev was placed to recruit rebel pilots. An Imperial patrol discovered him, by an accident, in a local cantina where they had tracked down a female informant. Jal's life was saved by the young humanoid Dubravan, Bobek. The planet was referred to as the galaxy's armpit hole.

Ducocon.title: Ducocon
Ducocon.lead: Ducocon was a terrestrial planet in the Utos system.

Drup III.title: Drup III
Drup III.lead: Drup III was a volcanic planet with two moons. It occupied the third orbital position around the binary stars Drup's Star and Drup's Companion in the Drup's Star system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Saijo sector.

Drup II.title: Drup II
Drup II.lead: Drup II was a gas giant–type planet with five moons. It occupied the second closest orbital position around the binary stars Drup's Star and Drup's Companion in the Drup's Star system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Saijo sector.

Drup I.title: Drup I
Drup I.lead: Drup I was a searing hot rock planet devoid of moons. It occupied the closest orbital position around the binary stars Drup's Star and Drup's Companion in the Drup's Star system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Saijo sector.

Dronseen.title: Dronseen
Dronseen.lead: Dronseen was a planet of the Dronseen system.

Dulathia.title: Dulathia/Legends
Dulathia.lead: Dulathia was an Imperial planet, until it was retaken by the New Republic around 8 ABY. The Star Destroyer Tempest was one of the few ships to survive, and brought its contents to Garos IV.

Droxine.title: Droxine
Droxine.lead: Droxine was a planet located in the Esstran sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was home to the carchar and nightmare demon species, although the latter—intelligent, telepathic killers—were believed to have been eradicated by the time of the Clone Wars. However, some survived, and one such demon, Reist, was forced to work for the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. He was sent to Lapez 3 to kill the Rebel Luke Skywalker but was defeated by the pilot.

Drup Asteroid Field.title: Drup Asteroid Field
Drup Asteroid Field.lead: The Drup Asteroid Field was located in the Drup's Star system, outside the orbits of the system's three planets. It was the location of "Woern's Asteroid".

Drunost.title: Drunost

facts.affiliation: Consolidated Shipping, Alliance to Restore the Republic

Drunost.lead: Drunost was a planet located within the Shelsha sector of the galaxy. A Consolidated Shipping hub and outlet were located near the planet's largest town, Conso City, making Drunost a good stop for fuel and supplies. Nominally under the jurisdiction of the Galactic Empire, the world consisted primarily of mines and farmland as well as company towns, and was settled by both Humans and aliens. During the time of the Galactic Civil War, the planet was also home to a Rebel Alliance supply line. The planet was also the scene of pirate activity engaged in by the BloodScar group.

Du Hutta.title: Du Hutta
Du Hutta.lead: Du Hutta was a terrestrial world located in the Du Hutta system, a part of the Hutt Space portion of the Slice. It was connected by the Ootmian Pabol hyperlane to the Irith and Y'Toub systems.

Duinarbulon.title: Duinarbulon

facts.affiliation: Kingdom of Cron, Xer's Empire, Xim's Empire, Galactic Empire

Duinarbulon.lead: Duinarbulon was a planet located within the Tion Cluster in the Outer Rim Territories. One of the original member-worlds of the Kingdom of Cron, it was absorbed into Xim's empire. This planet was home to the Duinarbulon Star Lancers, the elite soldiers of Xim's empire that fought for him during the war against the Hutts.

Du Mai.title: Du Mai
Du Mai.lead: Du Mai was a desert world located in the Du Mai system, a part of the Bryx sector in the Slice portion of the Mid Rim. It featured a mountain cave.

Duro.title: Duro/Legends

facts.sector: Duro sector (temporarily Corellian sector; Outlier systems)
facts.population: 18.5 billion:, 53% Duros, 36% Human, 11% Other, Historic:, 12,000 (surface), 53% Duros, 36% Human, 11% other, 1.6 billion (space cities), 91% Duros, 9% other
facts.affiliation: Infinite Empire, Duros High House, Herglic Trade Empire, Galactic Republic, Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders, Darth Revan's Sith Empire …

Duro.lead: Duro (also known as Duros) was the heavily polluted and depopulated homeworld of the Duros species. Located on the Corellian Trade Spine in the Core, the planet itself was mostly abandoned, mainly housing food processing plants. Most of the population lived in one of the twenty orbiting cities. Duro was also home to a large number of orbital shipyards.

Durren.title: Durren
Durren.lead: Durren was a terrestrial planet near the border between the Meridian and Antemeridian sectors that was home to the New Republic's naval base in Meridian sector.

Duroon.title: Duroon

facts.terrain: Hot springs, Jungles, Mountain, River, Thermal vents, Volcanic fissures
facts.affiliation: Corporate Sector Authority, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Five Worlds, Confederation

Duroon.lead: Duroon was a planet in Corporate Sector visited by Han Solo in 2 BBY.

Duneeden.title: Duneeden
Duneeden.lead: Duneeden was a planet in the Core Worlds. Despite its proximity to Coruscant, few beings ever came to Duneeden. It was home to the Cascardi Mountains, which was the location of a few private retreats.

Dur Sabon.title: Dur Sabon
Dur Sabon.lead: Dur Sabon was a planet inhabited by an eel-like species of the same name. Above the planet’s ocean level rose cities on large rocky platforms supported by descending pillars. In the sky above the cities, a series of spheres of unknown purpose hovered. Around 33 BBY, the young Ootoolan princess Foolookoola was escorted to Dur Sabon for her safety from the nearby planet Ootoola. Friends of the late royal family gave her shelter and expressed hope that she would one day return home safely.

Durkteel.title: Durkteel/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Alliance of Free Planets

Durkteel.lead: Durkteel was a Mid Rim world with a population of approximately 3.2 billion at the dawn of the Clone Wars. It was the homeworld of the Saurin, a subspecies of Trandoshan with human-like hands. Durkteel was located along the Durkteel Loop.

Dweem.title: Dweem
Dweem.lead: Dweem was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories used as a base of operations for the Galactic Republic until abandoned because of the Order of the Terrible Glare. Around 60 BBY, Aqinos trained the Iron Knights on Dweem, where he hid with them during the later Great Jedi Purge.

Duunir.title: Duunir
Duunir.lead: Duunir was a celestial body located in the Duunir system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Kibilini sector. At some point by the time of the Galactic Civil War, the interstellar smuggler and pirate organization Black Bha'lir had established a facility on Duunir that was the largest of several isolated refuges for the creature also known as the Black Bha'lir. The latter, a forest predator from the world of Iyred, had been adopted as a mascot of the criminal group, and consequently the Black Bha'lir founded the Duunir refuge as a charity.

Durgeon.title: Durgeon
Durgeon.lead: Durgeon was an astronomical object located in the Durgeon system, a part of the Galov sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. During the Galactic Civil War, the female bounty hunter Beylyssa single-handedly destroyed a Rebel cell on Durgeon after hunting the fledgling group for months.

Duron.title: Duron
Duron.lead: Duron was a planet located in the Duron system. Obo Rin first learned of the Charon race there.

Dwi'kar.title: Dwi'kar
Dwi'kar.lead: Dwi'kar was a gas giant and the third planet of the Kothlis system, located within the Bothan sector on the Mid Rim of the galaxy.

Dwi'lar.title: Dwi'lar
Dwi'lar.lead: Dwi'lar was a gas giant, the fifth planet of the Kothlis system.

Durollia.title: Durollia
Durollia.lead: Durollia was a celestial body located in the Durollia system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Kalamith sector. It had at least one spaceport. At some point during the Galactic Civil War, Yesgar's pirates, who had a hideout on the Esstran sector astronomical object Antared III, were spotted in Durollia's spaceport.

Dura-Kahn.title: Dura-Kahn
Dura-Kahn.lead: Dura-Kahn was a planet in the Expansion Region. It was part of the Galactic Empire and inhabited by Humans who maintained a tradition of big game hunting. One young native hunter was Moradmin Bast, who became an Imperial officer.

Dwor.title: Dwor
Dwor.lead: Dwor was a celestial body situated in the Dwor system, a part of the Steniplis sector in the Western Reaches portion of the Outer Rim Territories. A Rebel Alliance Task Force on Alliance Security SecuriDex datafile on the Filar-Nitzan infiltrator Vacander submitted at some point by 2 ABY noted Dwor as his last known location.

Dungal Lem.title: Dungal Lem
Dungal Lem.lead: Dungal Lem was the third planet orbiting the star Tor in the Tobali system. Located in the Outer Rim Territories, it was a gas giant.

Dulbris.title: Dulbris
Dulbris.lead: Dulbris was a gas giant in the Dantooine system, located in the Raioballo sector of the Outer Rim.

Durace.title: Durace

facts.terrain: Caverns, Sharp rocks, Toxic seas, Volcanic mountains

Durace.lead: Durace was a toxic, barren planet in a hostile region of space in the Unknown Regions. Although the atmosphere was breathable, Durace's hostile weather made colonization difficult.

Dwartii.title: Dwartii
Dwartii.lead: Dwartii was a planet located in the Dwartii system within the Nouane sector of the Inner Rim, in grid square N-8 on the Standard Galactic Grid. It was home to the eponymous Four Sages of Dwartii—Sistros Nevet, Faya Rodemos, Yanjon Zelmar, and Braata Danlos—who were controversial philosophers and lawgivers from the early days of the Galactic Republic, as well as the philosopher Cowus Roont, often called the 'Fifth Sage' of Dwartii.

Dulvoyinn.title: Dulvoyinn system
Dulvoyinn.lead: The Dulvoyinn system was located in the Deep Core and the Interior. It was also situated in the grid square K-12 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

Ehjenla.title: Ehjenla
Ehjenla.lead: Ehjenla was the small homeworld of the Tuhgri species. It was located within the Kathol Outback, which was part of the Kathol sector. Homeworld of the Tuhgri species, the planet began emerging from an ice age during the last centuries of the Galactic Republic. The polar ice caps were still large following as of 8 ABY, the oceans were large and deep, and the fertile plains were rutted with fjords.

Ebra.title: Ebra
Ebra.lead: Ebra, also referred to as Ebran, was a planet located in the Mid Rim's Kesh sector. Its surface was mountainous and featured caverns and large canyons such as the Grythsorin. Ebra was the homeworld of the Ebranites, six-armed humanoids who were well adapted for their environment. A relatively primitive, clan-based species, the Ebranites exported the valuable oil lu-ramin off-world.

Eeropha.title: Eeropha
Eeropha.lead: Eeropha was a planet in the Eeropha system of the Colonies. It was orbited by the moon Nierport VII.

Edatha.title: Edatha
Edatha.lead: Edatha was a world represented in the New Republic by Krall Praget.

Eeyyon.title: Eeyyon
Eeyyon.lead: Eeyyon was the Mid Rim planet saved by the Jedi prior to the Clone Wars. It was inhabited by a species of tall, pale-skinned humanoids. Native of Eeyyon, Teluron Thacker swore to aid the Jedi Order wherever he was, in gratitude for the help given to his homeworld.

Ebaq.title: Ebaq/Legends
Ebaq.lead: Ebaq was a gas giant in the Treskov system and the fifth planet of that system, orbiting Treskov 115-W. The planet had eleven moons, including Ebaq 9.

Ebiwaan.title: Ebiwaan
Ebiwaan.lead: Ebiwaan was an astronomical object located in the Sarin sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the endpoint of the Leisure Corridor, a trade and tourism route that started at the planet Coruscant in the Core Worlds.

Edonaaris.title: Edonaaris
Edonaaris.lead: Edonaaris was an obscure planet of swampy jungles in the Outer Rim. The Malka'an Eternal crashed on Edonaaris.

Eckless.title: Eckless
Eckless.lead: Eckless was a planet in Wild Space, considered to be an almost mythical world containing a great wealth of gems and metals.

Ediorung.title: Ediorung
Ediorung.lead: Ediorung was a planet in the Interior Regions of the Hapes Cluster. The planet was known for the dynamic holosculptures it produced; however, these were strictly judged by the Commission for the Preservation of the New Order Art Group. Porcellus, the chef for Jabba the Hutt, occasionally prepared Ediorung icefish for his master.

Edusa.title: Edusa

facts.affiliation: Reconstituted Sith Empire, Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Imperial Remnant

Edusa.lead: Edusa was an industrial planet located in the Outer Rim Territories' Morshdine sector. During the Great Galactic War, the reconstituted Sith Empire enslaved the Twi'lek girl Leontyne Saresh there, and she eventually incited a revolt of enslaved beings on the planet before departing for Galactic Republic space.

Eamus 6.title: Eamus 6
Eamus 6.lead: Eamus 6 was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Eamus system, a part of the Southern Core portion of the Core Worlds. It had at least one sun, and occupied the sixth orbital position within the system.

Eibon.title: Eibon

facts.affiliation: Kingdom of Cron, Xer's Empire, Xim's Empire, Galactic Empire

Eibon.lead: Eibon was a planet located within the Tion Cluster of the Outer Rim Territories. One of the original member-worlds of the Kingdom of Cron, it was absorbed into Xim's empire. A planet known for its proud and independent people, Xer VIII and his son Xim respected Eibon, and one of Xim's flagships was named the Eibon Scimitar. After Xim's empire collapsed, Eibon would continue to thrive as a world, and when it joined the Cronese Mandate after the rise of the Galactic Empire, it was considered one of the most powerful worlds of the Cron region.

Ebenmal.title: Ebenmal
Ebenmal.lead: Ebenmal was a planetoid located in the Ebenmal system of the Mid Rim's Irnaj sector. It was on Ebenmal that a battle between the Galactic Empire and the Rebel Alliance was fought sometime between the years 2 and 1 BBY. The ancient citadel of Ebenmal, which was said to have never fallen to an invader for over ten thousand years, was attacked by eighty-five Imperial jumptroopers, who brought chaos and disarray. In one hour's time, 3,000 Rebels surrendered. The battle was later mentioned in Imperial Atrocities and Other Noble Pursuits, by historian Chen Ming-di.

Earth.title: Earth/Legends
Earth.lead: Earth was a planet the Star Tours travel agency operated on at some point between 1 and 0 BBY. From space, one could see that a major proportion of Earth's surface was covered by oceans, with the remainder consisting of landmasses, and that a web of clouds enveloped the planet in a white veil. Through the Star Tours spaceline, Earth was connected to other worlds such as Coruscant, Kashyyyk, Naboo, Hoth, Geonosis and Tatooine. Around 4.3 ABY, Earth also acted as a hub for flights to Endor, prior to Star Tours being shut down.

Eberon.title: Eberon
Eberon.lead: Eberon was a planet located in the Eberon system of the Mid Rim's Mytaranor sector. Around the time of the Great Galactic War, Eberon was engaged in the Eberon–Kashyyyk War with the nearby planet Kashyyyk, but the conflict was eventually ended by the personal intervention of the Jedi Satele Shan.

Eadu.title: Eadu

facts.affiliation: Tarkin family, Galactic Empire, Tarkin Initiative

Eadu.lead: Eadu (pronounced /ˈiːduː/) was a storm-stricken planet in the Outer Rim Territories. It hosted the Eadu Energy Conversion Laboratory prior to the outbreak of the Galactic Civil War, where Galen Erso and his team of scientists attempted to unlock the secrets of the kyber crystals as part of the Death Star project. The refinery was targeted by agents of the Alliance to Restore the Republic following the destruction of Jedha City and resulted in the ruination of the facility and the death of Erso.

Egips.title: Egips
Egips.lead: Egips was a planet of the galaxy that was home to the nanak species.

Eclipse.title: Eclipse/Legends
Eclipse.lead: An eclipse was a type of astronomical event. During the Galactic War, a rare lunar eclipse was prophesized to reveal a location on the planet Shalyvane where the deity Kavaan was believed to have left his mark. Pakuuni experienced a solar eclipse every seventy-six years, which (according to legend) revealed a hidden tomb of the first settler, which may have had hidden treasures.

Eiattu.title: Eiattu system
Eiattu.lead: The Eiattu system was a star system located within the Mid Rim Territories. It was situated in grid square L-17 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

Elom.title: Elom/Legends
Elom.lead: Eloms were short, stocky, bipedal sentients, with a thick pelt of oily, dark fur, native to the frigid and mineral-rich desert planet of Elom, located in the Trans-Hydian. The primitive species had extremely tough skin, several layers of fat, and their hands and feet were coated by thick calluses.

Elrood.title: Elrood/Legends

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Metharian Nebula Territories
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Galactic Federation of Free Alliances

Elrood.lead: Elrood was a planet located between the Halbara and Kidron systems on the Elrood-Derilyn Trade Route. It functioned as capital of the Elrood sector and as its major trade and manufacturing hub. Elrood headquartered Radell Mining Corporation, the largest company in the sector. It had two moons, Sharene and Lodos. The planet was named after Senator Elrood, who secured funding for its colonization.

Eloggi.title: Eloggi

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories; Inner Zuma Region
facts.sector: Zuma sector; Moddell sector; Outer Moddell systems

Eloggi.lead: Eloggi was the second planet in the Endor system, on the Outer Rim of the galaxy. It was a frozen, barren rock that possessed no moons. The Galactic Empire established a mining colony on the planet. In the wake of the Battle of Endor, the New Republic allowed a number of Sullustans to take over the operations there.

Elerion.title: Elerion
Elerion.lead: Elerion was a notorious gambling planet located in the Outer Rim Territories near Phoebus.

Elcorth.title: Elcorth
Elcorth.lead: Elcorth was one of two mining colonies founded by the Morath on the edge of the Koornacht Cluster closest to Coruscant. The other was Kojash. Both were overtaken by the Yevetha during the Great Purge.

Elbara Nine.title: Elbara Nine
Elbara Nine.lead: Elbara Nine was a Mid Rim world on the Cerean Reach of the galaxy. It was an icy world and home to the Rebel GlitterFall base. The planet was near a little-used Imperial Navy staging area.

Ekibo.title: Ekibo
Ekibo.lead: Ekibo was a Trianii colony planet in Trianii Space, famous for its farms and herdbeasts. Trianii Rangers Atuarre and Keeheen were responsible for overthrowing a herdbeast-rustling ring there.

Elin Roe.title: Elin Roe
Elin Roe.lead: Elin Roe was a Colonies celestial body in the Elin Roe system, which was patrolled by Hallyn Phlynne during the Galactic Civil War. It had at least five moons, the fifth of which was bombarded with radioactive dust after the Krish mechanic Maniac had tinkered with the hyperdrive of the Yagaran Four's freighter; when the starship attempted to enter hyperspace, it exploded.

Eislomi III.title: Eislomi III
Eislomi III.lead: Eislomi III, also known as Eislo, was an astronomical object located in the Eislomi sector of the Inner Rim. It was the site of a HoloNet relay station.

Elokas.title: Elokas
Elokas.lead: Elokas was one of three habitable planets in the Sabrixin system in Samix sector. It was one of three worlds where crime was controlled by the Sabrin Ring.

Eliad.title: Eliad
Eliad.lead: Eliad was a planet in the Minos Cluster where many wealthy noble families of the galaxy were exiled after the rise of the Empire .

Ejolus.title: Ejolus
Ejolus.lead: Ejolus was a planet located in the Inner Rim.

Elriss.title: Elriss
Elriss.lead: Some time between 2 BBY and 0 BBY, the Galactic Empire sent stormtroopers including Daric LaRone to Elriss. While on it, the stormtroopers triple-checked the identities of the population of a village, and made all its inhabitants wait for six hours in the rain while doing so.

Elgit.title: Elgit
Elgit.lead: Elgit was a minor trade world that was located within the Elgit system of the galaxy's Hutt Space region and lay on the hyperlane called the Dead Road, which connected it to the planets of Zisia and Usk. The Elgit–M'Hanna Corridor linked Elgit to the world of Sakifwanna, and the trade planet was also joined by a hyperspace route to the Gos Hutta system.

Elke.title: Elke
Elke.lead: Elke was the seventh planet orbiting the star Iminec in the Kalee system. Located in Wild Space, it was a frozen rock.

Elatha.title: Elatha system/Legends
Elatha.lead: The Elatha system was located in the Outer Rim Territories' Stensen sector. It shared its name with the group known as the Elathan.

Elegasso.title: Elegasso
Elegasso.lead: Elegasso was a minor planet under the control of the Galactic Empire. In 0 ABY, a local election was blatantly rigged, drawing the attention of the Hand of Judgment stormtrooper team and Imperial agent Mara Jade.

Elamposnia.title: Elamposnia
Elamposnia.lead: Elamposnia was a monastery world located in the Elamposnia system. It was situated in the Back Reach area of the Gordian Reach sector, within the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. A hyperlane linked it to the Chenowei system.

Eilnia.title: Eilnia system/Legends
Eilnia.lead: The Eilnia system was a part of the Slice portion of the Inner Rim. It was home to the creatures known as Eilnian sweet flies.

Elkkasinn.title: Elkkasinn
Elkkasinn.lead: Elkkasinn was a world located in the Phelleem sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Many gunrunners of the Sendavé Shared Interest Collective were from Elkkasinn and Sunin.

Endor.title: Endor/Legends

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories; Inner Zuma Region
facts.sector: Zuma sector; Moddell sector; Outer Moddell systems
facts.routes: Bakura Trace, Ovise Reach, Shiritoku Way
facts.terrain: Forests, Mountains, Deserts, Savannas, Lakes, Rivers, Small seas
facts.species: Dulok, Ewok, Fftssfft, Gorph, Grass Trekker, Mimph, Wistie, Yuzzum
facts.language: Ewokese, Teek language, Yuzzum, Sanyassan, Galactic Basic Standard, Skandit language, Phlog language
facts.affiliation: Death Watch, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Alliance to Restore the Republic, Alliance of Free Planets, New Republic, New Jedi Order …

Endor.lead: Endor 9 (also known as the Forest Moon, Tana 9, and the Sanctuary Moon) was a small forested moon orbiting the gas giant planet of Endor and was the farthest moon away from it. An enchanted world, Endor was notable for being the native home of the Ewoks, and being the location of the Battle of Endor, which would result in the downfall of the Empire and the first death of Darth Sidious. Due to its remoteness, Endor was a relatively quiet planetoid.

Enkep.title: Enkep
Enkep.lead: Enkep was the first planet in the Katorrs system. A molten ball of rock, it had no moons, life, or water and was therefore all but ignored by cartographers of the Galactic Empire.

Empress Teta.title: Empress Teta/Legends

facts.routes: Byss Run, Carbonite Run, Daragon Trail, Koros Trunk Line, Koros-Tython hyperlane
facts.population: 310 billion: (modern), 71% Human, 29% other, 1.3 billion: (historic), 71% Human, 29% other
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Krath, Brotherhood of the Sith, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Galactic Alliance

Empress Teta.lead: Empress Teta was an ecumenopolis world located in the Empress Teta system, a star system in the Koros sector of the galaxy's Deep Core. Initially known as Koros or Koros Major, the planet's name was changed following Empress Teta's unification of the system in 5000 BBY. The extent to which the capital Cinnagar covered the world also caused many to refer to the world itself as Cinnagar, even in official documentation—a source of confusion at times. A major supplier of refined carbonite, the planet was a major hub of operations for the Mining Guild.

Endregaad.title: Endregaad

facts.terrain: Modern:, Rocky desert, Valleys, Plateaus, Mesas, Oases, Historic:, Shallow seas, Swamps
facts.affiliation: Xim's Empire, Indrexu Confederation, Corporate Sector Authority, Galactic Empire

Endregaad.lead: Endregaad, a world near the Indrexu Spiral, was the oasis mother homeworld.

Engira.title: Engira
Engira.lead: Engira was an Outer Rim Territories gas giant located in the Jospro sector. The site of a pirate base that was destroyed more than thirty years before the Battle of Yavin, by the time of the Galactic Civil War the planet had become a supply convoy colony of the Galactic Empire. An ambush near Engira once led to the loss of three Imperial freighters transporting food and ammunition.

Emmer.title: Emmer

facts.affiliation: Xim's empire, Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Zsinj's Empire, New Republic

Emmer.lead: Emmer, originally known as Umhul while it was part of Xim's empire, was a high-gravity planet in the Nilgaard sector that was covered in glowing grass and urban sprawls. The planet joined the Galactic Republic prior to 45 BBY. Emmerian walker vehicles inspired those built by Kuat Drive Yards, such as the AT-AT.

Emberlene.title: Emberlene

facts.affiliation: Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire

Emberlene.lead: Emberlene was a planet located in the Authala sector of the Expansion Region.

Endex.title: Endex

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Pentastar Alignment

Endex.lead: Endex was a world of rocky canyons. It was the Entymal homeworld. During the time of the Old Republic, the Entymals were renowned as excellent pilots across the galaxy. For centuries, many pilots were trained in the canyons which left a lot of wreckage behind.

Emra.title: Emra
Emra.lead: Emra was a gas giant planet in the Demar system. It had eleven moons.

Elsho.title: Elsho
Elsho.lead: Elsho was a planet in the Garqi system. It was a gas giant orbited by seven moons.

Enenpa.title: Enenpa
Enenpa.lead: Enenpa was a gas giant located within the Thurra system, a part of the Esstran sector in the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was orbited by forty moons.

Embaril.title: Embaril
Embaril.lead: Embaril was a world located in the Embaril system. It was a part of the Allied Tion sector of the Tion Cluster, situated within the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. Embaril lay on the Cadinth Run hyperlane between the Cadinth and Voss systems, and its surface featured green hills and crystalline lakes. It was among the Tion Cluster's least-spoiled worlds, and affluent aristocrats from the cluster and beyond were drawn to Embaril by its scenery.

Enaleh.title: Enaleh
Enaleh.lead: Enaleh was a planet located in the Colonies. At some point between 12,000 BBY and 11,000 BBY, Enaleh became a Galactic Republic Ordnance/Regional Depot outpost and was known by then as Ord Enaleh. The planet had a moist atmosphere, and its surface features included grasslands, freshwater seas, and lakes.

Endoraan.title: Endoraan
Endoraan.lead: Endoraan was a planet that was an endpoint of the Relgim Run, opposite Mantooine.

Endovan.title: Endovan
Endovan.lead: Endovan was a planet in the Sarka sector of the Mid Rim.

Enisca.title: Enisca
Enisca.lead: Enisca was a planet that, along with Sern Prime and Kashyyyk, were considered prime candidates for anti-Imperial rebellion by Mon Mothma.

Enferm.title: Enferm
Enferm.lead: Enferm was a planet notable for its medical research facilities.

Endelaan.title: Endelaan
Endelaan.lead: Endelaan was a lost planet in the Unknown Regions that the Nebula organization believed would bring about the destruction of the galaxy if discovered. The crew of the starship Spiral Dancer was sent to find it.

Endymion.title: Endymion
Endymion.lead: Endymion was a planet in the Pleiades region of the Kalamith sector in the Outer Rim Territories. Around 3660 BBY it was involved in the Great Galactic War. According to Darth Malgus in his personal journal, Sith troops were moved from Endymion, but its exact role in the war is unknown, as this part of the journal was cut out.

Ember.title: Ember
Ember.lead: Ember was a female charhound owned by the Jedi Padawan Bell Zettifar during the time of the High Republic. Ember accompanied Zettifar while he was stationed at the Jedi outpost on the ore planet of Elphrona, often wandering the world's iron hills. She was friendly with all of the Jedi stationed at the outpost, namely Indeera Stokes and Porter Engle. When the Jedi chased a group of Nihil who had captured the Blythe family from their home, Ember accompanied them and killed one of the marauders at an opportune moment, saving Engle's life.

Eredenn Prime.title: Eredenn Prime

facts.affiliation: Back Spiral, Xer's Empire, Xim's Empire, Honorable Union of Desevro & Tion, Galactic Republic

Eredenn Prime.lead: Eredenn Prime, also known as Eredenn IV, was a frozen planet in the Tion Hegemony.

Eres III.title: Eres III
Eres III.lead: Eres III was a Mid Rim world located in the Esuain sector. During the Mandalorian Wars, the Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders attacked it, causing decade-long fires on the world's surface when they ignited its Xoxin plains region. Eres III was a part of the Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Revan's empire during the Jedi Civil War, and millennia later, the world's fate was mentioned in the keynote address at Brentaal Academy's 412th Proceedings of Galactic Anthropology and History.

Ennth.title: Ennth
Ennth.lead: Ennth was a planet that, every eight years, was wreaked by enormous groundquakes, tidal waves, and volcanic eruptions. Ennth's moon was pulled in an orbit so that every eight years it would get sucked so close to the planet that the two atmospheres would connect, causing the huge natural disasters that lasted for several months. The colonists of Ennth usually chose to stay in crowded orbital refugee stations until the surface settled once more.

Er'Kit.title: Er'Kit/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Imperial Remnant

Er'Kit.lead: Er'Kit was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Noonian sector. It was the homeworld of the sentient Er'Kit species and in 22 BBY was represented in the Senate of the Galactic Republic by Senator Danry Ledwellow. Remaining a part of the Republic during the subsequent Clone Wars, Er'Kit also was a member of the Republic's successor, the Galactic Empire, with the future Imperial Navy officers Treuten and Kosh Teradoc hailing from the planet. After the Battle of Endor of 4 ABY, Er'Kit was a member of various Imperial splinter factions, including the Imperial Remnant.

Eol Sha.title: Eol Sha
Eol Sha.lead: Eol Sha was a volcanic planet in the Corva sector of the Outer Rim, near the Cauldron Nebula. Despite a rather temperate climate, the majority of the planet's surface was geologically unstable, with geysers and volcanoes dotting the surface and destructive natural phenomena, such as avalanches and groundquakes, occurring regularly.

Entralla.title: Entralla/Legends

facts.affiliation: Velcar Free Commerce Zone, Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Pentastar Alignment, Imperial Remnant, Fel Empire …

Entralla.lead: Entralla was a planet in the Velcar Free Commerce Zone.

Entrus.title: Entrus
Entrus.lead: Entrus was a planet in Trax sector. It was a temperate world scattered with many islands. Gambling resorts were built upon the hundreds of islands on the planet, resulting in underwater cities and repulsorlift platforms filling the oceans and skies. The cities were densely populated with entertainment complexes sometimes towering hundreds of meters. It contained the Alliance to Restore the Republic's Trax Sector Command for the Trax sector. The base only had a small number of personnel of less than 25 strategists and planners.

Ergeshui.title: Ergeshui/Legends
Ergeshui.lead: Ergeshui was a planet located in the Expansion Region, and the Ergesh homeworld. It was the only planet of the Agash system.

Equanus.title: Equanus
Equanus.lead: Equanus was a planet located within the Nharl system of the Veragi sector, in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of the Equani.

Erigorm.title: Erigorm
Erigorm.lead: Erigorm was a planet in the Core Worlds. After the Great Galactic War, Erigorm was one of the planets that threatened secession from the Republic, as part of the Rift Alliance. By that time, it had recorded and administrated the Republic's finances for centuries., The planet's representative in the Alliance council was Augin Blaesus, secretly a Child of the Emperor. Prior to the Clone Wars, the planet was represented in the Galactic Senate by Senator Gopple.

Er'stacia.title: Er'stacia
Er'stacia.lead: Er'stacia was a planet in Wild Space and the homeworld of the Er'stacians.

Epsom Asteroid Belt.title: Epsom Asteroid Belt
Epsom Asteroid Belt.lead: The Epsom Asteroid Belt was located in the Epsom system, a part of the Quiberon sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. During the Galactic Civil War, the Saurian crime lord Sithless Leethe owned a summer residence in the asteroid belt.

Entuur.title: Entuur
Entuur.lead: Entuur was a planet inhabited by the Human race known as the Entuurans.

Envos.title: Envos
Envos.lead: Envos was the first planet of the Bandomeer system.

Eridicon IV.title: Eridicon IV
Eridicon IV.lead: Eridicon IV was a planet which an old "Squid-face" retired to after owning the Limping Lady.

Ensolica.title: Ensolica

facts.terrain: Equatorial coniferous forests, Ice wastes, Tundra

Ensolica.lead: Ensolica was a planet of ice and tundra located in the Core Worlds. It was the homeworld of the near-Human Enso species, members of which were experts in hydroponics. The Enso offworld merchant Teyora Rekab hailed from Ensolica.

Epica.title: Epica
Epica.lead: Epica was a naturally beautiful world with forested hills, mountain valleys, and cold water seas. During the Yuuzhan Vong War, the Hydians Auction House was relocated to Epica. At the time it was believed that Epica was too remote to attract the attention of the Yuuzhan Vong. At the wars end, many of the beings that had relocated the Hydians decided to remain on world, building rich palaces and mansion on the world. In time the planet's primary city had been transformed into an area of sophistication for the wealthy and privileged.

Ereesus.title: Ereesus
Ereesus.lead: Ereesus was a planet in the Kanz sector of the Outer Rim Territories and the homeworld of the Ereesi species.

Epiphany.title: Epiphany

facts.affiliation: Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire

Epiphany.lead: Epiphany was the outermost of three planets that orbited a red dwarf star in the Salient system, in the Aparo sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Its moon was the location of the headquarters of Zerpen Industries. The Second Battle of Epiphany took place during the reign of the Galactic Empire and the early years of TIE pilot Soran Keize's service in the Imperial Starfighter Corps. Having been involved in the battle, Keize reflected on it as one of the events which taught him his responsibility to protect those close to him in order to protect the lives of even more.

Essowyn.title: Essowyn
Essowyn.lead: Essowyn was the only planet in the Saurton system. The planet was located in the Trax sector, situated between the Kanawyn and Greawyn asteroid belts.

Erilnar.title: Erilnar
Erilnar.lead: Erilnar was a planet located in the Outer Rim Territories's Centrality. Serving as the capital of the Centrality, Erilnar had three hundred thousand lakes on its surface, which forced the planet's transportation to go underwater. At some point by the reign of the Galactic Empire, a terrorist attack on Erilnar destroyed most of the world's monorail network and resulted in a million casualties. Blaming the Empire for its non-reaction to the attack, the Erilnar native Kulbart Zamoon joined the Rebel Alliance.

Esseles.title: Esseles/Legends

facts.population: 24 billion (historic), 1.5 billion (modern):, 86% Human, 8% Herglic, 2% Bothan, 4% other
facts.government: Empire (c. Pre–25,053 BBY), Empire (c. 25,053–19 BBY), Representative democracy (19 BBY—), Esselian Hall
facts.affiliation: Esselian empire, Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Esseles.lead: Esseles was a planet located along the Perlemian Trade Route in Darpa sector of the Ringali Shell. It was the third in position in the Essesia system and had one moon.

Esfandia.title: Esfandia/Legends

facts.language: Brrbrlpp language, Galactic Basic Standard, Trinary code variant
facts.affiliation: New Republic, Galactic Federation of Free Alliances

Esfandia.lead: Esfandia was a free-floating proto-world in Wild Space. At one time, it had orbited a star, but it eventually broke away. Even without a sun, the planet had enough radioactivity in its core to support a liquid atmosphere composed mainly of methane and hydrogen.

Erysthes.title: Erysthes

facts.affiliation: Corporate Sector Authority, Five Worlds, Confederation

Erysthes.lead: Erysthes, located in the Corporate Sector in the Tingel Arm of the galaxy, was the planet to which the chak-root was native.

Ession.title: Ession
