facts.affiliation: Corporate Sector Authority, Five Worlds, Confederation

Ession.lead: Ession was a planet in the Corporate Sector, located at the nexus of the Shaltin Tunnels and Lucaya Cross hyperlanes. It has been settled since before 6000 BBY, establishing itself as a thriving manufacturing and trading center of the Corporate Sector. An industrial manufacturing center, it was the headquarters of Pakkerd Light Transport, formerly a division of Sienar Fleet Systems.

Eriscot.title: Eriscot
Eriscot.lead: Eriscot was a Mid Rim water world located in the Haserian sector. It was the homeworld of the sentient Nejma species, which was relocated to the planet Iskalon by a group of spacefaring benefactors after a series of cataclysms on several water worlds, including Eriscot, five millennia before the Galactic Civil War. During the reign of the New Republic, the anthropologist Doctor Hoole was studying the ruins of those worlds.

Escabar.title: Escabar
Escabar.lead: Escabar was a planet located in the Escabar system, a part of the freestanding subsectors of the Expansion Region. It featured the regions Khrassh and Serhan, the latter of which had deserts in its northeastern areas. Despite the fierce sandstorms of those territories, the small, quadripedal scavenger creatures known as the borcatu evolved there, adapting for digging burrows and cracking open shells.

Esooma.title: Esooma
Esooma.lead: Esooma was a planet located in the Esooma system, within the Sprizen sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of the sentient Esoomian species, who were considered to be among the best hired muscle in the galaxy. Esooma was quarantined by the Galactic Empire, preventing the Esoomians from leaving their homeworld, up until around the year 7 ABY, after which they were free to depart and find work. An Esoomian known as Tantor first left Esooma when he was hired as an enforcer for a pirate ship.

Escarte.title: Escarte/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems

Escarte.lead: Escarte was an asteroid mining facility which belonged to the Commerce Guild. Located in the Outer Rim Territories, in the Escarte system, it orbited between massive, multimooned gas giants in an otherwise uninhabited star system two hyperspace jumps from Belderone, on the Rimward side of the Perlemian Trade Route. Oblate when mining operations had commenced in 39 BBY, Escarte was, by 19 BBY, a concave hemisphere, heavily cratered by the forces of nature and the gargantuan labor droids of the Commerce Guild.

Estaph.title: Estaph system/Legends
Estaph.lead: The Estaph system was a star system located in the Tapani sector's Mecetti Province, on the Procopian Shipping Lane; it was also an endpoint of the Calipsa Run.

Ertegas.title: Ertegas/Legends

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Western Reaches, Greater Javin
facts.sector: Javin sector (prior to c. 400 BBY), Anoat sector (c. 400 BBY—)

Ertegas.lead: Ertegas was an agriworld located in the Anoat sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was run by a populace of agri-droids overseen by a small number of Humans, and the future Bespin Wing Guard member Allen Neff hailed from the world.

Erodsis.title: Erodsis

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, The Slice, Trailing Sectors

Erodsis.lead: Erodsis was a gas giant located in the Outer Rim's Savareen sector in the Christoph system.

Esyam.title: Esyam

facts.routes: Oktos Route, Ootmian Pabol, Pabol Hutta, Shag Pabol

Esyam.lead: Esyam was a planet of molten rock that was located within the Y'Toub system of the galaxy's Hutt Space region. The planet occupied the first orbital position around its star, Y'Toub, and lay on the junction of four hyperlanes called the Oktos Route, the Ootmian Pabol, the Pabol Hutta, and the Shag Pabol.

Eshan.title: Eshan/Legends
Eshan.lead: Eshan was an Inner Rim world that was the homeworld of the Echani species. It was a member of the Six Sisters, a group of worlds governed by the Echani Command confederation. During the Mandalorian Wars, the Echani fought against the Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders, who threatened Eshan. In 1154 BBY, the celestial body Begali launched a rebellion against the Six Sisters; however, it eventually renewed ties with Eshan.

Estaria.title: Estaria/Legends

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Greater Tion, The Slice, Trans-Hydian
facts.routes: Perlemian Trade Route, Tion Trade Route

Estaria.lead: Estaria was an Outer Rim Territories planet situated in the Indrexu sector on the Perlemian Trade Route. It was a spaceport world and during the Galactic Civil War housed Estaria Central Starport, which regulated starship travel in the entire Estaria system.

Ermi.title: Ermi
Ermi.lead: Ermi was a planet located within the Sertar sector. Many years prior to the Clone Wars, a number of Jedi were from Ermi, and were distinguished by crafting lightsabers with multifaceted gems that caused stray energy tendrils to spiral off from their lightsaber blades. During the Clone Wars, distinct equipment inspired by the Jedi of the planet Ermi were available to Jedi Knights.

Essien.title: Essien
Essien.lead: Essien was a world in the Halthor sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Esaga.title: Esaga
Esaga.lead: Esaga was an astronomical object located in the Esaga system, a part of the Esaga sector in the Slice portion of the Mid Rim. After its restoration around 15,000 BBY, the navy of the Galactic Republic moved aggressively beyond the Republic's frontier to defend its colonies and commerce. Although few records survived from that time, millennia later naval songs continued to mention deeds of bravery committed by members of the Republic Navy during conflicts at Esaga, Caulbon, and the Sundered Veil.

Ertrax.title: Ertrax
Ertrax.lead: Ertrax was a Wild Space planet located within the star system of the same name. Ertrax was home to the Ertraxi, a peaceful species of multiple-eyed humanoids who were eager to make contact with other species and cultures.

Excarga.title: Excarga/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Excarga.lead: Excarga was a mining world in the Outer Rim Territories. The planet had ties to the Mining Guild.

Euceron.title: Euceron
Euceron.lead: Euceron was a planet located in the Eucer sector of the Mid Rim. It was located near Anzat.

Exodo II.title: Exodo II

facts.affiliation: Grissmath Dynasty, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Exodo II.lead: Exodo II was a hot, stormy, and dense world in the Meridian sector, near Durren and Odos. The Millennium Falcon had a brief encounter with the world nine years after the Battle of Endor.

Etti IV.title: Etti IV/Legends

facts.routes: Etti Route Major, Shaltin Tunnels, Solenbaran Merchant Route, Trianii Shunt

Etti IV.lead: Etti IV was a hot, stormy and dense planet in the Corporate Sector and the capital of the Corporate Sector Authority. Etti IV also had a population of the Etti species who left the Core Worlds circa 20,000 BBY to escape persecution.

Exocron.title: Exocron
Exocron.lead: Exocron was a planet in the Kathol Outback, hidden in a protostar gas cloud near the Kathol Rift in the Outer Rim Territories. It was settled by colonists who were opposed to the "plastic societies" of the Galactic Republic, and who were searching for a legendary planet called Exo. The colony grew in isolation from the rest of the galaxy, controlled by a technocracy known as the Devisors who forbade space travel. Their rule lasted until 8 ABY when the New Republic corvette FarStar assisted the local population in freeing themselves from the oppressive regime.

Evas VI.title: Evas VI
Evas VI.lead: Evas VI was a planet of the Evas system, located inside the Belshar sector, within the Mid Rim of the galaxy. The world was humid and it could rain for three days in a row. The planet was also very cold and one would freeze to death, if not for the occasional sunlight. By 0 BBY, Linkaas, a Pliith corporate criminal and president of the Linkaas Corporation, resided on the planet. From the planet, Linkaas assigned two of his thugs to ambush and kill one of his employees, a smuggler named Dannen Lifehold—who owed him a substantial debt—on the world Dohu VII.

Exodeen.title: Exodeen/Legends

facts.routes: Hydian Way, Brentaal-Denon Route, Nanth'ri Trade Route
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Exodeen.lead: Exodeen was a planet located in the Colonies along the Hydian Way.

Expora.title: Expora

facts.region: Core Worlds, Northern Dependencies, The Slice, Arrowhead

Expora.lead: Expora was the first planet of the Chandrila system, located in the Bormea sector of the Ringali Shell in the Core Worlds. The planet orbited the star Chandrila and was composed of searing rock. Expora was the only one of the system's planets to have no moons. The entirety of the Chandrila system lay on the Perlemian Trade Route, which served as a dividing line between the Northern Dependencies and the Arrowhead portion of the Slice.

Euton.title: Euton
Euton.lead: Euton was a terrestrial planet in the Dathomir system, a part of the Quelii sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It occupied the second orbital position around the star Domir, and it featured a searing hot environment and a rocky surface. Euton had no moons.

Etorasp.title: Etorasp
Etorasp.lead: Etorasp was a planet located in the Hakartha sector of the Expansion Region.

Eton.title: Eton
Eton.lead: Eton was a gas giant–type planet with forty-one moons that occupied the seventh orbital position around the star Asar. It was located within the Ilum system, a part of the Unknown Regions' 7G sector.

Explume Minor.title: Explume Minor
Explume Minor.lead: Explume Minor, also referred to as simply Explume, was an astronomical object located in the star system of the same name, a part of the Unknown Regions' Croke Reach. At some point during a civil war between members of the Croke species, the Croke introduced the invasive Lugubraa species as soldiers in the Croke Reach. The plans of the Croke backfired, however, when the Lugubraa began to overrun Croke settlements and strip them of all resources.

Extorin Minor.title: Extorin Minor (disambiguation)
Extorin Minor.lead: Extorin Minor may refer to one of the following:

Eyar.title: Eyar system/Legends
Eyar.lead: The Eyar system was a part of the Slice portion of the Inner Rim. It was the site of the settlement known as Eyar City and shared its name with the Eyar Treatment Systems company that operated there.

Etti V.title: Etti V
Etti V.lead: Etti V was a planet in the Etti system in the Corporate Sector of the Outer Rim Territories. By the time of the Battle of Yavin, the Corporate Sector Authority moved the Etti species off Etti IV to the planet and did not allow anyone else access to Etti V.

Exigar.title: Exigar
Exigar.lead: Exigar was a polluted planet in the galaxy. During the Cold War, surveys of Exigar detected unusual mutations in the planet's flora, and further investigation revealed that the pollution was causing abnormal variations in native lifeforms.

Eufornis Minor.title: Eufornis Minor
Eufornis Minor.lead: Eufornis Minor, sometimes referred to as simply Eufornis, was a planet located in the Shadola sector of the Outer Rim Territories. A remote colony, it was sometimes confused with Eufornis Major, a prestigious city-planet located within the Core Worlds.

Eufornis Major.title: Eufornis Major
Eufornis Major.lead: Eufornis Major, sometimes referred to as simply Eufornis, was a prestigious ecumenopolis planet located in the galaxy's Core Worlds. Due to their similar names, Eufornis Major was occasionally confused with Eufornis Minor, a remote Outer Rim colony world. In 5 BBY, Telgordo Travel operated a transport service from Coruscant that stopped at Eufornis Major, as well as Plexis and Hosnian Prime.

Etai.title: Etai/Legends
Etai.lead: Etai was a planet located in the Mid Rim of the galaxy. Miners plumbed the depths of the world's deep caverns in search of the rare, resonant etaan crystals, a powerful gemstone that was utilized to power lightsabers.

Ezaraa.title: Ezaraa
Ezaraa.lead: The Ezaraa were a species of warmongering carnivorous sentients that were native to the the planet Ezaraa. They intended to overthrow the Galactic Empire, only to replace it with their own dominion and feed on the other species, which they deemed as lesser to them. Despite their wide reaching dreams of conquest, however, the Dominion was limited to a mere two continents on Ezaraa. To arm their revolution, the dominion sent Ezaraa to take advantage of opportunities such as the Auction of Rur.

Faargau.title: Faargau
Faargau.lead: Faargau was a planet in the Zug system of the Core Worlds. A planet with fourteen moons, Faargau was one of four gas giants in the star system along with Zauhu, Urazuun, and Laazrau.

F'tral.title: F'tral
F'tral.lead: F'tral was an Outer Rim Territories waterworld located in the Calaron sector. The planet's surface was almost completely covered by freshwater oceans, with dry land being limited to chains of volcanic islands that were home to mostly predatory or parasitic plants. Cephalopods, including the sentient Iyra, were the dominant form of life in F'tral's oceans.

Fakir.title: Fakir

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Corporate Alliance, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire

Fakir.lead: Fakir was the sector capital of Fakir sector in the Bakchou arm.

Falang Minor.title: Falang Minor
Falang Minor.lead: Falang Minor, also known as just Falang, was a Galactic Republic fortress world located in the Outer Rim Territories' Thanium Worlds. A cold and rainy world, it was among the speculated origin points of the Jedi Order. Following the defeat of the Honorable Union of Desevro and Tion in the Tionese War, a series of fortress worlds, including Falang Minor, were established from which Jedi Knights would watch over the Tion Cluster.

Faldos.title: Faldos
Faldos.lead: Faldos was a dirty backwater Outer Rim Territories world used by smugglers to sell stolen weapons, armor, and technology. It sat on the very edge of the galaxy, making it far more removed than most of the Outer Rim Territories.

F'Dann IX.title: F'Dann IX
F'Dann IX.lead: F'Dann IX was a celestial body located in the F'Dann system, a part of the Dufilvian sector in the Slice portion of the Mid Rim. At some point by 2 BBY, the Carrack-class light cruiser Dominant of the Galactic Empire engaged the Crimson Nova Gang in battle near F'Dann IX, a confrontation in which the Dominant suffered damage heavy enough to warrant repairs in drydock.

Fahul.title: Fahul

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Metharian Nebula Territories

Fahul.lead: Fahul was the sixth planet in the Derilyn system. It was an airless, lifeless world.

F'tang.title: F'tang
F'tang.lead: F'tang was the eighth planet orbiting the star C'rel in the N'zoth system. Located in the Koornacht Cluster of the Core Worlds, it was a frozen rock.

Fal.title: Fal
Fal.lead: Fal was the third planet in the Obas system.

Fait d'Fait.title: Fait d'Fait
Fait d'Fait.lead: Fait d'Fait was a Mid Rim celestial body located in the Venaarian sector. Around 3643 BBY, criminal syndicates recruited an off-worlder to help them manipulate a governor of Fait d'Fait, who pursued anti–organized crime policies. Later, during the Galactic Civil War, the racer Siro Simito visited Fait d'Fait on a detour during the Dahvil-Fodro Hyperspace Promenade starship race.

Fadden.title: Fadden
Fadden.lead: Fadden was a world located in the Fadden system, a part of the Slice portion of the Inner Rim. It was settled by colonists of the Duros species, which was native to the Core Worlds planet Duro.

Fangol.title: Fangol
Fangol.lead: Fangol was a small frozen planet in the Mortex sector, and was the site of a secret Rebel Alliance base. It had an icy crust.

Faa.title: Faa/Legends
Faa.lead: The faa, or faynaa, as they were known to the Gungan species, were fast-moving, non-sentient predatory scalefish native to the oceans and swamps of the Mid Rim planet Naboo and Manaan. They were considered dangerous and would attack virtually anything with little provocation.

Fallowan.title: Fallowan
Fallowan.lead: Fallowan was an agricultural planet located within the Sujimis sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Fahariyn.title: Fahariyn
Fahariyn.lead: Fahariyn was a gas giant occupying the first orbital position in the Ansion system, which was located in the Churnis sector in the Mid Rim. It had three moons.

Fala.title: Fala
Fala.lead: Fala was the second planet of the Bestine system located in the Inner Rim Territories. Fala had one moon, and its surface was covered with volcanic rocks.

Faliar.title: Faliar
Faliar.lead: Faliar was a terrestrial planet in the Fondor system, located in the Freeworlds Territory portion of the Tapani sector, within the Southern Core portion of the Colonies. Along with the rest of its star system, Faliar was located on the hyperspace route known as the Gandeal-Fondor Hyperlane, with a hyperlane also connecting it to the Sefon system. The planet occupied the first orbital position around the star Fondor and had no moons. Faliar featured a hot climate.

Fabrin.title: Fabrin/Legends
Fabrin.lead: Fabrin was an Expansion Region planet located in the Circarpous sector. It was home to the Fabritech corporation, which owned the entire world and attracted large sums of money from the Galactic Empire due to its demand for Fabritech's sensor products. The planet's surface featured both vast factory districts and luxurious beach resorts on which programmers lived and worked.

Fanha.title: Fanha/Legends
Fanha.lead: Fanha was a celestial body located in the Fanha system, a part of the Seitia sector in the Western Reaches portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The Nineteenth Sector Army of the Galactic Republic was tasked with engaging the military forces of the Confederacy of Independent Systems in Fanha's vicinity during the first campaigns of the Clone Wars in 22 BBY.

Faket.title: Faket
Faket.lead: Faket was a world located in the Wild Space region of the galaxy. Faket was inhabited by the Drivoks, a species of psychic, sentient Humanoids.

Farfalla's Diamonds.title: Farfalla's Diamonds
Farfalla's Diamonds.lead: Farfalla's Diamonds was an asteroid belt located in the Ruusan system. It held the fifth orbital position around the star Hoth's Brand in the system. Located in the Teraab sector of the Mid Rim, it divided space between the planets Turpimir and Zor Vlahu.

Fedje.title: Fedje
Fedje.lead: Fedje was a planet in the Outer Rim's Atrivis sector. It was home to many exotic creatures, including the rare folded ear boosqueak. The planet was visited by members of the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. Imperial Intelligence operatives later posed as natives of the planet while carrying out sabotage on the Bothan homeworld Bothawui.

Farrfin.title: Farrfin
Farrfin.lead: Farrfin was the capital of Farrfin sector and the Farghul homeworld. It was a haven for criminals. A shakedown by the Jedi left the Farghul distrustful of Jedi.

Fedalle.title: Fedalle/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Fedalle.lead: Fedalle was a powerful and wealthy Core Worlds industrial planet located on the Hydian Way. It was home to a population known as the Fedalleans. Located in space explored between 27,500 BBY and 25,000 BBY, Fedalle had become a part of the Galactic Republic by around 22,000 BBY and was aligned with the Republic's capital world, Coruscant, during the early Alsakan Conflicts. By the time of the Mandalorian Wars, Fedalle had been visited by the Republic Hammerhead-class cruiser Sanctuary.

Faz.title: Faz/Legends
Faz.lead: Faz was one of the original 13 planets of the Duskhan League, and was one of the many colony worlds held by the Yevetha. It was located in the Koornacht Cluster, in the Farlax sector.

Far Qasqi.title: Far Qasqi

facts.routes: Perlemian Trade Route, Triellus Trade Route

Far Qasqi.lead: Far Qasqi was the eighth and outermost planet in the Centares system.

Farbog.title: Farbog
Farbog.lead: Farbog was a planet in the Galactic Empire visited by Leia Organa Solo during the Galactic Civil War.

Farsellah.title: Farsellah
Farsellah.lead: Farsellah was a terrestrial world located in the Farsellah system, a part of the Farstey sector in the Trans-Hydian portion of the Expansion Region.

Farstey.title: Farstey/Legends
Farstey.lead: Farstey was an Expansion Region astronomical object situated in the Farstey sector. During the Galactic Civil War, while the Galactic Empire was carrying out an offensive in Farstey's vicinity, the Rebel Alliance Chief of Sector Command suggested during a meeting of the Alliance High Command that the Rebel starfighter base at Farstey could be stripped to form a fighter wing for a planned assault on an Imperial base over the planet Mantooine.

Farquar III.title: Farquar III
Farquar III.lead: Farquar III was a planet in the Mid Rim's Kurost sector.

Far Pando.title: Far Pando
Far Pando.lead: Far Pando was a peaceful agrarian planet in the Far Pando system of Hutt Space. It was situated along the Pando Spur hyperlane, an offshoot of the larger Hollastin Run. The planet was under the control of the sentient Yahk-Tosh species.

Farana.title: Farana/Legends
Farana.lead: Farana was a Wild Space world that was home to the near-Human Ocsin species. Never governed by the Galactic Republic or the Galactic Empire, by 3705 BBY it was situated at the endpoint of the Morellian Trail hyperlane.

Faro.title: Faro
Faro.lead: Faro was a planet in the Faro system within the Colonies region of the galaxy.

Farnica.title: Farnica system/Legends
Farnica.lead: The Farnica system was located in the Interior Region, an area of the Hapes Cluster in the Slice portion of the Inner Rim. It was connected via hyperlanes to the Novi and Sivoria systems. The Farnica system was the origin point of the art form known as the Farnican chime-painting.

Farasu.title: Farasu
Farasu.lead: Farasu was a gas giant located in the Felucia system, which in turn was found in the Outer Rim Territories' Thanium sector. During the Clone Wars, this area of space was contested over by the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Far Ziux.title: Far Ziux
Far Ziux.lead: Far Ziux was the fifth planet orbiting the binary stars Toydar and Little Toydar in the Toydaria system. Located in Hutt Space of the galaxy, it was a gas giant.

Feena.title: Feena
Feena.lead: Feena was a world located in the Feena system. It was situated in the Back Reach area of the Gordian Reach sector, within the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. Feena lay between the B'trilla and Kalishik systems on the hyperlane known as the Ardan Cross—a portion of which already linked it to the Ethain and Vynx systems by 25,126 BBY—while the Feena Run hyperspace route connected the world to the Barison system.

Farstone.title: Farstone
Farstone.lead: Farstone was a world located in the Farstone system of the Juvex sector, a part of the Senex-Juvex region in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim. A hyperlane connected Farstone to the Umthyg system.

Farbinda III.title: Farbinda III
Farbinda III.lead: Farbinda III was an astronomical object located in the Farbinda system, a part of the Trailing Sectors portion of the Inner Rim. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, it was the site of a colony of conscientious objectors. At one point, an Imperial strike team rounded up the colonists. Witnessed by the smuggler Tarn Mison, who had taken a job running supplies to the colony and had also arrived there at the time, the colonists were all executed despite offering no resistance.

Feddasyr.title: Feddasyr
Feddasyr.lead: Feddasyr was a planet located in the Elus sector of the Inner Rim. The planet was known for being a drug and gambling hub. During the Galactic Civil War, the planet had a neutral status.

Felucia.title: Felucia/Legends

facts.population: 8.5 million immigrants, Unknown number of natives
facts.government: Corporate administration (immigrant communities), Independent townships (fugitive activists), Shamanistic tribes (native communities) …
facts.affiliation: Gossam Courivers, Xim's Empire, Thanium Worlds, Galactic Republic, Commerce Guild, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, New Republic …

Felucia.lead: Felucia ( or /fʌ'lusiə/) was a largely unsettled terrestrial jungle planet in the Felucia system of the Thanium Worlds in the Outer Rim Territories. Located near the junction of the Perlemian Trade Route and Shaltin Tunnels, the world featured a hot and humid atmosphere and significant water resources beneath a surface irradiated by ultraviolet light of the star Felix. Native plant, fungal, and animal life evolved to dominate the environment in a deep symbiotic relationship, causing significant Force energy to permeate the ecosystem.

Fef.title: Fef
Fef.lead: Fef was a moderately large planet orbiting an orange-yellow star in the Fef system. It was one of the Galactic Alliance planets threatened by a possible Killik coup.

Feriae Junction.title: Feriae Junction/Legends

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, New Territories, Trans-Hydian
facts.routes: Gordian Reach (historically), Hydian Way, Junction-Tierell Loop, Thesme Trace
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Zsinj's Empire, Greater Maldrood, New Republic

Feriae Junction.lead: Feriae Junction (often simply called "Junction") was a tradeworld at the nexus of the Hydian Way, the Thesme Trace, and the Gordian Reach.

Fehern.title: Fehern
Fehern.lead: Fehern was a planet in the Trax sector of the Mid Rim It was the homeworld of the Eddelians. In the time of the Galactic Republic, Eddelian trading ships would be seen in adjoining systems. The Galactic Empire fought a war against the Eddell, eliminated most of the technology owned by them. Only a few thousand remained with most subjugated as slaves.

Fere.title: Fere
Fere.lead: Fere, sometimes known as Feree, was the Fere homeworld.

Felacat.title: Felacat
Felacat.lead: Felacat was the Felacatian homeworld. It was located in the Outer Rim Territories, and its inhabitants were cat people who would transform into tiger-like creatures when in hyperspace for too long. During the Clone Wars, the Confederacy of Independent Systems laid siege to Felacat.

Fennesa.title: Fennesa/Legends

facts.terrain: Mountains, Hills, Rocky outcroppings, Rocky overhangs, Shallow caves

Fennesa.lead: Fennesa was a mountainous, rocky planet located in the Inner Rim. Its fauna included avian and feline predators as well as mountain nerfs, a subspecies of the ungulate nerfs introduced by colonists millennia before the Battle of Yavin.

Fenion.title: Fenion
Fenion.lead: Fenion was an unaligned Outer Rim planet, near warlord Zsinj's territory. It was the only planet on the Night Caller agenda not visited by Wraith Squadron.

Fengrine.title: Fengrine/Legends
Fengrine.lead: Fengrine was a Mid Rim agriworld situated in the Senex sector. A prestigious agricultural center that was the most powerful of the agricultural worlds of the Senex-Juvex region, by the time near the end of the Galactic Republic it had also become one of the largest exporters of foodstuffs in the galaxy.

Feenicks VI.title: Feenicks VI
Feenicks VI.lead: Feenicks VI was a planet in the Outer Rim's Feenicks system.

Feenix.title: Feenix/Legends
Feenix.lead: Feenix was a planet in the Mid Rim's D'Aelgoth sector. It was a member of the Galactic Republic and later the Galactic Empire.

Fenves.title: Fenves
Fenves.lead: Fenves was a planet located in the Boeus sector of the Expansion Region. It was the homeworld of the Devaronian bounty hunter Tyrn Jiton.

Ferrhast.title: Ferrhast
Ferrhast.lead: Ferrhast was the planet in the Core Worlds and location of the Imperial Institute of Higher Studies. Despite its distance from the Sith Worlds, ruins built by members of the Massassi species were found on the world during the Galactic War.

Feldrona.title: Feldrona
Feldrona.lead: Feldrona was a planet located in the Feldrona system, a part of the Glythe sector in the New Territories portion of the Mid Rim. At some point, it was colonized by members of the Zabrak species from the Glythe sector planet Iridonia.

Fenel.title: Fenel
Fenel.lead: Fenel was an Outer Rim Territories world located in the Demetras sector. It was the homeworld of the Fenelar species. A powerful world possessing starshipwrights and technologists, it was eventually raided by the Mandalorian Crusaders, resulting in the Fenelar's extinction. Fenel subsequently became a Mandalorian world and was bombarded by the Galactic Republic during the Mandalorian Excision.

Fegorosk IV.title: Fegorosk IV
Fegorosk IV.lead: Fegorosk IV was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Fegorosk system, a part of the Obtrexta sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories. By some point between 0 ABY and 4 ABY, a dank, smoky club on Fegorosk IV at which the swuvehorn musical instrument was played was among the locales recreated in holographic form at the Arcade Omicron, a cantina on the Obtrexta sector planet Bescane.

Feldwes.title: Feldwes
Feldwes.lead: Feldwes was a planet located in the Feldwes system. It was situated in the Back Reach area of the Gordian Reach sector within the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The hyperlane known as the Ardan Cross connected it to the Arda and Pygorix systems.

Feris.title: Feris
Feris.lead: Feris was a celestial body located in the Feris system, a part of the Agarix sector in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim. It featured polar ice caps and was home to a civilization millennia prior to 3637 BBY. By approximately that year, the melting of the ice caps had revealed preserved remnants of the civilization.

Fern.title: Fern

facts.affiliation: At Attin Middle School Gamma, Skeleton Crew, Troiks (Conscripted, briefly), Troik Army (Conscripted, briefly)

Fern.lead: Fern was a human female youngling who lived in the galaxy in the early New Republic Era. Fern lived together with her mother Fara on At Attin, where Fara was a teacher and part of the government, and was best friends with another child called KB. Around 9 ABY, Fern met the boy Wim who found an old starship buried in the woods outside their city. After the two, KB and Wim's best friend Neel investigated the ship, they accidentally activated it and became lost in space.

Firrerre.title: Firrerre/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Empire Reborn, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Firrerre.lead: Firrerre was a planet located in the Firrerre system in the Outer Rim Territories. Its sole sentient indigenous species were the near-extinct Firrerreo.

Fest.title: Fest/Legends

facts.affiliation: Sith Empire, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Atrivis Resistance Group, Pentastar Alignment

Fest.lead: Fest was the primary planet in the Fest system. It was a frozen and densely populated world with few wilderness areas beyond several steep-ridged mountain ranges and deep valleys.

Fiddanl.title: Fiddanl
Fiddanl.lead: Fiddanl, originally known as 96NK3F2, was a barren planet in the Yavin system.

Filve.title: Filve
Filve.lead: Filve was the hot, dry homeworld of the Filvians in the Dufilvian sector of the Mid Rim.

Findris.title: Findris
Findris.lead: Findris was a Colonies celestial body that was the site of a Galactic Empire sector command and the offices of Colonial News Nets. The anti-Imperial Justice Action Network terrorist organization was formed on Findris in 15 BBY. Shortly following the Battle of Yavin, the Colonial News Nets employee Pertaal Shenvehr, while working on Findris, distributed information on the Imperial Military to Rebel Alliance agents via the use of coded messages in a Colonial News Nets advice column.

Ferro.title: Ferro
Ferro.lead: Ferro was the Ferroan homeworld. In 89 BBY, the Ferroans colonized Zonama Sekot.

Filordis.title: Filordis/Legends
Filordis.lead: Filordis was a rocky planet located in the Larrin sector of the Inner Rim. It was a harsh world of fierce winds and frequent thunderstorms. The Filordi, the planet's native species of six-limbed sentients, often either left their homeworld for better living conditions elsewhere or attempted to terraform it. The territory of space surrounding Filordis was already explored by 20,000 BBY, and the Filordi became a partner species of the Metatheran Cartel by 33 BBY.

Fibuli.title: Fibuli
Fibuli.lead: Fibuli was a planet in Trianii Space annexed by the Corporate Sector Authority.

Filo.title: Filo

facts.routes: Perlemian Trade Route, Triellus Trade Route

Filo.lead: Filo was the innermost planet in the Centares system.

Ferros VI.title: Ferros VI
Ferros VI.lead: Ferros VI was a planet that occupied the sixth orbital position in the Ferros system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Ojoster sector. The Galactic Empire maintained a prison camp on the planet during the Galactic Civil War.

Ferxani.title: Ferxani
Ferxani.lead: Ferxani was the fifth planet orbiting the star Polith in the Polith system. Located in the Jaso sector of the Inner Rim Territories, it was a gas giant.

Fether.title: Fether
Fether.lead: Fether was a farming world located on the Solenbaran Merchant Route hyperlane, in the Outer Rim Territories' Corporate Sector. The planet hosted a population of sentient Ocsin and was the site of a small spaceport town.

Ferton.title: Ferton
Ferton.lead: Ferton was an astronomical object located in the Ferton system of the Al'Nasrl sector, a part of the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. At some point by the time of the Galactic Civil War, Harbon, a sergeant with a mercenary company, visited Ferton. The sergeant later told of the visit to another member of the company.

Fildrost.title: Fildrost
Fildrost.lead: Fildrost was a gas giant in the Honoghr system.

Fillata.title: Fillata
Fillata.lead: Fillata was the third planet orbiting the star Prael in the Japrael system. Located in the Japrael sector of the Inner Rim Territories, it was not able to sustain any life due to it being a toxic world.

Fii.title: Fii
Fii.lead: Fii was the sixth planet orbiting the binary stars Toydar and Little Toydar in the Toydaria system. Located in Hutt Space of the galaxy, it was a barren rock.

Fhost.title: Fhost
Fhost.lead: Fhost was a planet located in the Wild Space of the galaxy which was close to the edge of the Unknown Regions. Mostly covered by deserts, mountains, and a single ocean, Fhost had its beauty. The largest population center, Farpoint, was built on the remains of a spaceship that crashed there long before 25 ABY. Fhost was so far out from the main hyperlanes that all HoloNet shows that were available were at least four months old.

Bothawui asteroid field.title: Fervse'dra asteroid belt
Bothawui asteroid field.lead: The Fervse'dra asteroid belt was located within Bothan Space of the regions known as the Mid Rim Territories and the Slice. Located around the planet Bothawui, the asteroid belt was situated in grid square R-14 on the Standard Galactic Grid and retained several passable zones, such as zones six, five, four, and three.

Fillithar.title: Fillithar
Fillithar.lead: Fillithar were a snake-like sentient species hailing from the world of the same name. As a serpentine life-form, they lacked hindquarters. Their tail, however, was prehensile. During the High Republic Era, the Fillithar Jedi Master Simmix trained the Padawan Cohmac Vitus. Around 3 BBY, a male Fillithar named Sssamm Ashsssen was part of the Apprentice Legislature along with Leia Organa. Twenty years into the reign of the New Republic, the Fillithar were represented in the Galactic Senate. Around the time of the so-called Napkin Bombing, their senator sided with the Populist faction.

Filata.title: Filata
Filata.lead: Filata was a celestial body that was orbited by at least three moons. At Site-145 on the third moon, Jedi Sokiro Terebin unearthed blasters that contained crystalline resonators attuned to the Force.

Firro.title: Firro
Firro.lead: Firro was a planet in the Farrfin sector of the Galactic Core that was brutally subjugated by the Galactic Empire prior to the Battle of Yavin.

Flax.title: Flax

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Galactic Alliance, Killiks

Flax.lead: Flax was a tectonically-active planet in the Ptera system of the Sumitra sector, in the Expansion Region. Most of the surface's land masses were desert due to the high coastal mountain ranges which prevented atmospheric transference of moisture from the seas.

Fnessal.title: Fnessal
Fnessal.lead: Fnessal was a planet located in the Inner Rim's Fnessal system. It was the homeworld of the sentient Fnessian species, including the smuggler Kn'ik Th'ronik.

Foerost.title: Foerost/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems

Foerost.lead: Foerost was a Core planet orbited by the famous Foerost Shipyards, which was one of the Galactic Republic's largest and oldest shipyards.

Florn.title: Florn/Legends

facts.affiliation: Xim's empire, Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders, Darth Revan's Sith Empire

Florn.lead: Florn, known as Tinatorn while under the control of Xim's empire, was the Lamproid homeworld. This planet was mostly dense jungles with a few large oceans. The jungles of Florn were said to be so deadly that any sentient on Florn's surface without hyperaccelerated nerve implants, or a similar level of natural reflexes, risked certain and sudden death.

Flankers.title: Flankers
Flankers.lead: Flankers was a remote planet in Fakir sector in the Colonies. Its star went supernova shortly after the Battle of Yavin, destroying the entire system. Just prior to the explosion, the Imperial garrison on the planet was abandoned.

Fitca Prime.title: Fitca Prime

facts.region: Mid Rim, New Territories, Lesser Plooriod Cluster

Fitca Prime.lead: Fitca Prime was a terrestrial planet that was the primary world of the Fitca system, a part of Urce Space in the Lesser Plooriod Cluster, which was in turn situated in the New Territories portion of the Mid Rim. At some point by 2 ABY, a Galactic Empire force led by High Inquisitor Mox Slosin subjugated the Fitca system and Fitca Prime. During the first Rebel Alliance support wave during that conflict, Alliance Colonel Shanda Dok was captured, and she was subsequently interrogated by Slosin. Between 12 ABY and 13 ABY, Fitca Prime fell within the borders of the New Republic.

Flotsam.title: Flotsam
Flotsam.lead: Flotsam was the third planet of the Belgaroth system, located in the Core Worlds of the galaxy. Illuminated by binary stars Matanya A and Matanya B, Flotsam was a barren world with no moons. An asteroid field of the star system lay before Flotsam.

Flandar.title: Flandar
Flandar.lead: Flandar was a planet located within the Thanta Zilbra system of the Outer Rim Territories.

Fodurant.title: Fodurant
Fodurant.lead: Fodurant was a New Republic prison world.

Fleyars IV.title: Fleyars IV
Fleyars IV.lead: Fleyars IV was the fourth planet in its system. It was the location of the Battle of Fleyars IV, in which the Galactic Empire subjugated the planet. The hero of the Battle was Akal Zed, whom took over command of the Seswennan Nightcloak when his captain was killed.

Fluwhaka.title: Fluwhaka
Fluwhaka.lead: Fluwhaka was a misty planet in the Outer Rim Territories noted for its rocky spires and crags.

Fodro.title: Fodro
Fodro.lead: Fodro was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Clacis sector, on the Braxant Run hyperlane. During the Galactic Civil War, it served as the endpoint of the Dahvil-Fodro Hyperspace Promenade, a popular interstellar racing route. The racer Siro Simito once participated in the race, during which he estimated that his rival, Seeg, would arrive at Fodro several hours earlier than himself. Fodro later fell within the borders of the Pentastar Alignment.

Fokask.title: Fokask
Fokask.lead: Fokask was a planet within the Fokask system in Outer Rim Territories. It was home to one of Han Solo's old smuggling friends. This retired smuggler sent Solo a copy of the Fokask Banner, which had a rather slanderous article written about Chief of State Leia Organa Solo.

Fitee.title: Fitee
Fitee.lead: Fitee was the third and last planet in the Bandomeer system.

Flashpoint.title: Flashpoint (disambiguation)
Flashpoint.lead: Flashpoint can refer to:, ===In-universe===, Flashpoint (clone trooper), Flashpoint (planet), Flashpoint (star), Flashpoint system, Flashpoint Stellar Research Station, Battle of Flashpoint Station

Fislan.title: Fislan
Fislan.lead: Fislan was a terrestrial celestial body situated in the Fislan system, a part of the Mortex sector in the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. At some point by 2 ABY, a Rebel Alliance force carried out training movements on Fislan, at which time the Ocsin swordmaster Cene Gilvent, a member of the Zulirian Swordmasters group of melee weapon afficionados, attacked and nearly killed one of the Rebel soldiers. Alliance Major Bren Derlin subsequently mentioned the encounter in a Task Force on Alliance Security SecuriDex datafile on Gilvent.

Florrum.title: Florrum/Legends

facts.affiliation: Ohnaka Gang, Confederacy of Independent Systems

Florrum.lead: Florrum was a rocky, backwater planet located six parsecs from Vanqor in the Outer Rim Territories.

Flauss.title: Flauss
Flauss.lead: Flauss was the fifth planet orbiting the star Utapau in the Utapau system. Located in the Tarabba sector of the Outer Rim Territories, it was a poisoned rock.

Fitomp.title: Fitomp
Fitomp.lead: Fitomp was an unaligned planet situated in the Unknown Regions' Fitomp system. It was a part of the Rakatan Archipelago, a fragmented group of planets settled by tribes of the Rakata species after the collapse of the Rakatan Infinite Empire around 25,200 BBY. Fitomp was also home to another sentient species that already inhabited it before the arrival of the Rakata.

Frego.title: Frego

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, The Cobral, Galactic Empire

Frego.lead: Frego was a wealthy planet controlled by a crime ring led by the Cobral family since 61 BBY. However, after Lena Cobral testified in front of the Galactic Senate in 41 BBY, exposing Cobral's patronage from Frego's Senator Crote, Frego started on the road to a new beginning. Nevertheless, the Cobral ring survived on Naboo.

Forscan VI.title: Forscan VI

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems

Forscan VI.lead: Forscan VI was a colony planet in the Auril sector, on the edge of the Cron Drift. During the Clone Wars it had been neutral, but in 21 BBY elite Confederacy of Independent Systems agents had established a training camp on the world and disturbed the settlers. The settlers complained to the Galactic Senate, who dispatched Jedi Knights Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker to the planet in 20 BBY to covertly aide the settlers, without letting either side know the Jedi were present. Before they could finish however, they were summoned back to Coruscant for an emergency.

Fornax.title: Fornax/Legends
Fornax.lead: Fornax was a planet in the Glythe sector, well known throughout the galaxy as being home to the Fire Rings of Fornax.

Formos.title: Formos/Legends

facts.routes: Kessel Run, Pabol Sleheyron, Triellus Trade Route
facts.affiliation: Xim's Empire, Hutt Cartel, Brotherhood of Darkness, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Formos.lead: Formos, originally known as Xoloch, was a planet in the Kessel sector.

Freda.title: Freda
Freda.lead: Freda was a terrestrial world within the Freda system, located near Jante on the Mid Rim of the galaxy, and home to the Freda. During the Galactic Civil War, it was under the control of the Galactic Empire.

Foundry.title: Foundry/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Techno Union, Galactic Empire

Foundry.lead: Wat Tambor's private estate was located on the planet, in the city Denus.

Foless.title: Foless/Legends
Foless.lead: Foless was a planet located in the Southern Core portion of the Colonies. It was situated on the periphery of the Trailing Sectors portion of the Inner Rim.

Framesk Yagen.title: Framesk Yagen
Framesk Yagen.lead: Framesk Yagen was a planet in the Bovo Yagen system.

Forscan IV.title: Forscan IV
Forscan IV.lead: Forscan IV was a planet located in the Forscan system within the Auril sector., At some time prior to his mission to Ord Cestus, Jedi Knight Obi-Wan Kenobi traveled to Forscan IV for a mission. He had several close calls there, during one of which his padawan Anakin Skywalker saved his life.

Forsen.title: Forsen
Forsen.lead: Forsen was a lush agriworld in the Outer Rim. It was part of the Cassandran Worlds.

Folende.title: Folende
Folende.lead: Folende was an agriworld located in the Folende system of the Tion Hegemony, within the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The Desevran Trace hyperlane linked Folende to the worlds of Desevro and Omman. For centuries, Folende's agricultural output was moderate, with Omman being considered its competitor.

Forntay.title: Forntay
Forntay.lead: Forntay was a planet located in the Forntay system, in the Southern Core portion of the Core Worlds. According to a text from Forntay that was ancient by the time of the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Rebel Alliance and that was translated by the Human educator Emiel Skoff—who was researching historical insights that would aid the outnumbered Alliance prevail over the Empire—the planet was at one point home to a group of native inhabitants. Skoff characterized the group as primitive, and supposedly it had been subjugated by a faction utilizing superior forces.

Formac.title: Formac
Formac.lead: Formac was a planet in the Csilla system, which was located in Chiss Space in the Unknown Regions.

Fondor Belt I.title: Fondor Belt I
Fondor Belt I.lead: Fondor Belt I was the first asteroid belt located in the Fondor system in the Freeworlds Territory portion of the Tapani sector, within the Southern Core portion of the Colonies. It occupied the second orbital position around the star Fondor. Along with the rest of its star system, the asteroid belt was located along the Gandeal-Fondor Hyperlane, with another hyperspace route also connecting it to the Sefon system.

Fondor Belt II.title: Fondor Belt II
Fondor Belt II.lead: Fondor Belt II was an asteroid belt in the Fondor system, located in the Freeworlds Territory portion of the Tapani sector, within the Southern Core portion of the Colonies. Along with the rest of its star system, the asteroid belt was located along the Gandeal-Fondor Hyperlane, with another hyperspace route connecting it to the Sefon system. The asteroid belt occupied the third orbital position around the star Fondor.

Fondor Belt III.title: Fondor Belt III
Fondor Belt III.lead: Fondor Belt III was an asteroid belt located in the Fondor system in the Freeworlds Territory portion of the Tapani sector, within the Southern Core portion of the Colonies. The asteroid belt occupied the fifth orbital position around the star Fondor. Along with the rest of its star system, it was located along the Gandeal-Fondor Hyperlane, with another hyperspace route also connecting it to the Sefon system.

Fondor Belt IV.title: Fondor Belt IV
Fondor Belt IV.lead: Fondor Belt IV was an asteroid belt in the Fondor system, located in the Freeworlds Territory portion of the Tapani sector within the Southern Core portion of the Colonies. Along with the rest of its star system, the asteroid belt was located along the Gandeal-Fondor Hyperlane, with another hyperspace route connecting it to the Sefon system. Fondor Belt IV occupied the seventh orbital position around the star Fondor.

Fradian.title: Fradian
Fradian.lead: Fradian was an ore terminal planet located in the Mid Rim. It was an industrial place that looked like it was designed by an architect who wanted to lose his job. Former Jedi Bardan Jusik thought the place was ugly.

Foran Tutha.title: Foran Tutha/Legends
Foran Tutha.lead: Foran Tutha was a barren planet in the Cronese Mandate on the edge of the Tion Cluster, located in the Outer Rim. Otherwise unremarkable and beneath notice, Foran Tutha shot to prominence after the discovery of the Foran Tutha star probe in the system sometime around 500 BBY. Despite centuries of debate, academics never came to an agreement on the nature of the probe's origins. In the millennia after the Cron Supernova, Foran Tutha hosted a cottage industry of treasure hunters that made the dangerous jumps in the direction of Ossus.

Fornow.title: Fornow
Fornow.lead: Fornow was a planet within the Fornow system in the Pacanth Reach of the Outer Rim Territories.

Fresia.title: Fresia/Legends
Fresia.lead: Fresia was a Core World that served as headquarters for Incom Corporation.

Fwillsving.title: Fwillsving
Fwillsving.lead: Fwillsving was a planet near Kessel and Honoghr. It was sometimes used by smugglers as a repair depot and a hideaway from Imperial patrol starships while smuggling spice on the Kessel Run.

Froz.title: Froz
Froz.lead: Froz was the homeworld of the Frozian species. It was on the Corellian Run. It was a pristine low-gravity planet.

Fyodos.title: Fyodos
Fyodos.lead: Fyodos, also known as Tatrang IV, was an Outer Rim planet that was located within the Tatrang system. The world's surface was devastated during the Great Cleansing, a war of mass destruction that took place in 350 BBY. Prior to the cataclysm, the surface possessed two main seas, one of which was called the Othlorian Sea.

Fremond III.title: Fremond III
Fremond III.lead: Fremond III was a planet in the Inner Rim.

Froswythe.title: Froswythe
Froswythe.lead: Froswythe was a planet in the Colonies. It was a major source of meat and animal-based textiles for the Colonies and Core Worlds. Roaming herds of livestock included banthas and nerfs. Ycaqt were used for transportation.

Frithia.title: Frithia
Frithia.lead: Frithia was a terrestrial planet located in the Frithia system, a part of the Glythe sector in the New Territories portion of the Mid Rim. It was home to the predator known as poth as well as the gigantic herd creature krag.

Frellor.title: Frellor
Frellor.lead: Frellor was the first planet in the Fre'ji system.

Fretaria.title: Fretaria
Fretaria.lead: Fretaria was the third planet in the Fre'ji system.

Frenoris.title: Frenoris
Frenoris.lead: Frenoris was the fourth planet in the Fre'ji system.

G'hol.title: G'hol
G'hol.lead: G'hol was the fourth planet orbiting the star C'rel in the N'zoth system. Located in the Koornacht Cluster of the Core Worlds, it was a terrestrial planet.

Fyrth asteroid fields.title: Fyrth system/Legends
Fyrth asteroid fields.lead: The Fyrth system was located in the Inner Rim. It contained several asteroid fields that were believed to be the only source of the opila lightsaber crystals.

Fwiis.title: Fwiis
Fwiis.lead: Fwiis was a colony world between Darepp and Motexx visited by the Star Morning after it departed Teyr. It was more than 150 light-years away from Atzerri.

Fwatna.title: Fwatna
Fwatna.lead: Fwatna was a planet in the Subterrel sector near the site where Lando Calrissian found the abandoned freighter Spicy Lady. The ship belonged to his smuggling associate Jarril. This also led to the discovery of Dolph.

Fusai.title: Fusai/Legends
Fusai.lead: Fusai was a planet in the remote Fusai sector. It was the location of a branch of the Obroa-skai library, where a BRT supercomputer called Mistress Mnemos was installed about 200 BBY. Although Obroa-skai closed the branch, it was maintained locally. Fusai became a Rebel Alliance safe world, and it was here C-3PO reported to Mistress Mnemos the incidents that occurred to Luke Skywalker and Leia Organa on Vorzyd V, where they faced the minion of Blackhole. In addition to recording mission details, Mistress Mnemos helped the Alliance with tactics and long-term planning.

Frewwil.title: Frewwil
Frewwil.lead: Frewwil was a planet located in the Frewwil system, a part of the freestanding subsectors portion of the Expansion Region. An inhospitable world, Frewwil was explored by the Republic Survey Corps scout Barosa Warren. More than fifty years later, by 2 ABY, Frewwil was controlled by the Galactic Empire and was considered to be one of the most dangerous planets under the Empire's jurisdiction.

Freliq.title: Freliq
Freliq.lead: Freliq was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Calaron sector. It was home to the lepusa, a type of semi-sentient burrowing rodents who were able to manufacture crude tools. At some point, the farmers who had introduced off-world grain crops on Freliq first encountered the lepusa, whose herbivorous nature and burrowing habits soon made them little more than vermin in the farmers' eyes. The local farm manager Yasil Senerio once had an encounter with a lepusa which saved their daughter, and Senerio recounted the incident to the Imperial Investigation Committee on Lepusan Intelligence.

Frisal.title: Frisal
Frisal.lead: Frisal was a terrestrial planet located in the Frisal system, a part of the Atrisian Commonwealth in the Southern Core portion of the Core Worlds. It was the homeworld of loirbniggs, a species of eight-legged reptilian creatures.

G'haris.title: G'haris
G'haris.lead: G'haris was a planet from which the rare saass worm originated.

Furies Gate.title: Furies Gate
Furies Gate.lead: Furies Gate was the outermost planet of the Tython system that was located within the galaxy's Deep Core region. The cold and barren world was colonized more than thirty-six thousand years before the Battle of Yavin by the non–Force-sensitive settlers of the planet Tython. Several thousand years before 25,793 BBY, a space station called Fury Station was established in orbit around Furies Gate and for a long period of time served as a launch point of Tythan sleeper ships traveling into the Deep Core. By 25,793 BBY, the station still orbited Furies Gate and served as a scientific outpost.

Galidraan.title: Galidraan/Legends

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Greater Tion, Trans-Hydian
facts.affiliation: Xim's Empire, Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire

Galidraan.lead: Galidraan was a planet of snow-capped mountains and large pine forests, and was controlled by a planetary governor, who resided in an opulent castle in the midst of a forest.

Galantos.title: Galantos
Galantos.lead: Galantos was the second planet in the Utos system in the Core Worlds. It was located on the Widek Bypass, near the Koornacht Cluster. Its first contact with the galactic community was quite ancient, as at least one Fian served as a Jedi 500 years before the First Great Schism.

Gale.title: Gale

facts.affiliation: Jedi Order, Army of Light, Galactic Republic

Gale.lead: Gale was a male Jedi Knight and Lord of a series of constituent planets who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the final decades of the wars with the new Sith Empire. During one of the clashes Jedi Kiel Charny, Gale's forces were able to silence the gun turrets of the Sith army. Despite these successes, Lord Gale was struck down during the battle, perishing on the muddy world with so many of his brethren.

Gala.title: Gala

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems

Gala.lead: Gala was a beautiful and wealthy world at one point ruled by the Beju-Tallah dynasty. It was fairly close to Phindar.

G'rho.title: G'rho
G'rho.lead: G'rho was a planet in Wild Space on the Shiritoku Spur and was where forests of juvica grew. A remote colony, its colonists raised duncows and built Boku Settlement near a rich vein of crimson ore. Dev Sibwarra's family moved there shortly after his birth in 11 BBY when they fled Chandrila.

Gabredor III.title: Gabredor III/Legends
Gabredor III.lead: Gabredor III was a planet situated between Dantooine and Obtrexta sector, in Myto's Arrow. It had a Karazak Slavers Cooperative transfer center under the authority of slave master Greezim Trentacal. Trentacal kidnapped the children of the Ambassador of Cantras Gola to force the PowerOn Conglomerate to remain with the Alignment; in exchange, the Alignment agreed not to interfere with Karazak operations. The center was destroyed by the Red Moons, who rescued the children and other slaves.

Gacerian.title: Gacerian
Gacerian.lead: Gacerian was the fourth planet in the Gacerian system. It was home to many Gacerite mines and was the homeworld of the Gacerite species. During Imperial reign, the Imperial governor of the planet, Ulbrek Gostech, was compassionate and kind, allowing the general populace to run the planet. Thus, the Gacerites were happy to abide by Imperial values and obey the laws dictated to them through their governor.

Gadon 3.title: Gadon 3
Gadon 3.lead: Gadon 3 was a planet in the Tion Cluster of the Outer Rim Territories, noted for its Kif mines. Historically it had fallen under the influence of Kismaano, something long resented by the native Gadons. It was the center of a dispute in 71 BBY when the Kif miners began selling ore to enemies of the Gadons. The Galactic Republic ruled in favor of the miners.

Gailea.title: Gailea
Gailea.lead: Gailea was a planet located in the Gailea system of the Core Worlds. It was the site of the location Femon and the Marqua Spas, the latter of which hosted the renowned and exclusive annual Marqua Spas Grand Ball. On the date 37:1:13, a news report by TriNebulon News was issued from Femon that covered an incident where the Human floubette dance perfomer Jantaa Binx had begun performing at that year's Marqua Spas Grand Ball—only to be escorted off the Spas' premises due to the audience finding the interpretation by a Human of the traditionally avian-performed dance to be shocking and upsetting.

G'wenee.title: G'wenee/Legends
G'wenee.lead: G'wenee was an Imperial tradeworld whose operations were overseen by Tarrant Snil, who proved to be an adversary to Grappa the Hutt. Snil was captured by bounty hunter Kenix Kil.

Galand.title: Galand
Galand.lead: Galand was a Core world. It was homeworld of the near-Human Galandans, including the religious martyr H'kig. His teachings formed the basis of the H'kig philosophy. To escape persecution, the H'kig fled to distant Rishi.

Galaan.title: Galaan/Legends
Galaan.lead: Galaan was a gas giant in Corva sector's Galaanus system. Its local day lasted 132 standard hours; its year lasted 479 local days.

Galdar.title: Galdar
Galdar.lead: Galdar was the home planet of the Galderians. It was a small, rocky planet which held very little natural resources, or food.

Gaios.title: Gaios
Gaios.lead: Gaios was a planet in the Core Worlds within the grid coordinates K-9. Its philosophers' statement "a seed does not know the flower that produced it," was well known.

Gal Milnor.title: Gal Milnor
Gal Milnor.lead: Gal Milnor was a planet that housed the main supply base used by the Alliance to Restore the Republic to store food, munitions and fuel. The base, along with a sizeable fleet of Alliance freighters, was destroyed by the Galactic Empire shortly before the Battle of Endor. This setback forced the Alliance to seek supplies from Dunari and the Hurrim.

Gaftikar.title: Gaftikar

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems

Gaftikar.lead: Gaftikar was a planet in the Outer Rim. Some time before the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire, the mercenaries known as the Brig Stompers wiped out the planet's entire defense force during a coup.

Galboron.title: Galboron
Galboron.lead: Galboron was a celestial body situated in the Galboron system, a part of the Hertae sector in the Slice portion of the Mid Rim. It and the Nexus Ortai system were both located near the intersection of the hyperlanes known as the Askar Trace—which linked them to the Leritor, Lanos, and Bresnia system—and the Reena Trade Route, which connected them to the Masterra and Spirador systems.

Galidraan IV.title: Galidraan IV
Galidraan IV.lead: Galidraan IV was a planet in the Galidraan system within the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. It was orbited by at least two moons.

GUHL-JO387O.title: GUHL-J03870
GUHL-JO387O.lead: GUHL-J03870 was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Trilon sector. It had a rocky surface and was home to a type of six-limbed creature. At one point between 28 ABY and 34 ABY, the First Order Star Destroyer Finalizer visited the planet, with one of its troop transports bringing back from the surface one of the creatures as a stowaway. That led to a First Order stormtrooper squad being dispatched to GUHL-J03870, where they encountered multiple other members of the species, resulting in the unit departing the planet.

GH-531.title: GH-531
GH-531.lead: GH-531 was a planet in the GH-531 system in the Unknown Regions that was the site of a Galactic Empire communications station, which was later taken over by the First Order by the time of the outbreak of war between the First Order and the Resistance.

Gand.title: Gand/Legends
Gand.lead: The Gands, or Gand , were a sentient species of humanoids that xenobiologists believed to have evolved from an insect genus that inhabited the ammonia-gas planet of Gand. Several physical varieties of the species existed, differing from one another in the structure of the head and the texture and color of the exoskeleton, but the species was usually divided into two main subspecies: those with lungs and those without.

Gamorr.title: Gamorr/Legends

facts.terrain: Forest, Mountains, Jungle, Tundra, Plains, Swamps
facts.affiliation: Exar Kun's Sith Empire, Darth Revan's Sith Empire, Hutt Space, Hutt dependencies

Gamorr.lead: Gamorr was an agrarian planet located in the Opoku system of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of a porcine sentient species, the Gamorreans. Its varied terrain ranged from frozen tundra to deep forests, and was considered quite pleasant by off-worlders. Nevertheless, tourism was highly discouraged to Gamorr because of the vicious lifestyle of ferocious, bloody warfare constantly being waged between rival Gamorrean clans. Prominent mushrooms were also found on Gamorr, as were native coolsap trees.

Gallinore.title: Gallinore
Gallinore.lead: Gallinore was a planet in the Interior Region of the Hapes Cluster that was famed for its rainbow gems. Gallinore was also home to a number of high-tech labs, including a lockdown facility where imprisoned researchers, including a former Jedi, were allowed to continue some work.

Galleefryn II.title: Galleefryn II

facts.affiliation: Corporate Sector Authority, Galactic Empire, Rebel Alliance

Galleefryn II.lead: Galleefryn II was a jungle planet in Corporate Sector.

Ganath.title: Ganath/Legends

facts.sector: Hutt Space, Oktos Nebula, Ganathan Space

Ganath.lead: Ganath was a planet hidden within the unchartered depths of the Oktos Nebula, a cloud of intensely radioactive interstellar gas near Nal Hutta.

Gamandar.title: Gamandar
Gamandar.lead: Gamandar was a planet in the Mid Rim's Iskalon system, considered the twin planet of the nearby waterworld of Iskalon. The homeworld of a humanoid sentient species also known as the Gamandars, the planet was brutally conquered and its people enslaved by the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. Afterwards, Admiral Griggor Tower established his base of operations in the system in a massive citadel on Gamandar.

Gambolla.title: Gambolla
Gambolla.lead: Gambolla was a planet in the same star system as Arcopola, in the Spadja sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Galpos II.title: Galpos II/Legends
Galpos II.lead: Galpos II was a desolate planet in the Abrion sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was suspected to be a base for pirate groups operating in the sector. The pirate vessel GrimDeath I was once tracked traveling to the world.

Ganash.title: Ganash

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Alliance of Free Planets, New Republic, Galactic Federation of Free Alliances, Five Worlds, Confederation

Ganash.lead: Ganash was a violet gas giant planet was the fifth world in the Both system, and was orbited by fourteen moons. It was named for a character in Bothan mythology.

Galvoni III.title: Galvoni III
Galvoni III.lead: Galvoni III was an Imperial planet in the Core Worlds' Galvoni system with a military communications complex.

Galltine.title: Galltine
Galltine.lead: Galltine was a Human-inhabited planet in the Galltine system of the Thesme sector.

Galtea.title: Galtea/Legends
Galtea.lead: Galtea was a planet in the system of the same name, located within the Outer Rim Territories' Kathol sector. The world was situated near the edge of known space, on the border of the Marcol Void, an empty region of space thirty light-years across. Neutral in galactic politics, Galtea was only of cursory interest to the Galactic Empire, which established a small outpost on the planet and allowed the population a degree of autonomy.

Gam Tim'nisi asteroid belt.title: Gam Tim'nisi asteroid belt
Gam Tim'nisi asteroid belt.lead: Gam Tim'nisi asteroid belt was an asteroid belt in the Tungra sector of the Outer Rim Territories of The galaxy, not far from the Bespin system.

Gallshebbis Prime.title: Gallshebbis Prime
Gallshebbis Prime.lead: Gallshebbis Prime was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Gallshebbis Prime system, a part of Nilgaard sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the site of a warehouse. At one point during the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Rebel Alliance, Alliance General Airen Cracken and his team of Rebel soldiers, which had suffered some casualties, became surrounded in the warehouse by Imperial stormtroopers.

Galloa II.title: Galloa II
Galloa II.lead: Galloa II was the homeworld of the nonhuman Wind Dancers.

Gamor.title: Gamor system
Gamor.lead: The Gamor system was located in the Chaykin sector of the Expansion Region and the Slice. It was also situated in the grid square O-14 of the Standard Galactic Grid. The super-hyperroute known as the Corellian Run connected the Gamor system to the Allanteen and Bacrana systems, and the Gamor Run hyperspace route linked it to the Aridus system.

Galsol.title: Galsol
Galsol.lead: Galsol was a planet in the Belderone sector of the Outer Rim.

Galtor VI.title: Galtor VI
Galtor VI.lead: Galtor VI was a planet mined by the Galactic Empire. Some time during the Galactic Civil War, a prisoner managed to escape from the mines and joined a Rebel outpost in the Silenia system. The mines sometimes produced Socalium crystals.

Gan Moradir.title: Gan Moradir
Gan Moradir.lead: Gan Moradir was a colony planet located in the Gan Moradir system in the Xan sector of the Mid Rim, in grid square Q-15 of the Standard Galactic Grid. During the Galactic Civil War, it was occupied by the Galactic Empire. After the Battle of Endor, the burgeoning New Republic got rid of the Imperials on that world. With both the Empire and the New Republic gone, however, the people of Gan Moradir found themselves at the mercy of pirate gangs that seized the food sources. Additionally, the fightings had affected their wells, leaving them without drinking water.

Galzez.title: Galzez
Galzez.lead: Galzez was a planet located in the Galzez system, in the Dustig sector of the Mid Rim Territories. Its surface was covered rocky mountains and many orange crystals. It was home to a base operated by the Syvik Delegation.

Garban.title: Garban

facts.affiliation: Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Garban.lead: Garban was the homeworld of the Jenet species and the fourth planet in the Tau Sakar system. It was located in the Abrion sector of the Outer Rim Territories, in the region between the Perlemian Trade Route and Corellian Run known as the Slice.

Gandle Ott.title: Gandle Ott

facts.government: Parliamentary democracy (Until appointment of Imperial governor), Imperial governor (Until 8 ABY), Parliamentary democracy (From 8 ABY)
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Moff Kentor Sarne

Gandle Ott.lead: Gandle Ott was the fourth planet of the Ott system, located in the Kathol sector of the Outer Rim Territories. The terminus of the Trition Trade Route, Gandle Ott was considered to be the farthest major settled world in the sector. Settled around 592 BBY, Gandle Ott quickly grew into a thriving colony and became the most prominent world in the Kathol sector until Kal'Shebbol was settled two hundred years later. When the Kathol sector was inducted into the Galactic Republic, Kal'Shebbol was designated as the sector capital since it was closer to Republic space.

Gargon.title: Gargon/Legends
Gargon.lead: Gargon was a planet in Mandalore sector.

Garnib.title: Garnib
Garnib.lead: Garnib was the primary world of the Garnib system. It was subjugated by the Galactic Empire and many native Balinaka (considered to be the galaxy's most artistic beings) were exported as slaves to the breeding farms on Karfeddion. The planet was headquarters of Galactic Crystal Creations, which exported Garnib crystals.

Gap Nine.title: Gap Nine
Gap Nine.lead: Gap Nine was a backwater swamp planet home to a reptilian species.

Gargolyn IV.title: Gargolyn IV
Gargolyn IV.lead: Gargolyn IV was a planet known to be a garden paradise that was lush with animal life and vegetation. It was the homeworld of the Cor species. The land of the Cors was guarded by a huge beast that destroyed any settlement the scouting Karflo Corporation initiated.

Garos IV.title: Garos IV

facts.affiliation: Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Garos IV.lead: Garos IV was a planet in the Mid Rim, the fourth world in the Garos system. Located near the Nyarikan Nebula, it was somewhat isolated from outside contact and its inhabitants were a tough, self-reliant people. It was the homeworld of Imperial officers Brenn and Dellis Tantor, and the adopted homeworld of New Republic Captain Alexandra Winger.

Gantho.title: Gantho
Gantho.lead: Gantho was a planet located in the Gantho system. The planet was represented in the New Republic Senate by Senator Arastide. In 13 ABY the New Republic was in the middle of an investigation into Loronar Corporation and their supposed depletion of the world's resources.

Gandeal.title: Gandeal
Gandeal.lead: Gandeal was a Planet in the Core Worlds and partner planet to the world of Fondor, a fortress world situated on the Corellian Trade Spine.

Garobi.title: Garobi system/Legends
Garobi.lead: The Garobi system was a star system located in the Tapani sector's Barnaba Province, between the Barnaba and Hellios systems.

Gania.title: Gania system/Legends
Gania.lead: The Gania system was a star system located in the Tapani sector's Melantha Province, near the Shella system.

Gandrun Two.title: Gandrun Two
Gandrun Two.lead: Gandrun Two was a desert world that occupied the second orbital position in the Colonies' Gandrun system. Its terrain was dominated by endless sand dunes.

Garen IV.title: Garen IV/Legends
Garen IV.lead: Garen IV was a planet near Hargeeva in the Expansion Region. It was the location of an Imperial penal colony.

Ganlihk.title: Ganlihk
Ganlihk.lead: Ganlihk was a planet in the Dantus sector of the Outer Rim.

Garn.title: Garn/Legends
Garn.lead: Garn was a desolate world of craggy rocks and dead trees shrouded in a dense yellow fog, located in the Cadma sector of the Outer Rim. The planet was once home to the Force-wielding order known as the Order of the Terrible Glare thousands of years before the Galactic Civil War, until the Jedi Order laid waste to Garn at the climax of a war between the two organizations. Although the Terrible Glare was completely wiped out, their High Shaman, Rur, preserved an aspect of his consciousness by uploading his personality to a computer system in his citadel on ruined Garn.

Ganthel.title: Ganthel/Legends
Ganthel.lead: Ganthel was a celestial body located in the Ganthel system of the Core Worlds' Bormea sector. Grandon Holleck, a veteran of the Clone Wars and the Galactic Empire's governor of the Bormea sector planet Chandrila, hailed from Ganthel. After Galactic Emperor Palpatine forced Holleck's retirement, a news report issued by Coruscant Daily Newsfeed on the date 36:8:4 claimed that Holleck had cited in a resignation letter to Palpatine his desire to relocate from Chandrila to Ganthel as one of the reasons for his retirement.

Garia.title: Garia
Garia.lead: Garia was a planet in the Garia system of the Brak sector. It was the site of a battle during the Clone Wars.

Gandeid IV.title: Gandeid IV
Gandeid IV.lead: Gandeid IV was the primary planet of the Gandeid system, a part of the Expansion Region's Trailing Grant sector. The planet occupied the fourth orbital position in its star system, and the Gandeidan gravity was low and the climate temperate. It was home to the creatures known as noli as well as the large predatory avian cooha.

Ganzik.title: Ganzik
Ganzik.lead: Ganzik was a world located in the Ganzik system, a part of the Mid Rim's Maldrood sector. It was situated near the hyperlane known as the Perlemian Trade Route. The primary shipyards of the starship manufacturing company Mesens Corporation were located in orbit around Ganzik.

Garos.title: Garos
Garos.lead: Garos was a terrestrial planet located in the Garos system in the Msst sector of the Mid Rim Territories, in grid square P-7 of the Standard Galactic Grid. It was the location of a university and Imperial facility five years after the Clone Wars.

Gavryn.title: Gavryn
Gavryn.lead: Gavryn was a planet with a powerful magnetic pole. Ensign Gilad Pellaeon first distinguished himself while commanding an escort for a convoy to Gavryn. As the convoy entered orbit, pirates attacked. Pellaeon flew his ship into the magnetic pole, obscuring his ship from the pirates' sensors. As the pirate vessel moved to board the convoy ships, Pellaeon emerged from the pole and destroyed them. His quick thinking in this incident earned him the first in a string of promotions.

Garqi.title: Garqi/Legends

facts.language: Yuuzhan Vong, Formerly: Galactic Basic Standard
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Pentastar Alignment, Imperial Remnant, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire, Fel Empire …

Garqi.lead: Garqi was an agriworld and the sector capital of the Tadrin sector, in the Outer Rim Territories. Natural elements in Garqi's crust gave the native plant life a purple coloration. From space, the planet appeared a beautiful, hypnotic violet color. It was the source of the beans used to make caf.

Geedon V.title: Geedon V

facts.affiliation: Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire

Geedon V.lead: Geedon V was a planet in Sumitra sector of the Expansion Region. It was the site of a former base for pirates operating in the sector. Once, the entire planet was single-handedly taken over by the gunman Gallandro during one of his early exploits.

Gaulus.title: Gaulus/Legends
Gaulus.lead: Gaulus was a planet that at one time hosted a Alliance to Restore the Republic base. An espionage droid infiltrated the base and transmitted the location to the Galactic Empire, and thus the base was destroyed shortly after.

Gastrula.title: Gastrula
Gastrula.lead: Gastrula was a planet in the Rayter sector of the Outer Rim Territories. The homeworld of the Gastrulan species, it was the terminus of the short-lived Great Bantha Breakfast Biscuit Run during the Galactic Civil War. Captain Bungo Bung had established the trade route in an effort to make credits by selling the popular snack Bantha Breakfast Biscuits to the locals. However, when combined with certain elements in the environment of Gastrula, preservatives in the biscuits caused the snacks to mutate into the Giant Amorphous Bantha Breakfast Biscuit.

Gbu.title: Gbu

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Tion Cluster, The Slice
facts.affiliation: Xim's Empire, Keldrath Alignment, Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Gbu.lead: Gbu was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories, located in the Tion Cluster's Keldrath sector.

Gaurick.title: Gaurick
Gaurick.lead: Gaurick was a planet in the Corporate Sector. It was controlled by a religious cult, with leaders known as muftis, with the cult being known as the Renouncers.

Gastol.title: Gastol

facts.routes: Commenor Run, Hydian Way, Brentaal–Denon Route, Corsin Run, Perlemian Trade Route

Gastol.lead: Gastol was a planet in the Brentaal system. It was a gas giant with three moons.

Garulag.title: Garulag
Garulag.lead: Garulag was the third planet in the Corulus system. It was a gas giant orbited by 15 moons.

Gart.title: Gart
Gart.lead: Gart was the second planet in orbit in the Demar system. Over 30 years before the Battle of Yavin it had been reduced to an empty shell of rock by the Lant Mining Corporation. Gart was the first planet in the system to be mined by the LMC and was the first to be completely stripped of all available resources.

Gauther.title: Gauther
Gauther.lead: Gauther was a planet in the Desev system.

Gedi 4.title: Gedi 4

facts.affiliation: Hutt Cartel, Besadii Kajidic, Galactic Empire

Gedi 4.lead: Gedi 4 was a gas giant planet in the Arkanis sector of the Outer Rim.

Gartana.title: Gartana
Gartana.lead: Gartana was the fourth planet of the Gorsh system, with twelve moons in its orbit. Its oceans were composed of water that was toxic.

Garsala.title: Garsala
Garsala.lead: Garsala was a planet ravaged by volcanoes, and was the fifth orbit of the Gorsh system. It had two moons.

Gascon.title: Gascon
Gascon.lead: Gascon was a wealthy and powerful planet located in the Mid Rim's Trans-Gascon sector. Ruled by a king and Queen Marilla, following the formation of the New Republic, Gascon remained neutral yet strategically important during the Galactic Civil War between the New Republic and the Galactic Empire. At one point, the pro–New Republic Marilla, who had given a unique ring as a gift to her lover, the Prime Minister of the planet Demigue, tasked a group of individuals with retrieving the ring in time for a ball given by Gascon's king so that her affair would not be exposed.

Gathus.title: Gathus/Legends
Gathus.lead: Gathus was a planet in the Tynquay sector in the Outer Rim Territories. The local smashball team played against a team from Lafra.

Gaulix.title: Gaulix
Gaulix.lead: Gaulix was a planet in the Ansion system, which was located in the Mid Rim's Churnis sector. Gaulix occupied the second position in orbit of the star Ansion, and had one moon. Its atmosphere was a broiling toxic soup, rendering it uninhabitable.

Garr'lst.title: Garr'lst
Garr'lst.lead: Garr'lst was a planet in the Inner Rim. Members of the planet's native sentient feline species were massacred at some point before or during the Republic Dark Age.

Gavos.title: Gavos
Gavos.lead: Gavos was a small planet located in the Kastolar sector of the Mid Rim. It was the location of a poorly productive oridium mining operation that was won in a game of sabacc sometime during the Galactic Civil War by Bargos the Hutt—a gambling, middle-ranked Hutt Cartel crime lord living on hard times in a palace somewhere on the Outer Rim.
