Bargos called in a debt of obligation from a group of adventurers and had them travel to Gavos to assess the quality and worth of the mines.

Gatalenta.title: Gatalenta/Legends
Gatalenta.lead: Gatalenta was a planet located in the galaxy. By the third Galactic War, Gatalentans were known for their tea and their long tradition of supporting the Jedi. Gatalenta was considered a beautiful planet by Ardinondu Dipolus Daeruun, a general in the Galactic Republic.

Geonosis.title: Geonosis/Legends

facts.government: Hives, Ruling archduke, Monarchy, Hive councils
facts.affiliation: Geonosians, Mandalorians, Galactic Republic, Trade Federation, Geonosian Industries, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Separatist holdouts …

Geonosis.lead: Geonosis, called Geonosia by some natives, was a ringed, rocky desert planet in the Arkanis sector of the Outer Rim Territories. The home planet of the insectoid Geonosians, it was known for its droid factories and violent gladiatorial games. Geonosis was a major stronghold of the Confederacy of Independent Systems, due to it hosting major droid foundries. It was the site of the Battle of Geonosis, the opening conflict of the Clone Wars, in 22 BBY.

Gentes.title: Gentes/Legends

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories; Greater Javin, Western Reaches
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Brotherhood of Darkness, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire

Gentes.lead: Gentes was one of three habitable planets in the Anoat system of the Anoat sector, located in the Greater Javin of the Outer Rim. It was the homeworld of the Ugnaughts.

Genarius.title: Genarius
Genarius.lead: Genarius was a gas giant in the Cularin system. Much like Bespin, it had floating cities, including a manufacturing city built by SoroSuub Corporation in 32 BBY. The floating cities of Genarius were viewed as relatively lawless by the standards of the rest of the Cularin system.

Generis.title: Generis/Legends

facts.affiliation: Infinite Empire, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Alliance to Restore the Republic, Pentastar Alignment, New Republic, Empire-in-exile

Generis.lead: Generis was a high-gravity planet located in the Generis system of the Atrivis sector. It had rugged terrain and was covered with grassy plains and vast jungles. This natural beauty attracted offworld travelers keen to experience its wilderness. Prior to the formation of the Galactic Republic, the world was settled by the Rakata as part of their galaxy-spanning Infinite Empire. Following the collapse of their society, scattered temples were all that remained of their time on Generis.

Genesia.title: Genesia
Genesia.lead: Genesia was the second planet in the Genesia system of the Brak sector, orbited by a multitude of space stations known as G-Stations. Genesia was located on a popular hyperlane, and received an influx of spacers and other visitors on their way to various destinations.

Genassa.title: Genassa/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Genassa.lead: Genassa was a Mid Rim agriworld located in the M'shinni sector. It was the homeworld of the sentient M'shinn species, which evolved from a humanoid precursor species that had entered a symbiotic relationship with a local plant species. The M'shinni eventually colonized Genassa's moon and the rest of the Genassa system before going on to develop hyperdrive and settle worlds in other star systems at some point by 3966 BBY.

Gelgelar.title: Gelgelar/Legends

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Metharian Nebula Territories

Gelgelar.lead: Gelgelar was a cold, cloud-covered swamp planet in the Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of the Glarsaurs.

Geran.title: Geran/Legends
Geran.lead: Geran was a planet located in the Calaron sector of the Outer Rim.

Genian.title: Genian
Genian.lead: Genian was a Mid Rim world. The planet remained neutral during the Clone Wars due to its vast corporate holdings, research labs, and secure banks. Many Senators, both Separatists and Republic alike, would store their money here, due to its neutrality. Its large, prosperous cities included Bruit, located near a rocky desert surrounded by mountain ranges. Fry Industries was headquartered on Genian.

Geminor.title: Geminor

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories; Tion Cluster, The Slice

Geminor.lead: Geminor was the second planet in the Lianna system. Its atmosphere consisted of a hot, dense poisonous gas and the planet was orbited by one single moon.

Gendius V.title: Gendius V
Gendius V.lead: Gendius V was a world that occupied the fifth orbital position within the Gendius system, a part of the Mid Rim's Gendius sector.

Gerbaud 2.title: Gerbaud 2
Gerbaud 2.lead: Gerbaud 2 was a planet located in the Sepan system, a part of the Sepan sector in the Slice portion of the Expansion Region.

Gerhalt III.title: Gerhalt III
Gerhalt III.lead: Gerhalt III was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Altier sector, a part of the Slice portion of the Expansion Region. Gerhalt III was situated in the Gerhalt system, which was a part of the Galactic Republic by 17,000 BBY. From that year till 3996 BBY, a hyperlane connected the system to the Surron and Tarmidia systems; however, the hyperspace route had ceased to exist by 3960 BBY.

Gellefon.title: Gellefon
Gellefon.lead: Gellefon was a planet in the Korness system of the Outer Rim. It was the location of Kig Dannen Spaceport. It was a planet of cool, rocky crags, mountains, and crevasses. It was inhabited by Humans and other sapients as well as the indigenous, semi-sentient gellbeasts known as wardogs. The planet was ruled by Imperial Governor Schennt from his domicile in the center of Kig Dannen. Pinnacle Keep, an Imperial detention center, was also located on this planet.

Genon.title: Genon
Genon.lead: Genon was a planet not far from Imperial commercial centers but it was nearly devoid of settlement because of its most infamous inhabitant: Grappa the Hutt. Grappa used Genon as his base of operations, and his own reputation combined with his well-known connections to Black Sun kept the Empire and others at bay.

Gepparin.title: Gepparin
Gepparin.lead: Gepparin was a planet in the Gepparin system of the Shelsha sector. It was the headquarters of the BloodScar pirate gang, who had taken control of the large mining outpost on planet's surface during the Galactic Civil War, while the smaller farming outposts remained free. The base was attacked in 0.5 ABY by the Galactic Empire, and was completely destroyed.

Geraps Sule.title: Geraps Sule
Geraps Sule.lead: Geraps Sule was a gas giant–type planet with eleven moons that occupied the sixth orbital position around the star Abo. It was located within the Lehon system, a part of the Unknown Regions' area known as the Tempered Wastes.

Gendoraan.title: Gendoraan
Gendoraan.lead: Gendoraan was a planet in the Core Worlds. Imperial Security Bureau Agent Dal Rogos claimed to be a languages teacher from Gendoraan as part of his cover identity.

Gen'Dai homeworld.title: Gen'Dai homeworld/Legends
Gen'Dai homeworld.lead: This planet was the homeworld of the sentient Gen'Dai species. The planet was attacked by the Sith Empire at one point, with most of its native population killed in the fighting.

Gelemeade.title: Gelemeade
Gelemeade.lead: Gelemeade was a planet in the galaxy with at least four moons. During the Cold War, a routine scan of Gelemeade's fourth moon detected signs of simple organic life beneath its uninhabitable surface, and further investigation found a variety of exotic life underground.

Ghorman.title: Ghorman/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Ghorman.lead: Ghorman was a planet in the Sern sector of the Colonies region. It was the site of the infamous Ghorman Massacre. Fang Zar had a residence on the planet.

Gerrenthum.title: Gerrenthum/Legends

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories; Greater Javin, Western Reaches
facts.routes: Corellian Trade Spine, Lutrillian Cross, Nothoiin Corridor

Gerrenthum.lead: Gerrenthum was a planet along the Corellian Trade Spine and the capital of the Anoat sector.

Gerrard V.title: Gerrard V

facts.affiliation: Galactic Empire, Alliance to Restore the Republic

Gerrard V.lead: Gerrard V was a planet in the Core Worlds and the site of a battle during the Galactic Civil War.

Gevarno.title: Gevarno Cluster/Legends
Gevarno.lead: The Gevarno Cluster was a collection of star systems located in the Outer Rim Territories along the Gevarno Loop.

Gesaril.title: Gesaril
Gesaril.lead: Gesaril was a planet found in the Gesaril system of the Minos Cluster. During the Galactic Civil War the Empire had chosen to quarantine the world due to it being the site of a series of nine accidents concerning Imperial warships.

Gertafuu VI.title: Gertafuu VI
Gertafuu VI.lead: Gertafuu VI was a frigid astronomical object that occupied the sixth orbital position within the Gertafuu system of Wild Space. It was the site of Fort Balarad, a well-protected smuggler outpost. At some point, Fort Balarad's Aqualish and Whiphid inhabitants traded in furs and exotic meat.

Ghishi.title: Ghishi
Ghishi.lead: Ghishi was a planet located in the Ghishi system and was the homeworld of the Ghishi species.

Gettiarn.title: Gettiarn
Gettiarn.lead: Gettiarn was the ninth planet in the Iotran system. The Gettiarn Space Station orbited the planet and was operated by the Iotran Police Force. It served as the hub of space traffic control for the entire system.

Geriss.title: Geriss
Geriss.lead: Geriss was a planet that was located within the Geonosis system. It occupied that star system's first orbit.

Gestrex III.title: Gestrex III
Gestrex III.lead: Gestrex III was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Gestrex system, a part of the Calaron sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was connected to the Kegan and Norval systems via the hyperlane known as the Triellus Trade Route.

Geris VI.title: Geris VI
Geris VI.lead: Geris VI was a planet that occupied the sixth orbital position in the Geris system, a part of the Trans-Vulta sector in the Trans-Hydian portion of the Mid Rim. At some point, it became one of the first worlds to ban mercenaries of the Mandalorian warrior culture—particularly those hired by the planetary government—from drinking in local tapcafs. The Mandalorian drinking song Naasad'guur mhi – Mhi n'ulu dated from that ban.

Gestron.title: Gestron
Gestron.lead: Gestron was a planet in the Tennuutta sector of the Mid Rim.

Gerzob.title: Gerzob
Gerzob.lead: Gerzob was an astronomical object located in the Outer Rim Territories' Gerzob system. It was the homeworld of the creature known as the Yellow-Bellied Green-Proboscis Marsupial.

Geribun.title: Geribun
Geribun.lead: Geribun was the ninth planet orbiting the star Rek in the Guter Wade system. Located in the Trilon sector of the Outer Rim, it was a gas giant.

Geska Prime.title: Geska Prime
Geska Prime.lead: Geska Prime was a planet in the Lifh sector of the Mid Rim.

Ghaina.title: Ghaina
Ghaina.lead: Ghaina, a Core World, was one of the earliest settled colony worlds in the Galactic Republic. Remotely situated, it was not considered important to galactic society and produced only one Jedi: Taria Damsin.

Giaca.title: Giaca
Giaca.lead: Giaca was a lush, wild, world in the Unknown Regions, which was largely unspoiled by civilization. Although it was not a homeworld or colony for any particular species, it was not without intelligent inhabitants. Besides the numerous types of wild creatures in its dense forests and massive volcanic causeways, Giaca hosted a few scattered outposts of survey teams and criminal hideouts.

Geroon homeworld.title: Geroon
Geroon homeworld.lead: Geroon was the homeworld of the Geroon species. It was located in the Unknown Regions Geroon system. Around 27 BBY, it was attacked by the Vagaari species. While the Vagaari forces fought the Geroon defenders, the Chiss assault cruiser Springhawk arrived, retrieving one of the Vagaari gravity field generators used to prevent the Geroon's escape to hyperspace. The Chiss fled while the Vagaari captured the planet and its people, who they used as living shields in their warships.

Gesaral Beta.title: Gesaral Beta
Gesaral Beta.lead: Gesaral Beta was a planet in the Gesaral Beta system in the Gordian Reach, a sector of the Outer Rim Territories in grid square P-6 of the Standard Galactic Grid. According to Leo Leonis, it had rain so dangerous that it was capable of killing a human.

Glee Anselm.title: Glee Anselm/Legends

facts.terrain: Lakes, Patchy islands, Swamps, Seas, Tidal pools, Wetlands
facts.population: 100–500 million (25 ABY), 53% Anselmi, 45% Nautolan, 2% other species
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Glee Anselm.lead: Glee Anselm was a peaceful water planet in the Mid Rim. The planet's surface was largely covered in water or swamps, with only a few clear landmasses dotting its surface. The planet had very frequent season changes, causing it to be ravaged by intense storms with some of them turning cyclonic. The climate was moderate most of the standard year round.

Gillad.title: Gillad
Gillad.lead: Gillad was a planet in the Empress Teta system with one moon.

Giju.title: Giju/Legends

facts.routes: Giju Run, Hidakai Pool, Rimma Trade Route
facts.affiliation: Herglic Trade Empire, Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Galactic Federation of Free Alliances

Giju.lead: Giju was the Herglic homeworld. Located in the Colonies, it was on the Rimma Trade Route and was one endpoint of the Giju Run. Giju was an aquatic-type world with large bodies of water and associated terrain including: expansive oceans, islands, marshes, and glaciers. Giju had many spaceports and manufacturing centers.

Glova.title: Glova
Glova.lead: Glova was a semi-tropical planet in the Glova system colonized around 195 BBY. When its precious metals ran dry, its mines were abandoned, and the inhabitants turned to farming, becoming a leading supplier of food for planets in the region.

Glithnos.title: Glithnos
Glithnos.lead: Glithnos was a Galactic Republic planet represented in the Galactic Senate by Jannie Ha'Nook.

Glottal.title: Glottal
Glottal.lead: Glottal was a planet located within the Glottal system in the Baxel sector of the Outer Rim region of the galaxy. It was the Glottalphib homeworld. It was a hot and humid planet, making it a perfect habitat for the Glottalphibs.

Gigor.title: Gigor/Legends
Gigor.lead: species.]], Gigor was a cold, mountainous planet and the homeworld of the Gigoran species. The Gigorans evolved from group-oriented primates who lived in caves. As they developed intelligence, they took to living as hunter-gatherers while keeping their cavern homes. The species divided itself into home-clans made up of around 50 members who divided themselves into three to five family groups. There was no higher government than the home-clan on Gigor, each under the leadership of the most skillful hunter. The world was largely unsettled, and it had very little in the way of high-technology.

Gobindi.title: Gobindi
Gobindi.lead: Gobindi was an Outer Rim planet in the Noonian sector, with an Imperial bioweapons lab. Human siblings Zak and Tash Arranda visited the planet seeking medical aid after Zak contracted a stomach virus. Zak was taken to the hospital and treated. While Tash and her droid DV-9 went for a walk, they encountered a blob, unaware it was hostile until it lunged at them and almost crushed the droid. This was their first encounter with the blob, one of the experiments in Borborygmus Gog's Project Starscream.

Glade.title: Glade
Glade.lead: Glade was a planet in the Gordian Reach. It was a polluted industrial world plagued by acidic rains that rusted machinery within weeks.

Glauheim.title: Glauheim
Glauheim.lead: Glauheim was a gas giant that was orbited by three moons. It was the second planet in the Marcellus system, which resided in the Marcellus Nebula. Glauheim circled the yellow sun Marcellus. The gas giant, along with the rest of the its star system, was located in the Meerian sector of the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories.

Gilliana.title: Gilliana

facts.affiliation: House Cadriaan, Tapani Empire, Tapani Federation, Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Gilliana.lead: Gilliana was a planet in the Tapani sector's Gilliana system in the Cadriaan Province. Settlers from Gilliana colonized Aleron.

Gibbela.title: Gibbela
Gibbela.lead: Gibbela was a remote Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Atrivis sector. It was the homeworld of the shapeshifting Dazouri species, members of which engaged in simple farming on Gibbela.

Gilatter VIII.title: Gilatter VIII
Gilatter VIII.lead: Gilatter VIII or Gilatter Eight was a gas giant with red, yellow and orange gases and was close to Ansion.

Gipper.title: Gipper
Gipper.lead: Gipper was a planet, located in the Inner Rim. It had a submoon named Croyden which was known to have a very inefficient postal system.

Gizer.title: Gizer/Legends

facts.routes: Perlemian Trade Route, Vaathkree Trade Corridor

Gizer.lead: Gizer was a planet famed for the manufacturing of the Gizer L-6 freighter and gizer ale.

Gibad.title: Gibad/Legends
Gibad.lead: Gibad was one of the few planets that defied Emperor Palpatine shortly after the formation of the Galactic Empire. Home to parks and beautiful cities, the Gibadan Academy of Life Sciences was a well respected university in the Outer Rim.

Gligger.title: Gligger (disambiguation)
Gligger.lead: Gligger may refer to one of the following:

Ginn Jump.title: Ginn Jump/Legends
Ginn Jump.lead: The Ginn Jump was a part of the Arrowhead region, in the Slice portion of the Core Worlds. At some point between the collapse of the Infinite Empire around 25,200 BBY and the foundation of the Galactic Republic in 25,053 BBY, a Duros hyperspatial physicist romantically—yet relatively inaccurately—proclaimed the Ginn Jump and the star systems of Coruscant, Corellia, and Alderaan—which had long been inhabited by Humans—as the four "vertices" of a region of space that resembled a tetrahedron and was thus accordingly named the Tetrahedron.

Giddea.title: Giddea
Giddea.lead: Giddea was a planet in the galaxy whose sun died during the Cold War. Bioanalysts managed to harvest specimens from the world before it became permanently shrouded in darkness.

Gilvaanen.title: Gilvaanen
Gilvaanen.lead: Gilvaanen was a backwater planet located in the Gilvaanen system in the Inner Rim Territories. Prior to the Galactic Civil War, Gilvaanen housed production facilities for Imperial stormtrooper armor. When Count Denetrius Vidian and Grand Moff Wilhuff Tarkin discovered and prevented an insurgence in the facilities, Vidian placed the production chain under the direction of Lieutenant Everi Chalis.

Goluud Minor.title: Goluud Minor
Goluud Minor.lead: Goluud Minor was a mining world located within the Goluud Minor system of the Core Worlds. By 5000 BBY, a new mining colony had been established on the planet, and merchant lord Ssk Kahorr sent the drone ship Zeta Five to deliver much-needed mining technology and equipment to the colony and sell them to the wealthiest miners. However, the Zeta Five never arrived at Goluud Minor, as it was destroyed by a solar flare from the unstable red supergiant star Primus Goluud during a stopover in the Primus Goluud system.

Golkus.title: Golkus
Golkus.lead: Golkus was a planet between Carratos and Coruscant. Akanah Norand Goss Pell stopped there to get false identification papers from Talon Karrde's organization before she first met Luke Skywalker on Coruscant.

Goelitz.title: Goelitz
Goelitz.lead: Goelitz was a rival of nearby Ylix. The planet became embroiled in a war with its neighbor that lasted for a number of years. Goelitz and Ylix both used underhand tactics in the conflict, with either side employing increasingly vicious acts of barbarism and terrorism to outdo the other. The local Imperial Moff promised to bring a peaceful end to the civil war, but this vow went unfulfilled.

Godsspire.title: Godsspire
Godsspire.lead: Godsspire was an asteroid belt in the Muunilinst system.

Gonmore.title: Gonmore
Gonmore.lead: Gonmore was a Mid Rim planet located in the Irishi sector and on the Entralla Route hyperlane. At one point a part of the New Republic, by 22 ABY it hosted a sector clearinghouse for the smuggling organization led by Talon Karrde. That year, the smuggler Jerf Huxley unsuccessfully attempted to force Karrde's former second-in-command, Mara Jade Skywalker, to arrange for a large sum of money to be transferred to him from the Gonmore clearinghouse as severance pay for Karrde ending the employment of Huxley and his own smuggling group.

Golm.title: Golm
Golm.lead: Golm, also known as Bothawui Prime, was a planet in the Both system. A purple gas giant, it was the fourth planet in the star system and was orbited by 23 moons, as well as an asteroid belt.

Goravas.title: Goravas
Goravas.lead: Goravas was the second planet in the Kuat system.

Goratak III.title: Goratak III
Goratak III.lead: Goratak III was a planet in the Goratak system covered in crystalline wilderness known as the Crystal Forests. It was the site of a messy conflict between Rebel and Imperial forces.

Gorbah.title: Gorbah/Legends
Gorbah.lead: Gorbah was a planet and the location of four secret fighter bases under control of a rogue group attempting to take out invading Imperial forces. When they realized there was no hope in beating the Empire, they fled their bases immediately.

Gormen.title: Gormen (disambiguation)
Gormen.lead: Gormen may refer to one of the following:

Golh.title: Golh
Golh.lead: Golh was a planet located within the Golh system of the Outer Rim Territories. An aquatic planet, it was owned by Hydrospeare Corporation, who used Golh as a test site for its aquatic projects, commonly aquatic weapons and military vehicles.

Golm asteroid belt.title: Golm asteroid belt
Golm asteroid belt.lead: An asteroid belt surrounded the Mid Rim planet of Golm, also known as Bothawui Prime.

Gondagali.title: Gondagali
Gondagali.lead: Gondagali was the first planet attacked with the MS-19 shield buster, during the time of the New Republic.

Gorno.title: Gorno
Gorno.lead: Gorno was a planet in the Outer Rim, along the Corellian Run near Tatooine. The Galactic Empire had a secret research facility used to design the superlaser for the second Death Star, codenamed Hammertong. A spaceport there was used as an embarkation point from which the Hammertong was to depart, shortly before the Battle of Yavin.

Goettar.title: Goettar
Goettar.lead: Goettar was a barren rock with no atmosphere, located in the Honoghr system.

Gologry.title: Gologry
Gologry.lead: Gologry was the third planet orbiting the star Julevia in the Julevian system. Located in the Dalonbian sector of the Outer Rim Territories, it was an airless rock.

Gorobei.title: Gorobei/Legends
Gorobei.lead: Gorobei was a planet located in the Inner Rim's Gorobei system. It was the homeworld of the sentient humanoid Frenk species, including the bounty hunters Rumi Paramita and Twazzi.

Gorlan.title: Gorlan
Gorlan.lead: Gorlan was the second planet of Gorsh system in Wild Space. It was a searing desert with one moon.

Gorm.title: Gorm

facts.region: Wild Space (c. 12,000 BBY–11,000 BBY), Outer Rim Territories, New Territories

Gorm.lead: Gorm was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Meerian sector. Located on the Galactic Frontier by 4000 BBY, it was the homeworld of the venomous reptiles known as gorm-worms, which were exported across the galaxy. Around 3643 BBY, an individual visited the ancient Gorm Academy in order to study its secrets.

Gon Tiek.title: Gon Tiek
Gon Tiek.lead: Gon Tiek was a world located within the Gon Tiek system, a part of the Atravis sector in the Western Reaches portion of the Outer Rim Territories. At some point after the establishment of the Galactic Empire in 19 BBY, the 501st Legion, an elite Imperial stormtrooper unit, fought on Gon Tiek.

Gossam.title: Gossam/Legends
Gossam.lead: Gossams were a small saurian species native to the planet Castell in the Colonies region of the galaxy, with colonies on the Outer Rim worlds of Felucia and Saleucami. Averaging slightly over one meter in height, Gossams had wrinkled skin, with narrowing, shriveled heads on elongated necks. Physical appearance was considered important in Gossam society, and females often curved their hair up from the back of their heads. They were bipeds, balancing their frail bodies on small feet, and had long three-fingered hands. The average lifespan of a Gossam was about seventy-five years.

Gorsh.title: Gorsh
Gorsh.lead: Gorsh was the third planet of the Gorsh system, located in Wild Space 100,000 light years away from the Core. The watery planet had a population of 100,000.

Goroth Prime.title: Goroth Prime/Legends
Goroth Prime.lead: Goroth Prime, also simply known as Goroth, was the Gorothite homeworld, located on the border with the Mid Rim. The Aqualish knew this world under the name Celleballen, which meant "wasteland."

Gotida.title: Gotida
Gotida.lead: Gotida was a celestial body located in the Goti system within the Slice portion of the Inner Rim. It was the site of the settlement known as Jalor City as well as its suburbs.

Granna.title: Granna
Granna.lead: Granna was the Grannan homeworld, controlled by the Galactic Empire.

Gosfambling.title: Gosfambling

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Gosfambling.lead: Gosfambling was a planet in the Mid Rim, and was the homeworld of the Gosfamblings. C-Gosf represented the world in the New Republic Senate.

Gra Ploven.title: Gra Ploven
Gra Ploven.lead: Gra Ploven was a planet in the Colonies.

Gortis.title: Gortis
Gortis.lead: Gortis was the fifth planet in the Kuat system.

Gottlegoob.title: Gottlegoob
Gottlegoob.lead: Gottlegoob was a planet in the New Republic. During the Presidency of Leia Organa Solo, its people suffered from famine.

Gowdawl.title: Gowdawl
Gowdawl.lead: Gowdawl was a planet to which the Koqus liner Star Morning, fully loaded with passengers, was headed from Motexx. The ship never arrived, rather appearing at Arat Fraca empty of passengers 300 days later.

Gortamni.title: Gortamni
Gortamni.lead: Gortamni was the icy sixth planet in the Wild Space's Gorsh system.

Grakouine.title: Grakouine
Grakouine.lead: Grakouine was a world on which an Alliance to Restore the Republic storage depot was located. It was here that Boba Fett's ship Slave I was impounded by the New Republic after he was presumed killed by the Sarlacc on Tatooine. Sometime after escaping the Sarlacc, he made his way to Grakouine and recovered Slave I.

Graal'diin.title: Graal'diin
Graal'diin.lead: Graal'diin was a planet under the control of the Galactic Empire. Brenn and Dellis Tantor were told that their father died in a Rebel attack while delivering grain to the planet, but that was in fact a lie designed to cover the fact that the Empire had had him executed for losing his cargo to pirates. The Empire wished to make an example of him to ensure that other freighter pilots would go to great lengths to protect their cargo.

Graador.title: Graador
Graador.lead: Graador was a Mid Rim planet that featured caverns large enough to fit entire fleets of starships in them. The caverns were home to both immense exogorths and mynocks that could survive in the planet's atmosphere. Graador was also inhabited by two sentient species: the agrarian Graadorians and a mutated type of intelligent mynocks.

Grandeel.title: Grandeel (disambiguation)
Grandeel.lead: Grandeel may refer to one of the following:

Gorta.title: Gorta
Gorta.lead: Gorta was the first planet of Gorsh system in Wild Space. It was a desolate searing rock.

Grall.title: Grall
Grall.lead: Grall was a planet located in the Joralla system, a part of the Mektrun sector in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim. Grall occupied the second orbital position around its sun, the red giant–type star Jaska, and had no moons. The planet had a poisonous atmosphere and a temperate climate, and was considered to be commercially worthless.

Gorse.title: Gorse
Gorse.lead: Gorse was a tidally-locked planet located on the Inner Rim. It had one moon called Cynda, which was rich in thorilide crystals. During the Age of the Empire, Gorse had seemingly exhausted its thorilide reserves and had become a major refinery for thorilide exports from Cynda, which had been opened up to thorilide mining. Gorse served as the location of a conflict between the Galactic Empire and a small rebel cell led by Hera Syndulla and the former Jedi Padawan Kanan Jarrus.

Graf-World.title: Graf-World
Graf-World.lead: "Graf-World" was the nickname of an uncharted swamp planet located in the galaxy's Wild Space region. It was discovered by Auric and Rhyssa Graf, who were arrested by Captain Visler Aqorian Korda III of the Imperial Navy, who claimed it for the Galactic Empire.

Grange.title: Grange
Grange.lead: Grange was an agrarian planet located in the Kurost sector of the Mid Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of Galen Erso, who drew the attention of Republic Futures Program scouts in Grange's sector. During the Clone Wars, Grange was a strategically-important world, being well situated for hyperspace jump points to remote sectors. As such, it was besieged by the Confederacy of Independent Systems in 21 BBY.

Gromas.title: Gromas/Legends
Gromas.lead: Gromas was a gas giant located in the Gromas system, within the Perkell sector of the Mid Rim. Gromas was only notable for its 32 multicolored moons, including the "Blood Moon," Gromas 16. Its moons were the primary source of phrik. And-Yees, a Gran assassin, was known to have visited Gromas before being captured by Jango Fett at Outland Transit Station.

Grizmallt.title: Grizmallt/Legends

facts.region: Core Worlds, Northern Dependencies, The Slice, Arrowhead
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Alsakan, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Grizmallt.lead: Grizmallt was a planet in the Core Worlds inhabited by Humans called the Grizmallti. Queen Elsinoré den Tasia began her reign of Grizmallt around 3950 BBY, launching an era of exploration and colonization. Although many of the expeditions failed, Grizmallti colonists populated various planets around the galaxy, including eight in the Renatasia system and the planet Nam Chorios. Around 3900 BBY, Grizmallt was engulfed in a civil war, and Tasia sponsored a final expedition of refugees that resulted in the Human colonization of the planet Naboo.

Grastes.title: Grastes
Grastes.lead: Grastes was the second planet from the star Solis Axum in the Axum system.

Gravlex Med.title: Gravlex Med/Legends

facts.terrain: Modern:, Polluted wastelands, Mountains, Caves, Historically:, Savannas, Mountains, Caves
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Pentastar Alignment, Imperial Remnant, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Gravlex Med.lead: Gravlex Med was a terrestrial planet in the Outer Rim Territories. With an above-average gravity, the planet's native species, the Anx, had a stooped stature and other species found the world uninhabitable. Gravlex Med quickly became the heart of Anx Space as the spacefaring species expanded their borders throughout the Raioballo sector. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, Gravlex Med became so polluted by Imperial mismanagement of waste that the world no longer proved suitable for habitation.

Gree.title: Gree/Legends
Gree.lead: Gree was a planet located within the Gree Enclave, a small region in the Veragi sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of the Gree species, a race of six-tentacled cephalopods who, despite having an advanced form of technology, allowed their society to fall into ruin when they began prizing an individual's mastery of their advanced devices over improving them or creating new ones.

Guiteica.title: Guiteica/Legends
Guiteica.lead: Kadok III-D, commonly known as Guiteica, was a harsh planet located in Wild Space's Kadok Regions. It featured forests, mountains, glaciers, and huge waterfalls. The planet possessed rich reserves of metal ores and minerals such as feldspar, yttrium, and Bal'ta'ran crystals. Guiteica was inhabited by creatures such as j'kuutak and roggwart. It was also the homeworld of the Bitthævrians, a warlike yet isolationist sentient species. The sixteen primary continents of Guiteica were each governed by a separate military force, which made up the planetary defense force known as the Guiteica Militia.

Gravan Seven.title: Gravan Seven
Gravan Seven.lead: Gravan Seven was a volcanic planet in the Inner Rim. Its volcanoes polluted the skies, making them hard to navigate. Warlord Zsinj's forces ambushed Talon Squadron there, killing all in the New Republic training squadron, except for the squadron commander, Lieutenant Myn Donos, and his astromech droid Shiner.

Greawyn Belt.title: Greawyn Belt
Greawyn Belt.lead: The Graewyn Belt was the outermost of two asteroid belts in the Saurton system. The belt lay outside the orbit of Essowyn.

Gruvia.title: Gruvia
Gruvia.lead: Gruvia was a planet in the Expansion Region. It was the homeworld of the Gruvian species, whom exported Gruvian Tovash. The planet was part of the Empire.

Gromas Belt.title: Gromas Belt
Gromas Belt.lead: The Gromas Belt was an asteroid belt located in the Gromas system, within the Perkell sector of the galaxy's Mid Rim, in orbit of the star Gromas. In the year 0 ABY, mercenary Kyle Katarn and Rebel operative Jan Ors traveled through the Gromas Belt aboard their starship, the Moldy Crow, while en route to the moon Gromas 16.

Grella.title: Grella
Grella.lead: Grella was a planet located in the Tapani sector's Grella system.

Greyman's Planet.title: Greyman's Planet
Greyman's Planet.lead: Greyman's Planet was an industrialized Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Wazta sector. It was controlled by the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War, and at one point the Rebel Alliance executed a mission to transport supplies from it to the Alliance's outpost on the planet Karinda. As part of the mission, a team of Rebel agents, posing as employees of a front company, were able to retrieve the impounded supplies from Da'Harrin Spaceport on Greyman's Planet and, after a shootout with an Imperial patrol, their light freighter departed the planet's star system.

Gryyyl asteroid belt.title: Gryyyl asteroid belt

facts.region: Mid Rim, Kashyyyk Region, The Slice
facts.routes: Durkteel Loop, Great Kashyyyk Branch, Nightroad, Randon Run

Gryyyl asteroid belt.lead: The Gryyyl asteroid belt was an asteroid field within the Kashyyyk system located between the planets Kashyyyk and Trandosha.

Grillis.title: Grillis
Grillis.lead: Grillis was an asteroid belt located between Korbin and Abatrang in the Atrig system. It was mined by Cross-Galactic Mining.

Gryphon.title: Gryphon
Gryphon.lead: Gryphon was a mountainous planet located in the Inner Rim, where war among its clans had long been a way of life. During the rise of the Galactic Empire, the native Brock Lar had been the highest-ranking warrior in his clan, but after the death of his youngest son, he realized that there was no hope for peace. Around 0 BBY, he chose to escape the clutches of death and seek out a peaceful world where his family could begin a new life. The people of Alderaan listened to Brock’s story and welcomed his family with open arms.

Greater Marianas.title: Greater Marianas
Greater Marianas.lead: Greater Marianas was a small dust-swept planet in the Outer Rim Territories subjugated by the Galactic Empire some time before the Battle of Yavin. It contained at least one settlement of Humans and was also home to the yaggie, a creature hunted for its skin and meat.

Grathus.title: Grathus
Grathus.lead: Grathus was a terrestrial planet located in the Grathus system, a part of the Jospro sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The planet featured several large mud basin settlements, including one which contained a tavern owned by Xig Rollem.

Groth.title: Groth
Groth.lead: Groth was a terrestrial world located in the Groth system, a part of the Bootana Hutta area in the Hutt Space portion of the Slice. Hyperlanes linked it to the Kor Desilijic, Kor Gejalli, and Saki system. At one point, Groth served as a throneworld of one of the clans of the Hutt species, but eventually it became a resort where Hutts spent their time gambling and watching gladiatorial fights.

Gree Baaker.title: Gree Baaker
Gree Baaker.lead: Gree Baaker was a planet in the Gree Baaker system of the Outer Rim's Atrivis sector. Under the Galactic Empire, it was home to the Gree Baaker Labor Camp. Many of the camp's prisoners were transferred to work detail on the Death Star, and later perished with its destruction in 0 ABY.

Griwstrick.title: Griwstrick
Griwstrick.lead: Griwstrick was an unaligned terrestrial planet featuring patches of bamboos. It was situated in the Unknown Regions' Griwstrick system and constituted a part of the Rakatan Archipelago, a fragmented group of planets colonized by tribes of the Rakata species after the collapse of the Rakatan Infinite Empire around 25,200 BBY.

Gyndine.title: Gyndine/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Hutt Cartel, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire, Galactic Federation of Free Alliances …

Gyndine.lead: Gyndine was a planet in the Expansion Region. It was a local administrative center, and had mid-sized, advanced shipyards.

H'ratth.title: H'ratth

facts.terrain: Plains, Lush forests, Rock pinnacles, Deserts

H'ratth.lead: H'ratth was a lush planet with a Jedi Academy where Jedi Master Chamma taught Andur Sunrider the Jedi ways in 4001 BBY. It was the homeworld of Vima Sunrider. The academy was known for its training of Jedi healers.

Haariden.title: Haariden
Haariden.lead: Haariden was a volcanic world and the lava crab homeworld. It was orbited by a sole moon, which appeared pink from the planet's surface.

Gulma.title: Gulma
Gulma.lead: Gulma was a planet located within the Gulma system in Wild Space and was the homeworld of the Gulmarid species. The planet was covered by swampy terrain.

Haashimut.title: Haashimut
Haashimut.lead: Haashimut was an Outer Rim planet. It was a Republic fortress world colonized c. 24,000 BBY from which the Jedi kept a watchful eye on the hostile Tion Cluster from their stronghold there.

Gyosha.title: Gyosha
Gyosha.lead: Gyosha was an Imperial resort world in the Galactic Core. Wilek Nereus had hoped to be appointed Governor of Gyosha, but got stuck on Bakura instead. OrulShai III was a moon of Gyosha.

Haffrin.title: Haffrin
Haffrin.lead: Haffrin was a planet in the Haffrin system of the Esstran sector in the Outer Rim. Built millennia ago, a Shrine of Kooroo was fabricated on the planet using native stone.

Gumbus.title: Gumbus

facts.routes: Commenor Run, Hydian Way, Brentaal–Denon Route, Corsin Run, Perlemian Trade Route

Gumbus.lead: Gumbus was the fifth and largest planet in the Brentaal system. It was a gas giant orbited by sixteen moons.

Habassa II.title: Habassa II/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Empire, Alliance to Restore the Republic

Habassa II.lead: Habassa II, also known as Habassa, was a planet in the Habassa system of the Mid Rim. It was the Habassa homeworld.

Had Abbadon.title: Had Abbadon
Had Abbadon.lead: Had Abbadon was an ancient lost mythic planet, located in the Deep Core. According to some legends, the planet may have been linked to the origin of the Jedi Order or its forerunners.

Gymelo.title: Gymelo
Gymelo.lead: Gymelo was an astronomical object located within the Gymelo system, a part of the Bakura sector within the Outer Rim Territories and Wild Space.

Gwar.title: Gwar
Gwar.lead: Gwar was a planet that was orbited by the the platform Supply Base. In 4 ABY, Gwar was the site of a battle during the Zaarin insurrection.

Gwori.title: Gwori

facts.affiliation: Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Pentastar Alignment

Gwori.lead: Gwori was a planet located in the Clacis sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

H'ken.title: H'ken
H'ken.lead: H'ken was the primary planet in the H'ken system. Located within the H'ken asteroid belt, a 20 kilometer wide navigational nightmare, the planet was difficult to access.

Habon.title: Habon
Habon.lead: Habon was a gas giant in the Geonosis system.

Gyo.title: Gyo
Gyo.lead: Gyo was a gas giant in the Ottega system in the Mid Rim.

Hadlress.title: Hadlress
Hadlress.lead: Hadlress was an astronomical object located in the Hadlress system, a part of the Trailing Sectors portion of the Inner Rim. Jasis Temm, the owner and Chief Executive Officer of the company Hadlress Defense Systems, Limited, was based on Hadlress. At some point between 2 BBY and 2 ABY, Temm sold his company for 4.6 billion credits and eventually became a bounty hunter.

Gulvitch.title: Gulvitch
Gulvitch.lead: Gulvitch was a mining world located in the Gulvitch system. It was situated in the Loop Worlds area of the Gordian Reach sector within the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The hyperlane known as the Junction-Tierell Loop connected it to the Arkuda and Bronsoon systems.

Gurrisalia.title: Gurrisalia (disambiguation)
Gurrisalia.lead: Gurrisalia may refer to one of the following:

Haaridin.title: Haaridin
Haaridin.lead: Haaridin was a world located in the Kwymar sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Handooine.title: Handooine/Legends

facts.region: Kiirium Reaches (25,120 BBY–25,096 BBY), Outer Rim Territories, The Slice

Handooine.lead: Handooine was an Outer Rim Territories planet located on the Triellus Trade Route as part of the Phelleem sector. Known as Gwynhes during the reign of the conqueror Xim twenty millennia before the Battle of Yavin, by the time of the Clone Wars, Handooine was a sparsely populated world. During that conflict, the Galactic Republic used Handooine as a staging area for its upcoming military campaign on the nearby planet Jabiim. Separatist agents also introduced a computer virus onto the Republic's prototype Tector-class Star Destroyer Gibbon at Handooine at some point during the war.

Halm.title: Halm
Halm.lead: Halm was an arid desert world in the Mid Rim, famous for its extensive mines. These mines contained rare Adegan crystals, which were used in the construction of lightsabers.

Hakassi.title: Hakassi

facts.affiliation: Galactic Empire, Federated Teradoc Union, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Hakassi.lead: Hakassi was a planet located in the Deep Core.

Halbara.title: Halbara/Legends

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Metharian Nebula Territories

Halbara.lead: Halbara was a planet in the Elrood sector. It was known for its monsoons and hairstyles. The planet was owned by Radell Mining.

Halowan.title: Halowan

facts.terrain: Industrial (including Holowan Laboratories), Barren desert, Mountains

Halowan.lead: Halowan was a barren planet in the Fakir sector of the Bakchou arm. It was the location of Holowan Laboratories, the creators of the IG-series droids.

Haldeen.title: Haldeen
Haldeen.lead: Haldeen was a terrestrial planet located in the Haldeen system of the Colonies' Haldeen sector. It was one of the sector's primary worlds. When Earnst Kamiel, the leader of the terrorist organization the Justice Action Network, was captured on the Outer Rim Territories planet Elrood by 1 ABY, he was extradited to Haldeen, where he was sentenced to death by a court of the Galactic Empire.

Halmad.title: Halmad/Legends
Halmad.lead: Halmad was a planet in Quelii sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Hanofar.title: Hanofar
Hanofar.lead: Hanofar was a terrestrial world located in the Hanofar system, a part of the Southern Core portion of the Colonies. During the early years of the Galactic Civil War, a conflict fought between the Galactic Empire and the Rebel Alliance, Hanofar was held by the Empire.

Halpat.title: Halpat
Halpat.lead: Halpat was a planet in the Core Worlds, not far from the Koornacht Cluster. It was the New Republic supply depot for the New Republic Fifth Battle Group's blockade of the Cluster. Etahn A'baht did not consider it close enough to the Cluster.

Hallrin IV.title: Hallrin IV
Hallrin IV.lead: Hallrin IV was an Expansion Region world in the Hallrin system. The Stratis Games, including the Multi-Sentient Unarmed Combat Rounds, were held on Hallrin IV. Clyngunn represented the ZeHethbra in these Rounds.

Hanchin.title: Hanchin

facts.sector: Zuma sector, Inner Zuma Region, Moddell sector, Inner Moddell systems

Hanchin.lead: Hanchin was a planet in the Outer Rim's Moddell sector. It was orbited by Qina.

Hali.title: Hali
Hali.lead: Hali was a temperate planet in the Expansion Region with three suns and at least two moons. It was the homeworld of Marit Dice.

Hallitron-7.title: Hallitron-7/Legends
Hallitron-7.lead: Hallitron-7 was an Imperial planet in the Mid Rim.

Halco.title: Halco
Halco.lead: Halco was the third planet of the Bestine system located in the Inner Rim Territories. It had two moons and, along with Bestine IV, was one of the two terrestrial worlds in the star system.

Hanod.title: Hanod
Hanod.lead: Hanod was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Hanod system, a part of the Corva sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories. At some point by 38 ABY, military bunkers on Hanod were identified by letters from the ancient Common Sith writing system, a fact which was noted by the xenolinguist Doctor Milanda Vorgan in her publication "The Written Word: A Brief Introduction to the Writing Systems of Galactic Basic."

Hakara.title: Hakara/Legends
Hakara.lead: Hakara was a swamp planet native to the insectoid Hakaranss. Hakara was previously believed to be uninhabited by the Galactic Republic.

Halthor.title: Halthor
Halthor.lead: Halthor was a planet invaded by the Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders under the command of Dorjander Kace during the Mandalorian Wars at the Battle of Halthor.

Hallion.title: Hallion
Hallion.lead: Hallion was a planet located in the Sith Worlds of the Outer Rim. The planet featured lava fields that produced obsidian, and decorative spheres made of polished obsidian from the lava fields were prized for their dark luster. Hallion struggled during the transition from a private enterprise to adjust to the imperial economy of the Sith Empire.

Haidoral Prime.title: Haidoral Prime
Haidoral Prime.lead: Haidoral Prime, or simply Haidoral, was a backwater planet located in the Kastolar sector of the Mid Rim Territories and the Slice regions. It was governed by the Galactic Empire by the time of the Galactic Civil War, and Everi Chalis, an emissary to the Imperial Ruling Council, was appointed governor of the world as punishment after Emperor Palpatine blamed her and other Imperial higher-ups for the loss of the Death Star superweapon.

Halcyon.title: Halcyon

facts.affiliation: Chandrila Star Line, Hutt Clan, Galactic Empire

Halcyon.lead: The Halcyon was a Corellian passenger MPO-1400 Purgill-class star cruiser operated by Chandrila Star Line.

Hapes.title: Hapes/Legends

facts.affiliation: Lorell Raiders, Hapes Consortium, Galactic Federation of Free Alliances, Jedi Coalition

Hapes.lead: Hapes was the homeworld of the Hapans, a near-Human race known for their beauty, and the administrative capital of the Hapes Consortium. Surrounded by shimmering nebulae, and with seven moons in the sky after sunset, Hapes never knew the darkness of true night, and the Hapan people had relatively poor night-vision.

Harrin.title: Harrin/Legends

facts.routes: Corellian Trade Spine, Harrin Trade Corridor
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Corellian Hegemony, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire

Harrin.lead: Harrin was a planet located in the Inner Rim sector of the same name. It was situated on the Corellian Trade Spine super-hyperroute and served as the endpoint of the Harrin Trade Corridor hyperlane.

Harloen.title: Harloen

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, New Territories, Trans-Hydian

Harloen.lead: Harloen was a planet located in the Harloen system of the Outer Rim Territories' Belsmuth sector. It was situated on the Hydian Way super-hyperroute, which served as the dividing line between the New Territories and the Trans-Hydian region and which connected it to the Botajef system and the Crombach Nebula as well as the Bandomeer system of the Meerian sector.

Hargeeva.title: Hargeeva
Hargeeva.lead: Hargeeva was an Expansion Region world, the third of five planets in the Pelonat system located near Garen IV. Its local day was 23 standard hours long, while its year was 380 local days long. It was colonized in 2000 BBY, but was neglected. Its society evolved to a feudal state. Nobles sent their sons to serve in the local royal guard for military training.

Harix.title: Harix
Harix.lead: Harix was a planet in the Colonies that was a strong center of Rebel activity during the Galactic Civil War. In 1 ABY, Imperial Major Stafuv Rahz captured a Harix schoolteacher and a number of children to serve as bait for Rebel leaders. However, Rebels Luke Skywalker and Han Solo led a rescue mission that saved them before fleeing the planet.

Hathrox III.title: Hathrox III
Hathrox III.lead: Hathrox III was an urban planet in the Hathrox system. Its civilization was destroyed in a biochemical civil war in about 1196 BBY. The planet was quarantined by the New Republic. All attempts by scouts to study the planet resulted in their deaths, as well as the deaths of the rescue team that came after them, and the quarantine staff that came after them.

Hast.title: Hast
Hast.lead: Hast was a planet in Wild Space of the galaxy. It was the site of a secret New Republic shipyard that came under Imperial attack.

Harrod's Planet.title: Harrod's Planet
Harrod's Planet.lead: Harrod's Planet was an Outer Rim Territories world located in the Oplovis sector. During the Galactic Civil War, the base of the Oplovis Sector Fleet of the Galactic Empire was located on the planet's surface. When the Sector Fleet was defeated by the Rebel Alliance in the Yuvern system, it regrouped at Harrod's Planet. The smuggler Cane Adiss, whose starship was being inspected by Imperial officers at the time of the attack, was also forced to rendezvous with the fleet there.

Hasaq.title: Hasaq (disambiguation)
Hasaq.lead: Hasaq may refer to one of the following:

Harrandarr.title: Harrandarr
Harrandarr.lead: Harrandarr was a planet located in the Harrandarr system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Bosph sector. It was the homeworld of the sentient Buzchub species. Und'l, a Buzchub who worked for Galactic Empire sympathizers on the Expansion Region astronomical object Roldalna shortly after the establishment of the New Republic in 4 ABY, hailed from Harrandarr.

Haurgab.title: Haurgab
Haurgab.lead: Haurgab was a planet in the Mid Rim that allied itself with the Separatists during the Clone Wars. The Galactic Republic sent Omega Squad to the planet, who battled the local forces in the Battle of Haurgab.

Har Binande.title: Har Binande
Har Binande.lead: Har Binande was the primary planet in the Har system. Invaded by the Lahag Erli during the early years of the Galactic Republic, their forces occupied the planet for many years until they were finally deposed. They left in their wake cities of exquisite architecture on many of the Har worlds. These cities would become profitable as tourist attractions, erasing memory of the occupation.

Harbin-re.title: Harbin-re
Harbin-re.lead: Harbin-re was a planet located in the Harbin-re system of the Inner Rim. It was famous for productions of operas from the Neoclassical period, including several compositions favored by the Galactic Emperor Palpatine. On the date 35:10:16, the Harbin-re opera was mentioned in an Imperial HoloVision news report.

Harterra.title: Harterra (disambiguation)
Harterra.lead: Harterra may refer to one of the following:

Harugi Spill.title: Harugi Spill
Harugi Spill.lead: Harugi Spill was an asteroid belt in the Ottega system in the Mid Rim.

Hapor.title: Hapor
Hapor.lead: Hapor was a terrestrial planet that was located in the Inner Rim's Hapor system and featured the Griren Province. In 0 ABY, the Hand of Judgment, a group of five Galactic Empire stormtrooper deserters, participated in a minor water dispute in the province.

Harswee.title: Harswee
Harswee.lead: Harswee was an Outer Rim Territories celestial body located in the Mandalore sector. The Mandalorian ruler known as Mandalore the Binder hailed from Harswee, and carpets from its looms were used to decorate the Mandalorian starship Coronet.

Harcourt's outpost.title: Harcourt's outpost
Harcourt's outpost.lead: A remote outpost administrated by former-Captain Aron Harcourt was controlled by the Galactic Empire in 0 ABY.

Harloff Minor.title: Harloff Minor
Harloff Minor.lead: Harloff Minor was a planet in the Harloff Minor system of the Core Worlds, near Coruscant. The heavily-traveled world, with its large equatorial cities, was considered a center of commerce and culture in the galaxy.

Helska IV.title: Helska IV
Helska IV.lead: Helska IV, also called Helska 4, Helska Four, or simply Helska, was the fourth planet in the Helska system, located in Dalonbian sector in the Outer Rim Territories.

Haverling.title: Haverling
Haverling.lead: Haverling was a planet in the Albarrio sector of the Outer Rim Territories, near the world of Morishim. It joined the New Republic, aiding the government by providing new shipyards to support the New Republic Navy.

Havricus.title: Havricus
Havricus.lead: Havricus was a world located in the Havricus system of the Colonies. It was situated on the super-hyperroute known as the Corellian Run, which served as the dividing line between the regions known as the Slice and the Southern Core and linked it to the Pencael system as well as the Inner Rim's Iseno system.

Hefi.title: Hefi
Hefi.lead: Hefi was a planet located in the Hefi system of the Abrion sector, within the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. Covered by landmasses and oceans, Hefi's surface featured varied climates and was capable of supporting various forms of humanoid life.

Heffrin.title: Heffrin
Heffrin.lead: Heffrin was a planet located in the Arkanis sector of the Outer Rim. This mountainous world was a small mining colony maintained by the Galactic Empire. The planet held important ruins from a vanished civilization, including the Heffrin Aqueducts, which spanned Heffrin's continents; research during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire identified the Aqueducts' builders as early Ithorian explorers.

Havath Prime.title: Havath Prime
Havath Prime.lead: Havath Prime was the fourth planet in the Muunilinst system, a part of the Obtrexta sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was a gas giant orbited by thirty-two moons, itself circling the star Muunilinst. The entirety of the Muunilinst system was located along the hyperlane known as the Braxant Run.

Havath Minor.title: Havath Minor
Havath Minor.lead: Havath Minor was the fifth planet in the Muunilinst system. It was a gas giant inferior in size to Havath Prime and was orbited by 11 moons.

Hellios.title: Hellios system/Legends
Hellios.lead: The Hellios system was a star system located in the Tapani sector's Barnaba Province, between the Garobi system and the Mennaalii system. House Barnaba had holdings in the system during the Galactic Empire's reign.

Helska 1.title: Helska 1
Helska 1.lead: Helska 1 was the first planet in the Helska system.

Helska 2.title: Helska 2
Helska 2.lead: Helska 2 was the second planet in the Helska system.

Helska 3.title: Helska 3
Helska 3.lead: Helska 3 was the third planet in the Helska system.

Helska 5.title: Helska 5
Helska 5.lead: Helska 5 was the fifth planet in the Helska system. It was a gas giant.

Helska 6.title: Helska 6
Helska 6.lead: Helska 6 was the sixth planet in the Helska system.

Helska 7.title: Helska 7
Helska 7.lead: Helska 7 was the seventh planet in the Helska system.

Helix IX.title: Helix IX
Helix IX.lead: Helix IX was a planet whose native species were methane-breathers.

Hazzard.title: Hazzard
Hazzard.lead: Hazzard was a planet located within the Lahara sector of the Outer Rim that was the homeworld of Boo Rawl.

Helisk.title: Helisk
Helisk.lead: Helisk was one of three habitable worlds in the Sabrixin system.

Heloan Yagen.title: Heloan Yagen
Heloan Yagen.lead: Heloan Yagen was the wife of Bovo Yagen. The fifth planet in the Bovo Yagen system was named after her.

Hays Minor.title: Hays Minor
Hays Minor.lead: Hays Minor was a planet in the Otomok system that was the homeworld of Rose and Paige Tico. Prior to the pair joining the Resistance, the First Order used the world to test weapons after stripping it of its Haysian smelt and also stole children to become stormtroopers. After the First Order's arrival, the once quiet and unspoiled planet became dark and polluted.

Helska.title: Helska system
Helska.lead: The Helska system was a star system located in the Outer Rim Territories and New Territories, within the Dalonbian sector. It was situated in grid square L-2 on the Standard Galactic Grid.

Hensara III.title: Hensara III
Hensara III.lead: Hensara III, also known simply as Hensara, was a planet in the Colonies. The New Republic's stolen Imperial Customs Frigate Battle of Yavin was sunk in a deep lake on this planet to hide it from an Imperial patrol. The Eridain and Rogue Squadron retrieved the ship's crew and defeated the Empire in the Rout of Hensara.

Hemei IV.title: Hemei IV
Hemei IV.lead: Hemei IV was a wealthy Core Worlds planet that was the origin point of the Cosmic Balance religion. The Bakur Mining Corporation also originated there, and its Cosmic Balance–practicing executive officers believed that the world's affluence was disruptive. To remedy that state, the Corporation eventually led the settlement of the Wild Space planet Bakura. By more than a century later, the Cosmic Balance had ceased to be practiced on Hemei IV.

Herzob.title: Herzob
Herzob.lead: Herzob was an agriworld in the Colonies. It exported grains to several worlds in the Galactic Core and Mid Rim. The planet was infested with jevesects, which tore through the planet-spanning farms.

Herdessa.title: Herdessa/Legends

facts.region: Mid Rim, The Slice, Trailing Sectors
facts.affiliation: Sith Empire (Great Sith War), Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Alliance of Free Planets, New Republic

Herdessa.lead: Herdessa was a planet located in the Mid Rim on the Corellian Run. A peaceful world, many diplomats and others of affluence could remain neutral in debates. It was represented in the Galactic Senate by Shea Sadashassa.

Hern.title: Hern

facts.region: Core Worlds, Ringali Shell, The Slice, Arrowhead

Hern.lead: Hern was the innermost planet in the Rhinnal system. It was a molten rock, uninhabitable for life.

Herios IV.title: Herios IV
Herios IV.lead: Herios IV was a jungle planet located within the Outer Rim Territories' Herios sector. At some point during the Galactic Civil War, a group of slavers brought the Barabel Baraduk to the planet's Imperial colony, but the Barabel escaped into the jungle, stealing several weapons from the settlement. After a prolonged hunt for Baraduk failed to result in his capture, the colony's governor granted the Barabel amnesty in return for the fugitive's departure from the planet.

Herstell V.title: Herstell V
Herstell V.lead: Herstell V was a terrestrial astronomical object situated in the Herstell system of the Colonies. It hosted the headquarters of the "Red & Black League," a criminal organization that was active during the Galactic Civil War and was named after the colors of the Herstell system's Herstellic currency.

Hettsk.title: Hettsk
Hettsk.lead: Hettsk was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Belsmuth sector. In 9 ABY, the confederation of the Galactic Empire's forces led by Grand Admiral Thrawn was victorious over the New Republic in a large-scale battle fought on Hettsk. During the battle, two New Republic pilots were shot down over the planet, and after an Imperial recon team had retrieved them from an area of jungle, the New Republic Katarn Commandos special forces unit rescued the pilots.

Hewett.title: Hewett
Hewett.lead: The Hewett were a non-humanoid, sentient species from the Hewett system. At one point, an official banquet was held for Hewett senators, at which Konkeel pie was served on the menu. The pie was toxic to humanoids, and the Jedi Master Qui-Gon Jinn almost ate some before his contemporary Adi Gallia stopped him.

Hethar.title: Hethar

facts.affiliation: Galactic Empire, Pentastar Alignment, Imperial Remnant

Hethar.lead: Hethar was a forested planet located in the Outer Rim Territories' Atrivis sector. It was the homeworld of the omnivores known as gornts, whose meat was a staple in the diet of the local colonists. Shortly before the Battle of Yavin, the Galactic Empire annexed the planet and instituted a gornt breeding and processing program, wherein Sullustan ranchers provided gornt meat as supplies for the Imperial Navy.

Heptalia.title: Heptalia
Heptalia.lead: Heptalia was a planet located in the Heptalia system, a part of the Trailing Sectors portion of the Inner Rim. Heptalia's artisans produced furniture coverings and embroidered rugs that were considered to be exquisite and lent renown to the planet.

Hettig.title: Hettig
Hettig.lead: Hettig was the sixth planet orbiting the star Rek in the Guter Wade system. Located in the Trilon sector of the Outer Rim, it was a gas giant.

Hestria.title: Hestria
Hestria.lead: Hestria was a Mid Rim agriworld located in the Senex sector. It was known for the wines produced there. Around 3643 BBY, the government of Hestria shut down its secret police force that had been attempting to influence the governments of all the planets of the Hestria system.

Heterkus.title: Heterkus
Heterkus.lead: Heterkus was a planet in the Heterkus system, located in the Tharin sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Around 0 BBY, the Galactic Empire's Commander Westen of the Relentless clashed with Adar Tallon and the Rebel Alliance at Heterkus.

Hermos.title: Hermos
Hermos.lead: Hermos was an astronomical object located in the Hermos system, a part of the Spadja sector in the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It had at least one spaceport. At some point during the Galactic Civil War, the group of pirates led by Yesgar, who had a hideout on the Esstran sector celestial body Antared III, were spotted in Hermos's spaceport.

Hidden Tegoor.title: Hidden Tegoor
Hidden Tegoor.lead: Hidden Tegoor was a planet located in the Albanin sector of the Outer Rim.

Hettitite.title: Hettitite
Hettitite.lead: Hettitite was a planet that was located within the star system of the same name, a part of the Dalonbian sector in the Outer Rim Territories region of the galaxy. It was the homeworld of a sentient Near-Human species that had pale skin, white hair, and red eyes.

Hevurion.title: Hevurion
Hevurion.lead: Hevurion was an member world of the New Republic about thirty years after the Battle of Endor. Located in the Hevurion system in the Inner Rim Territories, it was situated along the Hydian Way southwest of Bogden. Erudo Ro-Kiintor was the senior senator from Hevurion to the Galactic Senate but used his position to collude with the First Order. The snowtrooper commander TX-8080 hailed from Hevurion.

Hendrix.title: Hendrix
Hendrix.lead: Hendrix was a world located in the Iska sector of the Mid Rim. Prior to the Battle of Hoth, Han Solo planned to run weapons from Minoth to Hendrix for the Rebel Alliance.

Hjaff.title: Hjaff
Hjaff.lead: Hjaff was a planet located in the Colonies. It was the homeworld of the Tarc, a isolationist species of sentient crustacean creatures. Hjaff had three continents.

Hirsi.title: Hirsi

facts.terrain: Lakes, Rivers, Shores and landmasses, Streams
facts.language: Qwohog, Qwohog sign language, Galactic Basic Standard
facts.affiliation: Galactic Empire, Alliance to Restore the Republic, Alliance of Free Planets, New Republic

Hirsi.lead: Hirsi was a planet on the Cerean Reach in the Mid Rim.

Hishyim.title: Hishyim

facts.affiliation: Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire

Hishyim.lead: Hishyim was a planet covered by a vast desert, located in the Abrion sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Hijarna.title: Hijarna
Hijarna.lead: Hijarna was a planet that was located near or in Orus sector, within the Inner Rim of the galaxy. The planet was once part of the Rakatan Infinite Empire, and was discovered by the Fifth Alderaanian Expedition, which also discovered the one thousand-year old remains of an ancient civilization. The civilization had fallen to alien invaders. Their last stronghold was the Fortress of Hijarna, made of what was dubbed Hijarna stone, similar to the Hand of Thrawn on Nirauan. The Fortress was used as a rendezvous by Talon Karrde's organization.

High Chunah.title: High Chunah

facts.sector: Greater Javin, Javin sector, Mugaari Space

High Chunah.lead: High Chunah was a planet on the Corellian Trade Spine in the Javin sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Once an outlying colony world of the Mugaari species, High Chunah became a profitable speeder-manufacturing planet once the Galactic Republic capitalized on the region's economic potential. High Chunah was best known for the phosphorescent rocks littering its surface, which gave the planet an unusual green glow when seen from space.

Hintivan II.title: Hintivan II
Hintivan II.lead: Hintivan II was a cold, heavily forested world that occupied the second orbital position in the Hintivan system, a part of the Corva sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was home to large trees.

Hirin.title: Hirin
Hirin.lead: Hirin, also known as OM814, was a barren rock planet with two moons. It occupied the fourth and outermost orbit around the red giant star Thrantin Major in the Thrantin OM81-A system, a part of the Ollonir Boundaries in the Negs portion of the Colonies.

Hikil.title: Hikil
Hikil.lead: Hikil was a tropical planet from which lulari trees were exported.

Hitaka.title: Hitaka
Hitaka.lead: Hitaka was a farming planet located in the Cademimu sector of the Outer Rim Territories, with a lush landscape of forests and mountains.

Hijado.title: Hijado

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, New Territories, Trans-Hydian

Hijado.lead: Hijado was a planet on the Hydian Way, halfway to Bonadan. The Human natives of Hijado were called Hijadoans. It was located in the Hijado system of the Thesme sector.

Hino-111.title: Hino-111
Hino-111.lead: Hino-111 was a planet and a member of the Galactic Republic.

Hiffis.title: Hiffis
Hiffis.lead: Hiffis was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Hiffis system, a part of the Jjannex sector in the Western Reaches portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the site of a lightly guarded warehouse of the Galactic Empire that was used to store outdated heavy equipment, including a large fleet of mostly well-maintained Ultra-Light Assault Vehicle (ULAV) landspeeders.

Hinakuu.title: Hinakuu
Hinakuu.lead: Hinakuu was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Hinakuu system, a part of the Calamari sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The hyperlane known as the Tidal Circuit connected it to the Krinemonen and Sanctuary systems. Hinakuu was settled by members of the Mon Calamari species of the Calamari system expanding outward from their homeworld, the planet Dac, aboard Mon Calamari starliners between 4400 BBY and 4200 BBY.

Hilak.title: Hilak
Hilak.lead: Hilak was a planet within the Rakatan Archipelago of the Unknown Regions of the galaxy. Following the collapse of the Infinite Empire, it was mostly inhabited by barbarous tribes of Rakata.

Hijo.title: Hijo
Hijo.lead: Hijo was an astronomical object located in the Hijoian system, a part of the Expansion Region's Hijoian Space. By 12 ABY, it fell within the territory controlled by the New Republic.

Hleua.title: Hleua
Hleua.lead: Hleua was an astronomical object located in the Hleua system, a part of the Eucer sector of the Mid Rim. During the Tionese War, waged between the Galactic Republic and the Honorable Union of Desevro & Tion, the Republic-settled celestial body Okator VIII was regularly visited by courier starships on business errands from Hleua.

Hinari.title: Hinari
Hinari.lead: Hinari was planet located in the Outer Rim Territories and the New Territories' Thesme sector, within the Hinari system. It was situated in grid square O-6 of the Standard Galactic Grid. In the months following the Battle of Endor in 4 ABY, New Republic pilot Wedge Antilles visited the world, hoping to locate hidden pockets of Imperial forces. However, he was unsuccessful and eventually opted to continue his search by traveling to the Outer Rim planet Akiva.

Hirara.title: Hirara
Hirara.lead: Hirara was a small, inhabitable planet located in the Five Points system of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. There were guesses that rebels had set up a base on the planet.

Hissrich.title: Hissrich
Hissrich.lead: Hissrich was a jungle planet located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. During the early stages of the Clone Wars, the Confederacy of Independent Systems attempted to establish footholds in the Outer Rim before they moved towards the galactic capital; Hissrich, where many vessels were sent, was one such site. Jedi Master Mace Windu was tasked by the Jedi High Council with traveling to Hissrich and determining what the Separatists' purpose was.

Hilo.title: Hilo

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Grand Army of the Republic, Galactic Empire, Recovery Strike Team

Hilo.lead: Clone Lieutenant Hilo was a clone commando who served in the Galactic Empire as part of Clone Commander Wolffe's Recovery Strike Team. A human clone of Jango Fett who had once served the Galactic Republic, Hilo participated in a battle on the B'Omarr Order Monastery against the Clone Underground movement during or after 18 BBY.

Hok.title: Hok/Legends

facts.affiliation: Infinite Empire, Galactic Republic, Trade Federation, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Galactic Alliance

Hok.lead: Hok was a planet located in the Colonies. The planet was split into two sides. One side was the desert wasteland that looked like Tatooine, while the other half was surrounded by pure darkness. This area also had a rich supply of crystals on which the people mined and traded.

Honoghr.title: Honoghr/Legends

facts.affiliation: Infinite Empire, Hutt Empire, Brotherhood of Darkness, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire, Galactic Federation of Free Alliances

Honoghr.lead: Honoghr was the homeworld of the Noghri, and the only one of the Honoghr system's seven planets with a permanent population.

Horuz.title: Horuz
Horuz.lead: Horuz was a planet located in the Horuz system in the Atrivis sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Horuz was what the Partisans considered a "dark planet," meaning it was a seemingly insignificant planet that experienced communication blackouts and much higher protocols than normal. In 7 BBY, Jyn Erso was sent on a mission to Horuz to assassinate the Imperial scientist Dorin Bell, who was eventually killed by land mines. Shortly before the Battle of Scarif, Imperial forces were deployed to Horuz.

Horob.title: Horob

facts.affiliation: Alliance to Restore the Republic, Galactic Empire

Horob.lead: Horob was a planet with an Rebel Alliance research lab discovered by the Galactic Empire. The planet was taken by the Victory-class Star Destroyer Imperial Hazard.

Hollast VII.title: Hollast VII
Hollast VII.lead: Hollast VII, or Hollast Seven, also known as Hollastin Seven, was a planet in Hutt Space.

Horska.title: Horska
Horska.lead: Horska was a planet in the Colonies. It was location of a HoloNet relay station.

Hoppawui.title: Hoppawui
Hoppawui.lead: Hoppawui was a barren planet in the Both system.

Horticar.title: Horticar
Horticar.lead: Horticar was the fifth planet in the Utos system. It was a gas giant orbited by 11 moons.

Hordon Cal.title: Hordon Cal
Hordon Cal.lead: Hordon Cal was a hot ball of rock located in the Thanta Zilbra system of the Outer Rim Territories, orbited by a small moon. Both were destroyed during the Starbuster Plot by the Sacorrian Triad.

Horn Station.title: Horn Station
Horn Station.lead: Horn Station was a backwater world in the Lahara sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was neglected by the Galactic Republic until a Jedi Knight, nicknamed "Pinky," liberated the planet from Shoto Eyefire, a Defel crime lord and blastfighter. Horn Station was the homeworld of a species of hulking, green-skinned, reptilian humanoids.

Homon.title: Homon/Legends
Homon.lead: Homon was a Mid Rim planet located in the Homon sector. While the Galactic Empire was carrying out an offensive in Homon's vicinity during the Galactic Civil War, the Rebel Alliance Chief of Sector Command suggested during a meeting of the Alliance High Command that the Rebel starfighter base at Homon could be stripped to form a fighter wing for a planned assault on an Imperial base over the planet Mantooine.

Holageus.title: Holageus
Holageus.lead: Holageus was a planet in the Expansion Region.

Holador.title: Holador
Holador.lead: Holador was a remote planet. It had a crashed colony of Squibs living on it.

Holess.title: Holess
Holess.lead: Holess was a planet in the Galactic Federation of Free Alliances and the Holessian homeworld. It had more laws than any other world. Its capital city was the location of the Mount of Justice. Most of the population lived in towering cities built with the wealth derived from thousands of years of exporting the planet's rich local deposits of duranium.

Hosko.title: Hosko
Hosko.lead: Hosko was a verdant agricultural world located in Hutt Space on the Pabol Hutta hyperspace route, not far from Nal Hutta. It was orbited by a space station frequented by traders and smugglers.

Hollastin.title: Hollastin/Legends
Hollastin.lead: Hollastin was a busy Hutt Space trade world. At one point, the smuggler Han Solo experienced an instance of good fortune there. Hollastin emerged unscathed from the Yuuzhan Vong invasion of Hutt Space and subsequently rose in importance.

Hol Simo.title: Hol Simo
Hol Simo.lead: Hol Simo was an extra-galactic gas giant orbiting the star Nagi Prime in the Nagi system, which was located in a dense star cluster. The planet was located in the satellite galaxy Companion Besh, which was officially classified by the Galactic Empire as part of the Unknown Regions. Hol Simo occupied the first orbital position in its star system and had two moons.

Hol Kinto.title: Hol Kinto
Hol Kinto.lead: Hol Kinto was the fifth and outermost planet of the extra-galactic Nagi system. It was located in a dense star cluster within the satellite galaxy Companion Besh that the Galactic Empire classified as part of the Unknown Regions. It was a gas giant that had five moons and orbited the star Nagi Prime.

Horos.title: Horos
Horos.lead: Horos was a celestial body that was located in the Horos system, a part of the Lambda sector in the Slice portion of the Mid Rim. It shared its name with the hyperlane known as the Horos Spine. During the Andoan Wars—fought from 57 BBY to 39 BBY between the Spiverelda, the group of worlds colonized by the Aqualish species and being under the influence of Ando, the Aqualish homeworld, and the fifteen Aqualish-settled planets known as the Andoan Free Colonies—the forces of the Spiverelda defeated those of the Free Colonies at a confrontation at Horos.

Horthav.title: Horthav
Horthav.lead: Horthav was a planet located in the Kuat sector of the Core Worlds.

Hoth.title: Hoth/Legends

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories; Greater Javin, Western Reaches
facts.terrain: Canyons, Frozen plains, Ice caves, Mountain ranges, Tundras
facts.population: 32% ice scrabblers, 23% tauntauns, 11% wampas, 34% other, Unknown amount of Skels
facts.affiliation: Infinite Empire, Sith Empire, Alliance to Restore the Republic, Galactic Empire

Hoth.lead: Hoth was the sixth planet of the remote Hoth system. A desolate world covered with ice and snow, located in the Anoat sector, a rarely-traveled portion of the Outer Rim Territories, it became famous as the one-time location of the Alliance to Restore the Republic's Echo Base during the Galactic Civil War. The base was discovered by the Empire in 3 ABY, precipitating the Battle of Hoth, a major engagement during which the Rebels suffered heavy casualties and lost Echo Base.

Hosrel XI.title: Hosrel XI
Hosrel XI.lead: Hosrel XI was a planet in the Hosrel system of the Centrality, located in the Outer Rim Territories. The planet was an almost barren rock.

Hoth asteroid field.title: Hoth asteroid field/Legends
Hoth asteroid field.lead: The Hoth asteroid field, also known as the Anoat Asteroid Belt and Hoth Asteroid Belt, was an extensive, wildly erratic asteroid belt in the isolated Hoth and Anoat systems in the Outer Rim Territories. Forged as the resulting effect of a collision between two rocky planets eons prior to the Galactic Civil War, the belt was rich in untapped mineral resources such as metal ore, a magnet for mining prospectors hoping to make a fortune.

Anoat Belt.title: Hoth asteroid field/Legends
Anoat Belt.lead: The Hoth asteroid field, also known as the Anoat Asteroid Belt and Hoth Asteroid Belt, was an extensive, wildly erratic asteroid belt in the isolated Hoth and Anoat systems in the Outer Rim Territories. Forged as the resulting effect of a collision between two rocky planets eons prior to the Galactic Civil War, the belt was rich in untapped mineral resources such as metal ore, a magnet for mining prospectors hoping to make a fortune.

Huk.title: Huk/Legends
Huk.lead: Huk was the home planet of the Yam'rii species, also known as the Huk (a Kaleesh slur translating as "soulless bug"). The planet was mostly covered with dense forests.

Hraki.title: Hraki
Hraki.lead: Hraki was a planet in the Vorzyd Cluster of the Outer Rim.

Houche.title: Houche
Houche.lead: Houche was a planet in the Zuma sector, which surrounded the Moddell sector. Houche was an endpoint of the Annaj-Houche Run.

Houll.title: Houll
Houll.lead: Houll was a terrestrial planet located in the Deep Core's Beshqek system before the planet Byss was destroyed. It occupied the seventh orbital position around the star Beshqek and had five moons. Houll featured a frigid climate and a rocky surface.

Hoth asteroid belt.title: Hoth asteroid field
Hoth asteroid belt.lead: The Hoth asteroid field, also known as the Hoth asteroid belt or Anoat Asteroid Belt, was an asteroid field overlapping the boundaries of the Hoth and Anoat systems near the planet Hoth.

Hrasskis.title: Hrasskis
Hrasskis.lead: Hrasskis was a planet located in the Hrasskis system of the Expansion Region. It was the homeworld of the Hrasskis species.

Hoszh Iszhir.title: Hoszh Iszhir
Hoszh Iszhir.lead: Hoszh Iszhir was a desert planet in the Core Worlds and was the homeworld of the reptilian Gektl species. Half of Hoszh Iszhir was covered in waterless deserts, while the other half was shrouded in a poisonous atmosphere. There were rich lodes of guerrerite on planet, forcing the Gektl to build planetary defenses. It wasn't until Major Stafuv Rahz traded the shield codes to the Galactic Empire which then subjugated Hoszh Iszhir.

Huldamun.title: Huldamun
