Huldamun.lead: Huldamun was a relatively prosperous industrial planet located in the Huldamun system, a part of the Arkanis sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was situated on the Vaschean Way hyperlane, which linked it to the Arkanis and Vasch systems. Huldamun was a part of the informal grouping of planets known as the Regency Worlds, and it chiefly exported mining equipment.

Hota.title: Hota
Hota.lead: Hota was the sixth planet orbiting the star Bright Jewel in the Bright Jewel system. Located in the Bright Jewel sector of the Mid Rim, it was a gas giant.

Hsyr.title: Hsyr
Hsyr.lead: Hsyr was the fifth planet orbiting the star Teth in the Teth system. Located in the Baxel sector of the Outer Rim Territories, it was a gas giant.

Hrill.title: Hrill
Hrill.lead: Hrill was a planet reputed to be peaceful, quiet, and dull. In 15 BBY, the merchant Mungo Baobab was assigned a mission to Hrill by the Merchant Council of his homeworld, Manda. Nevertheless, Baobab ignored the order and ventured off in search of the Roon system and its fabled Roonstones. He brought the droids R2-D2 and C-3PO with him.

Hoylin.title: Hoylin
Hoylin.lead: Hoylin was a world located in the Hoylin system, a part of the Fei Hu sector in the Slice portion of the Mid Rim. It was situated on the Gamor Run hyperlane, which connected it to the Aikhibba and Beris systems.

Hrthging.title: Hrthging
Hrthging.lead: Hrthging was a planet in the Hrthging system of Mandalore sector in the Outer Rim. It was home to the Hrthgingian Firegem. It became part of Mandalorian Space.

Hosnian Prime.title: Hosnian Prime

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Hosnian Prime.lead: Hosnian Prime was a planet in the Hosnian system of the Core Worlds, located along the Corellian Trade Spine. By 28 ABY, it served as the capital of the New Republic and the headquarters of the New Republic Senate.

Hosra.title: Hosra

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Greater Javin, Western Reaches

Hosra.lead: Hosra was an agrarian planet and the fourth planet of the Burnin Konn system in the Anoat sector. It had no mineral wealth or any major fuel sources.

Hosnian.title: Hosnian
Hosnian.lead: Hosnian was a planet located in the Hosnian system, in the Core region of the galaxy. The system, including Hosnian, was destroyed by the First Order in 34 ABY.

Hoven.title: Hoven
Hoven.lead: Hoven was an astronomical object located in the Inner Rim.

Hypori.title: Hypori/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Trade Federation, Baktoid Armor Workshop, Techno Union, Order of the Sith Lords, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Zann Consortium

Hypori.lead: Hypori was a planet located in the Hypori system of the Ferra sector in the Outer Rim Territories. It was home to no sentient species, though it was host to windrails and massiffs. Its surface was covered in rocky landscapes and small oceans.

Humbarine.title: Humbarine/Legends
Humbarine.lead: Humbarine was a Core Worlds city-planet and one of the founding members of the Galactic Republic, having been originally settled by Humans from the planet Kuat. During the Tionese War of 24,000 BBY–23,900 BBY Humbarine was the site of a Galactic Republic shipyard. A bank was located on the planet decades prior to the Clone Wars, and the world was home to the military officer Barrow Oicunn and Republic Senator Bana Breemu of the Humbarine sector. During the Clone Wars, Humbarine was repeatedly attacked by the Confederacy of Independent Systems, with Oicunn's family perishing in the process.

Hyabb.title: Hyabb
Hyabb.lead: Hyabb was a planet in the Core Worlds' Krenher sector. It lay on the Hyabb-Twith Corridor hyperlane, which connected it to the planet Twith. Hyabb and Twith were engaged in a continuous war lasting nearly since the foundation of the Galactic Republic and were both members of the Republic by 17,000 BBY. During the Alsakan Conflicts, Hyabb remained loyal to the world of Coruscant in its struggle against the planet Alsakan, with which Twith had allied itself.

Hutlar.title: Hutlar
Hutlar.lead: Hutlar was a small, chilly world located in the Mid Rim's Senex sector. Orbiting a red dwarf star, it was the homeworld of the sentient Hutlarians. They served the aristocratic Ancient Houses of the Senex-Juvex region in various roles until 553 BBY, when their home was liberated from the nobles' control.

Hurikane.title: Hurikane
Hurikane.lead: Hurikane was a planet located in Wild Space. It was inhabited by a species of sentient beings made of stone and purple Hurrikaine crystals, who were almost insectoid in appearance.

Hurcha.title: Hurcha
Hurcha.lead: Hurcha was the eighth planet from the single star of the Churba system. Because of its cold climate and distance from the sun, it was regarded as having no civilized purpose.

Ibanjji.title: Ibanjji
Ibanjji.lead: Ibanjji was a terrestrial world located in the Ibanjji system, a part of the Mieru'kar sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The conditions on Ibanjji were harsh, and it was home to packs of creatures known as varns. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, it was the site of a special motivational camp used to harden Imperial recruits.

Iceberg IV.title: Iceberg Four
Iceberg IV.lead: Iceberg Four was the eighth planet in the Calamari system and also the farthest from its sun. It was used as a Galactic Alliance staging area during the Defense of Mon Calamari.

Hyperion.title: Hyperion
Hyperion.lead: The Hyperion was a Ton-Falk-class escort carrier that was part of Task Force Vengeance during the Galactic Civil War.

Hyder.title: Hyder
Hyder.lead: Hyder was a planet. The New Republic agent Trask Lucan was born there

Hyomare.title: Hyomare
Hyomare.lead: Hyomare was the seventh planet of the Bestine system located in the Inner Rim Territories. Hyomare was one of the three gas giants in the star system and had ten moons.

Hynah.title: Hynah

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, New Territories, Trans-Hydian

Hynah.lead: Hynah was an industrial world located in the Kalamith sector of the Outer Rim Territories, on the Hydian Way hyperlane. It was home to the Hynese, a cosmopolitan population of various different species. Prior to the evacuation of the Rebel Alliance's Yavin system base, Rebel scouts charted an escape hyperlane leading from the Feswe Corridor star system to Hynah.

Hultomo.title: Hultomo
Hultomo.lead: Hultomo was the second planet of the Garnib system. It was an ice world, orbited by two moons.

Huloon.title: Huloon/Legends
Huloon.lead: The Huloons were a pliant, sentient species long enslaved by the Hutts. Their homeworld, Huloon, was a part of Hutt Space and was forcibly depopulated and converted into a nature preserve by the Hutts, resulting in the near extinction of the species. The Huloons then spread to nearby systems in order to escape their planet's fate. Some Huloons attempted to return every so often, simply trying to see their lost planet, only to be intercepted and tortured for entertainment by the Hutts.

Hypotria.title: Hypotria
Hypotria.lead: Hypotria was a Mid Rim planet situated in the Bortele sector. During the Galactic Civil War, a deep-cover Rebel Alliance operative and their astromech droid, R2z-DL, were posted on Hypotria, where the latter, posing as a maintenance droid, was stealing valuable data off starships arriving for repairs and then placing it in the memory banks of Rebel Alliance vessels.

Huro.title: Huro
Huro.lead: Huro was a planet in the Huro system within the Ciutric sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Trever Flume stopped at an exclusive florist on Coruscant who sold exotic blooms and bought a small plant with vibrant yellow leaves native to the planet Huro. It was the cheapest option they had.

Huulia.title: Huulia/Legends
Huulia.lead: Huulia was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Colonies' Huulia system. It was the origin point of a starfighter whose exhaust nacelle by 32 BBY had ended up in the possession of the junk dealer Watto on the Outer Rim Territories planet Tatooine. The Human male Kit Valent grew up as a roughneck spaceport kid on Huulia. As a teenager, he traveled the galaxy by hiring on to freighters and transports, and by 3 ABY he had joined the offworld Rebel Alliance.

Ianane III.title: Ianane III
Ianane III.lead: Ianane III was a Wild Space planet whose surface was completely covered by a deep layer of sand. The planet had violent storms in its atmosphere, and the brightness of its surface for a long time caused it to be misidentified as a star. Ianane III was orbited by the ruins of the Ianane Ring, believed to be constructed by the long-disappeared Celestials.

Ibaar.title: Ibaar
Ibaar.lead: Ibaar was a mountainous, rocky, and temperate planet located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories that fell under Imperial control in the years prior to the Battle of Yavin. The Empire created a blockade around the planet that cut off vital supplies from the Ibaarian people. An underground network of Ibaarians was assisted by the Rebellion which delivered the needed supplies to Ibaar. Despite this, Ibaar continued to suffer under Imperial sanctions well into the Galactic Civil War due to its suspected Rebel sympathies.

Iakar.title: Iakar
Iakar.lead: Iakar, also known as Iakaru, was a jungle planet and the homeworld of the Iakaru species. It was located in the Iakar system in the Rseik sector of the Outer Rim Territories. During the Clone Wars companies such as the Chiewab, Fabreth Medical, and Merisee Prime set up research installations on the planet which drove the Iakaru deeper into the jungle. When the Empire rose to power, it brought a full scale seizure and occupation of Iakar. The goal of the occupation was to get medical supplies for the Empire's expanding war machine.

Ichium.title: Ichium
Ichium.lead: Ichium was a barren planet in the Axum system.

Iego.title: Iego/Legends

facts.population: 4,500 castaways; unknown number Maelibi and Diathim, 40% Humans, 60% other species
facts.affiliation: Xim's Empire, Smugglers, Iego council, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Black Sun, Galactic Empire, Galactic Alliance Remnant

Iego.lead: Iego, named the Planet of a Thousand Moons, was a planet located in the Extrictarium Nebula in the Outer Rim Territories. Due to the obscurity of the Nebula, Iego did not appear on any star-charts. Iego did not orbit a sun; rather, it was warmed by local stellar gases. It was home to the subterranean Maelibi species, as well as thousands of stranded spacefarers who had been lured to the planet by the Diathim—a spaceworthy species that resided on Iego's forty-two moons. Although Iego appeared to have no noteworthy natural resources, the concepts of aging and hunger somehow eluded its residents.

Iktotch.title: Iktotch/Legends

facts.affiliation: Kwa holdings, Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Iktotch.lead: Iktotch was the homeworld of the Iktotchi. It was the third moon of Iktotchon.

Ichtor.title: Ichtor 8
Ichtor.lead: Ichtor 8 was a planet in the Ichtor system that was the site on an Imperial resort for wealthy Humans. The planet was very icy and also had abundant natural resources. The planet also contained a ski resort on Mount Quavaar. The stohl creature, a popular guard pet, was native to Ichtor 8. The species was first discovered by Imperial scouts. Hunters were soon enamored of the inquisitive creatures, and the creatures were exported at a high price. Holovid star Shantee Ree made attack stohls fashionable.

Ichtor 8.title: Ichtor 8
Ichtor 8.lead: Ichtor 8 was a planet in the Ichtor system that was the site on an Imperial resort for wealthy Humans. The planet was very icy and also had abundant natural resources. The planet also contained a ski resort on Mount Quavaar. The stohl creature, a popular guard pet, was native to Ichtor 8. The species was first discovered by Imperial scouts. Hunters were soon enamored of the inquisitive creatures, and the creatures were exported at a high price. Holovid star Shantee Ree made attack stohls fashionable.

Ieria.title: Ieria
Ieria.lead: Ieria was a planet in the Andaran system in the Core Worlds. It rivaled the wealthier planet Andara in production capability, but received nowhere near the income. The Ierians did not enjoy indirect senatorial representation through Andara, and attempted an attack on Andara in 26 BBY.

Illodia.title: Illodia

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Illodia.lead: Illodia was the sector capital of Illodia sector and home to the Illodian culture of Humans. The Illodians colonized 20 planets in Illodia sector.

Ifmix VI.title: Ifmix VI
Ifmix VI.lead: Ifmix VI was a planet in the Colonies. It was known for its terrible windstorms, tornadoes, and Squalris merchants. It was located near the Perlemian Trade Route.

Illarreen.title: Illarreen
Illarreen.lead: Illarreen was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Herios sector. It was the homeworld of the sentient Poss'Nomin species, who originally evolved on the planet's island continent Vhin. After climate change transformed their habitat into a wasteland, the Poss'Nomin expanded across their homeworld's surface, over time forming powerful nations that ultimately fought a global war.

Ilimardon.title: Ilimardon
Ilimardon.lead: Ilimardon was a planet located in the Mid Rim's Nicandra sector. It was governed by the Regal Hierarchy, which maintained a wildlife division and a fleet of starships. When the Regal Hierarchy became interested in the use of domesticated mynocks as weapons against starships, it employed the Human Gres Ople, former mynock trainer of the Trandoshan pirate Chorssk's organization, to train a new flock of the creatures. By 12 ABY, Ilimardon was a member of the New Republic.

Ijol.title: Ijol

facts.region: Inner Rim, Northern Dependencies, The Slice

Ijol.lead: Ijol was the fourth planet that orbited Tirahnn, the Tirahnn system's sun. The planet, along with the rest of its system, was situated in the Inner Rim's Zeemacht Cluster along the Perlemian Trade Route, which served as the dividing line between the Northern Dependencies and the Slice. By 17,000 BBY, Ijol's system also resided along a hyperspace route, that linked it to the Filordis and Ktil systems, that ceased to exist by 3976 BBY. Ijol was a gas giant with twenty-four moons.

Iktotchon.title: Iktotchon/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Iktotchon.lead: Iktotchon was a rocky planet in the Iktotch system. Its moons included Iktotch.

Iceberg III.title: Iceberg Three

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Alliance

Iceberg III.lead: Iceberg Three, or Iceberg III, was a comet captured in the seventh orbit of Daca.

Iceberg I.title: Iceberg One
Iceberg I.lead: Iceberg One was an icy planetoid in the Calamari system. It had one moon and was the third planet in the system.

Iceberg II.title: Iceberg Two
Iceberg II.lead: Iceberg Two was the fourth planet orbiting the star Daca in the Calamari system. Located in the Calamari sector of the Outer Rim Territories, it was an ice ball.

Ilos.title: Ilos
Ilos.lead: Ilos was a bland agricultural world dotted with cities. It was located within the Ilos system of the galaxy's Hutt Space region and lay on the hyperlane called the Pabol Sleheyron, which connected it to the planets of Chalacta and Ilos Minor.

Ilos Minor.title: Ilos Minor
Ilos Minor.lead: Ilos Minor was a planet that was located within the Ilos Minor system of the galaxy's Hutt Space region and lay on the hyperlane called the Pabol Sleheyron, which connected it to the planets of Ilos and Nar Kreeta. Another hyperspace route called the Ilosian Spur linked Ilos Minor to the world of Tal Nami. Ilos Minor was colonized by the sentient Ilosian species and served as a transfer point for foodstuffs and raw materials from the planets of the Ilosian Spur.

Ilamna.title: Ilamna
Ilamna.lead: Ilamna was an astronomical object located in the star system of the same name, which was a part of the Eucer sector of the Mid Rim. The celestial body was situated in the region known as the Divide during the Tionese War, fought between the Galactic Republic and the Honorable Union of Desevro & Tion. During that time, Ilamna had been settled by Republic colonists.

Iloh.title: Iloh
Iloh.lead: Iloh was a tropical terrestrial planet in the Iloh system of the Inner Rim Territories covered in archipelagos and oceans, offering tourists and locals thousands of beaches. Notably, it was the homeworld of Imperial officer turned Rebel pilot Kendy Idele. At least among the locals, walking unshod throughout day to day tasks was the norm. Swimming was also a common mode of transportation and recreation for Iloh's inhabitants, many of whom learned to swim before they mastered bipedal locomotion.

Ikari.title: Ikari
Ikari.lead: Ikari was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Ikari system of Wild Space, in grid square H-14 of the Standard Galactic Grid, that was home to a village where a tribal elder lived. Around 19 BBY, Lina Graf visited Ikari and encountered the tribal elder, who wore a sensor mask that allowed him to see, hear and smell better than his fellow tribesmen.

Iliabath.title: Iliabath
Iliabath.lead: Iliabath was an astronomical object located in the Iliabath system within the Mortex sector of the Outer Rim and New Territories. It was situated in grid square R-4 of the Standard Galactic Grid. Iliabath was the homeworld of the Force-sensitive female Zygerrian Tasi Lowa, who was born around 151 BBY and had joined the Jedi Order by 132 BBY.

Ilum.title: Ilum/Legends

facts.terrain: Caverns, Ice flows, Icy mountains, Snow
facts.population: Imperial Era: 5,200:, 45% support crew, 30% temporary researchers, 20% military, 5% other

Ilum.lead: Ilum was an ice planet in the Unknown Regions, one of the main sources of the valuable crystals used in the construction of Jedi lightsabers. The caverns containing these Ilum crystals were long ago turned into a Jedi temple. Unlike the crystals of other planets, those of Ilum were limited to blue, green, and purple in color. The planet was over ninety percent-covered by ice.

Improcco.title: Improcco

facts.routes: Corellian Run, Coruscant–Dantooine hyperlane, Koros Trunk Line, Leisure Corridor, Martial Cross, Metellos Trade Route, Namadii Corridor, Perlemian Trade Route …

Improcco.lead: Improcco was an icy planet in the Coruscant system. It was the ninth planet from the star Coruscant Prime. Improcco had one moon, known as the Frozen Moon of Improcco.

Imdaar.title: Imdaar/Legends
Imdaar.lead: Imdaar was a planet in the Dreighton Nebula with surface features reminiscent of Dagobah. It was the base of the TIE Phantom project, in which the production facility was located on Imdaar Alpha.

Ingo.title: Ingo/Legends

facts.terrain: Desolate desert salt flats, Polar ice, Craters

Ingo.lead: Ingo was a backwater Mid Rim world in the Bortele sector.

Indu San.title: Indu San/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Indu San.lead: Indu San was an Outer Rim Territories planet in the Indu San system inhabited by Humans. It was part of the Galactic Republic.

Indinor.title: Indinor

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories; Tion Cluster, The Slice

Indinor.lead: Indinor, a rocky wasteland, was the fifth planet in the Lianna system. It was orbited by two moons.

Indikir.title: Indikir
Indikir.lead: Indikir was an arid rock, the second planet orbiting the white dwarf Bseto.

Imoco.title: Imoco
Imoco.lead: Imoco was a world that was located in the Kamino system, within Wild Space. It was the eleventh planet out from that system's primary star.

Inat Prime.title: Inat Prime
Inat Prime.lead: Inat Prime was a planet in the Outer Rim's Quiberon sector. Boba Fett had microscopic subdermal trackers placed on Rivo Xarran on Inat Prime.

Immalia.title: Immalia

facts.region: Expansion Region, Outer Expansion Zone, Northern Dependencies

Immalia.lead: Immalia was an Expansion Region celestial body located in the Immalia sector, home to the Humans known as Immalians. During the Waymancy Storm, the Signatories of Waymancy carried out an orbital bombardment of Immalia, which was halted by the Galactic Republic via the use of the experimental cannonship Squintpipe.

Imerria.title: Imerria
Imerria.lead: Imerria was a world located in the Expansion Region that was known for its windstorms.

Indoumodo.title: Indoumodo/Legends
Indoumodo.lead: A terrestrial planet located in the Indoumodo system of Wild Space, Indoumodo was a lush world with jungles and forests that were home to kouhuns, poisonous arthropods that dwelled in damp caves and passages underground. The creatures were also known to dwell in vast, hollow trees and hunted dog-sized creatures that lived in the trees' crevices. Located near the end of the Corellian Run, Indoumodo was a destination for assassins and poisoners who would venture to capture the kouhuns for use as untraceable killers.

Indellian.title: Indellian
Indellian.lead: Indellian was a low-gravity planetoid that served as a trade world, manufacturing hub, and government center for the Yarith sector in the Outer Rim Territories. It was originally settled by the Galactic Republic centuries prior to the Galactic Civil War as commerce developed around the Corellian Trade Spine in the Outer Rim's Greater Javin region. Indellian's placement along the zigzagging border between the Yarith and Anoat sectors was part of an intentional Republic effort to cut off neighboring worlds and check local political power.

Injopan.title: Injopan/Legends
Injopan.lead: Injopan was a planet. The One Two Many once visited there, before departing for the Maw.

Imynusoph.title: Imynusoph/Legends
Imynusoph.lead: Imynusoph was an Outer Rim Territories world that, according to the opera The Kallea Cycle, was the site of rumored treasures around 3694 BBY, when the hyperspace scout Freia Kallea charted the final segment of the super-hyperroute that would become known as the Hydian Way. In the opera, Imynusoph was the homeworld of the peaceful Imyni species.

Imei.title: Imei
Imei.lead: Imei was an ice world, located in the Felucia system, which in turn was found in the Outer Rim Territories' Thanium sector. During the Clone Wars, this area of space was contested over by the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Imrooso.title: Imrooso
Imrooso.lead: Imrooso was a volcanic rock in the Ottega system in the Mid Rim.

Indar.title: Indar
Indar.lead: Indar was the eighth planet orbiting the star Tive in the Taanab system. Located in the Inner Rim Territories, Indar was a gas giant with five moons.

Imram.title: Imram
Imram.lead: Imram was a Mid Rim world located within Lannik Space. During the Kymoodon Era, Galactic Republic colonists settled Imram, which members of the Hutt species viewed as an act of war.

Imvur.title: Imvur
Imvur.lead: Imvur was a planet located in the Hasmir system within the Mid Rim Territories. Between 4 BBY and 3 BBY Imvur was controlled by the Galactic Empire, although a rebel cell of the larger rebellion had a base there.

Iridonia.title: Iridonia/Legends

facts.terrain: Acid pools and seas, Deep, windy canyons with farmable land
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Mandalorians, Darth Revan's Sith Empire, Brotherhood of Darkness, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire

Iridonia.lead: Iridonia was the homeworld of the Zabrak species. Due to the harsh living conditions, the Zabrak were a hardy species. They took to flight and then space travel as soon as they could develop the technology, and by the time the Duros encountered them, they had already colonized five systems. Notable Iridonians included Agen Kolar, Bao-Dur, Drell Kahmf, Sirak, and Maris Brood.

Ione.title: Ione/Legends
Ione.lead: Ione was a thriving spaceport world lying along the Corellian Trade Spine in the Anoat sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Originally settled by the Galactic Republic centuries before the Galactic Civil War, Ione occupied a key intersection on the Trade Spine that made it the sole hyperspace link to the Greater Javin region's four Mining Worlds.

Iotra.title: Iotra

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories; Imperial Space, The Slice

Iotra.lead: Iotra was the fifth planet in the Iotran system and the temperate, industrial homeworld to the militant Iotran species. The planet was ruled by the Joint Council, eight top-ranking leaders of the Iotran Police Force (IPF).

Iridium.title: Iridium
Iridium.lead: Iridium was a planet in the Atrivis sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was home to the infamous Pirates of Iridium, who utilized Iridium "power gems" to disable the shields of their victims' starships, raiding Atrivis space lanes for a year. However, a task force of Jedi and Galactic Republic Judicials routed the pirates in a battle over Vuchelle in 22 BBY.

Iri.title: Iri
Iri.lead: Iri was a forested planet in the Epidimi system located in the mid-rim, discovered in 5000 BBY by the Galactic Republic, which crossbred its native avians with the similar avians of Disim, resulting in the Tarongs, who drove their mother species on both worlds extinct.

Iphigin.title: Iphigin
Iphigin.lead: Iphigin was a planet in the Iphigin system of the Core Worlds and the homeworld of the Iphigini species.

Inysh.title: Inysh
Inysh.lead: Inysh was a Core Worlds planet that was home to the Abinyshi. A sentient, passive species of reptilians, the natives of Inysh were among the first species to achieve space travel, although their interstellar colonization was limited. The Galactic Empire eventually discovered the planet had vast reserves of the kalonterium ore and proceeded to strip-mine the world.

Intuci.title: Intuci
Intuci.lead: Intuci was a planet in the Abrion sector of the Outer Rim Territories under the control of the Galactic Empire.

Ios.title: Ios

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, New Territories, Trans-Hydian
facts.routes: Hydian Way, Junction-Tierell Loop, Thesme Trace

Ios.lead: Ios was a gas giant and the fourth and outermost planet located in the Feriae system.

Iqoon.title: Iqoon
Iqoon.lead: Iqoon was a planet in the Roon system. It possessed two moons and had a terrain of barren rock.

Inner Los.title: Inner Los
Inner Los.lead: Inner Los was a planet located in the Recopi system.

Inwil.title: Inwil
Inwil.lead: Inwil was the fifth planet of the Darpa sector's Ralltiir system.

Intran.title: Intran
Intran.lead: Intran was an uninhabited planet in the Intran system of the Brak sector. An Alliance to Restore the Republic military base was established on the planet shortly before the Battle of Yavin. The base housed a squadron of BTL Y-wing starfighters.

Irfan.title: Irfan
Irfan.lead: Irfan was the third planet in the Vaxal system. It was a gas giant orbited by seven moons.

Iridia.title: Iridia
Iridia.lead: Iridia was a Zabrak colony-world. It was the home of Donloor and Oorn Noth.

Iqobal.title: Iqobal
Iqobal.lead: Iqobal was the fourth planet orbiting the star Polith in the Polith system. Located in the Jaso sector of the Inner Rim, it was a gas giant.

Iol.title: Iol
Iol.lead: Iol was a lifeless planet in the Unknown Regions.

Iokath.title: Iokath
Iokath.lead: Iokath was a massive artificial sphere constructed around a star located in the Unknown Regions by a technologically advanced species at some point before the Manderon Period. Every orbital body in the system was demolished and salvaged for core elements, from which an impervious habitat for the species was constructed, using all of it star's energy output. The species of weapon designers created many technological wonders such as the Gravestone, the Eternal Fleet, the GEMINI droids, SCORPIO and the Old Gods, using their superweapons on dozens of different worlds for live testing.

Inusagi.title: Inusagi
Inusagi.lead: Inusagi was a planet in the Vilonis sector of the Mid Rim region of the galaxy. It was famous for its sakoola blossom festival.

Falk.title: Ire Falk

facts.affiliation: Galactic Empire, 224th Imperial Armored Division, Joint Chiefs of the Imperial Military, Tempest Force

Falk.lead: Ire Falk was an individual who served in the armed forces of the Galactic Empire with the military rank of general. In 10 BBY, Falk led the 224th Imperial Armored Division during the long Mimban Campaign. Following the Battle of Yavin and the gaps left in the Joint Chiefs of the Imperial Military as a result of the battle, Falk served in the group. Falk was appointed to lead the Imperial Army forces on the surface of the moon Endor and attended a meeting of senior Imperial officers prior to the Battle of Endor in 4 ABY.

Isis.title: Isis/Legends
Isis.lead: Isis was a terrestrial planet in the Anoat sector of the Outer Rim Territories. The homeworld of the Gutretee, it was a secret Rebel Alliance safe world during the Galactic Civil War, and later became one of the Mining Worlds under the control of the Figg conglomerate.

Isht.title: Isht
Isht.lead: Isht was the Ishori homeworld. It was directly represented in the New Republic Senate.

Issor.title: Issor
Issor.lead: Issor was the most powerful planet in the Trulalis system, and the homeworld of the Issori and Odenji.

Istic II.title: Istic II
Istic II.lead: Istic II was the irradiated, ore-rich mining planet that was the second world in the Istic system, located within the Teraab sector. With the permission of the local Imperial governor, the native Isticians were hunted by Human settlers as though they were vermin.

Iskadrell.title: Iskadrell
Iskadrell.lead: Iskadrell, also known as Iskallon, was a planet in the Iskallon system of the Wild Space. It was the homeworld of the Iskalloni, a species of humanoid cyborgs. It was raided by Mandalorian Crusaders shortly prior to the Great Sith War.

Iskalon.title: Iskalon/Legends
Iskalon.lead: During the time of the Cold War, a proxy conflict between the Sith Empire and Galactic Republic, the sea levels on the planet dropped, revealing several long-hidden caves that had been occupied hundreds of years before and eventually someone was sent to investigate them, discovering that the caves had been used by the native species to hide from slavers and their possessions could still be found inside the cave network.

Iseno.title: Iseno/Legends
Iseno.lead: Iseno was a planet in the Inner Rim, on the Corellian Run. Its people had a strong military tradition and maintained a large army mostly used for ornamental honor guard purposes.

Iscera.title: Iscera
Iscera.lead: Iscera was an Outer Rim planet near Issor and Nysza III. Fable Astin saw Jaalib Brandl perform in a play on this planet. It was a dry planet lacking any legal establishments that sold alcohol.

Ison.title: Ison/Legends

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories; Greater Javin, Western Reaches

Ison.lead: Ison was a cold, desolate planet in the Ison system, and little more than an obscure waypoint on the dangerous Ison Corridor.

Isen.title: Isen
Isen.lead: Isen was a young gas giant and the sole planet in the Isen system. Its five planetoid satellites included Isen IV.

Ishanna I.title: Ishanna I
Ishanna I.lead: Ishanna I was the first planet in the Ishanna system. It was a barren, searing rock, with two moons.

Ishanna II.title: Ishanna II
Ishanna II.lead: Ishanna II was the second planet in the Ishanna system. A barren world with no natural atmosphere, Ishanna II was important for its mineral deposits, which were mined by various independent companies. The planet had three moons.

Ishanna V.title: Ishanna V
Ishanna V.lead: Ishanna V was the fifth planet in the Ishanna system. It housed five moons. The aforementioned stellar objects followed their set individual orbital course, all similarly elliptical.

Isde Naha.title: Isde Naha/Legends

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Western Reaches, Greater Javin
facts.sector: Javin sector (prior to c. 400 BBY), Anoat sector (c. 400 BBY—), Yarith sector (generations after c. 400 BBY)

Isde Naha.lead: Isde Naha an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Greater Javin region. An industrial world with no tolerance toward law-breaking and smuggling, it was originally settled as part of the Javin sector. Around 400 BBY, the portion of that sector containing Isde Naha became the new Anoat sector, and, generations later, it in turn was re-designated the Yarith sector, which the planet served as the capital of.

Irith.title: Irith
Irith.lead: Irith was a terrestrial planet located in the Irith system, a part of the Hutt Space portion of the Slice. It was a motley stop on the Ootmian Pabol hyperlane between the Du Hutta and Nar Bo Sholla systems. An overcrowded, polluted world, Irith was the homeworld of the criminal Romort Raort, where, during his childhood, he was a bully who shaked down other children for their lunch money.

Isiring.title: Isiring

facts.affiliation: Cassandran Worlds, Galactic Empire, Pentastar Alignment, Imperial Remnant

Isiring.lead: Isiring was an Outer Rim Territories world located in the Cassander sector. An ore-rich mining world, Isiring became a part of the domain known as the Cassandran Worlds, founded by the former businessman Cassander Tadrin during the reign of the Galactic Republic. When the Galactic Empire later divided the domain into subsectors, Isiring became the capital of the Tendrannan sector. The world was subsequently a part of the Pentastar Alignment and the Imperial Remnant.

Issagra.title: Issagra
Issagra.lead: Issagra was a planet in the Issagra system. It was located approximately twelve hours hyperspace travel from Fether. Its most notable location was a large space station. Over three kilometers long, the station was devoted to trade and gambling, and could house tens of thousands of visitors and hundreds of freighters at a time. The station's atmosphere was often regarded as grand and exotic, though organized crime held sway in the background and contraband could be found in numerous locations.

Irmenu.title: Irmenu

facts.terrain: Shallow seas, Island archipelagos covered with sand, forests, and meadowlands, Rough oceans

Irmenu.lead: Irmenu was an oceanic planet located in the fringes of the Crombach Nebula, in the Belsmuth sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Isolated from the rest of the galaxy for millennia, it was a feudal world known for its seafaring and stern religious traditions.

Irkalla.title: Irkalla
Irkalla.lead: Irkalla was an astronomical object beyond the planet Kitel Phard where, at the end of the First Great Schism, Jedi Master Awdrysta Pina and Legions of Lettow leader Arden Lyn faced off. Pina suffered a mortal wound, but before dying, used morichro to stop Lyn's heart. At some point, an unidentified party discovered Lyn's body, and constructed a tomb, in which it was suspended in a stasis field, only to reawaken some 24,496 years later during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

Isobe.title: Isobe
Isobe.lead: Isobe was a planet located in the Thustra system in the Sumitra sector of the Expansion Region. It was ruled by a royal family and produced unique Tynzo crystals.

Ithor.title: Ithor/Legends

facts.region: Mid Rim, Lesser Plooriod Cluster, New Territories
facts.affiliation: Ithorian religion, Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Rebel Alliance, Alliance of Free Planets, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire, Galactic Alliance …

Ithor.lead: Ithor was the fourth planet located in Ottega system of the Mid Rim. One of the oldest members of the Galactic Republic, it was a planet full of lush life, and the planet's surface had not a touch of civilization on it. The Ithorians themselves, otherwise known as "Hammerheads," built great floating cities that did not harm the surface, which they considered to be sacred. Entry upon the surface was forbidden, unless one stayed there permanently.

J't'p'tan.title: J't'p'tan
J't'p'tan.lead: An almost untouched world in the Koornacht Cluster, J't'p'tan (known to most simply as Doornik-628E) was settled by the Galandan (from Galand), a population of whom were followers of a religious movement known as H'kig and were fleeing a conflict on Rishi. The planet was named after four sacred glyphs: "Jeh" (the Immanent), "Teh" (the Transcendent), "Peh" (the Eternal), and "Tan" (the Conscious Essence). Only the last of these glyphs was considered secular enough to be spelled-out fully.

Jabiim.title: Jabiim/Legends

facts.sector: Kiirium Reaches (25,120 BBY–25,096 BBY), Phelleem sector
facts.terrain: Modern:, Deserts, Seas, Rivers, Historic: Muddy plains
facts.affiliation: Xim's Empire, Jabiim Congress, Galactic Republic, Brotherhood of Darkness, Jabiimi Nationalists, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire …

Jabiim.lead: Jabiim , known as Gwynhes Minor during the reign of Xim, was a small, muddy, Outer Rim world. It was most notably the site of three fierce Battles of Jabiim.

Jaemus.title: Jaemus/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Pentastar Alignment, Imperial Remnant

Jaemus.lead: Jaemus was a planet with Galentro Heavy Works shipyards comparable in size to Sluis Van.

Ithull.title: Ithull
Ithull.lead: Ithull was the gigantic homeworld of the Ithullans and the colossus wasps. The Ithullans were almost wiped out by the Mandalorians in the year 200 BBY.

Iyuta.title: Iyuta
Iyuta.lead: Iyuta was an underdeveloped planet in the Fakir sector. Controlled by the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War, it was the location of several important governmental facilities and was well protected by spy satellites and large cruisers. The small city of Takari was situated on the planet, served by the Iyuta spaceport. An Imperial Communications Center was built outside the city over an old sewer system.

Ixtlar.title: Ixtlar/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire, Galactic Alliance, Bounty Hunters' Guild

Ixtlar.lead: Ixtlar was a planet in the Ixtlar system on of the Core Worlds, situated on the Corellian Run in the Ixtlar sector. It was covered in holographic advertisement signs. Almost any merchandise could be found on Ixtlar.

Iyred.title: Iyred
Iyred.lead: Iyred was a world located in the Iyred system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Kibilini sector. At one point, its surface was covered with tropical and temperate forests. That habitat was home to the Black Bha'lir, a species of large feline predators.

Ithoon.title: Ithoon

facts.routes: Perlemian Trade Route, Triellus Trade Route

Ithoon.lead: Ithoon was the sixth planet in the Centares system.

Ithona.title: Ithona
Ithona.lead: Ithona was a planet in the Essesia system. It was a gas giant with five moons.

Iychtor.title: Iychtor
Iychtor.lead: Iychtor was the fifth, outermost planet that orbited the sun Velus. It was located in the Velus system of the Northern Dependencies portion of the Core Worlds. The frozen rock planet had one moon. Iychtor, along with the rest of its system, was located along the Shawken Spur hyperlane, connecting it to the Shawken and Thokos systems. The Velusia system, and therefore Iychtor itself, was also connected by another hyperlane to the Scipio system.

Ivatch.title: Ivatch
Ivatch.lead: Ivatch was a planet within the Kathol sector's Ivatch system, located within the Outer Rim Territories. Connected to the neighboring planets of Shintel and Peirs by hyperlanes, Ivatch supported a small colony whose economy was based around supplying ore and natural resources to Gandle Ott.

Italbos.title: Italbos
Italbos.lead: Italbos was a planet located in the Mid Rim that had been discovered circa 3963 BBY. The rights for it were about to be sold by the Metellos Exchange on the auction, when Marn Hierogryph, Jarael and Rohlan Dyre (Demagol in disguise) had tried to run a con there, claiming that a native of Italbos was there to claim their share of money from the deal. After Gryph dealt with Nunk Plaarvin, Zayne Carrick told the people at the auction that Italbos was presumably inhabitable, and that weren't any confirmed mineral riches, but the rights to the planet had been sold anyway.

Itzeho.title: Itzeho/Legends
Itzeho.lead: Itzeho was an ice ball that was the last planet of the Mygeeto system.

Iwar.title: Iwar
Iwar.lead: Iwar was a searing rock planet with no moons that occupied the closest orbital position to the star Abo. It was located within the Lehon system, a part of the Unknown Regions' area known as the Tempered Wastes.

Ividal.title: Ividal
Ividal.lead: Ividal was an astronomical object located in the Ividal system, a part of the Slice portion of the Mid Rim. During the Clone Wars, the Foxfire Squadron, a unit of the Ividal Sector Forces equipped with Z-95 Headhunter starfighters, was stationed at Ividal.

Ivarujar.title: Ivarujar
Ivarujar.lead: Ivarujar was a volcanic planet in the Ivarujar system in the Vensensor sector of the Expansion Region, situated along the Corellian Trade Spine. During the Galactic Civil War, some time after the Battle of Yavin, a massive volcano eruption devastated the planet's surface and quickly overran the capital city. The Imperial Star Destroyer Devastator was sent to the planet to evacuate the remaining Imperial troops. Lieutenant Commander Ciena Ree also managed to evacuate forty civilians despite receiving no orders to do so.

Ivera X.title: Ivera X
Ivera X.lead: Ivera X was a Core Worlds planet that suffered under the rule of the Galactic Empire, having its cities destroyed as a response to Imperial posters being vandalized. The light freighter Mighty Oak Apocalypse did a supply run there during the Galactic Civil War. After the Imperial rule over Ivera X ended, the surviving Iverians looted the Empire's old headquarters and used its wealth to hire the bounty hunter Xegan Miatt to bring in the officials behind the destruction of the world's cities. Three officials were brought in and executed before the New Republic stepped in.

Jaatovi.title: Jaatovi
Jaatovi.lead: Jaatovi was an astronomical object in the Jaatovi system of the Inner Rim Territories. It had at least three moons around it, one of which was inhabited during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

Jaelen.title: Jaelen
Jaelen.lead: Jaelen was a peaceful planet located in the Mid Rim Territories. In 34 ABY, on the orders of Agent Terex, the First Order was using civilian transports to smuggle arms from the Outer Rim to planets like Jaelen.

Jaminere.title: Jaminere/Legends

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Tion Cluster, The Slice
facts.affiliation: Kingdom of Jaminere, Three Allied Kingdoms, Xer's Empire, Xim's empire, Jaminere Marches, Galactic Republic, Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders …

Jaminere.lead: Jaminere was a planet located in the Tion Cluster of the Outer Rim Territories, along the Cadinth Run. A powerful manufacturing world known for its efficiency, Jaminere was the capital of the Allied Tion sector.

Jandoon.title: Jandoon
Jandoon.lead: Jandoon was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories, in the Corva sector., It eventually came to be known as a haunted world. It was home to the ancient ruins of a civilization that disappeared.

Jante.title: Jante
Jante.lead: Jante was a planet in the Jante system, near Freda.

Jagga II.title: Jagga II

facts.affiliation: Galactic Empire, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong

Jagga II.lead: Jagga II was a planet located in the Venjagga system of the Colonies. Even after the Battle of Endor, Jagga II produced missiles for the Imperial Navy. It was later a strategic world of the New Republic during the Yuuzhan Vong War.

Jankok.title: Jankok
Jankok.lead: Jankok was a warm terrestrial planet located in the Jankok system, a part of the Bozhnee sector in the Western Reaches portion of Outer Rim Territories. Jankok was the homeworld of the sentient feline Srrors'tok species, members of which communicated via the Hras'kkk'rarr language and were susceptible to low temperatures. The Srrors'tok primarily lived in tribal hunting parties formed on the basis of familial ties and a common culture, and their homeworld was at a primitive technology level.

Jandur.title: Jandur
Jandur.lead: Jandur was a planet in the Inner Rim and was represented in the New Republic Senate.

Janguine.title: Janguine
Janguine.lead: Janguine was a jungle planet in the Outer Rim. Its natives spoke Janguine and were overrun by the Mooloolians around 275 BBY.

Jagga VII.title: Jagga VII
Jagga VII.lead: Jagga VII was a planet located within the Venjagga system of the Colonies.

Janara III.title: Janara III
Janara III.lead: Janara III was a planet in the Janara system, covered in rolling hills and green grass, where Matt Turhaya left his daughter in the care of his wife's parents. Turhaya's wife, Anii Degarienne, had died in a freak accident in a weapons manufacturing facility on Carida where Matt attended the Academy of Carida.

Janilis VII.title: Janilis VII
Janilis VII.lead: Janilis VII was an Outer Rim Territories planet situated in the Cronese Mandate sector of the Tion Cluster. It was one of the cradles of the Cronese Human civilization and was part of the Kingdom of Cron. Janilis VII hosted several archives that were still in existence twenty-five millennia later, although the planet itself had become rundown and its society was engaged in subsistence economy.

Jaguada.title: Jaguada/Legends

facts.affiliation: Ancient Sith Empire, Old Sith Empire, Order of the Sith Lords, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire

Jaguada.lead: Jaguada was a desert planet and the only inhabited world of the Jaguada system, located in the Sith Worlds region of the Outer Rim Territories' Esstran sector. It orbited a star and had one moon. A colony world of the Sith species that was settled around 27,700 BBY, Jaguada remained a part of both the ancient Sith Empire and the old Sith Empire. By 533 BBY, it was the site of a bastion constructed by the Sith Master Darth Gravid and his apprentice, Darth Gean. Around that year, they fought a duel there that cost Gravid his life.

Janodral Mizar.title: Janodral Mizar

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Greater Tion, The Slice
facts.affiliation: Xim's Empire, Indrexu Confederation, Galactic Empire

Janodral Mizar.lead: Janodral Mizar was a planet in Outer Rim Territories in the Indrexu sector.

Jangelle.title: Jangelle
Jangelle.lead: Jangelle was a planet in the Kathol sector. A temperate world of sandy lowlands, it was crossed with many interlinking rivers, streams and deltas, although it had few large bodies of water.

JanFathal.title: JanFathal

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems

JanFathal.lead: JanFathal was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories and was once part of the Republic. The city of Athar was its capital.

Jalarren.title: Jalarren

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic, House Garonnin, House Petro, House Picutorion

Jalarren.lead: Jalarren was a planet in the Senex sector of the Mid Rim.

Jamiron.title: Jamiron/Legends
Jamiron.lead: Jamiron was a Chiss Ascendancy planet in the Jamiron system of the Unknown Regions. The surface of Jamiron was barren, but its porous crust contained hydroponic agricultural facilities.

Jakelia.title: Jakelia system/Legends
Jakelia.lead: The Jakelia system was a part of the Mandalore sector in the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was home to the Jakelian tuft-oak tree and the sentient Jakelian species. It was also the origin point of the Jakelian knife-dance, a form of melee combat that also possessed some characteristics of dancing.

Jagomir.title: Jagomir
Jagomir.lead: Jagomir was a humid planet in the Jaga's Cluster of the Outer Rim Territories. The Rebel Alliance set up a base there after being forced to abandon their base on Arda I. While it had no known native sentient species, Jagomir was teeming with thousands of plants and animals, many of which were extremely dangerous.

Jakku.title: Jakku

facts.climate: Arid; hot days with cold nights
facts.language: Galactic Basic Standard, Hideo, Teedospeak, Uthuthma

Jakku.lead: Jakku was a remote desert planet located in the Jakku system in the galaxy's Inner Rim and was the homeworld of the Teedo and Uthuthma species. Though considered by many within the galaxy to be distant and relatively worthless, Jakku was the site of important events that would shape galactic history. In 5 ABY, Jakku was the site of the pivotal Battle of Jakku, which ended the Galactic Civil War in favor of the New Republic and the collapse of the Galactic Empire.

Jalindi.title: Jalindi
Jalindi.lead: Jalindi was a planet located in the Jalindi system of the Outer Rim Territories with a landscape of red rock pillars surrounded by mist amidst an atmosphere breathable to humans. Around 1 BBY, the Galactic Empire had a relay station there which was destroyed during a mission carried out by the Rebel Alliance, which had originally intended to only hack the relay.

Javin.title: Javin

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories; Greater Javin, Western Reaches
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Javin.lead: Javin was the capital and namesake of Javin sector and the subsequent Greater Javin Region, along the Corellian Trade Spine.

Jatee.title: Jatee
Jatee.lead: Jatee was the third planet of the Demophon system. It was the site of a Galactic Empire mining operation for rutgar-4. It was destroyed when its sun went supernova.

Jazbina.title: Jazbina/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Empire, Alliance to Restore the Republic

Jazbina.lead: Jazbina was a planet with luxurious aromatic baths and sun crystals.

Jatir.title: Jatir (disambiguation)
Jatir.lead: Jatir may refer to one of the following:

Javis-12.title: Javis-12
Javis-12.lead: Javis-12 was the only asteroid in the Mestra system with any sort of landing beacon or spaceport. Javis-12 also had the only ship repair and refuel services available in the system (for which the charge was an even 200 percent of list price). The Javis-12 spaceport consisted of a series of domes and caves on one of the largest asteroids in the system. Javis-12 was roughly egg-shaped, and about 400 kilometers across. It was located on the edge of the asteroid belt.

Javaal.title: Javaal

facts.routes: Commenor Run, Hydian Way, Brentaal–Denon Route, Corsin Run, Perlemian Trade Route

Javaal.lead: Javaal was the seventh planet in the Brentaal system. It was an ice ball.

Jarsatt.title: Jarsatt
Jarsatt.lead: Jarsatt was a planet located in the Hakartha sector of the Expansion Region.

Javis.title: Javis

facts.affiliation: House Mecetti, Tapani Empire, Tapani Federation, Galactic Empire

Javis.lead: Javis was a planet in located in the Tapani sector's Javis system.

Jardeen IV.title: Jardeen IV
Jardeen IV.lead: Jardeen IV was a planet in the Expansion Region's Trans-Jardeen sector. It was the site of the Imperial Army training center, used by the Galactic Empire for teaching the tactics of utilizing walkers in combat. Shortly after the Battle of Endor, Captain Iolan Gendarr of the Imperial Star Destroyer Reliance and General Arndall Lott, both stationed on Jardeen IV, fled the planet before the arrival of New Republic forces.

Jastro III.title: Jastro III
Jastro III.lead: Jastro III was a Core Worlds planet that was under the administration of a governor of the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. A Rebel Alliance underground group operated on the planet, and the governor's daughter, who was in love with the Rebel Selas Ferr, put the group in contact with "Alexan," a mysterious, influential individual who was secretly the governor himself in disguise. At one point, Alexan had Ferr's group take the governor's daughter away with them while helping them rescue two of their captured members.

Jedd Six.title: Jedd Six
Jedd Six.lead: Jedd Six was a planet that occupied the sixth orbital position in the Jedd system of Wild Space. During the last years of the Galactic Republic, Lexi Fernandin became the first individual to scout the planet. While the Human and his companions were exploring Jedd Six, an incident occurred. Later, at some point following the Battle of Yavin, Fernandin experienced another, similar incident that made him recall his time on Jedd Six.

Jendar.title: Jendar
Jendar.lead: Jendar was a planet located in the Nembus sector of the Outer Rim Territories. During the Galactic Civil War, it was the site of a campaign between the forces of the Rebel Alliance and the Galactic Empire for the control of the planet.

Jaresh.title: Jaresh/Legends
Jaresh.lead: Jaresh was a remote rainforest moon in the Jaresh system in Corva sector of the Outer Rim. Its indigenous trees grew hundreds of meters in height. Its local day lasted 29 standard hours, and its local year lasted 98 local days. The Twi'lek Ree Shala purchased Jaresh as a smuggling base.

Jebble.title: Jebble

facts.population: Humans (Formerly), Thousands of Mandalorian officers and recruits, subsequently transformed into rakghouls

Jebble.lead: Jebble was a frozen world located in the Ojoster sector of the Outer Rim. A target for ice miners, Jebble served as a resource world for the nearby ecumenopolis of Taris, and fell under threat when the Mandalorian Neo-Crusader hordes began encroaching upon Taris in the early weeks of their war with the Galactic Republic. When the Mandalorians finally struck, they swiftly captured Jebble and turned it into one of their main Outer Rim staging points, the place where the Mandalorians gathered thousands of local recruits for a planned raid on Alderaan.

Jarnollen.title: Jarnollen
Jarnollen.lead: Jarnollen was a planet in close proximity to Ord Mantell in the Mid Rim. It was covered in tropical jungle, and its trees possessed overgrown vines.

Jech.title: Jech
Jech.lead: Jech was the fourth planet orbiting the star Tive in the Taanab system. Located in the Inner Rim Territories, it was a gas giant and had four moons.

Jaxus.title: Jaxus
Jaxus.lead: Jaxus was a planet that supported life despite orbiting closely to its sun.

Jashwa.title: Jashwa
Jashwa.lead: Jashwa was a planet located somewhere in the galaxy. It was the homeworld of the Jashwik, a Sullustan cousin-species.

Jelucan.title: Jelucan

facts.affiliation: Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire

Jelucan.lead: Jelucan was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories. The planet sided with the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars. During the Age of the Empire, Jelucan was annexed by the Galactic Empire. It was the homeworld of Thane Kyrell and Ciena Ree, two star-crossed lovers who fought on opposite sides of the Galactic Civil War.

Jedha.title: Jedha

facts.terrain: Deserts, Mesas, Rocky dustbowls, Ruptured mantle, Magma seas
facts.affiliation: Jedi Order, Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire

Jedha.lead: Jedha, also known as the Pilgrim Moon, the Cold Moon, or the Kyber Heart, and formerly known as NiJedha, was a small desert moon which orbited the planet NaJedha. Located in the Jedha system of the galaxy's Mid Rim, the moon had a cold climate due to its lasting winter. The historical and spiritual significance of Jedha led the moon to become a world of worship for those who believed in the Force, and a holy site for pilgrims who sought spiritual guidance.

Jerijador.title: Jerijador
Jerijador.lead: Jerijador, located in the Calaron sector of the Outer Rim Territories, was a planet teeming with a variety of lifeforms that was hospitable to humanoids. In the aftermath of the Battle of Yavin, a fleet of Imperial warships led by Moff Vensell staged at Jerijador in preparation for an assault on the Rebel Alliance. This attracted many scavengers who came to salvage the junk that the departing Imperial vessels left behind upon entering hyperspace.

Jerrist VI.title: Jerrist VI
Jerrist VI.lead: Jerrist VI was a factory and resource mining world in the Corporate Sector. It was quarantined by the Corporate Sector Authority when a plague broke out.

Jerrilek.title: Jerrilek
Jerrilek.lead: Jerrilek was a tropical vacation world in the Jerrilek system.

Jerne.title: Jerne
Jerne.lead: Jerne was a desert planet in the Outer Rim Territories' Kanz sector. Its native Jerni species had gone extinct by the time the Galactic Empire militarized the world and headquartered themselves in Jerne City H.Q., an event that had occurred recently by 3 ABY. At that point, the Sith Lord Darth Vader crafted a trap for the Rebel Leia Organa—planted datatapes claimed that a highly valuable artifact called the Eternity Crystal with the power to wind back time was located on Jerne—ensnaring fellow Rebel Luke Skywalker in it as well.

Jendorn.title: Jendorn
Jendorn.lead: Jendorn was an Expansion Region planet located in the Farstey sector. It was situated in the Trans-Hydian, an area over which the confederation led by Imperial Grand Admiral Thrawn had control. In 9 ABY, a fierce battle was fought at Jendorn between the Imperial and New Republic forces, in which the Empire was victorious.

Jenenma.title: Jenenma
Jenenma.lead: Jenenma was a planet with many starshipwrights. The Hutt's Last Laugh cantina was on the planet, as was the headquarters of a syndicate run by Pal-Nada, a Cerean Force adept.

Jiaan.title: Jiaan
Jiaan.lead: Jiaan was a planet located in the Jiaan system in the Mid Rim's Almak sector. During the early years of the New Order—which was established in 19 BBY—Jiaan was one of many planets that was subjugated and decimated by the forces of the Galactic Empire, targeted after Jedi Knight Tyneir Renz—a Human native of the planet—escaped the Great Jedi Purge. Renz's wife and son were killed in the razing of Jiaan, though he managed to save his daughter, Padija Anjeri.

Jestefad.title: Jestefad/Legends
Jestefad.lead: Jestefad was the second planet orbiting the star Priate in the Mustafar system. Located in the Atravis sector of the Outer Rim Territories, it was a gas giant. Located very close to the planet Mustafar, it was constantly in a gravitational tug-of-war with the gas giant Lefrani suspending Mustafar in between their orbits.

Jinathik.title: Jinathik
Jinathik.lead: Jinathik was an asteroid belt in the Garqi system between the planets of Garqi and Elsho.

Jeyell.title: Jeyell/Legends
Jeyell.lead: Jeyell was a Mid Rim planet located in the Roche sector, on the Perlemian Trade Route hyperlane. It housed the headquarters of Reiber Manufacturing, a company that manufactured assassin droid components until it was nationalized by the Galactic Empire on 36:4:20.

Jentawui.title: Jentawui

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Alliance of Free Planets, New Republic, Galactic Federation of Free Alliances, Five Worlds, Confederation

Jentawui.lead: Jentawui was a frozen planet in the Both system.

Jhas.title: Jhas/Legends
Jhas.lead: Jhas was a gas giant and the fourth planet in the Hoth system in the Outer Rim. Jhas had twenty-four moons.

Jinet.title: Jinet
Jinet.lead: Jinet was an uninhabited planet in the Jinet system of the Brak sector in the Expansion Region. The Alliance to Restore the Republic established a starfighter base on the planet shortly before the Battle of Yavin. The base was home to a squadron of BTL Y-wing starfighters.

Jestan.title: Jestan

facts.region: Expansion Region, Outer Expansion Zone, Northern Dependencies

Jestan.lead: Jestan was a terrestrial planet located in the Jestan system. It was a part of the Expansion Region's Corpheli sector, being located both in the Outer Expansion Zone sub-region and the Northern Dependencies portion of that region. Jestan lay on a hyperlane linking it to the Belukat and Corphelion systems.

Jevelet.title: Jevelet
Jevelet.lead: Jevelet was a planet located in the Core of the galaxy that housed a prison/mental facility.

Jilrua.title: Jilrua
Jilrua.lead: Jilrua was a desert planet that orbited a blue giant star within the Jilrua system of the galaxy's Hutt Space region, in the immediate vicinity of the Oktos Nebula.

Jike.title: Jike
Jike.lead: Jike was a hot rock planet with no moons that occupied the closest orbital position to the star Asar. It was located within the Ilum system, a part of the 7G sector that was situated within the galaxy's Unknown Regions.

Jhensrus.title: Jhensrus
Jhensrus.lead: Jhensrus was a jungle frontier world in the Trax sector. The inhabitants of the planet were often confronted by the native creatures, hence a population of fighters and survivors was shaped.

Jhantoria.title: Jhantoria
Jhantoria.lead: Jhantoria was a celestial body located in the Jhantoria system. It was a part of the Allied Tion sector of the Tion Cluster, situated within the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. Jhantoria was the origin point of Jhantorian wine. By 25,130 BBY, the astronomical object was situated within the borders of the confederation of worlds known as the Livien League. At some point around that year, the forces of King Xim of the Kingdom of Cron defeated those of the Livien League at Jhantoria.

Jeosyn.title: Jeosyn
Jeosyn.lead: Jeosyn was a planet in the Weneen sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It had an extremely slow rotation period, about three months, which meant that days and nights were unusually long and that both caused temperature extremes. The side of the planet experiencing night was called the Shadow Side; the side experiencing day was the Sun Side. The Dreamers' headquarters was located on the Shadow Side of the planet.

Jumus.title: Jumus

facts.affiliation: New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire, Five Worlds, Confederation

Jumus.lead: Jumus was a planet in the Corellian sector conquered by the Yuuzhan Vong.

Joiol.title: Joiol
Joiol.lead: Joiol was a planet located in the Orus sector of the Inner Rim that teemed with life.

Julsujod III.title: Julsujod III
Julsujod III.lead: Julsujod III was a water world located in the Julsujod system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Tolonda sector. It was the homeworld of Stribers, a species of telepathic aquatic sentients.

Jiroch-Reslia.title: Jiroch-Reslia

facts.affiliation: Triumvirate, Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Jiroch-Reslia.lead: Jiroch-Reslia was a planet in the Yushan sector of the Mid Rim. It was the homeworld of the Tunroth, a relatively primitive species of hunters.

Jomark.title: Jomark/Legends

facts.affiliation: Xim's empire, Galactic Empire, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Jomark.lead: Jomark was the second of six worlds in the Jomark system. Originally known as Bynas, it was absorbed into Xim's Empire as he expanded his borders from the Kingdom of Cron.

Jubilar.title: Jubilar/Legends
Jubilar.lead: Jubilar was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories used as a penal colony by half a dozen of its neighboring worlds, resulting in many civil wars throughout its history. The thriving spice trade within this planet's sector was controlled by the Hutts.

Joruna.title: Joruna
Joruna.lead: Joruna was a planet in the Farlax sector of the Core Worlds.

Jontan Asteroid Belt.title: Jontan Asteroid Belt
Jontan Asteroid Belt.lead: The Jontan asteroid belt was an asteroid belt located in the Thanta Zilbra system.

Jun.title: Jun (planet)
Jun.lead: Jun was a hot rock planet with no moons that was located within the Parthovian Cluster's Faarlsun system, in the Wild Space region of the galaxy. The planet occupied the closest orbit to its star, the yellow-white Faarlsun.

Jomon.title: Jomon
Jomon.lead: Jomon was the third planet in the Kamino system.

Saloch.title: Jiroch-Saloch
Saloch.lead: Jiroch-Saloch, also known as Saloch, was a world in the Mid Rim's Yushan sector. At some point after receiving galactic-level technology, the hunting-oriented Tunroth species colonized the planet. Spacers referred to Jiroch-Saloch, together with the Jiroch system's other worlds Jiroch-Reslia and Jiroch-Kalok, as the Triumvirate. A number of Duros also settled on the planet, leaving a strong influence on its architecture.

Kalok.title: Jiroch-Kalok
Kalok.lead: Jiroch-Kalok, also known as Kalok, was a world situated within the Mid Rim's Yushan sector. The planet was colonized by the hunting-oriented Tunroth species at some point after they had received galactic-level technology. Jiroch-Kalok, together with the Jiroch system's other worlds Jiroch-Reslia and Jiroch-Saloch, were referred to by spacers as the Triumvirate. A number of Duros also settled on the planet, leaving a strong influence on its architecture.

Jjannex II.title: Jjannex II
Jjannex II.lead: Jjannex II was a planet in the Jjannex system. The Star Destroyer Stormclaw defeated a pirate attack near Jjannex II.

Jovan III.title: Jovan III
Jovan III.lead: Jovan III, often called simply Jovan, was a planet located in the Jovan system and was noted for the Jovan Station, built in orbit around the planet.

Jodaka.title: Jodaka
Jodaka.lead: Jodaka was a planet of the Jodaka system, within the Corsair Outback area in the Hapes Cluster, a remote region in the Inner Rim and the Slice regions of the galaxy. The vast saltwater seas of Jodaka were home to many strange yet deadly creatures, including the Jodakan needler crab, a deceptive and dangerous crustacean non-sentient species. The planet's surface was also composed of many rocky reefs, which the Needler crabs would hop on and use their poisonous projectile needles to take down gulls—a seabird species also native to Jodaka—or to be preyed upon by the birds instead.

Joodrudda.title: Joodrudda
Joodrudda.lead: Joodrudda was a barren, nearly uninhabited world located on the Tingel Route, just outside the borders of the Corporate Sector. Its only point of interest was a sprawling palace constructed hundreds of years before the Battle of Yavin by a clan of eccentric Hutts.

Julio.title: Julio
Julio.lead: Julio was a planet in the Julio system within the Marcol sector. It was known for its mountainous environment.

Jiran VII.title: Jiran VII
Jiran VII.lead: Jiran VII was a planet in the Outer Rim. It contained a monastery, which was also the home of the Zabrak monk Dao Jodh.

Jiroch.title: Jiroch system
Jiroch.lead: The Jiroch system was a star system located in the Yushan sector of the Mid Rim, in grid square K-17 of the Standard Galactic Grid along the Corellian Trade Spine.

Jonsior.title: Jonsior system
Jonsior.lead: Jonsior system was a star system located in the the galaxy's Core Worlds. It was situated at grid square L-10 on the Standard Galactic Grid. Transport to the system was available from the Coruscant Eastern Spaceport.

Juvex.title: Juvex
Juvex.lead: Juvex was the sector capital of Juvex sector. It was ruled by House Sreethyn which engaged in the slave trade, and thus was denied Galactic Republic membership until shortly before the formation of the New Order. It was later part of the New Republic.

Junction V.title: Junction V
Junction V.lead: Junction V, or Junction 5, was the homeworld of Lorian Nod.

Kaal.title: Kaal/Legends

facts.affiliation: Infinite Empire, Brotherhood of Darkness, Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Kaal.lead: A former Rakata colony in the Pre-Republic era, Kaal was a tropical resort world. It was a popular destination for Imperial personnel on leave, though military presence was minimal. Following the Battle of Endor, it was the site of a confrontation between the New Republic, Imperial Admiral Kermen, and the warlord Utoxx Prentioch. The New Republic took control of the world.

Jussafet Four.title: Jussafet Four
Jussafet Four.lead: Jussafet Four was a planet in the Outer Rim attacked by warlord Zsinj. It was a mining world under the Galactic Empire, and its inhabitants also mined the Jussafet asteroids.

Kabray.title: Kabray

facts.region: Mid Rim, The Slice, Trailing Sectors
facts.affiliation: Galactic Empire, Alliance of Free Planets, New Republic

Kabray.lead: Kabray was a Mid Rim forest world orbited by the Kabray Station, a neutral meeting place for diplomats from all over the galaxy.

Kabieroun.title: Kabieroun
Kabieroun.lead: Kabieroun was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories.

Kabaira.title: Kabaira
Kabaira.lead: Kabaira was an Imperial Outer Rim Territories planet in the Teilcam system with damp, foggy weather. Its vast oceans were interrupted by some 2 million volcanic islands, of which only a few in the southern hemisphere were active during the Galactic Civil War. There were two northern island-continents: Belshain and Madieri. Some of the planet's mountains were capped with snow and home to snow-wolves. Delgas Medical and Hydrospeare Corporation were headquartered on Kabaira. The capital city was Eponte Spaceport, which was known for Drayhar's Cantina.

K'zar.title: K'zar
K'zar.lead: K'zar was the first planet orbiting the star C'rel in the N'zoth system. Located in the Core Worlds, it was a searing rock.

Kadok III-A.title: Kadok III-A
Kadok III-A.lead: Kadok III-A was the first planet in the Tertiary Kadok system. It was a searing rock with eight moons.

Jweab VII.title: Jweab VII
Jweab VII.lead: Jweab VII was a planet in the Jweab system where the pirate Beyla Rus had a hidden lodge.

Junkfort Station.title: Junkfort Station/Legends

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, The Slice, Hutt Space (between 1004 BBY and 1000 BBY)
facts.routes: Cadma Conduit, Lesser Lantillian Route, Triellus Trade Route

Junkfort Station.lead: Junkfort Station was an Outer Rim Territories space station located in the Tharin sector at the junction of three hyperlanes. A notable shadowport and spice-smuggling point, Junkfort Station was often visited by starships in order to receive illegal modifications and equipment. Historically located in an area of space influenced by the Hutt species, by 17 BBY Junkfort Station was a part of the Galactic Empire.

K'Farri.title: K'Farri
K'Farri.lead: k'Farri was a planet known to grow crystals. It was located in the Hapes Cluster.

Kadavo.title: Kadavo/Legends
Kadavo.lead: Kadavo was a planet in the Kadavo system of Wild Space. During the Clone Wars, it was under the control of the Zygerrian Slave Empire.

K'ath.title: K'ath
K'ath.lead: K'ath was a planet located in the K'ath system of the Juvex sector, in the Mid Rim of the galaxy. An agriworld, K'ath was most notable for its seashells, which local artisans would craft into figurines. In addition to these trinkets, visitors knew K'ath for its wide beaches and terraced hills.

Junken.title: Junken
Junken.lead: Junken was the first planet orbiting the star Stisste in the Saleucami system. Located in the Suolriep sector of the Outer Rim Territories, it was a searing rock.

Junkfort.title: Junkfort (disambiguation)
Junkfort.lead: Junkfort may refer to one of the following:

Jurio.title: Jurio
Jurio.lead: Jurio was a planet in the Jurio system, a part of the Corva sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was home to the winged creature known as the Juriod fang-flier.

Kaddak.title: Kaddak
Kaddak.lead: Kaddak was a planet located in the Kaddak system of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories, near Rothana. During the New Republic Era, Kaddak was lawless despite efforts by the New Republic to bring it under control.

Junction.title: Junction system (Outer Rim Territories)
Junction.lead: The Junction system was located in the Outer Rim Territories and New Territories along the Hydian Way super-hyperroute, which connected it to the Toprawa and Celanon systems. Situated in the Thesme sector at the coordinates O-5 on the Standard Galactic Grid, the star system had a sun and the celestial body Feriae Junction.

Kaikielius.title: Kaikielius/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Kaikielius.lead: Kaikielius was a planet in the Kaikielius system of the Core Worlds. A regional power before the rise of the Republic and a Core Founder, it was situated on the Koros Trunk Line, just outside of the Deep Core. The planet was the homeworld of the influential political dynasty House Praji.

Kalee.title: Kalee/Legends
Kalee.lead: Kalee was a planet located in the star system of Wild Space that was the homeworld of the Kaleesh species, including General Grievous. It was located on the border of the Kadok Regions.

Kailion.title: Kailion
Kailion.lead: Kailion was the main port world for the 77 Sectors. It was the location of the Kailion caves.

Kadril.title: Kadril
Kadril.lead: Kadril was an inhospitable, irregularly-shaped world colonized by the reptilian Kadrillians in 6 BBY. It was the source of kunda stones. It was here that Darth Vader developed pacifog. The reptilian Kadrillians were the only inhabitants of the planet to survive the planet's bombardment during the Stenax Massacres of 4 ABY.

Kalandis IV.title: Kalandis IV
Kalandis IV.lead: Kalandis IV was an Inner Rim planet located in the Pallis sector. Once situated on the Itani Run hyperlane, during the Galactic Civil War, the planet was the base of operations for Prefect Ursellis of the Galactic Empire. She cooperated with the bounty hunter Tyionsis Cex, who would receive Imperial Legal Authorization for Advanced Confinement Documents from Sub-Prefect Matagorn and deliver individuals captured on the basis of those documents back to Kalandis IV.

Kalaan.title: Kalaan/Legends

facts.terrain: Barren plains, Canyons, Hills, Formerly:, Grassy hills, Plains, Valleys
facts.affiliation: Alliance to Restore the Republic, Galactic Empire

Kalaan.lead: Kalaan was a planet in the Kalaan system and home to a large Rebel base as of 0 BBY. Shortly before the Battle of Yavin, the Galactic Empire launched an invasion of the planet. The Battle of Kalaan reduced Kalaan City to rubble and routed the Rebels.

Kaisa.title: Kaisa
Kaisa.lead: Kaisa was a planet that was once home to the Buro species. However, it was accidentally driven to extinction by the actions of Human geologists.

Kailor V.title: Kailor V
Kailor V.lead: Kailor V was a planet in the Kailor system of the Galactic Core. It was the location of the Imperial Zoological Gardens, the aquaria of which were maintained by the Sedrian Shahlik family. The Design Team Beta research facility of Hydrospeare Corporation was also on Kailor V.

Kail.title: Kail
Kail.lead: Kail was a planet in the Corporate Sector. Torm Dadeferron, an associate of Han Solo, had family on Kail who controlled several large tracts of land known as the Kail Ranges. Torm's father and brother disappeared after a dispute with the Corporate Sector Authority over land-use rights and stock prices.

Kadok III-E.title: Kadok III-E
Kadok III-E.lead: Kadok III-E was the fifth planet in the Tertiary Kadok system. It was a gas giant with seventy-five moons.

Kadok III-C.title: Kadok III-C
Kadok III-C.lead: Kadok III-C was the third planet in the Tertiary Kadok system. It was a barren rock with one moon.

Kadok III-B.title: Kadok III-B
Kadok III-B.lead: Kadok III-B was the second planet in the Tertiary Kadok system. It was a searing rock with fifteen moons.

Kaellin III.title: Kaellin III
Kaellin III.lead: Kaellin III was a backwater planet in the Malenstorr system in the Mid Rim's Corbett sector, inhabited by primitive Human hunters. The Alliance to Restore the Republic attacked an Imperial supply convoy near Kaellin III. An Imperial Delta-class assault shuttle crashed near a local village. The surviving stormtroopers were offered peace by the village elder, but mistook his offer for an attack, and slaughtered the villagers.

Kaer.title: Kaer
Kaer.lead: Kaer was a gas giant in the Siskeen system of the Hunnoverrs sector.

Kal'Shebbol.title: Kal'Shebbol/Legends

facts.routes: Rimma Trade Route, Trition Trade Route
facts.government: Clan and city-state governments (From settlement in 392 BBY until Imperial annexation), Imperial Moff (From c. 2 BBY until 4 ABY) …
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Moff Kentor Sarne, New Republic

Kal'Shebbol.lead: Kal'Shebbol was the primary planet of the Kal'Shebbol system, in the Kathol sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Kal'Shebbol was located on the Trition Trade Route, the hyperlane that connected the major worlds of the sector to the nearby Minos Cluster. The planet was home to a colony during the third Galactic War, but was also settled around 392 BBY by escaped Twi'lek slaves from Ryloth. Kal'Shebbol grew from a small settlement into a major trading world only fifty years after the Twi'lek colonization as sizable Human and alien communities emigrated to the planet in search of a fresh start.

Kalevala.title: Kalevala/Legends
Kalevala.lead: Kalevala was a planet in the Mandalore sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories, where it occupied the fourth orbit of the cognominal Mandalore system. A neighbor of the Mandalorians' traditional homeworld of Mandalore, Kalevala's terrain primarily comprised a toxic desertscape. The planet was host to members of the pacifistic New Mandalorian political faction, and even spawned a noble lineage whence came the Duchess Satine Kryze and Prince Tal Merrik just prior to the Clone Wars.

Kafane.title: Kafane
Kafane.lead: Kafane was a poor agricultural planet that was located within the Kafane system of the galaxy's Hutt Space region. Kafane was connected to the worlds of Nimia and Ulmatra by the hyperlane called the Dead Road.

Kaldahan.title: Kaldahan
Kaldahan.lead: Kaldahan (formerly known as Kanduh) was the home planet of the ancient Kanduh civilization.

Kalandis Seven.title: Kalandis Seven
Kalandis Seven.lead: Kalandis Seven was a desolate planet in the Kalandis system, located in the Pallis sector within the Inner Rim. In 3640 BBY, Kalandis Seven was invaded by the reconstituted Sith Empire sometime after the Battle of Corellia. The Galactic Republic's military forces on the surface struggled to keep a foothold while the Republic and Imperial Navies fought above the planet. During the battle, a Republic squad on the planet's surface, including Sergeant Shanra Immel and Colonel Jace Malcom, was chosen to destroy the local spaceport. The squad's mission was ultimately successful.

Kafrene asteroid belt.title: Kafrene asteroid belt
Kafrene asteroid belt.lead: The Kafrene asteroid belt was an asteroid belt located in the Thand sector of the galaxy's Expansion Region that contained the Ring of Kafrene.

Kalist VI.title: Kalist VI/Legends
Kalist VI.lead: Kalist VI, also known simply as Kalist, was a planet located in the Deep Core. It was the homeworld of Dak Ralter.

Kamar.title: Kamar/Legends
Kamar.lead: Kamar was a dry and arid planet located in Wild Space, home to the insectoid Kamarian species and the howlrunner. It had deserts and mountains across its surface that scorched under the hot-white sun. Various plant life such as the miser-plant, barrel-scrub, and sting-brush sprouted up.

Kalla VII.title: Kalla VII

facts.affiliation: Corporate Sector Authority, Five Worlds, Confederation

Kalla VII.lead: Kalla VII, also simply known as Kalla, was a planet in the Corporate Sector. It was the location of the University of Kalla, an Imperial base, and the headquarters of Unlimited Horizons Inc.

Kalsunor.title: Kalsunor

facts.affiliation: Adas's Sith Empire, Old Sith Empire, Reconstituted Sith Empire, Galactic Republic

Kalsunor.lead: Kalsunor was a planet conquered by the Sith Empire sometime prior to the Golden Age of the Sith. It was close to Begeren and Ashas Ree and was located on the Kamat Aegit.

Kalidorn.title: Kalidorn
Kalidorn.lead: Kalidorn was a planet located in Wild Space. It was the homeworld of the Muttani.

Kalzeron.title: Kalzeron
Kalzeron.lead: Kalzeron was a planet with a feudal civilization. It was the homeworld of the Kalzerian people.

Kalkovak.title: Kalkovak
