Kalkovak.lead: Kalkovak was a remote planet populated by various species including a large sector populated by Quarren. It was a port world for travelers going to the Outer Rim Territories. Illyan Webble was left on the planet after he irritated the crew he was traveling with. Han Solo and Lando Calrissian once frequented the world in search of Webble and his information on the whereabouts of the Yavin Vassilika.

Kalki's Braid.title: Kalki's Braid
Kalki's Braid.lead: Kalki's Braid was an asteroid belt in the Garqi system.

Kaliska.title: Kaliska
Kaliska.lead: Kaliska was a planet in the Mid Rim. The Techno-priests of Kaliska developed the Visualization engine.

Kalis.title: Kalis

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Metharian Nebula Territories

Kalis.lead: Kalis was the third planet in the Derilyn system. It was a harsh and remote world with a thick, boiling atmosphere. There was no life on the world.

Kalki.title: Kalki
Kalki.lead: Kalki was a planet in the Garqi system which had no moons and was covered by searing rock.

Kaloo.title: Kaloo
Kaloo.lead: Kaloo was a planet in the Roon system within the Abrion sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It had no moons and had a terrain of searing hot rock.

Kallidah.title: Kallidah/Legends
Kallidah.lead: Kallidah was a planet that was the homeworld of the Kallidahin species located in the Subterrel sector of the Outer Rim Territories. The planet's Archaeological Research Council established a Research Base on the nearby Polis Massa asteroid colony to try and uncover evidence of an evolutionary link between the Kallidahin and the extinct Eellayin natives. Later, the entire population of Kallidah abandoned their homeworld and moved to Polis Massa to work on the project.

Kallalarra.title: Kallalarra

facts.routes: Durkteel Loop, Great Kashyyyk Branch, Nightroad, Randon Run

Kallalarra.lead: Kallalarra was a toxic hothouse world and the second planet in the Kashyyyk system.

Kamasto.title: Kamasto
Kamasto.lead: Kamasto was a frigid world that was located in the Grumani sector, along the Hydian Way hyperlane, where it orbited an orange dwarf. The world was the site of a number of monasteries that were operated by the Children of Mani, before the religion was divided by a schism. The world was later the site of a number of unsuccessful acts of diplomacy. Between 3701 BBY and 3699 BBY the Hydian Way was charted through Kamasto as part of the Seswenna Expansion.

Kalimahr.title: Kalimahr/Legends
Kalimahr.lead: Kalimahr was a cosmopolitan planet with three moons that was located within the Tython system of the galaxy's Deep Core region. More than thirty-six thousand years before the Battle of Yavin, it was the first planet the non–Force-sensitive settlers of the planet Tython colonized. By 25,793 BBY, Kalimahr had become a business and religious center of the system, boasting a high-density, well-integrated population and cities built out of white metal, along with tall spires. Kalimahr was referred to as the "jewel of the Tython system" by that time.

Kamgeddon.title: Kamgeddon (disambiguation)
Kamgeddon.lead: Kamgeddon may refer to one of the following:

Kalla asteroid belt.title: Kalla asteroid belt
Kalla asteroid belt.lead: An asteroid belt was located in the the Kalla system. It contained a number of luxurious homes built under pressure domes during an Authority fad.

Kalist.title: Kalist VI
Kalist.lead: Kalist VI, also known simply as Kalist, was a barren rocky planet located in the Kalist system of the Deep Core. It was the homeworld of rebel pilot Dak Ralter, who joined Rogue Squadron of the Rebel Alliance. During the Imperial Era, Kalist VI housed a high-surveillance Galactic Empire penal colony.

Kaller.title: Kaller

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems (during occupation), Galactic Empire

Kaller.lead: Kaller was a terrestrial planet with a complex climate located in the Kaller system of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of the Kallerans.

Kamino.title: Kamino/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Zann Consortium

Kamino.lead: Kamino was an aquatic planet located in a remote star system in Wild Space. It was sometimes considered extra-galactic due to being in close proximity to the Rishi Maze dwarf satellite galaxy. It was inhabited by a race of tall, elegant beings called the Kaminoans and the capital world of the Ruling Council, headed by the Prime Minister. Kaminoans kept to themselves and were known for their cloning technology, and for the creation of a clone army for the Galactic Republic.

Kamparas.title: Kamparas

facts.terrain: Rainforests, Grasslands, Rolling hills, Deep valleys
facts.affiliation: Jedi Order, Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Kamparas.lead: Kamparas was a planet in the Dolomar sector of the Core Worlds covered with rainforests, grasslands, rolling hills, and deep valleys.

Karazak.title: Karazak/Legends
Karazak.lead: Karazak was the primary planet in the Karazak system of the Sujimis sector in the Outer Rim Territories. Its surface was riddled with tunnels and caves which the Karazak Slavers Cooperative used as a base of operations. Along with Zygerria and the Thalassian system, Karazak was one of the Outer Rim's slavery capitals.

Kanaver.title: Kanaver

facts.routes: Desevran Trace (c. 25,150 BBY–c. 25,130 BBY), Perlemian Trade Route

Kanaver.lead: Kanaver was an Outer Rim Territories world located in the Tion Cluster's Tion Hegemony sector. By around 25,130 BBY, it was one of the leading worlds of the Livien League confederation, which later became a part of the empire of the Tionese conqueror Xim. Millennia later, Kanaver emerged from a long period of isolation and economic stagnation to become an active regional port.

Kaon.title: Kaon

facts.affiliation: Back Spiral, Xer's Empire, Xim's Empire, Honorable Union of Desevro & Tion, Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems

Kaon.lead: Kaon was a planet in the Tion Cluster. It was inhabited by scranges.

Kamori.title: Kamori/Legends
Kamori.lead: Kamori was a world in the Core Worlds. Its most accomplished artists were sometimes awarded the title of "living treasure", which was granted to the Glanthe painter Dana Dregond around 10 BBY. In 0 ABY, the Zethusian plains on Kamori were struck by a series of powerful groundquakes. They resulted in the deaths of several hundred thousand people and extensive damage to three cities in the area.

Karavis.title: Karavis
Karavis.lead: The Outer Rim Territories celestial body Karavis was a major industrial site for the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. Rebel Alliance General Crix Madine identified it as a possible target in the event that the Alliance campaign Operation Ringbreaker was successful.

Kanawyn Belt.title: Kanawyn Belt
Kanawyn Belt.lead: The Kanawyn Belt was the innermost of two asteroid belts in the Saurton system. The Kanawyns lay inside the orbit of Essowyn.

Kamsul.title: Kamsul
Kamsul.lead: Kamsul was one of seven inhabited worlds in the Stenness System.

Karedda.title: Karedda
Karedda.lead: Karedda was an ice ball and the third planet in the Kessel system.

Kamper.title: Kamper system/Legends
Kamper.lead: The Kamper system was a star system located in the Tapani sector.

Kammia.title: Kammia
Kammia.lead: Kammia was a planet in the extremely remote Drynn system, among the sparsely populated Shiritoku Spur of Wild Space. Kammia was a Human colony world of the Galactic Empire, notable for its rich soil. In the years following the Battle of Yavin, Emperor Palpatine ceded a number of colony worlds, including Kammia, to the Ssi-ruuvi Imperium in exchange for the aliens' species-enslaving entechment technology. The Empire released a news report claiming that a mysterious virus had wiped out the Kammia colony to hide the truth.

Kamur.title: Kamur
Kamur.lead: Kamur was an agricultural world owned by House Petro, and the homeworld of the Thanu species, which inhabited the planet's volcanic regions.

Karatha.title: Karatha
Karatha.lead: Karatha was a planet in the Expansion Region that was the location of the Rebel Alliance base Eyrie Base. The Eyrie was located in a natural sinkhole on the surface of Karatha.

Kar'a'katok.title: Kar'a'katok

facts.government: Democracy (Four millennia prior to the reign of the Galactic Empire)

Kar'a'katok.lead: Kar'a'katok was a Core Worlds planet that was home to the sentient Shimholt species. More than four millennia before the reign of the Galactic Empire, the Nelori Marauders launched a devastating invasion of Kar'a'katok that the Shimholt were able to eventually fight off.

Kampe.title: Kampe
Kampe.lead: Kampe was a Deep Core planet with a Type II atmosphere and an arid climate. By 12 ABY, Superior General Sander Delvardus, a warlord of the Galactic Empire, maintained a fortress in one of Kampe's labyrinthine canyons. Armed presence was light on the Deep Core world, however, due to nearly all of the warlord's money being funneled into the construction of the Super Star Destroyer Night Hammer elsewhere in the system.

Kant.title: Kant
Kant.lead: Kant was a planet located deep within Bothan space. Kant had two moons, which themselves had many asteroid companions. In 3643 BBY, Sith Lord Darth Chratis stationed his division near there.

Kareas.title: Kareas (disambiguation)
Kareas.lead: Kareas may refer to one of the following:

Kanzi.title: Kanzi
Kanzi.lead: Kanzi was a planet located in the Colonies region. A few months after the end of the Clone Wars, the scientist Galen Erso, his wife Lyra and their daughter Jyn rendezvoused with Lieutenant Commander Orson Krennic on Kanzi in the Orona Hotel, where Krennic used kyber crystals to persuade Galen to join Project Celestial Power, an initiative of the Galactic Empire.

Kardura.title: Kardura system
Kardura.lead: The Kardura system was located in the Juvex sector, a part of the Senex-Juvex region of the Mid Rim Territories and the Western Reaches. It was situated in grid square L-17 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

Kashi.title: Kashi
Kashi.lead: Kashi was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Phelleem sector. At one point home to the ancient, isolationist Kashi Mer civilization, it was governed by the Kashi Mer Dynasty, whose influence also extended outside the Kashi system. The Force-user organization known as the Guardians of the Breath played an important role in the Kashi Mer religion.

Karfeddion.title: Karfeddion/Legends

facts.routes: Anturi Reach, Senex-Juvex Loop, Senex Trace
facts.affiliation: House Vandron, Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Karfeddion.lead: Karfeddion was a planet in the Senex sector. It was the homeworld of House Vandron. A large bountiful world, rich with plantations and ranches, it was used as a breeding ground for slaves of various species, including Ossans, Balinaka, and Humans.

Karnst.title: Karnst
Karnst.lead: Karnst was in the Karstaxon Regions of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the location of a Xizor Transport Systems refueling depot.

Karideph.title: Karideph

facts.routes: Trition Trade Route, Rimma Trade Route

Karideph.lead: Karideph was a planet in the Karideph system, a star system in the Outer Rim Territories's resource-rich Minos Cluster. Home of the insectoid Kari species, Karideph's surface was almost entirely dominated by gardens and agricultural fields that provided for the planet's population of more than 88 billion. Discovered by the greater galaxy alongside the rest of the Minos Cluster between 3956 BBY and 3681 BBY, Karideph was the next stop along the Rimma Trade Route after Elrood, and the Trition Trade Route branched off Karideph to connect the Minos Cluster and the Kathol sector to the Rimma.

Karra.title: Karra
Karra.lead: Karra was the Karran homeworld. It was briefly colonized by the Mineral Assets Partnership in 500 BBY. Later, the Galactic Empire established varmigio mines on the planet. Both offworld settlements were destroyed by swarms of insects controlled by the Karran hive mind.

Karvoss II.title: Karvoss II
Karvoss II.lead: Karvoss II was a terrestrial planet in the Core Worlds' Parmorak sector. After the Great Sith War, a Human female from Karvoss II discovered her Force-sensitivity while practicing a form of martial arts. She eventually went on to create the Matukai sect of Force-users.

Karnak Alpha.title: Karnak Alpha
Karnak Alpha.lead: Karnak Alpha was a planet situated beyond the Hapes Cluster and near the Core Worlds. It was the home of the Karnak Alphans. Because the Karnak Alphans were very fond of strange and exotic animals; the planet was home to a number of large alternate environment zoos.

Kariek.title: Kariek
Kariek.lead: Kariek was a planet located in Wild Space. Its sole indigenous sentient lifeform were the Eickarie people, who were divided into various tribes. The Eickaries were a humanoid reptilian race with green and orange skin, with patterns of black scales around their eyes and across the back of their heads.

Kas.title: Kas
Kas.lead: Kas was a planet that was located within the Kamino system in Wild Space. It occupied the first orbit within that star system.

Kasiol 3.title: Kasiol 3

facts.terrain: Forests, River tributaries, Swamps and marshes

Kasiol 3.lead: Kasiol 3, also known as Kasiol's third planet, was a world located in the Outer Rim Territories' Pelgrin sector. Its surface featured forests and numerous swamps. The local fauna included the herlixx, a species of amphibian omnivore that hunted fish and smaller amphibians. Kasiol 3 had been colonized by the time of the reign of the Galactic Empire.

Karinda.title: Karinda
Karinda.lead: Karinda was an arid, dusty Outer Rim Territories planet that lay in the Wazta sector. During the Galactic Civil War, the Galactic Empire maintained a small garrison there, while the Rebel Alliance also constructed a hidden listening outpost on the planet. At one point, the Rebel light freighter Arion Star delivered supplies to the outpost, with the starship's crew experiencing in the process both a rough landing on Karinda and pursuit by an Imperial force from the garrison.

Kashoon.title: Kashoon
Kashoon.lead: Kashoon was a planet that was conquered by the Galactic Empire, and later freed with the help of the Rebel Alliance. The Kashoonara were left to their own devices afterwards.

Karlatt.title: Karlatt
Karlatt.lead: Karlatt was the homeworld of the Morses, a species with a spatial level of technology. It was the first planet in the Karlatt system. It had a temperate climate and moderate precipitation. Its local days lasted 19 hours, and 520 local days made a local year. The planetary capital was Grand Nord.

Kassa.title: Kassa
Kassa.lead: Kassa was the first planet orbiting the binary stars Adega Prime and Adega Besh in the Adega system. Located in the Auril sector of the Outer Rim, it was a searing rock.

Kashir.title: Kashir
Kashir.lead: Kashir was an Expansion Region planet situated in the Vardoss sector. It was home to the Kashirim cultural group, which acquired galactic infamy due to their socially-accepted practice of thievery. Shortly before the First Battle of Geonosis of 22 BBY, Kashir sought admission to the Galactic Republic, and, to that end, the planet's king, Sha-Mar Ma-dred, visited the Republic's capital world, Coruscant, where he had a ritual meeting with Jedi Knight Obi-Wan Kenobi and his Padawan, Anakin Skywalker. Between 12 ABY and 13 ABY, Kashir was a member of the New Republic.

Kastin.title: Kastin
Kastin.lead: Kastin, also known as OM811, was a barren rock planet with no moons. It occupied the closest orbital position around the red giant star Thrantin Major in the Thrantin OM81-A system, a part of the Ollonir Boundaries in the Negs portion of the Colonies.

Kassido.title: Kassido

facts.routes: D'Aelgoth Trade Route, Kassido Bypass, Senex-Juvex Loop

Kassido.lead: Kassido was a terrestrial world located in the Kassido system of the Juvex sector, a part of the Senex-Juvex region in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim. The Senex-Juvex Loop hyperlane linked it to the Manforgon and Ossiathora systems, while the Kassido Bypass and the D'Aelgoth Trade Route connected it to the Yhifar system and the D'Aelgoth sector's Selenius system, respectively.

Karkaris.title: Karkaris/Legends

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, On the border between the Trans-Hydian and the Slice

Karkaris.lead: Karkaris was a waterworld in the Nilgaard sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of the Karkarodons, a species of fearless sentient aquatics.

Karthrexia.title: Karthrexia
Karthrexia.lead: Karthrexia was a world in the Kriz sector of the Outer Rim. Around 5 ABY, a thick survival tent was necessary to withstand the harsh conditions on the Karthrexian glaciers.

Kartoosh.title: Kartoosh
Kartoosh.lead: Kartoosh was an astronomical object in the Western Reaches and Narrant sector of the Mid Rim Territories. It was located along the Cerean Reach hyperspace route. The massive construction and overhaul facility was a shipyard stationed over Kartoosh that saw design work in 23 BBY. In the aftermath of the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and Confederacy of Independent Systems, Kartoosh was left a devastated shell of itself, with a debris cloud of destroyed starships created in orbit around it.

Katorr.title: Katorr
Katorr.lead: Katorr was a gas giant world, the fourth and last planet in the Katorrs system. The star system, which also contained Adumar, was located within the region of the galaxy known as Wild Space.

Katarr.title: Katarr/Legends

facts.population: Millions of Miraluka, Rendered uninhabitable c. 3952 BBY

Katarr.lead: Katarr was a planet in the Mid Rim and a Miraluka colony world. It was completely devastated in 3952 BBY, during the First Jedi Purge.

Kattada.title: Kattada/Legends
Kattada.lead: Kattada was a planet on the Commenor Run in the Colonies.

Katanos VII.title: Katanos VII

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems

Katanos VII.lead: Katanos VII was a mining colony located in the Xan sector of the Mid Rim. After its cortosis mines became depleted, its plight was ignored by the Galactic Senate, so the colonists betrayed the Jedi to the Confederacy.

Kayri III.title: Kayri III
Kayri III.lead: Kayri III was a planet in the Expansion Region that was colonized by the Charon.

Kauron.title: Kauron
Kauron.lead: Kauron was a planet that was located in Kauron system within Meram sector in the Outer Rim Territories of the galaxy. The world was home to the Kauronian species and served as a hideout for the Cavrilhu Pirates.

Kegan.title: Kegan/Legends

facts.affiliation: Xim's Empire, Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Kegan.lead: Kegan was a planet located in the Outer Rim Territories. The planet was run by the Benevolent Guides, who isolated the planet from the rest of the galaxy after having visions of the destruction of Kegan. During the Yuuzhan Vong War, Kegan was conquered by the extragalactic Yuuzhan Vong.

Keedad.title: Keedad
Keedad.lead: Keedad was a remote terrestrial planet located in the Keedad system, a part of the Auril sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was home to the lettrani fruit tree as well as the near-Human Keed species.

Kauron asteroid field.title: Kauron asteroid field
Kauron asteroid field.lead: The Kauron asteroid field was an Outer Rim asteroid belt in the Kauron system. One of the asteroid contained a Cavrilhu Pirates's base.

Kaump III.title: Kaump III
Kaump III.lead: Kaump III was a Mid Rim planet located in the Bruanii sector. Its high gravity led to its native species being short-statured and with a dense body structure. The mercenary and pirate Chanchaz Iryt was born on Kaump III and eventually left his homeworld after committing a series of lucrative robberies in an affluent district of a local city.

Katraasii.title: Katraasii

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Imperial Remnant, Galactic Federation of Free Alliances, Confederation

Katraasii.lead: Katraasii was a planet in Outer Rim Territories.

Kavan.title: Kavan
Kavan.lead: Kavan was a planet in the Hapes Cluster. The planet featured a maze of tunnels, which the local Kavani used as emergency homes during harsh winters.

Kebolar.title: Kebolar
Kebolar.lead: Kebolar was a planet that was used for the removal of colonists from Qiilura. The Republic had already established farms for the colonists.

Keeper's World.title: Keeper's World

facts.terrain: Forests, Jungle, Mountains, Plains, Underground caverns

Keeper's World.lead: Keeper's World, located in the Outer Rim Territories, was the homeworld of The Keeper. It used to be inhabited by the Keeper's makers until they fled the planet during an ancient war.

Kayuk.title: Kayuk
Kayuk.lead: Kayuk was a planet. Ferus Olin once visited there and had a holoconference with Obi-Wan Kenobi.

Keeara Major.title: Keeara Major
Keeara Major.lead: Keeara Major was a world that Sargo VenHalgon had once encountered some trouble.

Katchan.title: Katchan
Katchan.lead: Katchan was a world that was located on the edge the Outer Rim Territories.

Kazarak.title: Kazarak
Kazarak.lead: Kazarak was a planet in the Mahrusha sector of the Outer Rim.

Katalla.title: Katalla
Katalla.lead: Katalla was a planet in the Kastolar sector of the Mid Rim. It was a casino world considered to be a respite from conflict. During the Clone Wars, the Besadii clan had a money funneling scheme with the Separatists. The clan used the Katalla casino to generate funds for the Separatists. The plot was discovered by the Jedi Order.

Kejim.title: Kejim
Kejim.lead: Kejim was the planet where the Kejim Outpost, an Empire Reborn base believed to be abandoned after the destruction of the first Death Star, was located.

Keres I.title: Keres I
Keres I.lead: Keres I was a searing rock planet with no moons that was located in the Empress Teta system.

Keres II.title: Keres II

facts.routes: Byss Run, Another hyperlane (c. 17,000 BBY—c. 11,000 BBY)

Keres II.lead: Keres II, alternatively known as Keres Two, was a frozen rock planet. The planet was located in the Empress Teta system of the Deep Core's Koros sector. By 3643 BBY, a mining outpost was set up to harvest carbonite deposits, though it was abruptly abandoned.

Kelada.title: Kelada/Legends
Kelada.lead: Kelada was a planet in the Anarid Cluster. It was controlled by the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. As the Rebel opposition grew stronger, an increasing number of smugglers frequented the planet, many of them hanging out at Lorana's Labyrinth.

Kerest.title: Kerest/Legends
Kerest.lead: Kerest was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Sluis sector. It was the homeworld of the sentient Kerestian species. At one point more than a millennium before the Battle of Yavin, the Kerestians settled the nearby moons Karoliston and Pharna and launched multiple sublight-speed colony ships toward distant star systems.

Kelrodo-Ai.title: Kelrodo-Ai/Legends
Kelrodo-Ai.lead: Kelrodo-Ai was a planet with famous gelatin mines and known for its water-sculptures. In 12 ABY, its Baron Administrator was Drom Guldi.

Kerensik.title: Kerensik
Kerensik.lead: Kerensik was a terrestrial planet located in the Kerensik system, a part of the Southern Core portion of the Core Worlds. Kerensik was a part of the Allied Region known as the Botor Enclave.

Keltos IV.title: Keltos IV
Keltos IV.lead: Keltos IV was a Mid Rim astronomical object situated in the Irnaj sector. During the Galactic Civil War, it was the site of a military shipyard of the Galactic Empire. Additionally, Imperial Intelligence Sector Plexus facilities were located in the celestial body's orbit. The Rebel Alliance spy droid R2-C3 worked undercover on computer network security there, surreptitiously transmitting to the Alliance information he had recorded from the facilities' computers.

Kendamar.title: Kendamar
Kendamar.lead: Kendamar was a terrestrial planet located in the Kendamar system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Lol sector. Around 10 ABY, it served as the homeworld of Kendamari Casinos, a chain of casinos that constituted a part of the Tenloss Syndicate.

Kelarea.title: Kelarea
Kelarea.lead: Kelarea was a planet located in the Tynna sector of the Expansion Region.

Kem Stor Ai.title: Kem Stor Ai
Kem Stor Ai.lead: Kem Stor Ai was a planet located in the Tennuutta sector of the Mid Rim.

Kemix.title: Kemix
Kemix.lead: Kemix was a barren planet of the Kemix system in the Outer Rim Territories. It had some minor glitterstim deposits located on it and Riboga the Hutt established a spice mine there to mine these. However, the mines were destroyed during the Clone Wars, by the Heroes of Cularin.

Kemla.title: Kemla
Kemla.lead: Kemla was a planet in the Dantus sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Keldooine.title: Keldooine/Legends
Keldooine.lead: Keldooine was a minor trade world that was located within the Keldooine system in Hutt Space, a region of the galaxy controlled by the Hutt species. The planet lay on the Ootmian Pabol hyperlane, which connected it to the planets of Kwenn and Nar Bo Sholla. During the rule of the Galactic Empire, Keldooine served as a customs stop for starships that left Hutt Space.

Kemal.title: Kemal
Kemal.lead: Kemal was a silver-colored gas giant–type planet located in the Kemal Station system, a part of the Arkanis sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was situated on the Triellus Trade Route hyperlane, which linked it to the Andooweel and New Ator systems.

Kenosha.title: Kenosha
Kenosha.lead: Kenosha was a planet in the Expansion Region, known for its cliffs.

Kerev Doi.title: Kerev Doi
Kerev Doi.lead: Kerev Doi was a spice-mining planet in the Kerev Doi system in the Circarpous sector of the Expansion Region that was known for its "colorful," lawless path and its corrupt banking system. The spice producing planet once had pink skies, but after the Imperial occupation, they turned dark. Following the Battle of Yavin, the Imperial Navy officer Thane Kyrell was stationed on the planet. After witnessing the maltreatment of imported Bodach'i slaves, Kyrell, who already had been disillusioned by the Empire's destruction of Alderaan, decided to desert the Empire.

Kellux.title: Kellux
Kellux.lead: Kellux was a planet located in the Kellux system. The Trade Federation had mining facilities on Kellux.

Keresia.title: Keresia
Keresia.lead: Keresia was an astronomical object located within the Keresia system, a part of the Demetras sector within the Outer Rim Territories and Trans-Hydian regions of the galaxy.

Keitum.title: Keitum/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Imperial Remnant

Keitum.lead: Keitum was a Mid Rim planet located in the Ariarch sector. It was the origin point of the Keitumites and was a member of the Galactic Republic and a signatory of the Keitumite Mutual Military Treaty, the latter of which bound it to the planet Ansion. In 22 BBY, the Confederacy of the Independent Systems sought to facilitate the secession of the Keitumite Mutual Military Treaty participants from the Republic; however, the Separatist plans were foiled by a Jedi mission to Ansion, which resulted in the planet and the alliance remaining loyal to the Republic.

Kessel.title: Kessel/Legends

facts.routes: Kessel Run, Kessel Trade Corridor, Rycar's Run
facts.climate: Cold and dry with thin atmosphere; occasionally smoggy
facts.affiliation: Hutt Cartel, Brotherhood of Darkness, Pyke Syndicate, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire, Galactic Federation of Free Alliances, Xim's empire

Kessel.lead: Kessel, originally known as Xo's Eye while under Xim's empire, was a planet located in the Kessel sector, in the Outer Rim Territories, and was near the dangerous celestial bodies of the Maw. It was a prison world, and was home to the galaxy's largest glitterstim spice mining operation. Under Imperial rule, slave labor was in extensive use.

Kerilt.title: Kerilt

facts.region: Mid Rim, The Slice, Trailing Sectors

Kerilt.lead: Kerilt was the innermost planet of the Algaran system, covered by large rainforests. Many surviving Caamasi fled to Kerilt after the bombardment of Caamas by the Galactic Empire, founding the planet's first city, Morymento.

Khar Delba.title: Khar Delba

facts.species: Sith, Sith war behemoth, Sith warbird
facts.affiliation: Ancient Sith Empire, Old Sith Empire

Khar Delba.lead: Khar Delba was an icy, snowy planet in the Sith Worlds, which was part of the Sith Empire as of 5000 BBY. Khar Delba had one moon, Khar Shian, and was located at the edge of Sith Space. It was the home to the Sith war behemoth. Naga Sadow placed a citadel there, but unbeknownst to the rest of the Sith at large, Sadow's Khar Delba citadel was a mere decoy; his real base was on Khar Shian. In 5000 BBY, with Naga Sadow in the midst of a power struggle with his rival, Ludo Kressh, Khar Delba was attacked from orbit by forces loyal to Kressh.

Keyorin.title: Keyorin
Keyorin.lead: Keyorin, also known as the Hunter's World, was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories, and known as a common destination for retired or semi-retired smugglers seeking second careers as entrepreneurs or bank-rollers of those who still flew. Smugglers who decided it was time to go dirtside but couldn't bear getting out of the game sometimes ended up on this planet. The most respected such retiree was typically given informal rule over Keyorin, and known as the Boss. Boss Tinketh Fo controlled the planet as of 4 ABY.

Ketaris.title: Ketaris/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Admiral Gaen Drommel, New Republic, Imperial Remnant, Yuuzhan Vong empire, Fel Empire …

Ketaris.lead: Ketaris was a planet in the Outer Rim which boasted the University of Ketaris. A major trade center, it had a few large continents surrounded by great oceans.

Kestos Minor.title: Kestos Minor/Legends
Kestos Minor.lead: Kestos Minor was a planet. It was represented directly in the Galactic Senate by Ivor Drake.

Kharzet III.title: Kharzet III
Kharzet III.lead: Kharzet III was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories' Mortex sector that was uncharted as of 3 ABY. The planet's lush forests were home a wide variety of plant life, and also to a unique species of gundark known as the long-necked gundark. Princess Leia Organa and C-3PO scouted the planet for possible new location for the Rebel base after the Battle of Hoth, but they they quickly fled after coming under attacked by long-necked gundarks.

Kho Nai.title: Kho Nai
Kho Nai.lead: Kho Nai was an astronomical object located in the Outer Rim Territories. It was the Khotta homeworld.

Ket.title: Ket
Ket.lead: Ket was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Ket system, a part of the Hapes Cluster in the Slice portion of the Inner Rim. It was situated on the Lorell Route hyperlane, which linked it to the Daruvvia and Lovola systems. Its surface featured the Great Dalvechan Deserts, which were home to various succulent plants such as the stillar cactus and where harsh sandstorms could occur. The sentient mammalian species known as the Ketton also hailed from that region. At some point by 2 ABY, the Ketton Derrida had traveled offworld.

Keskin.title: Keskin
Keskin.lead: Keskin was a planet which was the site of a battle during the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and Alliance to Restore the Republic.

Khemerion.title: Khemerion
Khemerion.lead: Khemerion was a planet in the Expansion Region, on which the Separatist Ruusaan Skirata was detained by the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.

Kesh.title: Kesh/Legends
Kesh.lead: Kesh was a remote planet located in Wild Space. It was the homeworld of the Near-Human Keshiri species and an offworld immigrant community of Human Sith known as the Lost Tribe of Sith. Kesh was a terrestrial world with a wide range of different climates and environments including mountains, plains, forests, ocean, and tundra. It had at least three continents in its southern hemisphere: Keshtah, the dominion of the Sith Tribe, Alanciar, and Eshkrene, which was at the South Pole.

Ketal.title: Ketal
Ketal.lead: Ketal was a planet located in the Ketal system in the Inner Rim Territories.

Kess Bela.title: Kess Bela
Kess Bela.lead: Kess Bela was an asteroid belt located between the planets Cala and Ilum in the Ilum system in the Unknown Regions.

Khars.title: Khars
Khars.lead: Khars was the second planet orbiting the star Teth in the Teth system. Located in the Baxel sector of the Outer Rim Territories, it was a gas giant.

Kes.title: Kes

facts.region: Inner Rim, Northern Dependencies, The Slice

Kes.lead: Kes was a terrestrial planet located in the Tirahnn system, within the Zeemacht Cluster sector of the Inner Rim. Kes occupied the fifth orbital position around the star Tirahnn and had no moons. It featured a frozen rock surface and frigid climate. Along with the rest of its star system, the planet was located on the Perlemian Trade Route hyperlane, which in the Inner Rim served as the dividing line between the regions known as the Northern Dependencies and the Slice.

Kestavel.title: Kestavel
Kestavel.lead: Kestavel was a planet located in the Colonies, near Borleias. It was the location of The Lucky Twi'lek. The crew of the Uhumele ambushed Darth Vader there in 19 BBY.

Keros.title: Keros
Keros.lead: Keros was the homeworld of the predatory species cidwen.

Kerroc.title: Kerroc
Kerroc.lead: Kerroc was an inhospitable planet allied with the First Order. During the Cold War, the Resistance hired Sidon Ithano and the crew of the Meson Martinet to infiltrate a First Order facility on Kerroc to steal an AAL-1971/9.1 Troop Transport needed to rescue Gial Ackbar, an important Resistance leader.

Kergans.title: Kergans
Kergans.lead: Kergans was a urban planet located in the Kergans system within the Inner Rim Territories that was protected by the New Republic. It was the homeworld of Lorica Demaris. A hotel owned by Lorica's mother and father was located on Kergans. At some point before joining the Resistance, Lorica watched podracing on her homeworld.

Kiffex.title: Kiffex/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire

Kiffex.lead: Kiffex was the smaller sister planet of Kiffu in the Azurbani system of the Inner Rim. It had rich soil, giving Kiffex the potential to become a major agriculture producing planet.

Khomm.title: Khomm/Legends
Khomm.lead: Khomm was a planet in the Khomm system in the Deep Core of the galaxy with wide blue seas, great land masses, and an abundance of oxygen. It was the home planet to the Khommites and the Khommite striders.

Kilmaulsias.title: Kilmaulsias
Kilmaulsias.lead: Kilmaulsias was a planet in the Vorzyd Cluster. It was the homeworld of the Kilmaulsi.

Kidron.title: Kidron/Legends

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Metharian Nebula Territories
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Kidron.lead: Kidron was a planet in Elrood sector, on the Elrood-Derilyn Trade Route. It was the homeworld of the sentient Orfite species as well as the quamin and slork creatures. Attakril Meats also operated on the planet.

Kimanan.title: Kimanan
Kimanan.lead: Kimanan was a planet in the Orus sector of the the galaxy's Inner Rim. It was where the pets known as furballs came from.

Kiffu.title: Kiffu/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire

Kiffu.lead: Kiffu was a planet in the outermost reaches of the Inner Rim. It was the homeworld of the Kiffar species.

Kidriff 5.title: Kidriff 5
Kidriff 5.lead: Kidriff 5, or Kidriff Five, was the most coreward world in Zsinj's space. It was a wealthy trade depot along several hyperroutes. It developed heavy alloys used to improve TIE hulls. Its gleaming cityscapes were similar to those of Coruscant. It had blue seas and rusty red forests. Kidriff 5 was one of the stops for the Millennium Falsehood when it was making its tour of deception.

Kidiet Olgo.title: Kidiet Olgo
Kidiet Olgo.lead: Kidiet Olgo was a celestial body and a shadowport located in the Kidiet Olgo system, a part of the Northern Dependencies portion of the Core Worlds. A hyperlane connected it to the Mamendin system of the Farrfin sector. Graxol Kelvyyn, an Anx enslaver operating throughout the Outer Rim Territories around 32 BBY, associated himself with a network of enslaved beings' smugglers, some of which made their living at Kidiet Olgo.

Kilia IV.title: Kilia IV/Legends

facts.terrain: Mountains, Rocky badlands, One lush valley, Keeps, Castles

Kilia IV.lead: Kilia IV was the homeworld of Kilian Rangers and Kilian Banthas.

Killaniri.title: Killaniri
Killaniri.lead: Killaniri was a gas giant world that was located within the Killaniri system. It was the second of two orbital bodies around its star. The planet possessed fifteen known moons.

Kile II.title: Kile II
Kile II.lead: Kile II was a terrestrial and geologically unstable planet located in the Jospro sector of the Outer Rim. Within its canyons, the Galactic Empire established multiple installations, including a sensor array and the spaceport Enclave, an enormous facility that supported the Empire's naval operations in the sector. During the Galactic Civil War, the planet was the site of a battle between the Empire and the Rebel Alliance, ending in a victory for the latter.

Kiilimaar.title: Kiilimaar
Kiilimaar.lead: Kiilimaar was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories.

Kich.title: Kich
Kich.lead: Kich was a hot terrestrial planet with no moons. It was located in the Rannon system, a part of the Instrop sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The planet occupied the second closest orbit to its star, the yellow-white Rannon.

Khorm.title: Khorm/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems

Khorm.lead: Khorm was a frozen planet located in the Mid Rim, home to the Khormai species. It was one of the few planets that contained an extremely rare ore called Agrocite that could be used to enhance the power of turbolasers. During The Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems, Khormai warlord Unger Gout betrayed his people and enslaved them to mine Agrocite for Dooku. This resulted in a major Republic offensive led by Plo Koon, Kit Fisto, and Tauht at the Battle of Khorm.

Khubeaie.title: Khubeaie
Khubeaie.lead: Khubeaie was a nondescript industrial planet located in the Khubeaie system, a part of the Arkanis sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was situated at the endpoint of the Vaschean Way hyperlane, which linked it to the Heffrin system, while the hyperspace route known as the Old Corellian Run connected it to the Vor Deo system as well as the Ryloth system of the Gaulus sector.

Khonji Seven.title: Khonji Seven
Khonji Seven.lead: Khonji Seven was a world that was located just outside the Brunet system.

Kholes.title: Kholes
Kholes.lead: Kholes was a planet in Imperial space and the home of a Rebel outpost. In 1 ABY, soon after an outbreak of Bledsoe's disease on the nearby planet Tay'ah'loo, the Rebel outpost was wiped out by Imperial forces.

Kimm Aurek.title: Kimm Aurek
Kimm Aurek.lead: Kimm Aurek was a dingy industrial world located in the Kimm Aurek system, one of the Kimm systems of the Juvex sector, which was itself a part of the Senex-Juvex region in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim. It lay on the hyperlane known as the Senex-Juvex Loop, which connected it to the Juvex and Kimm Besh systems. Similarly to its Senex-Juvex Loop neighbors Kimm Besh and Kimm Cresh, Kimm Aurek was under the control of House Sreethyn, one of the aristocratic Ancient Houses of the region.

Kimm Cresh.title: Kimm Cresh
Kimm Cresh.lead: Kimm Cresh was a planet located in the Kimm Cresh system of the Juvex sector, in the Mid Rim of the galaxy. It was one of a trio of dingy industrial worlds belonging to House Sreethyn.

Kiamurr.title: Kiamurr
Kiamurr.lead: Kiamurr was a world located in the Likasha sector of the Mid Rim.

Kintan.title: Kintan/Legends

facts.terrain: Rocky wastelands, Archipelagos, Forests, Swamps, Magma fields
facts.species: Nikto, Kintan crusher, Historic: Kintan strider
facts.affiliation: Hutt Empire, Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Yuuzhan Vong empire, Confederation

Kintan.lead: Kintan was the homeworld of the Nikto. After a supernova explosion near the system, evolution of the Nikto divided into five subspecies. Kintan was located within the Si'Klaata Cluster, on the Ac'fren Spur.

Kinyen.title: Kinyen/Legends

facts.routes: Corellian Trade Spine, Great Gran Run
facts.affiliation: Infinite Empire, Galactic Republic, Trade Federation, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Galactic Federation of Free Alliances

Kinyen.lead: Kinyen was an agriworld in the Expansion Region, located on the Corellian Trade Spine at the junction to the Great Gran Run. It was the Gran homeworld, with a recorded history dating back to 10,000 BBY. Though it was an outpost of the violent Rakata during the Pre-Republic era, during its recorded history, the planet has had no local wars. At the time of the Clone Wars, Senator Kharrus represented Kinyen in the Galactic Senate.

Kirrek.title: Kirrek

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Kirrek.lead: Kirrek was a planet in the Empress Teta system. It was the site of two important battles: a first during the Unification Wars and a later one the Great Hyperspace War. In the former, it was the last world to fall to Empress Teta. In the latter, it was attacked by the Sith Empire, which was easily repelled by the Galactic Republic.

Kip.title: Kip
Kip.lead: Kip was a planet in the Outer Rim's Chorlian sector and the homeworld of the Kip species. It was a source of ulikuo gemstones. It was a damp mud-ball riddled with caves. Zorba Desilijic Tiure was imprisoned on Kip in 22 BBY, shortly before the Clone Wars. After the Battle of Endor, in 5 ABY, Ysanne Isard arranged for pirates to take over Kip and free Zorba. Kip years were roughly equal to three standard years.

Kirtania.title: Kirtania

facts.government: Competing economic states (Dulai, Kinkosa, and Surana)
facts.affiliation: Kinkosa State allied with Galactic Empire at some point during the Galactic Civil War

Kirtania.lead: Kirtania was the homeworld of the spider-like, pacifist Araquia people. The Kubaz crime lord Schnil Hakoon settled on the planet and centered his operations in Kinkosa City.

Kinooine.title: Kinooine/Legends

facts.affiliation: Nagai expeditionary force, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Kinooine.lead: Kinooine was a planet located in Wild Space. Kinooine served as the main staging point for the Nagai–Tof War in 4 ABY. A world devoid of sentient life before the Nagai's arrival, Kinooine became the site of two duels between the "Dark Lady of the Sith" Lumiya and Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker, who was unable to prevent the Nagai from seizing the planet. After the ultimate Nagai defeat, Kinooine became home to a population of refugee Firrerreo.

Kiribi.title: Kiribi
Kiribi.lead: Kiribi was a planet located in the Colonies. Its galactic coordinates were 099, 099, 011. Although it was located 5000 light-years away from Coruscant, because Kiribi's coordinates were positive and began with zero, it was part of the Imperial Center Oversector during the Imperial Period.

Kir.title: Kir

facts.routes: Authority Guardian Corridor, Solenbaran Merchant Route

Kir.lead: Kir was a planet that was located within the Corporate Sector. A mineral found on this planet was used in the production of crystalline vertex.

Kins.title: Kins
Kins.lead: Kins was a terrestrial planet located in the Vulpter system of the Deep Core. It occupied the second orbital position around its star, Vulpter. The planet featured a toxic environment and a rocky surface, and it had one moon.

Kirian.title: Kirian
Kirian.lead: Kirian was the third planet in the Tirahnn system of the Inner Rim.

Kintoni.title: Kintoni/Legends
Kintoni.lead: Kintoni was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories that contained a single city with several towns, the rest being farmland. It contained Tinegris Street. New Republic forces occupied a former Imperial garrison on Kintoni circa 4 ABY, where Governor Barkale was held prisoner. Mara Jade infiltrated the base and assassinated Barkale on the behalf of Palpatine for stealing credits over the past ten years.

King's Galquek.title: King's Galquek
King's Galquek.lead: King's Galquek, sometimes referred to as Kay-Gee or K-G, was a planet located in the Meridian sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Kirtarkin.title: Kirtarkin/Legends
Kirtarkin.lead: Kirtarkin was a smoky world of pollution and machinery that traditionally served as the customs checkpoint for the Twin Nebulae sectors in the Greater Javin region of the Outer Rim Territories. Located along the Corellian Trade Spine in the Anoat sector, Kirtarkin collected billions in revenue annually from import/export taxes. During the Galactic Empire's rule, the Imperial Star Destroyer Desolator staged from Kirtarkin while patrolling the Greater Javin.

Kinun Depot.title: Kinun Depot
Kinun Depot.lead: Kinun Depot was a location where the Rodian slaver Malak made a stop sometime before 0 ABY, to refuel her ship. During this time her captured prey, Myo, escaped from his custody. Myo then met the musician Lirin Car'n, and the two became associates. Car'n helped Myo to reach Tatooine.

Kiros.title: Kiros/Legends
Kiros.lead: Kiros was an idyllic world filled with vast green valleys and flowing waterfalls. Located in the Expansion Region, the planet served as the site of a colony of Togruta artists.

Kindlabethia.title: Kindlabethia

facts.affiliation: Galactic Empire, Pentastar Alignment, Imperial Remnant

Kindlabethia.lead: Kindlabethia was a planet in the Braxant sector of the Outer Rim.

Kinoss.title: Kinoss/Legends
Kinoss.lead: Kinoss was a planet that was located within the Kinoss system, in the Chiss Space sector of the galaxy's Unknown Regions. It was connected by the Cressus Route hyperlane to the Bogo Rai system, and other hyperspace routes linked the planet to the Avidich system and to regions lying west of the core territory of the Chiss Ascendancy, the government of the Chiss species.

Kinzor.title: Kinzor
Kinzor.lead: Kinzor was a planet where Professor Schardak studied in the local archaeological museum.

Kirdo.title: Kirdo III
Kirdo.lead: Kirdo III, also referred to simply as Kirdo, was a planet located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories, that was the homeworld of the Kitonak species On the way back from Rodia, Luke Skywalker forged a new hyperspace lane between Kirdo and Orto Plutonia.

Kinrah.title: Kinrah
Kinrah.lead: Kinrah was a planet located in the star system of the same name in the Mid Rim Territories.

Klatooine.title: Klatooine/Legends

facts.affiliation: Hutt Empire, Galactic Empire, Confederation, Galactic Federation of Free Alliances

Klatooine.lead: Klatooine was the arid homeworld of the Klatooinian species. It was within the Si'Klaata Cluster, under Hutt control. It was covered with deserts and, to a lesser extent, savannas.

Koboth.title: Koboth
Koboth.lead: Koboth was the Kobok homeworld. It was located in the Outer Rim Territories, on the fringe of the Tingel Arm. It bordered the Corporate Sector.

Koda's World.title: Koda's World
Koda's World.lead: Koda's World, sometimes referred to as Krin Koda after the scout of the same name, was a planet located in the Unknown Regions, in the Tarin system. It is devoid of any advanced installations, as it is home to the primitive Tempestro. This temperate planet had warm, moist, breathable air.

Kloper.title: Kloper
Kloper.lead: Kloper was a New Republic member planet, and the homeworld of the Kloperian species.

Kiva.title: Kiva

facts.terrain: Rocky (after it was destroyed by Project Starscream)

Kiva.lead: Kiva was a planet that was located within the Mid Rim. Its indigenous Kivan people were wiped out by Project Starscream, to the utter horror of Shi'ido anthropologist Mammon Hoole. The only remnants of the people were shadowy wraiths.

Koba.title: Koba
Koba.lead: Koba was a planet on the Cerean Reach in the Mid Rim. It was ravaged by Tulak the Advozse warlord, but later protected from his son Kalut by Jedi Knight Yaddle.

Kktkt.title: Kktkt
Kktkt.lead: Kktkt was a planet in the Farlax sector in the Galactic Core.

Kluistar.title: Kluistar
Kluistar.lead: Kluistar was a planet on the border of the Colonies region, and was considered a comfortable if undistinguished world.

Kissarm.title: Kissarm
Kissarm.lead: Kissarm was a gas giant in the Deep Core's Beshqek system. The planet was orbited by nine moons and occupied the sixth orbital position around the star Beshqek.

Kleeva.title: Kleeva
Kleeva.lead: Kleeva was a massive gas giant located within Hutt Space. It was orbited by at least three moons, including Boonda's Moon and Vultee-Pietsch.

Kobbahn.title: Kobbahn
Kobbahn.lead: Kobbahn was an Outer Rim planet near the border of the Unknown Regions. It was the location of one of the earliest Rebel cells in the days following the declaration of the New Order.

Kismaano.title: Kismaano
Kismaano.lead: Kismaano was a world in the Tion Cluster of the Outer Rim Territories.

Kobal's World.title: Kobal's World/Legends
Kobal's World.lead: Kobal's World was a planet in the Koradin sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Kobal's World was the site of significant Imperial atrocities during the era of the Galactic Civil War, including the slaughter of a number of women and children by stormtroopers. One of those stormtroopers later accompanied Darth Vader to Cheelit, where the Guild of Vindicators assassin Clat the Shamer used the memories to compel the soldier to commit suicide.

Koaan.title: Koaan
Koaan.lead: Koaan was a planet near Nar Shaddaa. It was temperate and had many green hills. It was home to the Galactic Research Academy. Whenever an exploration party discovered a new planet, they sent information to this facility for processing. Under the Galactic Empire, the processing was greatly slowed down and it was considered by some as a convenient source for uninhabited planets.

Koda.title: Koda Space Station
Koda.lead: Koda Space Station, sometimes referred to simply as Koda, was a tiny spaceport in a backwater corner of the Outer Rim Territories as the end of the Koda Spur.

Kli'aar.title: Kli'aar
Kli'aar.lead: Kli'aar was a planet located on the Pinooran Spur in the Gordian Reach. It was inhabited by the Kli'aari, a four-armed species that were largely known for their mechanical skills. Many Kli'aari enclaves could be found on planets around the Reach.

Kith asteroid belt.title: Kith asteroid belt

facts.region: Mid Rim, Kashyyyk Region, The Slice

Kith asteroid belt.lead: The Kith asteroid belt was an asteroid belt in the Boz Pity system.

Kiskua.title: Kiskua

facts.routes: Oktos Route, Ootmian Pabol, Pabol Hutta, Shag Pabol

Kiskua.lead: Kiskua was a gas giant–type planet with eighteen moons that was located within the Y'Toub system of the galaxy's Hutt Space region. The planet occupied the fifth orbital position around its star, Y'Toub, and lay on the junction of four hyperlanes called the Oktos Route, the Ootmian Pabol, the Pabol Hutta, and the Shag Pabol. The Oktos Route connected Kiskua to the planet of Kleeva while the Ootmian Pabol linked the planet to the world of Du Hutta. In addition to that, the routes of Pabol Hutta and Shag Pabol joined Kiskua with the planets of Hosko and Rorak 4, respectively.

Kler'terria.title: Kler'terria system/Legends
Kler'terria.lead: The Kler'terria system was a part of the Core Worlds that was home to the sentient Kler'terrian species.

Kisen.title: Kisen
Kisen.lead: Kisen was one of the three asteroid belts of the Isen system in Outer Rim Territories.

Koensayr.title: Koensayr
Koensayr.lead: Koensayr was a planet in the Colonies region. It was the headquarters of Koensayr Manufacturing. A Gran colony, in addition to industrializing most of the planet, the lower latitudes contain a small, seaside tourism industry, with vibrant colorful sunsets being a standout feature.

Kooriva.title: Kooriva/Legends

facts.affiliation: Infinite Empire, Galactic Republic, Corporate Alliance, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Galactic Federation of Free Alliances

Kooriva.lead: Kooriva was a terrestrial, tropical planet located within the Kooriva system of the Inner Rim. The adopted homeworld of the Koorivar species, the planet was purchased by the horned-humanoids after a lengthy legal battle with the Galactic Republic. While the planet suffered an economic crisis under the reign of the Humanocentric-biases of the Galactic Empire, Kooriva recovered and thrived under both New Republic and Galactic Alliance rule.

Kolatill.title: Kolatill

facts.affiliation: Kolatill Council (Until annexation by the Galactic Empire), Galactic Empire (Until 8 ABY when the Imperial governor was overthrown by native population) …

Kolatill.lead: Kolatill was a planet located in the Kolatill system within the Kathol sector of the Outer Rim Territories. A stopping point for ships plying their business on the Trition Trade Route, the planet was located several days' travel from the sector capital, Kal'Shebbol. Noted as one of the sector's major repulsorlift manufacturing centers, Kolatill was ruled by the Kolatill Council until Imperial Moff Kentor Sarne was appointed to administer the Kathol sector in 2 BBY.

Kodai.title: Kodai
Kodai.lead: Kodai was a remote planet in the Belderone sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Some time prior to 29 BBY, its entire surface had been flooded save for the city of Rena., ]]The Jedi Order took advantage of Kodai's oceans to dispose of the holocron of King Adas. The Sith holocron was buried under millions of tons of water, deep in an underwater geyser crater, in the hopes that no one else would fall under Adas's influence and the powerful pull of the dark side., In 29 BBY, the Jedi, with the aid of the Quermian expert on the Sith, Murk Lundi, recovered the holocron from beneath Kodai's oceans.

Kojash.title: Kojash

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Duskhan League

Kojash.lead: Kojash was one of two mining colonies on the perimeter of the Koornacht Cluster, founded by the Morath. Along with the other settlement on Elcorth, it was conquered and depopulated by the Yevetha during the Great Purge.

Koli.title: Koli

facts.sector: Duro sector, Corellian sector; Outlier systems (Imperial)

Koli.lead: Koli was a planet located in the Duro system.

Kodasta.title: Kodasta
Kodasta.lead: Kodasta was a planet in the Essesia system.

Kol Huro VII.title: Kol Huro VII
Kol Huro VII.lead: Kol Huro VII was one of seven inhabited worlds in the Kol Huro system.

Kolaador.title: Kolaador
Kolaador.lead: Kolaador was a planet in the Kolaador system of the Outer Rim Territories.

Koltine.title: Koltine
Koltine.lead: Koltine was a Wild Space world located within the star system of the same name as part of the Jahilid Drift region. More than a decade after the establishment of the Galactic Empire, the Kaleesh Imperial General Bentilais san Sk'ar led a strike force in conquering Koltine and other worlds along the Jahilid Drift. Sk'ar's victories there led to a boost in his reputation among Imperial admirals.

Koozebane.title: Koozebane
Koozebane.lead: Koozebane was a planet located in the Outer Rim Territories.

Kor Besadii.title: Kor Besadii
Kor Besadii.lead: Kor Besadii was a swampy Hutt Space planet. Located in the Bootana Hutta region, it served as the throneworld of the Besadii clan of the Hutt species. The Besadii maintained vast palaces and opulent estates in the planet's swamps, and the structures were maintained by enslaved beings who frequently mounted escape attempts and even revolts.

Kor Hestilic.title: Kor Hestilic
Kor Hestilic.lead: Kor Hestilic was a world located within the Kor Hestilic system, a part of the Bootana Hutta region of Hutt Space, and was part of the Slice section of the galaxy. It was connected by hyperlanes to the Kor Besadii, Kor Nijiladii, Kor Vosadii, Mulatan and Nar Chunna systems.

Kor Desilijic.title: Kor Desilijic

facts.terrain: Lowlands and swamps, Rocky mountain ranges

Kor Desilijic.lead: Kor Desilijic was a Hutt Space planet situated in the Bootana Hutta region. It featured expansive swamps as well as great mountain ranges. The Hutt Desilijic clan established Kor Desilijic as a throneworld while the clan was regaining its power and prestige following the end of the Hutt Cataclysms around 15,000 BBY. The planet housed vast estates, including the ancient Rasmal Valley Palace, that the Desilijic used to store their large amount of accumulated treasure as well as a vacation site and a secure hideout when needed.

Kor Anjiliac.title: Kor Anjiliac
Kor Anjiliac.lead: Kor Anjiliac was a world located in the Kor Anjiliac system, a part of the Bootana Hutta area in the Hutt Space portion of the Slice. It was connected by a hyperlane to the Huloon and Langoona systems. Kor Anjiliac served as the throneworld of the Anjiliac clan of the Hutt species.

Kor Gejalli.title: Kor Gejalli
Kor Gejalli.lead: Kor Gejalli was a world located in the Kor Gejalli system, a part of the Bootana Hutta area in the Hutt Space portion of the Slice. It was connected by hyperlanes to the Groth and Kor Trinivii systems. Kor Gejalli served as the throneworld of the Gejalli clan of the Hutt species; however, at some point by the time of the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Rebel Alliance, the Anjiliac clan defeated the Gejalli in a clan war and took over its holdings, including Kor Gejalli.

Komnor.title: Komnor
Komnor.lead: Komnor was a planet located within the Outer Rim Territories. The planet was absorbed into Xim's Empire as he expanded his borders from the Kingdom of Cron. A few years before the Galactic Civil War, Han Solo met Chewbacca during a skirmish near Komnor. A vicious warlord later arrived in the system and evicted the Hutts from their home. The homeless Hutts complained to Jabba Desilijic Tiure, who assigned Dyyz Nataz with the job of assassinating the warlord.

Kol Atorn.title: Kol Atorn
Kol Atorn.lead: Kol Atorn was an astronomical object located in the Outer Rim Territories' Kanz sector. It was settled by Mandalorian emigrants and exiles. An individual grew up in the alleys of Kol Atorn and learned an accented version of the Mando'a language from the celestial body's settlers. The individual eventually became a famed Mandalorian leader with the title Mandalore the Hammerborn.

Kor Bareesh.title: Kor Bareesh
Kor Bareesh.lead: Kor Bareesh was a planet located in the Bootana Hutta region of Hutt Space. It was the ruined throneworld of the Bareesh kajidic.

Konkiv.title: Konkiv
Konkiv.lead: Konkiv was a remote jungle planet in the Outer Rim Territories, located within the Konkiv system in the Cadma sector.

Korriban.title: Korriban/Legends

facts.routes: Daragon Trail, Kamat Krote, Nache Bhelfia
facts.terrain: Mountains, Canyons, Dry riverbeds, Swamps, Deserts, Tombs, Ruins
facts.population: Historic (Sith Empire): 9.6 billion, under 94% Sith, 6% Other, Historic (Jedi Civil War): 25,000, Historic (Rise of the Empire era): few thousands …
facts.language: Modern: Galactic Basic Standard, Formerly: Sith
facts.government: Modern: None, Formerly: Sith Empire, Magocratic dictatorship
facts.affiliation: Sith species, Adas's Sith Empire, Infinite Empire, Xim's empire, Old Sith Empire, Brotherhood of the Sith/Exar Kun's Sith Empire, Darth Revan's Sith Empire …

Korriban.lead: Korriban, known as Horusar and Grevid as well as Pesegam during the reign of Xim and Moraband during the Clone Wars, was the sole planet in the Horuset system, located across the galaxy from Koros Major. It was the original homeworld of the Sith species and a sacred planet for the Sith, housing the tombs for many ancient and powerful Dark Lords of the Sith and containing immense dark side power.

Korev VII.title: Korev VII
Korev VII.lead: Korev VII was an astronomical object that occupied the seventh orbital position in the Korev system, a part of the Zaric sector in the Slice portion of the Inner Rim. At some point between 0 ABY and 4 ABY, Moff Linis of the Galactic Empire issued from Korev VII a bounty on the Wookiee Cherioer.

Korda Six.title: Korda Six
Korda Six.lead: Korda Six was a planet that ranged from barren rocky plains to small forests in which the natives lived. It was also where Montross betrayed Jaster Mereel to the Death Watch. Jaster was killed by Tor Vizsla, and Jango Fett became the Mandalore.

Korbin.title: Korbin
Korbin.lead: Rebel lieutenant Ayla Shar was a native of Korbin.

Korlings.title: Korlings
Korlings.lead: Korlings was a planet in the Korlings system, located in the Outer Rim, and home to a noble family. It was rumored to be the homeworld of the notorious pirate Faarl the Conqueror.

Korriba Scar.title: Korriba Scar

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories; Stygian Caldera, Trans-Hydian

Korriba Scar.lead: Korriba Scar was a debris belt orbiting in front of Korriban in the Horuset system.

Korfin.title: Korfin

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, New Territories, Trans-Hydian
facts.routes: Hydian Way, Junction-Tierell Loop, Thesme Trace

Korfin.lead: Korfin was a planet in the Feriae system in the Thesme sector.

Korphir.title: Korphir
Korphir.lead: Korphir was an Imperial planet during the Galactic Civil War.

Kormoran.title: Kormoran
Kormoran.lead: Kormoran was an astronomical object located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories that was a site of an Imperial attack. During the blitz, TIE Fighters were sent in to clear the roads of over 90,000 refugees. After the attack, one of the TIE pilots went AWOL and joined the Rebellion. He later became an X-wing pilot.

Kordu.title: Kordu
Kordu.lead: Kordu was a planet located in the Mid Rim's Kordu sector. The Kriss were native to the planet.

Kor Nasirii.title: Kor Nasirii
Kor Nasirii.lead: Kor Nasirii was a world located within the Kor Nasirii system, a part of the Bootana Hutta region of Hutt Space, and was part of the Slice section of the galaxy. It was connected by a hyperlane to the Kor Vosadii system.

Kor Vosadii.title: Kor Vosadii
Kor Vosadii.lead: Kor Vosadii was a planet located in the Bootana Hutta region of Hutt Space. It was the throneworld of the Vosadii kajidic.

Kor Nijiladii.title: Kor Nijiladii
Kor Nijiladii.lead: Kor Nijiladii was a world located within the Kor Nijiladii system, a part of the Bootana Hutta region of Hutt Space, and was a part of the Slice section of the galaxy. It was connected by a hyperlane to the Kor Hestilic system.

Kor Utoradii.title: Kor Utoradii
Kor Utoradii.lead: Kor Utoradii was a world located within the Kor Utoradii system, a part of the Bootana Hutta region of Hutt Space, and was part of the Slice section of the galaxy. It was connected by hyperlanes to the Kor Hunamma and Nar Chunna systems.

Kor Hunamma.title: Kor Hunamma
Kor Hunamma.lead: Kor Hunamma was a world located within the Kor Hunamma system, a part of the Bootana Hutta region of Hutt Space. It was part of the Slice section of the galaxy. It was connected by hyperlanes to the Kor Usilic and Kor Utoradii systems.

Kor Usilic.title: Kor Usilic
Kor Usilic.lead: Kor Usilic was a world located within the Kor Usilic system, a part of the Bootana Hutta region of Hutt Space. It was situated in the Slice section of the galaxy. It was connected by hyperlanes to the Gos Hutta and Kor Hunamma systems.

Kor Oktanivii.title: Kor Oktanivii
Kor Oktanivii.lead: Kor Oktanivii was a world located within the Kor Oktanivii system, a part of the Bootana Hutta region of Hutt Space. It was part of the Slice section of the galaxy. It was connected by hyperlanes to the Gos Hutta and Pybus systems.

Kor Jiramma.title: Kor Jiramma
Kor Jiramma.lead: Kor Jiramma was a world located in the Kor Jiramma system, a part of the Bootana Hutta area in the Hutt Space portion of the Slice. A hyperlane linked it to the Huloon system. Kor Jiramma was the throneworld of the Jiramma clan of the Hutt species, and its proximity to the throneworld Kor Vanderijar was a reason for partnership between the Jiramma and the Vanderijar clan.

Kor Trinivii.title: Kor Trinivii
Kor Trinivii.lead: Kor Trinivii was a world located within the Kor Trinivii system, a part of the Bootana Hutta region of Hutt Space. It was situated in a part of the Slice section of the galaxy. It was connected by a hyperlane to the Kor Gejalli system.

Korfo II.title: Korfo II/Legends
Korfo II.lead: Korfo II was a celestial body located in the Korfo system. It was a part of the Arrowhead, the Slice portion of the Core Worlds. Korfo II lay on the Commenor Run hyperlane, which linked it to the Cirius and Tepasi systems. It shared its name with the Imperial Bank of Korfo II, and during the Galactic Civil War, the Galactic Empire maintained the position of Imperial Liaison Officer to Korfo II, with Lieutenant Pandur holding the position at one point.

Kothlis.title: Kothlis/Legends

facts.terrain: Oceans, Tropical islands, Plains, Tundra, Forests, Mountains, Urban
facts.government: Imperial consul-general with Bothan colonial board
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Galactic Federation of Free Alliances, Confederation

Kothlis.lead: Kothlis was a Bothan colony world located in the Kothlis system of the Bothan sector in the Mid Rim. It was the fourth of seven planets in the star system.

Kowak.title: Kowak/Legends
Kowak.lead: Kowak was a tropical planet in the Outer Rim and the homeworld of the Kowakian monkey-lizard species.

Krant.title: Krant

facts.affiliation: Old Sith Empire, Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Alliance to Restore the Republic, New Republic

Krant.lead: Krant was a wilderness planet in the Bothan Space in the Mid Rim. It saw action from the Clone Wars and the Galactic Civil War, and the Jedi Master Echuu Shen-Jon hid on Krant during decades until Princess Leia Organa appeared on the planet, searching for the Bothan agent Utric Sandov.

Koru Neimoidia.title: Koru Neimoidia/Legends

facts.affiliation: Trade Federation, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Republic

Koru Neimoidia.lead: Koru Neimoidia was a Colonies planet that was one of the most famous purse world colonies of the Neimoidian species. It was a more desirable destination than the Neimoidians' homeworld, Neimoidia, itself and hosted opulent residences of affluent and powerful Neimoidians. By 3643 BBY, Koru Neimoidia was the site of the headquarters of the Opal Foundation, which was in reality a front for an influential crime lord.

Krayiss Two.title: Krayiss II
Krayiss Two.lead: Krayiss II, also referred to as Krayiss Two, was a planet in the Outer Rim, in the remote Sith Worlds region of the Stygian Caldera nebula. Connected to other nearby worlds by the Nache Bhelfia hyperlane, Krayiss II was considered one of the five sacred Sith planets that formed the heart of the Sith Empire. In ancient times, Krayiss II was home to a massive library-temple that was a place of meditation and study for Sith sorcerers. However, after 14,000 BBY, it was buried and largely forgotten, with its large obelisk being all that remained above ground.

Krake's Planet.title: Krake's Planet
Krake's Planet.lead: Krake's Planet was a planet in the Outer Rim's Demetras sector that was home to the Imperial Krake Data Vault during the Galactic Civil War. A small, rocky world, Krake's Planet was home to a species of large slugs that carved massive, twisting tunnels through the planet's surface. Krake Data Vault was formed out of a type of crystal cocoon created by the slugs, and repurposed by the Imperials to control the slugs' movements and contain the main personnel records for the Imperial military.

Korteen asteroid belt.title: Korteen asteroid belt
Korteen asteroid belt.lead: The Korteen asteroid belt was an asteroid belt located in the Korteen system, within the Kibilini sector of the galaxy's Territories. A ring of planetary wreckage, it was governed by Quarg's father during the last years of the Galactic Republic.

Koss.title: Koss
Koss.lead: Koss was a gas giant–type planet with eight moons that was located in the Faarlsun system, a part of the Parthovian Cluster in Wild Space. The planet occupied the fifth orbit around its star, the yellow-white Faarlsun.

Korseg IV.title: Korseg IV
Korseg IV.lead: Korseg IV was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Grohl sector. During the Galactic Civil War, the Rebel Alliance maintained a base there that was discovered and attacked by a ground force of the Galactic Empire. In the ensuing battle, the Alliance emerged victorious.

Korriz.title: Korriz

facts.affiliation: Old Sith Empire, Reconstituted Sith Empire

Korriz.lead: Korriz was an industrial planet in the Korriz system in the Sith Worlds, a region of space within the Stygian Caldera nebula in the Outer Rim's Esstran sector. Located on the Descri Wris hyperlane, Korriz was part of the Sith Empire before its collapse in the Great Hyperspace War of 5000 BBY, and around that time, it was the site of a workshop owned by the Sith Lord Tritos Nal.

Kothlis asteroid field.title: Kothlis asteroid field
Kothlis asteroid field.lead: The Kothlis asteroid field orbited Kothlis in a parabolic orbit. It was possibly the remains of a fourth moon or large single asteroid that was destroyed.

Korvaii.title: Korvaii
Korvaii.lead: Korvaii was a small agriworld located in the Kordu sector of the Mid Rim.

Kostra.title: Kostra
Kostra.lead: Kostra was a Mid Rim astronomical object situated in the Romintine sector. During the Galactic Civil War, the Galactic Empire attacked it, emerging victorious over Rebel Alliance forces there. During the confrontation, the Rebel starfighter pilot Fulkrehm Protial crash-landed on Kostra, where, due to exposure to the trosilon nerve gas, he suffered damage to his motor control skills that the celestial body's natives were not able to fully heal.

Kossan.title: Kossan
Kossan.lead: Kossan was one of the three asteroid belts of the Isen system in Outer Rim Territories.

Kossim.title: Kossim
Kossim.lead: Kossim was one of the three asteroid belts of the Isen system in Outer Rim Territories.

Krenhner.title: Krenhner
Krenhner.lead: Krenhner was a planet located in the Krenhner sector of the Inner Rim.

Kovor.title: Kovor
Kovor.lead: Kovor was a planet where a battle occurred during the Galactic War between the reconstituted Sith Empire and Galactic Republic, which the latter won thanks to the intervention of the Coruscant Aegis squadron.

Kraten.title: Kraten
Kraten.lead: Kraten was a planet in the Outlier systems of the Corellian sector.

Korrus.title: Korrus
Korrus.lead: Korrus was a world located in the Clacis sector's Korrus system within the Outer Rim Territories and the New Territories regions. Situated within grid square K-4 of the Standard Galactic Grid, it was connected by the Braxant Run hyperlane to the astronomical object Muunilinst and the Ord Trasi system. By 5 ABY, during the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the New Republic, Korrus contributed to the Imperial Military.

Korrilan IV.title: Korrilan IV/Legends
Korrilan IV.lead: Korrilan IV was a planet in the galaxy. The Zalpertine Cup was held on the world, a Podracing series that catered to racers piloting CR-17 Incendias.

Kroctar.title: Kroctar

facts.affiliation: Galactic Empire, Unified Factions, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Kroctar.lead: Kroctar was the homeworld of the Kroctari, and the capital and merchant center of the Shataum sector.

Krylon.title: Krylon
Krylon.lead: Krylon was a planet in the Gordian Reach. It was the dominant planet of the Pinooran Spur, a polluted, industrial world dominated by Hynese companies, however it was not very important in this region of space.

Kriekaal.title: Kriekaal

facts.terrain: Duranium oceans, Cooled ore and slag islands

Kriekaal.lead: Kriekaal was a planet in the Kriekaal system, and the homeworld of the Krieks. Its continents were composed of hardened duranium and its shallow oceans of molten duranium.

Krykas V.title: Krykas V
Krykas V.lead: Krykas V was an uninhabited planet in the Mid Rim, covered in mud, briers, and thorns. The planet was blanketed a thick, tan fog consisting of clouds of particulate matter with strong electromagnetic charges strong enough to knock out most ship's sensors. The planet was located in the middle of an asteroid field.

Kriselist.title: Kriselist/Legends

facts.routes: Corellian Trade Spine, D'Aelgoth Trade Route
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Alliance to Restore the Republic, Prentioch's Dominion, New Republic

Kriselist.lead: Kriselist was a planet in the Wornal sector of the Mid Rim. It sat at the junction between the Corellian Trade Spine and the D'Aelgoth Trade Route.

Kril'Dor.title: Kril'Dor/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Empire, Disciples of Ragnos, New Republic

Kril'Dor.lead: Kril'Dor was a gas giant planet that was located on the Mid Rim. It was a known source of tibanna.

Krevas.title: Krevas
Krevas.lead: Krevas was a swampy planet in the Outer Rim and the homeworld of the Krevaaki.

Ksiczzic III.title: Ksiczzic III
Ksiczzic III.lead: Ksiczzic III was a Mid Rim world in the Ksiczzic system.

Krinemonen.title: Krinemonen
Krinemonen.lead: Krinemonen was a gas giant planet in Calamari sector orbited by the oceanic moon of Krinemonen III.

Krykis IV.title: Krykis IV
Krykis IV.lead: Krykis IV was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Krykis system of the Duluur sector, a part of the Southern Core portion of the Colonies. At some point, an indoor marketplace became buried on Krykis IV, later being excavated by archaeologists of the Galactic Empire. They presented the find as the "Voorlach Temple"—which shared its name with the celestial body Voorlach of the Duluur sector's Voorlach system—and took the common market goods retrieved from the structure, which were instead claimed to be religious artifacts, on a tour through three sectors.

Kromus.title: Kromus

facts.population: 1.3 billion, before the Battle of Kromus

Kromus.lead: Kromus was the fourth planet in the Kro'eval system. It had a rich biosphere, and by the time of the Clone Wars, it had a sentient population of 1.3 billion.

Krintrino.title: Krintrino
Krintrino.lead: Krintrino was a planet. During the early stages of the Galactic Civil War, Imperial forces were responsible for the destruction of an Rebel Alliance resistance cell that was based there, about five years prior to the Battle of Yavin.

Kromol.title: Kromol
Kromol.lead: Kromol was the fifth planet in the Kro'eval system. It was largely uninhabited, with no sentient species.

Kruskan.title: Kruskan
Kruskan.lead: Kruskan was a planet located on the far fringes of the Colundra sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Kro Var.title: Kro Var
Kro Var.lead: Kro Var was a barren planet that was located in the Unknown Regions.

Krozurbia.title: Krozurbia
Krozurbia.lead: Krozurbia was a planet located in the Outer Rim's Shadola sector. It was the homeworld of the Krozurbian species. They were engaged in two hundred years of war until peace was brought about due to the intervention of the Ithorian Zorneth.

Krev Coeur.title: Krev Coeur

facts.terrain: Surface:, Crystals, Inactive volcanoes, Underground:, Caverns, Lakes, Rainforests

Krev Coeur.lead: Krev Coeur was a planet that was located within the Tython system of the galaxy's Deep Core region. The planet's climate was so hot and arid that no life-forms could survive on it without protection. Krev Coeur's surface was pockmarked with inactive volcanoes and also featured a large amount of blue crystals. However, in the dry world's underground lay a vast network of caverns, lakes and jungles. Krev Coeur was colonized more than a millennium after the year 36,453 BBY by the non–Force-sensitive settlers of the planet of Tython.

Krmar.title: Krmar (disambiguation)
Krmar.lead: Krmar may refer to one of the following:

Kronas.title: Kronas
Kronas.lead: Kronas was the first planet of the Kattellyn system, located in the Rolion sector of the Outer Rim. It was a ball of searing rock that orbited too close to its sun.

Krownest.title: Krownest
Krownest.lead: Krownest was an icy world in the Outer Rim Territories' Mandalore sector, cold and covered in snow. Mountainous terrain and evergreen forests comprised much of Krownest's frigid landscape, and its atmosphere proved breathable to humans. A planet under Mandalorian governance, Krownest was the ancestral home of Clan Wren, a legendary Mandalorian family whose warriors possessed a stronghold on the snowy world, built along the edge of a frozen lake.

Kuat.title: Kuat/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire, Galactic Federation of Free Alliances, Fel Empire, Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire

Kuat.lead: Kuat was a planet located in the Core Worlds and one of the earliest members of the Galactic Republic. It was best known as the home of Kuat Drive Yards. These famous shipyards, used to build ships for both the Galactic Republic and later the Galactic Empire, circled the planet for thousands of kilometers.

Kubindi.title: Kubindi/Legends

facts.terrain: Forests, Swamps, Rainforests, Bogs, Mountains, Rivers
facts.affiliation: Hutt Empire, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Kubindi.lead: Kubindi was a terrestrial world and home to the Kubaz. Kubindi orbited a blue giant star that emitted powerful solar flares. The planet was regularly hit with this radiation, causing erratic weather patterns and making the world dry and arid.

Kulthis.title: Kulthis

facts.affiliation: Alliance to Restore the Republic, New Republic

Kulthis.lead: Kulthis was a planet in the Belderone system that was the site of a Rebel Alliance base during the Galactic Civil War. The third planet in the system, Kulthis became a target of the Sith Lord Darth Vader around 3 ABY, who began to amp up the production of Imperial AT-AT walkers on nearby Belderone in preparation for an assault on the world. However, the Rebel base on Kulthis launched several fighter squadrons in a pre-emptive strike on Belderone, destroying the Imperial threat.

Ku'Bakai 11.title: Ku'Bakai 11

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Ku'Bakai 11.lead: Ku'Bakai 11 was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories. It was colonized by the Kubaz species.

Ku'Bakai 6.title: Ku'Bakai 6

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Ku'Bakai 6.lead: Ku'Bakai 6 was a planet in the Outer Rim. It was a colony planet of the Kubaz species.

Ku'Bakai 8.title: Ku'Bakai 8

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Ku'Bakai 8.lead: Ku'Bakai 8 was a planet in the Ku'Bakai system of the Outer Rim Territories. It was used as a colony for the Kubaz species.

Kuan.title: Kuan
Kuan.lead: Kuan was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories. It had a war with neighboring Bordal in 20 BBY, in which the Galactic Empire had to intervene by sending an Imperial Navy fleet under Admiral Mordon. An ace TIE pilot, Maarek Stele, was from Kuan. The planet stayed in Imperial control throughout the Galactic Civil War.

Kuar.title: Kuar
Kuar.lead: Kuar was a Deep Core world of flat, rocky, dusty plains.

Ksift.title: Ksift
