facts.affiliation: Galactic Empire, Alliance to Restore the Republic

Ksift.lead: Ksift was an Imperial rainforest world in the Outer Rim Territories. Its capital was Rakati. It was also the location of ATC-5/GS and a Rebel security outpost. Nik betrayed the local Rebels, but was brought to justice by Bret Hanson.

Kur.title: Kur
Kur.lead: Kur was the second planet in the Bakura system.

Kumru.title: Kumru

facts.sector: Greater Javin, Javin sector, Mugaari Space

Kumru.lead: Kumru was a thriving industrial world positioned along the Corellian Trade Spine in the Javin sector of the Outer Rim Territories. The planet was originally governed by the Mugaari species, who surrendered their territorial holdings to the Galactic Republic following hostilities. To the aversion of many of their kin, Kumru's substantial Mugaari population coexisted well with Humans, Lutrillians, and Nothoiins.

Kuna's Tooth.title: Kuna's Tooth/Legends

facts.sector: Zuma sector, Inner Zuma Region, Moddell subsector
facts.system: Inner Moddell systems, Kuna's Tooth system

Kuna's Tooth.lead: Kuna's Tooth, also known as the Tooth, was a cool Outer Rim Territories mining planet located in the Moddell sector. The site of an orbital shipyard called Doestes High Port, the planet was governed by a bureaucracy and inhabited by members of the Ayrou, Human, and Vashan species. Years after the Battle of Endor, Kuna's Tooth hosted backalley cookhouses where smuggled-in Rokna tree fungus from the Endor system was processed into the Rokna Blue drug before being transported into the wider galaxy.

Kuantar.title: Kuantar

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Metharian Nebula Territories

Kuantar.lead: Kuantar was the third planet in the Kidron system. It was a ringed gas giant.

Kuk'tar.title: Kuk'tar
Kuk'tar.lead: Kuk'tar was the second planet in the Kothlis system. It was a chaotic inhospitable world. Kuk'tar was a tiny planetoid with irregular orbit that teared the planet's surface to shreds. The proximity of the planet to its sun caused seering temperatures.

Ktil.title: Ktil/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Ktil.lead: Ktil was an Inner Rim planet that was the homeworld of the Ktilac species. It was a part of the Ktilac Regions, a group of star systems which the Ktilac co-inhabited with the Murachauns and the Tocoyans. Ktil had become a member of the Galactic Republic by 17,000 BBY, and it eventually became a part of the Galactic Empire and the New Republic as well.

Kuhurrik.title: Kuhurrik

facts.routes: Durkteel Loop, Great Kashyyyk Branch, Nightroad, Randon Run

Kuhurrik.lead: Kuhurrik was the seventh planet in the Kashyyyk system. A gas giant, it occupied the eighth orbital position around the star Kashyyyk, and had twenty-five moons in its own orbit.

Kupoh.title: Kupoh
Kupoh.lead: Kupoh was a planet located in the Kupoh system in the Dohlbani sector of the Mid Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of the Kupohan species. The planet had mountains, valleys, an high winds, causing cities such as Tonekh to be built inside of the valleys to be protected against the wind.

Kuliquo belt.title: Kuliquo belt
Kuliquo belt.lead: The Kuliquo belt was an airless and lightless asteroid field in the Inner Rim used for mining for the Galactic Empire's war effort during the Galactic Civil War. In 3 ABY, the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry deployed a strike force of twenty rebel soldiers to sabotage mining machinery at the Kuliquo belt, and one of the soldiers, Roach, returned with a piece of gold after completing the mission.

Ktath'atn.title: Ktath'atn
Ktath'atn.lead: Ktath'atn was a dark forest planet in the Ktath'atn system in the Chopani sector of the Outer Rim Territories that was ruled by the Queen of Ktath'atn, whose hive fed on the human inhabitants. It was the location of the Citadel of Ktath'atn, which stood over a village. Doctor Chelli Aphra traveled to Ktath'atn with Luke Skywalker to visit the queen, hoping that she could activate the Rur crystal.

Kur Minor.title: Kur Minor system
Kur Minor.lead: The Kur Minor system was a star system located in Wild Space and the Interior. The system was located in grid square I-8 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

Kuras III.title: Kuras III

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Metharian Nebula Territories

Kuras III.lead: Kuras III was the third planet in the Kuras system of the Elrood sector. Kuras III was a dry, volcanic world, and thanks to a mixture of heavy metals, harmful bacteria and airborne poisons, the environment was considered lethal to Humans and many other species. Three indigenous life-forms managed to evolve in Kuras III's inhospitable atmosphere; the Aganof, the Pulra, and Hairy Savages. Because The Drift made travel to and from the planet difficult, much of Kuras III remained unexplored. The average day lasted for eighteen standard hours on Kuras III, and a year encompassed four hundred days.

Kwookrrr.title: Kwookrrr

facts.region: Mid Rim, Kashyyyk Region, The Slice

Kwookrrr.lead: Kwookrrr was a planet where enslaved Wookiee children were used for labor in factories and farms. It had previously been a Wookiee colony world.

Kwevron.title: Kwevron
Kwevron.lead: Kwevron was an Outer Rim Territories agriworld. It was a lightly populated world, with almost of all of its people engaged in farming to provide food for neighboring sectors. An Imperial Prefect oversaw its starport during the Galactic Civil War. Hills and fields covered most of its surface.

Kushibah.title: Kushibah
Kushibah.lead: Kushibah was a planet in the Gordian Reach sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was home to the primitive lagomorph Kushiban species, most notably the Jedi Master Ikrit. The planet had no cities and limited technology.

Kutag.title: Kutag
Kutag.lead: Kutag, also known as Doornik-881, was an Imperial factory farm world that was maintained by droids. It was in the Doornik-881 system in the Koornacht Cluster. Its inhabitants were killed in the Great Purge by the Yevetha, who took over the planet.

Kuras IV.title: Kuras IV

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Metharian Nebula Territories

Kuras IV.lead: Kuras IV was the fourth and outermost planet in the Kuras system of the Elrood sector. Kuras IV was a frigid, rocky wasteland.

Kuthul.title: Kuthul
Kuthul.lead: Kuthul was the outermost planet in the Honoghr system. This frozen giant was devoid of life.

Kwenn.title: Kwenn/Legends

facts.affiliation: Hutt Cartel, Brotherhood of Darkness, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Kwenn.lead: Kwenn was a planet located in the Kastolar sector of the Mid Rim. It was situated along the Ootmian Pabol hyperlane. Kwenn was orbited by the Kwenn Space Station.

Kyrouac.title: Kyrouac
Kyrouac.lead: Kyrouac was a backwater Inner Rim farming planet held by the Galactic Empire. The planet's fauna included brush bats and a shelled creature residing in the Spiral Sea. The Kyrouaquian population was governed by the Kyrouaquian High Council, and the planet's capital of Montalvia was the only settlement with a spaceport.

Kvabja.title: Kvabja
Kvabja.lead: Kvabja was a planet which was ruled over by a monarch called a Mrahash. Presumably, the Mrahash and the planet itself had little military power during the time of the New Republic, and was controlled by a Drach'nam named Chay Praysh and his slaver consortium. Praysh didn't dwell on Kvabja, though, and lived in his headquarters on the planet Torpris.

Kwannot.title: Kwannot
Kwannot.lead: Kwannot was a Mid Rim planet where Aurra Sing killed Mana Veridi sometime prior to 32 BBY.

Kyryll's World.title: Kyryll's World/Legends
Kyryll's World.lead: Kyryll's World was a terrestrial planet located in the Kyryll's World system, a part of the Phelleem sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of the sentient Pui-ui species, members of which communicated in the Pui-ui language and which was known to the wider galaxy by 671 BBY.

KyLessia.title: KyLessia
KyLessia.lead: KyLessia was located within the KyLessia system. It was the homeworld of wulfruit trees, KyLessian fruit bats, and KyLessian feather mites. Its exports included KyLessian Fruit Distillate, a popular Outer Rim alcohol.

Kyood's World.title: Kyood's World
Kyood's World.lead: Kyood's World was the first planet in the Anoat system. It was searing rock with no moons.

Kynachi.title: Kynachi

facts.affiliation: KynachTech Industries, Trade Federation, Confederacy of Independent Systems

Kynachi.lead: Kynachi was a remote Wild Space planet and the base of KynachTech Industries. In 32 BBY, the world was seized by the Trade Federation, and the Skakoan Overseer Umbrag took over the KynachTech factory, also imposing a frequency jammer on the world. The planet's isolation led the rest of the galaxy to believe that it had simply become isolated out of choice. The planet's captive inhabitants were liberated in 21 BBY from the KynachTech factory prison by the Galactic Republic self-proclaimed Breakout Squad unit.

Kurdavvia.title: Kurdavvia
Kurdavvia.lead: Kurdavvia was a planet in the Core Worlds of the galaxy known for its bright sunrises. Princess Kalieva K'ntarr's face lit up like one when Sienn Sconn agreed to help her gain passage off of Rydonni Prime.

Kursid.title: Kursid
Kursid.lead: Kursid was a planet in Esstran sector of the Outer Rim Territories of the galaxy. It was inhabited by a species of primitive humanoids whose sole contact with the greater galaxy was through training missions conducted to the planet by the Order of the Sith Lords.

Kuthard.title: Kuthard
Kuthard.lead: Kuthard was a planet located in the Sepan system, a part of the Sepan sector in the Slice portion of the Expansion Region.

Kuratooine.title: Kuratooine
Kuratooine.lead: Kuratooine was a planet in Wild Space. Though it was home to several Galactic Alliance Army bases and a Galactic Alliance embassy, it was not officially part of the Alliance and continued to maintain its own system of laws and its own government. Its capital was Kura City.

Kuthic Worlds.title: Kuthic Worlds/Legends
Kuthic Worlds.lead: The Kuthic Worlds were a part of the Tharin sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The hyperlane known as the Talcene Transit connected the group of worlds to the larger Perlemian Trade Route hyperlane as well as the Saleucami system of the Suolriep sector. Starships traveled along the Talcene Transit in order to deliver cargo from the Perlemian to the Kuthic Worlds.

Laazrau.title: Laazrau
Laazrau.lead: Laazrau was a planet in the Zug system. It was one of four gas giants in that star system, along with Zauhu, Urazuun, and Faargau. It was the outermost of them and had the fewest natural satellites – thirteen in total.

Lahsbane.title: Lahsbane/Legends

facts.affiliation: Alliance of Free Planets, New Republic

Lahsbane.lead: Lahsbane was a planet located in the Onatos sector of the Mid Rim, that served as the home for the Lahsbee and Huhk species—the small and peaceful Lahsbee, who lived in Lahsbane's forests, inevitably grew into the large and aggressive Huhk in the planet's cities. Remote and resource-poor, Lahsbane was left uncharted until an Imperial expedition happened across the world sometime before 3 ABY. During the Galactic Civil War, Rebel spy Yom Argo crashed and died on Lahsbane.

Lafra.title: Lafra
Lafra.lead: Lafra was a planet in the Wyl sector of the Outer Rim with a variety of terrains. It was the home world of the Lafrarians, gray-skinned, avian humanoids who were once flyers but lost this ability over eons of evolutionary change. They built their homes in high, inaccessible locations on the planet (such as treetops or high mountain sides). Nearly everyone on the world owned a flying conveyance, with few land or water transports seeing use.

Lamuir IV.title: Lamuir IV
Lamuir IV.lead: Lamuir IV was a planet in the Tapani sector's Freeworlds Territory. It was formerly part of the Herglic Trade Empire. The Priole Danna Festival was held there.

Laboi II.title: Laboi II
Laboi II.lead: Laboi II was a small planet in the Slice which was home to the Laboi species. Due to its slow, retrograde rotation, its day was 4,040 standard hours long, just ten hours shorter than its year. As a result, the side facing its sun, the red giant Er'Dox Kaan, became hot enough to melt some rocks. The night side, on the other hand, plunged into a deep freeze. The temperature differential led to high winds, which served to exchange heat between the day and night sides and moderate the temperature extremes. The animal life on Laboi II had to adapt to these temperature extremes.

Lamaredd.title: Lamaredd/Legends

facts.affiliation: Bartyn Gourmet Delicacies, Outer Rim Oreworks Company

Lamaredd.lead: Lamaredd, also known as Great Menahua, was a planet in the Lamaro system of Wild Space. With water covering 85% of its surface, Lamaredd was rich in minerals and seafood, as well as having its own native sentient species, the primitive Menahuun.

Langhesa.title: Langhesa
Langhesa.lead: Langhesa was the Langhesi homeworld situated in the Langhesa system in the Meram sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was conquered in 129 BBY by the Tsinimals, leading to a mass migration of Langhesi offworld.

Lamus.title: Lamus
Lamus.lead: Lamus was a moon of an Outer Rim Territories planet. It was inhabited by the A'Mar people. Its equator was forested; its poles were deserts with sinkholes. Gundarks inhabited the moon. One of the moon's settlements was the town of Vidge-Ribu, a low-tech agrarian community.

Ladarra.title: Ladarra
Ladarra.lead: Ladarra was a desert planet in the Gordian Reach along the Pinooran Spur. It was the location of the Human colony of New Hope Settlement. The planet was colonized during the days of the Old Republic and ended up becoming a failed chromium mine. By the time of the Galactic Empire, the planet's people were dying out. All that was left were poor farmers, hermits and fugitives, as well as some dust balls from the rust-colored desert.

Lammax.title: Lammax
Lammax.lead: Lammax was a shadowport planet in the Danju system in the Colonies, near a nebula that made travel to the planet dangerous. Port Bianco was established on Lammax by Lamuu Bianco during the last years of the Galactic Republic as a place for his pirate ships to dock between tourist seasons. It was at its height during the Galactic Civil War. Former bacta pirate Shanto Dhil served as mayor of Port Bianco.

Lamarebb.title: Lamarebb
Lamarebb.lead: Lamarebb was a gas giant in the Lamaro system. It was very close to the sun, Lamaro, and orbited close to the second planet, Lamarecc.

Lamarecc.title: Lamarecc
Lamarecc.lead: Lamarecc was a gas giant in the Lamaro system. It was very close to the sun, Lamaro, and orbited close to the first planet, Lamarebb.

Lamaremm.title: Lamaremm
Lamaremm.lead: Lamaremm was the fourth planet in the Lamaro system.

Lacia.title: Lacia
Lacia.lead: Lacia was a planet in the Recopi system. It was a gas giant with nine moons.

Laertos.title: Laertos
Laertos.lead: Laertos was a planet the primary spaceport of which had a Rebel Alliance drop point.

Ladro.title: Ladro
Ladro.lead: Ladro was a planet in the Colonies that supported the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.

Laakteen.title: Laakteen/Legends
Laakteen.lead: Laakteen was an astronomical object in the Colonies region, located just off the Giju Run hyperlane. It was the home of Laakteen Depot, a one-time pirate base and later Rebel Alliance outpost during the Galactic Civil War. Laakteen Depot was destroyed by the Super Star Destroyer Executor during its maiden voyage.

Lahn.title: Lahn
Lahn.lead: Lahn was a planet located in the galaxy. It was covered in beaches, forests, and oceans.

Lah'mu.title: Lah'mu

facts.terrain: Black sand and beaches, Fertile lowlands, Plateaus, mountains

Lah'mu.lead: Lah'mu was a ringed agrarian planet in the Raioballo sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Its small population of settlers included the Erso family, who relocated to Lah'mu after the Clone Wars, and were ultimately tracked down by Director Orson Callan Krennic years later.

Lahag Erli.title: Lahag Erli
Lahag Erli.lead: Lahag Erli was a planet located in the Lahag Erli system, a part of the Expansion Region's Cantons of Lahag sector. It was the homeworld of a social group of the same name, the forces of which invaded and occupied the worlds of the Har system early in the history of the Galactic Republic, which was founded in 25,053 BBY.

Lao-mon.title: Lao-mon

facts.region: Colonies, Unknown Regions (from another point of view)

Lao-mon.lead: Lao-mon was the tropical homeworld of the shape-shifting Shi'ido species, it was known in their language as Sh'shuun. Their world remained isolated, its exact location unknown to any outlanders. It was the homeworld of the Senior Anthropologist Mammon Hoole, who was famous during the New Republic.

Lannik.title: Lannik/Legends

facts.terrain: Rocky Inhospitable deserts (at the equator), Mountainous highlands and deeply forests (at the poles)
facts.government: A hierarchical system of vassalage with a hereditary prince at its head and with the assistance of the High Court
facts.affiliation: Rivalled clans and houses, Galactic Republic (factually Independent), Exar Kun's Sith Empire (briefly), Galactic Empire (indirectly), New Republic …

Lannik.lead: Lannik was a harsh and isolated world in the Mid Rim, inhabited by stocky humanoids known as Lanniks. Their warlike homeworld integrated into the interstellar civilization relatively late, which caused it to suffer from chronic technological backwardness. The limited share of developments that did reach Lannik either provoked the rise of criminal groups or offered the local noble houses and clans a new way to advance their personal interests.

Lapez 3.title: Lapez 3
Lapez 3.lead: Lapez 3 was a planet located in the Outer Rim Territories on which Luke Skywalker confronted the nightmare demon Reist.

Lansono.title: Lansono
Lansono.lead: Lansono was a celestial body located in the Lansono system, a part of the Southern Core portion of the Core Worlds. By the date 13:5:16, Senator Candabrine Bu represented Lansono in the Galactic Republic's Senate. Bu supported the passing of the Military Creation Act that proposed the restoration of a centralized Republic military, which had been dissolved as part of 1000 BBY's Ruusan Reformation event.

Lasan.title: Lasan/Legends

facts.climate: Warm, Cold at night in the desert, Arid

Lasan.lead: Lasan was a Wild Space planet. An arid and warm world, its surface featured desert and plains as well as high mountains. Lasan was inhabited by herbivorous banthas and the sentient, humanoid Lasat.

Laseel.title: Laseel
Laseel.lead: Laseel was a hot jungle planet in the Dathomir system, located in the Quelii sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories. Laseel had two moons and occupied the third orbital position around the star Domir.

Latt.title: Latt
Latt.lead: Latt was the third planet in the Demar system. By the Battle of Yavin, it had been reduced to a nearly barren rock by the Lant Mining Corporation. A few workers had remained on the planet to seal the deep mine shafts and salvage the leftover mining equipment and buildings. Latt had one moon.

Lanthrym.title: Lanthrym

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Metharian Nebula Territories

Lanthrym.lead: Lanthrym was a planet in the Elrood sector. It was on this planet that Cermack Rustill boarded the Shining Comet which was en route to Bodrin. It was considered a good port for pirates. There was a sizable Gamorrean population living there.

Langoona.title: Langoona
Langoona.lead: Langoona was a remote world located in the Bootana Hutta region of Hutt Space. Centuries ago, it was the homeworld of a once-favored slave species of the Hutts. However, after a failed rebellion, their masters drove them to the brink of extinction, preserving them only as targets for sadistic safaris.

Latoma.title: Latoma
Latoma.lead: Latoma was a planet in the Latoma system in the Brak sector of the Expansion Region. It was a small rocky planetoid and covered in impact craters. The planet was used by Byro Ti'mere to distract visitors and bounty hunters searching for his secret base on Brugga. Ti'mere established the ruins of an outpost on the planet to throw off suspicions that he was still operating out of the Latoma system and convince them he had moved elsewhere.

Lankashiir.title: Lankashiir
Lankashiir.lead: Lankashiir was a planet of the Lankashiir system, which was located along the Quellor Run hyperlane within the Colonies and the Slice regions of the galaxy. During the Imperial Era, Lankashiir was under the control of the Galactic Empire. A planet thriving with forests, Lankashiir was home to Adion Lang, a lieutenant serving with the Imperial Security Bureau, and the Durasha family, a Human family with strong Imperial ties.

Las Lagon.title: Las Lagon

facts.affiliation: Galactic Federation of Free Alliances, Confederation

Las Lagon.lead: Las Lagon was a minor planet in the Inner Rim seceded from the Galactic Alliance during the Second Galactic Civil War.

Lankor VI.title: Lankor VI
Lankor VI.lead: Lankor VI was the sixth planet in its system, and was orbited by three moons. It had a temperate climate and was home to the Lankorians, an intelligent species of skinny bipeds, with long arms and a sugar-loaf shaped head. The Lankorian civilization was feudal and not significantly industrialized by the time of the Galactic Civil War. An important town on the planet was Rham'Dhaam.

Lanos.title: Lanos

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems

Lanos.lead: Lanos was a member world of the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. Around 22 BBY, it was attacked by the Confederacy of Independent Systems and became the subject of propaganda on the Republic's HoloNet News, which claimed that the Separatists were liberating it from a "crushing servitude to the corrupt and decayed Republic."

Lanteeb.title: Lanteeb/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems

Lanteeb.lead: Lanteeb was a neutral pastoral planet in the Malor-77 system. While aligned with the Galactic Republic, it did not have a representative in the Galactic Senate. It was located equidistant between Rattatak and Bespin. It was located in Bri'ahl sector.

Lant.title: Lant
Lant.lead: Lant was the planet in the Lant system, a star system in the Periphery, a sector in the Outer Rim Territories. Lant was a trade world with extensive Hutt holdings.

Latharra.title: Latharra
Latharra.lead: Latharra was located in the Yminis sector of the Outer Rim Territories and was the location of Kolanda Station.

Laud.title: Laud system/Legends
Laud.lead: The Laud system was a star system in the Brak sector of the Expansion Region. The system contained at least one gas giant, which Lant Mining Corporation conducted gas mining operations.

Latza VII.title: Latza VII
Latza VII.lead: Latza VII was a planet in the Spirva sector of the Mid Rim.

Laria.title: Laria
Laria.lead: Laria was an Outer Rim Territories celestial body located in the Rseik sector. By 3643 BBY, dozens of star-charts, accompanied by notes in a forgotten language, had been stored in computer banks inside ancient ruins on Laria. Around that year, archaeologists were able to restore the charts. Millennia later, the Trade Federation improved the facilities of Laria's spaceport.

Lehon.title: Lehon/Legends

facts.population: Modern: None, Historic: 11 billion, 90% Rakata, 10% other slave species
facts.affiliation: Infinite Empire, Galactic Republic (historical preserve only)

Lehon.lead: Lehon, also referred to as Rakata, Rakata Prime, and the Unknown World, was the homeworld of the Rakata species and the capital of their Infinite Empire.

Lekua V.title: Lekua V
Lekua V.lead: Lekua V, also known simply as Lekua, was a planet located in the Centrality, a sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It had several universities.

Lelmra.title: Lelmra
Lelmra.lead: Lelmra was a mountainous planet in the Churba sector of the Mid Rim. At one time, it was the headquarters of Garm Bel Iblis, and also served as a backup base for the smuggler organization of Mazzic.

Lavisar.title: Lavisar/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Zsinj's Empire

Lavisar.lead: A planet in the Strabin sector, Lavisar was once part of a larger high-gravity world. It was a medium-sized world of reddish-brown rock with an abundance of heavy metal ores and a few dark seas and abundant mining and refining industries. It remained neutral in the Galactic Civil War until conquered by Warlord Zsinj. It was the headquarters of Skyrung Manufacturing, a licensed builder of Lambda-class shuttles. The main port city was known as Syward.

Lenthalis.title: Lenthalis
Lenthalis.lead: Lenthalis was the sector capital of the Spirva sector. Its largest continent was Basin. The capital city was Hreas Port City. It was the headquarters of Galladinium Galactic Exports, one of the galaxy's largest shipping corporations, founded by Galladinium around 50 BBY, from which it published annuals of Galladinium's Galactic Datalog of Fantastic Technology. The Galactic Empire banned the Datalog since it was being used by the Rebel Alliance to purchase weapons. Hreas contained the Commerce Concourse, where a series of gang-rivalry riots broke out shortly before the Battle of Hoth.

Leria Kerlsil.title: Leria Kerlsil
Leria Kerlsil.lead: Leria Kerlsil was a planet in the Core Worlds. It allowed Refugee Relief Movement settlement in 22 BBY, shortly before the Clone Wars, but only by wealthy single men. At the time of the New Republic, the planet had a population of 300,000. Leria Kerlsil was the only planet known to be home to Life-bearers, also known as life-witches.

Leritor.title: Leritor/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Exar Kun's Sith Empire, Resurgent Sith Empire, Brotherhood of Darkness, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Leritor.lead: Leritor was a mineral-rich Mid Rim planet of rolling plains and oceans. The native Sauvax engaged in aquaculture; Human colonists mined the minerals. Amid a brewing war between the colonists and the Sauvax, Profex Rynalla attempted to excavate a Sith artifact buried within the planet's mountainous Bleaks.

Lefrani.title: Lefrani/Legends
Lefrani.lead: Lefrani was a gas giant. It had a strong gravitational pull which prevented Mustafar from becoming a moon of Jestefad.

Lenniera.title: Lenniera
Lenniera.lead: Lenniera was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Lenniera system. It was a part of the Arrowhead, or the Slice portion of the Core Worlds. It was the site of the estate of the centuries-old family of the Lennieran jatz musician Fitz Roi of the Colonies' Tapani sector. Three weeks before the date 36:4:10, Roi left his home on Lenniera for an impromptu galactic tour, and eventually he announced his unexpected decision to move his permanent residence to the city Calamar on the Core world Esseles.

Lenico Belt.title: Lenico Belt
Lenico Belt.lead: The Lenico Belt was an asteroid belt that was located within the Lenico system on the Outer Rim of the galaxy. The field contained the hidden Cairn Installation, which played host to an Imperial Remnant operation that was active during the Empire Reborn campaign. The facility also served as a base for Galak Fyyar's flagship, the Doomgiver.

Lazerian VI.title: Lazerian VI
Lazerian VI.lead: Lazerian VI was the sixth planet in the Lazerian system, in orbit around the yellow star named Lazerian. The planet was a gas giant and had eight moons. It was located within the Kira sector in the Trailing Sectors portion of the Expansion Region. Lazerian VI was found along the trade routes known as the Harrin Trade Corridor and the Kira Run. At some point, it was surveyed by the Lazerians of Lazerian IV, another planet in the Lazerian system.

Lazerian VII.title: Lazerian VII
Lazerian VII.lead: Lazerian VII was the seventh planet in the Lazerian system. It was located within the Kira sector, in the Trailing Sectors portion of the Expansion Region. The planet was a gas giant with ten moons, and orbited the yellow star known as Lazerian. Lazerian VII was found along the trade routes known as the Harrin Trade Corridor and Kira Run. It was once surveyed by the Lazerians of Lazerian IV, another planet in the Lazerian system.

Lemmi VI.title: Lemmi VI
Lemmi VI.lead: Lemmi VI was an Inner Rim planet located in the Hapes Cluster. The rare Millennium blossom grew in jungle there, and immense creatures jumping around the planet's forests caused large numbers of trees to be flattened. At one point during the Galactic Civil War, a group of spacers traveled to Lemmi VI to retrieve a specimen of the Millennium blossom.

Leafar.title: Leafar
Leafar.lead: The Leafar were a group involved in merchant shipping based out of the Leafar system. Shortly after the Battle of Yavin, they began to challenge the Galactic Empire. The Empire responded by sending the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Badi Dea to attack their shipping convoys. The ambush was foiled by the Alliance to Restore the Republic, which, initially, sent five X-wing starfighters to protect Leafar shipping. Three separate groups of Leafar ships were defended by the Alliance, which called in reinforcements as the battle continued.

Letaki.title: Letaki
Letaki.lead: The Letaki were a species of sentient beings distinguished by eight tentacles, an egg-shaped head, four eyes, and a sharp beak. Two sets of gills allowed them to breathe in both air and water. They were able to focus their eyes on more than one object at a time, and to use their limbs to manipulate several items independently. As carnivores, Letaki gutted their dinners. The Letaki vocal range was higher than that of most species. The musician Evar Orbus, leader of Evar Orbus and His Galactic Jizz-Wailers, was a Letaki.

Lessuris.title: Lessuris
Lessuris.lead: Lessuris was a backwater planet located within the Lessuris system of the Outer Rim Territories. Luskin Exovar was born on Lessuris.

Lesu.title: Lesu
Lesu.lead: Lesu was a world located in the Lesu system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Dail sector. Around 10 ABY, it served as the homeworld of Malakin Enterprises, a criminal organization that constituted a part of the Tenloss Syndicate.

Lenico IV.title: Lenico IV
Lenico IV.lead: Lenico IV was a planet in the Lenico system of the Outer Rim Territories. Its barren surface presented ruins and others desolated places, like the Ash Plains. Numerous space station colonies such as Lenico Colony Blue remained in its orbit.

Lesser Vaced.title: Lesser Vaced
Lesser Vaced.lead: Lesser Vaced was a planet located in the Jalor sector of the Mid Rim.

Lerct.title: Lerct/Legends
Lerct.lead: Lerct was a celestial body located in the Expansion Region's Prackla sector. The Lerct Historical Institute was based on Lerct.

Lianna.title: Lianna/Legends

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Tion Cluster, The Slice
facts.routes: Cadinth Run, Perlemian Trade Route, Shaltin Tunnels
facts.government: Representative democracy (de jure), Corporate-sponsored democracy (de facto)
facts.affiliation: Kingdom of Barseg, Xer's Empire, Xim's empire, Kingdom of Cron, Honorable Union of Desevro & Tion, Galactic Republic, Darth Revan's Sith Empire …

Lianna.lead: Lianna was the fourth planet of the Lianna system in the Allied Tion sector of the Outer Rim Territories. The ecumenopolis was the homeworld of House Santhe and the headquarters of Santhe/Sienar Technologies. Located on the junction of the Perlemian Trade Route, the Cadinth Run and the Shaltin Tunnels, Lianna was one of the busiest ports in the Tion Cluster.

Lijuter.title: Lijuter
Lijuter.lead: Lijuter was the Houk homeworld. It was located near Hutt Space.

Lirra.title: Lirra
Lirra.lead: Lirra was an Outer Rim planet with mineral pools and mud flats on its surface. Located within the Baxel sector close to the border with Hutt Space, Lirra was originally colonized by Human settlers, but almost a century prior to 2 ABY, the Humans on Lirra became outnumbered by members of the Hutt Jhank Shel clan.

Liinade III.title: Liinade III

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Ciutric Hegemony, New Republic

Liinade III.lead: Liinade III was an agriworld in the Ciutric Hegemony. Its development began near the end of the Galactic Republic and continued under the Galactic Empire. It had light industry which produced comlinks and caf synthesizers. It fell to the New Republic in 9 ABY during the Battle of Liinade III.

Levian Two.title: Levian Two
Levian Two.lead: Levian Two was an orange, inhospitable world that was located within the Inner Rim of the galaxy, near warlord Zsinj-controlled territory. It was the location of the New Republic's Beta Sector Base.

Lisal.title: Lisal
Lisal.lead: Lisal was a planet in the Mid Rim, rumored to be home to a Sith holocron.

Lis.title: Lis
Lis.lead: Lis was the innermost planet in the Cirius system. A molten, searing rock, it was uninhabitable.

Lish.title: Lish
Lish.lead: Lish was the sixth planet in the Demar system of the Expansion Region. A large, blue-green gas giant, Lish was orbited by fifteen moons.

Letev.title: Letev system/Legends
Letev.lead: The Letev system was a star system that was located within the Freeworlds Territory of the Tapani sector in the Colonies region of the galaxy. It was situated between the Tavya and Jappe systems.

Liok.title: Liok
Liok.lead: Liok was a planet in Ciutric sector in Outer Rim Territories, where archaeologists discovered the Shadow Traproom, one of the greatest finds of the modern era.

Lettow.title: Lettow
Lettow.lead: Lettow was a Core Worlds planet. After leaving the Jedi Order in 24,500 BBY, the Jedi Knight Xendor founded the Legionnaire Academy on Lettow for studying alternative Force-user traditions. Other like-minded individuals who came to follow Xendor named themselves the Legions of Lettow, and the group eventually came into conflict with the Jedi. After Xendor's death at the Battle of Columus, Jedi armies attacked the Legionnaires at Lettow, who held them off long enough to escape beyond the borders of the Galactic Republic. Over the subsequent millennia, Lettow became a legendary lost world.

Licha In.title: Licha In
Licha In.lead: Licha In was a world of the Gree Enclave and the first to suffer from the degeneration of Gree society. This resulted in the reputation that this world's inhabitants were both wild and backward; an example of what happened to the Gree during their decline, an example at least seen by the Gree of other worlds.

Liaq.title: Liaq
Liaq.lead: Liaq was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Core Worlds' Liaq system. At some point by 2 ABY, the Rebel Alliance officer Beryl Chiffonage encountered a group of mercenaries on Liaq. Later, when, around 2 ABY, the Alliance officer Risiev Credal jumped to hyperspace during a patrol, with all contact with him being lost, he was considered to have potentially defected to the Galactic Empire. Chiffonage, who had mentored Credal, subsequently made a personal addendum to a Task Force on Alliance Security SecuriDex datafile on the latter officer.

Lipsec.title: Lipsec system
Lipsec.lead: The Lipsec system was located in the Koradin sector of the Outer Rim Territories in grid square I-18 of the Standard Galactic Grid. The hyperspace route known as the Lipsec Run connected it to the Virgillia system and also extended in the opposite direction from it, further Rimward.

Lexas Prime.title: Lexas Prime system/Legends
Lexas Prime.lead: The Lexas Prime system was located in the Kessel sector, a part of the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It shared its name with the group of star systems known as the Lexas systems.

Lexrul.title: Lexrul/Legends

facts.region: Mid Rim, Kashyyyk Region, The Slice

Lexrul.lead: Lexrul was an urban planet located in the Trax sector of the Mid Rim.

Lira San.title: Lira San
Lira San.lead: Lira San was a remote planet located in the Lira San system of the galaxy's Wild Space region. Hidden behind a treacherous nebula formed from an imploded star cluster, it was the original homeworld of the Lasat species. Though many Lasat dwelled on Lasan, millions of Lasat remained on Lira San, but their existence was forgotten by the people of Lasan, who knew of Lira San only through an ancient prophecy.

Li-Toran.title: Li-Toran
Li-Toran.lead: Li-Toran was a volcanic Inner Rim planet that was the homeworld of the sentient, hive-based Melitto insectoids. The planet's atmosphere was noxious, dark, hot, and stormy, while underground, rivers of molten rock carved networks of tunnels and caverns filled with even more toxic steam.

Lew'el.title: Lew'el
Lew'el.lead: Lew'el, which meant deluge, was an aquatic planet located in the Wild Space of the galaxy. Originally settled by humans a long time ago, Lew'el remained a largely forgotten world by those who craved power. Humans native to Lew'el were called Lew'elans.

Leviathan.title: Leviathan
Leviathan.lead: The Leviathan was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer that served the Imperial Navy during the Imperial Era. At some point, it escorted the Imperial war minister to an Imperial supply moon alongside another Imperial Star Destroyer, although the group was attacked by rebel starfighters. Imperial TIE fighters defeated the rebels, although the war minister was pursued to the supply moon by more rebels in X-wing starfighters.

Lobaoc.title: Lobaoc
Lobaoc.lead: Lobaoc was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Mieru'kar sector. Its surface featured lakes and marshes, which were home to the tentacled and omnivorous dianogas. Human and Near-Human farmers maintained several settlements on Lobaoc. At some point between 67 BBY and 19 BBY, the Jedi High Council of the Jedi Order learned of the existence of a young Force-sensitive girl on Lobaoc. The Jedi Council dispatched the Mon Calamari Jedi Ambaln to investigate the situation and bring the child back to the Order for Jedi training.

Loce.title: Loce
Loce.lead: Loce was a celestial body situated in the Loce system of Wild Space that shared its name with the sentient near-Human Locan species. It was the homeworld of the young Locan Talas Piran. At some point by 2 BBY, Piran was captured by enslavers and taken from Loce, eventually being sold to a Galactic Empire–sanctioned company for which he was forced to log trees on the world Hintivan II in the Outer Rim Territories' Corva sectors.

Lohopa II.title: Lohopa II
Lohopa II.lead: Lohopa II was a mining colony in the Lohopa system of the Expansion Region, on the Harrin Trade Corridor. The local mining operations managed to resist Imperial takeover attempts. The planet developed a growing travel business due to its location on the Corridor. The local day was 25 standard hours long; its year was 414 local days long.

Logru.title: Logru
Logru.lead: Logru, also known as Loghru was the first planet in the Honoghr system. It was covered in molten lava.

Listoria.title: Listoria system/Legends
Listoria.lead: The Listoria system was a star system located in the Tapani sector's Cadriaan Province, between the Pavia system and the Cesya system.

Lockest IV.title: Lockest IV
Lockest IV.lead: Lockest IV was a planet in the Lockest system. The system was located in the Palamut sector of the Expansion Region. Roark Garnet once claimed to have contracted the Merthian lung infection while on Lockest IV to stop Tax Inspector Mothra from searching his ship. Mothra, a hypochondriac, hastily ended the inspection without searching the vessel.

Llorkan.title: Llorkan
Llorkan.lead: Llorkan was a planet and home to an Imperial army garrison. Llorkan was the original destination of Captain Norello's ship, Happer's Way, during his interrupted delivery of fifty AT-ST walkers.

Liul.title: Liul
Liul.lead: Liul was a planet where RC-5108/8843 blew up a gas storage facility in 21 BBY.

Loj.title: Loj
Loj.lead: Loj was a planet located in the Colonies' Loj system. It was the site of the Moss Caverns, near which the expensive intoxicating beverage known as T'iil-T'iil was manufactured.

Little Capella.title: Little Capella
Little Capella.lead: Little Capella was a planet in the Little Capella system in the Gordian Reach, a region in the Outer Rim Territories. In 2 ABY, the company Rapora Mining operated the Rapora Mining Center on Little Capella as one of many new facilities throughout the Outer Rim.

Llanic.title: Llanic/Legends

facts.routes: Llanic Spice Run, Triellus Trade Route
facts.affiliation: Hutt Cartel, Brotherhood of Darkness, Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems

Llanic.lead: Llanic was a planet in the Karthakk sector of the Outer Rim.

Loedorvia.title: Loedorvia
Loedorvia.lead: Loedorvia was a celestial body located in the Core Worlds' Weemell sector. During the Clone Wars, it was the site of a battle between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems. During that confrontation, Confederate General Grievous ordered the release on Loedorvia of the disease known as the Brainrot Plague. The act killed tens of thousands of individuals and led to the deaths of nearly every Human in the Weemell sector.

Little Kessel.title: Little Kessel
Little Kessel.lead: Little Kessel was a planet located in the Kessel sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Livien.title: Livien

facts.affiliation: Livien League, Xim's Empire, Honorable Union of Desevro & Tion, Tion Hegemony

Livien.lead: Livien was a planet located within the Outer Rim Territories and the founding world of the Livien League.

Little Talhovi.title: Little Talhovi
Little Talhovi.lead: Little Talhovi was a world located in the Little Talhovi system of the Juvex sector, a part of the Senex-Juvex region in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim. A hyperlane connected it to the Talhovi system. Little Talhovi was considered to be a promising agriworld by 43 ABY and, like the rest of the Senex-Juvex worlds, was under the control of the region's aristocratic Ancient Houses.

Lo'Uran.title: Lo'Uran
Lo'Uran.lead: Lo'Uran was a planet located in the Aparo sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Its governor was Blithane.

Llewebum.title: Llewebum
Llewebum.lead: Llewebum was a planet located in the galaxy. It was home to a species of the same name. It was a member of the New Republic.

Little Petrovi.title: Little Petrovi/Legends
Little Petrovi.lead: Little Petrovi was a celestial body located in the Little Petrovi system, a part of the Yushan sector in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim. It was situated on the super-hyperroute known as the Corellian Trade Spine, which linked it to the Jiroch, Kaal, and Dalisor systems.

Little Atullus.title: Little Atullus
Little Atullus.lead: Little Atullus was an Inner Rim astronomical object located in the Anthos sector. It was the homeworld of a Galactic Republic soldier. During the soldier's childhood at the time of the Tionese War, traders from the planet Brentaal sold the boy's parents some farmland on the celestial body Okator VIII. After moving to their new home on Okator VIII, the boy eventually forgot about Little Atullus despite still seeing it in his dreams.

Listehol.title: Listehol/Legends

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, New Territories, Trans-Hydian
facts.routes: Hydian Way, Morellian Trail, Listehol Run
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Zygerrian Slave Empire, Galactic Empire, Zsinj's Empire

Listehol.lead: Listehol was a planet located in the Listehol system within the Outer Rim Territories.

Lok.title: Lok/Legends

facts.terrain: Deserts, Sulfur pools, Mountains, Lava lands
facts.language: Galactic Basic Standard, Lok Pirate's Cant
facts.affiliation: Trade Federation, Lok Revenants, Galactic Empire

Lok.lead: Lok was a barren and dusty pirate world in the Outer Rim Territories.

Lolnar.title: Lolnar
Lolnar.lead: Lolnar was a planet located in the Lolnar system, in the Slice portion of the Core Worlds that was known as the Arrowhead. It was situated on the Corellian Run super-hyperroute, between the Perma and Rehemsa systems. The Human Lesan Ramier, who was a Moff of the Galactic Empire, hailed from Lolnar.

Lorahns.title: Lorahns/Legends
Lorahns.lead: Lorahns was a Mid Rim planet near the Gamor Run.

Lorell.title: Lorell

facts.affiliation: Lorell Raiders, Galactic Empire, Galactic Alliance

Lorell.lead: Lorell was a planet located in the Inner Rim of the galaxy. It lay in a system just outside the Hapes Cluster. It was once base of the Lorell Raiders and was later known for its kickboxing.

Lomabu III.title: Lomabu III
Lomabu III.lead: Lomabu III was a planet in the Mid Rim's Lomabu system, which was located near the Aida system. It had only one moon and was covered almost completely by oceans interrupted by long archipelagos. These islands many beaches were covered by carnivorous flagellate microorganisms. The Galactic Empire depopulated the planet of its natives as punishment for rebelling against Imperial authority, then used the planet as a penal colony for fugitive Wookiees.

Lokondo.title: Lokondo
Lokondo.lead: Lokondo was an icy world in the Braxant sector of the Outer Rim.

Lorenz.title: Lorenz system/Legends
Lorenz.lead: The Lorenz system was a star system located in the Tapani sector's Pelagia Province, situated along the Calipsa Run. It was annexed into Calipsa Province with the rise of the New Order.

Lonnaw.title: Lonnaw
Lonnaw.lead: Lonnaw was a Mid Rim planet located on the Entralla Route. It served as the first scheduled stop on the shakedown cruise of the Galactic Republic exploratory vessel Outbound Flight in 27 BBY. Thirty-nine years later, Lonnaw was temporarily captured from the New Republic by the Imperial Remnant.

Lonatro.title: Lonatro
Lonatro.lead: Lonatro was a world located within the Gree Enclave and served as the primary provider of foodstuffs to the Gree. During the height of the Gree civilization, this world's surface was dominated by farms and food production facilities, but after the decline of the Gree, 90% of the planet's surface was given over to game preserves and botanical gardens. The few remaining parcels of land still provided food for the Enclave.

Loken III.title: Loken III
Loken III.lead: The planet of Loken III was the headquarters of TransTech Droidworks. It was the location of Power Station TD-332, which Separatist Geonosians failed to protect from a Republic assault during the Clone Wars.

Lok Trul.title: Lok Trul
Lok Trul.lead: Lok Trul was a gas giant planet located in the Opoku system, a part of the Galov sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The planet occupied the fifth orbital position around the star Opoku and had thirteen moons. Along with the rest of its system, Lok Trul was located along the Triellus Trade Route.

Lola Sayu.title: Lola Sayu/Legends
Lola Sayu.lead: Lola Sayu was a sulfurous, cracked planet that was home to the Citadel, a prison engineered to hold Jedi, during the Clone Wars.

Longwind.title: Longwind

facts.region: Mid Rim, Kashyyyk Region, The Slice

Longwind.lead: Longwind was a planet located in the Trax sector of the Mid Rim.

Lorardia.title: Lorardia
Lorardia.lead: Lorardia, or Lorardian, was a planet located in the D'Astan sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Londor.title: Londor system/Legends
Londor.lead: The Londor system was located in the Londori sector, a part of the New Territories portion of the Mid Rim. The star system was connected by hyperlanes to the Ariarch, Valrar, Darkon, and Glee Anselm systems. It was the site of the Londori Mental Facility. By 12 ABY, the Londor system lay within territory controlled by the New Republic.

Lopor Station.title: Lopor Station
Lopor Station.lead: Lopor Station was a planet in the Spirva sector of the Mid Rim. The bounty hunter Quantana started out his career as a child in the streets of the planet.

Loped VII.title: Loped VII
Loped VII.lead: Loped VII was a planet in the Inner Rim.

Lonera.title: Lonera
Lonera.lead: Lonera was the homeworld of the Loneran species. It was located in the Inner Rim Territories along the Nanth'ri Trade Route between Antar and Gyndine. The fact Lonera was near the galaxy's Expansion Region was met with derision by some.

Lokori.title: Lokori
Lokori.lead: Lokori was the home planet to the species of the same name. It was near Ryloth and had a pleasant atmosphere. The planet had a rainy season. The capital city was Fucallpa, which was home to Helical HyperCom, a producer of personal comm devices.

Lolet.title: Lolet
Lolet.lead: Lolet was a planet located in the Lolet system. The Galactic Empire's Apprentice Legislature was chosen to decide a punishment for the planet after its government stood in violation of Regulation 16-ME regarding supplying fuel to Imperial pilots.

Lowick.title: Lowick/Legends

facts.terrain: Mountains, Oceans, Rainforests, Salt marshes, Seas

Lowick.lead: Lowick was a neutral planet in the Outer Rim Territories with equatorial rainforests that was the homeworld of the Pa'lowick species who hunted, fished, and farmed in the salt marshes. The planet abounded in fish, reptiles, marlello ducks, and veejy fruit.

Lorrd.title: Lorrd/Legends

facts.language: Galactic Basic Standard and Kinetic communication
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Myrialites, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire, Galactic Federation of Free Alliances

Lorrd.lead: Lorrd was located in the Kanz sector and was home to the unique Lorrdian culture of baseline Humans. Lorrd was close to Bimmiel and its capital city was Lorrd City.

Loronar.title: Loronar/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Darth Revan's Sith Empire, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Loronar.lead: Loronar was the headquarters of Loronar Corporation and the site of the Loronar shipyards and protected by the Loronar navy.

Lotide.title: Lotide
Lotide.lead: Lotide was a planet in the Mortex sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Low'n.title: Low'n
Low'n.lead: Low'n was a populous world in the Romintine sector of the Mid Rim. It was the homeworld of the Lowen.

Lorista.title: Lorista
Lorista.lead: Lorista was a terrestrial planet located in the Lorista system, a part of the Glythe sector in the New Territories portion of the Mid Rim. Its surface featured wastelands in which grew the flith flower, and it was also home to the vicious predatory creature bruth.

Lorta.title: Lorta/Legends
Lorta.lead: Lorta was a planet located on the Cerean Reach, near Jiroch-Reslia in the Mid Rim. It was was home to the violent and expansionist Lortans.

Lucazec.title: Lucazec/Legends

facts.affiliation: Xim's Empire, Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Lucazec.lead: Lucazec was a planet located within the Outer Rim Territories. Originally known as Far Thanium, it was absorbed into Xim's Empire as he expanded his borders from the Kingdom of Cron. Lucazec was a potential candidate for one of the lost thrones of Xim. After the fall of the empire in 25,100 BBY, it would eventually join the Galactic Republic. Lucazec was the Fallanassi world of origin. During the Clone Wars the planet was located within Separatist space. The Fallanassi fled the planet when Cassio Tagge tried to recruit them to the Empire.

Lorimax.title: Lorimax
Lorimax.lead: Lorimax was a planet in the Fakir sector's Lorimax system. It was noted for growing grain.

Lorora.title: Lorora

facts.region: Core Worlds, Northern Dependencies, The Slice, Arrowhead

Lorora.lead: Lorora was the third planet of the Chandrila system, located in the Bormea sector of the Ringali Shell in the Core Worlds. The planet orbited the star Chandrila and was composed of toxic rock. The world was itself orbited by a single moon. The entirety of the Chandrila system lay on the Perlemian Trade Route, which served as a dividing line between the Northern Dependencies and the Arrowhead portion of the Slice.

Lors.title: Lors

facts.sector: Duro sector, Corellian sector; Outlier systems (Imperial)

Lors.lead: Lors was a planet in the Duro system of the Core Worlds. The closest to the star Duro, Lors was a searing rock with one moon.

Lorrad.title: Lorrad
Lorrad.lead: Lorrad was an Outer Rim Territories urban world located in the Tion Cluster's Allied Tion sector. By around 25,130 BBY, it was ruled by the Livien League and was the site of a League victory over the forces of the Kingdom of Cron. Lorrad later spent millennia enslaved by the Kingdom of Barseg, with it only gaining its freedom around 300 BBY.

Loretto.title: Loretto
Loretto.lead: Loretto was the homeworld of the famed artist, Duos'tine.

Loxizhra.title: Loxizhra
Loxizhra.lead: Loxizhra was the second planet orbiting the star Polith in the Polith system. Located in the Jaso sector of the Inner Rim Territories, it was a desert world.

Lourdes' homeworld.title: Lourdes' homeworld
Lourdes' homeworld.lead: Lourdes' homeworld was a small planetoid located in the galaxy. A desert world, there was at least one city on the planet, dotted with small stone buildings. Around 31 BBY, the world was conquered by the Yahk-Tosh warlord Gar-Oth and his droid army. Killing the King, the warlord ruled the people of the world with fear. When Jedi Knight Yoshi Raph-Elan crash-landed on the world and befriended Princess Lourdes, the duo were able to confront the warlord and assassinate him, liberating the world.

Loth.title: Loth
Loth.lead: Loth was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Inner Rim's Loth system. The natural structures known as rubygrub cysts could be found there.

Lubang Minor.title: Lubang Minor
Lubang Minor.lead: Lubang Minor was a jungle planet widely considered nameless located in the Illisurevimurasi sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Lubang Minor was the site of a Clone Wars battle that stranded clone trooper BL-1707, known as Able. Decades later, the Alliance to Restore the Republic attempted to site a listening post on the unsettled planet in a mission guarded by Rebel pilots Arhul Narra, Luke Skywalker, Wedge Antilles, and Zev Senesca. They were attacked by Imperial forces, which drove the Rebels off the world only after they had met and recruited Able.

Lovola.title: Lovola system/Legends
Lovola.lead: The Lovola system was located in the Rifle Worlds, an area of the Hapes Cluster in the Slice portion of the Inner Rim. It was connected by the hyperlane known as the Great Rim Route to the Rifle Worlds' Maires system as well as the Ket system in the Lorelli Reach. The Lovola system was the origin point of the Lovolan company.

Lotho Minor.title: Lotho Minor/Legends
Lotho Minor.lead: Lotho Minor, also known as the Junk World or simply Lotho, was a planet located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories that was the homeworld of the Junker species. Used as a dumping ground, its surface was covered with junk and trash amassed over a number of generations, which brought salvage operations to the planet to find junk that could still be used. Following his defeat during the Battle of Naboo, the Sith Lord Darth Maul went into exile in the bowels of Lotho Minor, where he lost his mind until he was found by his brother, Savage Opress, over a decade later.

Lothal.title: Lothal

facts.terrain: Mountainous, Prairies, Rock formations, Semi-arid savannah, Marshes
facts.language: Aqualish, Galactic Basic Standard, Huttese, Ithorese
facts.affiliation: Jedi Order, Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire (Occupation), New Republic, First Order

Lothal.lead: Lothal was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories. During the early years of the Galactic Empire, Lothal was in a state of economic disrepair and invited the Empire to take over the planet's industries, with the promise of prosperity and security. Although many people said the Empire would bring doom, their attempted insurgency failed, while the Lothalites, who preached of new jobs and prosperity, were vindicated. Amid Lothal's growing strife with the Empire in 5 BBY, however, Lothal became the nesting ground for the Spectres, a small rebel cell which operated from the starship Ghost.

Lwhekk.title: Lwhekk/Legends
Lwhekk.lead: Lwhekk was a planet located in the Ssi-ruuk Star Cluster of the Unknown Regions in the galaxy. It was the homeworld of the sentient Ssi-ruu and P'w'eck species. It was the capital of the Ssi-ruuvi Imperium.

Shira.title: Lumiya

facts.affiliation: Galactic Empire, Emperor's Hands, Alliance to Restore the Republic (Undercover as a spy), Rogue Squadron (Undercover as a spy), Sith …

Shira.lead: Lumiya, born Shira Elan Colla Brie, was a Force-sensitive Human female who went from being an agent of the Galactic Empire to Dark Lady of the Sith. Born on Imperial Center during the height of Galactic Emperor Palpatine's reign over the majority of the galaxy, Brie dedicated herself to the tenets of the Imperial New Order doctrine. This garnered the interest of Palpatine's chief enforcer, the Sith Lord Darth Vader, who sped the young woman's advancement in various Imperial-sponsored programs, including her enrollment into the Intelligence Academy of Carida.

Lutrillia.title: Lutrillia/Legends

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories; Greater Javin, Western Reaches

Lutrillia.lead: Lutrillia was a planet in the Yarith sector of the Outer Rim, on the Lutrillian Cross hyperlane. An important export of Lutrillia was ochroid dust.

Lur.title: Lur
Lur.lead: Lur was an icy planet on the Outer Rim, known for the native Lurrian species, who were masters of genetic engineering. Located near the Corporate Sector, Lur was racked by severe storms and high winds, and the planet's dangerous wildlife forced the Lurrians to band into tight family groups as they evolved. As the planet's harsh environment limited their technological development, Lurrians advanced their society by mastering the flora and fauna around them, breeding and cloning purposely designed creatures that helped them build cities within Lur's glaciers.

Lweilot Asteroid Belt.title: Lweilot Asteroid Belt
Lweilot Asteroid Belt.lead: The Lweilot Asteroid Belt orbited the white dwarf Bseto and stretched 90 million kilometers wide.

Lyran IV.title: Lyran IV
Lyran IV.lead: Lyran IV was an Outer Rim Territories farming planet located in the Quiberon sector. It was home to the parasites known as Lyran bloodslugs. The planet served as a notable trans-shipment point of illegal spice, with the local crime lords investing into the local agricultural communities in order to maintain cover for their illicit operations.

Lynaria.title: Lynaria
Lynaria.lead: Lynaria was a planet in the Atrig system. It was a frozen rock incapable of supporting life.

M'buh.title: M'buh
M'buh.lead: M'buh was the sixth planet orbiting the star C'rel in the N'zoth system. Located in the Koornacht Cluster of the Core Worlds, it was a barren rock.

Lusk.title: Lusk system/Legends
Lusk.lead: The Lusk system was in the Freeworlds Territory of the Tapani sector, near the Mennaalii, Don I, and Don II systems.

Lucrenn.title: Lucrenn
Lucrenn.lead: Lucrenn was a world located within the star system of the same name, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Skine sector. Around the year 10 ABY, it served as the homeworld of Galindas Exports, a fencing operation and member of the criminal Tenloss Syndicate.

Luuq Two.title: Luuq Two
Luuq Two.lead: Luuq Two was a planet in the Luuq system in the Mid Rim's Luuq sector that was known for its beautiful, deep canyons.

M'Bardi.title: M'Bardi
M'Bardi.lead: M'Bardi was a water planet located in the Kalamith sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was also the site of the M'Bardi Prison.

Lurr.title: Lurr
Lurr.lead: Lurr was a planet in the Outer Rim's Rayter sector. One of the stormtroopers that accompanied the Sith Lord Darth Vader to Cheelit killed a young woman while on the planet. The Guild of Vindicators assassin Clat the Shamer later used the memories of that event to compel the soldier to commit suicide.

M'Hanna.title: M'Hanna
M'Hanna.lead: M'Hanna was a desolate planet that was located within the M'Hanna system in Hutt Space, a region of the galaxy controlled by the Hutt species. The planet was connected to the worlds of Tisht and Varl by the hyperlane called the Dead Road, while the Elgit–M'Hanna Corridor linked M'Hanna to the planet of Sakifwanna. M'Hanna was a world of black dust that was scoured by supersonic winds, and its history was the subject of various rumors and legends.

Lujo.title: Lujo
Lujo.lead: Lujo was a planet in the Core. It had a temperate climate, and was home to magnificent oceans and landscapes.

Lyntra.title: Lyntra
Lyntra.lead: Lyntra was the fourth planet orbiting the star of Sriluur in the Sriluur system. Located in the Tharin sector of the Outer Rim, it was a barren rock.

Lusaanda.title: Lusaanda
Lusaanda.lead: Lusaanda was a celestial body located in the Lusaanda system, a part of the Meram sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories.

Lusdu.title: Lusdu system/Legends
Lusdu.lead: The Lusdu system was a star system located in the Core Worlds region of the galaxy. The system was located one hour from the Alderaan system via lightspeed. Several months after the Destruction of Alderaan, the Ithorian Herdship Bazaar visited the system, orbiting the main planet in the system.

Lysatra.title: Lysatra
Lysatra.lead: Lysatra was an isolated planet in the Lysatra system in grid square I-8 of the Standard Galactic Grid, a portion of the Expansion Region that was considered Wild Space. By 15 BBY, it was still considered a part of Wild Space. Eli Vanto grew up on Lysatra, where he heard stories about the Chiss and worked in a shipping company. Besides Galactic Basic Standard, many trade languages of the Wild Space were spoken, including the language Sy Bisti.

Luprora.title: Luprora
Luprora.lead: Luprora was a planet located in the galaxy that had unstable environment conditions. The planet was the homeworld of the aquatic Tsw'ells and sentient R'ora species. Prior to the First Order-Resistance War, Luprora was settled by a humanoid species known as the Lupr'or. Following the Battle of Starkiller Base, Captain Phasma, TN-3465, and BB-K8 pursued the fugitive Lieutenant Sol Rivas to Luprora, whom Phasma framed for lowering Starkiller Base's shields. Phasma then killed Rivas and TN-3465, and destroyed BB-K8 in order to conceal the secret that she had destroyed Starkiller Base.

Maires.title: Maires/Legends

facts.affiliation: Hapes Consortium, Galactic Empire, Galactic Alliance

Maires.lead: Maires was the Mairan homeworld. It was an ocean world located in the Hapes Cluster.

Mackar.title: Mackar
Mackar.lead: Mackar was a water world located in the Mackar system, a part of the Hewett sector in the New Territories portion of the Mid Rim. It was the homeworld of the Frid, a species of telepathic, fish-like aquatic sentients.

Ma'ar Shaddam.title: Ma'ar Shaddam/Legends
Ma'ar Shaddam.lead: Ma'ar Shaddam was a remote Outer Rim planet, home to the armorers who served Boba Fett. The planet was settled by Galactic Republic Master Weaponsmiths not only for the quality of its ore, but because its remoteness made it difficult for the authorities to police the sale of illegal weaponry.

Magagran.title: Magagran
Magagran.lead: Magagran was an Imperial planet in the Halthor sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Mabonte.title: Mabonte
Mabonte.lead: Mabonte was the fourth planet in the Geonosis system. It was orbited by a pair of moons.

Maedano.title: Maedano
Maedano.lead: Maedano was the second planet in the Metellos system, a star system in the Corusca sector of the Core Worlds. It was a barren rock with one moon.

Majesticas.title: Majesticas
Majesticas.lead: Majesticas was the third planet in the Metellos system, a star system in the Corusca sector of the Core Worlds. It was a toxic rock with no moons.

Maddules.title: Maddules
Maddules.lead: Maddules was the fourth planet in the Metellos system, a star system in the Corusca sector of the Core Worlds. It was a gas giant with nine moons.

M4-78.title: M4-78
M4-78.lead: M4-78 was a legendary planet of droids, supposedly dating back to the Old Republic. I-5YQ once joked about being the deposed ruler of the planet while he was on Drongar.

Mairne.title: Mairne
Mairne.lead: Mairne, situated within the system of the same name, was a planet in the Kathol sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Connected to the neighboring planets of Charis and Gandle Ott by hyperlanes, Mairne was located just off the Trition Trade Route that ran through the sector. By 8 ABY, the world supported a small colony whose economy was based around supplying ore and natural resources to Gandle Ott.

Majilop.title: Majilop
Majilop.lead: Majilop was a world located within the star system of the same name, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Lol sector. Around the year 10 ABY, it served as the homeworld of the Lucin Syndicate, a major producer and distributor of illegal holoporn.

Magar's World.title: Magar's World/Legends
Magar's World.lead: Magar's World was a brutal, inconsequential backwater planet that did not appear on many star-charts. It was said there were only two real reasons why someone might know of it: that individual either went to see the gladiatorial games, or they were among the unlucky beings forced to fight in them.

M2398.title: M2398
M2398.lead: M2398 was a gas giant, in the M2398 system, near warlord Zsinj's territory. It was orbited by the Blood Nest moon which was controlled by pirates. Furthermore, it was the place where Wraith Squadron suffered its first loss, Jesmin Ackbar.

Maal.title: Maal
Maal.lead: Maal was a gas giant located at the intersection of the Authority Guardian Corridor and the Trianii Shunt, in space annexed by the Corporate Sector in 5 BBY. The planet was orbited by Hiit, a moon that was the home of the avian Hiitians.

Makatak.title: Makatak
Makatak.lead: Makatak was a planet within the Rakatan Archipelago. Following the collapse of the Infinite Empire, it was inhabited by an enlightened tribe of Rakata called the Makatak tribe.

Maccent.title: Maccent
Maccent.lead: Maccent was a planet located in the Phelleem sector of the Outer Rim Territories, along the Sisar Run.

Maicombe.title: Maicombe
Maicombe.lead: Maicombe was a planet in the Mid Rim's Corthenia sector. In 21 ABY, Luke and Mara Jade Skywalker spent their second honeymoon on Maicombe.

Maarka.title: Maarka
Maarka.lead: Maarka was a planet located in the Perkell sector of the Mid Rim. During the Clone Wars, it was the site of a Republic base. While on a mission to deliver a data file with important intelligence for the Republic base on Maarka, Ahsoka Tano was ambushed by six Vulture droid starfighters in an asteroid field near the planet.

Magravia.title: Magravia
Magravia.lead: Magravia was a world located in the Magravia system, a part of the Karthakk sector in the Trailing Sectors portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was situated on the hyperlane known as the Llanic Spice Run, which connected it to the Llanic system as well as the Socorro system in the Kibilini sector.

Mahranee.title: Mahranee

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems

Mahranee.lead: Mahranee was a planet in the Mahranee system in the Taldot sector of the Mid Rim Territories that was the homeworld of the Mahran species. Known for being rich in resources, Mahranee was attacked and taken by the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars in order to secure the planet's riches for the Separatist cause.

Malachor V.title: Malachor V

facts.terrain: Post-cataclysm, Caverns, Crevasses, Gorges, Jagged rock spires, Poison gas vents, Sheer cliffs
facts.affiliation: Adas's Sith Empire, Old Sith Empire, Vitiate's Sith Empire, Darth Revan's Sith Empire, Sith Triumvirate

Malachor V.lead: Malachor V, or simply Malachor, was an Outer Rim planet located in the Malachor system. Prior to the final battle of the Mandalorian Wars, the planet was fertile and hospitable. After the cataclysm caused by the Mass Shadow Generator, it became a cracked and twisted wasteland covered with jagged cliffs and plagued by constant lightning storms. It was inhabited by monstrous storm beasts. The gravity of the planet was unstable, which made it dangerous for starships to stay there for very long.

Makem Te.title: Makem Te/Legends

facts.affiliation: Congress of Caliphs, Xim's Empire, Galactic Republic, Sith Empire (Great Sith War), Sith Empire, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire

Makem Te.lead: Makem Te was the dry homeworld of the Swokes Swokes species, on the Perlemian Trade Route.

Malagarr.title: Malagarr/Legends
Malagarr.lead: Malagarr was located in Wild Space. Its primary terrain was red sand. It was home to droids of Q-7N's type. In 0 ABY, the Galactic Empire made an incursion there.

Makem Pria.title: Makem Pria
Makem Pria.lead: Makem Pria was a planet in the Makem system. It was a giant ball of searing rock.

Makem Sup.title: Makem Sup
Makem Sup.lead: Makem Sup was a planet in the Makem system.

Makem Hek.title: Makem Hek
Makem Hek.lead: Makem Hek was a planet in the Makem system.

Makem Liva.title: Makem Liva
Makem Liva.lead: Makem Liva was a planet in the Makem system.

Makem Qat.title: Makem Qat
Makem Qat.lead: Makem Qat was a planet in the Makem system.

Makem Dua.title: Makem Dua
Makem Dua.lead: Makem Dua was a planet in the Makem system.

Malanose.title: Malanose
Malanose.lead: Malanose was a planet in the Gree Enclave, on the Outer Rim of the galaxy, which served as the primary world containing the Crafter and Researcher castes of the Gree civilization.

Makksre.title: Makksre
Makksre.lead: Makksre was the planet located in the Uoti sector of the Core Worlds in the galaxy. Sansia Bardrin and her ship were captured by pirates some time prior to 18 ABY.

Malador.title: Malador/Legends
Malador.lead: Malador was an overpopulated urban planet located in the Mid Rim's Juvex sector. Cappabellor beetles were native to Malador, and it served as the homeworld of the aristocratic House Kellermin. Over time, Malador's ecosystem was ruined by industrial pollution, and many House Kellermin nobles left the planet for the nearby world of Resti Kel, leaving slaves and client species to work in Malador's factories.

Makthierse.title: Makthierse
Makthierse.lead: Makthierse was a colony world noted for ranches, farms, crystal caves, and Quantrax Creek. Native creatures included lacas and preying makthiers.

Malano III.title: Malano III
Malano III.lead: Malano III was a planet formerly ruled by the A'mari clan.

Malata.title: Malata
Malata.lead: Malata was a planet located in the Malata system of the Unknown Regions. It was a part of the Rakatan Archipelago, a fragmented group of unaligned planets settled by tribes of the Rakata species after the collapse of the Rakatan Infinite Empire around 25,200 BBY.

Malachor III.title: Malachor III
Malachor III.lead: Malachor III was an Outer Rim planet located in the Malachor system.

Malachor II.title: Malachor II
Malachor II.lead: Malachor II was an Outer Rim planet located in the Malachor system.

Makeb.title: Makeb

facts.affiliation: Avesta Mining Corporation, Hutt Cartel, Galactic Republic (contested), Sith Empire

Makeb.lead: Makeb was a planet in the Mid Rim in the Aida sector close to the edges of Hutt Space. It was a major source of isotope-5, one of the rarest minerals in the galaxy.

Malachor.title: Malachor
Malachor.lead: Malachor was a rocky, hellish wasteland planet located in the Chorlian sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories region. It was a planet shrouded in mystery, and the location of an event known as the Great Scourge of Malachor, which took place thousands of years before the rise of the Empire. The Great Scourge was an ancient battle at Malachor's Sith temple between the Sith and the Jedi Order, which saw a superweapon activated, killing and petrifying all the participants of the battle, remaining for years after.

Manaan.title: Manaan/Legends

facts.population: Historic (Jedi Civil War): 502,000:, 99.6% Selkath, 0.4% Other, 1.8 million:, 80% Selkath, 18% Humans, 2% other, c. 25 ABY: 1–10 million
facts.affiliation: Infinite Empire, Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire

Manaan.lead: Manaan was an aquatic planet in the Pyrshak system. It was home to the Selkath, an amphibious species. The planet was completely covered in water and was the only known source of the medicinal substance kolto in the galaxy. Controlled by the Rakata during pre-Republic history, it became independent following the collapse of their Infinite Empire. In the years leading up to and during the Jedi Civil War, kolto was so important to the galaxy that the Selkath were able to use their monopoly to enforce their policy of neutrality and autonomy.

Maltha Obex.title: Maltha Obex system
Maltha Obex.lead: The Maltha Obex system was a star system located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories.

Mandalore.title: Mandalore/Legends

facts.terrain: Deserts, Forests, Grass plains, Jungles, Seas
facts.government: Mandalorian warrior clans: Clan leaders under the authority of the Mand'alor, New Mandalorians: Prime Minister-led Ruling Council
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire

Mandalore.lead: Mandalore was the fifth planet in the Mandalore system of the Outer Rim Territories, not far from the Hydian Way trade route. The homeworld of the multi-species cultural group known as the Mandalorians, the planet was known as Manda'yaim in the Mandalorian language, and was named after the legendary conqueror of the vibrant world, Mandalore the First. Mandalore the First's Taung warriors slew the indigenous mythosaurs and tamed the savage landscape, solidifying Mandalore's place as a powerbase and the center of Mandalorian space for millennia to come.

Mandell.title: Mandell
Mandell.lead: Mandell was a Bothan colony world. It was once devastated by drought, requiring grain shipments from Bothawui. Unfortunately, these shipments contained radarks, which infested the planet.

Malrev IV.title: Malrev IV
Malrev IV.lead: Malrev IV was a planet located in the Thrasybule sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Its history was strongly associated with the Sith.

Manda.title: Manda/Legends

facts.routes: Manda Merchant Route, Manda-Roon Merchant Route, Tatooine Dash
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Exar Kun's Sith Empire, Brotherhood of Darkness, Galactic Empire

Manda.lead: Manda was a planet located in the Mid Rim region of the galaxy.

Malthor.title: Malthor
Malthor.lead: Malthor was a Mid Rim planet located in the Tandon sector. It featured the active trade city Fabrillan, which in turn was the site of the busy Fabrillan City Spaceport. Fabrillan was home to a relatively large population of the sentient Reigat, and the Humans Berren Sid Té and Reginna Bel Typolla were also native to the planet.

Mamendin.title: Mamendin
Mamendin.lead: Mamendin was a world situated in the Core Worlds. It colonized the Mid Rim's Malari system, and, by the time of the Separatist Crisis, the Malarian Alliance bound it to that system as well as, ultimately, around forty others. By 24 BBY, Mamendin was where the Slams gang of criminals hailed from. Two years later, members of the Malarian Alliance were considering withdrawing from the Galactic Republic. A Separatist plot to ensure that outcome did not succeed, and the Galactic Empire later declared the Malarian Alliance to be null and void.

Mall'ordian.title: Mall'ordian

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Corporate Sector Authority, Zsinj's Empire, Confederation, Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire

Mall'ordian.lead: Mall'ordian was a planet in the Corporate Sector. A popular tourist destination, it was renown for its crystalline forests. The Corporate Sector Authority was interested in the planet for its potential resources.

Maltorian mining belt.title: Maltorian Mining Belt
Maltorian mining belt.lead: The Maltorian Mining Belt was an asteroid belt that was located in the Maltorian system, a part of the Lifh sector in the Slice portion of the Mid Rim. It was located near Maltoria.

Maldra IV.title: Maldra IV
Maldra IV.lead: Maldra IV was a planet in the Maldra system of the Outer Rim's Shadola sector. Not long after the Battle of Yavin, the Galactic Empire sought to destroy a pirate base on the planet, but discovered the base actually belonged to the Rebels. The Empire claimed it was a munitions base; the Alliance claimed it was a refugee base. Regardless of the propaganda, Imperial forces led by the Imperial Star Destroyer Motivator under the command of Captain Briera demolished the base.

Malicar 3.title: Malicar 3
Malicar 3.lead: Malicar 3 was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories, covered in rocky wastes.

Malo VI.title: Malo VI
Malo VI.lead: Malo VI was a planet in the Malo system where a warrant was issued for the arrest of Tegist Byrg.

Mandrine.title: Mandrine/Legends
Mandrine.lead: Mandrine was a celestial body located in the Outer Rim Territories' Kessel sector. It featured several bars, including Maizie's. During the Galactic Civil War, the crew of the smuggling starship Capri Nitari visited Mandrine's bars to celebrate a successful spice trafficking run. At Maizie's, the vessel's Captain Scarlet Bloodhawk met the mercenary Kelly Vermillion and his companions Tyric and Nana, who became involved in a bar fight against Kronus and his thugs, which resulted in Kronus's death. Bloodhawk later visited the same bar on Mandrine on several occasions.

Malkii.title: Malkii/Legends
Malkii.lead: Malkii was a remote planet. It commonly served as a refuge for mercenaries, insurrectionists and terrorists, but perhaps it was most notorious for its reputation as the training ground of the infamous assassins known as Malkite Poisoners.

Mandallia.title: Mandallia
Mandallia.lead: Mandallia was a planet located in the Mandalore system of the Outer Rim Territories. The homeworld of the Mandallian Giants, a race of physically large and muscular beings raised from birth as warriors, Mandallia was the neighbor world of the Mandalorian's home planet, Mandalore. The two worlds became associated after a failed invasion by the ancient Mandalorian Crusaders displayed the prowess of Mandallia's inhabitants, earning the Mandallian Giants the respect of the Mandalorians.

Manalin.title: Manalin
Manalin.lead: Manalin was a rocky planet located in the Joralla system, a part of the Mektrun sector in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim. Manalin occupied the closest orbital position around its sun, the red giant–type star Jaska, and had no moons. The searing-hot planet had a poisonous atmosphere and was considered to have no commercial value.

Malterra.title: Malterra
Malterra.lead: Malterra was a minor planet that was located within the Tython system of the galaxy's Deep Core region. The small world experienced violent storms when it passed the planet Sunspot in its orbit, and it had an extremely hot climate. More than thirty-six thousand years before the Battle of Yavin, the non–Force-sensitive settlers of the planet Tython colonized Malterra. Millennia later, mining operations had been established on the planet.

Mandalah III.title: Mandalah III

facts.terrain: Rocky desert (70%), putrid swamps (20%), polluted lakes and ponds (10%)

Mandalah III.lead: Mandalah III was a planet in the Mandalah system.

Malpaz.title: Malpaz
Malpaz.lead: Malpaz was a planet that during the Clone Wars suffered invasions from both the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems. It was home to an avian species.
