During the Imperial Era, the Galactic Empire's Project Celestial Power established a research facility on Malpaz, building it on a hill that overlooked the Malpaz capital city. However, an accident resulted in the facility's destruction and the deaths of thousands of civilian casualties.

Mantooine.title: Mantooine/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Mantooine Liberators (briefly), Pentastar Alignment, New Republic

Mantooine.lead: Mantooine was a planet in the Atrivis sector, on the Relgim Run. The people of Mantooine distrusted outsiders and government, particularly the totalitarian Galactic Empire. After the Mantooine Liberators were decimated by Imperial forces, the Fest Resistance Group united with the Liberators to form the Atrivis Resistance Group, which allied with the pan-galactic Rebel Alliance and became its Atrivis Sector Force.

Maramere.title: Maramere
Maramere.lead: Maramere was a planet located in the Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of the sentient Mere species. The planet fell under the domination of Lord Toat of the Trade Federation, which used it as a repository of stygium crystals from Aeten II.

Manwess III.title: Manwess III
Manwess III.lead: Manwess III was an astronomical object that occupied the third orbital position in the Manwess system, a part of the Kilbanis sector in the Slice portion of the Colonies. At some point between 0 ABY and 4 ABY, Moff Adrell of the Galactic Empire issued from Manwess III a bounty on the Human counterfeiter Malindin Gevarak.

Marasai.title: Marasai
Marasai.lead: Marasai was a planet in the Marasa Nebula, near the Trellen Trade Route. It was the homeworld of the Marasans, a species of cyborgs. It was notable for a gentle ecology, despite the sometimes difficult to predict weather which resulted from Marasai's location within the chaotic nebula.

Marca.title: Marca/Legends
Marca.lead: Marca, the Sekct homeworld, was a planet in the Marcellus Nebula.

Mantessa.title: Mantessa

facts.affiliation: Yuuzhan Vong empire, Galactic Federation of Free Alliances

Mantessa.lead: Mantessa was a planet in the Orus sector of the Inner Rim. The world was encased in forests and treacherous jungles. The wilderness was extremely dangerous due to the existence of Mantessan panthacs, predatory animals who stalked and killed quite efficiently in their home environment.

Manress.title: Manress/Legends
Manress.lead: Manress was the Stokhli homeworld. The Stokhli were hunters who invented Stokhli spray sticks.

Manpha.title: Manpha/Legends
Manpha.lead: Manpha was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Seitia sector. A humid world with marshlands and swamps on its single continent, it was the homeworld of the amphibian Shawda Ubb species. The Shawda Ubb primarily lived in many small communities scattered across Manpha's swamplands and harvested petroleum bubbling up out of the swamps. The substance was shipped to factories in Manpha's sole spaceport community, the capital city Shanpan, where it was processed into plastics for export offworld.

Maphus Tria.title: Maphus Tria
Maphus Tria.lead: Maphus Tria was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories where the con artist Tord Gamb ran a con that netted him several hundred thousand credits.

Mantarran.title: Mantarran
Mantarran.lead: Mantarran was a planet where Moranda Savich managed to avoid capture by Hal Horn.

Mantan.title: Mantan
Mantan.lead: Mantan was a terrestrial world located in the Mantan system, a part of the Calamari sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The Prously's Rim Run hyperlane linked it to the New Heurkea and Pammant systems. Members of the Mon Calamari species of the planet Dac settled Mantan at some point between 4400 BBY and 4200 BBY, and the former world shared its name with the Mon Calamari cruiser Mantan Wanderer of the Rebel Alliance.

Mar'ta II.title: Mar'ta II
Mar'ta II.lead: Mar'ta II was the seventh planet of the Kothlis system.

Mar'ta I.title: Mar'ta I
Mar'ta I.lead: Mar'ta I was the sixth planet in the Kothlis system.

Manforgon.title: Manforgon
Manforgon.lead: Manforgon was a planet located in the Mid Rim's Senex sector. It was used for centuries as a penal colony of the Senex-Juvex region. Eventually becoming a lawless world fought over by warlords, Manforgon was turned over to the Galactic Empire by the noble houses of the Senex-Juvex. The Empire used the planet for military purposes, and during the Galactic Civil War, Imperial Customs Officer Tellix served there.

Mangez.title: Mangez system/Legends
Mangez.lead: The Mangez system was a star system in the Expansion Region's Brak sector. The system contained at least two planet upon which Lant Mining Corporation conducted underground metal mining operations. Two orbital Lormar-class Refinery Stations were also present in the system, one of which was designated Lormar 23. Lant Mining Corporation planned on transporting a third Lormar-class station to the system to assist with refinery operations.

Mannova.title: Mannova
Mannova.lead: Mannova was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Mannova system, a part of the Gordian Reach sector in the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. A hyperlane linked it to the Betshish system.

Marcelan Prime.title: Marcelan Prime
Marcelan Prime.lead: Marcelan Prime was a celestial body located in the Wild Space star system of the same name. During the Galactic Civil War, the Tempest Force unit of the Galactic Empire's armed forces, which included the stormtrooper Hume Tarl, participated in a military operation at Marcelan Prime.

Mangan Three.title: Mangan Three
Mangan Three.lead: Mangan Three was a world located in the Colonies.

Mannius Eight.title: Mannius Eight
Mannius Eight.lead: Mannius Eight was a planet located in the Mannius system in Wild Space, in grid square I-14 of the Standard Galactic Grid. At one point it was explored by the Graf family. The planet included lifeforms such as octopoids which communicated by changing their skin patterns.

Mapuzo.title: Mapuzo/Legends
Mapuzo.lead: Mapuzo was a world located in the Mapuzo system in the Hollan sector, which lay in the New Territories portion of the Mid Rim. Via a hyperlane, Mapuzo was connected to the Nicandra system in the Nicandra sector and the Walin'or system in the Shiwal sector.

Maridun.title: Maridun/Legends

facts.affiliation: Infinite Empire, Galactic Empire, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Maridun.lead: Maridun was the grassy and forested homeworld of the Amanin species. Maridun went unnoticed for many millennia, and so was considered a haven by those who knew of of its existence. The planet came to support a colony of Lurmen who sought to escape the Clone Wars, and was the site of a battle when Confederate General Lok Durd arrived on the planet to test an experimental weapon. Amani could be found on the planet of Utapau, where many of them were refugees from Maridun.

Maryo.title: Maryo
Maryo.lead: Maryo was a resort world in the Corporate Sector. It was well known for its bazaars and was often visited by idle wealthy beings. Those who visited the planet also enjoyed hunting the native peckvas and fishing for colossus fish amongst the world's vast seas.

Marquarra.title: Marquarra
Marquarra.lead: Marquarra was an Outer Rim planet with a weapons cache of the Ubiqtorate. It was allied with the Imperial Remnant.

Marenn Yagen.title: Marenn Yagen
Marenn Yagen.lead: Marenn Yagen was a planet in the Bovo Yagen system.

Marjune.title: Marjune
Marjune.lead: Marjune was the first planet in the Tirahnn system of the Inner Rim Territories. It was a barren, rocky world.

Markon IV.title: Markon IV
Markon IV.lead: Markon IV was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Markon system of the Core Worlds. During the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Rebel Alliance, it hosted an Imperial base.

Marngar III.title: Marngar III
Marngar III.lead: Marngar III was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Marngar system. It was a part of the Arrowhead, or the Slice portion of the Core Worlds. During the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Rebel Alliance, Marngar III was affiliated with the Empire and was the site of the Imperial University of Marngar III.

Maryx Minor.title: Maryx Minor/Legends
Maryx Minor.lead: Maryx Minor was a volcanic planet in the Outer Rim Territories, covered in geysers and pits of lava. It was the location of the hermitage of the Ancient Order of Pessimists, beyond the Maryb Wastes. Abal Karda fled to the hermitage with the head of Selestrine the prophet; while there, the terrified Karda threatened the hermits living there and killed one, named Mabob. Later, Darth Vader destroyed the hermitage by Star Destroyer barrage.

Mastala.title: Mastala
Mastala.lead: Mastala was the third planet in the Outer Rim Territories' Garnib system. It was frigid and rocky. The Alliance to Restore the Republic named a ship after it.

Masalou.title: Masalou
Masalou.lead: Masalou was a barren rock planet with no moons that occupied the third orbital position around the yellow star Baralou within the Baralou system of the Outer Rim Territories' Varada sector.

Marmoth.title: Marmoth
Marmoth.lead: Marmoth was a planet located in the Albarrio sector of the Outer Rim Territories, and was a part of the Relgim Run. It was one of the ports of call of the luxury liner Kuari Princess.

Mash Shareo.title: Mash Shareo
Mash Shareo.lead: Mash Shareo was the second planet orbiting the star Tor in the Tobali system. Located in the Outer Rim Territories, it was a gas giant.

Mase.title: Mase
Mase.lead: Mase was the fifth planet orbiting the star of Tive in the Taanab system. Located in the Inner Rim, it was a gas giant.

Masposhani.title: Masposhani
Masposhani.lead: Masposhani was a planet in the Mid Rim. According to Beldorion the Hutt, the Jedi Order had once maintained a training facility in its caves.

Massoss.title: Massoss/Legends
Massoss.lead: Massoss was a planet located in the Massoss system, a part of the Chiss Space area of the Unknown Regions. The Phalanx Route hyperlane linked it to the planet Cormit. Massoss was an outlying colony of the sentient Chiss species and was home to one of the Ruling Families that ruled over the Chiss Ascendancy, the government of the Chiss.

Marfa.title: Marfa

facts.affiliation: Jedi Order, Agricultural Corps, Galactic Republic

Marfa.lead: Marfa was a planet in the Core Worlds that housed Jedi AgriCorps facilities during the Cold War. Hestizo Trace and the Murakami orchid she had created a bond with were kidnapped here by the Whiphid bounty hunter Tulkh. Later, Jedi Knight Rojo Trace came to the planet in search of Hestizo.

Marotan.title: Marotan
Marotan.lead: Marotan was a planet located in the Inner Rim.

Marrovia.title: Marrovia
Marrovia.lead: Marrovia was an agriworld located in the Marrovia system, a part of the Gordian Reach sector in the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The Pinooran Spur hyperlane connected the world to the Kli'aar and Ladarra systems.

Marleyvane.title: Marleyvane
Marleyvane.lead: Marleyvane was a terrestrial astronomical object that hosted an Imperial Academy and Imperial shipyards. It was located in the Marleyvane system in the Tharin sector of the Outer Rim Territories, along the Triellus Trade Route just north of the intersection with another hyperspace route at the nearby Junkfort Station. Lieutenant Chiron and Sergeant Currahee were stationed at Marleyvane before being transferred to the Academy for Young Imperials on Lothal.

Mardona III.title: Mardona III/Legends
Mardona III.lead: Mardona III was a location in the galaxy.

Mechis III.title: Mechis III/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Darth Revan's Sith Empire, Techno Union, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, IG-88's Droid Army, New Republic

Mechis III.lead: Mechis III was a rocky, smoky and volcanic planet which served as one of the prime droid manufacturers in the galaxy. Covered in automated droid building facilities, it provided the galaxy with all manner of droids for generations. Many of the galaxy's largest droid designers subcontracted the construction work to the plants on Mechis III, where the automated systems were highly efficient.

Mataou.title: Mataou/Legends

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Western Reaches, Greater Javin
facts.sector: Javin sector (prior to c. 400 BBY), Anoat sector (c. 400 BBY—)

Mataou.lead: Mataou was a desert world located in the Anoat sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was home to the ro hypa, a snake-like creature whose venom was collected by a colony of Human snake handlers for its medicinal properties. Mataou was orbited by a drydock and a fuel station.

Maya Kovel.title: Maya Kovel/Legends

facts.sector: Zuma sector, Inner Zuma Region, Moddell subsector
facts.system: Inner Moddell systems, Maya Kovel system

Maya Kovel.lead: Maya Kovel was a windswept Outer Rim Territories desert planet located in the Moddell sector. It was the homeworld of the sentient Ayrou species, which had already developed spaceflight technology prior to its first contact with the Galactic Republic by 50 BBY. The Ayrou went on to have a significant presence throughout the larger Zuma sector's Inner and Outer Zuma regions, including control over the Vashan-worked mines on the planet Vasha.

Masterra.title: Masterra

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Masterra.lead: Masterra, originally known as Ord Masterra, was a planet in the Hertae sector of the Mid Rim.

Meastrinnar.title: Meastrinnar
Meastrinnar.lead: Meastrinnar was an Inner Rim planet. During the Galactic Civil War, it rebelled against the Galactic Empire, leading to an Imperial pacification campaign in the city Vondrel. The Empire eventually discovered a Rebel Alliance intelligence cell in Vondrel's sister city Vondrol; however, due to a communications error, a stormtrooper unit under the command of Vin Northal stormed a building in Vondrel instead.

Mauk.title: Mauk
Mauk.lead: Mauk was a planet where Asajj Ventress was worshiped as a goddess of death.

Mawan.title: Mawan/Legends

facts.terrain: Urban and hot humid fungus rainforest
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Mawan.lead: Later, 8t88 murdered Zokor Polpot on Mawan.

Mazuma.title: Mazuma
Mazuma.lead: Mazuma was a planet located in the Mazuma system, within the Nuiri sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories, that was site of the Lucre Cosminational Bank.

Mattri Asteroid.title: Mattri asteroid base
Mattri Asteroid.lead: The Mattri asteroid base was an asteroid base in the Mattri system that once served as a location for the headquarters of Garm Bel Iblis's private, anti-Imperial resistance movement, dubbed Peregrine's Nest.

Maxca.title: Maxca system/Legends
Maxca.lead: The Maxca system was an isolated star system in the Brak sector, located in the Expansion Region. During the Galactic Civil War, the Rebel Alliance's Brak Sector Force began construction on a secret base in the system to act as a safe fallback position in case any main Alliance bases in the sector were compromised.

Mazhar.title: Mazhar
Mazhar.lead: Mazhar was a jungle planet in the Spadja sector. Embra the Hutt based his operations there.

Matarri.title: Matarri
Matarri.lead: Matarri was a planet noted for its sudden, monsoon rainstorms that contained pounding raindrops that could kill small animals.

Matt Talon's homeworld.title: Matt Talon's homeworld
Matt Talon's homeworld.lead: The Human male Matt Talon was born on an agricultural planet. His family was impoverished.

Mawr.title: Mawr
Mawr.lead: Mawr was a gas giant planet with seven moons that was located within the Tython system of the galaxy's Deep Core region. Mawr and Obri—another gas giant of the star system—were collectively referred to by the settlers of the Tython system as "the Giants." More than thirty-six thousand years before the Battle of Yavin, the non–Force-sensitive settlers of the planet Tython colonized Mawr's moons. By 25,793 BBY, gas-mining facilities had also been established within the atmosphere of the planet itself.

Maun Digitalis.title: Maun Digitalis
Maun Digitalis.lead: Maun Digitalis was a world located in the Maun Digitalis system, a part of the Northern Dependencies portion of the Colonies. At some point after the establishment of the Galactic Empire in 19 BBY, the elite Imperial stormtrooper unit 501st Legion fought on Maun Digitalis.

Mechis II.title: Mechis II
Mechis II.lead: Mechis II was an industrial planet located in the Mechis system of the Inner Rim. By the time of the Cold War, the world's plant life had adapted to grow inside droids and other machinery.

Matabre.title: Matabre
Matabre.lead: Matabre was an astronomical object located in the Eucer sector's Matabre system. It was considered a part of the Mid Rim, although it was situated in the region known as the Divide during the Tionese War, which was fought between the Galactic Republic and the Honorable Union of Desevro & Tion. Matabre had been settled by Republic colonists by that time.

Bright Jewel asteroid field.title: Masul'ivis Asteroid Belt
Bright Jewel asteroid field.lead: An Masul'ivis Asteroid Belt was situated near the planet of Ord Mantell in the Bright Jewel system. A debris of a vessel was known to be strewn among the asteroids. The asteroid belt was mined by the Dynath Miners during the Galactic Civil War. During the Battle of Tansarii Point Station, Black Sun pirates targeted Dynathian transports in the Masul'ivis Asteroid Belt. Car'das starfighters dispatched by Laetin A'shera finally repelled Black Sun forces and escorted Dynathian ships safely back to the H-5 70 Mining Facility.

Mathas.title: Mathas
Mathas.lead: Mathas was a planet in the Mathas system of the Inner Rim Territories whose inhabitants suffered from the Niffin plague at some time before the Clone Wars. The Jedi Order set up an outreach temple in response to the plague where individuals could go for emotional and spiritual aid. Jedi Master Kez Velaz was chosen to oversee the program before he disappeared and an individual known as Drooz, claiming to be a Jedi prophet and healer took up residence in the temple. Jedi Master Cyslin Myr and Padawan Mace Windu later traveled to Mathas to assess the situation.

Mechis.title: Mechis III
Mechis.lead: Mechis III, also known as Mechis, was a small planetoid vital to the Techno Union. It was defended by a mix of starships from member corporations and design firms such as SoroSuub Corporation.

Megiddo.title: Megiddo

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories; Inner Zuma Region
facts.sector: Zuma sector; Moddell sector; Outer Moddell systems

Megiddo.lead: Megiddo was the third planet of the Endor system. It was a barren rock with no moons.

Mephitis.title: Mephitis
Mephitis.lead: Mephitis was the Mephitisian homeworld. The indigenous people had no sense of smell. Offworlders found the entire planet's atmosphere to have a foul stench.

Melinz.title: Melinz
Melinz.lead: Melinz was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Melinz system of the Core Worlds. It featured foothills situated within the limits of the city Shad.

Mengjini.title: Mengjini
Mengjini.lead: Mengjini was a planet in the Bright Jewel sector of the Mid Rim.

Mepha'as Prime.title: Mepha'as Prime
Mepha'as Prime.lead: Mepha'as Prime was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Mepha'as Prime system, a part of the Belsmuth sector of the Outer Rim Territories. A week before the destruction of the Core Worlds planet Alderaan by the Galactic Empire's Death Star battle station, the Human mercenary and smuggler Jin-Jin won nearly half a million credits while gambling in the Arenas of Mepha'as Prime, which he then invested into real estate on Alderaan.

Menias.title: Menias
Menias.lead: Menias was the first planet in the Metellos system, a star system in the Corusca sector of the Core Worlds. It was a searing rock with no moons.

Mekith.title: Mekith
Mekith.lead: Mekith was a tiny terrestrial planet in the Prakith system, located in Sector 5 of the Deep Core. It occupied the second orbital position around the star Prak and had a moon. Mekith featured a rocky surface and a toxic environment.

Melasaton.title: Melasaton
Melasaton.lead: Melasaton was a low-tech planet devastated by a great plague. It was saved from the plague when Arbor Industries developed an antidote, even though it was Arbor Industries that secretly unleashed the plague in the first place.

Meldazar.title: Meldazar
Meldazar.lead: Meldazar was a planet that was visited by Siri Tachi and her Padawan, Ferus Olin, sometime before the outbreak of the Clone Wars.

Media.title: Media/Legends
Media.lead: Media are the channels and tools used for storing and transmitting information.

Melnea's World.title: Melnea's World/Legends
Melnea's World.lead: Melnea's World was a gloomy and swampy world located in the Melnea's World system, a part of the Arkanis sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was situated on the hyperlane known as the Cranan-Excarga Route, which linked it to the Cranan system as well as the Excarga system of the Herios sector.

Mentanar Vosk.title: Mentanar Vosk
Mentanar Vosk.lead: Mentanar Vosk was a planet in the Nijune sector.

Mek va Uil.title: Mek va Uil
Mek va Uil.lead: Mek va Uil was a planet in the Expansion Region. The Regent of Mek va Uil was from this world.

Meldina.title: Meldina
Meldina.lead: Meldina was a volcanic rock planet with no moons that occupied the second closest orbital position to the star Abo. It was located within the Lehon system, a part of the Unknown Regions' area known as the Tempered Wastes.

Meglumine.title: Meglumine
Meglumine.lead: Meglumine, originally known as Ord Meglumine, was a planet in the Meglumine system of the Inner Rim. An Ordnance/Regional Depot, Ord Meglumine was used by the Pius Dea-controlled Galactic Republic as a staging point for their assault on Iridonia during the Great Northern Crusade in 11,884 BBY.

Ord Meglumine.title: Meglumine
Ord Meglumine.lead: Meglumine, originally known as Ord Meglumine, was a planet in the Meglumine system of the Inner Rim. An Ordnance/Regional Depot, Ord Meglumine was used by the Pius Dea-controlled Galactic Republic as a staging point for their assault on Iridonia during the Great Northern Crusade in 11,884 BBY.

Melldia.title: Melldia
Melldia.lead: Melldia was a planet located in the Melldia system of the Outer Rim Territories's Esstran sector. In 3950 BBY, the Sith Lord Darth Nyriss claimed to be "the destroyer of Melldia."

Mendavi.title: Mendavi
Mendavi.lead: Mendavi was a terrestrial astronomical object where the 291st Legion established a vanguard for urban combat, utilizing AT-DPs. It was located in the Mendavi system in the Ferra sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Meedis Minor.title: Meedis Minor
Meedis Minor.lead: Meedis Minor was an astronomical object located in the Meedis Minor system, a part of the Tandon sector in the Slice portion of the Mid Rim. At one point, a pair of dour ladies were traveling aboard the starliner Pendrake's Horizons that was captured by Thalassian slavers off Phibia in the Haserian sector. The ladies from Meedis Minor were eventually rescued by the Corellian Security Force agent Bey.

Mennar-Daye.title: Mennar-Daye

facts.affiliation: Alliance to Restore the Republic, New Republic

Mennar-Daye.lead: Mennar-Daye was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Mennar-Daye system in the Thesme sector of the Outer Rim Territories. During the Galactic Civil War, the Rebel Alliance had a base in its the cave systems, and the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing fought the rebels at some point prior to the Battle of Endor, which occurred in 4 ABY. Imperial bombers had made runs over the cave systems for days. It later came to have a New Republic presence. The starship Yissira Zyde traveled to the commerce center on Mennar-Daye, where it was screened by Republic authorities.

Megalox Beta.title: Megalox Beta

facts.affiliation: Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Megalox Beta.lead: Megalox Beta was a planet in the Expansion Region that housed a prison known as Megalox, which Poe Dameron and Black Squadron visited during their search for Lor San Tekka. The planet had a high gravity and was considered inhospitable, except for a small gravity field-covered zone that housed the Megalox prison. The planet was the site of a brief skirmish between the Resistance and the First Order.

Metellos.title: Metellos/Legends
Metellos.lead: Metellos was the fourth of seven planets in the Metellos system of the Corusca sector in the Core Worlds region. The planet orbited one star, also called Metellos, and in turn was orbited by three moons.

Metalorn.title: Metalorn/Legends

facts.terrain: Barren rocky wastes, Magma pits, Underground industrial factories, Formerly: Rain forests
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Techno Union, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Separatist holdouts, Galactic Empire, Greater Maldrood, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire …

Metalorn.lead: Metalorn was an industrial world in the Talcene sector of the Mid Rim, between Anzat and Roche. Once a hot jungle planet, its rich veins of ore attracted heavy industry, and by the time of the Clone Wars Metalorn had become a polluted factory world covered with industrial plants, mines and ore refineries. Metalorn was one of the Confederacy of Independent System's most productive industrial planets during the Clone Wars, and under the Galactic Empire became a penal colony for dissidents.

Merakai.title: Merakai
Merakai.lead: Merakai was a colony of the Khil species.

Merisee.title: Merisee/Legends

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Metharian Nebula Territories

Merisee.lead: Merisee, was an agriworld in the Elrood sector, located along the Elrood-Derilyn Trade Route. It was known as the "Breadbasket of Elrood Sector."

Meridian.title: Meridian
Meridian.lead: Meridian, also known as Meridias, was a planet in the Meridian sector in the Outer Rim Territories.

Merkat.title: Merkat
Merkat.lead: Merkat was a trade world located in the Merren system, in the Chaykin sector of the Expansion Region. It was an endpoint of the Harrin Trade Corridor.

Merson.title: Merson

facts.affiliation: Merson pirates, Confederacy of Independent Systems

Merson.lead: Merson was a planet that was located within the Inner Rim, near the Merson asteroid belt.

Merson asteroid belt.title: Merson asteroid belt
Merson asteroid belt.lead: The Merson asteroid belt was an asteroid belt, with a lot of minerals and metal veins, it was close to the planet Merson. It was located at the junction of several hyperroutes.

Meris VI.title: Meris VI

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Metharian Nebula Territories

Meris VI.lead: Meris VI was the outermost planet in the Meris system in Elrood sector. It was a frigid planet swept by constant ice storms. Meris VI had a breathable type II atmosphere in warmer seasons; in winter, the air was too cold to be safe without a heating mask filter.

Meris II.title: Meris II

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Metharian Nebula Territories

Meris II.lead: Meris II was the second planet in the Meris system of the Elrood sector.

Meris III.title: Meris III

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Metharian Nebula Territories

Meris III.lead: Meris III was the third planet in the Meris system.

Mexeluine.title: Mexeluine/Legends
Mexeluine.lead: Mexeluine was a thriving trade world lying along the Corellian Trade Spine in the Anoat sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Originally settled during the Galactic Republic's efforts to harvest the economic potential of the Greater Javin region centuries before the Galactic Civil War, Mexeluine grew wealthy as a result of Figg & Associates' commercial development of the region. Mexeluine successfully positioned itself as a cheaper alternative to neighboring Gerrenthum, the region's commercial capital.

Merikon.title: Merikon
Merikon.lead: Merikon was a planet located in the Fath sector of the Outer Rim Territories in the galaxy. During the Imperial Era, the Galactic Empire operated a training facility on the planet. Ivhin Jayme, a member of the Imperial Military, received intensive training by the Merikon instructors while at the facility.

Meruud.title: Meruud
Meruud.lead: Meruud was a planet in the Meruud system. It was home to the Meruud Memorial Spaceport.

Mes Cavoli.title: Mes Cavoli
Mes Cavoli.lead: Training Sergeant Kal Skirata once spent some time there with the Mandalorians fifty years before the first battle of Geonosis.

Messert.title: Messert/Legends
Messert.lead: Messert was a celestial body located in the Messert system, a part of the Kashyyyk Region's Mytaranor sector in the Slice portion of the Mid Rim. The hyperlane known as the Randon Run linked it to the Chamble and Randon systems. Messert was a financial hub of the sector, and loans from it financed several mining, industrial, and agricultural ventures in the Kashyyyk Region. The astronomical object shared its name with the offworld company Messert Mines Corporation.

Mezeg.title: Mezeg
Mezeg.lead: Mezeg was a planet located in the Mezeg sector. Aligned with the Galactic Republic, it had strict enforcement at its freighter terminals, sometimes guarding them with akk dogs.

Mestare.title: Mestare
Mestare.lead: Mestare was a planet where unique lightsaber crystals were mined. It was said that lightsabers which utilized these crystals could cut through cortosis, a lightsaber-resistant metal. The unique crystals were also known to make the lightsaber blades curved, similar to ancient Jedi katanas. Mestare Jedi also wore protective armor for an unknown reason.

Mhatma 5.title: Mhatma 5
Mhatma 5.lead: Mhatma 5 was a cold terrestrial world that occupied the fifth orbital position in the Mhatma system, a part of the freestanding subsectors portion of the Mid Rim. During the Galactic Civil War, Mhatma 5 was situated on the galactic frontier.

Merj.title: Merj
Merj.lead: Merj was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories that was the homeworld of the methane-breathing Morseerian species. During the Clone Wars, it was a member world of the Confederacy of Independent Systems. Around this time, it clandestinely received equipment and supplies from smugglers, including Has Obitt.

Mimban.title: Mimban/Legends

facts.affiliation: Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Mimban.lead: Mimban, formally known as Circarpous V, was the home planet of the Coway, the Mimbanites, and the extinct Thrella. Although originally named Circarpous V, the planet was never colonized by the Circarpousians. The planet, locally known as Mimban, was in the Circarpous system.

Mijos.title: Mijos/Legends
Mijos.lead: Mijos was a swampy world in the Anoat sector of the Outer Rim Territories and a stopover point for travel between the planets Lutrillia and Gerrenthum on the Lutrillian Cross hyperlane. A number of Lutrillian-run spaceports could be found on Mijos, but poor structural planning had caused many of these settlements to sink into the planet's muck.

Milarian.title: Milarian
Milarian.lead: Milarian was the sector capital of the Trans-Nebular sector.

Milagro.title: Milagro/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Milagro.lead: The planet Milagro lay at the confluence of two important hyperroutes, the Corellian Run and the Harrin Trade Corridor.

Midani.title: Midani/Legends
Midani.lead: Midani was an Outer Rim planet near Andasala. It was a favored destination of hunters.

Mindabaal.title: Mindabaal
Mindabaal.lead: Mindabaal was a planet located in the Inner Rim of the galaxy.

Militar.title: Militar
Militar.lead: Militar was the seventh planet in the Metellos system, a star system in the Corusca sector of the Core Worlds. It was a gas giant with five moons.

Mikak.title: Mikak
Mikak.lead: Mikak was the first planet orbiting the star Tyrius in the Tyrius system.

Miglar 2.title: Miglar 2
Miglar 2.lead: Miglar 2 was a planet where Ma'w'shiye lost his facial horns in a speeder bike accident.

Miko.title: Miko

facts.sector: Tapani sector, Freeworlds Territory, Three Ellas

Miko.lead: Miko was a planet located in the Sorella system.

Millinar.title: Millinar
Millinar.lead: Millinar was an elusive planet believed to be only a myth by the galaxy at large. The myth of Millinar was often compared to those of the Lost City of the Jedi and the Valley of the Jedi. The "mythic" planet was actually located in the Interior Region of the Hapes Cluster, a region which itself had become almost legendary by the era of the Galactic Civil War.

Milvayne.title: Milvayne/Legends
Milvayne.lead: Milvayne was a planet in the Gyrica system of the Inner Rim.

Minashee.title: Minashee/Legends
Minashee.lead: Minashee was an industrial planet in the Outer Rim's Tadrin subsector. It served as the sector capital.

Minavar.title: Minavar system/Legends
Minavar.lead: The Minavar system was a star system located within the Bheriz sector, a part of the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. At some point, an expedition that included the Human infant Reina Gale and her family established a colony within the system. By 0 ABY, however, the colony was ravaged by a virus that killed nearly its entire population, including Gale's parents, and the girl was left in the care of her uncle.

Mika.title: Mika (disambiguation)
Mika.lead: Mika may refer to:, __NOTOC__, ==Canon==, ===Characters===, Mika Grey, a Human archaeologist, Mika, a Nagai connected to Garlev, Mikal

Mindemir.title: Mindemir
Mindemir.lead: Mindemir was the primary planet of the Mindemir system. Jenna Zan Arbor wanted to use the planet's water supplies in her experiments, but was blocked from doing so by the Galactic Senate.

Miele Nova.title: Miele Nova
Miele Nova.lead: Miele Nova was a planet. The PanGalactic Arts Conservatory was located there.

Mil Velay.title: Mil Velay
Mil Velay.lead: Mil Velay was a planet that prohibited individuals with criminal records from entering their space.

Mikaster III.title: Mikaster III
Mikaster III.lead: Mikaster III was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Mikaster system, a part of the Mikaster sector in the Trailing Sectors portion of the Expansion Region. During the Clone Wars, the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems fought a battle on Mikaster III. During the engagement, Confederate octuptarra combat tri-droids picked their way through rubble, deploying a nanovirus-based bioweapon that shrouded them in veils of acidic vapor and targeted the Republic's clone troopers, to whom the weapon was lethal.

Mila.title: Mila
Mila.lead: Mila was a human fortune-teller who lived at Takodana Castle on the planet Takodana by the time of the First Order-Resistance War. Mila used the ancient, historically forbidden Bakurat card deck to tell fortunes.

Mirial.title: Mirial/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Darth Revan's Sith Empire, Trade Federation, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Zsinj's Empire

Mirial.lead: Mirial was a cold, dry planet located near the Hydian Way. It was the homeworld of the Mirialans, including Luminara Unduli.

Mira.title: Mira

facts.affiliation: Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders, Jedi Order, Lost Jedi, Galactic Republic

Mira.lead: Mira was a human female Mandalorian Neo-Crusader and bounty hunter-turned Jedi Sentinel and one of the Lost Jedi from the moon Nar Shaddaa, serving as one of the followers of Meetra Surik, the Jedi Exile, during her search for lost Jedi Masters in 3951 BBY.

Mindor.title: Mindor/Legends
Mindor.lead: Mindor, also known as Taspan I, was a planet in the Inner Rim with vast landmasses covered in grasslands. It had little to offer the galactic community other than its landmasses, which would have been ideal for farming. Mindor had four medium sized moons in very close proximity to the planet.

Minntooine.title: Minntooine/Legends
Minntooine.lead: Minntooine was an Outer Rim Territories waterworld located in the Calamari sector. It was one of several worlds settled by the Quarren species of the planet Dac. During the Clone Wars, Minntooine hosted a population of Quarren who had been exiled from Dac and allied itself with the Confederacy of Independent Systems. At shipyards maintained on Minntooine, the Free Dac Volunteers Engineering Corps subsequently constructed warships for the Confederacy.

Mirshilan.title: Mirshilan
Mirshilan.lead: Mirshilan was a planet within the Mirshilan system in the Outer Rim, near to Nishr.

Mirani.title: Mirani
Mirani.lead: Mirani was the fourth planet in the Aramand system, located within the Expansion Region of the galaxy. It was a gas giant that was orbited by nineteen moons. The Aramandi species colonized some of them.

Miser.title: Miser/Legends

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories; Greater Javin, Western Reaches

Miser.lead: Miser was a planet in the Bespin system. Most of the metal that was used in the production of Cloud City came from the hot planet, which had a core of mostly iron and gententhium. Lord Ecclessis Figg, the creator of Cloud City, sketched out a plan for a rolling mining center that could stay permanently out of direct sunlight on Miser's dark side, but the idea was never followed up. Miser's terrain was too rough for something on wheels to move easily.

Miyuu.title: Miyuu
Miyuu.lead: Miyuu was a rocky planet, and the seventh in the Kamino system. It was orbited by five moons.

Minntaa.title: Minntaa

facts.affiliation: Galactic Empire, Alliance to Restore the Republic

Minntaa.lead: Minntaa was a Human-inhabited planet liberated by the Rebel Alliance when Imperial Colonel Jeph Shannessi was assassinated by the Alliance Special Forces.

Missarassa.title: Missarassa
Missarassa.lead: Missarassa was the fifth planet orbiting the binary stars Adega Prime and Adega Besh in the Adega system. Located in the Auril sector of the Outer Rim, it was an ice ball.

Mirshaf.title: Mirshaf
Mirshaf.lead: Mirshaf was a planet with an ancient culture that was venerated in the galaxy. Captain Dorja, who served under Grand Admiral Thrawn, used the culture's victory gestures in battle.

Minkring.title: Minkring
Minkring.lead: Minkring was a planet in the Shelsha sector. By 0.5 ABY it was home to one of the only two remaining Imperial army garrisons in the sector (the other being located on Chaastern 4).

Misnor.title: Misnor
Misnor.lead: Misnor was a frigid moon with frozen oceans and glacial regions. Chiilaks were native to Misnor, and were hunted for their fur.

Mining Worlds.title: Mining Worlds/Legends

facts.system: Burnin Konn system, Allyuen system, Tokmia system, Isis system

Mining Worlds.lead: The Mining Worlds referred to four planets of the remote Greater Javin region of the Outer Rim Territories regarded for their abundance of resources. These worlds included Burnin Konn, Allyuen, Tokmia, and Isis. The nearby planet Ione was the sole hyperspace link to the Mining Worlds.

Mistar-5.title: Mistar-5
Mistar-5.lead: Mistar-5 was a terrestrial astronomical object. The attorney known as The Wavering Oeklass once appropriated a boat on Mistar-5. The ownership of the vessel, as outlined by Contract of the Common Ownership Agreement, was shared between the partners of the law firm Nani, Medypsh, Effervesence, & Oeklass. In response, the attorney's partners sent a letter to The Wavering Oeklass at Abar-12 requesting the return of the boat.

Mirak Major.title: Mirak Major
Mirak Major.lead: Mirak Major was a planet located in the Mirak Major system in the Trailing Sectors portion of the Inner Rim. Between 22 BBY and 19 BBY, during the Clone Wars, the planet's mega-volcanoes were triggered abruptly by the Confederacy of Independent Systems, leading General Gentis of the opposing Galactic Republic to successfully evacuate six billion individuals from its surface.

Miraluka homeworld.title: Miraluka homeworld
Miraluka homeworld.lead: This planet was the original homeworld of the Near-Human Force-sensitive Miraluka species. At some point in time, however, the planet was rendered uninhabitable because it was unstable and began losing its atmosphere to space. As a result of the cataclysm, the Miraluka were forced to leave their homeworld and ultimately settled on the planet Alpheridies.

Mittoblade.title: Mittoblade/Legends
Mittoblade.lead: Mittoblade was an Inner Rim celestial body. During the Waymancy Storm, Chief Sergeant Saens Sukko was among a Galactic Republic group that scaled a magnetic cliff on Mittoblade. There, Sukko helped trigger the destruction of the Clowse Glowstack, associated with the Republic's enemy, the Signatories of Waymancy. The naval officer Ruthbert Ozzel eventually came to be known as the "Savior of Mittoblade."

Mirrin Prime.title: Mirrin Prime

facts.affiliation: Alliance to Restore the Republic, New Republic

Mirrin Prime.lead: Mirrin Prime was a planet in the Mirrin sector. Following the Battle of Yavin, Mirrin Prime, along with D'Qar, was scouted by Caluan Ematt and the Rebel Alliance's Shrikes and was eventually built up.

Minoth.title: Minoth/Legends
Minoth.lead: Minoth was a world located in the Masla sector of the Mid Rim. Prior to the Battle of Hoth, Han Solo planned to run weapons from Minoth to Hendrix for the Rebel Alliance.

Mon Calamari.title: Mon Calamari/Legends

facts.language: Mon Calamarian, Galactic Basic Standard, Quarrenese

Mon Calamari.lead: The Mon Calamari (also known as Calamari, Calamarians, Mon Cal, Mon Calamarians, or rarely Mon Cala) were one of the sentient species indigenous to the world of Dac.

Mon Gazza.title: Mon Gazza/Legends

facts.routes: Corellian Run, Llanic Spice Run, Old Corellian Run
facts.affiliation: Infinite Empire, Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems

Mon Gazza.lead: Mon Gazza was a planet located in the Mon Gazza system in the Mid Rim. It was a famous shadowport and featured podracing.

Moltok.title: Moltok/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Yuuzhan Vong Empire

Moltok.lead: Moltok was a planet located in the Atrivis sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Orbiting close to its sun, the planet was quite warm, kept habitable only by the shielding action of active volcanoes. Beneath the ash they spewed forth, moist rain-forests covered the planet, home to a countless array of plant species. The planet was home to two sentient species, the Ho'Din and the Makurth. The former were known throughout the galaxy for their botanical skills, while the latter often found employment as bodyguards in the criminal underworld.

Miztoc.title: Miztoc
Miztoc.lead: Miztoc was an astronomical object located in the Miztoc system, a part of the Irnaj sector in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim. It was situated on the D'Aelgoth Trade Route hyperlane, which linked it to the Keltos system as well as the Feenix system of the D'Aelgoth sector and the Wornal sector's Kriselist system.

Monastery.title: Monastery/Legends
Monastery.lead: Monastery was a planet in the Mid Rim that was home to the religious order known as the Order of the Sacred Circle, who originally settled the world and ruled it for thousands of years. Distinguished by its massive ring, Monastery had a number of dangerous native predators, and its topography itself could be deadly—for instance, the planet's Crystal Valley could mean certain death to most visitors, as jagged crystals burst from the ground without warning.

Molavar.title: Molavar/Legends

facts.routes: Manda Merchant Route, Triellus Trade Route

Molavar.lead: Molavar was a backwater, desert world in the Outer Rim Territories, with a number of seedy spaceports and low-income moisture farms. It was inhabited by beings of various species, but especially by the native Molavaran race. Darca Nyl chased Lycan to the planet. During the Clone Wars, the planet lay within Separatist space.

Mon Torri.title: Mon Torri
Mon Torri.lead: Mon Torri was a snowy, mountainous and glacier-covered world that was located within the Mid Rim of the galaxy. Situated between Ord Mantell and Tatooine, it was surrounded by seven rings, each of them a different color and composition.

Mobus.title: Mobus/Legends
Mobus.lead: Mobus, sometimes referred to as Sanctuary, and also known as Klasse A in the Chiss surveys, was a gas giant in the Klasse Ephemora system of the Unknown Regions. It orbited the star Klasse Ephemora.

Mol Luxu.title: Mol Luxu
Mol Luxu.lead: Mol Luxu was the first planet orbiting the star Daca in the Calamari system. Located in the Calamari sector of the Outer Rim Territories, it was a rocky planetoid.

Mon Eron.title: Mon Eron
Mon Eron.lead: Mon Eron was the fifth planet in the Calamari system. It was settled by members of the Mon Calamari species around 4400 BBY. The colonists eventually terraformed the planet's oceans. It was orbited by two moons. and contained forests.

Mon Bala.title: Mon Bala

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, The Slice, Trailing Sectors
facts.routes: Corellian Run, Corellian Skip Run, Death Wind Corridor, Old Corellian Run, Ryloth Road

Mon Bala.lead: Mon Bala was the innermost planet orbiting the star Ryloth in the Ryloth system. Located in the Outer Rim Territories, it was a molten rock.

Mokk IX.title: Mokk IX
Mokk IX.lead: Mokk IX was a planet in the Inner Rim Territories. It was an Imperial labor camp covered in work settlements and wastelands. After stowing away in an Imperial shuttle, Sish Sadeet was left there to die, but rescued by Mirith Sinn when the New Republic liberated the world sometime before 11 ABY.

Mizra.title: Mizra (disambiguation)
Mizra.lead: Mizra may refer to one of the following:

Monhudle.title: Monhudle

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems

Monhudle.lead: Monhudle was a mining planet in the Cassandran sectors region. During the Outer Rim Sieges of the Clone Wars, Jedi General Traavis led clone forces to war against the Separatists on this planet.

Moll.title: Moll
Moll.lead: A moll was a companion of a gangster or a smuggler. Molls found the casinos of the planet Ord Mantell to be entertaining.

Mogoshyn.title: Mogoshyn
Mogoshyn.lead: Mogoshyn was a run-down industrial world located in the Mogoshyn system, a part of the Gordian Reach sector in the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The world lay between the Betshish and Kushibah systems on the Pinooran Spur hyperlane.

Moer.title: Moer
Moer.lead: Moer was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Dalon system, a part of the Hewett sector in the New Territories portion of the Mid Rim. It was the birthplace of the Human female Liadden, who by the age of eighteen had become a free-trader and the partner of the Twi'lek trader To'iir.

Monsolar.title: Monsolar/Legends
Monsolar.lead: Monsolar was a backwater planet in the Alzoc system, with the the Sujimis sector of the Outer Rim Territories. The planet was home to the Syrox species of parasitic worm, which laid its eggs in the planet's rivers, where they were consumed by other animals and grew within their new hosts. The sentient natives of the planet lived in several warring tribal communities, most of which either worshiped or feared the Syrox. Waleed Nagma was a native of this planet, but after becoming infested by a Syrox he ended up in the Cog Hive Seven prison.

Mon Cala.title: Mon Cala

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems (briefly), Galactic Empire, Alliance to Restore the Republic, New Republic

Mon Cala.lead: Mon Cala, also known as Mon Calamari or Dac, was an oceanic planet located in the Mon Calamari system, a binary star system positioned in the Calamari sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories and The Slice.

Moonus Mandel.title: Moonus Mandel/Legends
Moonus Mandel.lead: Moonus Mandel was a planet in the Mid Rim's Bothan sector, and the homeworld of the Veknoid species.

Morellia.title: Morellia/Legends
Morellia.lead: Morellia was an astronomical object located within the Morellia system, a part of the Wild Space star cluster known as the Morellian Commonwealth. It was the homeworld of the Morellian lawman and scout Barosa Warren.

Moorja.title: Moorja/Legends

facts.affiliation: Corporate Alliance, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Salliche Agricultural Corporation, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Moorja.lead: Moorja was a small Inner Rim world on the Corellian Trade Spine. It was owned by the Salliche Agricultural Corporation, which ran an agricultural and mining colony there. Though the planet was frequently swept by fierce ion storms capable of interfering with electronic equipment, it was a major exporter of foodstuffs.

Mordagon.title: Mordagon
Mordagon.lead: Mordagon was a celestial body located in the Mordagon system, a part of the Authala sector in the Slice portion of the Expansion Region. It was the homeworld of the Mordageen smuggler Bendix Fust.

Montitia.title: Montitia
Montitia.lead: Montitia was a poverty-stricken planet in the Montitia system of the Montitian Grant sector, located within the Expansion Region of the galaxy. The region of space around Montitia was explored between 1000 and 25 BBY, and during the Extorin Minor skirmishes, the world's populace was threatened by the Extorin aggressors and evacuated. Montitia was within unaligned space during the Clone Wars, and by the Imperial Era the planet was inhabited again and was controlled by the Galactic Empire.

Morado.title: Morado
Morado.lead: Morado was a planet located in the Hune sector of the Mid Rim.

Moraices.title: Moraices

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, New Territories, Trans-Hydian
facts.routes: Hydian Way, Junction-Tierell Loop, Thesme Trace

Moraices.lead: Moraices was a planet in the Feriae system of the Thesme sector of the Outer Rim.

Mores.title: Mores
Mores.lead: Mores was the sixth planet in the Metellos system, a star system in the Corusca sector of the Core Worlds. It was a gas giant with seventeen moons.

Moog Mot VI.title: Moog Mot VI
Moog Mot VI.lead: Moog Mot VI was an Outer Rim Territories banking world located in the Tharin sector. It hosted a Galactic Empire garrison, where Imperial technicians at one point mined the data core of the chief accounting droid of Sollima—a crime lord from whom the Empire wanted to wrest control over the gambling space station known as the Hollow Moon.

Moralan.title: Moralan
Moralan.lead: Moralan was a Hutt Space planet that was home to the Moralans, a slave species of the Hutt Empire. During the conflict between the Hutts and the Tionese conqueror Xim twenty-five millennia before the Battle of Yavin, the forces of the latter entered the Moralan system.

Moonan.title: Moonan
Moonan.lead: Moonan was the second planet orbiting the star of Nen in the Neimoidia system. Located in the Colonies, it was a toxic rock.

Aldin.title: Moons of Aldin
Aldin.lead: The Moons of Aldin were located in the Aldin system of the Aldino sector in the Mid Rim. Two Jedi Masters—the Human Mace Windu and the Nautolan Kit Fisto—once had an unpleasant, dangerous experience at the moons. The pair later recollected the experience at the Battle of Juma 9 during the Clone Wars while fighting against waves of Separatist sabotage droids.

Mooga.title: Mooga/Legends

facts.affiliation: Commerce Guild, Confederacy of Independent Systems

Mooga.lead: Mooga was a planet in the Mooga system of the Perkell sector. It was the homeworld of the Moogan species.

Morda.title: Morda
Morda.lead: Morda was a planet and the homeworld of the Morling species., Its land surfaces were covered by dense and dark forests. The light from the distant, orange star of the system couldn't always pierce the thick clouds.

Moorjhone.title: Moorjhone
Moorjhone.lead: Moorjhone was a planet located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories, within the Jospro sector and was the homeworld of felinoid Moorjhoni. It was in a trinary star system. It was normally lit and heated by two of the three suns at a given time. Once every ten years, however, all three suns would rise on the same side of the planet, resulting in the Day of Three Suns.

Moraband.title: Moraband
Moraband.lead: Moraband, known in antiquity as Korriban, was an Outer Rim planet that was home to the ancient Sith Order. The desolate and mountainous world was abandoned after many ancient wars. The Valley of the Dark Lords on the planet's surface was the final resting place of Darth Bane, the Sith Lord who created the Rule of Two. During the Clone Wars, Yoda ventured to the abandoned world as part of his journey to discover the secrets of eternal consciousness.

Mordal.title: Mordal
Mordal.lead: Mordal was a terrestrial world situated in the Illisurevimurasi sector's Mordal system of the Outer Rim Territories and the New Territories. During the Galactic Civil War in 4 ABY, the Galactic Empire and the Rebel Alliance fought a battle on Mordal. The civilian Corwin Ballast became trapped between the warring sides with his wife, Lynnta, and their daughter. The latter two perished from indiscriminate blaster fire.

Montross.title: Montross
Montross.lead: Montross was a planet in the binary star Montross system in the Truum sector of the Mid Rim Territories. By 2 BBY, Montross had fallen under the control of the Galactic Empire, which established Skystrike Academy, an elite flight academy for future TIE fighter pilots, in its atmosphere. The Vaathkree Trade Corridor connected Montross to the celestial bodies Contruum and Gizer.

Moraga.title: Moraga
Moraga.lead: Moraga was a jungle planet located in the Oricho sector of the Outer Rim Territories that was the homeworld of the Moragan species.

Ai'ken Prime.title: Moons of Ai'ken Prime
Ai'ken Prime.lead: The moons of Ai'ken Prime were a group of at least two moons located within the Inner Rim Territories. Lord Hossferin of the Vandelae star system Hossferins traveled from the moons of Ai'ken Prime to visit the queen of Ktath'atn, but was killed by her lieutenant, Bombinax.

Mrlsst.title: Mrlsst/Legends

facts.population: 5.3 billion Mrlssi, 3 billion Humans, 2 billion students of other species
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, League of Tapani Freeworlds, Galactic Empire

Mrlsst.lead: Mrlsst was a planet located in the Tapani sector's Freeworlds Territory on the Shapani Bypass. It was the homeworld of the Mrlssi and a voting member of the League of Tapani Freeworlds.

Morishim.title: Morishim

facts.affiliation: Galactic Empire, Pentastar Alignment, Imperial Remnant, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Morishim.lead: Morishim was a planet in the Albarrio sector of the Outer Rim and the homeworld of the Morish species.

Mozos.title: Mozos
Mozos.lead: Mozos was a planet in the Empress Teta system with two moons.

Morvogodine.title: Morvogodine
Morvogodine.lead: Morvogodine was a planet crawling with life that was located in the Calaron sector of the Outer Rim Territories. The Galactic Empire occupied Morvogodine during the Galactic Civil War and hosted a notoriously vicious stormtrooper training facility on the planet. Shortly before the Battle of Yavin, the Empire arrested famous musician Maxa Jandovar on Morvogodine to suppress her politically outspoken artistic endeavors.

Mugaar.title: Mugaar/Legends

facts.affiliation: Mugaari Space, Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire

Mugaar.lead: Mugaar was the Mugaari homeworld, located on the Corellian Trade Spine.

Morseer.title: Morseer
Morseer.lead: Morseer was a world located in the Quelii sector of the Outer Rim Territories with a methane-rich atmosphere. Morseer was colonized by the methane-breathing Morseerians, a secretive species who had kept secret the actual location of their homeworld to the rest of the galaxy during thousands years. Hence, the Morseerians were named after their colony of Morseer by the Drackmarians after they conquered the world. After the conquest, the Morseerians became a client species of the Drackmarians, another methane-breathing species.

Mrisst.title: Mrisst/Legends

facts.population: 3.5 billion Mrissi, 6 billion other species (mostly students)
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Mrisst.lead: Mrisst was a mid-sized planet, located in the Fakir sector of the Colonies. It had a mild climate, and its four continents were dotted with small lakes and rivers. Jungle made up the majority of the terrain, consisting of spinetrees, spirepines, and a variety of other flora. It was the homeworld of the Mrissi.

Mowgle.title: Mowgle
Mowgle.lead: Mowgle was a low-tech agriworld in the Core Worlds, one day and three hours from Demophon with a Class 1 hyperdrive. It was responsible for much of the consumables produced for Demophon during the Galactic Civil War. Thadius Black arranged for political prisoners from Demophon to be smuggled here as cargo soon before the Demophon system was destroyed in a supernova.

Mos.title: Mos
Mos.lead: Mos was a planet, first in the Dostra system in Corporate Sector. It was a searing rock with no moons.

Morjakar.title: Morjakar
Morjakar.lead: Morjakar was a planetoid originally from a system on the opposite side of the galaxy, when its star swelled into a red giant, swallowing all of its planets except Morjakar. This seemed to disrupt the balance between the planet's gravity and centrifugal force, and Morjakar was sent spiraling off into deep space. It eventually entered the Cularin system (although it did not become a part of it), and was caught in the massive gravity well of the system's binary stars. It settled into an eccentric orbit at an odd angle from the rest of the system's planets, and was sometimes missed by scouts.

Motexx.title: Motexx

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire

Motexx.lead: Motexx was a planet located in the Colonies region on the other side of the Black Nebula from Arat Fraca.

Moro Three.title: Moro Three
Moro Three.lead: Moro Three was a planet in the Moro system where a maintenance engineer serviced the DR919a.

Mossak.title: Mossak
Mossak.lead: Mossak was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories' Thanium sector, located at the end of the Perlemian Trade Route and at the start of the Tingel Arm. It was located near Felucia and Galidraan. It was part of Xim's Empire.

Mourn.title: Mourn

facts.region: Mid Rim, Kashyyyk Region, The Slice

Mourn.lead: Mourn was a planet in the Boz Pity system. It shared a synchronous orbit with Boz Pity. Sultan Nastuonodon had created a droid army of Electric Caliphs, which were used after his death by the Hutts to wipe out the Gargantelles of Boz Pity.

Morvolo.title: Morvolo
Morvolo.lead: Morvolo was the fourth planet orbiting the star Prael in the Japrael system. Located in the Japrael sector of the Inner Rim, it was made almost entirely of ice.

Mortis.title: Mortis/Legends
Mortis.lead: Mortis was a planet enclosed in a monolith located in the remote Chrelythiumn system that was a conduit for the entire Force of the universe. Mortis became home to the Ones, a family of powerful Force users, years prior to the Clone Wars. Time was experienced differently inside the Mortis monolith than in the rest of the galaxy—standard days experienced on Mortis by Obi-Wan Kenobi, Anakin Skywalker, and Ahsoka Tano were only "a moment" experienced in normal space by Captain Rex.

Morton.title: Morton
Morton.lead: Morton was a male Human who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic, serving sergeant within the Office of Peace and Security, a law enforcement agency that operated on the planet Cularin. He was a contact of the Thaereian military captain Drom Virbilge and in circa 31 BBY, Virbilge contacted Morton, warning him that there was going to be some trouble at the house of Krol-Pek, a male Cerean who lived in the city Gadrin on Cularin.

Moseum.title: Moseum
Moseum.lead: Moseum was a planet located in the Moseum system within the Thesme sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Movris.title: Movris
Movris.lead: Movris was a planet located in the Noonian sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Morr Three.title: Morr Three
Morr Three.lead: The terrestrial celestial body Morr Three was located in the Amorris system, a part of the Quelii sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was site of a base operated by the Cavrilhu Pirates, who carried out raids in the Amorris system. The pirates used the base for the refurbishment of their starships.

Mustafar.title: Mustafar/Legends

facts.affiliation: Mustafarians, Jedi Order, Techno Union, Damask Holdings, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Geonosian Industries, Separatist holdouts, Gizor Dellso …

Mustafar.lead: Mustafar was a small, young planet in the Mustafar system of the Atravis sector in the Outer Rim Territories. Orbiting the star Priate, the planet was situated between the gas giants Jestefad and Lefrani, the gravity from the two worlds tearing Mustafar apart and causing its unstable geology, despite it having once been a lush world orbiting Jestefad. The world experienced rains of ash, and its surface was covered in volcanoes, obsidian mountains, and lava rivers.

Mygeeto.title: Mygeeto/Legends

facts.terrain: Crystallized glaciers, Jagged mountains, Ice canyons, Ice wadi, Crevasses, Tunnels, Cliffs, Underground lakes
facts.population: 19 million (historic):, 96% Muuns, 4% other, Unknown number of Mygeetans
facts.affiliation: Mygeetans, Infinite Empire, Smugglers, Hutts, Neimoidians, InterGalactic Banking Clan, Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire …

Mygeeto.lead: Mygeeto was a wealthy InterGalactic Banking Clan colony between Ord Biniir and Morishim under the control of the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Muunilinst.title: Muunilinst/Legends

facts.language: Galactic Basic Standard, Muun, Imperial Basic
facts.affiliation: Infinite Empire, Galactic Republic, InterGalactic Banking Clan, Muunilinst Banking Clan, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire …

Muunilinst.lead: Muunilinst (pronounced "MYOON-il-ist", with a silent "n" near the end in Galactic Basic), nicknamed Moneylend, was the temperate, mineral-rich planet that was the homeworld of the Muun species and headquarters of a subdivision of the InterGalactic Banking Clan. It was located on the Braxant Run. It was a member of the Confederacy of Independent Systems under Chairman San Hill.

Munto Codru.title: Munto Codru/Legends

facts.affiliation: Confederacy of Independent Systems, New Republic, Galactic Federation of Free Alliances, Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire

Munto Codru.lead: Munto Codru was a remote and backwater world in the Outer Rim Territories located within the Codru system on the Overic Griplink, between Pakuuni and the Calamari sector. Its sole sentient species were the Codru-Ji, who were born as canine wyrwulfs before metamorphosis upon reaching maturity.

Muscave.title: Muscave

facts.routes: Corellian Run, Coruscant–Dantooine hyperlane, Koros Trunk Line, Leisure Corridor, Martial Cross, Metellos Trade Route, Namadii Corridor, Perlemian Trade Route …

Muscave.lead: Muscave was one of two gas giants in the Coruscant system. During the Battle of Yuuzhan'tar, the Galactic Alliance's Second Fleet engaged elements of the Yuuzhan Vong armada above Muscave.

Muskree.title: Muskree
Muskree.lead: Muskree was a backwater planet in the Outer Rim Territories. Its lone settlement was the failed mining colony Hardscrabble.

Mycroft.title: Mycroft

facts.terrain: Frozen polar caps, Hot arid deserts, Forest-covered mountains

Mycroft.lead: Mycroft was a terrestrial planet in the Fakir sector. The world hosted a variety of climates and terrains, ranging from low mountains covered in forests, arid deserts, and frozen polar icecaps. Several dangerous species inhabited Mycroft, including a bear-like creature and a flying carnivore.

Mutanda.title: Mutanda
Mutanda.lead: Mutanda was a planet in the Killaniri system. The planet was a rolling land of grasslands, jungles, and natural wonders. In addition to the sentient Horansi, the world had many different species of big game animals, resulting in a booming legalized safari trade. Primarily, Mutanda was a planet for exotic hunting vacations and was easily accessible because of the spaceport on the satellite of Justa. However, the encroachments of poachers resulted in the extinction of many species of Mutandan wildlife.

Muzara.title: Muzara
Muzara.lead: Muzara was a planet in the Expansion Region. Humans from Brentaal colonized the planet in 4000 BBY, barely avoiding conflict with the native Muzaran people, who were also known as the Muza.

Munlali Mafir.title: Munlali Mafir

facts.terrain: Destroyed after the passing of Zonama Sekot

Munlali Mafir.lead: Munlali Mafir was a planet in the Unknown Regions.

Murninkam.title: Murninkam
Murninkam.lead: Murninkam was a tropical world far from the space lanes. The Kajiin Swamp can be found there.

Mulako Corporation Primordial Water Quar.title: Mulako Corporation Primordial Water Quarry
Mulako Corporation Primordial Water Quar.lead: The Mulako Corporation Primordial Water Quarry, also known as Mulako Corporation Quarry, Mulako Corporation comet, MC Quarry, and Mulako quarry, was a comet that orbited its star once every hundred years. For the greater part of this period, the Mulako Corporation mined ice on the comet's surface, extracting pure water from it and selling it to gourmets.

Murkhana.title: Murkhana/Legends

facts.affiliation: Xim's Empire, Trade Federation, Galactic Republic, Corporate Alliance, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire …

Murkhana.lead: Murkhana was a planet in the Auril sector on which the Battle of Murkhana was fought during the Outer Rim Sieges.

Muugrah.title: Muugrah
Muugrah.lead: Muugrah was a planet that was closer to the fringe of the galaxy than it was to the Galactic Core. Its capital was Slaibo, which was close to Squarn's Junkyard. It was a planet of open grasslands inhabited by prospectors and ranchers.

Mussubir Three.title: Mussubir Three
Mussubir Three.lead: Mussubir Three, or simply Mussubir, was a planet located in the Mussubir system of the Senex sector, in the Mid Rim of the galaxy. It was an important industrial world controlled by House Araba.

Mulatan.title: Mulatan
Mulatan.lead: Mulatan was a world located in the Mulatan system, a part of the Bootana Hutta area in the Hutt Space portion of the Slice. It was connected to the Gos Hutta and Sleheyron systems by the hyperlane known as the Pabol Hutta.

Mulchoop.title: Mulchoop
Mulchoop.lead: Mulchoop was the fifth planet orbiting the star Prael in the Japrael system. Located in the Japrael sector of the Inner Rim, it was a gas giant.

Mugg Fallow.title: Mugg Fallow
Mugg Fallow.lead: Mugg Fallow was the presumed homeworld of Mnggal-Mnggal, deep in the Unknown Regions. The grey sludge that formed the being's body (or brain) covered almost the entire planet, with only lifeless continents and the remains of fossilized trees visible. Mnggal-Mnggal filled the planet's former oceans, and ran across the continents in gray rivers.

Mullan.title: Mullan
Mullan.lead: Mullan was a terrestrial world located in the Mullan system. It was a part of the Keldrath sector in the Greater Tion historical region, which in turn was situated within the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The hyperlane known as the Pakuuni Drift connected Mullan to the Gbu system as well as the Brigia system in the neighboring Tion Hegemony sector.

Murk.title: Murk system
Murk.lead: The Murk system was located in the Moddell sector, a subsector of the Zuma sector of the Outer Rim Territories in grid square H-16 of the Standard Galactic Grid. It lay on the Sanctuary Pipeline, a hyperspace route that connected the Moddell sector moon of Endor to the Sullust sector's Sullust system. The Murk system was depicted on a map of the Moddell sector included with the Rebel Alliance collection of non-electronic documents known as The Rebel Files.

Myrkr.title: Myrkr

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Pirates, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Myrkr.lead: Myrkr was a forested world, located fairly close to the galaxy's major population centers in the outskirts of the Inner Rim Territories. It was close to the borders with the Expansion Region and relatively near to the planet of Wayland. It was believed to be the homeworld of the Neti species, although the Neti established a colony on Ryyk some time prior to 4000 BBY, apparently abandoning Myrkr.

Nabatu.title: Nabatu

facts.routes: Corellian Run, Coruscant–Dantooine hyperlane, Koros Trunk Line, Leisure Corridor, Martial Cross, Metellos Trade Route, Namadii Corridor, Perlemian Trade Route …

Nabatu.lead: Nabatu was a barren planet in the Coruscant system. It was the tenth planet from the star Coruscant Prime.

Myl Vlahu.title: Myl Vlahu

facts.affiliation: Jedi Order, Army of Light, Galactic Republic

Myl Vlahu.lead: Myl Vlahu was a Jedi who fought in the Ruusan campaign during the New Sith Wars. She was the sister of Zor Vlahu and died in an assault on the Sith in 1000 BBY. The planet of Myl Vlahu in the Ruusan system was named after her.

Mytus VII.title: Mytus VII/Legends
Mytus VII.lead: Mytus VII was the outermost planet of the Mytus system in Wild Space. Mytus VII was avoided, even by the Ocsin spacers, due to being the near the Corporate Sector Authority's Stars' End penal facility.

Mytaranor.title: Mytaranor
Mytaranor.lead: Mytaranor was a bleak industrial world located in the Mytaranor system, a part of the Kashyyyk Region's Mytaranor sector in the Slice portion of the Mid Rim. The hyperlane known as the Nightroad linked it to the Tholatin system as well as the Terr'skiar sector's Pizilis system.

Mylok IV.title: Mylok IV
Mylok IV.lead: Mylok IV, or simply Mylok, was the fourth world in the Mylok system, located within the Outer Rim of the galaxy

N'zoth asteroid field.title: N'zoth asteroid field
N'zoth asteroid field.lead: An asteroid field was an asteroid belt in the N'zoth system. Located in the Koornacht Cluster of the Core Worlds, it occupied the seventh orbital position around the star C'rel.

Myomar.title: Myomar/Legends
Myomar.lead: Myomar was a planet in the Deadalis sector of the Expansion Region, and the site of Imperial starship maintenance facilities. After the inception of the Galactic Empire, Grand Admiral Ishin-Il-Raz conducted a massacre on the planet. Years later, Han Solo and Chewbacca stole the Millennium Falcon's deflector shield generators from an Imperial facility on Myomar.

N'ildwab.title: N'ildwab
N'ildwab.lead: N'ildwab was a rocky planet in the Outer Rim with many canyons. The inhabitants of N'ildwab lived very simple lives. Because of this, in an effort to control the people, Nobam Nol terrorized the inhabitants and claimed to be a Sith. He was able to mimick Force powers because of his wired gloves. Because of his terrorism, the people of N'ildwab hired Boba Fett to kill Nol. Fett was successful.

N'Zoth.title: N'Zoth
N'Zoth.lead: N'Zoth was a planet located in the N'zoth system of the Koornacht Cluster in the galaxy's Core Worlds. On the periphery of the Deep Core, it was connected via hyperspace route to Jedha and Coruscant, and situated in square K-10 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

NCW-781.title: NCW-781
NCW-781.lead: NCW-781 was an unexplored Wild Space planet. A terrestrial world, its surface featured mountains, canyons, and woods. During the Galactic Civil War, the Rebel Alliance operative Kala Kevv was shot down over NCW-781, where he crash-landed while carrying a data plaque with information vital to the Alliance.

N'dian.title: N'dian
N'dian.lead: N'dian was a planet located in the N'dian system, a part of the Spadja sector within the Outer Rim Territories and Trans-Hydian regions.

Mzeh.title: Mzeh
Mzeh.lead: Mzeh was a gas giant located in the Fondor system in the Freeworlds Territory portion of the Tapani sector, within the Southern Core portion of the Colonies. The planet occupied the sixth orbital position around the star Fondor and had eleven moons. Along with the rest of its star system, Mzeh was located on the Gandeal-Fondor Hyperlane, with another hyperlane also connecting it to the Sefon system.

Nach.title: Nach
Nach.lead: Nach was the first planet orbiting the star Rek in the Guter Wade system. Located in the Trilon sector of the Outer Rim, it was a scorched rock.

Myron.title: Myron
Myron.lead: Myron was the first planet orbiting the star Tive in the Taanab system. Located in the Inner Rim Territories, it was a scorched ball.

Nadhe.title: Nadhe
Nadhe.lead: Nadhe was a remote planet that defied Emperor Palpatine shortly after the formation of the Galactic Empire. Like the other worlds that refused to cooperate, Nadhe suffered an unspecified devastation as a result.

Mytus asteroid belt.title: Mytus asteroid belt
Mytus asteroid belt.lead: The uncharted Mytus asteroid belt was a thick concentration of asteroids in the Mytus system. The belt was situated halfway between the system's primary star and Mytus VII, the outermost planet. Han Solo altered the course of one of the asteroids of the belt to act as cover for the Millennium Falcon during the liberation of Stars' End.

Mykapo.title: Mykapo
Mykapo.lead: Mykapo was a planet located in the Mykapo system of the Outer Rim Territories.

NaJedha.title: NaJedha
NaJedha.lead: NaJedha was an oceanic crystalline planet in the galaxy's Mid Rim, orbited by the moon Jedha. The Rebel Alliance were briefly stationed on NaJedha during a mission to contact the Partisans.

Mytus.title: Mytus system
Mytus.lead: The Mytus system was a star system located in Wild Space, within grid square S-3 on the Standard Galactic Grid. It was the site of Stars' End, a prison on a planet that was operated by the Corporate Sector Authority.

Nagi.title: Nagi/Legends

facts.terrain: High peaks, Deep and wide valleys, Wastes

Nagi.lead: Nagi was a planet located in a star cluster of the Firefist satellite galaxy that was gravitational bound to the host galaxy and was part of the Unknown Regions. Nagi was the homeworld of the Nagai species, who built great cities of crystal and wire among the planet's expansive wastelands. The Tofs conquered Nagi in a long and bloody campaign starting around 296 BBY, and many Nagai would later leave Nagi in an attempt to wage war on the Alliance of Free Planets in 4 ABY.

Nal Hutta.title: Nal Hutta/Legends

facts.routes: Oktos Route, Ootmian Pabol, Pabol Hutta, Shag Pabol
facts.terrain: Modern:, Barren, Vongformed, Historic:, Glimmering urban zones, Decaying urban zones, Oceans, Swamps, Bogs, Marshes, Ancient:, Mountainous, Rain-forests
facts.population: 7 billion:, 43% Hutt, 29% Human, 15% Vippit, 14% Various others
facts.affiliation: Hutt Empire, Galactic Republic, Hutt Cartel, Yuuzhan Vong empire, Confederation

Nal Hutta.lead: Nal Hutta (Glorious Jewel in Huttese), also known simply as Hutta, was the capital of Hutt Space and was located in the Y'Toub system. It was formerly known as Evocar and was the original home world of the Evocii, who were ousted by the Hutts in 15,000 BBY, who migrated from their original home world of Varl along with their servants the t'landa Til. The planet was controlled by the ancient ruling Hutt families, who also ruled its moon Nar Shaddaa from Nal Hutta and became the new capital of Hutt Space.

Nam Chorios.title: Nam Chorios/Legends

facts.affiliation: Tsils, Grissmath Dynasty, Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Nam Chorios.lead: Nam Chorios was a planet in the Chorios system. Though desolate, it was able to support Human life. It was even able to grow vegetation, such as brachniel and gomex moss. The planet was in a constant state of dusk due to its dim sun.

Nadiem.title: Nadiem/Legends
Nadiem.lead: Nadiem was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Baxel sector. It was home to a population of farmers, including both Humans and members of other species. During the Clone Wars, it had little to offer either the Galactic Republic or the Confederacy of Independent Systems, yet the latter nevertheless launched an attack on it due to the former choosing to defend it. The Republic carried out evacuations of the planet's settlements, during which the local Crys Taanzer gave up her son Kennan for training as a Jedi, which allowed him to be granted priority evacuation off Nadiem.

Najiba.title: Najiba/Legends
Najiba.lead: Najiba was the Najib homeworld. It was a remote world covered with wetlands and its surface was lashed with atmospheric electrical discharges and frequent rainstorms.

Nam'ta.title: Nam'ta
Nam'ta.lead: Nam'ta was a gas giant located in the Nam'ta system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Atrivis sector. Its clouds formed bands of red, orange, and white. The planet was inhabited during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire, and governed by a local government. At that time a local organization planned to leak thousands of Republic diplomatic dispatches, prompting a Republic-allied individual to urge the local government to clamp down on the organization.

Nahsu Minor.title: Nahsu Minor

facts.affiliation: Ktilac Regions Confederacy, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Galactic Federation of Free Alliances

Nahsu Minor.lead: Nahsu Minor was a temperate, grassy planet located in the Ktilac Regions, an Allied Region in the Inner Rim. It was the homeworld of the Murachaun species, who, along with the Ktilacs and Tocoyans, two other species native to the region, developed a quasi-religion in which each species was seen as complementary to the other two and constructed a network of cities, towns, and farms. At some time during the Galactic Civil War, the Galactic Empire took thousands of Murachaun off world to work as slaves due to their industrious nature.

Nam Priax.title: Nam Priax
Nam Priax.lead: Nam Priax was an oceanic planet located within the Nam Priax system of the Outer Rim Territories.

Nak Shimor.title: Nak Shimor
Nak Shimor.lead: Nak Shimor was a planet in the Colonies, on the Perlemian Trade Route near the border with the Inner Rim. Andur Sunrider purchased the Lightside Explorer on Nak Shimor from a Vultan dealer.

Naldar.title: Naldar
Naldar.lead: Naldar was an Outer Rim world in the Phelleem sector. During the Galactic Civil War, Naldar became the target of severe Imperial aggression, withstanding a 2 ABY offensive that killed most of the royal family, and a 4 ABY another Imperial attack subjugated the world. However, Princess Vila, the royal family's sole survivor, returned with an Alliance of Free Planets force that ended the Imperial threat on Naldar.

Nanta-Ri.title: Nanta-Ri
Nanta-Ri.lead: Nanta-Ri was a planet in the Farlax sector of the Core Worlds. The New Republic Fourth Battle Group was sent to blockade it during the Black Fleet Crisis.

Namra.title: Namra
Namra.lead: Namra was the second-largest gas giant of the system. A yellow and orange planet, Namra had ten moons, four of which were asteroids. The remaining moons were relatively the same size and composition, with thin atmospheres and a cratered coating of ice.

Najarka.title: Najarka
Najarka.lead: Najarka was a planet located in the Outer Rim's Rayter sector.

Nal Koska.title: Nal Koska

facts.routes: Oktos Route, Ootmian Pabol, Pabol Hutta, Shag Pabol

Nal Koska.lead: Nal Koska was a terrestrial planet with two moons that was located within the Y'Toub system of the galaxy's Hutt Space region. The planet occupied the second orbital position around its star, Y'Toub.
