Nal Yeshu.title: Nal Yeshu

facts.routes: Oktos Route, Ootmian Pabol, Pabol Hutta, Shag Pabol

Nal Yeshu.lead: Nal Yeshu was a terrestrial planet that occupied the fourth orbital position within the Y'Toub system of the galaxy's Hutt Space region. The planet lay on the junction of four hyperlanes called the Oktos Route, the Ootmian Pabol, the Pabol Hutta, and the Shag Pabol. During the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire in the year 3642 BBY, a secret listening post that was used by the Empire was destroyed by pirates hired by the Republic.

Nalyd.title: Nalyd

facts.terrain: Enormous rock pinnacles with shallow wetlands at the base

Nalyd.lead: Nalyd was an Outer Rim planet and the homeworld of the Nalydians, a species of sentient, stocky humanoids. Its inhabitants practiced the death penalty on citizens who had broken the law, and it was there that Ania Solo and Jao Assam went in search of Darth Wredd's minion, Dieben, in 138 ABY.

Nakadia.title: Nakadia

facts.affiliation: Confederacy of Independent Systems (occupied), Galactic Empire, New Republic

Nakadia.lead: Nakadia was an agricultural planet in the Expansion Region located just off of the Rimma Trade Route. The homeworld of the Nakadian species, it was occupied for some time by the Separatist Alliance. In 3 ABY, the Rebel Alliance 61st Mobile Infantry destroyed the Galactic Empire's plastoid factories on Nakadia, facing the Empire's local bioweapon stockpile.

Nag Ubdur.title: Nag Ubdur
Nag Ubdur.lead: Nag Ubdur was a planet located in the Ubdur system of the the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. It was inhabited by Ubdurians. Binjai-Tin was considered to be a large merchant city on the planet.

Najan-Rovi.title: Najan-Rovi
Najan-Rovi.lead: Najan-Rovi was an Outer Rim and Western Reaches gas giant located along the Rimma Trade Route. Dockyards there housed starships for high-ranking figures within the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. In 3 ABY, the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry attacked the dockyards, deploying strike teams. The 61st left Najan-Rovi with almost a hundred burning vessels. Former Imperial governor Everi Chalis believed the attack would draw security from the Kuat Drive Yards and force the Corellian Engineering Corporation to increase ship production.

Namadii.title: Namadii/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Namadii.lead: Namadii was an astronomical object located in the Namadii system, a part of the Churnis sector in the New Territories portion of the Mid Rim. It lay at the endpoint of the hyperlane known as the Namadii Corridor, which connected it to the Ansion system.

Nar Hekka.title: Nar Hekka
Nar Hekka.lead: Nar Hekka was a cold planet located barely beyond the edge of the Y'Toub system, where it also orbited a dim red star. It was situated on the Ootmian Pabol hyperlane between the worlds of Nal Hutta and Du Hutta. Nar Hekka also sat on the Sheela Run.

Nar Kreeta.title: Nar Kreeta

facts.affiliation: Hutt Empire, Hutt Cartel, Mining Guild, Yuuzhan Vong empire, Confederation

Nar Kreeta.lead: Nar Kreeta was a Hutt colony and major trade world, located at the nexus of the Pabol Kreeta and Pabol Sleheyron.

Nathas I.title: Nathas I
Nathas I.lead: Nathas I was a cold and airless rocky planet located in the Core Worlds' Questal sector. It was the homeworld of the silicon-based species of shape-shifters known as Proteans. Although seemingly primitive, they noted key historical events by carving stone pillars and placing them in prominent locations on their home planet. The Proteans were eventually discovered and briefly studied by scientists of the Galactic Empire.

Narg.title: Narg
Narg.lead: Narg was an isolated planet in the Rayter sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Its Human inhabitants were known to be xenophobic. During the Galactic Civil War, the planet was controlled by TransGalMeg Industries, Incorporated.

Narvath.title: Narvath
Narvath.lead: Narvath was the Narvath homeworld. Many members of its local underground joined the Rebel Alliance. It was later a member world of the New Republic.

Nar Bo Sholla.title: Nar Bo Sholla
Nar Bo Sholla.lead: Nar Bo Sholla was a Hutt Space world that was the homeworld of the poisonous spor crawler insect. It was a part of the Hutt Empire twenty-five millennia before the Battle of Yavin. In 25 BBY, the Human Morteos was born on Nar Bo Sholla. Three years later, it became one of the worlds that suffered damage from an infestation of the structure-damaging arthropods known as stone mites. The Nar Bo Sholla system was later conquered by the extra-galactic Yuuzhan Vong during their invasion of the galaxy.

Narigus III.title: Narigus III
Narigus III.lead: Narigus III was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Narigus system of the Outer Rim Territories' Belsmuth sector. At one point during the Galactic Civil War, the individuals Lauren and Sam stole the valuable art piece known as the Kubaz Insect from the collector Rock'co on Narigus III. They then attempted to smuggle the artifact offworld on their starship but were eventually forced to separate due to being pursued by a group of thugs, ultimately ending up in a large spaceport city. Afterward, Rock'co himself also traveled to the city in search of the thieves.

Nanth'ri.title: Nanth'ri/Legends

facts.affiliation: Infinite Empire, Galactic Republic, Darth Revan's Sith Empire, Hutt Cartel, Brotherhood of Darkness, Confederacy of Independent Systems, New Republic …

Nanth'ri.lead: Nanth'ri was a planet found along the Nanth'ri Route. Celis Mott hailed from this world.

Nantuker.title: Nantuker
Nantuker.lead: Nantuker was a planet in the Corsair Outback region of the Hapes Cluster. It was the source of premium Nantuker dates.

Nar Haaska.title: Nar Haaska/Legends
Nar Haaska.lead: Nar Haaska was a Hutt Space trade world. It was a part of the territory controlled by the Hutts by 25,000 BBY, and by 17 BBY, the world became a part of the Galactic Empire. During the Yuuzhan Vong War, the extra-galactic Yuuzhan Vong conquered the Nar Haaska system.

Nar Kaaga.title: Nar Kaaga/Legends
Nar Kaaga.lead: Nar Kaaga was a planet located in Hutt Space. It was a cold, swampy world that survived on trade. It was home to the H'uun and Shell Hutt clans.

Naos.title: Naos system
Naos.lead: The Naos system was a star system located in Wild Space and the Slice. It was situated in grid square S-18 on the Standard Galactic Grid, just off the southern endpoint of the Corellian Run super-hyperroute, and contained a terrestrial astronomical object Naos III.

Nar Chunna.title: Nar Chunna
Nar Chunna.lead: Nar Chunna was a trade world located in the Nar Chunna system, a part of the Bootana Hutta area in the Hutt Space portion of the Slice. It was connected by a hyperlane to the Kor Hestilic and Kor Utoradii systems. It was rumored that large amounts of priceless artifacts could be obtained on Nar Chunna.

Nath Goordi.title: Nath Goordi
Nath Goordi.lead: Nath Goordi was a planet located within the Nath Goordi system of the Mid Rim that was home to a procession of royal heirs.

Nars.title: Nars
Nars.lead: Nars was a terrestrial planet located in the Nars system of the Senex sector, a part of the Senex-Juvex region in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim. A hyperlane linked it to the Knores system.

Naporar.title: Naporar/Legends

facts.routes: Chasdemonus Route, Path of the Houses
facts.affiliation: Chiss Ascendancy, House Nuruodo, Chiss Expansionary Defense Fleet

Naporar.lead: Naporar was a planet located in the Naporar system of the Unknown Regions' Chiss Space. The hyperlane known as the Path of the Houses linked it to the Ornfra and Sposia systems, while the Chasdemonus Route connected it to the Colonial Station Cam'co system.

Nathema.title: Nathema

facts.terrain: Fertile agricultural fields (pre–4999 BBY), Barren plains (4999 BBY–3630 BBY), Forests (post 3630 BBY)
facts.affiliation: Sith Empire, Eternal Empire, Nathema Zealots

Nathema.lead: Nathema, originally known as Medriaas, was a fertile agriworld located in the Nathema system of the Outer Rim Territories' Chorlian sector. During the reign of the Sith Empire in 5103 BBY, the planet's ruler, Sith Lord Dramath, was deposed in by his own illegitimate son Tenebrae, who received the title of Lord Vitiate and rulership of Medriaas from the reigning Dark Lord of the Sith, Marka Ragnos. Renaming the planet Nathema, Vitiate kept his world isolated from the power plays of his fellow Sith over the next century, and his isolation spared Nathema from the Great Hyperspace War in 5000 BBY.

Nar Kanji.title: Nar Kanji
Nar Kanji.lead: Nar Kanji was an Outer Rim world that was the homeworld of the Jablogian species. Long before the Cold War, it became a Hutt colony world and its human colonists were enslaved and consequently subjected to years of exploitation and suppression. Following a gang war within the Hutt cartels that left the world in disarray, the humans overthrew their overlords and struck out on their own. Tasu Leech, the topboss of Kanjiklub, a gang of renegade slaves from Nar Kanji, grew up on this world.

Narq.title: Narq
Narq.lead: Narq, also known as Narqui, was a Colonies world located on the Quellor Run hyperspace route. Its surface featured fungus forests, in which the sentient Narquois species originated. At some point, the offworld Neimoidian species occupied Narq and subjected the Narquois to virtual serfdom, which centuries later led to the latter suing the former in the New Republic courts.

Naraka.title: Naraka
Naraka.lead: Naraka was a rocky and hazy planet located in the Outer Rim Territories. During the Imperial Era, it was controlled by the Galactic Empire, who maintained a prison there. In 2 BBY, the rebel team known as the Spectres traveled to Naraka to rescue the pirate Hondo Ohnaka from the prison.

Neimoidia.title: Neimoidia/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Trade Federation, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Galactic Alliance

Neimoidia.lead: Neimoidia, also called Pure Neimoidia to avoid confusion with the Neimoidian purse worlds, was a planet in the Colonies region that the Duros from Duro colonized sometime around 25,000 BBY, bringing it into the Galactic Republic.

Nelvaan.title: Nelvaan/Legends

facts.affiliation: Techno Union, Confederacy of Independent Systems

Nelvaan.lead: Nelvaan was a planet in the Koobi system in the Savareen sector of the Outer Rim Territories and was located at galactic coordinates Q-16. A frigid world, Nelvaan was home to the sentient Nelvaanian people. The Nelvaanians were considered primitive to many, as they lived in tribal villages, one of which was named Rokrul. Each village was led by a chieftain and their bond-mate along with a shaman who served as consultant on most matters. Religion was central in Nelvaanian culture, and the planet itself was referred to as the Great Mother.

Neelanon.title: Neelanon/Legends
Neelanon.lead: Neelanon was a planet located in the Neelanon system of the Senex sector, a part of the Senex-Juvex region in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim. The Senex Trace hyperlane linked it to the Fengrine and Senex systems, while another hyperspace route connected it to the Crovna system.

Neelgaimon.title: Neelgaimon
Neelgaimon.lead: Neelgaimon was a hot, drought-ridden planet in the Xappyh sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Nauton IV.title: Nauton IV
Nauton IV.lead: Nauton IV was a planet located in the Nauton system of the Taldot sector in the Mid Rim. In 20 BBY, Jedi Master Ruati was beheaded by an assassin on Nauton IV, and fellow Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi suspected the Dark Jedi Asajj Ventress to be the murderer.

Nazzri.title: Nazzri

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Darth Revan's Sith Empire, Galactic Empire

Nazzri.lead: Nazzri was a Mid Rim planet that was located in the Lantillian sector and was the homeworld of the sentient Nazzar species. The planet had become a member of the Galactic Republic by 17,000 BBY and was one of the worlds that provided it with armies during the Great Hyperspace War of 5000 BBY. Around that time, the Nazzar government, which was originally a monarchy, and Emperor-King Prrit Qabaq of Nazzri, had became corrupted by the use of dark magic.

Nedij.title: Nedij
Nedij.lead: Nedij was a planet in the Outer Rim on the eastern spiral arm of the galaxy. It had thin air in which its native species evolved. Natural terrain included snowy mountains which the Nediji preferred, and lowlands. The planet was inhabited by a species of humanoids which served as prey for the Nediji. The Black Sun operative Kaird hailed from this planet.

Neelabi.title: Neelabi
Neelabi.lead: Neelabi was a planet located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories that was the homeworld of the Neelabi species. The Neelabi had a social hierarchy built upon competition.

Nativum.title: Nativum
Nativum.lead: Nativum was a planet. During the Clone Wars, the Confederacy of Independent Systems changed their plans — instead of attacking Nativum, they changed to Azure.

Needan.title: Needan
Needan.lead: Needan was a Wild Space planet. A jungle world featuring massive oceans and numerous species of plants and animals, it was the homeworld of the sentient Geelan. Just as the Geelan civilization on Needan had entered the information age, a passing comet struck the planet, causing the climate to become permanently cold.

Neary.title: Neary
Neary.lead: Neary was a celestial body located in the Neary system, a part of the Calaron sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. Around 2 ABY, the Rebel Alliance Task Force on Alliance Security compiled a SecuriDex datafile on the former scout Yurdak Fav, which named Neary as Fav's last known location.

Neftali.title: Neftali/Legends

facts.terrain: Barren glaciers, Fjords, Frozen oceans, Mountains, Ice canyons

Neftali.lead: Neftali was an Outer Rim planet in the Socorro system. Its name in Old Corellian meant "home" or "safe place," which is what the planet was to some of the unsavory elements that came to the Socorro system. It was a barren frozen world with a long orbit around its red star.

Navlaas.title: Navlaas/Legends
Navlaas.lead: Navlaas was a gas giant in the Pyrshak system. It was orbited by eight moons.

Nella.title: Nella system/Legends
Nella.lead: The Nella system was a star system located in the Tapani sector's Mecetti Province, on the Calipsa Run.

Nelfrus.title: Nelfrus

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Metharian Nebula Territories

Nelfrus.lead: Nelfrus was a planet located in the Nelfrus system of the Elrood sector, a part of the Metharian Nebula Territories region of the Outer Rim Territories.

Natinati.title: Natinati
Natinati.lead: Natinati was a planet in the Natinanti system in Wild Space region of the galaxy. The sacred temple Poborandurannum was located on the planet. At a time prior to 5 BBY, Jabba Desilijic Tiure, a Hutt crime lord, came to the planet to explore Poborandurannum and sacked it during his visit. When Jabba returned to his palace the planet Tatooine in 5 BBY, the Hutt mentioned the planet and the sacking to his Twi'lek majordomo Bib Fortuna.

Neka.title: Neka
Neka.lead: Neka was a planet in the Outer Rim. During the Jedi Civil War, it was subject to a Sith blockade which stopped incoming and outgoing space traffic. The Sith then virus-bombed the world, killing all of its intelligent life. Only a few fortunate individuals, including the Hutt businessman Shuma, were able to bypass the blockade and escape the devastation. It shares its name with the Neka nut.

Near Pando.title: Near Pando
Near Pando.lead: Near Pando was an emerging trade world that was located within the Near Pando system in Hutt Space, a region of the galaxy controlled by the Hutt species. The planet lay on the hyperlane called the Pando Spur that connected it to the world of Far Pando. Near Pando was the site of ancient and mysterious ruins known as the Malabar Construct.

Near Indosa.title: Near Indosa
Near Indosa.lead: Near Indosa was a world located in the Near Indosa system. It was situated in the Loop Worlds area of the Gordian Reach sector within the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The hyperlane known as the Junction-Tierell Loop connected it to the Presbalin and Trinovat systems, and another, smaller hyperspace route linked it to the Far Indosa system.

Necropolis.title: Necropolis
Necropolis.lead: The Necropolis was a junk planet located in the Outer Rim Territories. It was connected to the worlds of Rattatak and Ponemah Terminal by a hyperspace route. During their journey to find Jedi Master Luke Skywalker, Rey, Chewbacca, and R2-D2 were forced to land on Necropolis after a mechanical issue.

Nespis VIII.title: Nespis VIII
Nespis VIII.lead: Nespis VIII, or Nespis 8, also known as the Nespis VIII spaceport or Space City, was a space station in the Auril system constructed sometime during the dawn of the Galactic Republic.

New Alderaan.title: New Alderaan/Legends

facts.affiliation: Alliance to Restore the Republic, Alliance of Free Planets, New Republic, Zsinj's Empire, Dark Empire, Galactic Federation of Free Alliances …

New Alderaan.lead: New Alderaan was a planet in the Outer Rim Ash Worlds. It was home to thousands of former residents of Alderaan that moved there after the Destruction of Alderaan by the first Death Star.

Nentan.title: Nentan

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Alliance to Restore the Republic, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Nentan.lead: Nentan was a terrestrial planet located in the Nentan system of the Glythe sector. Nentan was a barren planet, and the main point of interest was the ancient ruins of a city built by an unknown alien species. During the Galactic Civil War, Nentan briefly hosted an Alliance base. The facility was evacuated after being discovered two months after going operational. Captain Bren Derlin's actions during the evacuation earned him a promotion to the rank of Major.

New Agamar.title: New Agamar

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems

New Agamar.lead: New Agamar was a high-gravity planet in the Galactic Republic. At least one native was enlisted in the Republic military by the time of the late Clone Wars.

Neona.title: Neona
Neona.lead: Neona was a temperate planet in the Tapani sector's Freeworlds Territory, populated by an indigenous sentient species. In 19,997 BBY, the planet experienced a period of intense geological warming that melted the ice caps and plunged the landmass below massive oceans, sparing only two ice-continents, one located at each pole. The native species was consumed by the tides and succumbed to extinction, leaving behind only extravagent ruins interred beneath the waves as proof of their existence.

Neutra Four.title: Neutra Four
Neutra Four.lead: Neutra Four was a planet in the Neutra system, located in the Expansion Region's Oeiros sector. The Galactic Empire forcibly seized Neutra Four during the Galactic Civil War, leading one native, Human Rad Torlent, to join the Rebel Alliance as a junior officer.

New Bornalex.title: New Bornalex/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems

New Bornalex.lead: New Bornalex was an Outer Rim Territories world situated in the Belsmuth sector. It was home to the bluffbeast creature. By 32 BBY, New Bornalex was a member of the Galactic Republic; however, during the Clone Wars, it was a part of the Republic's enemy, the Confederacy of Independent Systems. As one of the Confederacy's fortified holdings, it was besieged by the Republic during the conflict's Outer Rim Sieges.

Nessem.title: Nessem

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Trade Federation, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire

Nessem.lead: Nessem was a Trade Federation planet in the Expansion Region. It was orbited by the modest Nessem Shipyards.

New Apsolon.title: New Apsolon/Legends

facts.affiliation: Sith Empire (Great Sith War), Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems

New Apsolon.lead: Apsolon, later renamed New Apsolon, was a world located in the Terr'skiar sector of the Mid Rim. During the Great Sith War, it was a part of the Sith Empire.

New Bakstre.title: New Bakstre

facts.affiliation: Cassandran Worlds, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Pentastar Alignment, Imperial Remnant, New Republic, Galactic Empire …

New Bakstre.lead: New Bakstre was a planet located within the Tendrannan subsector of the Outer Rim's New Territories. Part of the loosely affiliated domain known as the Cassandran Worlds, New Bakstre was a planet dominated by industry situated on the important Braxant Run hyperlane that served much of the galaxy's northern quadrant. One of New Bakstre's major settlements, Havridam City, was partially destroyed in 22 BBY after activists from the Mechanical Liberation Front accidentally detonated a shipment of Vindicator XM-15 "brilliant" missiles.

Nensil.title: Nensil

facts.region: Core Worlds, Ringali Shell, The Slice, Arrowhead

Nensil.lead: Nensil was the second planet in the Rhinnal system. It was a barren rock.

Nepe.title: Nepe
Nepe.lead: Nepe was a gas giant in the Episol system. It was orbited by the moon Dayark, a member of the Kathol Republic.

Neshtab.title: Neshtab
Neshtab.lead: Neshtab was a planet of snowy ice plains located in the Inner Rim region of the galaxy.

Netolio.title: Netolio system/Legends
Netolio.lead: The Netolio system was a star system located in the Tapani sector's Pelagia Province, near Betolio system. It was annexed by Calipsa Province with the rise of the New Order.

Nevoota.title: Nevoota/Legends
Nevoota.lead: The planet Nevoota was the homeworld of the eponymous Nevoota, an insectoid, sentient species. The Nevoota species was disdainful of death and was considered one of the deadliest species in the known galaxy. The Nevoota were invaded by the Mandalorians prior to the Old Sith Wars, and over the course of a three-year war, the species was hunted to extinction. The experience proved formative for Mandalorian culture, which deified war.

Nepoy.title: Nepoy
Nepoy.lead: Nepoy was a Mid Rim planet in the Nepoy system, Senex sector known for its legendary fruit fields. Nectarwine and other sugary alcoholic beverages were the planets' chief exports.

New Balosar.title: New Balosar
New Balosar.lead: New Balosar was a planet in the Expansion Region, located on the Great Gran Run. It shared its name with the Core Worlds planet Balosar, the homeworld of the eponymous sentient species. It was the location of The Kindest Cut, a beauty salon run by Zenn Bien, the former owner of the Millennium Falcon.

New Ator.title: New Ator
New Ator.lead: New Ator was an agriworld located in the New Ator system, a part of the Arkanis sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was situated on the Triellus Trade Route hyperlane, which linked it to the Kemal Station and Trulalis systems. New Ator was a part of the informal grouping of planets known as the Regency Worlds, and it was settled by Atorese colonists in approximately 80 BBY.

Nettani.title: Nettani
Nettani.lead: Nettani was the fifth planet orbiting the star Rek in the Guter Wade system. Located in the Trilon sector of the Outer Rim, its primary terrain was composed of toxic swamps.

Neree.title: Neree
Neree.lead: Neree was a celestial body located in the Neree system, a part of the Suolriep sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The Human Rebel Alliance intelligence agent Lesle Andreya was born at Neree around 21 BBY. Andreya spoke with a slight Neree accent, and around 7 ABY her origin was noted by New Republic General Airen Cracken in Wanted by Cracken, a datafile that served as a compilation of reports on various threats to the New Republic.

New Plympto.title: New Plympto/Legends

facts.terrain: Barren mountains, Formerly, Forests, Swamps, Jungles
facts.population: 14 million (historic), 95% Nosaurian, 4% Human, 1% Other, 7 million (Rebellion era), 95% Nosaurian, 4% Human, 1% Other, 0 (New Jedi Order era)
facts.affiliation: Herglic Trade Empire, Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Separatist holdouts, New Plympto resistance, Galactic Empire, New Republic …

New Plympto.lead: New Plympto was a temperate terrestrial planet in the Core Worlds region populated by Nosaurians. It was discovered by Corellians around 10,000 BBY - although the Jedi Order apparently had contact with it since at least 25,000 BBY, using the native population as potential recruits. The planet was also the homeworld of podracer pilot Clegg Holdfast. Its capital was the city of Phemiss.

Nibiru.title: Nibiru
Nibiru.lead: Nibiru was a forest world, which also boasted at least one large lake. It was located in the Outer Rim's Kakani sector.

New Brigia.title: New Brigia
New Brigia.lead: New Brigia was a planet in the Koornacht Cluster.

New Holstice.title: New Holstice/Legends
New Holstice.lead: New Holstice was a Mid Rim hospital world between Belderone and Roche. It was part of the Galactic Republic since before 4000 BBY, and contained a monument to all Jedi killed since the formation of the Republic.

New Canistel.title: New Canistel
New Canistel.lead: New Canistel was an inconsequential terrestrial planet located in the Demetras sector's New Canistel system, a part of the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of the senoti tree, a plant that produced medicinal sap and could also be found on the Forest Moon of Endor.

Nez Peron.title: Nez Peron/Legends

facts.affiliation: Sith Empire, Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire

Nez Peron.lead: Nez Peron was an Outer Rim agriworld and the homeworld of the powerful D'Asta family.

New Ralltiir.title: New Ralltiir
New Ralltiir.lead: New Ralltiir was a planet on which Han Solo, Leia Organa Solo, and Chewbacca rested after the first defeat of the clone of Palpatine. While there, Voren Na'al interviewed Han about his exploits in the Corporate Sector years before.

Niddion.title: Niddion
Niddion.lead: Niddion was the seventh planet in the Lianna system.

New Shella.title: New Shella system/Legends
New Shella.lead: The New Shella system was in the Freeworlds Territory of the Tapani sector, between the Lamuir and Procopia systems.

New Javis.title: New Javis system/Legends
New Javis.lead: The New Javis system was a star system located in the Tapani sector's Pelagia Province, on the Calipsa Run. Prior to the rise of the Galactic Empire, the system was part of Pelagia Province. After House Mecetti decimated House Pelagia, New Javis system was taken over by House Calipsa. The system had the second highest population in Calipsa Province next only to Calipsa itself. After the rise of the New Order, the system was annexed by Calipsa Province.

New Polokia.title: New Polokia
New Polokia.lead: New Polokia was a colony world between Darepp and Motexx visited by the Star Morning.

Nichen.title: Nichen
Nichen.lead: Nichen was a planet found in the Outer Rim Territories. Kettemoor jumped to this location after its encounter with the Teljkon Vagabond.

New Holgha.title: New Holgha
New Holgha.lead: New Holgha was a terrestrial planet in the Outer Rim Territories' Ciutric sector, known for its Five Holy Cities. During the Yuuzhan Vong War, it was easily conquered by the extragalactic invaders after the New Republic, believing Mandalorian intelligence on the upcoming attack to be untrustworthy, relocated New Holgha's defense force elsewhere.

Nexus Ortai.title: Nexus Ortai/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Nexus Ortai.lead: Nexus Ortai was a Mid Rim planet located at the intersection of two hyperlanes. It was considered a peaceful world.

Nfolgai.title: Nfolgai
Nfolgai.lead: Nfolgai was a world on the Descri Wris in Sith Space. Sorzus Syn encountered a Mrlssi slave on this world, burdened with stones and nearly unrecognizable under its soot-slicked feathers.

Nicht Ka.title: Nicht Ka
Nicht Ka.lead: Nicht Ka was a planet in the Sith Worlds, a region of space within the Stygian Caldera, which was located in the Esstran sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

New Cylimba.title: New Cylimba
New Cylimba.lead: New Cylimba was a planet within a star system in the D'Aelgoth sector of the Mid Rim region of the galaxy. It was situated on the Veron Route, which connected it to Veron. It was an industrial world whose badlands were the location of an Alliance base during the Galactic Civil War. The base and its crew would likely have been crushed by Imperial forces, had Rivoche Tarkin not provided the necessary intelligence to avoid the attack.

New Brampis.title: New Brampis
New Brampis.lead: New Brampis was the site of the New Brampis Starship Museum.

Niele.title: Niele (disambiguation)
Niele.lead: Niele may refer to one of the following:

Nicandra.title: Nicandra (disambiguation)
Nicandra.lead: Nicandra may refer to one of the following:

Nim Drovis.title: Nim Drovis

facts.affiliation: Grissmath Dynasty, Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Nim Drovis.lead: The world of Nim Drovis was located in the Drovian system in the Meridian sector, and was a rainy planet which boasted a Sector Medical Facility and Medical Research Facility attended to by the Ho'Din physician Doctor Ism Oolos, along with a small New Republic base. The largest free port on Nim Drovis was Bagsho, which was originally settled by colonists from Alderaan turned into a link between the sector's neutral worlds and the New Republic.

Nieuth Four.title: Nieuth Four
Nieuth Four.lead: Nieuth Four was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Nieuth system, a part of the Wyloff sector in the Northern Dependencies portion of the Colonies. At some point by the time the Battle of Yavin was fought, the Rebel Alliance operative and Imperial defector Colonel Vin Northal contacted Colonel Ilo Jev, the commanding officer of the Wyloff sector Imperial Intelligence ExComm facility, who was on leave at the time.

Nimban.title: Nimban/Legends

facts.affiliation: Hutt Empire, Galactic Republic, Hutt Cartel

Nimban.lead: Nimban was a Hutt Space planet that was the homeworld of the sentient Nimbanel species. Having evolved from herbivorous reptiles that had tracked moving plants across Nimban's plains, the Nimbanese preferred an intellectual approach to problem-solving instead of violence and excelled at dealing with bureaucracies. Nimban was a part of the Hutt Empire by 25,102 BBY, and the Nimbanese played an important role in the foundation of the galactic Bureau of Ships and Services around 18,000 BBY.

Nimbia.title: Nimbia
Nimbia.lead: Nimbia was the fourth planet orbiting the star Nubus in the Nubus system. Located in the Core Worlds, it was a gas giant.

Nimba Five.title: Nimba Five
Nimba Five.lead: Nimba Five was a planet in the Nimba system in Wild Space with which the hunter Sam Heggs was familiar. According to Heggs, Nimba Five had a time warp, with one time tropical and the other frozen in ice. It was located on the same hyperroute as Beta Rhama.

Niian.title: Niian
Niian.lead: Niian was a tropical planet of the Niian system, located within the Thaere sector, in the Expansion Region of the galaxy. In 0 BBY, the smuggler Dannen Lifehold was on the planet doing an errand for his mentor, another smuggler named Twolz. While Lifehold was on the errand, Twolz and his crew were killed by stormtroopers, the elite soldiers of the Galactic Empire.

Nilg.title: Nilg system/Legends
Nilg.lead: The Nilg system was located in the Alderath sector, a part of the New Territories portion of the Mid Rim. By approximately 5 ABY, the Ithorian gangster Tolad Dor was active in the Nilg system, a fact that was eventually noted by the New Republic General Airen Cracken in an entry of the datafile Wanted by Cracken—the initial version of which was published in 7 ABY—dedicated to the saboteur Ostan Atur.

Nilrebmah I.title: Nilrebmah I
Nilrebmah I.lead: Nilrebmah I was a planet in the Nilrebmah system. No life had ever evolved on the world; its terrain was largely desert plains. There were no moons in Nilrebmah I's orbit.

Nilrebmah II.title: Nilrebmah II
Nilrebmah II.lead: Nilrebmah II was a planet in the Nilrebmah system. The atmosphere of the world was fluorine-based. It's desert-covered surface was cratered, due to the fact that its atmosphere was filled with asteroids which made frequent impact on the surface. It was the homeworld of an unidentified civilization.

Nilrebmah III.title: Nilrebmah III
Nilrebmah III.lead: Nilrebmah III was an uninhabited low-gravity planet of rocky plains in the Nilrebmah system.

Nilrebmah IV.title: Nilrebmah IV
Nilrebmah IV.lead: Nilrebmah IV was a frozen planet in the Nilrebmah system. The planet's atmosphere was methane-based, and no life had ever evolved on its frigid surface.

Nilrebmah V.title: Nilrebmah V
Nilrebmah V.lead: Nilrebmah V was a terrestrial world planet in the Nilrebmah system. Covered in seas filled with fish and crustaceans, the planet's atmosphere was oxygen-rich and breathable by the majority of species; though the planet never evolved sentient life.

Nilrebmah VI.title: Nilrebmah VI
Nilrebmah VI.lead: Nilrebmah VI was once a planet in the Nilrebmah system. After some cataclysm in the galaxy's ancient past, the planet was reduced to rubble, forming a debris cloud where the planet once was. An exogorth was recorded as making its abode deep within the asteroid cloud.

Nilrebmah VII.title: Nilrebmah VII
Nilrebmah VII.lead: Nilrebmah VII was a desert planet in the Nilrebmah system. The planet's atmosphere was a mix of oxygen-nitrogen, and no life had ever evolved on its dry surface.

Nilrebmah VIII.title: Nilrebmah VIII
Nilrebmah VIII.lead: Nilrebmah VIII was a planet in the Nilrebmah system. The planet's surface was tectonically unstable, with great storms of ash and fire worsening the erosion and blackening of the surface.

Nilrebmah IX.title: Nilrebmah IX
Nilrebmah IX.lead: Nilrebmah IX was once a planet in the Nilrebmah system. After some cataclysm in the galaxy's ancient past, the planet was reduced to rubble, falling into its old orbit as an asteroid belt. Flocks of mynocks flitted about the belt.

Nilrebmah X.title: Nilrebmah X
Nilrebmah X.lead: Nilrebmah X was a rocky planet in the Nilrebmah system. The planet's atmosphere of sulfur dioxide. Lacking any surface water, the planet was home to a silica-based life form that were capable of touching the Force. Incapable of locomotion, these creatures were united through a type of telepathic mind, which allowed them to project their emotions into the collective.

Nilrebmah XI.title: Nilrebmah XI
Nilrebmah XI.lead: Nilrebmah XI was a planet in the Nilrebmah system. A world with a chlorine-based atmosphere, Nilrebmah XI never developed any lifeforms.

Nilrebmah XII.title: Nilrebmah XII
Nilrebmah XII.lead: Nilrebmah XII was a volcanic planet in the Nilrebmah system. The planet was in an unnatural state of tectonic activity, brought about by the machinations and experiments of Ku'ar Danar in the time of the Hundred-Year Darkness. After conquering the system, Danar used his altar to the dark side of the Force to pull Nilrebmah XIII out of its orbit and thrust it into a lunar orbit over the twelfth planet. The forces exerted on the surface of Nilrebmah XII shattered the ecosystem. The planet's surface was riddled by active volcanoes and lava rivers which stretched for thousands of kilometers.

Nilrebmah XIII.title: Nilrebmah XIII

facts.terrain: Shell formed 5,000 meters above the actual surface, Dense forests, Scarred, barren regions

Nilrebmah XIII.lead: Nilrebmah XIII was a planet in the Nilrebmah system. Following the experiments of Ku'ar Danar, Nilrebmah XIII had been moved into a lunar orbit over its neighbor, Nilrebmah XII.

Nirauan.title: Nirauan/Legends

facts.affiliation: Infinite Empire, Empire of the Hand

Nirauan.lead: Nirauan was a planet located in second of three inner planets in the Nirauan system in Wild Space. It was inhabited by the indigenous avian Qom Jha and Qom Qae species, and was the capital of the Empire of the Hand, where it housed a large garrison of Chiss and human personnel.

Nkllon.title: Nkllon/Legends

facts.terrain: Crater fields, Molten waterfall, Searing rock, Volcanoes

Nkllon.lead: Nkllon was a small, mineral rich, harsh world in the Athega system. Its surface was covered in plains of searing rock, impact craters, and volcanic features.

Nod Kartha.title: Nod Kartha
Nod Kartha.lead: Nod Kartha was a desolate, rocky world in the Karthakk system.

Nishr.title: Nishr
Nishr.lead: Nishr was a planet in the Outer Rim, home to a near-Human species known as the Nish. It was the scene of a conflict between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.

Nizon.title: Nizon

facts.routes: Perlemian Trade Route, Triellus Trade Route

Nizon.lead: Nizon was the fifth planet in the Centares system. It was the homeworld of the Nazren species. Agents of Bail Organa provoked the local resistance to oust Imperial occupation and Trandoshan slavers some months after the end of the Clone Wars.

Nista.title: Nista

facts.affiliation: House Cadriaan, Tapani Empire, Tapani Federation, Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Alliance to Restore the Republic, New Republic

Nista.lead: Nista was a planet in the Tapani sector's Nista system. It was located in the Cadriaan Province and was the base of the Rebel Alliance cell, the Pelagia Freedom Force.

Nivek.title: Nivek
Nivek.lead: Nivek, also know as Night Planet, was a planet in the Expansion Region, known as a "night planet" due to the perpetual darkness which shrouded its surface.

Ninn.title: Ninn

facts.affiliation: Priests of Ninn, Corporate Sector Authority

Ninn.lead: Ninn was a small planet located in the Ninn system of the Outer Rim Territories. The world was despoiled and depopulated in an ancient conflict, but was later resettled by a group that became known as the Priests of Ninn. Ninn came to be part of the Corporate Sector following that region's expansion, and so fell under the control of the Corporate Sector Authority.

Niran.title: Niran
Niran.lead: Niran was a world located within the Niran system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Tunka sector. It was the homeworld of the Human Viran Qol.

Nimia.title: Nimia
Nimia.lead: Nimia was a planet located in the Hutt Space between Klatooine and Yoribuunt. It was located near the Si'Klaata Cluster. A lackluster industrial world, Nimia was occasionally used as a meeting place between Hutt servants and outlanders who had failed to attract much favor with the Hutts.

Nixor.title: Nixor/Legends
Nixor.lead: Nixor was a planet located in the Mid Rim, coreward of Hutt Space. It was the homeworld of the Nixor species.

Niorde.title: Niorde
Niorde.lead: Niorde was a planet in a star system of that same name in the Unknown Regions.

Niorde's rival planet.title: Niorde's rival planet
Niorde's rival planet.lead: A planet was in the Unknown Regions of the galaxy. Its inhabitants were at war for centuries with the Niordi from the Niorde system, and eventually defeated the Niordi with help from hired merceneries from the Leech Legions.

Noctralis.title: Noctralis
Noctralis.lead: Noctralis was a planet where Trachta was grievously injured during the Clone Wars. He and a group of clone troopers were hunting a Jedi Padawan who defected to the Confederacy of Independent Systems when the Padawan threw a thermal detonator, killing the troopers and injuring Trachta. The planet was dark and had spindly-looking dead trees.

Nocto.title: Nocto
Nocto.lead: Nocto was a world located in the Airam sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Nixus.title: Nixus

facts.routes: Five Veils Route, Llanic Spice Run

Nixus.lead: Nixus was a frigid planet in the Nixus system of the Outer Rim Territories' Parmic sector, at the end of the Llanic Spice Run. Despite sporting glacial terrain and low-gravity, the planet was not inhospitable and actually hosted a structure, Nixus Hub 218. Hub 218 was populated and visited by numerous individuals, and at some point became the chosen location for a deal between crime lords Azmorigan and Cikatro Vizago. However, Vizago was incarcerated on his own ship by the pirate Hondo Ohnaka, who attempted to execute the deal in Vizago's place alongside the rebel Ezra Bridger.

Noctu.title: Noctu
Noctu.lead: Noctu was a blue and massive gas giant in the Noctu system of the Colonies that revolved around one star and had several moons. Centuries before the Imperial Era, one of Noctu's moons was crammed to the core with resources, including gems, minerals, and spice. Because of the dangerous and extensive mining operations that exploited those resources, the moon ended up exploding, giving Noctu a planetary ring made of ice and boulders. Following that cataclysm, the Galactic Republic closed the mines down, deeming them too dangerous.

Tilth.title: Ninth moon of Tilth
Tilth.lead: The ninth moon of Tilth was a moon that had a presence of water, in the form of the Sea of Carawak. The sea contained a floating depot that was once used by Grand Admiral Rae Sloane to refuel her battleship, the Dreadstar.

Ningoth.title: Ningoth
Ningoth.lead: Ningoth was a water planet located in the Karthakk sector within the Outer Rim Territories. At some point, R0-GR was part of an event on Ningoth which he later recorded in his autobiography, From Trenches to Wrenches: The Roger Story.

Niro.title: Niro
Niro.lead: Niro was a male Duros who lived during the later Republic Era. Niro grew up as an orphan on the streets of a crime ridden city together with his friend Colby. After the two helped a criminal gang led by a Duros man called Lazlo raid a local grocery store and casino, Niro was captured by the arriving police droids, while Colby was able to flee with the gang. Years later, Niro had become a deputy in the local police force, serving under a human marshal.

Norval II.title: Norval II

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Norval II.lead: Norval II was a planet in the Calaron sector abounding with organic life.

Norah.title: Norah
Norah.lead: Norah was a planet where Soara Antana and Darra Thel-Tanis went on a mission.

Noori.title: Noori

facts.region: Expansion Region; the Slice, The Slice

Noori.lead: Noori was a terrestrial planet in the Noori sector's Noori system within the galaxy's southeast quadrant, located in an area of the Expansion Region overlapping with a part of space known as the Slice. The Galactic Republic began scouting the region during the Great Manifest Period, resulting in widespread colonization in the following millennia. Noori was the homeworld of the Noorians, a sentient humanoid species with striped eyes. Tahl, a Noorian Jedi Master who lived during the last decades of the Republic, hailed from the planet.

Norne.title: Norne
Norne.lead: Norne was a world situated in the Core Worlds. It featured several cities that were home to homeless children. Norne was the homeworld of Mygo Skinto, who was orphaned and then, upon reaching the age of legal independence, forced to live on the streets due to her guardians having spent her inheritance. Skinto began to organize Norne's street children and eventually established a permanent home for them. By the time of the Battle of Yavin, she had also began traveling off-world in order to help the homeless children of other star systems, as well.

Norulac.title: Norulac
Norulac.lead: Norulac was a planet in the Inner Rim with numerous mountain ranges strewn all over its surface. Its lack of a strong government enabled various groups avoiding authorities elsewhere to take refuge on the planet.

Noe'ha'on.title: Noe'ha'on/Legends
Noe'ha'on.lead: Noe'ha'on was a jungle planet located in the Expansion Region's Piryn Shar sector. Its fauna included poisonous insects and k'lor'slugs—ferocious, worm-like swamp predators. Noe'ha'on also had large fossil beds rich with the preserved remains of organisms.

Nolar.title: Nolar
Nolar.lead: Nolar was a wealthy planet in the Inner Rim, a commercial center plagued by thieves. Mining equipment was manufactured on the planet.

Nordra.title: Nordra
Nordra.lead: Nordra was a cold, tectonically-active planet in the Inner Rim Territories. Though located along the famous Hydian Way trade route, it was often bypassed by travelers following the Itani Run that detoured around the nearby Itani Nebula.

Nopces Prime.title: Nopces Prime
Nopces Prime.lead: Nopces Prime was a planet in the Nopces system on the edge of the Bormea sector, near the Hydian Way.

Noleria.title: Noleria
Noleria.lead: Noleria was the fourth planet in the Sacorrian system.

Noquivzor.title: Noquivzor
Noquivzor.lead: Noquivzor was a planet located in the Colonies.

Noonar.title: Noonar
Noonar.lead: Noonar was a planet located in the Noonian system of the Outer Rim Territories. During the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire, Noonar was host to the pacifist Noonar Confederacy, which controlled a key stretch of territory between the two galactic powers. During the Galactic Civil War, Noonar was run by Imperial governor Trophan Thanis.

Noremac.title: Noremac
Noremac.lead: Noremac was a planet within the Kanz sector. Following the end of the Kanz Disorders in 3670 BBY, the Jedi Watchman Mari-Elan Nora was killed by slavers on that world.

Norbon.title: Norbon
Norbon.lead: Norbon was the second planet orbiting the star Iminec in the Kalee system. Located in Wild Space, it was an airless rock.

Nog.title: Nog
Nog.lead: Nog was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories' Mandalore sector. Nog occupied the first orbit of the Mandalore system, located closest to the system's star, Mandalore. Nog's close proximity to its sun rendered the planet a searing rock. After the Taung forces of Mandalore the First journeyed from Roon to conquer the uninhabited planet that became Mandalore, the newly renamed Mandalorians spread out to conquer the planets of the surrounding system, including Nog.

Nopsin.title: Nopsin
Nopsin.lead: Nopsin was a planet located in the Nopsin system, a part of the freestanding subsectors portion of the Mid Rim. At one point by approximately 3642 BBY, the reconstituted Sith Empire carried out the operation known as the Cleansing of Nopsin there.

Norclune.title: Norclune
Norclune.lead: Norclune was located in the Norclune system, a part of the Northern Dependencies portion of the Colonies.

Noris.title: Noris/Legends
Noris.lead: Noris was a planet that was located within the Noris system, in the Chiss Space sector of the galaxy's Unknown Regions. It was connected to the planets Schesa and Sharb via the hyperlane known as the Path of the Houses, and to the planet Ornfra by another hyperspace route.

Noryath.title: Noryath (disambiguation)
Noryath.lead: Noryath may refer to one of the following:

Nooli.title: Nooli
Nooli.lead: Nooli was a world located in the Nooli system in the Noolian sector in the Mid Rim.

Nubia.title: Nubia/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Industrial Automaton, New Republic, Galactic Federation of Free Alliances, Five Worlds, Confederation

Nubia.lead: Nubia was a small, temperate world located in the Nubus system on the outer edge of the Core Worlds. It was the headquarters of Nubian Star Drives, Inc., developers of parts for starships, including the hyperdrive for the Naboo cruisers. It also was headquarters for Industrial Automaton, TradeCo, Inc., and the massive PharmCorp. Although not heavily urbanized and with a relatively rural landscape and economic backbone (by the standards of the heavily developed Core Worlds), Nubia was always considered a deserving member of the title of 'Core World' and all its associated connotations.

Nothoiin.title: Nothoiin/Legends

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Greater Javin, Western Reaches

Nothoiin.lead: Nothoiin was the Nothoiin homeworld, on the Nothoiin Corridor and Nothoiin Route. It was a planet with limited development beyond the ur-diamond mining operations conducted on its crystal moon. In the years leading up to and following the Clone Wars, Nothoiin's affairs were dominated by a crushing fifty-year-long drought leading to rampant, uncontrollable wildfires.

Nyasko.title: Nyasko
Nyasko.lead: Nyasko was a terrestrial planet located in the Nyasko system. It constituted a part of the Colunda sector, a subsector of the Phelleem sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. During the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Rebel Alliance, a battalion of Imperial All Terrain Armored Transport walkers was stationed on Nyasko.

Null.title: Null/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Zsinj's Empire

Null.lead: Null was an arboreal world and the only inhabited planet in the Null system.

Novor 23.title: Novor 23
Novor 23.lead: Novor 23, in the Novor system was the Ry'coz homeworld. It was located on the Salin Corridor, and was a busy world with large Human and alien populations living in thriving cities. Its capital was Luj City, which was a key financial center of Tharin sector—even though the Novor system itself was in the Periphery. The local corporate offices of Jatayus Outbound were located on the world; so was one of Black Sun Vigo Sprax's villas, built in the Vos'yr valley.

Novor 33.title: Novor 33
Novor 33.lead: Novor 33 was an uninhabitable Outer Rim planet in the Novor system that orbited further from the system's star, Novor Major, than any of the other thirty-two planets there. The planet's position saved it from destruction when Novis Major evolved into a red giant: it expanded exponentially and engulfed the first seventeen worlds. That event reclassified the thirty-third world as the sixteenth.

Nushk.title: Nushk
Nushk.lead: Nushk was the third planet in the Hoth system, located within the Anoat sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was mostly covered with methane oceans and had four moons.

Nothar.title: Nothar
Nothar.lead: Nothar was the fifth planet orbiting the star Nubus in the Nubus system. Located in the Core Worlds, it was a frozen rock.

Nosken.title: Nosken
Nosken.lead: Nosken was a gas giant planet. Several years before 400 BBY the TriGas Corporation attempted to set up a dirigible mining operation on this world, which ultimately failed.

Nuswatta.title: Nuswatta

facts.affiliation: Kingdom of Cron, Xim's Empire, Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire

Nuswatta.lead: Nuswatta was a planet in the Tion Cluster of the Outer Rim Territories.

Nouane.title: Nouane/Legends
Nouane.lead: Nouane was an Inner Rim trade world and the capital of the Nouane region. It had famous libraries and a long tradition of skillful statecraft. Originally the center of a small state separate from the Galactic Republic, it was ravaged by the Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders during the Mandalorian Wars, which prompted the region to seek the protection of the Republic and eventually became one of its Allied Regions. Later, Nouane became part of the Galactic Empire but afterward remained independent from its successor, the New Republic.

Nubisa.title: Nubisa
Nubisa.lead: Nubisa was the second planet orbiting the binary stars Toydar and Little Toydar in the Toydaria system. Located in Hutt Space of the galaxy, it was a hothouse world.

Nurstin.title: Nurstin

facts.region: Mid Rim, Kashyyyk Region, The Slice

Nurstin.lead: Nurstin was rocky and gas-covered. It was the third planet of the Bissillirus system which was located in the Trax sector. A number of mining colonies were established by Messert Mines Corporation around the planet during the last century of the Galactic Republic. Its red atmosphere was discovered by Arnoth Draenell to have brilliant flashes of light sparkling its face, and it was later discovered to be rich in Corthel and Cortheum.

Novar.title: Novar
Novar.lead: Novar was a planet in the Expansion Region. On the 1,000th year since the world was settled, a large tract of land was turned over to House Korden.

Nyara.title: Nyara
Nyara.lead: Nyara was a planet containing a class-3 toxic weapons dump. In 13 ABY a team of thieves hired by Nom Anor raided the dump to retrieve a chunk of zinethium.

Novor 18.title: Novor 18
Novor 18.lead: Originally the 18th planet of the Novor system, Novor 18 was the the most inner planet that was not destroyed when the system's star, Novor Major, expanded into its red giant phase.

Noult.title: Noult
Noult.lead: Noult was a planet that played host to a slaughter during the Galactic Civil War. The planet was later found to have housed a secret Rebel base. The incident on Noult was later remarked by Ransolm Casterfo as an example of the Rebel Alliance's so-called terrorist tactics.

Nummunr.title: Nummunr
Nummunr.lead: Nummunr was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Ash Worlds, within the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories.

Nur.title: Nur
Nur.lead: Nur was a water-rich ocean moon in the Mustafar system of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. It was covered in sodium-rich water and had no natural land masses charted. There was also an apparent lack of indigenous sentient life, leaving the heavily secured underwater Fortress Inquisitorius, as the only known structure on the moon. After an incident on Coruscant, it was used as the headquarters of the Inquisitorius and to contain captured Jedi.

Nox.title: Nox

facts.affiliation: Order of the Night Wind, Hunters of the Outer Rim

Nox.lead: Nox was an Iridonian Zabrak who participated in the Hunters of the Outer Rim competition. Formerly an assassin for the Order of the Night Wind, the acrobatic archer aimed to use the fame of being a Hunter to generate leads about her long-lost sister.

OboRin Comet Cluster.title: OboRin Comet Cluster

facts.region: Core Worlds, Northern Dependencies, The Slice, Arrowhead
facts.routes: Corellian Run, Coruscant–Dantooine hyperlane, Koros Trunk Line, Leisure Corridor, Martial Cross, Metellos Trade Route, Namadii Corridor, Perlemian Trade Route …

OboRin Comet Cluster.lead: The OboRin Comet Cluster, also known as the OboRins, was a comet cluster on the edge of the Coruscant system.

Oblis.title: Oblis
Oblis.lead: Oblis was a technologically-advanced planet in the Cularin system. It included large crystal deposits.

Nysza III.title: Nysza III
Nysza III.lead: Nysza III, also known as Nysza, was an Outer Rim Territories celestial body located in the Dalchon sector. At one point, the Galactic Empire began the construction of a communications bunker there. By 0 ABY, however, the Rebel Alliance Harrier Infiltration Team under the command of captain Fable Astin destroyed the structure.

Obinipor.title: Obinipor
Obinipor.lead: Obinipor was an unaligned planet in the Outer Rim, near Warlord Zsinj's territory. Its volcanoes spewed out metals used to fabricate power generators.

Nyny.title: Nyny
Nyny.lead: Nyny was a homeworld of a three-headed sentient species located in the Ash Worlds. Thirteen years after the Battle of Endor, Nyny was represented in the New Republic Senate.

Obana Belt.title: Obana Belt
Obana Belt.lead: The Obana Belt, also known as Rycar's Run, was a field of asteroids in the Arkanis sector near Tatooine. It was the site of small amounts of mining and pirate activity.

Nyrvona.title: Nyrvona
Nyrvona.lead: Nyrvona was a planet in the Cha Raaba system of the Hutt Space. Like Ylesia, the Besadii kajidic used it as a quasi-religious spice-processing colony.

Obas.title: Obas
Obas.lead: Obas was a superheated volcanic planet located in the Expansion Region's Andirma sector. During the Galactic Civil War, the Alliance to Restore the Republic operated a base on the planet, the environmental control systems of which at one point malfunctioned. As a result, the base faced imminent melt-down due to the extremely high temperatures of Obas. The personnel of the base tasked a group of Rebel agents that had arrived in the Obas system to retrieve critical replacement parts from an Imperial supply depot in the nearby Rainos Cluster.

Obelia.title: Obelia system/Legends
Obelia.lead: The Obelia system was a star system located in the Tapani sector's Pelagia Province, near Pelagon.

Nyssa.title: Nyssa

facts.affiliation: House Mecetti, Tapani Federation, Sith Empire (Great Sith War), Galactic Republic, Mecrosa Order, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Nyssa.lead: Nyssa was a planet in the Tapani sector's Nyssa system, in the Mecetti Province. The Sith cult of assassins known as the Mecrosa Order arose on the planet thousands of years before the Battle of Yavin, backed by House Mecetti.

Nyss.title: Nyss

facts.region: Mid Rim, Kashyyyk Region, The Slice

Nyss.lead: Nyss was the fifth planet in the Boz Pity system.

OHS2132-04.title: OHS2132-04 system/Legends
OHS2132-04.lead: The OHS2132-04 system was located in the Ash Worlds sector, a part of the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. Between 25,120 BBY and 25,096 BBY, it was known as the Ulonsus system and was situated in the Kiirium Reaches region, a part of the empire of the Tionese conqueror Xim. During that time, the Ulonsus system was connected by hyperlanes to the Balshebr, Pakuuni, and Xoraes systems, and Xim moved his forces from Pakuuni to Ulonsus and then to Xoraes.

Oben.title: Oben
Oben.lead: Oben was a resource-rich planet in Wild Space, and was a colony of the Kaleesh species.

OHS3842-03.title: OHS3842-03
OHS3842-03.lead: OHS3842-03, at one point known as Astigone, was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Ash Worlds sector. Around 25,100 BBY, Astigone was designated as the Eighth Throne of the empire of the Tionese conqueror Xim. Over the subsequent millennia, the knowledge of Astigone's location became lost and was subject to much scholarly debate. The xenoarchaeologist Henrietya Antilles ultimately re-discovered Astigone's identity with the help of a document found in the Great Duinarbulon Mausoleum.

Nyriaan.title: Nyriaan/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Yuuzhan Vong empire, Galactic Federation of Free Alliances, Fel Empire

Nyriaan.lead: Nyriaan was a planet that was located in the Luire system of the Mid Rim.

O'reen.title: O'reen
O'reen.lead: O'reen was an Unknown Regions planet with a surface featuring thick fog and tall mesas and plateaus. It was inhabited by the near-Human O'reenians. The planet was colonized after the Great Hyperspace War as a Galactic Republic advance warning outpost, based on a self-sufficient military garrison. Eventually, the colonists were stranded and isolated from the rest of the galaxy.

Nyemari.title: Nyemari
Nyemari.lead: Nyemari was a planet. By 1 ABY, the planet's capital city Anem had the most modern, sophisticated spaceport in the Meridian sector. The planet was also host to Galactic Empire military installation. The indigenous species was the Nyemarians. It was visited by a team of Rebel Alliance operatives to steal the Duchess' access codes to the installation. After the mission, the Rebel's encounter with a mysterious messenger led them to Rezi Soresh in the Sixela system.

Oba Diah.title: Oba Diah/Legends
Oba Diah.lead: Oba Diah was a planet located close to Kessel, in the Kessel sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. The homeworld of the Pyke species, it was the base of operations the Pyke Syndicate, a criminal organization of spice dealers.

Oaka Prime.title: Oaka Prime
Oaka Prime.lead: Oaka Prime was a wildlife preserve planet in the far corners of the Inner Rim, near the Unknown Regions. Under the Infinite Empire of the Rakata, Oaka Prime was designated as a nature reserve, kept apart from the conflicts with the Gree and the Kwa, but it fell into obscurity after the collapse of the Empire. The nascent Galactic Republic later confirmed the planet’s protected status, which was maintained for several tens of thousands of years. Many of the species that lived on Oaka Prime were rare or already extinct elsewhere.

Nyonpur.title: Nyonpur
Nyonpur.lead: Nyonpur was a colony world of the Rodian species in the Mid Rim Territories. Located in the Nyonpur system in the Daimar sector, the world was represented in the Imperial Senate, the legislative body of the Galactic Empire, until Emperor Palpatine disbanded it shortly before the Battle of Yavin. The senator from Nyonpur and his delegation then went into hiding on Mataou, in the Anoat sector.

Obroa-skai.title: Obroa-skai/Legends

facts.language: Galactic Basic Standard, Formerly: Yuuzhan Vong
facts.affiliation: Jedi Order, Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire, Galactic Alliance

Obroa-skai.lead: Obroa-skai was a planet in the Obroa-skai system within a strategic position in the Trans-Hydian of the Inner Rim.

Odik II.title: Odik II
Odik II.lead: Odik II was a planet that was located on the Byss Run hyperlane in the Deep Core. It housed political detention wards used by the Galactic Empire to secretly imprison many dissidents. The Human officer Major Calders served at the detention facility before being reassigned aboard the Imperial Death Star battle station.

Ohann.title: Ohann
Ohann.lead: Ohann was the second planet orbiting the stars Tatoo I and Tatoo II in the Tatoo system. Located in the Arkanis sector of the Outer Rim Territories, it was a gas giant. It was the largest out of the three planets in the Tatoo system.

Ogden Minor.title: Ogden Minor
Ogden Minor.lead: Ogden Minor was the homeworld of the savage terbeasts. It mainly consisted of a jungle-type terrain.

Ogem.title: Ogem/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Alliance to Restore the Republic

Ogem.lead: Ogem was the homeworld of the near-Human Ogemite species. It was in the D'Aelgoth sector of the Mid Rim, along the D'Aelgoth Trade Route. It was a busy trade world that generally avoided involvement in galactic politics.

Obredaan.title: Obredaan

facts.affiliation: New Republic, Galactic Federation of Free Alliances, Confederation

Obredaan.lead: Obredaan was a planet in the Irishi sector of the Mid Rim and was known to have large deposits of cortosis ore, which made the mining industry the planet's main income source. Since Obredaan was located on the Entralla Route, it was known as one of the most active trading posts in the Irishi sector alongside Orinda and Ord Tessebok

Ockbur.title: Ockbur
Ockbur.lead: Ockbur was a planet located in the Ralltiir system.

Odae Ripp.title: Odae Ripp

facts.region: Expansion Region, The Slice, Trailing Sectors

Odae Ripp.lead: Odae Ripp was the first planet located within the Thaereian system of the Expansion Region.

Obulette.title: Obulette
Obulette.lead: Obulette was a planet in the Tapani sector's Obulette system. It was the capital of Mecetti Province and throneworld of House Mecetti. It was in perpetual twilight due to its dim red star. Its orbital shipyards were smaller than those of Tallaan but nonetheless successful. Most of the planet was covered in cities, ash-colored rock, and shallow seas. The planet was the headquarters of Shimper Ale, a small Rebel cell consisting of amateur warriors from House Mecetti.

Ogoth Tiir.title: Ogoth Tiir/Legends
Ogoth Tiir.lead: Ogoth Tiir was a planet in the Atravis sector of the Outer Rim.

Obroa-held.title: Obroa-held
Obroa-held.lead: Obroa-held was a gas giant world located within the Obroa-skai system on the Inner Rim of the galaxy.

Odryn.title: Odryn
Odryn.lead: An isolated planet in the Outer Rim Noonian sector, Odryn was the chief colony world of the warlike Feeorin species. Known as a world of climatic extremes, Odryn was covered in jungles and mountains, into the sides of which the Feeorin built their settlements. Although commonly believed to be the Feeorin homeworld, the Feeorin's original home was lost—by the time of the Mandalorian Wars, more Feeorin lived on Odryn than anywhere else in the galaxy, and developed an extremely traditionalistic and insular society.

Off-Canau.title: Off-Canau
Off-Canau.lead: Off-Canau was a planet. It was one of the favorite tourist destinations of the galaxy.

Ocsin.title: Ocsin
Ocsin.lead: The Ocsin, also known as the Ocsinin, were a near-Human species with white skin and black, pupilless eyes that hailed from the Wild Space celestial body Farana. Believed to be descended from the Human Tionese culture of the Tion Cluster, the Ocsin established first contact with the Galactic Republic at some point before 4500 BBY. The species' members included merchants and explorers, and it established at least several dozen colonies in Farana's galactic neighborhood, including the worlds Ocsin and Saclas.

Odacer-Faustin.title: Odacer-Faustin
Odacer-Faustin.lead: Odacer-Faustin was a planet with a cold harsh terrain. Heavy snow and high winds constantly buffeted the world.

Obri.title: Obri
Obri.lead: Obri was a gas giant planet with three moons that was located within the Tython system of the galaxy's Deep Core region. Obri and Mawr—another gas giant of the star system—were collectively referred to by the settlers of the Tython system as "the Giants." More than thirty-six thousand years before the Battle of Yavin, the non–Force-sensitive settlers of the planet Tython colonized Obri's moons. By 25,793 BBY, gas-mining facilities had also been established within the atmosphere of the planet itself.

Odessen.title: Odessen
Odessen.lead: Odessen was a planet located in the Wild Space, that had a strong connection to the Force. A world with significant oceans and mountainous continents, Odessen had a mild climate and a variety of wildlife among its forested terrain. An unsettled and unimportant world, it was the place of Satele Shan's exile following the Grand Master's failure to defend the Galactic Republic from the Eternal Empire conquest. During the war against Zakuul, Odessen was chosen by Lana Beniko as the headquarters of the Alliance that opposed the Eternal Empire of Zakuul.

Obus VI.title: Obus VI
Obus VI.lead: Obus VI was an aquatic planetoid that was located in the Wild Space region of the galaxy that was uncharted before the Eternal Empire conquest. It was picked by the Shroud as the location of his new multi-part base of operations - the Coil - for its proximity to Zakuul. After the construction was completed, the base consisted of underwater section, an underground section beneath that, and a space elevator linking the facility to an asteroid base. Obus VI was surrounded by the strongest scrambling field credits could buy.

Ocahont.title: Ocahont
Ocahont.lead: Ocahont was a planet in the galaxy that was six hours' hyperspace travel from Pamarthe. In 3 BBY, it was the location of a large rebel base.

Ochotl Ag.title: Ochotl Ag
Ochotl Ag.lead: Ochotl Ag was an agricultural company based on the Airam sector planet Ochotl.

Ojom.title: Ojom/Legends
Ojom.lead: Ojom was a frozen ocean planet located within the Deep Core and the homeworld of the Besalisk. Largely inhospitable, several space stations hung in orbit so as to accommodate other species less acclimated to the cold.

Olanji.title: Olanji

facts.affiliation: Hapes Consortium, Galactic Empire, Galactic Federation of Free Alliances

Olanji.lead: Olanji was a high-tech planet located in the Hapes Cluster.

Omman.title: Omman
Omman.lead: Omman was a planet located in the Tion Hegemony of the Outer Rim.

Ompersan.title: Ompersan
Ompersan.lead: Ompersan was an Outer Rim planet located within Imperial Remnant space. It was the site of the Imperial Navy fleet records center.

Ohda.title: Ohda
Ohda.lead: Ohda was a planet holding the fourth orbit in the Obas system, with three satellites.

Omeddyl.title: Omeddyl

facts.region: Core Worlds, Ringali Shell, The Slice, Arrowhead

Omeddyl.lead: Omeddyl was a planet located in the Rhinnal system. Positioned just beyond the asteroid field, it was a gas giant with 18 moons, and one of two such planets in the star system.

Oko E.title: Oko E
Oko E.lead: Oko E was a resort world in the Oko system. It was known for its "wild-water" rafting on rivers of molten sulfur. The cyborg Lobot partook in this activity, likening it to maneuvers he performed on the elusive Teljkon Vagabond ship with Lando Calrissian in 16 ABY.

Omiddelon III.title: Omiddelon III
Omiddelon III.lead: Omiddelon III was a planet in the Mid Rim whose rotational plane and orbital plane were perpendicular to each other. Its weather consisted of an intensely hot climate, followed by a brief mild season, then an extremely freezing winter, followed by another mild season. The planet orbited a very bright and hot star and so was subjected to intense light, heat, and radiation. Omiddelon III was the Adar homeworld.

Omar.title: Omar
Omar.lead: Omar was a planet located in the system of the same name.

Olanet.title: Olanet
Olanet.lead: Olanet was a planet in the Outer Rim's Siskeen system that sided with the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars. It was said to be home to the second largest droid factory since Geonosis. One of the most important sectors of the economy was the nerf-meat industry.

Ohratuu.title: Ohratuu
Ohratuu.lead: Ohratuu was a terrestrial planet located within the Ohratuu system of the Expansion Region's Piryn Shar sector. It was home to a species of docile land-based herd creatures known as deripors.

Oligtaz.title: Oligtaz
Oligtaz.lead: Oligtaz was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Oligtaz system, in the Southern Core portion of the Core Worlds. It was the site of the Esraza Temple, which was known to the wider galaxy by 10,000 BBY. Early explorers described the structure as a reality-warping nexus that granted visitors the abilities of teleportation and farseeing. By 43 ABY, the temple lay in ruins, and researchers hypothesized that the structure had been situated above a cavern of lumni-spice.

Okyaab 6.title: Okyaab 6
Okyaab 6.lead: Okyaab 6 was a supposed Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Ojoster sector. According to a 3963 BBY Galactic Republic propaganda broadcast by the "Captain Goodvalor" persona, Okyaab 6 had been conquered by the Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders but, after less than a week of Mandalorian rule, the local Okyaabi residents had risen up against them and reclaimed the planet, subsequently joining the Republic.

Olamenco.title: Olamenco
Olamenco.lead: Olamenco was the third planet orbiting the star Stisste in the Saleucami system. Located in the Suolriep sector of the Outer Rim Territories, it was an airless rock.

Omega 379.title: Omega 379
Omega 379.lead: Omega 379 was the largest asteroid in the MZX32905 star system. Dician ordered her crew to wait for retrieval on the asteroid after they destroyed Alema Rar's base.

Omman Minor.title: Omman Minor
Omman Minor.lead: Omman Minor, best known as Omman, was a planet located in the Kibilini sector of the Outer Rim.

Okator VIII.title: Okator VIII
Okator VIII.lead: Okator VIII, also known as Okator, was a Mid Rim astronomical object located in the Eucer sector. It had a chilly climate and a surface that featured forests and tree-covered hills. The fauna of Okator VIII included nightscowls, shakwulfs, and whellays. During the century-long Tionese War, fought between the Galactic Republic and the Honorable Union of Desevro & Tion, a family from the celestial body Little Atullus moved to Okator VIII after buying a land property there. The family established a farm and made a living by herding whellays and growing various plants.

Omereth.title: Omereth/Legends
Omereth.lead: Omereth was an aquatic planet located in the galaxy. During the rule of the Eternal Empire, seismic activity brought a new archipelago to the surface of the world's oceans.

Oliu.title: Oliu
Oliu.lead: Oliu was a forest planet located in the Jubilar sector within the Outer Rim Territories.

Oktaro.title: Oktaro
Oktaro.lead: Oktaro was the home planet of a human culture known as the Oktarians. It was located in the Oktaro system in Lannik Space, within the Mid Rim Territories. During the Clone Wars, it was invaded by the Confederacy of Independent Systems and liberated by the Galactic Republic. Three years later, however, the planet fell under the control of the Galactic Empire, who renamed it G3-477. Once they took control of the planet, the Empire drove the Oktarians from the coastal areas to the deserts where they wanted to dig.

Onderon.title: Onderon/Legends

facts.population: 4 million, 92% Human, 8% other, Historic (Great Sith War): 4 million, 99% Humans, 1% other species
facts.affiliation: Infinite Empire, Onderon Royal Family, Galactic Republic, Naddists, Mandalorian Crusaders, Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders, Confederacy of Independent Systems …

Onderon.lead: One of eight planets in the Japrael system, Onderon had a temperate climate, and was once home to a primitive race of Humanoids.

Oon Tien.title: Oon Tien

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Moff Sarne's forces

Oon Tien.lead: Oon Tien was a planet in the Kathol sector of the Outer Rim Territories, and the homeworld of the Jarell species. Discovered by Galactic Republic colonists roughly 300 years before the Galactic Civil War, the planet was settled by Humans. The native Jarell monarchies traded with the new Human settlers, acquiring weapons and high technology that fueled a change in Jarell society. In the decades preceding the Galactic Civil War, Oon Tien was integrated into the Kathol sector, and became a major manufacturing and agricultural hub.

Onadax.title: Onadax
Onadax.lead: Onadax was a planet in the Minos Cluster of the Outer Rim Territories in the galaxy. It was the location of an ODT compound that was infiltrated by Jaina Solo. The small world was thick with dust, which drifted knee-deep into corners, fouled machines and droids, and irritated the eyes.

Ootoola.title: Ootoola
Ootoola.lead: Ootoola was the vastly oceanic homeworld of the Ootoolan race. The world was located in the Morshdine sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Oorn Tchis.title: Oorn Tchis

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems

Oorn Tchis.lead: Oorn Tchis was an Outer Rim planet near Agamar. It was a small, backrocket rural world best known for exporting colorful fabrics and a rare ore used in guidance system design.

Ongella.title: Ongella
Ongella.lead: Ongella was an Inner Rim planet of the Galactic Empire.

Oor VII.title: Oor VII
Oor VII.lead: Oor VII was a planet located within the Cronese Mandate, on the Outer Rim of the galaxy. In ancient times, Oor VII was a humming factory world, but millennia of environmental degradation had left it parched and thinly populated. The planet was also known for its annual spelling bees.

Ondos.title: Ondos
Ondos.lead: Ondos was a planet lost long ago. It was located in the Core Worlds. Along with Had Abbadon, it was one of a handful of candidates believed to be the planet of origin for either the Jedi Order or their Force-using predecessors.

Oovo.title: Oovo
Oovo.lead: Oovo was a gas giant located in the Oovo system of the Outer Rim's Tharin sector. It was orbited by an asteroid belt which contained the asteroid Oovo IV, which housed the maximum security prison named Desolation Alley.

Ookbat.title: Ookbat/Legends
Ookbat.lead: Ookbat was the site of a botched mission by bounty hunters Tinian I'att and Chenlambec the Wookiee. A warren-like network of dank caves existed under the planet's surface.

Onuf.title: Onuf
Onuf.lead: Onuf was a gas giant–type planet with five moons. It was located in the Rannon system, a part of the Instrop sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The planet occupied the fourth and outermost orbit around its star, the yellow-white Rannon.

Ooo-sek.title: Ooo-sek
Ooo-sek.lead: Ooo-sek was one of the first Rodian colony worlds. Its swamps were home to a carnivorous species of plant known as yo'uqiol, Rodese for "Hand of Death." Ooo-sek also boasted vast jungles rife with flora and fauna, making it an ideal hunting ground for adventurous Rodians to train as bounty hunters.

Oordo III.title: Oordo III
Oordo III.lead: Oordo III was a celestial body in the Oordo system, a part of the Strabin sector in the New Territories portion of the Mid Rim. Flatsculps were produced there, with the Ithorian chief trader Tredo Dopra of the herdship Veldt having acquired a number of the artworks by the time of the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Rebel Alliance.

Ooo-temiuk.title: Ooo-temiuk
Ooo-temiuk.lead: Ooo-temiuk was a forested world located in the Ooo-temiuk system, a part of the Arkanis sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was situated on the Triellus Trade Route hyperlane, which linked it to the C-Foroon and Tatoo systems.

Ool.title: Ool/Legends
Ool.lead: Ool was a forested planet located in the Ool system of the Unknown Regions' Chiss Space. A hyperlane linked the world to the Avidich and Shihon systems. The sentient Chiss of the Chiss Ascendancy established large circular plots of farmland across the surface of Ool.

Omphalos.title: Omphalos
Omphalos.lead: Omphalos was a planet teeming with a number of different living organisms. In 22 BBY, the Confederacy of Independent Systems attempted to test the superweapon known as the Planet Killer on Omphalos. However, Mace Windu was able to disable the Planet Killer before the superweapon could be activated.

Oon.title: Oon
Oon.lead: Oon was an arid planet located in the Lothal sector of Outer Rim Territories.

Ongary IX.title: Ongary IX
Ongary IX.lead: Ongary IX was a Mid Rim astronomical object located in the Ividal sector. It featured hfredium mines that were converted into Vulture droid starfighter bases when the Confederacy of Independent Systems captured the celestial body during the Clone Wars.

Oovri II.title: Oovri II
Oovri II.lead: Oovri II was a celestial body located in the Oovri system, a part of the Tungra sector in the Western Reaches portion of the Outer Rim Territories. At some point during the reign of the Galactic Empire, Imperial TIE fighter pilot Makkor von Urron participated in a skirmish over Oovri II against a group of insurgents' Y-wing starfighters. During the engagement, von Urron shot down eleven of the enemy craft before himself suffering an injury.

Oosalon.title: Oosalon
Oosalon.lead: Oosalon was a barren, mountainous planet located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories.

Ord Cestus.title: Ord Cestus/Legends

facts.species: Dashta eel, Spider People, X'Ting, Zeetsa
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Darth Revan's Sith Empire, Techno Union, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Zsinj's Empire, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Ord Cestus.lead: Ord Cestus, also known simply as Cestus, was a planet that was home to the X'Ting species.

Ord Biniir.title: Ord Biniir/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Alliance to Restore the Republic (briefly), Pentastar Alignment, Imperial Remnant …

Ord Biniir.lead: Ord Biniir was a planet located in the Outer Rim Territories.

Ophideraan.title: Ophideraan
Ophideraan.lead: Ophideraan was an arid desert planet in the Colonies that, by the era of the Galactic Civil War, was ruled by a group of bandits known as the Serpent Masters. Ophideraan's skies were dominated by a unique species of flying serpent that communicated through ultrasonic tones not audible to the Human ear—it was through discovery of these tones that the Serpent Masters learned to control and mount these fearsome beasts.

Ord Cantrell.title: Ord Cantrell/Legends
