facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Crimson Empire, Imperial Remnant, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Ord Cantrell.lead: Ord Cantrell was an Outer Rim planet. It was originally an Ordnance/Regional Depot under the Galactic Republic. It was one of the galaxy's most exclusive resorts. During the early days of Duros exploration, it was settled by a colony of Duros that lost contact with the galaxy and reverted to simple technology before dying out.

Ord Canfre.title: Ord Canfre/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Pentastar Alignment, Imperial Remnant

Ord Canfre.lead: Ord Canfre was an Outer Rim Territories world located in the Cassander sector. Having served as a Galactic Republic Ordnance/Regional Depot outpost during the Pius Dea Era, millennia later Ord Canfre hosted a facility of the Jedi Order's Exploration Corps. While there, the Jedi Bowspritz first encountered akk dogs. During the Clone Wars, the Republic surrendered the world to the Confederacy of Independent Systems after the Battle of Ord Canfre.

Orax.title: Orax
Orax.lead: Orax was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories, and was the homeworld of the crystalline Shard.

Ord Antalaha.title: Ord Antalaha
Ord Antalaha.lead: Ord Antalaha was a planet located along the Shwuy Exchange, in the Colonies region of the galaxy, that was colonized and established as an Ordnance/Regional Depot by the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. As a military outpost, Ord Antalaha was primarily used for storage and recreational purposes, prompting the construction of thousands of warehouses across the planet. After the Clone Wars, all military forces abandoned the planet, leaving the civilian colonists as the planet's only inhabitants.

Or Tuma.title: Or Tuma

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, The Slice, Trailing Sectors
facts.routes: Corellian Run, Corellian Skip Run, Death Wind Corridor, Old Corellian Run, Ryloth Road

Or Tuma.lead: Or Tuma was the outermost planet orbiting the star Ryloth in the Ryloth system. It was a frozen rock located in the Outer Rim Territories.

Oplovis.title: Oplovis
Oplovis.lead: Oplovis was a world located in the Oplovis system, a part of the Oplovis sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the point of origin of the fine material known as Oplovis linens, and the Oplovian love poems composed by Sumi Zanthe were a part of classic literature.

Ord Bueri.title: Ord Bueri/Legends
Ord Bueri.lead: Ord Bueri was a world located in the eponymous star system, a part of the Nilgaard sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. In the Pius Dea Era, a period of time that lasted between 12,000 BBY and 11,000 BBY, this planet served as a frontier outpost for the Galactic Republic to protect human colonists in the region. Such planets were denoted as Ordnance/Regional Depot, and many of them from that era of expansion retained the prefix «Ord» in their names.

Ord Adinorr.title: Ord Adinorr
Ord Adinorr.lead: Ord Adinorr was a snow-covered planet in the Meridian sector.

Ord Dycoll.title: Ord Dycoll
Ord Dycoll.lead: Ord Dycoll was a planet located within the Ord Dycoll system of the Mid Rim that was destroyed by an ancient drill ship at some point during the Imperial Era.

Opyol.title: Opyol
Opyol.lead: Opyol was a terrestrial planet located in the Opoku system, located in the Galov sector as part of the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The planet occupied the fourth orbital position around the star Opoku and had a single moon. Along with the rest of its system, Opyol was situated along the Triellus Trade Route.

Ord Dalet.title: Ord Dalet
Ord Dalet.lead: Ord Dalet was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Sertar sector. It was a Galactic Republic Ordnance/Regional Depot outpost established no earlier than the time of the Old Sith Wars and was named after the letter "dalet" from the Common Sith writing system. Around 3638 BBY, a member of the Shi'ido species became hospitalized on Ord Dalet.

Opatajji.title: Opatajji (disambiguation)
Opatajji.lead: Opatajji may refer to one of the following:

Ord Dolsan.title: Ord Dolsan
Ord Dolsan.lead: Ord Dolsan was a world located in the Dolsan system, a part of the Negs portion of the Core Worlds. Ord Dolsan served as an Ordnance/Regional Depot outpost for the Galactic Republic during the Pius Dea Era, a period of time that lasted between approximately 12,000 BBY and 11,000 BBY, despite it being located just outside the borders of Republic space.

Ord Celbus.title: Ord Celbus
Ord Celbus.lead: Ord Celbus was a world located in the Ord Celbus system, a part of the Karthakk sector in the Trailing Sectors portion of the Outer Rim Territories. Ord Celbus served as an Ordnance/Regional Depot outpost for the Galactic Republic during the Pius Dea Era, a period of time that lasted between approximately 12,000 BBY and 11,000 BBY. During that time, Ord Celbus was situated just outside the borders of Republic space.

Ord Carpagia.title: Ord Carpagia
Ord Carpagia.lead: Ord Carpagia was a world located in the Carpagia system, a part of the Northern Dependencies portion of the Colonies. It served as an Ordnance/Regional Depot outpost for the Galactic Republic during the Pius Dea Era, a period of time that lasted between approximately 12,000 BBY and 11,000 BBY.

Ord Fanthal.title: Ord Fanthal

facts.region: Wild Space (c. 12,000 BBY–11,000 BBY), Outer Rim Territories, Trans-Hydian

Ord Fanthal.lead: Ord Fanthal was a world located in the Ord Fanthal system, a part of the Ojoster sector in the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. Ord Fanthal served as an Ordnance/Regional Depot outpost for the Galactic Republic during the Pius Dea Era, a period of time that lasted between approximately 12,000 BBY and 11,000 BBY, despite it being located outside the borders of Republic space.

Ord Mantell.title: Ord Mantell/Legends

facts.sector: Bright Jewel sector, Bright Jewel Cluster
facts.terrain: Plains, Jungles, Seas, Mesas, Volcanic islands, Urban
facts.government: Ord Mantell Central Authority, New Republic governorship
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Brotherhood of Darkness, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire, Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire

Ord Mantell.lead: Ord Mantell was a terrestrial planet which was located into the Bright Jewel system of the Bright Jewel sector in the Mid Rim Territories. It was located near Anobis and was originally settled by the Galactic Republic circa 12,000 BBY as an Ordnance/Regional Depot.

Ord Radama.title: Ord Radama/Legends

facts.affiliation: Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders, Darth Revan's Sith Empire, Galactic Republic, Resurgent Sith Empire, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire

Ord Radama.lead: Ord Radama was a planet in the Radama Void of the Outer Rim Territories' Esstran sector. Once a world of marshes and wetlands, it was built up with cities and streets over the years. The planet was the homeworld of the Devlikk species.

Ord Mynock.title: Ord Mynock/Legends
Ord Mynock.lead: Ord Mynock was a planet in the Mynockra system of the Outer Rim Territories' Prefsbelt sector. It was originally settled during the Old Republic as a communication relay. As trade lanes shifted elsewhere, the planet fell into relative obscurity.

Ord Mirit.title: Ord Mirit

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong

Ord Mirit.lead: Ord Mirit was originally one of the Republic's Ordnance/Regional Depots. After the Battle of Endor, the planet's Imperial garrison relocated to Corellia. During the Yuuzhan Vong War, the planet was a strategic world of the New Republic. It was the homeworld of Habeer Zignean.

Ord Pardron.title: Ord Pardron/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Alliance to Restore the Republic, New Republic

Ord Pardron.lead: Ord Pardron was a tiny planet with a thin atmosphere in the Ord Pardron system of the Dufilvian sector, located in the Mid Rim.

Ord Sedra.title: Ord Sedra

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Pentastar Alignment, Imperial Remnant, Yuuzhan Vong empire, Fel Empire, Empire-in-exile

Ord Sedra.lead: Ord Sedra was originally an Ordnance/Regional Depot located in the Clacis sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Ord Janon.title: Ord Janon

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems

Ord Janon.lead: Ord Janon was an Outer Rim Territories planet located within the Spinward sector. At some point, Ord Janon served as an Ordnance/Regional Depot for the Galactic Republic, and during the Clone Wars, it was occupied by military forces of the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Ord Lithone.title: Ord Lithone
Ord Lithone.lead: Ord Lithone was an Inner Rim world that served as a Galactic Republic outpost during the Pius Dea Era. Millennia later, it hosted a Baktoid Armor Workshop factory. In 22 BBY, citing the increased Republic regulations on battle droid manufacture and sales as a reason, Baktoid announced the closure of several of its factories, including that on Ord Lithone.

Ord Sabaok.title: Ord Sabaok
Ord Sabaok.lead: Ord Sabaok was a Core Worlds planet. During the Pius Dea Era, it served as an Ordnance/Regional Depot outpost for the Galactic Republic. It came to be orbited by Imperial Star Destroyers by the time of the Battle of Yavin and was the home of Rebel spy Barthalemew Windsloe, who worked undercover to gather information from the Imperials while living there.

Ord Sigatt.title: Ord Sigatt
Ord Sigatt.lead: Ord Sigatt was an Outer Rim Territories mining planet in the Galactic Republic. The planet was originally settled by the Republic militia as an Ordnance/Regional Depot, but upon the discovery of carvanium by one of the settlers, it quickly evolved into a mining colony.

Ord Klina.title: Ord Klina
Ord Klina.lead: Ord Klina was a world located in the Ord Klina system, a part of the Klina sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. Ord Klina served as an Ordnance/Regional Depot outpost for the Galactic Republic during the Pius Dea Era, a period of time that lasted between approximately 12,000 BBY and 11,000 BBY, despite it being located outside the borders of Republic space. When the Republic launched the Thirty-Fourth Pius Dea Crusade against the Hutt species in 11,057 BBY, Republic forces moved from Ord Klina toward Hutt Space.

Ord Segra.title: Ord Segra
Ord Segra.lead: Ord Segra was a Galactic Republic world in the Mid Rim's Ord Segra system.

Ord Namurt.title: Ord Namurt
Ord Namurt.lead: Ord Namurt was an Outer Rim planet in the Galactic Republic, and the site of an Ordnance/Regional Depot. An'ya Kuro, known as the Dark Woman, had a training ground for Jedi students on the planet. She was training Aurra Sing on this planet when the girl was kidnapped by star pirates.

Ord Hallitron.title: Ord Hallitron
Ord Hallitron.lead: Ord Hallitron was a planet in the Mid Rim. An Ordnance/Regional Depot, Ord Hallitron was used by the Pius Dea-controlled Galactic Republic as a staging point for their assault on the nearby world of Glee Anselm during the Great Northern Crusade in 11,884 BBY.

Ord Gustald.title: Ord Gustald
Ord Gustald.lead: Ord Gustald was a world located in the Ord Gustald system. It was situated in the Mytaranor sector, a part of the Kashyyyk Region in the Slice portion of the Mid Rim. Ord Gustald served as an Ordnance/Regional Depot outpost for the Galactic Republic during the Pius Dea Era, a period of time that lasted between approximately 12,000 BBY and 11,000 BBY.

Ord Ivarn.title: Ord Ivarn
Ord Ivarn.lead: Ord Ivarn was a world located in the Ord Ivarn system, a part of the Hakartha sector in the Western Reaches portion of the Expansion Region. Ord Ivarn served as an Ordnance/Regional Depot outpost for the Galactic Republic during the Pius Dea Era, a period of time that lasted between approximately 12,000 BBY and 11,000 BBY, despite it being located outside the borders of Republic space.

Ord Marsax.title: Ord Marsax
Ord Marsax.lead: Ord Marsax was an Outer Rim Territories world located in the Belderone sector. During the Pius Dea Era, it served as a Galactic Republic outpost. Millennia later, according to a story relayed by Bounty Hunters' Guild member Arack Dostryt, the researcher Doctor Nuvo Vindi carried out gas attacks on every bounty posting agency on Ord Marsax.

Ord Lonesome.title: Ord Lonesome
Ord Lonesome.lead: Ord Lonesome was a world located in the Ord Lonesome system, a part of the Albanin sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. Ord Lonesome served as an Ordnance/Regional Depot outpost for the Galactic Republic during the Pius Dea Era, a period of time that lasted between approximately 12,000 BBY and 11,000 BBY, despite it being located outside the borders of Republic space. When the Republic launched the Thirty-Fourth Pius Dea Crusade against the Hutt species in 11,057 BBY, Republic forces moved from Ord Lonesome to the Riileb system, in the vicinity of Hutt Space.

Ord Ortag.title: Ord Ortag
Ord Ortag.lead: Ord Ortag was a world located in the Ord Ortag system, a part of the Slice. Ord Ortag served as an Ordnance/Regional Depot outpost for the Galactic Republic during the Pius Dea Era, a period of time that lasted between approximately 12,000 BBY and 11,000 BBY, despite it being located outside the borders of Republic space. When the Republic launched the Thirty-Fourth Pius Dea Crusade against the Hutt species in 11,057 BBY, Republic forces moved from Ord Ortag to the Hollastin system, in the vicinity of Hutt Space. Eventually, Ord Ortag itself became incorporated into that region.

Ord Pentala.title: Ord Pentala
Ord Pentala.lead: Ord Pentala was a world located in the Ord Pentala system of the Inner Rim's Western Reaches portion. Ord Pentala served as an Ordnance/Regional Depot outpost for the Galactic Republic during the Pius Dea Era, a period of time that lasted between 12,000 BBY and 11,000 BBY, despite it being located just outside the borders of Republic space.

Ordo.title: Ordo/Legends
Ordo.lead: Ordo was the homeworld of the Mandalorian Clan Ordo, including Canderous Ordo, who became Mandalore in 3954 BBY. Mostly a barren desert planet, Ordo had some vegetation around its equator.

Ord Trasi.title: Ord Trasi/Legends

facts.routes: Braxant Run, Coruscant–Dantooine hyperlane, Veragi Trade Route
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Pentastar Alignment, Thrawn's Confederation, Imperial Remnant, New Republic …

Ord Trasi.lead: Ord Trasi was a planet in the Relgim sector of the Outer Rim and a major shipbuilding world.

Orin.title: Orin/Legends

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories; Greater Javin, Western Reaches

Orin.lead: A volcanic world, Orin occupied the second-planet position within the Bespin system in the Outer Rim Territories. The planet had an elliptical orbit, passing through the asteroids of the nearby Velser's Ring twice during its year. The planet's black surface was rocked by frequent groundquakes and covered with rivers of lava and erupting volcanoes. Orin's surface temperature was unbearably high and its atmosphere was choked with thick soot and ash that rained down from the sky.

Orellon II.title: Orellon II
Orellon II.lead: Orellon II was a planet in the Mid Rim, covered in jungles, plains and volcanic mountains. Thirty-five point nine percent of the planet's surface was covered with water.

Ord Vaxal.title: Ord Vaxal

facts.terrain: Rainforests, Oceans, Aquamarine grassy plains, Polar tundra

Ord Vaxal.lead: Ord Vaxal was a planet in the Inner Rim of the galaxy.

Ord Vaug.title: Ord Vaug

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Alliance of Free Planets

Ord Vaug.lead: Ord Vaug was a planet in the Expansion Region's Rocantor sector. The site of a major Imperial propaganda victory over Separatist holdouts in 17 BBY, Ord Vaug was the site of an Imperial prison that at one point held the Venerated Ones of Vandelhelm. Ord Vaug was liberated by the Alliance of Free Planets in 4 ABY, and the Venerated Ones returned home.

Ord Tessebok.title: Ord Tessebok

facts.region: Mid Rim, New Territories, Wild Space (c. 12,000 BBY–c. 11,000 BBY)
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Refugee Resettlement Coalition, New Republic

Ord Tessebok.lead: Ord Tessebok was a Mid Rim planet situated in the Irishi sector. Serving as a Galactic Republic Ordnance/Regional Depot outpost during the Pius Dea Era, millennia later it loosened its immigration restrictions for people displaced by the Separatist Crisis. Eventually the planet became a part of the New Republic.

Ord Tiddell.title: Ord Tiddell/Legends
Ord Tiddell.lead: Ord Tiddell was a Mid Rim planet located in the Tennuutta sector. Having served as a Galactic Republic Ordnance/Regional Depot outpost during the Pius Dea Era, in 22 BBY it fell victim to a galaxy-wide infestation of stone mites. The silicate-and-metal-eating arthropods caused the ruination of Ord Tiddell's capital, Lagabee, and the world's population subsequently underwent a mass exodus.

Ord Varee.title: Ord Varee

facts.region: Mid Rim, New Territories, Wild Space (c. 12,000 BBY–c. 11,000 BBY)
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Refugee Resettlement Coalition, New Republic

Ord Varee.lead: Ord Varee was a Mid Rim planet situated in the Belshar sector. Serving as a Galactic Republic Ordnance/Regional Depot outpost during the Pius Dea Era, millennia later it loosened its immigration restrictions for people displaced by the Separatist Crisis. Eventually the planet became a part of the New Republic.

Ord Thoden.title: Ord Thoden

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Pentastar Alignment

Ord Thoden.lead: Ord Thoden was a tectonically active planet in the Dynali sector. Its capital was Domitree, and it was represented in the Galactic Senate by Boganni Hrul prior to the Clone Wars. It was the headquarters of Bengel Shipbuilders, and relied on the company's XQ1 Space Platforms as stopover points for travelers to alleviate space transport traffic. The Tenloss Syndicate also had dealings on the planet. It was the site of a deadly groundquake 23 BBY, and was the homeworld of Aris-Del Wari and her mother, Jonava Billane.

Orflon.title: Orflon
Orflon.lead: Orflon was a frozen, uncharted asteroid located near the Demophon system. It was the location of Asteroid Base, the only permanent Alliance to Restore the Republic base near Demophon during the Galactic Civil War. It was so remote that it was not even inhabited by mynocks.

Ordaj.title: Ordaj
Ordaj.lead: Ordaj was the fifth planet of the Hoth system in the Outer Rim Territories. It was a gas giant, orbited by seventeen moons, including Ordaj Besh.

Ord Torrenze.title: Ord Torrenze
Ord Torrenze.lead: Ord Torrenze was a planet in the Sertar sector of the Outer Rim.

Ord Traga.title: Ord Traga
Ord Traga.lead: Ord Traga was a planet, possibly the location of an Imperial base.

Ord Wylan.title: Ord Wylan
Ord Wylan.lead: Ord Wylan was a world located in the Mid Rim's Oktos sector. During the Pius Dea Era, between 12,000 BBY and 11,000 BBY, it served as an Ordnance/Regional Depot outpost for the Galactic Republic. Shortly after the Battle of Yavin, the gambler Lando Calrissian won the license rights for the taxi service on Ord Wylan in a sabacc game but lost them shortly afterward.

Ord Zat.title: Ord Zat
Ord Zat.lead: Ord Zat was a world located in the Ord Zat system, a part of the Jospro sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It served as an Ordnance/Regional Depot outpost for the Galactic Republic during the Pius Dea Era, a period of time that lasted between 12,000 BBY and 11,000 BBY.

Orimanther.title: Orimanther
Orimanther.lead: Orimanther was a world in the Quelii sector that was visited by the Chevin slaver Phylus Mon during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. According to a rumor, Mon attempted to capture a flock of Orimanther's battlebirds, but was initially unsuccessful, so he meditated and created a Force storm, to knock the birds from out of the sky.

Ord Yndar.title: Ord Yndar
Ord Yndar.lead: Ord Yndar was a world located in the Ord Yndar system, a part of the Esaga sector in the Slice portion of the Mid Rim. Ord Yndar served as an Ordnance/Regional Depot outpost for the Galactic Republic during the Pius Dea Era, a period of time that lasted between 12,000 BBY and 11,000 BBY, despite it being located just outside the borders of Republic space. Specifically, the world served as the launching point for Republic attacks toward Hutt Space during the First Pius Dea Crusade of 11,965 BBY.

Ord Thabl.title: Ord Thabl
Ord Thabl.lead: Ord Thabl was a world located in the Ord Thabl system. It was situated in the Halla sector, a part of the Kashyyyk Region in the Slice portion of the Mid Rim. Ord Thabl served as an Ordnance/Regional Depot outpost for the Galactic Republic during the Pius Dea Era, a period of time that lasted between approximately 12,000 BBY and 11,000 BBY. When the Republic launched the Third Pius Dea Crusade against the Hutt species in 11,939 BBY, Republic forces moved from Ord Thabl toward Hutt Space, including the Cyborrea system in the region's vicinity.

Oriadann.title: Oriadann
Oriadann.lead: Oriadann was a planet located in the Outer Rim, and the twin of the planet Brazadann.

Orinackra.title: Orinackra
Orinackra.lead: Orinackra was a prison planet located within the Wild Space of the galaxy.

Orto.title: Orto/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Alliance to Restore the Republic

Orto.lead: Orto was a small planet in the Orto system of the Sluis sector, located in the Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of the Ortolan race.

Orooturoo.title: Orooturoo
Orooturoo.lead: Orooturoo was the home of a race of titanic purple-colored sluglike beings, most notably Princess Nampi. It was an endpoint of both the Metellos Trade Route and the Widek Bypass.

Orron III.title: Orron III
Orron III.lead: Orron III was an agricultural world located in the Orron system, in the Corporate Sector. An Authority Data Center was located there. Incoming traffic was restricted to drone barges for transporting crops and Authority fleet vessels. Orron III had three moons.

Orinda.title: Orinda/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Thrawn's confederation, New Republic, Imperial Remnant, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Orinda.lead: Orinda was a planet in the Irishi sector of the galaxy's Mid Rim. It was located along the Entralla Route. Orinda was on the border of the Mid Rim and the Outer Rim Territories.

Orleon.title: Orleon
Orleon.lead: Orleon was a rainy planet in the Mid Rim. The rain was torrential and never stopped, leaving the planet covered in mud.

Orline.title: Orline
Orline.lead: Orline was the third planet in the Carida system. It was a world composed of methane seas, and had one moon. Like all the planets in the Carida system, it was destroyed by the Sun Crusher.

Orion IV.title: Orion IV

facts.affiliation: Alliance to Restore the Republic, Galactic Empire

Orion IV.lead: Orion IV was a planet in the Tion Cluster of the Outer Rim Territories.

Orn Kios.title: Orn Kios/Legends

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Western Reaches, Greater Javin
facts.sector: Javin sector (prior to c. 400 BBY), Anoat sector (c. 400 BBY—), Yarith sector (generations after c. 400 BBY)

Orn Kios.lead: Orn Kios was an Outer Rim Territories planet situated in the Yarith sector. It was home to a populace known as the Ornki that practiced fishing and lived in lightweight structures built atop giant lily pads. During the early stages of the settlement of the Greater Javin region which eventually included the Yarith sector, Galactic Republic merchants launched from worlds such as Orn Kios in search of new local trade routes. To the Ornki's resentment, Orn Kios eventually became a tourist attraction.

Orvax.title: Orvax
Orvax.lead: Orvax was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Orvax system in the Dalchon sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Orvax had damp ground and dark forests, which made it hard to see.

Orma.title: Orma
Orma.lead: Orma was a junk planet in the Aramand Cluster of the Brak sector. Junkers had covered the world in scrapyards which contained many cultural artifacts including some toys and tech. Further within the planet were items of amazing value. Around the time of the Cold War, an individual was sent to look for the valuable artifacts, discovering a relic from the height of the Tion Hegemony. Several hundred years before the Galactic Civil War, the Orma akia colonized the planet.

Oriolanis.title: Oriolanis
Oriolanis.lead: Oriolanis was a terrestrial planet located in the Oriolanis system, a part of the Mid Rim's Oriolan sector. The minor technology company Oriolanis Defense Systems, which existed by 27 BBY, was based on Oriolanis. Shortly before the Battle of Endor of 4 ABY, Oriolanis was the site of a Class II military shipyard used by the Galactic Empire. The output of the facility was limited to Imperial-class Star Destroyers.

Orocco.title: Orocco
Orocco.lead: Orocco was a planet located within the Orocco system of the Mid Rim.

Ornfra.title: Ornfra/Legends
Ornfra.lead: Ornfra was a planet located in the Ornfra system of the Unknown Regions' Chiss Space. The hyperlane known as the Path of the Houses linked the world to the Naporar and Sharb systems, and a smaller hyperspace route also connected it to the Noris system. Ornfra was an outlying colony of the sentient Chiss species and was home to one of the Ruling Families that ruled over the Chiss Ascendancy, the government of the Chiss.

Oristrom.title: Oristrom

facts.affiliation: Nuso Esva's realm, Empire of the Hand

Oristrom.lead: Oristrom was an Unknown Regions planet located in the eponymous system. The homeworld of the strong–willed Stromma species, the world was controlled by the Stromma council, an organization that led all Stromma planets.

Orroman.title: Orroman
Orroman.lead: Orroman was an astronomical object that was located within the Wild Space Orroman system. At some point, a group of mercenaries caused a water crisis there, with information about the disaster eventually becoming general knowledge across the galaxy. During the New Republic's reign, the New Republic Scout Service captain Korren Starchaser compared in his datafiles the mercenary group Happy Blasters with the group that had caused the water crisis, considering them both disreputable.

Orsis.title: Orsis
Orsis.lead: Orsis was a planet that had jungles, oceans and at least one volcano. It was home to the Orsis Academy, which was famous for training trackers, spys and assassins; among its most famous graduates was a young Darth Maul.

Orondia.title: Orondia/Legends
Orondia.lead: Orondia was a bleak planet located in Hutt Space in the galaxy. A fueling depot was located on the planet's surface. The depot was run by a Bith scammer, in league with his brother on Nal Hutta.

Orkana.title: Orkana
Orkana.lead: Orkana, also known as the Poisoned Land, was a heavily polluted territory on the planet Tatooine. It was the domain of Orko, a Hutt trader of the lower H'uun caste, and was the location of his palace.

Orish.title: Orish
Orish.lead: Orish was a planet in the Orish system in the Brema sector of the Outer Rim Territories that was the homeworld of the Orishen species.

Ossus.title: Ossus/Legends

facts.population: Modern: 250 million, 85% Human, 15% other, Galactic Civil War: 3,750,000, 99% Ysanna, 1% other, Historic: 250 million, 15% Ysanna, 10% Human, 75% other species
facts.language: Modern:, Galactic Basic Standard, Ysannan, Historic:, Galactic Basic Standard, Classical Ossan
facts.affiliation: Xim's empire, Jedi Order, Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, New Republic, New Jedi Order, Galactic Federation of Free Alliances

Ossus.lead: Ossus, known as Idux while under the control of Xim's empire, was the third planet in the Adega system in the Auril sector. Known to the galaxy since before 25,000 BBY, when the Jedi Order expanded there from the planet Tython and established a Jedi Academy, Ossus would become a popular world of the Galactic Republic. This world would also become a place of great importance to the Jedi, as the site where they stored the sum of their knowledge, though such attentions came at a price.

Oseon 5792.title: Oseon 5792

facts.terrain: Groves (under pressurized domes), Rolling lawns (under pressurized domes)

Oseon 5792.lead: Oseon 5792, also known as Asteroid 5792, was a fifteen-kilometer-wide asteroid located in the Oseon system of the Outer Rim Territories' Centrality sector. It served as the private estate of the trillionaire industrialist Bohhuah Mutdah, and it had a set of domed gardens on its surface. At the center of the asteroid, a chamber housed Mutdah's large collection of library items.

Oseon 6845.title: Oseon 6845
Oseon 6845.lead: Oseon 6845 was the largest asteroid in the Oseon system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Centrality. A 700-kilometer-wide iron-and-rock planetoid, it was airless and had extremely weak gravity; however, the inhabitants of Oseon 6845 locally augmented the latter and increased its rotation speed. As a result, landing starships on the asteroid was difficult, leading to a spaceport being constructed at its northern pole.

Oslumpex V.title: Oslumpex V/Legends
Oslumpex V.lead: Oslumpex V was a planet in the Corporate Sector's Oslumpex system, located at the crossroads of the hyperlanes known as the Authority Arc and the Shaltin Tunnels. Situated near the Corporate Sector's border with the Wyl sector, Oslumpex V served as a convenient entrance point for outside goods, and was a rich world as a result. The Corporate Sector Authority's largest shipyard was located on Oslumpex V, along with a headquarters for starshipwrights' unions and drydocks that serviced many smuggler and tramp starships.

Ossel II.title: Ossel II

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Ossel II.lead: Ossel II was the swampy, high-gravity homeworld of the Ossans, in Western Reaches and the Outer Rim Territories. Its main export was syp wood, though traders trying to purchase syp wood from Ossans were often required to take Ossans on as part of their crew. Many Ossans ended up slaves on Karfeddion.

Osarian.title: Osarian

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Osarian.lead: Osarian was a planet in the Expansion Region, near the Corellian Run. It was in the same system as Rhommamool, an inhospitable desert world. The two planets orbited each other that brought them within a million kilometers of each other every ten years, usually resulting in a flare-up of hostilities between the two. The worlds would remain in missile-strike range for months.

Ota.title: Ota
Ota.lead: Ota was a frozen world in the Kashyyyk Region of the Mid Rim which was the home of the furry sentient species known as the Snogars. The Snogars lived in cities built within the planet's ice canyons by their ancestors, a highly intelligent race referred to as the "Old Ones." By 1 ABY the heating machines that kept the Snogar cities warm began to fail, leading Ota's natives to seek out offworlders who could repair the devices and help them survive the planet's biting cold.

Osseriton.title: Osseriton/Legends
Osseriton.lead: Osseriton was the only planet in the Osseriton system of the Unknown Regions. The Hemes Arbora settled there after abandoning their homeworld of Carrivar.

Oshetti IV.title: Oshetti IV
Oshetti IV.lead: Oshetti IV was a swampy planet in the Outer Rim Territories. Its inhabitants used dried swamp hemp, which contained bioluminescent bacteria, to create the glowing fabric known as illuminescence.

Orvax IV.title: Orvax IV
Orvax IV.lead: Orvax IV was a slave trade planet in the Dalchon sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Slaves were stored in dungeons here before being sold off to slave owners. The slave traders lived in the upper levels of the cities. Members of the T'surr species worked as security staff.

Osirrag.title: Osirrag

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Metharian Nebula Territories

Osirrag.lead: Osirrag was the home planet of the Onahk species. It was a small planet, boasting a pleasant climate of light breezes, perfumed air, and moderate temperatures.

Osadia.title: Osadia
Osadia.lead: Osadia was a planet located within the Core Worlds. Its location was kept secret and removed off the star-charts so that the mysterious school that was located there could not be disturbed.

Otavon XII.title: Otavon XII
Otavon XII.lead: Otavon XII, also written Otavon 12 and sometimes called simply "Otavon", was a forested planet inhabited by the Ovoni.

Oseon VII.title: Oseon VII
Oseon VII.lead: Oseon VII was a planet located in the Oseon system that was a major tourist attraction and a center of exploration for the whole Centrality. Trouvee family owned a gambling complex on this planet. At one time, Han Solo and Leia visited the planet.

Ossiathora.title: Ossiathora
Ossiathora.lead: Ossiathora was an agriworld located in the Ossiathora system of the Juvex sector, a part of the Senex-Juvex region in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim. The Senex-Juvex Loop hyperlane linked it to the Deminol and Kassido systems. Ossiathora was the origin point of Ossiathoran noodles and was controlled by House Kassido, a noble house based on the world of Kassido.

Osara.title: Osara (disambiguation)
Osara.lead: Osara may refer to one of the following:

Osmani.title: Osmani

facts.affiliation: House Petro, House Hax, House Picutorion

Osmani.lead: Osmani was a planet located in the Western Reaches of the Mid Rim. Part of the Senex sector's Osmani system, is a minor trade world owing to its location in the Tangles.

Ostor.title: Ostor

facts.terrain: Desert, Deep canyons, Red soil, Wind-sculpted rock formations

Ostor.lead: Ostor was an arid terrestrial planet located in the Ostor system, at the fringe of the Outer Rim Territories in the Koradin sector. It was a barren planet composed of red soil, deep canyons, and various wind-sculpted rock formations.

Ostega.title: Ostega
Ostega.lead: Ostega was a planet located in the Grohl sector of the Outer Rim Territories. A civil war occurred on this planet before the Clone Wars.

Othone.title: Othone
Othone.lead: Othone was a planet in the Hoth's Brand system. An ice ball, it was the ninth planet orbiting the star Hoth's Brand. It was named after Johun Othone, who was killed by Darth Zannah during the Duel on Tython.

Otunia.title: Otunia
Otunia.lead: Otunia was a planet that was the Galactic Empire sector capital of the Bosph sector, and the home of the Kabul family. It was covered in deserts and had mineral-rich soil, perfect for mining by Kabul Industries.

Ovise III.title: Ovise III

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories; Inner Zuma Region; Inner Zuma Region
facts.sector: Zuma sector; Moddell sector; Inner Moddell systems
facts.population: Over 700 million:, 500 million Humans, 150 million Vashans, 50 million Ayrou

Ovise III.lead: Ovise III was a planet that was located in the Moddell sector on the Annaj-Houche Run.

Ovise I.title: Ovise system/Legends

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories; Inner Zuma Region
facts.sector: Zuma sector, Moddell sector, Inner Moddell systems

Ovise I.lead: The Ovise system was a star system in the Moddell sector of the Outer Rim. The Ovise system contained five planets.

Ovise II.title: Ovise system/Legends

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories; Inner Zuma Region
facts.sector: Zuma sector, Moddell sector, Inner Moddell systems

Ovise II.lead: The Ovise system was a star system in the Moddell sector of the Outer Rim. The Ovise system contained five planets.

Ovise IV.title: Ovise system/Legends

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories; Inner Zuma Region
facts.sector: Zuma sector, Moddell sector, Inner Moddell systems

Ovise IV.lead: The Ovise system was a star system in the Moddell sector of the Outer Rim. The Ovise system contained five planets.

Ova.title: Ova
Ova.lead: Ova was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories that disappeared from the galaxy after being was sucked by an Infinity Wave in 30 BBY.

Ovise V.title: Ovise V

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories; Inner Zuma Region
facts.sector: Zuma sector; Moddell sector; Inner Moddell systems

Ovise V.lead: Ovise V was a planet in the Ovise system of the Moddell sector. A gas giant and a known source of tibanna gas, Ovise V was orbited by several inhabited moons, including Midakos and Midakinos.

Ovise VI.title: Ovise VI
Ovise VI.lead: Ovise VI was a planet in the Ovise system.

Outer Los.title: Outer Los
Outer Los.lead: Outer Los was a planet located in the Recopi system.

Ozu.title: Ozu/Legends

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Western Reaches, Greater Javin
facts.sector: Javin sector (prior to c. 400 BBY), Anoat sector (c. 400 BBY—)

Ozu.lead: Ozu was a terrestrial world located in the Ozu system, a part of the Anoat sector. It was situated in the Greater Javin region within the Western Reaches portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The world lay on the super-hyperroute known as the Corellian Trade Spine, which connected it to the Isde Naha and Orn Kios systems of the neighboring Yarith sector. Ozu was a quiet world of sustenance farmers living on small farms. It was rarely visited by offworlders. A small starship fuel station was situated atop a mountain on Ozu. It was the most frequent reason for visits to the world by spacers.

Ottethan.title: Ottethan/Legends
Ottethan.lead: Ottethan was a planet located in the Outer Rim Territories's Ottethan system, in the Ottethan Empire. It was ruled by a warlord who married Neema-Da-Boda, but later fed her to the rancors that roamed the planet.

Otranto.title: Otranto
Otranto.lead: Otranto was the base of the Church of the First Frequency. It was ordered to be closed by Imperial Grand Inquisitor Laddinare Torbin.

Outpost.title: Outpost

facts.region: Mid Rim, Kashyyyk Region, The Slice

Outpost.lead: Outpost was a small frozen planet located in the Bissillirus system. It was the outermost planet and covered in frozen ammonia. Unilliten Industries once established a large research facility on the world, the purpose of which was kept secret.

Oulanne.title: Oulanne/Legends
Oulanne.lead: Oulanne was a jungle planet in the Inner Rim of the the galaxy.

Outer Zznza.title: Outer Zznza
Outer Zznza.lead: Outer Zznza was a location in the Zznza system, a part of the Yminis sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The Besalisk chef Dexter Jettster claimed in the menu for Dex's Diner, his restaurant on the Core Worlds planet Coruscant, that nerf steak was a breakfast staple throughout the galaxy, including such locations as Coruscant and Outer Zznza.

Ottega.title: Ottega/Legends

facts.region: Mid Rim, New Territories, Wild Space (c. 12,000 BBY–11,000 BBY), Lesser Plooriod Cluster

Ottega.lead: Ottega was a Mid Rim planet located in the Ottega system of the Ottega sector. Situated on the Celanon Spur hyperlane, it hosted a warehouse in which, around 3 BBY, a would-be bounty hunter set up a booby-trap using a faulty homemade thermal detonator. When the explosive detonated it left the smuggler Toob Ancher without his left eye, his brother Karl Mathieu Ancher in need of a cybernetic leg implant, and seven other people dead, including the bounty hunter themself.

Overt.title: Overt
Overt.lead: Overt was the eighth planet orbiting the star Prael in the Japrael system. Located in the Japrael sector of the Inner Rim, it was a gas giant.

Oyokal.title: Oyokal/Legends
Oyokal.lead: Oyokal was a terrestrial planet located in the Oyokal system of the Unknown Regions' Chiss Space. A hyperlane linked the world to the Shihon system. A quadrupedal species was native to Oyokal.

Oznek.title: Oznek
Oznek.lead: Oznek was a planet located in the Cademimu sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Ovanis.title: Ovanis
Ovanis.lead: Ovanis was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories on which the followers of a religion known as the Crèche dwelled. They lived inside a series of caverns, within which they protected a giant egg that they believed would one day hatch a savior who would bring salvation to the galaxy. General Leia Organa of the Resistance sent Commander Poe Dameron and Black Squadron to Ovanis as part of their search for the galactic explorer Lor San Tekka, who once spent two years living with the Crèche.

Paigu.title: Paigu
Paigu.lead: Paigu was a planet in the Vorzyd Cluster of the Commonality in the Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of the Paigun species.

Palanhi.title: Palanhi/Legends

facts.routes: Coruscant–Dantooine hyperlane, Namadii Corridor, Shwuy Exchange
facts.terrain: Small oceans, Volcanic islands, Less than 50% surface water
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Corporate Alliance, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire, Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire

Palanhi.lead: Palanhi was a Colonies world that was located within the Fakir sector, situated on the Bakchou arm of the galaxy.

Pakrik Minor.title: Pakrik Minor
Pakrik Minor.lead: Pakrik Minor was a peaceful agriworld in Kanchen sector with fruit and tallgrain farms, resorts, and undeveloped countryside. The cloned Imperial sleeper cell Jenth-44 was located on Pakrik Minor. It was the twin planet of Pakrik Major.

Pakuuni.title: Pakuuni/Legends
Pakuuni.lead: Pakuuni was a planet located in the Pakuuni sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Pakrik Major.title: Pakrik Major
Pakrik Major.lead: Pakrik Major was the sector capital of Kanchen sector. It was a Planet in the Pakrik system and was located in the Core Worlds region. It was more densely populated than its twin world, Pakrik Minor, and hosted the annual Kanchen Sector Conference. It was ruled by the Grandiose Elector.

PDC3141-02.title: PDC3141-02
PDC3141-02.lead: PDC3141-02 was a Mid Rim planetoid located in the Trax sector. For centuries, the Trade Federation used it for dumping radioactive industrial waste. Shortly prior to 13:3:21, University of Sanbra scientists discovered a native unicellular lifeform on the planetoid, and a subsequent temporary injunction prevented further Federation dumping. At the time of the discovery, however, a Trade Federation scow had been transporting a cargo of hazardous waste to PDC3141-02.

Pallaxides.title: Pallaxides

facts.terrain: Scenic canyon vistas (Highlands), Temperate rainforests (Lowlands), Ice (Poles)

Pallaxides.lead: Pallaxides was a planet of the Ojoster sector in the Outer Rim. It was owned by TaggeCo, who used it as a resort world.

Paarin Minor.title: Paarin Minor

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Imperial Remnant

Paarin Minor.lead: Paarin Minor was a planet located in the Cademimu sector of the Outer Rim Territories. A stronghold of the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars, the planet was the target of an unsuccessful attack by the Confederacy of Independent Systems. It later fell within the territory of the Galactic Empire, and eventually within Supreme Commander Gilad Pellaeon's Imperial Remnant from 12 ABY to 17 ABY.

Pako Ramoon.title: Pako Ramoon
Pako Ramoon.lead: Pako Ramoon was an Outer Rim Territories astronomical object located in the Rayter sector. During the Galactic Civil War, TransGalMeg Industries, Incorporated corporate headquarters were situated there. At one point, while the company's guards were escorting the apprehended Rebel Alliance operative Basal Moor through the headquarters, the Alliance agents K'lial and Diskio Khzrry distracted the guards and extracted Moor via the use of a remote-controlled ground speeder.

Paig.title: Paig
Paig.lead: Paig was a planet located in the Expansion Region

Palawa.title: Palawa
Palawa.lead: Palawa was a planet in the Core Worlds. It was the planet of origin of two mystic Force traditions, the Followers of Palawa and the Chatos Academy.

Pal Goral.title: Pal Goral
Pal Goral.lead: Pal Goral was a planet in the Mortex sector of the Outer Rim.

Pa'hir'al.title: Pa'hir'al (disambiguation)
Pa'hir'al.lead: Pa'hir'al could refer to one of the following:

Paloma.title: Paloma

facts.climate: Arid, high temperature and low humidity

Paloma.lead: Paloma was the sole planet in the Paloma system, near the Kathol sector. It didn't have any important resources nor strategic value.

Pa Tho.title: Pa Tho
Pa Tho.lead: Pa Tho was an astronomical object located in the Inner Rim's Pa Tho system. It shared its name with the alien culture known as the Pa Tho, which had vanished at some point by 16 ABY. Pa Tho was also the homeworld of the Human Rebel pilot Nala Hetsime, who participated in the Battle of Hoth in 3 ABY.

Paklan.title: Paklan
Paklan.lead: Paklan was a forest planet, located in the Paklan system in the Nuiri sector of the Outer Rim. In 20 BBY, the Nightbrothers Darth Maul and Savage Opress took refuge on the planet after having a bounty posted on their heads by the Gossam Ja'Boag, the leader of the Rim Commercial Mining corporation. After Zika led a band of bounty hunters to the two's location in a local diner, Savage and Maul brutally killed their assailants before fleeing the planet.

Pamina Prime.title: Pamina Prime
Pamina Prime.lead: Pamina Prime was a planet in the Inner Rim. It was home to shellfish that were responsible of a deadly disease when eaten, the Borotavi syndrome. Jedi Master Taria Damsin was diagnosed with this disease after eating a local blue-shelled mollusk with a green stripe.

PM-1203.title: PM-1203
PM-1203.lead: PM-1203, colloquially known as the Fort Anaxes asteroid, was a massive planetoid located in the Azure system's Anaxes asteroid belt, within the Azure sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was created from the remains of the planet Anaxes, which was obliterated in a cataclysmic event near the end of the Clone Wars. However, Fort Anaxes, a Galactic Republic military base located on the asteroid's surface, miraculously survived the planet's destruction.

Pamarthe.title: Pamarthe
Pamarthe.lead: Pamarthe was an Outer Rim planet located in the Pamarthe system of the Mayagil sector that was home to the human culture known as the Pamarthens, who were known for being excellent pilots, as well as for their courage and gusto. Pamarthen pilots were often recruited by neighboring worlds for racing or for military service, and in the early days of the Galactic Empire many flocked to join the Imperial Navy, as they did not understand the Galactic Republic's decision to use clone soldiers and were eager for new battles.

PM-6986.title: PM-6986
PM-6986.lead: PM-6986 was a planetoid located in the Outer Rim Territories' Anaxes asteroid belt. It had been formed by 19 BBY from the remains of the destroyed planet Anaxes. The planetoid's surface housed a former stronghold and a complement of battle droids used by the Separatist Alliance during the Clone Wars. After the war, the droid complement, including the tactical droid JF-86, was reactivated, and the latter attempted to follow its final directive of attacking the Galactic Republic Senate on the planet Coruscant. However, the droids were unable to leave PM-6986 due to their lack of transportation.

Pammant.title: Pammant/Legends

facts.population: At least two billion (before the Clone Wars), None (around 19 BBY)
facts.affiliation: Free Dac Volunteers Engineering Corps, Confederacy of Independent Systems

Pammant.lead: Pammant was a tunneled planet located in the Calamari sector of the Outer Rim Territories. The Quarren of nearby Dac staked claims to Pammant and other worlds located in the sector, using them as bases for starship construction. During the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems, the Pammant shipyards were used by the Quarren-dominated Free Dac Volunteers Engineering Corps to produce Separatist warships such as the Malevolence and the Invisible Hand, both used as flagships by the Separatist General Grievous.

Pas'sic.title: Pas'sic
Pas'sic.lead: Pas'sic was a planet in the Oricho sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Panatha.title: Panatha

facts.affiliation: Sith Empire, Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire

Panatha.lead: Panatha, also known as Epicanthix was a jungle planet in the Pacanth Reach in the Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of the Epicanthix. It was close to the Unknown Regions.

Pantolomin.title: Pantolomin/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Pantolomin.lead: Pantolomin was the primary planet of the Panto system, in the Dolomar sector of the Core Worlds. It was an aquatic world known as one of the greatest tourist places of the galaxy.

Paqualis III.title: Paqualis III/Legends
Paqualis III.lead: Paqualis III, also known as Paqualis, was an urbanized planet in the Paqualis system of the Inner Rim. It was the homeworld of Corvastan Benelex of House Benelex. It was the headquarters of the Benelex Bounty Hunters Guild.

Parshoone.title: Parshoone

facts.affiliation: Galactic Empire, Pentastar Alignment, Imperial Remnant

Parshoone.lead: Parshoone was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories, controlled by the Imperial Remnant. It was an Ubiqtorate contact station.

Panna.title: Panna/Legends

facts.affiliation: Kingdom of Argai, Kingdom of Cron, Xim's Empire, Galactic Empire

Panna.lead: Panna was a planet in the Outer Rim's Tion Cluster, orbited by Panna Prime and two other moons.

Paramatan.title: Paramatan
Paramatan.lead: Paramatan was a primitive terrestrial world located in the Mid Rim's Senex sector. Its surface featured forests and jungles as well as plains and oceans. The world's fauna included birds, reptiles, and great oopiks, a species having both avian and reptilian traits. The oopiks were a relic species of flightless creatures that made their home in the Paramatan fruit trees of the continent of Grxy. Paramatan was discovered by scouts of the aristocratic House Elegin and eventually came to be used by the nobles of the Senex-Juvex region as a destination for hunting safaris.

Pasmin.title: Pasmin

facts.affiliation: Kingdom of Cron, Xim's Empire, Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire

Pasmin.lead: Pasmin was a planet located within the Outer Rim Territories. One of the original member-worlds of the Kingdom of Cron, it was absorbed into Xim's Empire. After the fall of the empire in 25,100 BBY, it would eventually join the Galactic Republic. It would continue to thrive as a world, eventually joining the Cronese Mandate after the rise of the Galactic Empire. Known for its weavers, they created extremely light, yet warm, blankets and clothes.

Pastil.title: Pastil/Legends
Pastil.lead: Pastil was an astronomical object located in the Abrion sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was situated along the Manda Merchant Route near the Rishi system.

Pamorjal.title: Pamorjal
Pamorjal.lead: Pamorjal was a planet located in the Pamorjal system in the Expansion Region.

Parada.title: Parada
Parada.lead: Parada was a Mid Rim agriworld located in the Hadar sector. It was home to the giant herbivorous herd creatures known as wombacks. Parada exported womback hides and meat, as well as a variety of grains, offworld, and it provided most of the food for the Ado sector planet Ord Gimmel.

Partainu.title: Partainu
Partainu.lead: Partainu was the fifth planet orbiting the star of Deel in the Neimoidia system. Located in the Colonies, it was a gas giant.

Pashvi.title: Pashvi/Legends
Pashvi.lead: Pashvi was a planet that was located on the edge of Wild Space and had thousands of rock pillars scattered across its landscape. Both nutritional plants and dangerous predatory avians could be found on the tops of the pillars. As a result, the native Pashvi, a sentient humanoid species, were both drawn to and afraid of the pillars, and had a distanced emotional state. The Pashvi also created works of art that were sought after in the Corporate Sector, and the Human smuggler Dubrak Qennto had visited the world a few times by the year 27 BBY.

Pargaux.title: Pargaux
Pargaux.lead: Pargaux was a celestial body located in the Pargaux system, a part of the Southern Core portion of the Core Worlds. Before the Battle of Ruusan and the event known as the Ruusan Reformation, both of which took place in 1000 BBY, Pargaux was governed by a matriarchy. The Galactic Empire stormtrooper known as TD-5144 hailed from Pargaux, a fact that their fellow stormtrooper of the 291st Legion Dalisor, Isila Drutch, noted in their 33 ABY memoirs.

Parcovey Minor.title: Parcovey Minor
Parcovey Minor.lead: Parcovey Minor was a Mid Rim world situated in the Hune sector. During the Kymoodon Era, it was settled by Galactic Republic colonists from Belasco; however, the Hutts viewed the world as a part of their territories. They ordered a raid on Parcovey Minor in order to enslave its inhabitants, but the Belasco Free Volunteers militia, which learned of the planned attack beforehand, was able to repel it. In return, the heavily armed militia members and colonists then launched a surprise attack into Hutt Space.

Pasher.title: Pasher
Pasher.lead: Pasher was a desert planet located in the Pasher system in the Inner Rim region of the galaxy, in square M-14. Although similar to the planet Tatooine in terms of terrain, Pasher lacked the intersecting hyperspace routes that made the other world a popular smugglers' den. By the time of the Galactic Civil War, the largest industry on Pasher was Kelen Biolabs, which exploited the natural poison and glands of the native sandstone scorpions and spine spiders.

Parau VI.title: Parau VI
Parau VI.lead: Parau VI was a dying planet located in the galaxy's Expansion Region. Members of the B'ankora species who were residents of the B'ankor Refuge on the Galactic Empire's capital of Coruscant were relocated to Parau VI after the rise of the Empire so an Imperial research complex could be built where the refuge was located.

Parnassos.title: Parnassos

facts.terrain: Cliffs, Plateaus, Spires of black rock, Caves, Desert

Parnassos.lead: Parnassos was a desolate planet located in the galaxy's Unknown Regions that was the homeworld of Phasma. Formerly lush and green, Parnassos had been colonized by the Con Star Mining Corporation. Following a nuclear disaster, Con Star abandoned Parnassos and abandoned the colonists, who were forced to eke out a perilous existence on the environmentally ruined world.

Parcellus Minor.title: Parcelus Minor
Parcellus Minor.lead: Parcelus Minor was a location in the Parcelus Minor system in the Parcelus sector of the Expansion Region. The mercenary Saponza once participated in the Retreat from Parcelus Minor.

Paulking XIV.title: Paulking XIV
Paulking XIV.lead: Paulking XIV was a planet in the Paulking system of the Centrality. It was renowned for its unusual water life, which included fur-bearing trout, flying crabs, and talking algae.

Patch-4.title: Patch-4
Patch-4.lead: Patch-4 was a trash-covered planet in the Outer Rim that was used to store valuable merchandise by Orion Ferret, an infamous weapons dealer and owner of the Bazarre black market space station. During the Galactic Civil War, Patch-4 became the unlikely home of a tight-knit group of refugees cast out of their previous homes by the Galactic Empire. However, this small population was threatened by Ceasar, the massive and deadly watchbeast Ferret used to guard his wares.

Pelagon.title: Pelagon
Pelagon.lead: Pelagon was a planet in the Pelagia Province of the Tapani sector and was the capital world of House Pelagia. It was a planet with a long tradition of providing many Jedi, such as Taj Junak. As a result, it was stripped of much of its power during the Great Jedi Purge.

Peg Shar I.title: Peg Shar I/Legends
Peg Shar I.lead: Peg Shar I was an industrial world that occupied the first orbital position in the Peg Shar system. It was a part of the Halla sector in the Kashyyyk Region, within the Slice portion of the Mid Rim. The hyperlane known as the Lesser Lantillian Route linked it to Pusat Station and the Saari Ha system.

Pelemax.title: Pelemax (disambiguation)
Pelemax.lead: Pelemax may refer to one of the following:

Pelgrin.title: Pelgrin
Pelgrin.lead: Pelgrin was a planet in the Outer Rim. Over two million years before the Battle of Yavin, an indigenous species, the Pelgrin, built the Oracle on the planet, a merging of technology and the Force. The Pelgrin went extinct, leaving many mysterious ruins and artifacts.

Patar.title: Patar
Patar.lead: Patar was the outermost planet in the Demar system.

Pehzehvar.title: Pehzehvar
Pehzehvar.lead: Pehzehvar (Doornik-628D) was a planet in the Doornik-628 system with a single moon.

Pauc'on.title: Pauc'on
Pauc'on.lead: Pau'con was a planet in the Ralltiir system.

Pavia.title: Pavia

facts.affiliation: House Cadriaan, Tapani Federation, Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Pavia.lead: Pavia was a planet in the Pavia system. It was located in the Cadriaan Province of the Tapani sector.

Pavo Prime.title: Pavo Prime/Legends
Pavo Prime.lead: Pavo Prime was a warm gambling planet in the Inner Rim.

Pedducis Chorios.title: Pedducis Chorios
Pedducis Chorios.lead: Pedducis Chorios was a planet in the Meridian sector in the Pedducis Chorios system. After her initial retirement from the Imperial Starfleet, Admiral Daala led a group of former Imperial settlers on the world. It was also the world were warlord K'iin resided and was home to several pirate bases.

Peirs.title: Peirs
Peirs.lead: Peirs was a planet within the Peirs system of the Outer Rim Territories' Kathol sector. Connected to the neighboring planets of Gandle Ott, Shintel and Ivatch by hyperlanes, Peirs supported a small colony whose economy was based around supplying ore and natural resources to Gandle Ott.

Pegg.title: Pegg
Pegg.lead: Pegg was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Pegg system, a part of the Tynquay sector in the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It hosted multiple spaceports, with the concourse of the main one being the site of the store named Merrk's Weapons Shop. During the Galactic Civil War, several members of the group of pirates led by Yesgar, who had a hideout on the Esstran sector celestial body Antared III, were observed entering the shop, after which they never registered their purchases with Pegg's local government.

Pedd 4.title: Pedd Four
Pedd 4.lead: Pedd Four was an astronomical object located in the D'Astan sector of the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It occupied the fourth orbital position within the Pedd system, and the Celanon Spur hyperlane connected it to the Ord Cestus and Celanon systems.

Patrolia.title: Patrolia/Legends
Patrolia.lead: Patrolia was the aquatic homeworld of the Patrolian species. The planet was located in the Inner Rim.

Patitite Pattuna.title: Patitite Pattuna/Legends
Patitite Pattuna.lead: Patitite Pattuna was a planet close to the world Balnab that was home to the diminutive Patitite species.

Patagonia.title: Patagonia
Patagonia.lead: Patagonia was a planet where the former pirate Roberts palace was located following the Lost Tribe of Sith emergence.

Peldon Minor.title: Peldon Minor
Peldon Minor.lead: Peldon Minor was an astronomical object located within the Peldon Minor system. It was located in the star cluster that eventually became the Cassander subsector, a part of the Cassander sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories. During the Clone Wars, Galactic Republic colonel Hurst Romodi participated in military actions at Peldon Minor and was later decorated for his efforts while fighting there.

Paucris Major.title: Paucris Major
Paucris Major.lead: Paucris Major was a planet located in the Paucris system. In 3 BBY, Princess Leia Organa traveled to Paucris Major, discovering a fleet of battleships and transports being refurbished in the planet's orbit. Leia later returned to warn the rebel base there that they needed to evacuate because the Galactic Empire intended to "bring peace" to the planet.

Peragus II.title: Peragus II
Peragus II.lead: Peragus II was a planet in the Peragus system of the Outer Rim Territories' Xappyh sector. A major source of low-grade engine fuel, Peragus II was originally a terrestrial world, but it was nearly destroyed hundreds of years before 3959 BBY by the early attempts of miners to siphon off fuel from the planet. A mining accident caused an explosion beneath the crust, blowing a massive hole in the planet and forming an asteroid field around the world.

Pembric II.title: Pembric II

facts.government: Corporate government, Puppet government under the control of the Bombaasa Cartel
facts.affiliation: Galactic Empire, Moff Sarne's forces, Bombaasa Cartel

Pembric II.lead: Pembric II, also referred to as Pembric 2, was a planet in the Pembric system, located in the Kathol sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Although it was originally terraformed as an agricultural colony, careless actions during the process resulted in unsuitable conditions, creating boggy wetlands and a near-constant light rain to fall. Situated in a remote part of the galaxy, and partially isolated by the presence of a dense asteroid field and radiation fields, Pembric II was marketed by its residents as a resort for gangsters, which eventually evolved into a full-blown shadowport.

Pergitor.title: Pergitor
Pergitor.lead: Pergitor was a planet in the Minos Cluster settled by Jesa Corporation miners.

Pengalan IV.title: Pengalan IV

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems

Pengalan IV.lead: Pengalan IV was a planet in the Inner Rim, between Taanab and Obroa-skai. In 22 BBY, the Galactic Republic destroyed a Confederacy of Independent Systems facility on the planet during the Clone Wars.

Pendal.title: Pendal
Pendal.lead: Pendal was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Pendal system, a part of the Homon sector in the New Territories portion of the Mid Rim. It was the site of the settlement known as Tilam City, and technology that was relatively simpler than high-technology tools available in the wider galaxy was in common use on the celestial body.

Pella.title: Pella

facts.affiliation: House Mecetti, Tapani Empire, Tapani Federation

Pella.lead: Pella was a planet in the Pella system in the Mecetti Province of the Tapani sector. It was probably named after the Pella Compact. The planet produced vast harvests of grain and vegetables each year and was an important agricultural producer of the sector.

Pelutt.title: Pelutt
Pelutt.lead: Pelutt was a terrestrial planet in the Beshqek system of the Deep Core. It occupied the eighth orbital position around the star Beshqek and had two moons. It featured a rocky surface and a frozen environment.

Peppel.title: Peppel
Peppel.lead: Peppel was an Outer Rim Territories planet in the Corva sector. In 17 ABY, the wanted Devaronian former army captain Kardue'sai'Malloc fled to Peppel, where for the following two years he resided in a simple hut that was protected by a sophisticated security system. Eventually, the bounty hunter Boba Fett tracked Kardue'sai'Malloc to Peppel, where, eschewing his combat armor and wielding only a bow and knife in order to bypass the Devaronian's security system, Fett captured the fugitive and went on to deliver him to the world Devaron for execution.

Penovia.title: Penovia
Penovia.lead: Penovia was a planet in the Recopi system. It was a gas giant with fourteen moons.

Pembric asteroid field.title: Pembric asteroid field
Pembric asteroid field.lead: The Pembric asteroid field was located in the Pembric system. The field surrounded Pembric II, and its asteroids constantly bombarded the surface of the planet. The field was rich in hfredium, and was mined during the time Moff Kentor Sarne controlled the Kathol sector.

Pencael IV.title: Pencael IV
Pencael IV.lead: Pencael IV was an Imperial planet in the Pencael system. It was the homeworld of the wealthy Cholus family, including Imperial Commander Senn Cholus and Rebel Scandium Team member Aven Cholus.

Pendarr III.title: Pendarr III/Legends
Pendarr III.lead: Pendarr III was the homeworld of the Pendarran Warriors, a military organization headed by Gendal Delan which worked alongside the Jedi of the Republic. The Emperor ordered the Pendarran Warriors killed in the Great Jedi Purge. The survivors formed Pendarran's Revenge.

Peragus asteroid field.title: Peragus asteroid field
Peragus asteroid field.lead: The Peragus asteroid field was a formation of fuel-rich asteroids that was created after the first attempt to set up a mining station on Peragus II.

Pellastrallas.title: Pellastrallas
Pellastrallas.lead: Pellastrallas was a planet located in the Pellastrallas system, a part of the Agarix sector in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim. Its surface featured mountain ranges that were inhabited by the arqet, an aggressive warm-blooded predator that used camouflage—with its skin changing color depending on the amount of solar radiation absorbed—to ambush prey in its rocky habitat. The latter creatures included the smaller Ixzinian rock ram and Uthori breix, which originated in the Ixzinia system and Uthor system respectively.

Peridon's Folly.title: Peridon's Folly
Peridon's Folly.lead: Peridon's Folly was a weapons depot that was operated by traders who sold obsolete arms to crime lords. Sectors were controlled by gunrunners and were separated by wastelands where the weapons were tested. IG-88B collected his first bounty there.

Per Lupelo.title: Per Lupelo

facts.terrain: Lakes, Mountain ranges, Oceans, Plains, Forests

Per Lupelo.lead: Per Lupelo was a cosmopolitan planet in the Per Lupelo system. It was dotted by a number of clean cities and bodies of water, and it was also dotted with a number of mountain ranges. A crime organization led by the gangster Raze had its headquarters on the planet at the height of the Galactic Civil War.

Pendari.title: Pendari
Pendari.lead: Pendari was a planet in the Expansion Region, located on the Corellian Trade Spine rimward of the Kinyen system.

Pergoomi.title: Pergoomi/Legends
Pergoomi.lead: Pergoomi was an airless rock that was the second planet of the Mygeeto system.

Pengalan.title: Pengalan system
Pengalan.lead: The Pengalan system was a star system located in the galaxy's Inner Rim.

Pendaxa.title: Pendaxa
Pendaxa.lead: Pendaxa was a celestial body located in the Pendaxa system, a part of the Jjannex sector in the Western Reaches portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was situated on the hyperlane known as the Lipsec Run, which linked it to the Kelrodo-Ai system of the Steniplis sector and the Anoat sector's Mev system.

Pernicar.title: Pernicar

facts.affiliation: Jedi Order, Army of Light, Galactic Republic

Pernicar.lead: Pernicar was a male Human Jedi Master who fought in the New Sith Wars. The son of a scribe, Pernicar's father sent him to the Jedi Order once he proved himself to be Force-sensitive, something he resented for many years. From 1010 BBY until 1000 BBY, Pernicar fought in the New Sith Wars against the Brotherhood of Darkness, at one point being forced to kill his former Padawan, Wud Mortull, who had fallen to the dark side of the Force. In 1002 BBY, he was called into action to fight on the planet Ruusan in the Army of Light, a Jedi army led by Pernicar's good friend, Lord Hoth.

Perilix.title: Perilix
Perilix.lead: Perilix was an oceanic world inhabited by thinking clams.

Phaeda.title: Phaeda/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Empire, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire, Imperial Remnant

Phaeda.lead: Phaeda was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories, with two rocky moons. Of little strategic or commercial importance, its Imperial garrison was corrupt, and so the planet provided haven for many smugglers, thieves and other fringers. This led to diverse species finding a home on the planet, in addition to the many Human inhabitants.

Pernella.title: Pernella

facts.sector: Tapani sector, Freeworlds Territory, Three Ellas
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Tapani Empire, League of Tapani Freeworlds, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Pernella.lead: Pernella was a planet in the Pernella system in Tapani sector. It was one of the Freeworlds. It was also one of the Three Ellas, with a liberal government looser about crime and smuggling than most Tapani worlds.

Pesitiin.title: Pesitiin
Pesitiin.lead: Pesitiin was an Expansion Region gas giant in the Pesitiin system with perpetual atmospheric storms. Several years before 400 BBY its upper atmosphere housed a Bosken & Bosken mining center which attempted to harvest the planet's gases for profit, but it proved to be an unsustainable business due to the high cost of maintaining a floating mining center, leading to the abandonment of the outpost less then a decade after it was built.

Permeles.title: Permeles
Permeles.lead: Permeles was a planet in the Essesia system.

Perithal VI.title: Perithal VI
Perithal VI.lead: Perithal VI was a planet in the Perithal system of the Inner Rim. It was the location of a branch campus of the Institute of Starship Engineers.

Pernam Minor.title: Pernam Minor
Pernam Minor.lead: Pernam Minor was a planet in the Pernam Minor system.

Pesfavri.title: Pesfavri/Legends
Pesfavri.lead: Pesfavri was an Unknown Regions planet located in Chiss Space. A colony of the Chiss species, it housed a base of the Defense Fleet of the Chiss Ascendancy. As Defense Fleet Admiral Ar'alani was escorting the detained Chiss Force Commander Mitth'raw'nuruodo off the Galactic Republic exploration and colonization vessel Outbound Flight after it had been crippled by Mitth'raw'nuruodo's forces in 27 BBY, the trader Jorj Car'das and Syndic Mitth'ras'safis of the Chiss Eighth Ruling Family informed the admiral of their intent to remain aboard the ship.

Petrakis.title: Petrakis
Petrakis.lead: Petrakis was the site of the first engagement between Rebel Alliance B-wing starfighters and Imperial forces. During an attack on an Imperial convoy that carried a squadron of Fighters, the escorting TIEs were so panicked when they first encountered the attacking B-Wings that they left formation and fled. So the rebel starfighters managed to destroy the whole convoy consisting of several Freighters, Transports and Shuttlecraft despite the arrival of imperial reinforcements, a full wing of assault gunboats.

Phaseera.title: Phaseera
Phaseera.lead: Phaseera was a manufacturing planet that was the location of a battle near the end of the New Sith Wars. It had been occupied by the Galactic Republic before the conflict, but after the Republic defeat, it became Sith occupied. Its terrain included jungles, valleys, and plateaus. It orbited a yellow sun, and cydera trees grew on it.

Perilious.title: Perilious
Perilious.lead: Perilious was a planet that was located within the Outer Rim Territories of the galaxy. It was home to a large criminal element, which including a large slaving ring that dealt in Twi'leks. The world was continually covered by storms.

Pesmenben IV.title: Pesmenben IV
Pesmenben IV.lead: Pesmenben IV was an Imperial planet in the Mid Rim's Teraab sector that had ore deposits and dunes. At one point by 0 BBY, the businessman Lando Calrissian duped the planet's Imperial governor into leasing it by pulling a scam involving lithium.

Perma.title: Perma
Perma.lead: Perma was a planet in the galaxy's Core Worlds.

Persoro.title: Persoro
Persoro.lead: Persoro was the first planet orbiting the star Utapau in the Utapau system. Located in the Tarabba sector of the Outer Rim Territories, it was a searing rock.

Persappa.title: Persappa
Persappa.lead: Persappa was a terrestrial planet located in the Persappa system of the Unknown Regions. It was a part of the Rakatan Archipelago, a fragmented group of unaligned planets settled by tribes of the Rakata species after the collapse of the Rakatan Infinite Empire around 25,200 BBY. Persappa featured bubbling brew pools on its surface.

Peroenia.title: Peroenia
Peroenia.lead: Peroenia was a planet in the Unknown Regions. It was the homeworld of the Peroenians.

Peshara.title: Peshara
Peshara.lead: Peshara was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Peshara system. It was situated in the Arrowhead region, a part of the Slice portion of the Core Worlds. In 4 BBY, agents of the Galactic Empire awakened the former Steel Hand of Palawa Arden Lyn from twenty-four-millennia-long stasis and debriefed her, with selections of the debriefing being filed by Grand Inquisitor Laddinare Torbin.

Perlemia.title: Perlemia
Perlemia.lead: Perlemia was an industrial world located in the Perlemia system of the Core Worlds. It was the site of famous orbital shipyards. Perlemia's starshipwrights constructed many of the scout ships used to chart the hyperlane that would become, upon the signing of the Corellian Treaty in 25,000 BBY, one of the two formal boundaries of the Slice region. The hyperlane would accordingly become known as the Perlemian Trade Route.

Perin.title: Perin
Perin.lead: Perin was a Trianii colony planet in Trianii Space.

Pho Ph'eah.title: Pho Ph'eah/Legends

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, New Territories, Trans-Hydian
facts.affiliation: Infinite Empire, Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire

Pho Ph'eah.lead: Pho Ph'eah was a mountainous world in the Outer Rim Territories, that served as the homeworld for the four-armed Pho Ph'eahian species. Located far from its star, Pho Ph'eah relied on its heavy natural geothermal activity to provide heat to its native lifeforms. Pho Ph'eahians were naturally adept with technology, and turned Pho Ph'eah into a hub of technological development in the years after contact with the Galactic Republic.

Phindar.title: Phindar/Legends

facts.population: 95% Phindian, 3% Human, 2% other, 100 million to 500 million (c. 25 ABY)
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders, Darth Revan's Sith Empire, Brotherhood of Darkness, Galactic Empire, Zsinj's Empire, New Republic …

Phindar.lead: Phindar was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories, near the Mandalore sector. It was controlled by a criminal organization, the Syndicat, until 44 BBY, when it was overthrown by the Jedi Knights Qui-Gon Jinn and Obi-Wan Kenobi. The Phindians then elected a Governor. The planet was orbited by Phindar Station, which was twice attacked by the Confederacy of Independent Systems in 20 BBY, during the Clone Wars.

Phlors Rex.title: Phlors Rex
Phlors Rex.lead: Phlors Rex was a gas giant in the Axum system. It was orbited by 18 moons.

Phlors Regina.title: Phlors Regina
Phlors Regina.lead: Phlors Regina was a gas giant planet located within the Azure sector of the galaxy's Core Worlds. Phlors Regina held the seventh position in the Axum system, orbiting the star Solis Axum. It itself was host to fifteen moons.

Phiris.title: Phiris
Phiris.lead: Phiris was a planet located in the Empress Teta system. It had two moons.

Phoros.title: Phoros
Phoros.lead: Phoros was a planet in the Empress Teta system with one moon.

Phorliss.title: Phorliss
Phorliss.lead: Phorliss was a planet in the Dolomar sector of the Core Worlds that could support almost any kind of life.

Phraetiss.title: Phraetiss
Phraetiss.lead: Phraetiss was a planet in the Farrfin sector of the Galactic Core with thick and very tall grasslands.

Phracas.title: Phracas
Phracas.lead: Phracas was a planet located in sector 151 of the Core Worlds.

Phoebus.title: Phoebus
Phoebus.lead: Phoebus was an Outer Rim planet near Elerion.

Phemis.title: Phemis

facts.terrain: Cliffs, Canyons, Mountain ranges, Rock formations
facts.government: None (corporate interests operate under remote government from their native worlds)

Phemis.lead: Phemis was a backwater planet in the Core Worlds region of the galaxy, within the Corellian sector. Phemis was the only planet where rubat crystals, a type of kyber crystal, could be found. The crystal was historically used by the Jedi Order to craft lightsabers during the Old Republic. Phemis was only sparsely inhabited, due to its harsh terrain. Overall, the planet only had a population of approximately ten thousand, largely made up of mining settlements and a military garrison.

Phaylenn.title: Phaylenn
Phaylenn.lead: Phaylenn was an Imperial planet near Bespin and Ahlenn.

Pheon.title: Pheon
Pheon.lead: Pheon was the outermost planet in the Vaxal system. It was a barren rock with two moons.

Phateem.title: Phateem/Legends
Phateem.lead: Phateem was an Inner Rim planet which housed a Jedi library and storehouse known as the Halls of Knowledge, within the planet's Ashlendu Mountains.

Phatrong.title: Phatrong/Legends
Phatrong.lead: Phatrong was the homeworld of the Kyuzo species.

Phorose.title: Phorose

facts.terrain: Ancient temples, Deserts, Mountains, Underground tunnels

Phorose.lead: Phorose was a planet located in the Colonies.

Phibia.title: Phibia
Phibia.lead: Phibia was a celestial body situated in the Phibia system of the Haserian sector, a part of the Slice portion of the Mid Rim. It was the origin point of the Phibian beer beverage. At one point, the starliner Pendrake's Horizons was captured by Thalassian enslavers off Phibia. The starship was subsequently infiltrated by the Corellian Security Force agent Bey, who ultimately liberated the vessel.

Phorsa Gedd.title: Phorsa Gedd
Phorsa Gedd.lead: Phorsa Gedd was a Mid Rim Territories planet that had factory-deserts. The Imperial soldier Vryant served in the planet's trenches for two years, and the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry also fought on Phorsa Gedd as a part of the Alliance's campaign into the Mid Rim, which spanned nine months from around 1 ABY. The engineer Vifra also joined the 61st off of the world between 2 ABY and 3 ABY. Members of the company remembered and spoke about the battle in the time afterward.

Pheryon.title: Pheryon
Pheryon.lead: Pheryon was a gas giant located in the galaxy's Inner Rim. Poe Dameron traveled to Pheryon during the Cold War to meet with the journalist Suralinda Javos.

Philaxia.title: Philaxia/Legends
Philaxia.lead: Philaxia was a planet discovered by the Galactic Republic. Artificers on the planet created the phase-knife.

Phu.title: Phu/Legends
Phu.lead: Phu was a world inhabited by the Phuii species of aliens. It was located in the Colonies, near the Aur system. Phu was a planet famous for its gambling industry.

Pii III.title: Pii III
Pii III.lead: Pii III was a planet famous for the luxury greel wood that grew there. It was located in the Pii system inside the Arkanis sector of the galaxy. It was one of "Teeda's Eyes." It averaged 105 centimeters of precipitation annually.

Pii IV.title: Pii IV

facts.routes: Corellian Run (—by 4000 BBY), Old Corellian Run, Trans Gulf Route

Pii IV.lead: Pii IV, also named Pii 4 or Pii4, was a logging world located in the Pii system in the Arkanis sector of the galaxy. It was one of "Teeda's Eyes."

Picutorion.title: Picutorion/Legends
Picutorion.lead: Picutorion was a planet which rebelled against the Galactic Empire during the Kwymar Suppressions.

Pinoora.title: Pinoora
Pinoora.lead: Pinoora was a planet located into the Pinoora system of the Gordian Reach sector between Torque and Selitan. It was located at the junction of the Pinooran Spur and the Junction-Tierell Loop just north of the Denarii Nebula. It served as one of the most strategic trade worlds in the Gordian Reach and was known as an active entertainment hub for spacers between hyperspace jumps.

Pii I.title: Pii system's first planet
