facts.routes: Corellian Run (—by 4000 BBY), Old Corellian Run, Trans Gulf Route

Pii I.lead: The Pii system's first planet was a fiery ball of rock that orbited the Pii sun. The hot planet was located in the Arkanis sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The planet was a seven-day hyperspace journey away from the Perlemian Trade Route, like the rest of the Pii system, and along the Old Corellian Run and the Trans Gulf Route hyperlanes.

Pii II.title: Pii II

facts.routes: Corellian Run (—by 4000 BBY), Old Corellian Run, Trans Gulf Route

Pii II.lead: Pii II was a planet in the Pii system. A fiery ball of rock, the planet was the second to orbit the Pii sun. Pii II, along with the rest of the Pii system, was located in the Arkanis sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Sometime between 1 ABY and 3 ABY, a battle between the Rebel Alliance's Red Squadron and Imperial Assault Gunboats occurred near Pii II.

Pii V.title: Pii system's fifth planet

facts.routes: Corellian Run (—by 4000 BBY), Old Corellian Run, Trans Gulf Route

Pii V.lead: The fifth planet of the Pii system was a barren terrestrial planet of no interest. The planet was located in the Arkanis sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the fifth planet to orbit the Pii sun. Like the rest of the Pii system, the planet was a seven-day hyperspace journey away from the Perlemian Trade Route and lay along the Old Corellian Run and the Trans Gulf Route hyperlanes.

Pii VII.title: Pii system's seventh planet

facts.routes: Corellian Run (—by 4000 BBY), Old Corellian Run, Trans Gulf Route

Pii VII.lead: The Pii system's seventh planet was a frozen ball of ice that orbited the Pii sun. The cold planet was located in the Arkanis sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. Like the rest of the Pii system, it was a seven-day hyperspace journey away from the Perlemian Trade Route and lay along the Old Corellian Run and the Trans Gulf Route hyperlanes.

Pii VI.title: Pii system's sixth planet

facts.routes: Corellian Run (—by 4000 BBY), Old Corellian Run, Trans Gulf Route

Pii VI.lead: The sixth planet of the Pii system was the system's only gas giant and it orbited the Pii sun. The planet was located in the Arkanis sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. Like the rest of the Pii system, the planet was a seven-day hyperspace journey away from the Perlemian Trade Route and lay along the Old Corellian Run and the Trans Gulf Route hyperlanes.

First Pii asteroid belt.title: Pii system's first asteroid field

facts.routes: Corellian Run (—by 4000 BBY), Old Corellian Run, Trans Gulf Route

First Pii asteroid belt.lead: The Pii system's first asteroid field was located in the Arkanis sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The asteroid field orbited the Pii sun and lay between Pii II and Pii III, the system's second and third planets, respectively. It had poor mineral content, much like the system's second asteroid field. The inner asteroid field was extensive but smaller, more condensed, and less erratic than the second field.

Second Pii asteroid belt.title: Pii system's second asteroid field

facts.routes: Corellian Run (—by 4000 BBY), Old Corellian Run, Trans Gulf Route

Second Pii asteroid belt.lead: The Pii system's second asteroid field was located in the Arkanis sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The asteroid field orbited the Pii sun and lay between the system's fifth and sixth planets, respectively. It had poor mineral content, much like the system's first asteroid field. The outer asteroid field was larger, further spread-out, and more erratic than the first field. Like the rest of the Pii system, it lay a seven-day hyperspace journey away from the Perlemian Trade Route and along the Old Corellian Run and the Trans Gulf Route hyperlanes.

Pil Diller.title: Pil Diller
Pil Diller.lead: Pil Diller was a forested planet in the Quelii sector of the Outer Rim. According to records, this planet was once home to the extinct singing fig trees.

Pickerin.title: Pickerin
Pickerin.lead: Pickerin was a planet under the control of the Galactic Empire. In 0 ABY, Pickerin was visited by the Hand of Judgment stormtrooper team after hearing word that the government there had enslaved local artisans.

Pindra asteroid field.title: Pindra system asteroids
Pindra asteroid field.lead: A group of tumbling asteroids was situated in the Pindra system, a part of the Slice portion of the Inner Rim. In 5 ABY, as part of the Galactic Civil War, the New Republic navy officer Willham Burke prepared a trap for the fleet of Admiral Ledre Okins of the Galactic Empire. Burke had a grav trap laid among the asteroids of the Pindra system and tricked Okins into diverting key units of his fleet there. The Imperial forces were ensnared, and Burke went on to defeat Okins in the Colla system.

Pii.title: Pii
Pii.lead: Pii was a planet in the Pii system, located near the Gulf of Tatooine. It was the location of the Galactic Empire's Imperial marshaling station Pii. Fourteen years before the Battle of Yavin, an Imperial convoy planned to travel there from Desolation Station, via a moon coreward of the Gulf of Tatooine, and then jump to Sentinel Base and Geonosis. These plans were interrupted, however, when the convoy was attacked by a rebel cell run by former Republic Intelligence Captain Berch Teller.

Pipada.title: Pipada

facts.affiliation: Galactic Empire (during occupation), A Drabatan movement

Pipada.lead: Pipada was a humid planet in the Pipada system of the Videnda sector, located in the Outer Rim Territories and the Western Reaches. It was home to the amphibious Drabatan species. Pipada evaded conflict during the Clone Wars; however, when the Galactic Republic was reformed into the Galactic Empire, the Drabatans protested its rule of the galaxy. By 1 BBY, criticism of the Emperor went too far, and the Empire responded with a crackdown on Pipada.

Pion.title: Pion
Pion.lead: Pion was a planet located in the Pion system within Wild Space.

Pillio.title: Pillio
Pillio.lead: Pillio was a remote and uncolonized aquatic planet on the edge of the Jinata system in the Core Worlds that was home to more than 3 million species.

Pine.title: Pine
Pine.lead: The pine was a tree that could be found in the forests of the planets Chandrila and Shili. The trees had green needles and brown bark, and vines grew up their trunks. As an infant, Jedi Ahsoka Tano and her mother Pav-ti Tano traveled through a dense forest of pines that surrounded their village while hunting kybuck.

Platoril.title: Platoril

facts.routes: Corellian Run, Coruscant–Dantooine hyperlane, Koros Trunk Line, Leisure Corridor, Martial Cross, Metellos Trade Route, Namadii Corridor, Perlemian Trade Route …

Platoril.lead: Platoril was a barren planet in the Coruscant system, the second planet from Coruscant Prime.

Piroket.title: Piroket/Legends

facts.routes: Trans Gulf Route, Triellus Trade Route

Piroket.lead: Piroket was a trading planet in the Arkanis sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Pitann.title: Pitann
Pitann.lead: Pitann was a desert planet in the Kathol Outback, two days travel from Dayark.

Pirin.title: Pirin
Pirin.lead: Pirin was a planet in Locris sector. It was the headquarters of Kontag.

Piton.title: Piton
Piton.lead: Piton was a terrestrial planet located in the Piton system of the Core Worlds. It was the homeworld of the sentient Piton species, which lived underground. Miro Daroon, who had become a member of the off-world Jedi Order at some point by approximately 53 BBY, was a Piton from the planet Piton.

Pirralor.title: Pirralor
Pirralor.lead: Pirralor was a planet located in the Pirralor system of the Juvex sector, in the Mid Rim of the galaxy. It was the homeworld of House Pilor, and its spaceports were thick with outsiders from the Ninth Quadrant and the Agarix sector. Imperial Captain Dor Reder hailed from Pirralor.

Pirol-5.title: Pirol-5
Pirol-5.lead: Pirol-5 was a factory-farm planet taken over by the Yevetha during the Great Purge. Nil Spaar himself led the assault from the Pride of Yevetha.

Pirdia.title: Pirdia
Pirdia.lead: Pirdia was the third planet orbiting the star Tyrius in the Tyrius system. Located in the Savareen sector of the Outer Rim Territories, it was a ringed gas giant with green-blue gases striping its surface.

Plavin 6.title: Plavin 6
Plavin 6.lead: Plavin 6 was a Colonies jungle world whose native inhabitants preferred to wear loose-fitting clothing. It was the homeworld of the Humans Nashiak Llalik and Saren Llalik. Nashiak eventually became a renowned engineer and built a large mansion on Plavin 6, where he stored two incomplete prototypes of the Sunder 9 power armor suit. At some point, a number of smugglers and thieves set up residence on the world in order to locate Nashiak.

Pitrillistia.title: Pitrillistia
Pitrillistia.lead: Pitrillistia was a remote terrestrial planet situated on the galactic periphery. It was a part of the Pitrillistia system, located in the Mieru'kar sector within the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories. Pitrillistia was the homeworld of the sentient, bipedal Pitrillistian species, members of which spoke a mostly musical language produced by their small wings.

Pirik.title: Pirik

facts.affiliation: Galactic Empire, Alliance to Restore the Republic

Pirik.lead: Pirik was a temperate planet that was located in the Pirik system, in the Divis Arm of the galaxy.

Plooma.title: Pits of Plooma/Legends
Plooma.lead: The Pits of Plooma was a deep space formation in the Outer Rim Territories near the Galactic Rim. Han Solo once went past there while delivering rock ivory to Grambo. The Pits were a subject of the Rakata Infinite Empire during their heyday.

Planet of the Red Nebula.title: Planet of the Red Nebula
Planet of the Red Nebula.lead: The Planet of the Red Nebula was the sole inhabited planet in the Red Nebula, located in Wild Space. It was bombarded with comets when the nebula was severed from the rest of the galaxy by an unknown cataclysm.

Pizkoss.title: Pizkoss
Pizkoss.lead: Pizkoss was a planet in the Core Worlds. Two months after Order 66, the Uhumele stopped there to get a new transponder, and Janks was taken into custody by stormtroopers.

Pismaria.title: Pismaria
Pismaria.lead: Pismaria was the sixth planet orbiting the star Stisste in the Saleucami system. Located in the Suolriep sector of the Outer Rim Territories, it was a gas giant.

Pizilis.title: Pizilis
Pizilis.lead: Pizilis was a gas giant–type planet. It was located within the Pizilis system of the Terr'skiar sector, a part of the Kashyyyk Region in the Slice portion of the Mid Rim. The Dauntless Run hyperlane connected the planet to the world of Rorgam while the hyperspace route known as the Nightroad linked Pizilis to the worlds of Mytaranor and Terr'skiar.

Pleida.title: Pleida
Pleida.lead: Pleida was a planet located in the Tovosh system of the Outer Rim Territories.

Pkihantri.title: Pkihantri
Pkihantri.lead: Pkihantri was a location in the Pkihantri system, a part of the Southern Core portion of the Core Worlds. During the Galactic Civil War, it was the site of a Rebel Alliance base. At one point, an Imperial Intelligence SB-20 Slicer Droid played a key role in retrieving information before the Galactic Empire attacked the base.

Pleem's Nexus.title: Pleem's Nexus
Pleem's Nexus.lead: Pleem's Nexus was a planet located in the Mezeg sector of the Mid Rim.

World.title: Planet
World.lead: A planet, commonly called a world, was a type of celestial body in orbit around one star or multiple. A system of planets orbiting a star could, under the correct conditions, be formed when drifting clouds of gas and dust beyond the star itself clumped together. Many scientists stated that a planet had to be large enough for its gravity to have 'cleared its orbit' by attracting all the smaller bodies in its immediate neighborhood, excluding its own satellites, known as moons.

Polis Massa.title: Polis Massa/Legends

facts.population: Less than 1 million: (25 ABY), 99% Kallidahin, 1% other

Polis Massa.lead: Polis Massa was once an arid but habitable planet in the Subterrel sector of the Outer Rim Territories; and the homeworld of the little-known Eellayin species. Polis Massa was later struck by a mysterious cataclysm. This natural disaster destroyed the planet and formed a field of asteroids. The largest fragment of the planet remained known as Polis Massa and was colonized by the Kallidahin who dedicated their entire species to excavate the remains of the now-vanished Eellayin civilization.

Ploo IV.title: Ploo IV/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Zsinj's Empire, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Ploo IV.lead: Ploo IV was a planet in the Ploo sector of the Expansion Region.

Polmanar.title: Polmanar/Legends

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Greater Javin, Western Reaches
facts.affiliation: Galactic Empire, Alliance to Restore the Republic

Polmanar.lead: Polmanar was a textile-manufacturing world located in the Anoat sector of the Greater Javin region. In addition to textiles, farmers on-planet grew reedug narcotic among Polmanar's warm hills.

Poderis.title: Poderis

facts.affiliation: Galactic Empire, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Poderis.lead: Poderis was a planet in the Orus sector of the Inner Rim.

Pochi.title: Pochi

facts.terrain: Caves, Endless dry plains, Low mountain ranges, Small forests

Pochi.lead: Pochi was a planet located in the Faarlsun system, a part of Wild Space's Parthovian Cluster. It was an arid yet habitable world, the surface of which featured endless plains, covered in low grasses and small trees, and low mountain ranges.

Pollillus.title: Pollillus/Legends
Pollillus.lead: Pollillus was a Core Worlds planet. It was the homeworld of the two-headed sentient Troigs, including the famous sportscaster Fodesinbeed Annodue. By 32 BBY, the planet had only recently been discovered by the galactic community. A decade later, HoloNet News reported on the efforts of one of the heads of the Pollillus Troig Dwuirsintabb to become surgically separated from the other head.

Polith Belt.title: Polith Belt
Polith Belt.lead: The Polith Belt was an asteroid belt orbiting the star Polith in the Polith system. Located between the planets Loxizhra and Thyferra, it held the third orbital position.

Poison Moon.title: Poison Moon/Legends
Poison Moon.lead: The Poison Moon was an asteroid in the Hoth system. Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi encountered the Dark Jedi Alysun Celz here.

Polana.title: Polana
Polana.lead: Polana was the third planet in the Aramand system. It was a gas giant. Its nine moons supported Aramandi colonies.

Pocia.title: Pocia
Pocia.lead: Pocia was a planet in the Essesia system. It was a gas giant with 19 moons.

Plooriod III.title: Plooriod III
Plooriod III.lead: Plooriod III, the third planet of the Plooriod system, was an agricultural territory of the Expansion Region. Plooriod III had a vast ocean with small spire-like islands dotting the surface.

Pluthan asteroid field.title: Pluthan asteroid belt
Pluthan asteroid field.lead: The Pluthan asteroid belt was an asteroid belt located in Wild Space of the galaxy.

Plooriod IV.title: Plooriod IV
Plooriod IV.lead: Plooriod IV, the fourth planet of the Plooriod system, was an agricultural territory of the Expansion Region of the galaxy.

Plesstil.title: Plesstil
Plesstil.lead: Plesstil was an astronomical object located in the Plesstil system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Veragi sector. A hyperlane linked Plesstil to the Veragi system as well as the northern reaches of the galaxy.

Polixi.title: Polixi
Polixi.lead: Polixi was the first planet orbiting the star Polith in the Polith system. Located in the Jaso sector of the Inner Rim Territories, it was a barren rock.

Plexis.title: Plexis/Legends
Plexis.lead: Plexis was an astronomical object located in the Plexis system, a part of the Southern Core portion of the Core Worlds. The home offices of House Neuvalis, a chapter house of the Bounty Hunters' Guild, were located on Plexis, leading to the celestial body being considered the homeworld of the house. Plexis was listed as the Neuvalis headquarters in an entry for the house included in the Bounty Hunters Guild Handbook.

Poln Major.title: Poln Major
Poln Major.lead: Poln Major was a planet located in the Poln system, of the Outer Rim Candoras sector. Poln Major was the seat of government in the area.

Ploo II.title: Ploo II/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Zsinj's Empire, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Ploo II.lead: Ploo II was a planet in the Ploo sector of the Expansion Region.

Plintep.title: Plintep (disambiguation)
Plintep.lead: Plintep may refer to one of the following:

Ploo.title: Ploo system
Ploo.lead: The Ploo system was a star system located in the Ploo sector of the Expansion Region. It was located in grid square N-7 on the Standard Galactic Grid and contained the astronomical objects Ploo II and Ploo IV.

Polneye.title: Polneye

facts.affiliation: Galactic Empire, Duskhan League, New Republic

Polneye.lead: Polneye was a planet in the Farlax sector of the Core Worlds. Polneye was established under the Galactic Empire as a Grannan colony. It was then taken over by the Yevetha during the Yevethan Purge in the Koornacht Cluster, and later admitted as an empty world to the New Republic as a memorial to the Yevethan atrocities.

Praadost II.title: Praadost II/Legends

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, New Territories, Trans-Hydian
facts.affiliation: Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Alliance to Restore the Republic

Praadost II.lead: Praadost II was a planet near the Kwymar sector.

Porus Vida.title: Porus Vida
Porus Vida.lead: Porus Vida was a planet located in the Inner Rim and famous for its beauty and its culture. Despite its reputation as a peaceful world of museums, Porus Vida saw conflict throughout its history, including several sieges during the Alsakan Conflicts, and was devastated by the United Warlord Fleets in 12 ABY.

Polos.title: Polos
Polos.lead: Polos was a terrestrial planet in the Deep Core's Beshqek system. It occupied the third orbital position around the star Beshqek and had one moon. Polos featured a rocky surface and a toxic environment.

Pomagra.title: Pomagra
Pomagra.lead: Pomagra was a planet in the Utos system.

Pozzi.title: Pozzi system/Legends
Pozzi.lead: The Pozzi system was a star system located in the Tapani sector's Mecetti Province, on the Leozi Route.

Pouffra.title: Pouffra (disambiguation)
Pouffra.lead: Pouffra may refer to one of the following:

Polus.title: Polus
Polus.lead: Polus was an ice world orbiting the binary star Avindia of the Avindia system in the Outer Rim Territories. A frigid, mountainous planet, it had a massive frozen ocean and blizzards as well as ice storms that would frequently scour the planet's surface. Its average day temperature was 50 degrees below freezing. Polus was the homeworld of the Pyn'gani, a near-Human species.

Port Haven.title: Port Haven/Legends
Port Haven.lead: Port Haven was the third of seven planets in the Whendyll system and was known as a place for smugglers and spacers to recuperate, relax and fix their ships. The planet was filled with thick jungles and azure oceans.

Poytta.title: Poytta
Poytta.lead: Poytta was a planet in Hutt Space along a small hyperspace route situated alongside the Shag Pabol; as such, it was used as a refueling stop by many slavers and smugglers who travelled along the bigger hyperlane. It also served as Tuga SalPivo's base of operations.

Port Evokk.title: Port Evokk
Port Evokk.lead: Port Evokk was the homeworld of con artist and gambler Tord Gamb. The locals of this planet would use ansmul-hide to make boots and jackets. The bounty hunter Sirenas Firil worked with a small guild out of Port Evokk.

Porchello.title: Porchello
Porchello.lead: Porchello was a planet in the Elbaran sector of the Mid Rim.

Polomie.title: Polomie
Polomie.lead: Polomie was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Polomie system, a part of the Mid Rim's Oriolan sector. During the Galactic Civil War, a Rebel Alliance stronghold was located on Polomie.

Poln Minor.title: Poln Minor
Poln Minor.lead: Poln Minor was a planet in the Poln system, of the Outer Rim Candoras sector. Although once a center of mining and manufacturing, by 0 ABY its roles had diminished in both capacities. Poln Minor was rich in natural resources, and had a deep network of underground caverns. AF-two-two-seven-five was an intersection located below Poln Minor's surface.

Port Jerrell.title: Port Jerrell
Port Jerrell.lead: Port Jerrell was a planet located in the Outer Rim Territories.

Povanaria.title: Povanaria
Povanaria.lead: Povanaria was a world located in the Povanaria system. It was situated in the Loop Worlds area of the Gordian Reach sector within the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The hyperlane known as the Junction-Tierell Loop connected it to the Bronsoon and Durgen's Star systems. Povanaria was a windswept world of low grasses and moss, and it was the homeworld of the Povanarian species, members of which had already traveled offworld centuries prior to 43 ABY.

Pommwomm homeworld.title: Pommwomm homeworld
Pommwomm homeworld.lead: The inner planet of the Sif'kric system was located in the Mezeg sector of the Mid Rim.

Portug.title: Portug
Portug.lead: Portug was a planet located in the Outer Rim region of the galaxy. The Tusken Raider KkH'Oar'Rrhr and his followers once visited this planet in search of his revered leader A'sharad Hett, after his exile from Tatooine.

Ponemah Terminal.title: Ponemah Terminal
Ponemah Terminal.lead: Ponemah Terminal, also known simply as Ponemah, was a remote desert planet located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories, near the planets Ogem and Jakku in the Mid Rim. It was located not too far from the edge of New Republic space, and so was postulated to be a good place to drop off Resistance-friendly passengers.

Pothor.title: Pothor

facts.affiliation: Galactic Empire, Alliance to Restore the Republic

Pothor.lead: Pothor was a planet in the Mid Rim Territories that the Rebel Alliance took over during its unsuccessful Mid Rim Offensive, later being set to evacuate when the Galactic Empire began pushing back in 2 ABY. By 4 ABY, the Imperial II-class Star Destroyer Overseer had won distinction at Pothor.

Prakith.title: Prakith/Legends

facts.affiliation: Sith Empire, Galactic Empire, Constitutional Protectorate of Prakith, New Republic

Prakith.lead: Prakith was a mountainous fortress world located in the Prakith system of the Deep Core that, thanks to its unstable terrain and its isolation, was a difficult location to conquer by force. The planet was a powerful Fifth Army fortress world during the Galactic Civil War and later the personal empire of Moff Foga Brill.

Pria.title: Pria/Legends

facts.terrain: Polar ice caps, Oceans, Atolls, Tidal flats

Pria.lead: Pria was a Core Worlds planet that was the homeworld of the sentient Priapulin species. A tectonically active waterworld, it featured oceans and polar ice caps, with the majority of the Priapulin population living in atolls and tidal flats. Pria had a single moon, and its tidal cycles equalled almost exactly ten standard hours, giving rise to the Priapulins using tidal hours as a unit of time.

Procopia.title: Procopia/Legends
Procopia.lead: Procopia was a planet located in the Tapani sector, on the Procopian Shipping Lane. It was one of the wealthiest worlds in the Tapani sector. It was the sector capital since Shey Tapani united the Tapani sector, and remained the capital when the sector joined the Galactic Republic.

Prefsbelt IV.title: Prefsbelt IV/Legends
Prefsbelt IV.lead: Prefsbelt IV, also referred to as simply Prefsbelt, was a green planet in the Prefsbelt system, a star system in the Prefsbelt sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was notably the site of the ancient Republic—and later Imperial—Naval Academy.

Prazhi.title: Prazhi
Prazhi.lead: Prazhi was an Expansion Region planet located in the Cyrillian Protectorate. It was the homeworld of the Zexx species. A member of the galactic community since at least 5000 BBY, a millennium later Prazhi was situated on an important hyperspace trade route. By the time of the Galactic Empire's reign, Prazhi had become a trade world the economy of which was revitalized by Imperial efforts to resettle the Expansion Region.

Prishardia.title: Prishardia
Prishardia.lead: Prishardia was a backwater agriworld that was located on the Outer Rim Territories of the galaxy near Chad.

Prildaz.title: Prildaz
Prildaz.lead: Prildaz was the Yevethan name of the third planet in the ILC-905 system in the Farlax sector in the Galactic Core. It was a barren dustball orbited by the Imperial shipyard Black Nine. The New Republic defeated the Yevethan defense of Black Nine.

Prakess.title: Prakess
Prakess.lead: Prakess was a tiny terrestrial planet in the Prakith system, located in the Deep Core's Sector 5. It occupied the fifth orbital position around the star Prak and had two moons. Prakess featured a frozen environment and a rocky surface.

Prishella III.title: Prishella III
Prishella III.lead: Prishella III was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Kessel sector. It hosted several garrisons of the Galactic Empire. During the Galactic Civil War, a Rebel Alliance Special Forces team was air-dropped on Prishella III, where it kidnapped Imperial General Evar Orllincus during his inspection tour of the garrisons.

Praven Prime.title: Praven Prime
Praven Prime.lead: Praven Prime was an Outer Rim Territories world in the Quelii sector that was home to the L'Xing species. By 3951 BBY, it was a part of the Galactic Republic as well as situated in space controlled by the Gu-vandi species. However, an intentional mistranslation of a L'Xing language phrase by an HK-50 series assassin droid masquerading as a translator droid led to a civil war between the L'Xing and the Gu-vandi Collective. The conflict eventually resulted in the Republic withdrawing from both Praven Prime and Gu-vandi space.

Praidaw.title: Praidaw
Praidaw.lead: Praidaw was the planet where the Fallanassi parents of Akanah first met.

Protazk.title: Protazk
Protazk.lead: Protazk was a terrestrial world located in the Protazk system, a part of the Kwymar sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the site of Spuma Flats, a region that shared its name with the Seswenna sector planet Spuma. The terrain there included a flat, dusty plain on which laser emplacement towers and trenches were at one point established.

Pral.title: Pral
Pral.lead: Pral was a planet in the Jahilid Drift that was conquered by the Imperial forces under the command of General Bentilais san Sk'ar.

Presbalin.title: Presbalin
Presbalin.lead: Presbalin was a planet located in the Presbalin system. It was situated in the Loop Worlds area of the Gordian Reach sector within the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The hyperlane known as the Junction-Tierell Loop connected it to the Near Indosa system as well as the Tierell system of the Thesme sector.

Prelly.title: Prelly
Prelly.lead: Prelly was the first planet orbiting the star Iminec in the Kalee system. Located in Wild Space, it was a molten rock.

Prekaz.title: Prekaz (disambiguation)
Prekaz.lead: Prekaz may refer to one of the following:

Prexiar.title: Prexiar
Prexiar.lead: Prexiar was a planet located in the Steniplis sector of the Outer Rim Territories. The planet had great freshwater seas and vast jungles. The Pirates of Prexiar operated an outpost there.

Prospera Jang.title: Prospera Jang
Prospera Jang.lead: Prospera Jang was a celestial body located in the Prospera Jang system, a part of the Kurost sector in the Slice portion of the Mid Rim. At some point between 39 BBY and 34 BBY, Corporate Alliance forces under the command of the Harch military leader Trench captured the Kurosti merchant fleet during a daring raid at Prospera Jang.

Praya.title: Praya
Praya.lead: Praya was an ocean planet located in the Praya system, within the Clacis sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. By the year 4.3 ABY, it was home to the luxurious Sea Castle Resort Hotel. The Star Tours travel agency facilitated transit to Praya through their Deluxe Undersea Package.

Protobranch.title: Protobranch/Legends
Protobranch.lead: Protobranch was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Protobranch system of the Core Worlds. It was the homeworld of the Bivall Galactic Republic scientist Doctor Sionver Boll.

Pzob.title: Pzob/Legends
Pzob.lead: Pzob was a planet in the Herios sector of the Outer Rim Territories, settled by Gamorreans from the world of Gamorr a long period of time prior to the Battle of Yavin. The settlers, organized into various clans, constantly waged war on each other. All other concerns were secondary to the fighting, and as a result Pzob's inhabitants had a nearly non-existent relationship with advanced technology. The planet was covered in dark, dense forests with tall trees, an environment that greatly appealed to the colonists.

Pursin.title: Pursin
Pursin.lead: Pursin was a planet home to the Pursian species, that was constantly at war with Yugami and its inhabitants.

Pypin.title: Pypin
Pypin.lead: Pypin was one of the Trianii colony worlds within the disputed border of the Corporate Sector.

Pyr.title: Pyr
Pyr.lead: Pyr was one of the planets of the Pyrshak system, which contained Manaan, and was located on the Inner Rim of the galaxy.

Pyria VI.title: Pyria VI
Pyria VI.lead: Pyria VI, also called Pyria Six, was the sixth planet in the Pyria system.

Proxima Dibal.title: Proxima Dibal
Proxima Dibal.lead: Proxima Dibal was the primary star of the Proxima Dibal system, orbited by a planet of the same name.

Purnham.title: Purnham
Purnham.lead: Purnham was a planet that was the target of attacks by BloodScar. It was located in the Purnham system and along the Purnham Run.

Q'Maere.title: Q'Maere
Q'Maere.lead: Q'Maere was a planet located within the Kathol Rift. The planet had a deadly, poisonous atmosphere, full of chlorine, and the sky was a sickly green. The majority of the surface was a caustic ammonia ocean interspersed with volcanic salt-caked islands. The planet was the location of the Q'Maere Research Facility.

Pybus.title: Pybus
Pybus.lead: Pybus was a planet located in the Bootana Hutta region of Hutt Space.

Pujool.title: Pujool/Legends
Pujool.lead: Pujool was a gas giant in the Anoat sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Purnell.title: Purnell
Purnell.lead: Purnell was a gas giant in the Dantooine system, located in the Raioballo sector of the Outer Rim.

Proxida.title: Proxida
Proxida.lead: Proxida was the second planet orbiting the star Julevia in the Julevian system. Located in the Dalonbian sector of the Outer Rim Territories, it was a volcanic rock.

Puloorn.title: Puloorn
Puloorn.lead: Puloorn was a snow-covered planet located in the Outer Rim Territories's Spinward sector. It was the site of an ancient, ruined Sith temple that was inhabited both by creatures twisted by the dark side of the Force and by a group of cultists. At some point, the Galactic Republic's Supreme Chancellor Palpatine dispatched a team of agents on a mission to investigate the rumored existence of Puloorn's temple.

Pzandias.title: Pzandias/Legends
Pzandias.lead: Pzandias was a planet. During the Clone Wars, the Confederacy of Independent Systems established a training facility on the world.

Pyjridj.title: Pyjridj
Pyjridj.lead: Pyjridj was a planet where a pickpocket once told Lando Calrissian that four out of every five belt pouches he stole contained passcodes, and it typically took less than a minute to find them.

Pyros.title: Pyros
Pyros.lead: Pyros, originally known as Ord Pyros, was a planet located in the Colonies.

Pygorix.title: Pygorix
Pygorix.lead: Pygorix was a world located in the Pygorix system. It was situated in the Back Reach area of the Gordian Reach sector within the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The hyperlane known as the Ardan Cross connected it to the Feldwes system as well as the Spintir system of the Spadja sector. A smaller hyperspace route linked Pygorix to the Karsten's World system.

Protogeyser.title: Protogeyser
Protogeyser.lead: Protogeyser was an astronomical object located in the Inner Rim's Protogeyser system. Known to the wider galaxy by the Ruusan Reformation of 1000 BBY, the fractal urchins, a non-sentient species that lacked cellular structures and thus midi-chlorians, life-forms that lived symbiotically inside cells and allowed their symbiont to detect the Force, originated from Protogeyser.

Pulassas Minor.title: Pulassas Minor
Pulassas Minor.lead: Pulassas Minor was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Pulassas Minor system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Koradin sector. At some point prior to the Battle of Yavin, a Galactic Empire TIE fighter squadron was ordered to bombard civilian targets on Pulassas Minor. Horrified by the order, the squadron's pilot Nozzo Naytaan deserted from the Imperial Military, going on to join the Empire's enemy in the Galactic Civil War, the Rebel Alliance.

Purala IV.title: Purala IV
Purala IV.lead: Purala IV was an astronomical object located in the Purala system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Kibilini sector. At some point by 27 BBY, the Lords of Purala IV requested that the Kaminoan cloners of the planet Kamino create Human clones who would serve the Puralan nobles as members of infiltration squads. In 27 BBY, the Kaminoan geneticist Hali Ke noted the request of the Lords of Purala IV in an internal memorandum.

Qiilura.title: Qiilura/Legends

facts.terrain: Deciduous forests, Fields, Islands, Lakes, Plains, Rivers
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Qiilura.lead: Qiilura was a temperate planet in the Mid Rim, 40 light-years away from Ord Mantell. It was the home world of the Gurlanins—a race of shapeshifting intelligent predators, but by the time of the Clone Wars, Human colonization had been well established, with a population of two hundred thousand farmers. The economy of the planet mostly revolved around agriculture, specifically the production of barq, kushayan, and other luxury foodstuffs, merlie meat was a known export and source of income and food for the farmers of this planet.

Qat Chrystac.title: Qat Chrystac/Legends

facts.terrain: Radioactive lava seas, Volcanic glass plateaus
facts.population: 2,000 New Republic troops, Approximately 1,500 Imperial Radtroopers

Qat Chrystac.lead: Qat Chrystac was a volatile, radioactive, and volcanic world that was a point of contention between Rebel (later New Republic) and Imperial forces for over ten years.

Quadrant Seven.title: Quadrant Seven
Quadrant Seven.lead: Quadrant Seven was a planet which was not part of the Galactic Republic. The planet's last war took place in about 612 BBY. It was a rocky world with canyons, caves, and hills.

Qalita Prime.title: Qalita Prime
Qalita Prime.lead: Qalita Prime was a planet located in the Inner Rim that was represented in the New Republic Senate. The Right Earl was the leader of this planet.

Qretu 5.title: Qretu 5
Qretu 5.lead: Qretu 5 was a bacta refinement planet in the Inner Rim's Qretu system, loyal to Ysanne Isard during the Bacta War.

Qalydon.title: Qalydon/Legends
Qalydon.lead: Qalydon was a planet located in the Qalydon system of the Outer Rim's Sertar sector. The planet served as the headquarters of the Fellowship of Kooroo.

Quas Killam.title: Quas Killam

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems

Quas Killam.lead: Quas Killam was a planet on the edge of the Mid Rim. Its people were the Killam. Quas Killam was a world of weapons manufacturing factories and trinium mines, and so was conquered by the Trade Federation early in the Clone Wars. Throughout the war the planet changed sides several times.

Quaensan Prime.title: Quaensan Prime
Quaensan Prime.lead: Quaensan Prime was a Gendius sector, Mid Rim world on the Cerean Reach, near the Jiroch system. Its inhabitants were wiped out by the Reslian Purge, similar to what happened to the Tunroth.

Qasqi.title: Qasqi

facts.routes: Perlemian Trade Route, Triellus Trade Route

Qasqi.lead: Qasqi was the fifth planet in the Centares system. Due to the fact that it was next to Centares, it absorbed most, if not all asteroids that strayed near Centares.

Qoribu.title: Qoribu
Qoribu.lead: Qoribu was a ringed gas giant in the Gyuel system with 55 moons, including Jwlio, Eyyl, Zvbo, Ruu, Nrogu, and Kr.

Quanton.title: Quanton
Quanton.lead: Quanton was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Quanton system, a part of the Obtrexta sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories. During the Galactic Civil War, Rebel Alliance General Airen Cracken was captured by the Imperial Security Bureau of the Galactic Empire on Quanton. Cracken was subsequently subjected to the truth serum Bavo Six and later mentioned both his capture and his experience with Bavo Six in the Cracken's Rebel Field Guide, a datafile he had composed that documented various pieces of equipment utilized by Rebel Alliance agents.

Qlothos.title: Qlothos
Qlothos.lead: Qlothos was an Inner Rim planet with a cloudy atmosphere. By 3 ABY, the Imperial II-class Star Destroyer Interrogator detected unusual transmissions from the nearby Qlothos that resembled those made by the Rebel Alliance. Acting on the suspicion that the signals indicated the presence of a Rebel garrison, Senior Lieutenant Leeds ordered a TIE bomber strike on the planet. However, one of the bombers' missiles veered off target and destroyed a residential community, causing the deaths of nearly sixty Galactic Empire citizens, including a prominent Kuat Drive Yards engineer.

Qualtrough.title: Qualtrough
Qualtrough.lead: Qualtrough was a terrestrial planet located in the Qualtrough system of the Outer Rim Territories' Belsmuth sector. Its native population was at one point engaged in an intense worldwide civil war.

Q'mara.title: Q'mara
Q'mara.lead: Q'mara, located in the Q'mara system of the Juvex sector, was a desert planet with a number of shabby spaceports, where all manner of smugglers and thugs sought illicit employment. Juvex nobles frequented Q'mara's houses of ill repute; foolish ones were drawn into its subterranean gambling and spice dens, sometimes never to return. Qellrin was attacked by pirates near Q'mara.

Qogo.title: Qogo

facts.sector: Hapes Cluster, Hapan Rim Worlds, Transitory Mists

Qogo.lead: Qogo was an amber clouded gas giant and twin of Uluq in the Hapes Cluster and shared the same system as Shedu Maad in the Transitory Mists. Uroro Station was once built between Qogo and Uluq to serve as a transfer station for Hapan ships traveling along the Throat to the mining world of Shedu Maad.

Quatin.title: Quatin
Quatin.lead: Quatin was the fifth planet orbiting the star Bright Jewel in the Bright Jewel system. Located in the Bright Jewel sector of the Mid Rim, it was a gas giant.

Quay Lyn.title: Quay Lyn
Quay Lyn.lead: Quay Lyn was an asteroid belt between the planets Alcrue and Lyntra in the Sriluur system.

Qaras.title: Qaras
Qaras.lead: Qaras was the homeworld of the Jessar species as well as the Minyavish. In 44 ABY, the Minyavish were revolted against by the Jessar, led by Rokari Kem. The Minyavish were then forced to leave the planet. Qaras was then accepted into the Galactic Alliance, with Rokari Kem serving as the planet's Senator.

Quarzite.title: Quarzite/Legends
Quarzite.lead: Quarzite was a planet composed of crystalline caves and with a surface that was strained by strong atmospheric pressure, with the ability to crush starships and flatten beings. During the Clone Wars, the planet was ruled by the tyrannical Belugan Otua Blank, who was involved in a battle with the natives on the planet, the Kage Warriors.

Quanducial.title: Quanducial (disambiguation)
Quanducial.lead: Quanducial may refer to one of the following:

Quockra-4.title: Quockra-4
Quockra-4.lead: Quockra-4 was the fourth planet in the Quockra system, located in the remote Minos Cluster of the southern Outer Rim Territories., ==Description==, Quockra-4 was a desert world, flat without much differentiation of terrain. It never rained and there weren't any oceans, though there were several extremely large salt flats. It would become extremely hot during the midday hours, making it dangerous for unprotected Humans. At night the temperature was so cold that protective clothing was required.

Questal.title: Questal/Legends
Questal.lead: Questal was a planet in Questal sector, infamous during the Galactic Civil War as the stronghold of the sadistic Moff Bandor.

Queyta.title: Queyta

facts.affiliation: Techno Union, Confederacy of Independent Systems

Queyta.lead: Queyta was a planet in the Outer Rim's Danjar sector.

Quellor.title: Quellor/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Quellor.lead: Quellor was a planet in the Colonies region of the galaxy.

Ques.title: Ques/Legends
Ques.lead: Ques was a planet in the Ques system in Hutt Space.

Quenus.title: Quenus

facts.region: Core Worlds, Northern Dependencies, The Slice, Arrowhead

Quenus.lead: Quenus was the fourth planet of the Chandrila system, located in the Bormea sector of the Ringali Shell in the Core Worlds. A gas giant, the planet orbited the star Chandrila and was itself circled by three moons. The entirety of the Chandrila system lay on the Perlemian Trade Route, which served as a dividing line between the Northern Dependencies and the Arrowhead portion of the Slice.

Quiberon V.title: Quiberon V
Quiberon V.lead: Quiberon V was an Outer Rim Territories planet situated in the Quiberon sector. The company Gamorrean Interstellar held mining rights there, which it eventually agreed to sell to the bounty hunter Moxin Tark and his expeditor Minas Derel.

Quyste.title: Quyste
Quyste.lead: Qusyte was a planet in the Quyste system within the Thesme sector of the Outer Rim Territories on which Talon Karrde had a training center. The smuggler sent H'sishi there before 18 ABY to study starship operations.

Quian.title: Quian
Quian.lead: Quian was a terrestrial planet located in the Quian system of the Core Worlds. It was home to a Human population known as the Quians.

Quelii.title: Quelii
Quelii.lead: Quelii was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories, which maintained a population of Humans who lived in villages. Quelii was devastated by a Mandalorian attack in the years leading up to the Mandalorian Wars, although some natives managed to escape the onslaught and make it to Republic space. One of these refugees grew to become the infamous Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Malak, who led a Sith army against the Republic in the Jedi Civil War.

Quilken.title: Quilken/Legends
Quilken.lead: Quilken was a planet located within the Quilken system of the Outer Rim Territories. After Mungo Baobab, heir of the Baobab Merchant Fleet and Auren Yomm, a girl from the planet Roon got married, the couple settled on Quilken. They found new sources of roonstones on the planet and set up facilities to process it. The also opened the Club Baobab casino for visitors to the nearby Roon system. The security of the facilities was increased to guard the precious gems. Mungo was busy arranging roonstone shipments to planet Sim'char'ser and other Outer Rim worlds.

Quell.title: Quell/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Greater Maldrood, New Republic

Quell.lead: Quell was the principal planet of the Quell system in the Outer Rim. During the Clone Wars, a battle was fought between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems in the upper atmosphere of the planet.

Queel.title: Queel
Queel.lead: Queel was a swamp-covered Mid Rim planet. The planet was one of the many worlds to see action in the early months of the Clone Wars. In 22 BBY it was the site of a battle between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems. During the battle, Jedi General Anakin Skywalker, Jedi Commander Ahsoka Tano, and Clone Captain CT-7567 "Rex" received a new mission, and General Obi-Wan Kenobi continued the command of the engagement.

Quesaya.title: Quesaya (disambiguation)
Quesaya.lead: Quesaya could refer to one of the following:

Quesh.title: Quesh
Quesh.lead: Queshː (pronounciation: /'kwɛʃ/) was a world riddled with toxic waste within Hutt Space, due to a period of geological instability beginning around 53,600 BBY dubbed the Quake. It was discovered by the Galactic Republic during the Great War, but was at first promptly abandoned due to its poisonous atmosphere. To survive the atmosphere most sentients required a breath mask or protective injection, but the Hutts could breathe the toxic air without any difficulty. In addition to the toxicity, some of the planet's marshes were noted to be radioactive.

Quethold.title: Quethold

facts.language: Quesoth Common Speak, Quesoth Soldier Speak
facts.affiliation: Nuso Esva's realm, Empire of the Hand

Quethold.lead: Quethold was a terrestrial planet located in the Quethold system of the Unknown Regions. The planet, which contained several mines, was the homeworld of the insectoid Quesoth species, which spoke the Quesoth Common Speak and Soldier Speak languages. The Quesoth lived periodically in three cities: the Black City, the Red City, and the White City. The three settlements were ruled by three Queens of the Quesoth which changed and died once their rule had lasted for a number of years. The inhabitants of each city then would travel to the next one.

Qui-Gon Jinn's homeworld.title: Qui-Gon Jinn's homeworld
Qui-Gon Jinn's homeworld.lead: A terrestrial planet was the homeworld of Jedi Master Qui-Gon Jinn. Though he left the world as an infant to become a Jedi, he returned to visit it later in life. The planet had liquid surface water and an atmosphere that was suitable for Humans. A type of Force-sensitive stone, one of which Jinn obtained from the River of Light and kept as a memento, was found on the world.

Quooria.title: Quooria
Quooria.lead: Quooria was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Quooria system, a part of the Farstey sector in the Trans-Hydian portion of the Expansion Region. It was the homeworld of the Quoorian marshsucker, a species of creature similar to, but much more deadlier than mosquitos. In addition, creatures that were related to Quoorian marshsuckers eventually went extinct on Quooria and became preserved in the sap of the celestial body's trees.

Quila.title: Quila
Quila.lead: Quila was an aquatic planet located in the Rolion sector of the Outer Rim Territories that appeared blue from space. In 4 BBY, an Imperial freighter carrying Janard, a prisoner of the Empire and informant to the rebel Sabine Wren, crashed into Quila's oceans. Wren and her rebel allies Ahsoka Tano and Hera Syndulla tracked the freighter to Quila after Janard sent a distress call. While Syndulla piloted their ship, the Ghost, Wren and Tano donned SCUBA gear and ventured into the partially-submerged freighter to rescue Janard.

Quint.title: Quint Cresadde

facts.affiliation: Gwarm's gang, Ohnaka Gang, Hutt Clan

Quint.lead: Quint Cresadde was a Weequay gunslinger who lived during the Imperial Era. A former pirate member of the Ohnaka Gang and Gwarm's gang who later worked for the Hutt Clan, she eventually turned away from her lifestyle to become the sheriff of Wayfar on the planet Tatooine. She wielded a DL-18 blaster pistol.

Ragna III.title: Ragna III
Ragna III.lead: Ragna III was a forest planet in the Mid Rim, and the homeworld of the Yuzzem race.

Rafa IV.title: Rafa IV
Rafa IV.lead: Rafa IV was a temperate planet in the Rafa system of the Centrality, located in the Outer Rim Territories. It was a colony world of the Sharu species.

Rafa V.title: Rafa V
Rafa V.lead: Rafa V was the fifth planet of the Rafa system and the homeworld of the Sharu species.

Ragnar VIII.title: Ragnar VIII
Ragnar VIII.lead: Ragnar VIII was a remote astronomical object located in the Ragnar system, a part of the Merel sector in the Outer Rim Territories. The home offices of the Ragnar Syndicate, a chapter house of the Bounty Hunters' Guild, were located on Ragnar VIII, leading to the celestial body being considered the homeworld of the house. Ragnar VIII was listed as the Ragnar headquarters in an entry for the house included in the Bounty Hunters Guild Handbook.

Rabaan.title: Rabaan
Rabaan.lead: Rabaan was the fourth planet in the Ishanna system. It was settled by Corellians during the Subterra Period.

Ragoon VI.title: Ragoon VI
Ragoon VI.lead: Ragoon VI, or Ragoon-6, was a beautiful planet in the Core Worlds untouched by civilization and therefore pollution. Ragoon gave off a blue glow from space and was surrounded by several stars.

Raed-7.title: Raed-7
Raed-7.lead: Raed-7 was a planet in the Colonies that traded with its neighbor, Bellassa.

Radnor.title: Radnor/Legends

facts.region: Mid Rim, The Slice, Trailing Sectors

Radnor.lead: Radnor was a small, sea-covered planet with a small main landmass, and prevailing winds. It was located in the same system as Avon. Radnor had two capitals: the Twin Cities of Aubendo and Tacto. Each of the cities had their own governing ministers. Radnor was known for its research and development of high-tech weapons systems.

R'alla.title: R'alla
R'alla.lead: R'alla was a planet in the Corporate Sector, located on the Solenbaran Merchant Route between Bonadan and Kir. R'alla was home to many of the Corporate Sector Authority's top media companies, and its lush, green landscape had many farms and bubbling water springs. R'alla mineral water—which was found in underground caverns below a mountain town also called R'alla— was widely exported throughout the Corporate Sector and beyond, and was often smuggled to nearby, drought-ridden Rampa III.

Rago.title: Rago/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Alliance, Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire

Rago.lead: Rago was a planet located in Wild Space that anchored the Rago Run to the Unknown Regions. It was the closest Galactic Alliance planet to the Colony of the Killiks.

Rafa III.title: Rafa III
Rafa III.lead: Rafa III was a terrestrial planet located in the Rafa system, a part of the Centrality sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It occupied the third orbital position around the Rafa system's sun, and along with the rest of the Rafa was situated on the Arleen Loop hyperlane, which connected it to the Arleen and Dela systems.

Rafa XI.title: Rafa XI
Rafa XI.lead: Rafa XI was an icy slush planet that occupied the outermost orbit in the Outer Rim Territories' Rafa system. It was the site of a helium refinery and a research installation. In 3 BBY, after the freighter captain Lando Calrissian and his droid, Vuffi Raa, disarmed a team of Colonial Constabulary troopers who attempted to arrest the former on the planet Rafa V, the duo made the police officers board their own cargo barge, which was modified by Vuffi Raa to take them on a week-long trip to Rafa XI.

R-Duba.title: R-Duba
R-Duba.lead: R-Duba was a desert and ocean planet located in the R-Duba system, within the Quiberon sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. A minor trade world, it was located in a backwater province of the Galactic Empire.

Radix.title: Radix

facts.terrain: Mountains, Golden hills, Industrial, Red deserts

Radix.lead: Radix was a Mid Rim planet with a harsh climate. The surface consisted of a large desert with some smaller mountains. The surrounding space were full of ship-debris and other things that were pulled between the central worlds in the system. Even huge orbiting fabrics were commonly found circling the planet. A Imperial renegade faction was found on the planet. They were Eiattu pirates that had gone into hiding, after the defeat at Endor in 4 ABY. Lando Calrissian went on a Mission to Radix on the behalf of the New Republic.

Ragmar V.title: Ragmar V
Ragmar V.lead: Ragmar V was a barren, desert-coated world in the Outer Rim Territories. Its population center was an outpost of outcasts of various species, who were opposed to the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.

Rachuk.title: Rachuk
Rachuk.lead: Rachuk was a small planet in the Rachuk system, located in the Colonies region.

RZ7-6113-23.title: RZ7-6113-23
RZ7-6113-23.lead: RZ7-6113-23 was a rocky, volcanic class-6 planetoid that was devoid of life. It was located in the Chopani sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

R'terleD'er.title: R'terleD'er
R'terleD'er.lead: R'terleD'er was a world located in the Kriz sector of the Outer Rim Territories. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, hunters on R'terleD'er were known to pay Baragwins handsomely to track large game.

Radhii.title: Radhii
Radhii.lead: Radhii was a planet located in the Radhii system of Wild Space that was part of the Galactic Empire by the time of the Battle of Endor. In Tavuu the capital of the planet, the Segenka prison was located there. Also Tavuu was located on a large plateau, in the western part, which cut off into the jungle of Zoess. The deschene and ghoma were a clawed creatures native to the Zoess.

Ralltiir.title: Ralltiir/Legends

facts.region: Core Worlds, Ringali Shell, The Slice, Arrowhead
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Kalmec, Galactic Empire, Alliance to Restore the Republic, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire, Galactic Federation of Free Alliances …

Ralltiir.lead: Ralltiir was a planet in the Ralltiir system of the Darpa sector in the Core Worlds. The second planet in orbit of the star Rallt, Ralltiir had twenty-eight moons and three continents that wrapped around the planet. A major financial center in the galactic economy, Ralltiir was a member world of the Galactic Republic but remained largely neutral in galactic politics to ensure that the finances of its inhabitants remained safe from political influences and war.

Raisa.title: Raisa
Raisa.lead: Raisa was the first planet from the star Alderaan in the Alderaan system.

Raithal.title: Raithal/Legends

facts.terrain: Freezing Oceans, Ice Plains, Ice Mesas, Ice Canyons

Raithal.lead: Raithal was a planet in the Colonies, on the Perlemian Trade Route near the border with the Inner Rim.

Rakaa IV.title: Rakaa IV
Rakaa IV.lead: Rakaa IV was a planet occupying the fourth orbital position in the Rakaa system, on the edge of the Core Worlds. It was a warm world of jungle and forests, with surface water also being present. The planet's flora included the nargk root.

Rakrir.title: Rakrir
Rakrir.lead: Rakrir was the homeworld of the Rakririan species. A highly refined and meticulous species, few left their homeworld, finding the rest of the galaxy to be too unsophisticated. The planet was sometimes known as Ballikite.

Rake.title: Rake
Rake.lead: Rake was a tiny terrestrial planet in the Prakith system of the Deep Core's Sector 5. It occupied the first orbital position around the star Prak and had a barren rock surface.

Ralme IV.title: Ralme IV
Ralme IV.lead: Ralme IV was a planet in Brak sector's Ralme system. Ralme IV was the site of mining operation overseen by Lant Mining Corporation. Two of the miners were the parents of future Brak sector crimelord Qual'om Soach.

Rainboh.title: Rainboh
Rainboh.lead: Rainboh was a terrestrial planet located in the Rainboh system of the Inner Rim's Hapes Cluster. Positioned among the Hapan Rim Worlds, Rainboh could be reached from the Great Rim Route or the Rynmar Trail hyperlanes via the planet Rynmar itself.

Roon Comet.title: Rainbow comet

facts.sector: Abrion sector; The Cloak of the Sith

Roon Comet.lead: The rainbow comets of the Cloak of the Sith nebula were for centuries the only method for finding safe passage to the planet Roon. Annually, the comet would find its path through the hazardous spaceway on its way to briefly orbit the system's sun. It moved in a way that resembled a ricochet.

Rakata Prime.title: Rakata Prime
Rakata Prime.lead: Rakata Prime, also known as Rakata and Lehon, was the homeworld of the long-extinct Rakata species, who were rumored to be the first to develop hyperspace travel, and was one of the few navigable worlds located in the Unknown Regions. The planet was orbited by a refueling station. At some point, the Resistance pilot Venisa Doza visited Lehon along with her astromech droid, Torch. The Zabrak pirate Tryki was also once arrested for attempting to board a First Order cruiser near Rakata Prime.

Rampa II.title: Rampa II
Rampa II.lead: Rampa II, also known as Rampa, was an astronomical object in the Corporate Sector of the Outer Rim Territories, connected to Panna in the Cronese Mandate by the smugglers' hyperlane Bubble Wink. The former pirate Queen Maz Kanata marked it as a point of interest on a map she included in the book that would become known as the Smuggler's Guide.

Rahm Kota's homeworld.title: Rahm Kota's homeworld
Rahm Kota's homeworld.lead: The homeworld of Rahm Kota, this planet was a war-torn place. The population of the planet were engaged in trench warfare for years, and Kota saw combat from the age of ten. Eventually, the Jedi Mace Windu arrived on the planet to negotiate a peaceful end to the fighting. During his time of the planet, he discovered Kota's Force sensitivity, and took him to Coruscant to be trained as a Jedi. Kota was eighteen at the time.

Raltac III.title: Raltac III
Raltac III.lead: Raltac III was a planet located within the Raltac system of the Inner Rim Territories. A band of criminals under the leadership of Grintlok had a safe house located in on the planet.

Ramoa.title: Ramoa
Ramoa.lead: Ramoa was a planet, and the homeworld of the Ramoan species, including Bazel Warv, a Jedi Knight.

Rakhuuun.title: Rakhuuun
Rakhuuun.lead: Rakhuuun was a planet that was located in the Rakhuuun system of the Mytaranor sector. It was a part of the Kashyyyk Region, in the Slice portion of the Mid Rim. The Randon Run hyperlane connected the planet to the worlds of Chamble and Kashyyyk.

Rajine's planet.title: Rajine's planet
Rajine's planet.lead: Rajine's planet was a rocky planet used by the Jedi Knight Samuro to imprison the Jedi and energy vampire Rajine and her victims. He imprisoned them in a city and raised a Force barrier over the planet to ensure that Rajine could not escape. During the Clone Wars, the Jedi Master Mace Windu defeated Rajine in the city on the planet.

Ramook.title: Ramook
Ramook.lead: Ramook was an agriworld located just beyond the far end of the Chiloon Rift.

Ramsir.title: Ramsir (disambiguation)
Ramsir.lead: Ramsir may refer to one of the following:

Rajtiri.title: Rajtiri
Rajtiri.lead: Rajtiri was an arid planet in the Rajtiri system in the Dona Laza sector of the Expansion Region. It was safeguarded by thorny space-time anomalies, but still close enough to a couple of major hyperspace lanes that could permit effortless jumps to lightspeed. Some believed that Rajtiri had birthed and fostered more smugglers than anywhere else outside of Hutt Space—and as a result, the ancient city of Jibuto prospered.

Rampa I.title: Rampa I
Rampa I.lead: Rampa I was a location in the Rampa Minor system of the Outer Rim Territories' Baxel sector. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, Rampa I was subjected to an Imperial subjugation carried out by the 9th Engineering Battalion and former combat engineer Lira Hardin, who defected from the Empire after the subjugation.

Rattatak.title: Rattatak/Legends
Rattatak.lead: Rattatak was an Outer Rim world unknown to the Galactic Republic at the time of the Clone Wars.

Raxus Prime.title: Raxus Prime/Legends

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Greater Tion, Tion Cluster, The Slice
facts.terrain: Historic:, Warm lagoons, Beaches, Modern:, Industrial metal junkscape, Toxic waste pools
facts.population: 1.3 million, 39% Jawa, 38% Labor droids, 23% Human, -or-, 40% Human, 37% Jawa, 20% Rodian, 03% Other species, -or-, 63% Jawa, 37% Human
facts.language: Galactic Basic Standard, Jawa Trade language
facts.government: Sienar Fleet Systems bureaucracy, Jawa tribal chiefs, The Core
facts.affiliation: Infinite Empire, Kingdom of Cron, Xim's empire, Honorable Union of Desevro and Tion, Galactic Republic, Nikato's Bootheel, Exar Kun's Sith Empire …

Raxus Prime.lead: Raxus Prime, once known as the Circlet of the Tion and Nikato's Shining Gem, was a waste-covered planet in the Raxus system in the Tion Hegemony sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Once a beautiful world of lagoons and islands, over many centuries it became heavily-industrialized, until by the time of the Clone Wars it had become totally covered with toxic debris and had a poisonous surface as a result of the Commerce Guild and Corporate Alliance dumping endless waste.

Randorn 2.title: Randorn 2
Randorn 2.lead: Randorn 2 was an Outer Rim Territories astronomical object situated in the Rolion sector. Its surface featured swamps, in which the caustic harrowbane plant grew and which were home to the large mollusk called the ibliton. Iblitons were apex predators and held a significant role in the mythology of Randorn 2's native Mizx species, who believed the creatures were incarnations of an evil mage. At some point by the reign of the Galactic Empire, a group of xenobiologists visited Randorn 2, where they fought and killed an ibliton attacking a Mizx village.

Rathalay.title: Rathalay
Rathalay.lead: Rathalay was a planet in the Mid Rim known for its vast private beaches. The planet exported Rathalayan firestones.

Randa.title: Randa/Legends
Randa.lead: Randa was a planet in the Outer Rim which hosted a small Rebel base during the Galactic Civil War. That led it to be targeted by Imperial Admiral Gaen Drommel, who decimated the Rebels on Randa during the war.

Rasapan.title: Rasapan
Rasapan.lead: Rasapan was a gas giant and the sixth planet in the Kuat system.

Ranste.title: Ranste
Ranste.lead: Ranste was a searing rock planet in the New Plympto system that occupied the closest orbital position around its star, New Plympto.

Raxus II.title: Raxus II

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Greater Tion, Tion Cluster, The Slice

Raxus II.lead: Raxus II, or Raxus Two, was a planet located within the Raxus system, a part of the Tion Hegemony's Back Spiral in the Tion Cluster. It was situated within the historical Greater Tion region, in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. Raxus II lay on the hyperlane known as the Tion Trade Route, which connected it to the Endregaad and Tion systems.

Randon.title: Randon/Legends

facts.routes: Ootmian Pabol, Pabol Sleheyron, Randon Run, Trax Tube
facts.affiliation: Sith Empire (Great Sith War), Darth Revan's Sith Empire, Confederacy of Independent Systems, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Randon.lead: Randon was a planet from which the Randoni originated. It was a large business world with crowded bazaars and elegant corporate towers. It was at the intersection with several major trade routes, including the Trax Tube, Ootmian Pabol, Pabol Sleheyron, and the Randon Run.

Rannon.title: Rannon
Rannon.lead: Rannon was a forested planet that was located in the Outer Rim Territories' Instrop sector. It was settled centuries before the reign of the New Republic and was inhabited by a population of ten million Humans and Rodians, who governed their settlements via cooperative council.

Ranklinge.title: Ranklinge
Ranklinge.lead: Ranklinge was a planet in the Shelsha sector of the Colonies.

Rantorin.title: Rantorin
Rantorin.lead: Rantorin, also known as OM812, was a barren rock planet with two moons. It occupied the second closest orbital position around the red giant star Thrantin Major in the Thrantin OM81-A system, a part of the Ollonir Boundaries in the Negs portion of the Colonies.

Rasterous.title: Rasterous
Rasterous.lead: Rasterous was a planet with a shipyard belonging to Kuat Drive Yards.

Ranroon.title: Ranroon
Ranroon.lead: Ranroon was a planet located within the Mortex sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was particularly known for its legendary Queen Indrexu.

Rangorah.title: Rangorah
Rangorah.lead: Rangorah was a planet in the Outer Rim's Calaron sector and the location of the Event Horizon cantina.

Raskane IV.title: Raskane IV
Raskane IV.lead: Raskane IV was an Expansion Region planet located in the Sepan sector. Political tensions nearly led to a civil war on the planet around 3643 BBY, but the situation was defused by an individual affiliated with one of the sides in the ongoing struggle between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. During the Galactic Civil War, the Rebel Alliance agent Matt Talon once claimed that he had caused the agony and death of an alien on Raskane IV.

Ravaath.title: Ravaath
Ravaath.lead: Ravaath was a planet within the Ravaath system in the Pacanth Reach of the Outer Rim Territories.

Raxus Secundus.title: Raxus Secundus/Legends

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Greater Tion, Tion Cluster, The Slice

Raxus Secundus.lead: Raxus Secundus, also known simply as Raxus, was at one point during the Clone Wars, the capital of the Confederacy of Independent Systems. It was a temperate world with grassy hills and many trees.

Raquish.title: Raquish (disambiguation)
Raquish.lead: Raquish may refer to one of the following:

Raxus.title: Raxus Secundus

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire

Raxus.lead: Raxus Secundus, also known simply as Raxus, was a lush world in the Outer Rim Territories' Tion Hegemony that served as the capital planet of the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars. Renowned for its beauty, Raxus had a temperate climate and was covered with oceans and landmasses. Since the Separatist Senate was headquartered within its capital city of Raxulon, Raxus became home to a number of Confederate senators, including Mina Bonteri of Onderon. Other major Raxian cities included Tamwith Bay, which was located a considerable distance from Raxulon.

Recopia.title: Recopia

facts.affiliation: Galactic Empire, New Republic, Galactic Federation of Free Alliances

Recopia.lead: Recopia was a planet in the Recopi system in the Core Worlds, between the Corellian Run and the Hydian Way. It was the site of the annual Bandercamp Auctions in the Hinder Market.

Reboam.title: Reboam

facts.region: Inner Rim; Transitory Mists, The Slice
facts.affiliation: Hapes Consortium, Jedi Order, Galactic Empire

Reboam.lead: Reboam was a planet located within the Hapes Cluster which was noted for being a small world with a harsh climate that was relatively uninhabited and was comparable to Tatooine.

Reaper's World.title: Reaper's World/Legends

facts.terrain: Glaciers, Mountains, Plateaus, Taiga, Tundra, Urban

Reaper's World.lead: Reaper's World was a planet in the Nilgaard sector. It was the sector capital, colonized c. 5000 BBY; at the time it was idyllic, with green oceans and blue mountains. Nilgaard Bioprocessing used up the planet's natural resources, leaving it in an ice age of glaciers. The planet had urban cityplexes.

Raxxa.title: Raxxa
Raxxa.lead: Raxxa was a planet represented in the New Republic Senate by Dall Thara Dru.

Reecee.title: Reecee/Legends
Reecee.lead: Reecee was a planet in the Inner Rim, located near the Utegetu Nebula.

Redcap.title: Redcap
Redcap.lead: Redcap was a planet that was located in the Outer Rim Territories, situated near Socorro, Tatooine, and Issor. It was a barren, rainy world of fluid mud lakes, mud plains, canyons, and mountains that hosted a small-scale mining colony. The planet was populated by impoverished Human descendants of the mining colonists and lived in settlements at the bases of the mountain chains. Starships would sink in Redcap's thick mud, so landings were made in Tyma Canyon, which ran for several hundred kilometers across the planet's surface.

Red Nebula.title: Red Nebula/Legends
Red Nebula.lead: The Red Nebula was a nebula located in Wild Space of the galaxy. The Red Nebula was slowly drifted away from the galaxy due to a cosmic cataclysm. It contained a single inhabited planet, a multitude of stars, and a deadly meteor field. The nebula boasted a race of unidentified humanoids with pointed ears, who protected their homeworld from asteroid bombardment with mystical red jewels.

Refgar.title: Refgar
Refgar.lead: Refgar was a planet located within the Refgar system of the Core Worlds.

Regel Eight.title: Regel Eight
Regel Eight.lead: Regel Eight was the eighth planet in the Regel system.

Reena.title: Reena/Legends
Reena.lead: Reena was a planet in Tapani sector's Reena system. It was the capital of Reena Province and throneworld of House Reena. It had a local day of 25 standard hours and a local year of 360 local days. It had warm, shallow oceans and small continents, largely urbanized. It was the location of Reena University. Three HX.6 Turbolaser Batteries on its single moon protected the planet.

Reginard.title: Reginard
Reginard.lead: Reginard was the location of a hidden Rebel base called Reginard Base.

Refnar.title: Refnar
Refnar.lead: Refnar was a celestial body located in the Refnar system, a part of the Pakuuni sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. During the early Galactic Civil War, it was the site of a Rebel Alliance base. At some point by 1 BBY, the Galactic Empire discovered the facility and launched an attack on it. Amid the ensuing confrontation between the Alliance and Imperial forces that became known as the "Last Stand at Refnar," most of the Rebel freighters, troop transports, and starfighters were able to escape from the Refnar system.

Reerez.title: Reerez/Legends
Reerez.lead: Reerez was an airless rock that was the first planet of the Mygeeto system.

Rayamal.title: Rayamal
Rayamal.lead: Rayamal was the sixth planet orbiting the star of Julevia in the Julevian system. Located in the Dalonbian sector of the Outer Rim Territories, it was a gas giant.

Refrax.title: Refrax
Refrax.lead: Refrax was a planet in the Mortex sector of the Outer Rim Territories. The planet contained an Imperial-controlled spaceport that served as a stop-over point for ships traveling through Mortex sector during the Galactic Civil War.

Raydonia.title: Raydonia/Legends
Raydonia.lead: Raydonia was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories. The Human colonists who lived there were known as Raydonians.

Regellia.title: Regellia
Regellia.lead: Regellia was a celestial body located in the Regellia system, a part of the Minos Cluster in the Outer Rim Territories. It was the origin point of the beverage known as Regellian draught and was the homeworld of the pilot Nozzo Naytaan.

Reamma.title: Reamma

facts.affiliation: Alliance to Restore the Republic, Resistance

Reamma.lead: Reamma was a planet located in the Reamma system in the Corbett sector of the Mid Rim Territories. Sometime after the Battle of Yavin, the Alliance to Restore the Republic set up a temporary base, LX-Robynsun V, on Reamma. The Resistance used LX-Robynsun V as a base during the Cold War between the First Order and the Resistance.

Raysho.title: Raysho
Raysho.lead: Raysho was one of five planets that orbited the same sun, making up the Hosnian system, in the Core region of the galaxy. The system, including Raysho, was destroyed by the First Order in 34 ABY.

Refnu.title: Refnu
Refnu.lead: Refnu was a planet located in the Outer Rim Territories. It served as the departure point for the Atterra campaign as it was not as far from the Atterra system as D'Qar was.

Renatasia III.title: Renatasia III
Renatasia III.lead: Renatasia III, or simply Renatasia, was an agriworld that was brutally conquered by the Galactic Empire.

Rendili.title: Rendili/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems/Independent Provisional Government of Rendili, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Rendili.lead: Rendili was a planet in the Core Worlds and one of the Core Founders of the Galactic Republic. The planet was ruled by an Arch-Provost. It was the headquarters of Rendili StarDrive, founded in 20,000 BBY, and was affiliated with the starshipwrights Rendili Hyperworks, Rendili/Vanjervalis Drive Yards and Golan Arms joint venture. At some point during the Mandalorian Wars a Republic Military installation housing thousands of troops, vehicles, and starfighters was stationed outside of the major cities, though by the time of the Clone Wars the installation had been all but forgotten.

Reigalius.title: Reigalius
Reigalius.lead: Reigalius was the Reigat homeworld. It was located in the Yucrales Sector of the Mid Rim near Leritor.

Rehemsa.title: Rehemsa
Rehemsa.lead: Rehemsa was a Core Worlds celestial body located on the Corellian Run. Around 3671 BBY, the Human Felix Iresso was born at a refugee camp at Rehemsa to refugees of the Great Galactic War. Four millennia later, the Human botany researcher Chine Gabbard also hailed from Rehemsa, where he was an executive at the company Rehemsa Consumables.

Reltooine.title: Reltooine
Reltooine.lead: Reltooine was a gas giant in the Tingel Arm. It was a part of the Corporate Sector and a member world of the Corporate Sector Authority.

Relus.title: Relus
Relus.lead: Relus was the fourth planet of the Beshqek system, located within the Deep Core. It was one of two terrestrial planets in the system and was orbited by a single moon.

Renatasia.title: Renatasia/Legends
Renatasia.lead: Renatasia was the Renatasia system's primary star. It was a medium-sized yellow star.

Regolith Prime.title: Regolith Prime
Regolith Prime.lead: Regolith Prime was a planet in the Regolith system where Jiliac the Hutt had a listening outpost.

Rend 5.title: Rend 5
Rend 5.lead: Rend 5 was a planet in the Rend system that suffered famine in approximately 45 BBY. Jenna Zan Arbor created a synthetic source of nutrition which saved the populace.

Renegg.title: Renegg
Renegg.lead: Renegg was a planet located in the Kuat sector of the Core Worlds.

Rellnas.title: Rellnas
Rellnas.lead: The gas giant Rellnas was the sixth planet in the Rell system. Its sole moon, Rellnas Minor, was the homeworld of the Rellarin people.

Relephon.title: Relephon

facts.region: Inner Rim, Transitory Mists, The Slice

Relephon.lead: Relephon was a gas giant in the Hapes Cluster orbited by the Relephon Moons, of which several were populated.

Rehn.title: Rehn VII
Rehn.lead: Rehn VII was a planet located within the Rehn system of Brak sector, situated in the Expansion Region. The world was capable of foodstuff production and had manufacturing capabilities.

Relkass.title: Relkass
Relkass.lead: Relkass was an Outer Rim Territories planet that featured an equatorial region of grasslands. The grasslands were home to the cactus known as the Relkass sentinel plant, which contained a powerful narcotic compound in its juice.

Renas.title: Renas
Renas.lead: Renas was the sixth planet orbiting the star Polith in the Polith system. Located in the Jaso sector of the Inner Rim Territories, it was an ice ball.

Remsh.title: Remsh
Remsh.lead: Remsh was the sixth planet orbiting the star Iminec in the Kalee system. It was a gas giant, located in Wild Space.

Rekkiad.title: Rekkiad
Rekkiad.lead: Rekkiad was a planet in the remote Rekkiad system, located in the Outer Rim region of the galaxy. A desolate world covered in ice and snow, it was where the Jedi Knights Revan and Malak hid Mandalore's Mask following the Mandalorian Wars.

Remitik.title: Remitik
Remitik.lead: Remitik was a planet located near the Hoth system, in the Outer Rim. In 3 ABY, an Alliance to Restore the Republic repair yard was located near the planet. In preparation for the Battle of Hoth, the Galactic Empire launched an attack on the yard. After the repair yard was destroyed, the Imperial forces ambushed the Rebel craft retreating from Hoth.

Remduba II.title: Remduba II
Remduba II.lead: Remduba II was a remote planet located in the Remduba system within the galaxy.

Rena.title: Rena
Rena.lead: Rena was a Force-sensitive human who was a member of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. In 132 BBY, they and six other Padawans attended a lightsaber combat class on a training verandah in the Jedi Temple on the planet Coruscant. Rena and the other students followed a routine using bokken sabers as the class's instructor, Jedi Master Lakshay, moved among them giving advice. A chime sounded just as the routine drew to a close and Lakshay announced the session was over.

Revisse.title: Revisse

facts.routes: Corellian Run, Coruscant–Dantooine hyperlane, Koros Trunk Line, Leisure Corridor, Martial Cross, Metellos Trade Route, Namadii Corridor, Perlemian Trade Route …

Revisse.lead: Revisse was the first planet from its star, Coruscant Prime, in the Coruscant system. The planet had a molten surface.

Rett I.title: Rett I
Rett I.lead: Rett I was a planet in the Rettna system. It was a Jante colony.

Rett II.title: Rett II
Rett II.lead: Rett II was the second planet in the Rettna system, and was the site of a Jante mining colony. It was attacked and captured by the Jante's sector neighbors, the Freda. During the New Order, the decades-old feud between Jante and Freda erupted into full-scale war as each sabotaged the other's mining operations. Imperial forces were called in to put an end to the hostilities.

Revyia.title: Revyia
Revyia.lead: Revyia was a planet in the Veragi sector of the Outer Rim, and the homeworld of the Revwien species.

Reopi.title: Reopi

facts.region: Core Worlds, The Slice, Arrowhead, Inner Sphere

Reopi.lead: Reopi was a Core Worlds desert world. It featured the vast equatorial area known as the Red Reopi Deserts. There, magus creatures fed on insects and reptiles and was in turn preyed upon by the Reopi sand crushers. Under strict government regulation, private Reopi businesses hunted magus for their hides, which were prized off-world.

Repea.title: Repea
Repea.lead: Repea was an Outer Rim planet near the Cron Drift in the Auril sector. The planet was protected by the Crimson Aces until politicians on the planet feared the squadron might turn on them. The politicians sought aid from the Galactic Empire in razing the Aces' planet-side base.

Rennokk.title: Rennokk
Rennokk.lead: Rennokk was a moon of Cularin. It was a molten planetoid, its glow visible on Cularin. Reidi Artom's survey of the moon indicated there were minerals of interest in the lava of the planet, but nobody had attempted to reach those minerals by 31 BBY.

Resht VII.title: Resht VII
Resht VII.lead: Resht VII was a planet in the Resht system. It was the headquarters of the Salaktori Hunters Guild, led by Jeslor Salaktori.

Retep III.title: Retep III
Retep III.lead: Retep III was a planet in the Retep system.

Retep V.title: Retep V
Retep V.lead: Retep V was a planet within the Mid Rim.

Renforra.title: Renforra
Renforra.lead: Renforra was the site of an Alliance to Restore the Republic base during the height of the Galactic Civil War. Jon Vander led the BTL Y-wing starfighters of Specter Squadron from this headquarters.

Resti Kel.title: Resti Kel
Resti Kel.lead: Resti Kel was a planet located in the Resti Kel system of the Juvex sector, in the Mid Rim of the galaxy.

Revery.title: Revery
Revery.lead: Revery was a planet known for being inhabited by rich beings, as well as its beaches, mountains, and privacy.
