It appeared blue from space, and on the planet, there were aquamarine seas, green and gold land, and pink clouds could be seen in the sky., Astri Oddo and Clive Flax visited this planet looking for Eve Yarrow's estate.

Rentean.title: Rentean
Rentean.lead: Rentean was a planet in the Jjannex sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Repplic.title: Repplic

facts.routes: Cressus Route, Path of the Houses, Vagaari Corridor

Repplic.lead: Repplic was a gas giant that orbited the star Csilla in the Csilla system. Repplic occupied the third orbital position and had twenty-two moons. The gas giant was located in Chiss Space, a sector of the Unknown Regions controlled by the Chiss Ascendancy.

Repta.title: Repta
Repta.lead: Repta was the first planet orbiting the star Bright Jewel in the Bright Jewel system. Located in the Bright Jewel sector of the Mid Rim, it was an irradiated ball.

Renenen.title: Renenen
Renenen.lead: Renenen was the third planet orbiting the star Rek in the Guter Wade system. Located in the Trilon sector of the Outer Rim Territories, it was a poisoned rock.

Rentor.title: Rentor/Legends
Rentor.lead: Rentor was a terrestrial planet located in the Rentor system of the Unknown Regions' Chiss Space. It was linked via hyperlanes to the Csilla and Jamiron systems. Rentor's surface featured oceans as well as icebergs that slowly cruised the currents of the open seas. The sentient Chiss of the Chiss Ascendancy had colonized Rentor, establishing settlements atop the world's icebergs.

Rentalles.title: Rentalles/Legends

facts.terrain: Caves, Forest, Hillocks, Rocky foothills, Woods

Rentalles.lead: Rentalles was a planet located in the D'Astan sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Resilon.title: Resilon
Resilon.lead: Resilon was a mining world located in the Bortele sector of the Mid Rim.

Rhen Var.title: Rhen Var/Legends

facts.terrain: Modern:, Glaciers, Snow-covered mountains, Historic: Beaches
facts.affiliation: Infinite Empire, Xim's empire, Thanium Worlds, Sith Empire, Galactic Republic, Jedi Order, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire …

Rhen Var.lead: Rhen Var was a planet situated near the Tion Cluster in the Outer Rim Territories and one of the former Thanium Worlds. It was the first planet in the Tobali system. Throughout the history of the Galactic Republic, Rhen Var was covered in ice, rendering it almost uninhabitable. Remains of an ancient civilization and old Jedi artifacts were found beneath the ice on the planet, remnants of a former civilization.

Riflor.title: Riflor/Legends

facts.species: Modern: None, Historic:, Advozsec, Various aliens
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Riflor.lead: Riflor was a tectonically active Mid Rim planet located in the trinary star system of Riflorii on the Cerean Reach with a tendency to change its gravitational pull. The native population was known for its bureaucracy and engineering accomplishments.

Reytha.title: Reytha

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Rebel Alliance (temporarily), Galactic Empire

Reytha.lead: Reytha was one of the most productive agriworlds of the Galactic Republic and later the Galactic Empire. At the time of the Battle of Yavin, Reytha was governed by Governor Antes Belladar.

Rhelg.title: Rhelg/Legends

facts.affiliation: Adas's Sith Empire, Old Sith Empire

Rhelg.lead: Rhelg was one of the only agricultural worlds in the Sith Worlds region of the Outer Rim Territories' Esstran sector. Falling between Khar Delba and the Sith homeworld of Korriban on the looping Nache Bhelfia hyperlane, Rhelg was considered one of the five sacred Sith planets, along with Ziost, Khar Delba, Krayiss II, and Korriban. A primitive world covered in vast expanses of arable land, Rhelg was the private world of the Sith Lord Ludo Kressh as well as the site of his palace during the Great Hyperspace War.

Rhinnal.title: Rhinnal/Legends

facts.region: Core Worlds, Ringali Shell, The Slice, Arrowhead
facts.affiliation: Esselian Empire, Galactic Republic, Jedi Order, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Rhinnal.lead: Rhinnal was a planet in the star system of the same name in the Darpa sector of the Core Worlds. Orbited by two moons and located in the Ringali Shell, the region of space along the Perlemian Trade Route near the Ringali Nebula, Rhinnal possessed almost no axial tilt and a near-circular orbit, giving the planet very little seasonal variations.

Riileb.title: Riileb/Legends
Riileb.lead: Riileb was a planet in Hutt Space and the homeworld of the Riileb species. This planet was one of the few worlds within Hutt Space other than the Sakiyan worlds to maintain independence against Hutt influence. It was a hot and torrid world which supported a wide range of flora and fauna. Much of the planet was covered in oceans with islands being the only landforms.

Rigel VII.title: Rigel VII
Rigel VII.lead: Rigel VII was a heavy-gravity planet in the Outer Rim Territories. Its native sentient species, the hulking Rigellians, were almost extinct at the time of the Galactic Civil War. The planet was also the homeworld of the Rigelian Iris.

Rhommamool.title: Rhommamool/Legends

facts.affiliation: Osarian, Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Red Knights of Life, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Rhommamool.lead: Rhommamool was an impoverished mining world in the Expansion Region, along the Corellian Run. It was in the same system as Osarian.

Rhamalai.title: Rhamalai
Rhamalai.lead: Rhamalai was an agriworld near Seitia Prime, to which the Cherishites fled following persecution by the Galactic Republic.

Rhigar.title: Rhigar/Legends
Rhigar.lead: Rhigar was a snowy planet located within the Unknown Regions' Rata Nebula and the Rhigar system controlled by the Chiss Ascendancy's Nuruodo family. It was orbited by three moons: Rhigar's forested moon, Asdroni, and Rhigar 3. The site of the Syndic Mitth'raw'nuruodo training academy, the snowy celestial body was where military personnel were trained for service under Grand Admiral Mitth'raw'nuruodo, who was also known by his core name "Thrawn, Household Phalanx."

Ricaldi.title: Ricaldi system/Legends
Ricaldi.lead: The Ricaldi system was a star system located in the Tapani sector's Melantha Province, between the Tocco and Cauper systems.

Rianon.title: Rianon system/Legends
Rianon.lead: The Rianon system was a star system located in the Tapani sector's Melantha Province, between Shella and Shindra systems.

Reynon.title: Reynon
Reynon.lead: Reynon was a planet. Rebel agent Harovan Toth was a native of Reynon.

Rijel-12.title: Rijel-12
Rijel-12.lead: Rijel-12 was a planet where Doolb Snoil had once engaged in sensitive negotiations preventing the planet seceding from the Galactic Republic.

Reyna.title: Reyna
Reyna.lead: The Reyna was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer assigned to the Tapani sector. It was assigned to the planet Mrlsst. The ships assigned to the planets Mrlsst and Achillea, protected by the Leonides, were strategically located to control the only routes in and out sector.

Rietta.title: Rietta
Rietta.lead: Rietta was a gas giant and the fifth planet in the Mustafar system.

Rhand.title: Rhand
Rhand.lead: Rhand was a planet located deep within the Perann Nebula, in the Unknown Regions. Rhand was once inhabited by a species that disappeared before some members of the Knell of Muspilli, Kanzer Exiles, and Warriors of Shadow arrived on the planet. These three groups merged after thousands of years to create the Sorcerers of Rhand. This dark organization expanded their territory in the nearby region known as the Nihil Retreat but kept Rhand as base of operations.

Rhilithan.title: Rhilithan
Rhilithan.lead: Rhilithan was a lifeless planet located within the Indrexu sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Rigoron.title: Rigoron
Rigoron.lead: Rigoron was a planet located in the Dimean sector of the Expansion Region.

Reyniu.title: Reyniu
Reyniu.lead: Reyniu was a terrestrial planet located in the Mayagil sector between the Omwat and Kabal systems.

Rishi.title: Rishi/Legends

facts.affiliation: H'kig religion, Galactic Republic, Hutt Cartel, Brotherhood of Darkness, Confederacy of Independent Systems (Briefly), Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire

Rishi.lead: Rishi was a tropical planet in the Rishi system which was located in the Outer Rim Territories. The planet was the homeworld of the avian Rishii.

Rindao.title: Rindao
Rindao.lead: Rindao was a drab training station in the days of the Galactic Empire, close to the Outer Rim Territories. When the Empire arrived to take over the planet, the local populace had not resisted outright, and so avoided any significant persecution by the new regime. An exception to this was when an Imperial officer heard an old woman singing songs of the glorious days of the Galactic Republic and the Jedi Knights. The old woman was swiftly executed by blaster rifles for her perceived slur on the glory of the Empire.

Ripoblus.title: Ripoblus/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Galactic Federation of Free Alliances

Ripoblus.lead: Ripoblus was a planet located in the Sepan system, a part of the Sepan sector in the Slice portion of the Expansion Region.

Risban.title: Risban
Risban.lead: Risban was a planet in the Tion Hegemony, and the location of the river town Keremark. The town was ruled by the Neolsse family, who opposed Imperial subjugation from Fortress Keremark.

Rion.title: Rion/Legends
Rion.lead: Rion was a planet located in the Kessel sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Rinn.title: Rinn/Legends
Rinn.lead: Rinn was a backwater planet in the Outer Rim Territories and the homeworld of the Tintinna.

Rimma 18.title: Rimma 18

facts.routes: Hydian Way, Lipsec Run, Nothoiin Corridor, Rimma Trade Route, Senex Trace, Yankirk Route

Rimma 18.lead: Rimma 18 was a hyperspace exit point located within the Eriadu system, a part of Seswenna sector in the Trailing Sectors portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It shared its name with the Rimma Trade Route.

Rima.title: Rima
Rima.lead: Rima was the first planet of the Demar system. Its closeness to the system's sun caused it to be a lifeless, super-hot ball of rock. Though the entire Demar system was owned by the Lant Mining Corporation, Rima was never mined due to a lack of resources and the difficulty of working so close to the supergiant sun.

Risha.title: Risha
Risha.lead: Risha was the first planet orbiting the star Rish in the Rishi system. Located in the Abrion sector of the Outer Rim Territories, it was a toxic hothouse. The planet did not support Human-like life, as its surface was covered with molten rivers and steaming lakes of chemicals.

Rishal.title: Rishal
Rishal.lead: Rishal was the second planet orbiting the star Rish in the Rishi system. Located in the Abrion sector of the Outer Rim, it was a barren, lifeless world that couldn't support life, but was rich in metal and ores. Rishal had no moons.

Rishos.title: Rishos
Rishos.lead: Rishos was the fourth planet orbiting the star Rish in the Rishi system. Located in the Abrion sector of the Outer Rim Territories, it was a gas giant. Promising stores of gases were found on Rishos that stood waiting to be harvested by enterprising mining corporations.

Ringneldia II.title: Ringneldia II
Ringneldia II.lead: Ringneldia II, also known simply as Ringneldia, was an industrial planet located in the Centrality, a sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Rimma.title: Rimma
Rimma.lead: Rimma was an astronomical object in the Core Worlds, situated on the super-hyperroute known as the Rimma Trade Route. The city of Recardeon was located on Rimma, as was a set of ancient ruins. Several scrolls discovered in the latter by 3637 BBY noted the existence of the artifacts known as the Three Great Works.

Rim 3.title: Rim 3
Rim 3.lead: Rim 3 was a planet in the Outer Rim's Kibilini sector. In 3 BBY, the bounty hunter Boba Fett visited Rim 3 while searching for the rogue Imperial colonel Abal Karda.

Rirsack.title: Rirsack
Rirsack.lead: Rirsack was a planet located in the Belsmuth sector of the Outer Rim. Lieutenant Lar Ndigo of the New Republic bravely fought there sometime during or prior to 13 ABY.

Rimbaux Four.title: Rimbaux Four
Rimbaux Four.lead: Rimbaux Four was a location where an Ithorian lived at some point after they metamorphosized from the stage of a pupa. The Ithorian, whose environment included a caravan door, fed on others' refuse and—claiming later to have been the most handsome and admired member of their species in the orbit of Satellite Nine—did not experience difficulties with mating. Sending their saliva out into the winds of Solax, the Ithorian eventually fathered several thousand offspring.

Ristal.title: Ristal
Ristal.lead: Ristal was a planet in the Kubilaï system. The colonel Ershack commanded a Rebel base on the planet sometime after the Battle of Yavin. After the disappearance of an Ytterbium cargo which was destined to the Rebel garrison on Hoth, he sent Rebel operatives to investigate.

Ringo Vinda.title: Ringo Vinda/Legends
Ringo Vinda.lead: Ringo Vinda was a planet found in the Ringo Vinda system, within the Eucer sector of the galaxy's Mid Rim. An important industrial production center, it was encircled by a massive space station that served as a distribution point for all incoming and outgoing resources.

Riosa.title: Riosa
Riosa.lead: Riosa was a planet located in the Inner Rim region of the galaxy.

Rinagom.title: Rinagom
Rinagom.lead: Rinagom was a planet located in the Corporate Sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories.

Roche.title: Roche asteroid field

facts.terrain: Caves, Urban, Manufacturing centers, Yerrariums, Vacuum
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Darth Revan's Sith Empire, Brotherhood of Darkness, Galactic Empire, Greater Maldrood, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire …

Roche.lead: The Roche asteroid field, sometimes known simply as Roche, was a series of asteroids colonized by the Verpine, including Nickel One (the capital), Slayn, Korpil, Roche G42, and Shantipole.

Roche asteroid field.title: Roche asteroid field

facts.terrain: Caves, Urban, Manufacturing centers, Yerrariums, Vacuum
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Darth Revan's Sith Empire, Brotherhood of Darkness, Galactic Empire, Greater Maldrood, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire …

Roche asteroid field.lead: The Roche asteroid field, sometimes known simply as Roche, was a series of asteroids colonized by the Verpine, including Nickel One (the capital), Slayn, Korpil, Roche G42, and Shantipole.

Rodia.title: Rodia/Legends

facts.population: 1.3 billion:, 91% Rodians, 9% Yuuzhan Vong, Historic (3 ABY): 1.3 billion Rodians, 100,000 others
facts.language: Rodese (Rodian), Huttese, Galactic Basic Standard, Formerly: Yuuzhan Vong
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Brotherhood of Darkness, Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems (briefly), Galactic Empire, New Republic …

Rodia.lead: Rodia, a rainforested, industrial planet in the Tyrius system in the Outer Rim, was the homeworld of the Rodians.

Ronika.title: Ronika/Legends
Ronika.lead: Ronika was a world in the Empress Teta system, which was used as a prison colony around the time of the Great Hyperspace War. Ronika was the eighth planet in the system, and had one moon. First settled around 5000 BBY, the harsh landscape was not conducive to settlement; to prepare the planet for large-scale colonization, Empress Teta, the ruler of the system, used prison labor to terraform Ronika. After the conclusion of the Unification Wars, many members of the rebels of Kirrek were imprisoned on Ronika.

Roon.title: Roon/Legends

facts.sector: Abrion sector; The Cloak of the Sith
facts.routes: Death Wind Corridor, Manda-Roon Merchant Route
facts.population: 665,000:, 55% Human, 12% Twi'lek, 11% Duros, 7% Sullustan, 3% Kobok, 12% other
facts.government: Dictatorship (temporarily Imperial-aligned in 15 BBY), Representative democracy (during New Republic)
facts.affiliation: Brotherhood of Darkness, Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Baobab Merchant Fleet, Alliance to Restore the Republic …

Roon.lead: Roon was a planet located in the nearly impenetrable Cloak of the Sith. Known for its Roonstones, the planet was constantly sought after by treasure hunters for years.

Romar.title: Romar
Romar.lead: Romar was the sector capital of Galov sector. It was home to Moff Antoll Jellrek's base.

Rondai-2.title: Rondai-2
Rondai-2.lead: Rondai-2 was a cosmopolitan planet of mild weather and mild landscapes, with rolling hills but no mountains. It was two days travel by hyperspace from Haven and less than a day from Coruscant. It was a planet for top-security, low-profile business meetings in the Ulta Center.

Roona.title: Roona/Legends
Roona.lead: Roona was a planet located in the Roona system, a part of the Bes Ber Bikade sector in the Western Reaches portion of the Expansion Region. It was situated on the Corellian Trade Spine super-hyperroute, which linked it to the Arquata Station, Borkyne, and Epica systems. Roona shared its name with the Roonan lemon fruit.

Romin.title: Romin
Romin.lead: Romin was a small Mid Rim planet. It was the homeworld of the Romins.

Rodis.title: Rodis

facts.sector: Zuma sector, Outer Zuma, Sugai sector

Rodis.lead: Rodis was a primitive and war-torn planet located in the Rodis system of the Sugai sector, one of the subsectors making up the Outer Zuma region within the Outer Rim Territories' Zuma sector. It was the homeworld of the Rodisar species, members of which waged seasonal winter wars.

Rodaj.title: Rodaj
Rodaj.lead: Rodaj was a planet in the Inner Rim located near Wroona.

Roonadan.title: Roonadan

facts.affiliation: Corporate Sector Authority, Five Worlds, Confederation

Roonadan.lead: Roonadan was the fourth planet in the Corporate Sector's Bonadan system. On Roonadan, passengers could board the Lady of Mindor.

Rokwahl Asteroid Belt.title: Rokwahl Asteroid Belt
Rokwahl Asteroid Belt.lead: The Rokwahl Asteroid Belt was located in the Lazerian system, occupying its eighth orbital position. The asteroid belt was located within the Kira sector, in the Trailing Sectors portion of the Expansion Region. Rokwahl orbited the yellow star known as Lazerian and was found along the trade routes known as the Harrin Trade Corridor and Kira Run.

Ristel.title: Ristel
Ristel.lead: Ristel was the first planet in the Kuat system.

Ronyards.title: Ronyards/Legends
Ronyards.lead: Ronyards, also known as the Body of the Living God by its droid inhabitants, was a junkyard planet located in the Ronyards system of the galaxy's Inner Rim. Ronyards was a common dumping ground for obsolete, inoperative and unwanted droids, and was covered in metal piles that could reach up to five miles deep. Ronyards was home to a large population of active droids who worshipped Ronyards itself—and their "living god" was known to defend its inhabitants when they were threatened by outsiders.

Romm.title: Romm
Romm.lead: Romm was a planet in the Delantine system with a small Rebel cell. Trux Zissu intended to rally support from Romm, but was captured by the Empire when he entered the system. From Da'nor, another planet in the system, Stuart Zissu, C-3PO, R2-D2, and 4B-X were directed to go to Romm.

Rol II.title: Rol Two
Rol II.lead: Rol Two was a terrestrial celestial body situated in the Rol system, a part of the Noonian sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories. During the Galactic Civil War, it hosted detention facilities used by the Galactic Empire.

Rivvidu.title: Rivvidu
Rivvidu.lead: On the planet of Rivvidu, Boba Fett once chased a female Iotran mark. After the capture, Fett acquired his Silver Speeder. Its Imperial governor employed a Kubaz spy.

Rocantor.title: Rocantor
Rocantor.lead: Rocantor was a planet located in the Expansion Region of the galaxy.

Rokaria.title: Rokaria system/Legends
Rokaria.lead: The Rokaria system was located in the Tynquay sector, a part of the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was home to Rokarian dirt-fish.

Romossobar.title: Romossobar
Romossobar.lead: Romossobar was a planet in the galaxy that was the site of the Place of Enlightenment Through Knowledge. During the Cold War, the Jedi Master Tarben Jenoquan was studying on Romossobar when he was briefly infected with the Dark Plague.

Rothana.title: Rothana/Legends

facts.affiliation: Kuat Drive Yards, Galactic Empire, Confederation

Rothana.lead: Rothana was a remote planet in the Rothana system located in Quiberon sector, near the edge of the Outer Rim Territories and Wild Space, most famous for being the headquarters of Rothana Heavy Engineering and the source of military materiel for the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.

Rudrig.title: Rudrig/Legends

facts.affiliation: Back Spiral, Kingdom of Cron, Xer's Empire, Xim's empire, Honorable Union of Desevro & Tion, Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems …

Rudrig.lead: Rudrig was a planet located within the Tion Hegemony of the Outer Rim.

Rordak.title: Rordak
Rordak.lead: Rordak was a planet in the Rordak system. It was an Imperial penal colony with an orbital nightcloak. A battle was fought there between 3681 BBY and 3653 BBY between the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic. The battle ended in a Republic victory when Bouris Ulgo personally boarded Moff Ceptor's battlecruiser.

Rotas V.title: Rotas V
Rotas V.lead: Rotas V was a terrestrial planet that occupied the fifth orbital position in the Rotas system, a part of the Yminis sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was home to a group of indigenous fighters that was affiliated with the Galactic Republic.

Ruan.title: Ruan

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Ruan.lead: Ruan was an agriworld in the Core Worlds.

Rrulinn.title: Rrulinn
Rrulinn.lead: Rrulinn was a Mid Rim world in the Yushan sector. Its population fell victim to the Reslian Purge, much as did the Tunroth.

Roxuli.title: Roxuli/Legends
Roxuli.lead: Roxuli was an Expansion Region planet located at the edge of Galactic Republic space. By 27 BBY, a dispute had arisen between Roxuli's planetary government and the Roxuli system's asteroid miners, threatening the economic stability of the local sector. That year, Roxuli was visited by the Republic exploration and colonization vessel Outbound Flight as the last stop on its shakedown cruise before it entered uncharted space.

Roxuli asteroids.title: Roxuli asteroids
Roxuli asteroids.lead: The Roxuli asteroids were planetoids in the Roxuli system.

Ruhe.title: Ruhe
Ruhe.lead: Ruhe was a planet that was allied with the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars. Dooku maintained a citadel on Ruhe, situated on the edge of a massive volcanic or meteoric crater. Half a month after the Battle of Boz Pity, a strike team including Anakin Skywalker, Obi-Wan Kenobi, and Jenks was shot down on Ruhe while trying to capture Dooku; it was later revealed that it was a trap set by Dooku in the hopes of capturing Skywalker and Kenobi.

Ruisto.title: Ruisto
Ruisto.lead: Ruisto was a planet located in the Calamari sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Ruisto was the first world settled by the Mon Calamari and the site of their initial meeting with the Republic scouts. During the early years of the Galactic Civil War, the Empire bombarded Ruisto as a training exercise for its planned attack on the Mon Calamari homeworld.

Ruby.title: Ruby/Legends
Ruby.lead: Rubies were gemstones valued by pirates. They could be worth anywhere from fifty to twenty thousand credits per Coruscant Standard Carat.

Rosha.title: Rosha

facts.affiliation: Trade Federation, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire

Rosha.lead: Rosha was a planet in the Leemurtoo system. It was a neighbor of Samaria.

Ruac.title: Ruac Outpost
Ruac.lead: The Ruac Outpost was a base of the Imperial Army of the Galactic Empire that was located in the Ruac system of the Outer Rim Territories' Dominus sector. Several years prior to some point in 2 ABY, the Humans Derembus Sitnalta and Clenna served together at the Ruac Outpost. Years later, Sitnalta noted their shared service in a personal addendum to a Rebel Alliance Task Force on Alliance Security SecuriDex datafile on Clenna.

Rorgam.title: Rorgam
Rorgam.lead: Rorgam was a Mid Rim planet whose population consisted mainly of immigrants from other planets. Many of the world's elite were known to wear wrapped cloth headpieces.

Rorak 4.title: Rorak 4
Rorak 4.lead: Rorak 4 was an industrial planet that was located within the galaxy's Hutt Space region and lay on the hyperlanes called the Gamor Run and the Shag Pabol. Rorak 4 was orbited by the Rorak 5 space station and was the site of the largest slave market in the Hutt Space.

Rubler.title: Rubler
Rubler.lead: Rubler was the eighth and outermost planet of the Bestine system located in the Inner Rim Territories. Rubler was one of the three gas giants in the star system and had twenty-nine moons.

Rulaar.title: Rulaar
Rulaar.lead: Rulaar was a celestial body in the Mid Rim's Senex sector. The Rulaarian pleasure yacht existed in the galaxy by the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Rukabi Major.title: Rukabi Major
Rukabi Major.lead: Rukabi Major was an asteroid located within the Vaal asteroid field. Around the time of the Cold War, the Hutt Glorzo issued a contest there where the winner would acquire a hologram program named Holiday.

Rseik.title: Rseik
Rseik.lead: Rseik was a terrestrial astronomical object located within the Rseik system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Rseik sector. It was the homeworld of the sentient Rseikharhl species. At some point following 214 BBY, the Kett family maintained investments on Rseik, a fact which was noted in the memoirs of the Trade Defense Force captain Firmus Kett.

Rorak.title: Rorak
Rorak.lead: Rorak was an astronomical object located in the Rorak system in Hutt Space in grid square S-12 of the Standard Galactic Grid. It sat along the Shag Pabol hyperspace route, and was an endpoint of the Gamor Run route that linked it to Circumtore to the west.

Ryloth.title: Ryloth/Legends

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, The Slice, Trailing Sectors
facts.routes: Corellian Run, Corellian Skip Run, Death Wind Corridor, Old Corellian Run, Ryloth Road
facts.terrain: Mountains, Valleys, Deserts, Tundra, Ice cap on night side, Forests, Plains
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Brotherhood of Darkness, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Zann Consortium, Alliance of Free Planets, New Republic …

Ryloth.lead: Ryloth, also known as Twi'lek, and Twi'lek Prime, was the harsh, rocky homeworld of the Twi'leks, an Outer Rim Territories world located on the Corellian Run and forming one endpoint of the Death Wind Corridor. One side of the planet perpetually faced its sun and the other remained in darkness, a phenomenon known as tidal locking. The dayside was referred to as the Bright Lands and the night-side was known as the Nightlands.

Ruuria.title: Ruuria/Legends

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Tingel Arm, New Territories, Trans-Hydian
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Darth Revan's Sith Empire, Resurgent Sith Empire, Galactic Empire, Zsinj's Empire, New Republic, Unified Ruurian Colonies

Ruuria.lead: Ruuria, on the Hydian Way, was the homeworld of the insectoid Ruurians. The planet was located near the Corporate Sector. It featured tropical jungles, manufacturing centers, and universities. Ruuria was a member of the Unified Ruurian Colonies.

Runaway Prince.title: Runaway Prince
Runaway Prince.lead: Runaway Prince, or Lordunkee Wanpolla in Huttese, was a minor Hutt colony world in a region of the galaxy controlled by the Hutt species. During the early stages of the Yuuzhan Vong War, the planet was one of several worlds promised to the extragalactic invaders, the Yuuzhan Vong, by the Hutts as a token of goodwill and for resource gathering.

Rydonni Prime.title: Rydonni Prime
Rydonni Prime.lead: Rydonni Prime was the only habitable planet in the Namaryne system and home to Rythani Products, headed by the K'ntarr family. Moff Caerbellak ruled the planet during the Galactic Civil War and the early years of the New Republic. It was very wealthy and had very few disenfranchised inhabitants, which made it very loyal to the Galactic Empire.

Rydar II.title: Rydar II

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire

Rydar II.lead: Rydar II was the original homeworld of the Ranat species. The local Human Governor had the Ranats exterminated in 200 BBY. Only three individuals escaped, ending up on nearby Aralia.

Rutan.title: Rutan/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Nagai, Yuuzhan Vong

Rutan.lead: Rutan was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories, on the Hydian Way.

Rustibar.title: Rustibar
Rustibar.lead: Rustibar was a Mid Rim planet subjugated by the Galactic Empire.

Ryoone.title: Ryoone/Legends

facts.species: Lyunesi, A second species, A third species, A fourth species, A fifth species, A sixth species

Ryoone.lead: Ryoone was a dismal planet in the Outer Rim characterized by a "seemingly permanent suspension of ash in the upper atmosphere." It was inhabited by six sentient species, including the Lyunesi.

Rutal IV.title: Rutal IV
Rutal IV.lead: Rutal IV was a planet located in the Fferon system. It was the headquarters of Ry-Kooda.

Ryloon.title: Ryloon
Ryloon.lead: Ryloon was Outer Rim Territories planet in Velcar sector, Ryloon systemand the site of several Imperial Remnant controlled orbital factories where captured prisoners were sent to work. The world remained part of the Remnant following its peace agreement with the New Republic.

Ryvellia.title: Ryvellia
Ryvellia.lead: Ryvellia was a planet located in the Avhn-Bendara system. Its capital city, V'eldalv, was the site of a brutal uprising that was crushed by the Galactic Empire via orbital bombardment.

Ruweln.title: Ruweln
Ruweln.lead: Ruweln was a Bothan colony world located in Bothan space. Ruweln was among the roughly 150 settled systems in Bothan Space dominated by Bothan colonists, and was ruled by the Bothan Council, which was made up of representatives from hundreds of Bothan clans. It was the homeworld of Galactic Alliance Admiral Nek Bwua'tu.

Rya.title: Rya
Rya.lead: Rya was a celestial body situated in the Rya system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Kwymar sector. It was the homeworld of the Human Cinto Alaras. He went on to study at the Carosi XII Academy of Medicine on the planet Carosi XII of the neighboring Nembus sector, from which he eventually received a doctor's degree seven standard months prior to a point in 2 ABY.

Rynmar.title: Rynmar
Rynmar.lead: Rynmar was a world located in the Rynmar system. It was situated in the Hapan Rim Worlds, an area of the Hapes Cluster in the Slice portion of the Inner Rim. Rynmar lay at the junction of the Great Rim Route and Rynmar Trail hyperlanes, while another hyperspace route linked it to the Rainboh system.

Rychel.title: Rychel

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Tingel Arm, New Territories

Rychel.lead: Rychel was a remote planet located within the Rychel system of the Dalonbian sector in the Outer Rim Territories. Rychel was invaded by the Yuuzhan Vong early in the Yuuzhan Vong War, shortly after the Battle of Artorias. Members of the New Jedi Order, including Jedi Masters Luke Skywalker, Le'Ung, and new recruit Finn Galfridian helped evacuate the planet, at the cost of Le'Ung's life and many troops and civilians.

Ryien.title: Ryien
Ryien.lead: Ryien was a planet in the Cholganna system of the Outer Rim Territories. It orbited the star Chol, with a smaller planet, Chol, and a larger planet, Cholganna orbiting more closely than it and one larger planet, Be'ekk, orbiting further away. It was grey in color. The Cholganna system was partially engulfed by the Chol Nebula, and the planets in the Star system passed through the nebula during their orbit.

Rullag.title: Rullag
Rullag.lead: Rullag was an astronomical object located in the Rullag system, a part of the Cadma sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim. During the Clone Wars, between 22 BBY and 19 BBY, the Confederacy of Independent Systems-allied Dark Jedi Nax Cirvan eliminated eight Jedi of the Jedi Order and their Padawans on Rullag's plains. Eventually, Cirvan was captured by Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker and taken to The Prism, a space station prison operated by the Jedi Order.

Rumitaka.title: Rumitaka
Rumitaka.lead: Rumitaka was a small, dusty planet located in the Five Points system of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories.

Ruoss Minor.title: Ruoss Minor
Ruoss Minor.lead: Ruoss Minor was a planet located in the Colonies and the Interior's Ruoss Minor system, which was situated in grid square M-9 of the Standard Galactic Grid. It was controlled by the Galactic Empire at some point during the Imperial Era. The world suffered due to a crackdown ordered by Emperor Palpatine, the Empire's leader. In 3 BBY, Viceroy Bail Organa gave his daughter, the Alderaanian Princess Leia Organa, a list of locations in need of humanitarian aid, which included Ruoss Minor.

Ruul.title: Ruul
Ruul.lead: Ruul was a Dathomirian Zabrak male from the planet Dathomir who was part of a clan of the Nightbrothers during the Clone Wars. Prior to the Second Battle of Dathomir of 19 BBY, Ruul met with a group of hired individuals and Mak Eak, a Nightbrother leader, in a warehouse-like building on a mission for the runaway Nightbrother Arzo Suun to help steal supplies for Eak. The group was eventually caught by a group of Nightsisters, a group of witches who commanded the Nightbrothers, led by Nelsel, who detected the Nightbrothers' presence through the Force.

Sacorria.title: Sacorria

facts.climate: Temperate, Cold (poles), Hot and humid (equatorial regions)
facts.affiliation: Sacorrian Triad, Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Five Worlds, Confederation

Sacorria.lead: Sacorria was an agriworld in the Sacorrian system, located on the fringe of the Corellian sector.

Saheelindeel.title: Saheelindeel
Saheelindeel.lead: Saheelindeel was an agricultural world that was located in the Tion Hegemony, within the Outer Rim of the galaxy. It was a backwater world inhabited by the Saheelindeeli, a species of intelligent, green-furred primates.

Ryyk.title: Ryyk
Ryyk.lead: Ryyk was a Neti colony. It was wrongly considered by some to be the original Neti homeworld, which was Myrkr. Some time prior to the Great Sith War, Ryyk was destroyed when its star went supernova. The remnants formed the Ryyk Nebula.

Saffalore.title: Saffalore
Saffalore.lead: Saffalore was a planet in the Corporate Sector, at one end of the Lucaya Cross. It was one of the Sector's most recent boomworlds.

S'krrr.title: S'krrr
S'krrr.lead: S'krrr was the third planet in the Ishanna system. It was discovered by the Rabaanites. The average day on S'krrr lasted 22 standard hours, and its year lasted 310 local days.

Saclas.title: Saclas
Saclas.lead: Saclas was a barren Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Corporate Sector. Home to gelatinous pet slimes, it was a colony world of the sentient Ocsin species. Saclas was frequently visited both by Ocsin merchants travelling to Galactic Empire–controlled space and free-traders and smugglers making cautious trips into Corporate Sector Authority territory, and the world had a rough-and-tumble reputation. The Ocsin future member of the Zulirian Swordmasters group Cene Gilvent grew up on Saclas, where she eventually earned enough money to travel offworld.

Saijo.title: Saijo/Legends

facts.affiliation: Alliance of Free Planets, Nagai, Tofs, Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire

Saijo.lead: Saijo was an Outer Rim Territories fortress world near Cantros 7. It had green river valleys.

Saarn.title: Saarn
Saarn.lead: Saarn was an isolated and hidden Outer Rim Territories planet with vast, green grasslands.

Sabrix.title: Sabrix
Sabrix.lead: Sabrix was an Outer Rim planet. A mining operation led by Denedin extracted radioactive elements from the planet to fund the Sabrin Ring.

Sajun.title: Sajun
Sajun.lead: Sajun was a frozen rocky planet with one moon, the outermost planet in the Colavas system.

Sagma.title: Sagma (disambiguation)
Sagma.lead: Sagma may refer to one of the following:

Sab Rufo.title: Sab Rufo
Sab Rufo.lead: Sab Rufo was an Inner Rim astronomical object that was the site of the Academy at Sab Rufo. At one point during the reign of the Galactic Empire, Major Herrit of Imperial Intelligence sent a communique, addressed to Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Vader, in which they erroneously claimed that neither the academy nor Sab Rufo itself existed. In response, Vader's aide Captain Solistein claimed that the Sith Lord himself had visited Sab Rufo.

Saberhing.title: Saberhing/Legends
Saberhing.lead: Saberhing was a planet in the Corellian sector which manufactured starships. Han Solo and Chewbacca worked as mechanics in a factory on Saberhing before becoming smugglers when Han was 20 years old.

Sakifwanna.title: Sakifwanna
Sakifwanna.lead: Sakifwanna was a planet that was located within the Sakifwanna system in Hutt Space. The planet lay on the Elgit–M'Hanna Corridor hyperlane that connected it to the worlds of Elgit and M'Hanna. A smaller hyperspace route linked Sakifwanna to the Cyax system, and another hyperlane connected the world to the planet of Saki.

Sakidopa.title: Sakidopa
Sakidopa.lead: Sakidopa was a planet of the Sakidopa system, situated in the Bootana Hutta area in the Hutt Space portion of the Slice. A secret hyperlane linked it to the Saki system.

Sakiduba.title: Sakiduba
Sakiduba.lead: Sakiduba was a planet located in the Sakiduba system, a part of the Bootana Hutta area in the Hutt Space portion of the Slice. It was connected by a secret hyperlane to the Saki system.

Saak Sooin.title: Saak Sooin
Saak Sooin.lead: Saak Sooin was the single asteroid belt of the Neimoidia system. Located in the Colonies, it was set into the fourth orbital position around the star Nen. It had valuable minerals under its surface found by miners in 13 BBY.

Ryvester.title: Ryvester
Ryvester.lead: Ryvester was a planet in the Meridian sector. Imperial Admiral Kosh Teradoc was presumed dead on the planet during a Wraith Squadron, a New Republic commando unit, mission in 13 ABY. Teradoc kept a personal yacht in the bay to the east of his naval base which the Wraiths stole after their mission.

Rywin.title: Rywin
Rywin.lead: Rywin was a planet in the galaxy. It was the homeworld of the tromonids. Mere months after a scientific expedition to the planet resulted in the discovery of the species, they had infested five other planets due to their high reproduction rate.

Saki.title: Saki
Saki.lead: Saki was a planet located in the Saki system in Hutt Space that was conquered by the Hutt Cartel, which was controlled by the Hutts from the neighboring world of Nal Hutta, who turned the native Sakiyans into slaves or vassals.

Saleucami.title: Saleucami/Legends

facts.population: 1.4 billion:, 36% Wroonian, 8% Weequay, 8% Gran, 6% Humans, 4% Twi'leks, 38% other
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Rift Alliance, Techno Union, Commerce Guild, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Hutt Cartel, Zann Consortium …

Saleucami.lead: Saleucami was a dim, arid world in the Suolriep sector of the Outer Rim Territories. An economic powerhouse and major trading center in the Outer Rim, Saleucami was politically powerful during the Great Galactic War and a strategically held world within the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars. Controlled by the Techno Union throughout the Separatist Crisis, the world was liberated by the Grand Army of the Republic before the rise of the Galactic Empire and was spared the retribution demanded of other former Separatist worlds.

Salliche.title: Salliche/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Salliche.lead: Salliche was an agricultural world in the Core Worlds region. It was the headquarters of the Salliche Agricultural Corporation. The planet was one of 18 planets on the Agricultural Circuit.

Sanctuary.title: Sanctuary/Legends
Sanctuary.lead: Sanctuary, a small, island-dotted oceanic planet located in Mon Calamari Space, was one of the oldest and most well-known Rebel Alliance safe world colonies, predating the Declaration of Rebellion. Sanctuary was originally settled by religious pacifists dodging an Imperial draft. These colonists joined the Alliance on the condition that they would not have to fight in the war against the Galactic Empire.

Saleeh.title: Saleeh

facts.affiliation: Jedi Order, Army of Light, Galactic Republic

Saleeh.lead: Saleeh was a Jedi Lord who served in the Army of Light during the Ruusan campaign. Saleeh was killed during the final battles in 1000 BBY, and the eighth planet in the Ruusan system was named in Saleeh's honor following the conflict.

Sakiya.title: Sakiya

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Yuuzhan Vong empire, Confederation

Sakiya.lead: Sakiya, also known as Saki, was a planet located in the Bootana Hutta region of Hutt Space. It was the tropical and heavily industrialized homeworld of the Sakiyan species.

Sanyassa IV.title: Sanyassa IV

facts.sector: Zuma sector, Inner Zuma Region, Moddell sector

Sanyassa IV.lead: Sanyassa IV was a terrestrial planet located in the Outer Rim Territories' Moddell sector. A forested world, Sanyassa was home to the barbaric Sanyassan species, who were governed by a kleptocracy. The Sanyassans' technology was mostly on a feudal level until they discovered others with spaceflight technology, which they stole and used for themselves, attacking starships all over the Moddell sector.

Sanza.title: Sanza
Sanza.lead: Sanza, also known as Krish, was a Mid Rim world dedicated to casinos, race tracks, arenas, agriculture, and manufacturing. It was the home of the Krish species.

Sanjin.title: Sanjin/Legends
Sanjin.lead: Sanjin was a gas giant located in the Colonies region of the galaxy.

Sapella.title: Sapella
Sapella.lead: Sapella was a planet located in the Kathol Outback. Remote even by Outback standards, the planet was five days travel from Timbra Ott. Not many merchants plied the route, since more profits were to be had at Jangelle and the Kathol Republic. Around 8 ABY, Sapella was in the early stages of an ice age. The polar ice-caps covered much of the northern and southern hemispheres, and a temperate band at the equator was the only habitable part of the planet. Temperatures ranged from icy to frigid, but the colony's placement allowed it to avoid the worst of the weather.

Samaria.title: Samaria/Legends
Samaria.lead: Samaria was a desert planet located in the Leemurtoo system in the galaxy's Core Worlds.

Salteract.title: Salteract
Salteract.lead: Salteract was a celestial body located in the Salteract system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Rayter sector. At some point by the time of the Galactic Civil War, the crew of a II-xC Maintenance/Broadcast Ship of the Galactic Empire stored into the ship's computer system a flight plan from Salteract to the planet Narg.

Salvara.title: Salvara (disambiguation)
Salvara.lead: Salvara may refer to one of the following:

Sanzen.title: Sanzen
Sanzen.lead: Sanzen was the seventh planet orbiting the star Rek in the Guter Wade system. Located in the Trilon sector of the Outer Rim, it was a gas giant.

Salin.title: Salin

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, New Territories, Unknown Regions (c. 17,000 BBY–c. 11,000 BBY)

Salin.lead: Salin was an Outer Rim Territories world situated in the Sprizen sector. It served as the endpoint of the Salin Corridor and Veragi Trade Route hyperlanes. Salin was at one point part of territories controlled by the Kwa species before it was annexed by the Rakata species' Infinite Empire.

Samarine Province.title: Samarine Province
Samarine Province.lead: The Samarine Province was a subsector of the D'Astan sector, in the Outer Rim Territories. It contained the Samarine system.

Sakuub.title: Sakuub
Sakuub.lead: Sakuub was a world located in the Sakuub system of Pelgrin sector in the Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of the Sakuubians.

Salient I.title: Salient I

facts.affiliation: Salient Battle Group, Salient II's militias, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Zerpen Industries, Galactic Empire (during occupation)

Salient I.lead: Salient I was a planet located in the Salient system of the Aparo sector in the Outer Rim Territories, along the Hydian Way.

Salient II.title: Salient II

facts.affiliation: Salient Battle Group, Salient II's militias, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Zerpen Industries, Galactic Empire (during occupation)

Salient II.lead: Salient II was a planet located in the autonomous Salient system, on the edge the Corporate Sector. In 18 BBY, the planet, along with the rest of the system, resisted what they perceived as intrusion by the Galactic Empire in a hard-fought, prolonged campaign. Nevertheless, the planet's government was bombed into submission, despite several guerrilla groups forestalling the imposition of an occupying force

Samovar.title: Samovar
Samovar.lead: Samovar was a legacy planet in the Western Reaches portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was located in grid square I-18 on the Standard Galactic Grid. Samovar had mining interests that legally mined minerals there in accordance with Samovar's status as a Legacy world. During the Clone Wars, these interests aligned with the Confederacy of Independent Systems. The Galactic Empire hired Ranos Yalli and Has Obitt to transport cargo to Samovar, and were paid handsomely.

Sammun.title: Sammun
Sammun.lead: Sammun was a planet in the Outer Rim's Batonn sector that was governed by Governor Estorn. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, Commander Karyn Faro was tasked with taking the Ninety-Sixth Task Force to Sammun and eliminating local insurgents.

Sarahwiee.title: Sarahwiee
Sarahwiee.lead: Sarahwiee was the third planet orbiting the white dwarf Bseto in the Mid Rim. A frozen planet, with a local day of 28 standard hours long, and a year of 389 local days. The planet was discovered shortly after the declaration of the New Order. Emperor Palpatine kept its location a secret.

Sarapin.title: Sarapin/Legends
Sarapin.lead: Sarapin was a volcanic world in the Sarapin system, between Neimoidia and the Treskov system. It had ashy soil and streams of lava flowing across its surface.

Sarvchi.title: Sarvchi/Legends
Sarvchi.lead: Sarvchi was a planet located in the Sarvchi system, a part of the Unknown Regions' Chiss Space. It was situated on the hyperlane known as the Path of the Houses, which connected it to the Cioral and Copero systems.

Sarafur.title: Sarafur

facts.sector: Zuma sector, Inner Zuma Region, Moddell subsector
facts.system: Outer Moddell systems, Kuna's Tail system

Sarafur.lead: Sarafur was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Moddell sector, outside of which it was also known as Kuna's Tail III due to its location in the Kuna's Tail system. The planet was tidally locked with its sun, with the same parts of its desert-covered surface always facing the star as a result. Sarafur's surface was dotted with ancient stone ruins, and in the zone separating the illuminated and dark sides of the planet lay the dried-out seabed known as the Krasho Salt Rifts, which was the site of monolithic salt formations, calcified corals, and skeletons of large aquatic creatures.

Sareet.title: Sareet
Sareet.lead: Sareet was a planet within the Sareet system in the Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of the Sareeta species.

Sarka.title: Sarka/Legends

facts.population: 4 billion (9 ABY), 1 billion to 10 billion (c. 25 ABY)
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Darth Revan's Sith Empire, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Sarka.lead: Sarka was a Mid Rim planet and the homeworld of the Sarkan species.

Sappire.title: Sappire
Sappire.lead: Sappire was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories.

Sasan.title: Sasan
Sasan.lead: Sasan was a planet found in the New Plympto system of the Corellian sector in the Core of the Galaxy. The second world in the system, Sasan was a searing rock planet.

Sarko VI.title: Sarko VI
Sarko VI.lead: Sarko VI was a planet in the Venzeiia sector of the Expansion Region.

Sarrish.title: Sarrish/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems

Sarrish.lead: Sarrish was a planet in the Expansion Region's Vensensor sector, and the homeworld of red-skinned species. At the end of the Clone Wars, a member of the species, Veedaaz Awmetth, represented the sector in the Galactic Senate.

Sarconia.title: Sarconia
Sarconia.lead: Sarconia was the homeworld of green fleas.

Sardoran.title: Sardoran
Sardoran.lead: Sardoran, at one point known as Ord Sardoran, was a world located in the Sardoran system, a part of the Arrowhead, or the Slice portion of the Core Worlds. It served as an Ordnance/Regional Depot outpost for the Galactic Republic during the Pius Dea Era, a period of time that lasted between approximately 12,000 BBY and 11,000 BBY. The Human Casti Tholon, who was active by 2 ABY, was native to Sardoran, although she grew up in the Core Worlds' Duro system.

Sarm.title: Sarm
Sarm.lead: Sarm was a yellow planet in Wild Space which had been inhabited by an unknown species which built a vast irrigation canal network across the planet. When the Utegetu Nebula erupted, however, it scoured the planet clean of its population, leaving only the canal network behind. The Killik fleet would later mass above it, setting the stage for the Battle of Sarm.

Sargesso asteroids.title: Sargesso asteroids
Sargesso asteroids.lead: The Sargesso asteroids were situated in the Sargesso system, a part of the Tharin sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. After escaping from the Oovo system's Galactic Republic prison asteroid Oovo IV at some point by 32 BBY, the criminal Meeko Ghintee was pursued by a Tri-Mark VII Interceptor of the Republic Security Force. Ghintee then led the interceptor into an ambush in the Sargesso asteroids. There, the criminal rammed the vessel, breaching its hull, destroying its life support systems, and killing its crew.

Saqqar.title: Saqqar
Saqqar.lead: Saqqar was an icy planet that was located within the Saqqar system in Hutt Space, a region of the galaxy controlled by the Hutt species. The planet lay on the hyperlane called the Dead Road, which connected it to the worlds of Tisht and Usk. A smaller hyperlane linked the planet to the world of Nar Haaska.

Sarlucif.title: Sarlucif
Sarlucif.lead: Sarlucif was a planet in Wild Space and home to the outlaw tech base run by Klaus Vandangante and his daughter, Jessa.

Sartoy.title: Sartoy (disambiguation)
Sartoy.lead: Sartoy may refer to one of the following:

Sarrahban.title: Sarrahban
Sarrahban.lead: Sarrahban was a planet in the Sarrahban system, located within the Cyrillian Protectorate of the Expansion Region. It hosted a native species, and attempted to remain neutral in the Galactic Civil War between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and Galactic Empire despite both sides attempting to persuade them to join. The Empire, however, got tired of Sarrahban's neutrality and launched an invasion of the world. During the battle, Alliance to Restore the Republic members from the local partisan force attempted to escape aboard the Harvest Moon, a grain freighter.

Sarnus.title: Sarnus
Sarnus.lead: Sarnus was a planet in the Chiloon Rift in Wild Space. In 45 ABY, Lando Calrissian had established a refinery on the world to mine the plentiful asteroids present in the rift.

Sarapin Four.title: Sarapin Four
Sarapin Four.lead: Sarapin Four was a planet in the Sarapin system of the Core Worlds. During the Cold War, the Galactic Republic Valor-class cruiser Enkindle retreated to the upper atmosphere of Sarapin Four, but was destroyed by Imperial forces.

Scillal.title: Scillal (disambiguation)
Scillal.lead: Scillal may refer to one of the following:

Seftek.title: Seftek
Seftek.lead: Seftek was a planet located in the Vorzyd Cluster of the Outer Rim.

Sebiris.title: Sebiris
Sebiris.lead: Sebiris was a planet located in the Sebiris system of the Outer Rim Territories' Kathol sector. A hot jungle world, it was the homeworld of the Sebiri, a primitive species of scaly-hided humanoids. At some point, Sebiris had been visited by an advanced species that the Sebiri referred to as "those who came before," whom they believed created the jungle and performed miracles through the use of glowing charms. The only evidence of their passing was the ruins of a stone temple located within the planet's equatorial region.

Sedri.title: Sedri/Legends
Sedri.lead: Sedri was a waterworld, the third planet in the Sedri system. It was the homeworld of the Sedrians and the Golden Sun, a living coral used as a power source.

Seezar's Planet.title: Seezar's Planet
Seezar's Planet.lead: Seezar's Planet was a planet where the "Chanteuse of the Stars," Shirley, once performed.

Savrant.title: Savrant
Savrant.lead: Savrant was the outermost planet of the Bacrana system, and the smallest of the system's gas giants. The green-yellow planet had six moons. All six were strip-mined by Lant Mining Corporation and subsequently abandoned. Calito, the planet's third moon, was taken over by the Bacrana System Defense Force and converted into a surveillance post which serves to monitor the outermost regions of the system.

Sat'Skar.title: Sat'Skar

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Metharian Nebula Territories

Sat'Skar.lead: Sat'Skar was a planet located within the Coyn system of the Outer Rim Territories. It was considered a sister planet to Coyn itself. The name "Sat'Skar" meant "Sword" in the Coynite language.

Seft.title: Seft
Seft.lead: Seft was a planet in the Genesia system. The system's largest gas giant, Seft was orbited by six moons which had been stripped of all resources by the Lant Mining Corporation. LMC occasionally used the planet's atmospheric gases for use in Genesia's industrial plants.

Seffi.title: Seffi/Legends

facts.region: Core Worlds, Ringali Shell, The Slice, Arrowhead

Seffi.lead: Seffi was the third planet in the Rhinnal system. The planet's surface was covered by a toxic ocean. The Republic rocket-jumpers distinguished themselves through their actions on Seffi, which was later reflected in their motto.

Scipio.title: Scipio/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, InterGalactic Banking Clan, Confederacy of Independent Systems (during occupation)

Scipio.lead: Scipio was an ice- and snow-covered planet in the Outer Rim Territories' Albarrio sector. An important world for the Muuns and the InterGalactic Banking Clan, the world had frozen peaks dotted with towering columns and graceful arches.

Secundus Ando.title: Secundus Ando/Legends
Secundus Ando.lead: Secundus Ando was a world located in the Secundus Ando system, a part of the Lambda sector in the Slice portion of the Mid Rim. It was the homeworld of the sentient Harch species, which was governed by ruling nests and was related to the Aqualish species of the planet Ando. The Harch military leader Trench, who was born at some point between one and two hundred years prior to the Clone Wars of 22 BBY–19 BBY, hailed from Secundus Ando.

Sebaddon.title: Sebaddon
Sebaddon.lead: Sebaddon was a small world in the Mid Rim of the the galaxy.

Schesa.title: Schesa/Legends

facts.routes: Path of the Houses, Way of Schesa

Schesa.lead: Schesa was a planet located in the Schesa system of the Unknown Regions' Chiss Space. The hyperlane known as the Path of the Houses linked it to the Noris system, and it was also situated at the endpoint of the Way of Schesa hyperspace route, which connected it to the Pesfavri system and the Redoubt. Schesa was an outlying colony of the sentient Chiss species and was home to one of the Ruling Families that ruled over the Chiss Ascendancy, the government of the Chiss.

Sathiemon.title: Sathiemon
Sathiemon.lead: Sathiemon was an arid desert world located in the galaxy, where Boba Fett was presumed dead by a hit squad during the Imperial Period, while the latter was hunting a bounty. Sathiemon had numerous holes and burrows, that the natives used.

Seidhkona.title: Seidhkona
Seidhkona.lead: Seidhkona was a planet in the galaxy's Wild Space. During the Galactic Civil War, the mind-witch S'ybll used the planet as the base of her operations.

Seelos.title: Seelos
Seelos.lead: Seelos was a remote desert planet in the star system of the same name in the Kwymar sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Once considered a prospective mining world, by the Age of the Empire all attempts at settlement and exploitation had been abandoned, in part due to the deadly joopa worms living under the surface of the vast salt plains. Seelos was largely uninhabited, though there were isolated settlements of outlaws at the foot of the mountains, as well as retired clone troopers Rex, Wolffe, and Gregor.

Sedratis.title: Sedratis (disambiguation)
Sedratis.lead: Sedratis may refer to the following items:

Scarif.title: Scarif

facts.sector: Abrion sector, Imperial Navy Exclusion Zone
facts.terrain: Oceans, Rocky archipelagos, Sandy beaches, Verdant jungles, Volcanic island chains

Scarif.lead: Scarif was a remote, tropical planet located in the Abrion sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. Although a small and idyllic world, Scarif played an important part in the Galactic Empire's military-industrial complex, becoming the center for top-secret research beyond inspection distance of the prying eyes of the Imperial Senate. Among the projects stored here was the Death Star battle station, a construction project so important that the entire planet was covered by a planetary deflector shield that could only be entered via the Shield Gate, a Golan M3185 space station.

Satotai.title: Satotai
Satotai.lead: Satotai was a small, inhabitable planet located in the Five Points system of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories.

Savareen.title: Savareen
Savareen.lead: Savareen was a planet that was located at one spur of the Kessel Run, in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. The planet consisted of sandy landmasses and huge oceans. Savareen was also known for its famous brandy drink. The Crimson Dawn once had a business there and they chopped off the tongues of the natives. The former pirate Queen Maz Kanata marked it as a point of interest on a map she included in the book that would become known as the Smuggler's Guide.

Selonia.title: Selonia/Legends

facts.routes: Corellian Trade Spine, Corellian Run, Secure Route ID-5N, Trade Route X143
facts.affiliation: Infinite Empire, Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Galactic Federation of Free Alliances, Five Worlds …

Selonia.lead: Selonia was an oceanic planet in the Corellian system. It was one of the Five Brothers, and the homeworld of the Selonian race.

Selvaris.title: Selvaris

facts.language: Yuuzhan Vong; formerly: Galactic Basic Standard

Selvaris.lead: Selvaris was a backwater planet of little significance during the Galactic Civil War. It was the closest inhabited planet to the Bilbringi system.

Selgon.title: Selgon
Selgon.lead: Selgon was the first planet from the star Solis Axum in the Axum system.

Sembla.title: Sembla/Legends
Sembla.lead: Sembla was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Sertar sector. An isolated world, it featured warm oceans and shallow seas as well as archipelagos of volcanic islands. It was the homeworld of the nomadic, low-technology reptomammal species known as the Vurks, and it also hosted ancient underwater ruins thought to be of non-Vurk origin.

Selab.title: Selab

facts.region: Inner Rim; Transitory Mists, The Slice
facts.affiliation: Hapes Consortium, Galactic Empire, Galactic Federation of Free Alliances

Selab.lead: Selab was a planet in the Hapes Cluster famed for its trees of wisdom. The crystal domes on the Star Home came from Selab.

Sennatt.title: Sennatt
Sennatt.lead: Sennatt was a world located within the Bothan sector, on the Mid Rim of the galaxy. Colonized by the Bothans, it was one of their industrial hubs. Publictechnic's main manufacturing plant was located on Sennatt.

Selaggis VI.title: Selaggis VI
Selaggis VI.lead: Selaggis VI, or Selaggis Six, commonly known as Selaggis, was a gas giant located in the Quelii sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Senex.title: Senex/Legends
Senex.lead: Senex was an agriworld in the Senex sector. Offworlders were restricted to the planet's space stations and a small number of spaceports.

Seikosha.title: Seikosha/Legends
Seikosha.lead: Seikosha was a planet in the Breago system which remained neutral during the Galactic Civil War.

Seitia Prime.title: Seitia Prime
Seitia Prime.lead: Seitia Prime was a planet in the Seitia system, near Rhamalai.

Seoul 5.title: Seoul 5
Seoul 5.lead: Seoul 5 was a planet in Wild Space which was home to an ancient Human civilization in the Pre-Republic era. The Seoularians, as they were called, powered their cities with enormously powerful crystals that were kept in large supplies underground. Seoul 5 was long uninhabited by the Galactic Civil War, and its location lost—however, the legendary lost world was finally rediscovered in 4 ABY.

Senna.title: Senna/Legends
Senna.lead: Senna was a molten rock, and first planet in the Kessel system.

Selnesh.title: Selnesh/Legends
Selnesh.lead: Selnesh was a notorious Imperial prison planet orbiting a pale blue star in the Mid Rim. It was a barren, gray, rocky world devoid of vegetation or color. It had a single white, domed building, the Selnesh Imperial Detention Center from which the Rebel Alliance rescued Gebnerret Vibrion.

Selenius VII.title: Selenius VII
Selenius VII.lead: Selenius VII, also referred to as Selenius, was an astronomical object that lay in the Mid Rim's D'Aelgoth sector, along the D'Aelgoth Trade Route. A busy spaceport, it was the location of the establishment known as "Arc of Fire" Bar & Grill.

Seline.title: Seline

facts.affiliation: Gree Empire, Jedi Order, Galactic Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Seline.lead: Seline was a remote outpost planet—cold, rocky, harsh and barren—with a Jedi starport, located in the Dalonbian sector of the galaxy's Tingel Arm.

Selsor.title: Selsor
Selsor.lead: Selsor was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Selsor system, a part of the Zarracina sector in the Trailing Sectors portion of the Expansion Region. It featured several continents.

Sellasas.title: Sellasas
Sellasas.lead: Sellasas was an Outer Rim Territories world located in the Jjannex sector. During the Galactic Civil War, it hosted an Imperial army garrison of the Galactic Empire. In the wake of the Battle of Yavin, the Rebel Alliance subjected the world to a protracted siege, and Rebel soldiers killed all but one member of a local Srrors'tok merchant family that was caught in the middle of the fighting. The events on Sellasas led the last surviving member of the family, Tyionsis Cex, who had fought against the Rebels, to become a bounty hunter in service to the Empire.

Selitan.title: Selitan
Selitan.lead: Selitan was a planet located in the Selitan system. It was situated in the Loop Worlds area of the Gordian Reach sector within the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The hyperlane known as the Junction-Tierell Loop connected it to the Pinoora and Tertiary Feswe systems.

Seltaya Major.title: Seltaya Major
Seltaya Major.lead: Seltaya Major was a planet in the Mieru'kar sector of the Outer Rim.

Seluket.title: Seluket
Seluket.lead: Seluket was a planet that featured numerous stone monuments that were centuries old by the time of the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. During the Cold War, glowing patterns appeared on the monuments, and investigations into the monuments revealed that the patterns warned of an impending ecological disaster.

Serenno.title: Serenno/Legends

facts.terrain: Rainforests, Misty rivers, Mountains, Savannahs, Oceans
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Resurgent Sith Empire, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Separatist holdouts, Galactic Empire, Zsinj's Empire

Serenno.lead: Serenno was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories. It was known for its aristocratic Counts, the most famous of them being Dooku. It was also well known for its long history of resisting authority.

Sernpidal.title: Sernpidal/Legends

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Tingel Arm, New Territories
facts.affiliation: Darth Revan's Sith Empire, Resurgent Sith Empire, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Sernpidal.lead: Sernpidal was the fifth planet in the Julevian system, orbiting only 115,000 kilometers from its sun, the most populous world of its sector.

Sern Prime.title: Sern Prime/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Sern Prime.lead: Sern Prime was a planet located in the Sern sector, in relative proximity to the world of Ghorman. Sern Prime was located in the Colonies region. The leader of Sern Prime held the title of president.

Setor.title: Setor/Legends
Setor.lead: Setor was a Colonies world. A group of colonists were persecuted on, and then exiled from, Setor nearly a decade before the Battle of Yavin. The colonists intended to settle the Outer Rim Territories world Wetyin's Colony but changes in financial support from the Galactic Empire left them virtually abandoned. The colonists then searched for a new homeworld, and the scout Lile Gorsek eventually became convinced that the moon Yavin 4 would over time allow the Wetyin's Colony's inhabitants to rival and even surpass their original home, Setor.

Sestria.title: Sestria
Sestria.lead: Sestria was a banking world in the Testarr sector. It was considered corrupt and not as trustworthy as Muunilinst.

Sesid.title: Sesid/Legends
Sesid.lead: Sesid was a planet in the Sesid system, and home to the Draedan. During the Galactic Civil War, it was run by Governor Arvel Trace.

Sermeria.title: Sermeria
Sermeria.lead: Sermeria was an agriworld in the Expansion Region.

Seregar.title: Seregar
Seregar.lead: Seregar was an Outer Rim jungle planet with a breathable atmosphere and green and blue vegetation. The planet's flora included a carnivorous plant, while an example of its fauna was the predator known as the ravenbeast. Years before the Battle of Endor, several corporations ran mining operations on Seregar; however, once the natural resources they were harvesting ran out, the companies abandoned the jungle world. Eventually, the planet attracted smugglers, with locales in the settlement of Storrd Township, such as the CrossWind Saloon and Cather Taan's Gun Shop, catering to their needs.

Sev Tok.title: Sev Tok/Legends
Sev Tok.lead: Sev Tok was a planet in the Mid Rim's Kurost sector.

Serias.title: Serias
Serias.lead: Serias was a planet located within the Serianan system in the Wild Space region of the galaxy. The lone inhabited world in the star system, Serias was theorized by the New Republic Scout Service captain Korren Starchaser to be the home of a sentient humanoid species. Upon exploring the Serianan system, Starchaser's scouting team only gave the planet a cursory inspection without making any contact with the local civilization due to the already amassed information from the nearby Serianan Belt of asteroids.

Sep Elopon.title: Sep Elopon
Sep Elopon.lead: Sep Elopon held the sixth orbital position in the Calamari system. It was a gas giant with a beautiful system of rings and was also orbited by 32 moons. It was used as a Galactic Alliance staging area during the Defense of Mon Calamari.

Setolio.title: Setolio
Setolio.lead: Setolio was a planet in Tapani sector's Setolio system.

Serroco.title: Serroco
Serroco.lead: Serroco, the homeworld of the Stereb species, was a planet in the Ploo sector of the Expansion Region. A muddy world, Serroco was constantly buffeted by ferocious storms and tornadoes that often forced the Stereb to retreat to underground shelters and catacombs. The world was dotted by the grand stone Stereb cities and newer settlements populated by Humans from the Galactic Republic. Serroco was a full member of the Republic, and when the galactic government went to war with the Mandalorian warrior clans in 3963 BBY, the planet became a flashpoint in the growing conflict.

Sepan 8.title: Sepan 8
Sepan 8.lead: Sepan 8 was a planet located in the Sepan system, a part of the Sepan sector in the Slice portion of the Expansion Region.

Sestooine.title: Sestooine
Sestooine.lead: Sestooine was an Imperial world. It was located in the Outer Rim Territories.

Serpine.title: Serpine
Serpine.lead: Serpine was a planet known for gambling palaces. It was ruled by an "emperor-governor."

Sep Elopor.title: Sep Elopor
Sep Elopor.lead: Sep Elopor was a ringed gas giant in the Calamari system of the Outer Rim. At least 32 moons were known to orbit the planet.

Sessa.title: Sessa
Sessa.lead: Sessa was the first planet in the Kothlis system. It was a chaotic inhospitable world. Sessa was a tiny planetoid with irregular orbit that tore the planet's surface to shreds. The proximity of the planet to its sun caused searing temperatures.

Serenity.title: Serenity/Legends
Serenity.lead: Serenity was the leader of the Force Priestesses.

Seoul.title: Seoul system
Seoul.lead: The Seoul system was a star system located in Wild Space.

Shawti.title: Shawti
Shawti.lead: Shawti was a prominent agricultural world located in the Shawti system of Hutt Space. The world was a colony of the Hutts, the sentient species that dominated Hutt Space, and used as a site for the reproduction of enslaved Klatooinians. Mud baths and a large agricultural plantation operated by the Desilijic kajidic were present on Shawti. Several Hutt clan leaders were locals of the world.

Shaum Hii.title: Shaum Hii/Legends

facts.affiliation: Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Shaum Hii.lead: Shaum Hii was a planet in Tragan Cluster of the Outer Rim Territories.

Sevetta.title: Sevetta/Legends
Sevetta.lead: Sevetta was a planet with an atmosphere toxic to Humans.

Shaymore.title: Shaymore
Shaymore.lead: Shaymore was a planet located in the Shaymore system, which was itself located in the Immerian Outback of the Expansion Region and situated in the lee of the Trailing Sectors. It was the homeworld of the river otter–like Sessehshellah species, and was mined by the Galactic Empire for hydrocarbon–based fossil fuels. With logistical and military support from the Rebel Alliance, the Sessehshellah took up arms against the Imperials, and were ultimately successful in expelling the invaders.

Shador.title: Shador
Shador.lead: Shador was a Mid Rim planet on the Gamor Run. It was the Shadorian homeworld and had such a foul atmosphere, that it was painful for Humans to breathe. The planet was dominated by swamps, and the various towns were built on pylons rising above the wet terrain.

Shawken.title: Shawken

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Alliance of Free Planets

Shawken.lead: Shawken was a planet in the Core Worlds that boasted one of the most ancient known civilizations in the galaxy, dating back to the Pre-Republic era. The Shawkenese were noted for their studies of science, technology and philosophy, and over the course of several millennia created achievements such as the low orbit-piercing Shawken Spire—one of the Twenty Wonders of the Galaxy—and the universe-destroying Shawken Device. In 4 ABY, after the withdrawal of Imperial forces from Shawken, the world became an early member of the new Alliance of Free Planets.

Shalyvane.title: Shalyvane

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Greater Tion, The Slice

Shalyvane.lead: Shalyvane was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories and the homeworld of the Em'liy.

Shantipole.title: Shantipole
Shantipole.lead: Shantipole was a remote planet located in the galaxy's Mid Rim that was renowned for having a violent atmosphere and being a one-way trip for pilots. It was home to the Mon Calamari Quarrie, who designed a prototype for the B-wing starfighter. During the blockade of Ibaar, Hera Syndulla, Sabine Wren, and Garazeb Orrelios traveled to Shantipole to get the prototype B-wing to break Ibaar's blockade.

Shallow March.title: Shallow March
Shallow March.lead: Shallow March was an Outer Rim Territories planet situated in the Mortex sector. It hosted the Shallow March Supply Post of the Galactic Empire, with the facility being under the command of Major Tarn Innis beginning around 4 BBY. At one point, Innis, who supplied military units of both the Empire and the Rebel Alliance, fended off the planet's predators via the use of grenades while providing supplies for the Alliance officer Airen Cracken.

Shalm.title: Shalm

facts.sector: Zuma sector, Outer Zuma, Ikenomin sector

Shalm.lead: Shalm was the planet where Mount Ganton was located, the highest mountain in its range. An Imperial garrison on the western face of Ganton was abandoned after the Battle of Endor, only to become the base of the Pendarran's Revenge, led by Kolor Delan.

Shadren V.title: Shadren V
Shadren V.lead: Shadren V was a celestial body located in the Shadren system, a part of the Belsmuth sector in the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The Salin Corridor hyperspace route linked it to the Belsmuth, Botajef, Katraasii, New Bornalex, Sheris, and Solaest systems.

Shar'Ack.title: Shar'Ack
Shar'Ack.lead: Shar'Ack was a planet located in the Shar'Ack system, a part of the Atrivis sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories.

Shalam.title: Shalam
Shalam.lead: Shalam was an Inner Rim planet that was home to the Shalamite cultural group. It was subjected to a bombardment by the Galactic Empire Star Destroyer Emperor's Disciple and had become a part of the New Republic by 12 ABY. Seven years later, the Shalamite had imposed a one-hundred-percent tariff on the import of the Jandarra vegetable from the planet Jubilar.

Shatuun.title: Shatuun
Shatuun.lead: Shatuun was a planet in the Kathol Outback region of the Outer Rim Territories. The planet was covered in towering mountains and plagued by fierce electrical storms. It was an isolated planet, seldom visited by travelers en route to Danoor.

Shaylin 18.title: Shaylin 18
Shaylin 18.lead: Shaylin 18 was a celestial body located in the Shaylin system, a part of the Pakuuni sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The hyperlane known as the Overic Griplink linked it to the Pakuuni and Turkana systems. At some point between 0 ABY and 2 ABY, the military forces of the Rebel Alliance fought the Battle of Shaylin 18 there.

Shedu Maad.title: Shedu Maad

facts.sector: Hapes Cluster, Hapan Rim Worlds, Transitory Mists

Shedu Maad.lead: Shedu Maad was a world in the Hapes Cluster, located within its Transitory Mists region.

Sharb.title: Sharb/Legends
Sharb.lead: Sharb was a planet located in the Sharb system of the Unknown Regions' Chiss Space. The hyperlane known as the Path of the Houses linked it to the Noris and Ornfra systems. An outlying colony of the sentient Chiss species, Sharb was home to one of the Ruling Families that ruled over the Chiss Ascendancy, the government of the Chiss.

Seven Flames.title: Seven Flames
Seven Flames.lead: Seven Flames was a planet located in the Rayter sector of the Outer Rim Territories. During the Galactic Civil War, the Alliance to Restore the Republic established a support base on the planet, which the Rebels used to launch a diplomatic operation to the planet Karra in an attempt to gain an alliance with the native Karrans. However, the mission was unsuccessful, though the Rebel diplomatic team was able to return to the base on Seven Flames with Karra's Imperial Governor Darryn Edalm in custody.

Sha Qarot.title: Sha Qarot
Sha Qarot.lead: Sha Qarot was a planet located in the Sha Qarot system in the Deep Core that orbited a red sun. It had a moon named Fex. Due to its poisonous atmosphere and heavy volcanic activity, Nakari Kelen thought nobody would ever want to set foot on the planet.

Seymarti V.title: Seymarti V
Seymarti V.lead: Seymarti V was the fifth planet of the Seymarti system. Han Solo destroyed the planet in 2 ABY.

Shili.title: Shili/Legends

facts.terrain: Cities, Savannahs, Seas, Plains, Rainforest valleys, Mountains
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Shili.lead: Shili was the homeworld of the Togruta located in the Ehosiq sector.

Shimia.title: Shimia/Legends

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Trailing Sectors, Exploitation Region (c. 17,000 BBY)

Shimia.lead: Shimia was a planet of grass-covered plains, mountains, and seas located in the Outer Rim Territories' Dalchon sector. It was the homeworld of the Pacithhip species, the society of which was ruled by a caste system. Situated near the Corellian Run super-hyperroute, Shimia had become a part of the Galactic Republic by 17,000 BBY, with the Republic establishing spaceports there. The Galactic Empire subsequently subjugated the planet but largely left it alone, and the Pacithhips took over the Imperial facilities and began importing standard galactic technology after the Battle of Endor.

Sheris.title: Sheris

facts.affiliation: Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Thrawn's confederation

Sheris.lead: Sheris was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Belsmuth sector. During the Clone Wars, it was under the control of the Confederacy of Independent Systems, while a few years later, the Galactic Empire defeated a fleet of pirates and Mandalorians there. As part of the Empire's Grand Admiral Thrawn's campaign against the New Republic, an Imperial force advanced on Sheris, leading to a battle in the planet's Bhir'khi Pass.

Shinbone.title: Shinbone
Shinbone.lead: Shinbone was a hardscrabble mining world in Wild Space. It was hit by the Hardan plague. Beilert Valance was born on Shinbone.

Shikitari.title: Shikitari
Shikitari.lead: Shikitari was a planet located somewhere within the Unknown Regions. In the world's lush jungle lived a rare subsentient species of insectoids that shared their name with their homeworld. Shikitari were born in clusters of eggs suspended in a poisonous protective gel that warded off predators. As the eggs hatched, the developing pupae fused together, growing into a single combined lifeform. The pupae developed a body structure that mimicked their guardian.

Sheva.title: Sheva

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Tapani Empire, League of Tapani Freeworlds, Galactic Empire

Sheva.lead: Sheva was a planet in the Sheva system in Tapani sector. It was a backwater in the Freeworlds Territory. It had a liberal government that did little to threaten smugglers and other criminals.

Shiffrin.title: Shiffrin
Shiffrin.lead: Shiffrin was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Tammuz sector. Constable Kallin Bremen maintained law and order in a small village there. At one point, a Shiffrin farmer discovered what turned out to be large deposits of the valuable ore hfredium, and the Galactic Empire subsequently established a garrison there and began confiscating the properties of local landowners. Bremen was eventually executed after planning a peaceful demonstration against the confiscations, and his son, Jak Bremen, went on to leave the planet.

Shifa.title: Shifa system/Legends
