Shifa.lead: The Shifa system was a star system located in the Tapani sector's Calipsa Province, near the Calipsa system.

Shindra.title: Shindra system/Legends
Shindra.lead: The Shindra system was a star system located in the Tapani sector's Melantha Province, between the Procopia and Rianon systems.

Shesharile.title: Shesharile
Shesharile.lead: Shesharile was a gas giant world that was located within the Shesharile system, in the Minos Cluster.

Shimmer.title: Shimmer
Shimmer.lead: Shimmer was a planet located in the Rayter sector.

Shibric.title: Shibric
Shibric.lead: Shibric was an Inner Rim planet situated on the Hydian Way. The crew of the Hopskip claimed that Shibric was their destination when they were captured by the Galactic Empire.

Shelkonwa.title: Shelkonwa
Shelkonwa.lead: Shelkonwa was a planet in the Shelsha sector of the Colonies.

Shella.title: Shella (disambiguation)
Shella.lead: Shella could refer to any of the following:

Shi'kar Straits.title: Shi'kar Straits

facts.affiliation: Confederacy of Independent Systems, Zygerrian Slavers Guild

Shi'kar Straits.lead: The Shi'kar Straits was an asteroid belt formed after a comet hit the homeworld of the Shi'kar species, obliterating it into many pieces. It was located in the Nembus sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Shihor.title: Shihor
Shihor.lead: Shihor was a gas giant in the Ottega system in the Mid Rim.

Shi'kar homeworld.title: Shi'kar homeworld
Shi'kar homeworld.lead: The Shi'kar homeworld was inhabited by the Shi'kar species. It was destroyed by a comet prior to the Clone Wars, and became an asteroid belt known as the Shi'kar Straits. It was located in the Nembus sector.

Shihon.title: Shihon/Legends
Shihon.lead: Shihon was a terrestrial planet located in the Shihon system of the Unknown Regions' Chiss Space. A hyperlane linked the world to the Ool and Oyokal systems. The planet's surface featured several oceans.

Shikaakwa.title: Shikaakwa

facts.government: Feudal crime lord clans (up to 25,805 BBY), Monarchy (25,805 BBY), Feudal crime lord clans (after 25,805 BBY)

Shikaakwa.lead: Shikaakwa was a planet that was located within the Tython system of the galaxy's Deep Core region. The planet had a breathable atmosphere and was covered by landmasses and expanses of ocean. Shikaakwa was colonized more than a millennium after the year 36,453 BBY by the non–Force-sensitive settlers of the planet of Tython. Eventually, Shikaakwa came to be ruled by feudal gangster clans known as the Nine Houses.

Shingra.title: Shingra
Shingra.lead: Shingra was the only inhabitable planet in the Ordali system. It is covered in snowy mountains, with an average temperature of -15°C. Rarely, gems renowned for their size and purity can be found by mining the rock here. The primary spaceport is a small town of Kommba, mainly constructed of local conifer wood. Atmospheric flying is discouraged due to constant turbulence, and repulsorlifts are unreliable due to magnetic materials in the ground.

Shusugaunt.title: Shusugaunt
Shusugaunt.lead: Shusugaunt was a high-gravity planet located in the Outer Rim Territories' Raioballo sector. It was the homeworld of the warlike Shusugaunt species. Millennia before the Battle of Yavin, the spacefaring Shusugaunt encountered the sentient Anx of the nearby planet Gravlex Med. The former conquered and enslaved the latter, relocating many Anx to Shusugaunt. The Anx could not survive the planet's high gravity, however, and eventually perished.

Shulstine V.title: Shulstine V
Shulstine V.lead: Shulstine V was a planet located in the Colonies region.

Shulxi.title: Shulxi
Shulxi.lead: Shulxi was a terrestrial celestial body situated in the Shulxi system, a part of the Southern Core portion of the Core Worlds. Its surface featured beaches. Around the time of the death of Emperor Palpatine of the Galactic Empire in 4 ABY, the Human Imperial governor Luthus Tadrin of the Outer Rim Territories' Tadrin sector spent most of this time on the beaches of Shulxi, as well as those of the Core Worlds planet Spira. There, Tadrin squandered his part of the wealth of the Tadrin family as well as bemoaned the decline of the Empire.

Shiva IV.title: Shiva IV

facts.government: Twelve Tribes of T'Syriél, Calian Confederacy

Shiva IV.lead: Shiva IV was a planet in Wild Space that was noted for its extremely remote location, far from the auspices of the Galactic Empire. A world with a history soaked in blood, Shiva IV was marked by generations of warfare between the Human Calian Confederacy and the Twelve Tribes of T'Syriél, which forged both peoples into extremely formidable fighters. In 2 ABY, that conflict was finally brought to an end when Calian Warlord Aron Peacebringer signed the Concordat of Peace with T'Syriél Demarch Kéral Longknife.

Shron.title: Shron
Shron.lead: Shron was a small, volcanic planet that was the innermost planet of the Hoth system.

Shopani.title: Shopani system/Legends
Shopani.lead: The Shopani system was a star system located in the Tapani sector's Cadriaan Province, between Gilliana system and Pavia system.

Shola.title: Shola/Legends

facts.terrain: Desolate flats, Magma rivers, Volcanic crevasses

Shola.lead: Shola was a volcanic planet with constant groundquakes and corrosive air. Its core was a chamber of icy gas while the outside was searing hot. The planet was also almost impossible to explore, with falling volcanic ash and dangerous mining shafts.

Shumavar.title: Shumavar/Legends
Shumavar.lead: Shumavar was a planet located in the Outer Rim Territories.

Shintel.title: Shintel
Shintel.lead: Shintel was a planet located in the Shintel system of the Kathol sector, which was part of the Outer Rim Territories. A remote, muddy, and wet world, Shintel's only distinction was that it was the location of a supply depot established by Warlord Moff Kentor Sarne as part of his military forces. Commanded by veteran Imperial Army officer Colonel Heget, the depot was intended to be used by Sarne in the event that the Galactic Empire ever decided to attempt to reabsorb the Kathol sector.

Shuldene.title: Shuldene/Legends
Shuldene.lead: Shuldene was a planet in the Yarith sector of the Outer Rim Territories' Greater Javin region. Formerly a waterworld with abundant aquatic life, Shuldene froze solid after undergoing an orbital shift. Tourists occasionally visited the planet to amaze at the carcasses of massive sea creatures poking through the glassy ice surface.

Shumogi.title: Shumogi
Shumogi.lead: Shumogi was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Shumogi system. It was a part of the Southern Core portion of the Core Worlds. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, Shumogi was under the Empire's control and was the site of the Imperial Ordnance Research Facility, at which the Human Golanda was employed at some point by 0 BBY.

Shurr.title: Shurr

facts.region: Mid Rim, Kashyyyk Region, The Slice
facts.routes: Durkteel Loop, Great Kashyyyk Branch, Nightroad, Randon Run

Shurr.lead: Shurr was a gas giant planet with fourteen moons. It held the seventh orbital position around the star Kashyyyk. Shurr and its star were located within the Kashyyyk system, a part of the Mytaranor sector positioned in the Kashyyyk Region, in the Slice portion of the Mid Rim.

Shukut.title: Shukut/Legends
Shukut.lead: Shukut was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories' Mandalore sector. Located within the Mandalore system, Shukut occupied the eighth orbit around the system's star, Mandalore, between the orbits of Bonagal and Werda. A gas giant, Shukut was surrounded by a total of thirty moons.

Shotem.title: Shotem
Shotem.lead: The planet Shotem was the mining site for specialized lightsaber crystals which pulsed and caused the lightsaber to be more powerful. The Jedi of the planet were known to wear visors, robes, gloves, and boots which were unique to the planet in addition to using a different type of lightsaber hilt to that of other Jedi.

Shramar.title: Shramar
Shramar.lead: Shramar was a planet that was controlled by the Imperial Remnant during the time of the Yuuzhan Vong War.

Shoon.title: Shoon

facts.terrain: Rings of molten rock and glassy stone

Shoon.lead: Shoon was a terrestrial world located in the Shoon system of the Senex sector, a part of the Senex-Juvex region in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim. Situated in the area of the sector known as the Tangles, it was connected via hyperlanes to the Antiquity, Osmani, and Suliana systems.

Shor.title: Shor
Shor.lead: Shor was a planet in the Unknown Regions that was inhabited by the Near-Human Shorak species. Shor was located near to the world Giaca and about one hundred years before the Jedi Civil War, scouts from Shor discovered Giaca. A number of expeditions were subsequently lauched from Shor to explore Giaca, but after Peroenian military forces attacked the Shorak colonists on Giaca, a war broke out between Shor and the planet Peroenia.

Shrokaan.title: Shrokaan
Shrokaan.lead: Shrokaan was a planet located in the Baroli sector of the Expansion Region. During the Great Jedi Purge, Darth Vader executed a Jedi Master on the twelve-bladed satellite of Shrokaan by exposing him to the void of space, as he was too dangerous to capture alive.

Shu-Torun.title: Shu-Torun
Shu-Torun.lead: Shu-Torun was a volcanic, resource-rich planet located in the Mid Rim region of the galaxy, in grid square J-7 on the Standard Galactic Grid. Its infrastructure was powered by the Spike, a massive structure built by the first settlers. The planet was ruled by a royal family which controlled the planet's ore-supplying nobles that held to a distinct obsession of courtly rituals and pageantry, but was also under the control of the Galactic Empire during the Imperial Era.

Sif'kric.title: Sif'kric
Sif'kric.lead: Sif'kric was a planet in the Mezeg sector of the Mid Rim. This planet was attacked during the Caamas Document Crisis.

Silken Asteroids.title: Silken Asteroids

facts.affiliation: Galactic Empire, Alliance to Restore the Republic

Silken Asteroids.lead: The Silken Asteroids was a field of asteroids in a system in Wild Space.

Simpla-12.title: Simpla-12

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, New Territories, Trans-Hydian

Simpla-12.lead: Simpla-12 was a neglected, underdeveloped planet, strip-mined and criminal-infested. Jenna Zan Arbor had a lab on the planet surface, and performed her twisted experiments on unfortunate Jedi there. The thieves Cholly, Weez, and Tup lived there, as well as the bounty hunter Ona Nobis.

Siluria III.title: Siluria III
Siluria III.lead: Siluria III was a planet in the Siluria system of the Atravis sector in the Outer Rim Territories.

Sikurd.title: Sikurd
Sikurd.lead: Sikurd was a planet located in the Sikurd system within the Tynquay sector in the Outer Rim Territories, and it was the homeworld of the Sikurdian species. It was also where Sikurdian battle-axes were made.

Sibisime.title: Sibisime
Sibisime.lead: Sibisime was a planet in the Mid Rim. The slicer Zakarisz Ghent was living there, in Saraban City in 4 ABY when he was approached by a man who offered him a job if he went to Chibias and gave him a spaceliner ticket. On Chibias, Ghent failed to make his connection with the strange man and got caught up in a plot involving stolen government secrets, only to be rescued by Mara Jade. After a few days adventuring with the ex-Hand, Ghent and Jade parted company and the youth finally made his connection with his mysterious employer—Talon Karrde.

Sif-Uwana.title: Sif-Uwana
Sif-Uwana.lead: Sif-Uwana was a planet within the Colonies area of the galaxy. It was the homeworld of the individuals known as Sif-Uwani and was administered by the Sif-Uwana Council. The planet was controlled by Alsakan during the Alsakan Conflicts but was eventually lost to the Galactic Republic. At some point, the Emperor's agent Mara Jade visited the world.

Sifuchi.title: Sifuchi

facts.region: Expansion Region, Outer Expansion Zone, Northern Dependencies

Sifuchi.lead: Sifuchi was a celestial body located in the Sifuchi system. It was a part of the Expansion Region's Lostar sector, being located both in the Outer Expansion Zone sub-region and the Northern Dependencies portion of that region.

Sim'char'ser.title: Sim'char'ser
Sim'char'ser.lead: Sim'char'ser was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories. It received shipments of Roonstones from the mines of Quilken.

Simbarc.title: Simbarc
Simbarc.lead: Simbarc was an Outer Rim Territories mining planet located in the Cadma sector. It had both rich ore deposits as well as several famous casinos, at one of which around 1 BBY, the smuggler Han Solo was caught cheating. The casino's security team pursued Solo and his partner, Chewbacca, in a speeder chase that ended with the two smugglers ultimately escaping to the hangar where their starship waited for them.

Simang.title: Simang
Simang.lead: Simang was the seventh planet orbiting the star Tive in the Taanab system. Located in the Inner Rim Territories, it was a gas giant with twelve moons.

Sigil.title: Sigil
Sigil.lead: Sigil was a planet in the Sigil system. The Sith Terrak Morrhage trained there.

Simocadia.title: Simocadia

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems

Simocadia.lead: Simocadia was a planet located in the Inner Rim and the homeworld to the Mosciive species.

Sikkem IV.title: Sikkem IV
Sikkem IV.lead: Sikkem IV was one of the many planetary haunts of Captain Ellin Lah and her crew from the Woebegone.

Simento-Threk.title: Simento-Threk
Simento-Threk.lead: Simento-Threk was a celestial body located in the Simento-Threk system, a part of the Meram sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories.

Sicemon.title: Sicemon
Sicemon.lead: Sicemon (also spelled Siceman) was a planet located in the Sice system that was covered in vast grasslands and mounds. Inhabited by giant flying whales, it was home to a city that was used as a base by the Rebel Alliance.

Sif-Alula.title: Sif-Alula

facts.region: Expansion Region, Outer Expansion Zone, Northern Dependencies

Sif-Alula.lead: Sif-Alula was an Expansion Region astronomical object located in the Trestis sector. It was the namesake of the Sif-Alulan process, in which the Sisters of the Machinesmith studied and upgraded Galactic Republic technology in the build-up of the Waymancy Storm of 7811 BBY. During that conflict, the Republic captured weapons and starship power generators of the Signatories of Waymancy at Sif-Alula, allowing the Republic to study the military technology of its enemy.

Silversisi.title: Silversisi (disambiguation)
Silversisi.lead: Silversisi may refer to:, __NOTOC__, ==Canon==, Silversisi system, a star system located in the Inner Rim Territories

Sibensko.title: Sibensko
Sibensko.lead: Sibensko was an aquatic planet in the Sibensko system in the Bes Ber Bikade sector of the Expansion Region, situated along the Corellian Trade Spine between Cymoon and Kinyen. It was in an area affiliated with the Centrists, and it was one of the planets on which cartel leader Rinnrivin Di operated.

Simoom.title: Simoom/Legends
Simoom.lead: The Simoom was a Maelstrom-class battle cruiser used by the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

Sisk.title: Sisk/Legends
Sisk.lead: Sisk was a planet that orbited a red dwarf star. It was the homeworld of the Sic-Six. It cooled when its star suffered partial atomic collapse.

Sirpar.title: Sirpar/Legends
Sirpar.lead: Sirpar, a large planet with little natural resources, was an Imperial high-gravity training center and the Eklaad homeworld. It was near Tatooine. It was the primary Imperial training facility in its sector. Stories about Sirpar—usually not good ones—were known throughout the Empire, even by soldiers that were trained elsewhere.

Sinsang.title: Sinsang
Sinsang.lead: Sinsang was an industrious world located in the Sinsang system, a part of the Raioballo sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was situated on the hyperlane known as the Veragi Trade Route, which connected it to the Anx Minor, Neka, and Dantooine systems.

Sionia.title: Sionia
Sionia.lead: Sionia was the homeworld of the Skups, located within Hutt Space. Sionian Skups were a near-human species with a vast range of genetic characteristics. Rumor had it that the Skups were genetically altered by another species and sold to the Hutts ages ago.

Sinton.title: Sinton
Sinton.lead: The planet Sinton was located in the Sinton system, a part of the Mid Rim's Rago sector. It lay along the Rago Run hyperlane, which connected it to the Moro and Gilatter systems. Sinton was populated by non-Humans, and at some point by 3 ABY, the planet was subjugated by the Galactic Empire, which subjected the planet's inhabitants to slave labor.

Sinkar.title: Sinkar
Sinkar.lead: Sinkar was a planet in the Lawreys system in the Fakir sector. It was a cold and inhospitable world with heavy gravity, and the oxygen supply was frozen on the surface. Extremely hostile to life, it was nonetheless the homeworld of the Sinkar. The Sinkar were a species of helium-based slugs that lived on solar energy and impurities in the planet's oxygen blanket. The Galactic Empire established a garrison on Sinkar during the Galactic Civil War.

Sinal.title: Sinal
Sinal.lead: Sinal was the innermost planet of the Bacrana system. An uninhabitable ball of searing hot rock, Sinal orbited close to the system's star, Bacrana. Starships approaching Sinal had to be heavily shielded, and could only remain for a short amount of time.

Sissubo.title: Sissubo/Legends

facts.region: Core Worlds, Northern Dependencies, The Slice, Arrowhead

Sissubo.lead: Sissubo was the seventh planet of the Chandrila system, located in the Bormea sector of the Ringali Shell in the Core Worlds. The planet orbited the star Chandrila and was a frozen, rocky world circled by one moon. The Chandrila system lay on the Perlemian Trade Route, which served as a dividing line between the Northern Dependencies and the Arrowhead portion of the Slice.

Simus Minor 1.title: Simus Minor 1
Simus Minor 1.lead: Simus Minor I was the innermost planet in the Simus Minor system.

Simus Minor 2.title: Simus Minor 2
Simus Minor 2.lead: Simus Minor 2 was the second planet in the Simus Minor system.

Sirilla.title: Sirilla
Sirilla.lead: Sirilla was the fourth and outermost planet in the Cirius system. It was a gas giant orbited by 17 moons.

Siskeen.title: Siskeen/Legends
Siskeen.lead: Siskeen was a planet located in the Hunnoverrs sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Sirdar.title: Sirdar
Sirdar.lead: Sirdar was a planet in a remote region of the galaxy. At some point, a small population of the insectivorous winged xendrites was placed on Sirdar to help with insect control. The xendrites reproduced at an astounding rate and soon overran the planet.

Sittana.title: Sittana
Sittana.lead: Sittana was a planet with rivers and falls of fire. Holographic information of Sittana was stored in the Anywhere Room at Hologram Fun World, so that visitors to the attraction could be virtually transported to the locale. Sittana marble was used as a building material.

Sivoria.title: Sivoria
Sivoria.lead: Sivoria was a planet located in the Hapes Cluster of the Inner Rim.

Sintheti.title: Sintheti
Sintheti.lead: Sintheti was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Sintheti system, a part of the Noonian sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories. Its surface featured crags.

Siquay.title: Siquay/Legends
Siquay.lead: Siquay was the sixth planet orbiting the star Sriluur in the Sriluur system. Located in the Tharin sector of the Outer Rim Territories, it was a gas giant.

Ska Gora.title: Ska Gora
Ska Gora.lead: Ska Gora was a verdant forest planet that was located within the Tython system of the galaxy's Deep Core region. More than thirty-six thousand years before the Battle of Yavin, the non–Force-sensitive settlers of the planet Tython colonized Ska Gora. Most of the planet's population lived in city-ships that floated above Ska Gora's surface, but when the Wookiee warlord Gharcanna led members of his species to illegally settle the surface, the matter ended in a conflict that saw the illegal settlers dead and swaths of the apex tree forests ablaze.

Sinjan.title: Sinjan
Sinjan.lead: Sinjan was a planet located in the Albarrio sector of the Outer Rim.

Skako Minor.title: Skako Minor

facts.terrain: Canyons, Caverns, Craters, Fungal forests, Mountains
facts.affiliation: Techno Union, Confederacy of Independent Systems (secretly), Galactic Empire (occupied)

Skako Minor.lead: Skako Minor, sometimes referred to as simply Skako, was a planet that was the homeworld of the Poletec species. It was controlled by the Techno Union, whose headquarters was the city of Purkoll. Despite the Techno Union's ostensible neutrality, Skako Minor was captured by the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars, and its successor, the Galactic Empire, maintained the occupation into the Galactic Civil War.

Skako.title: Skako/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Techno Union, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire

Skako.lead: Skako was an ecumenopolis on the Hydian Way in the galactic core and homeworld to the Skakoan species. Though most of Skako was covered by urban sprawl, some examples of the planet's original ecosystem had been preserved in the form of vast fields of sprawling vines.

Skor II.title: Skor II

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Alliance to Restore the Republic

Skor II.lead: Skor II was a planet in the Squab system and the homeworld of the Squibs. It was located in the Outer Rim Territories just west of the Rimma Trade Route. The world was small, with a varied terrain and climate that provided it with vast natural resources. The planet's system of government, known as the polyanarchy, was headed by a king. One major population center was Metrobig City, site of the Metrobig Interplanetary Blastport.

Skye.title: Skye/Legends

facts.government: Supreme Council of the Highland Clans
facts.affiliation: Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire

Skye.lead: Skye, designated Marat V by the Galactic Republic, was a terrestrial planet in the Outer Rim Territories and the home of the S'kytri people. Remaining isolated from the wider galaxy, the world attempted to gain admittance into the Council of Neutral Systems during the Clone Wars but was interrupted by an invasion led by Zeta Magnus and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Skeebo.title: Skeebo
Skeebo.lead: Skeebo, also known as the Jewel of the Five Systems, was a rocky Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Shadola sector. At some point long before 10 ABY, the Skeebos of Skeeb erected pyramidal stone funeral palaces in a region of the planet known as the sacred valley. On their honeymoon in that year, the Hutts Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo and Anachro visited Skeebo. During the pair's tour, the Skaver swoop gang kidnapped Anachro, holding her hostage for a one-million-credit-large ransom.

Sljee.title: Sljee/Legends

facts.region: Expansion Region, Outer Expansion Zone, Northern Dependencies

Sljee.lead: Sljee was an Expansion Region planet located in the Ehosiq sector. Species living on it, which included the sentient Sljee, primarily relied on the sense of smell. Between 12 ABY and 13 ABY, Sljee was part of the New Republic.

Skorrupon.title: Skorrupon/Legends
Skorrupon.lead: Skorrupon was a planet located in the Trans-Vulta sector of the Mid Rim. Skorrupon was the site of several notable battles: during the early Imperial Era, anti-Imperial agents Arani Korden, Rorworr, and Deel Surool intercepted High Inquisitor Volytar's shuttle outside of his personal Star Destroyer over the world. The three thus became known as the Heroes of Skorrupon. Later, in 0 ABY, Rebel forces attempted to ambush the newly christened Super Star Destroyer Executor above Skorrupon, in one of the Rebellion's first encounters with the powerful flagship.

Sleheyron.title: Sleheyron/Legends

facts.affiliation: Infinite Empire, Hutt Empire, Hutt Cartel, Brotherhood of Darkness, Yuuzhan Vong empire, Confederation, Xim's empire

Sleheyron.lead: Sleheyron was a planet in Hutt Space. Although it was based on slave trade, its powerful economy made Sleheyron one of the most important Hutt worlds.

Sluudren.title: Sluudren

facts.government: Intricate feudal system with nobles and kings (previously), Loose alliance of shady Sludir of varying dispositions

Sluudren.lead: Sluudren, or just Sludir, was a planet in the Outer Rim. It was the homeworld of the Sludir. It was located in the Chorlian sector of the galaxy.

Slag.title: Slag
Slag.lead: Slag was the first planet from the sun in the Sacorrian system. It was a searing rocky world with no atmosphere and no moons.

Skynara.title: Skynara

facts.affiliation: Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire, Galactic Alliance Remnant

Skynara.lead: Skynara was an astronomical object located in the Skynara system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Skine sector. It was situated at the endpoint of the hyperlane known as the Five Veils Route.

Skuumaa.title: Skuumaa
Skuumaa.lead: Skuumaa was a planet contested during the Clone Wars. Delta Squad traveled there ahead of the main Republic assault in order to sabotage strategic targets and "prepare the battlefield", shortly after their involvement in an anti-terror operation on Coruscant.

Skone II.title: Skone II
Skone II.lead: Skone II was a planet in the Skone system of Brak sector, located in the Expansion Region. The planet was capable of foodstuff production and had manufacturing capabilities.

Skann.title: Skann
Skann.lead: Skann was a terrestrial planet located in the Skann system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Astal sector. It was inhabited by farmers who grew crops such as Dust-Corn and Dry Gene Wheat. The farmers made the unique beverage Skannbult Likker, which was possibly the most volatile fire-water in the galaxy, from surplus crops, distilling it in rock basins.

Skine.title: Skine
Skine.lead: Skine was a planet located in the Skine sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the location of the Skine Bounty Hunter College.

Skotla.title: Skotla
Skotla.lead: Skotla was the sixth planet orbiting the star Teth in the Teth system. Located in the Baxel sector of the Outer Rim Territories, it was a gas giant.

Slession.title: Slession (disambiguation)
Slession.lead: Slession may refer to one of the following:

Slotern.title: Slotern
Slotern.lead: Slotern was a world where a battle was fought between the Galactic Empire and a resistance group sometime between the years 19 BBY and 1 BBY. The world was located in the Slotern system of the Wazta sector, which was located in the Outer Rim Territories.

Skarpos.title: Skarpos
Skarpos.lead: Skarpos was a barbaric world located in the Grumani sector that was under the sway of the Sith Lord Malakite. It was a stormy planet with many trenches, and a forbidding-looking mesa. In 1032 BBY, the planet was invaded and occupied by rival Sith Lord Odion's Odionate military forces. Later, Aunt Zoojoo revealed to Jedi Knight Kerra Holt that Skarpos was the location of the Helm of Ieldis, an ancient Sith artifact created prior to the Great Hyperspace War which was the target of Odion's Project Pandemonium.

Skaradosh.title: Skaradosh
Skaradosh.lead: Skaradosh was a desert planet located in the Skaradosh system in the Inner Rim Territories. During the Galactic Civil War, between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic, Skaradosh served as neutral-ground for a prisoner transfer during Princess Leia Organa's rescue mission.

Skuhl.title: Skuhl
Skuhl.lead: Skuhl was a planet located in the Skuhl system in the Spadja sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Solaest.title: Solaest
Solaest.lead: Solaest was a planet located in the Solaest system, a part of the Belsmuth sector in the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The Salin Corridor hyperspace route linked it to the Belsmuth, Katraasii, New Bornalex, and Shadren systems as well as the Phindar system of the Demetras sector.

Sneeve.title: Sneeve/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Darth Revan's Sith Empire, Hutt Space, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Sneeve.lead: Sneeve was the homeworld of the Sneevel species. It was located in the Kastolar sector of the Mid Rim.

Smarteel.title: Smarteel
Smarteel.lead: Smarteel was a desert planet in Wild Space.

Socorro.title: Socorro/Legends

facts.terrain: Desert swells and flats, Mountains, Volcanic regions

Socorro.lead: Socorro was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories with a reputation as a smuggler haven. It was the homeworld of Lando Calrissian.

Solem.title: Solem
Solem.lead: Solem was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories and the homeworld of a species.

Solay.title: Solay
Solay.lead: Solay was the main planet in the Solay system in the Dominus sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Home to a variety of species, Solay remained in the hands of a despot for half a century, before the Rebel Alliance hero Luke Skywalker assisted the resisters. The rebel victory was short-lived, however, as the Galactic Empire quickly annexed Solay, forcing Skywalker to flee.

Smuggler's Run.title: Smuggler's Run/Legends
Smuggler's Run.lead: Smuggler's Run was a treacherous asteroid field that harbored a plethora of smugglers and illegal activities, located near Wrea.

Sollace.title: Sollace

facts.routes: Commenor Run, Hydian Way, Brentaal–Denon Route, Corsin Run, Perlemian Trade Route

Sollace.lead: Sollace was a planet in the Brentaal system. A searing rock, it was unable to support any life.

Solag.title: Solag
Solag.lead: Solag was a planet in the Corulus system.

Smarck.title: Smarck
Smarck.lead: Smarck was a planet in Outer Rim Territories, Cademimu sector, Smarck system.

Sochi.title: Sochi
Sochi.lead: Sochi was a vacation planet located in the Sochi system within the Slice portion of the Inner Rim. The Galactic Empire maintained the camp known as Troopers' Rest on Sochi, where Imperial stormtroopers who reached retirement age were eventually sent.

Solanus.title: Solanus
Solanus.lead: Solanus was a planet in the Solanus system. It was situated within the Dominus sector, a part of the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. Solanus was home to a sentient ocean that covered it, a murky sea so rich in chemicals that it could perform billions of thought processes within its depths, which classified it as a super-brain. However, like other super-brains, the ocean was too large to move around independently and kept to itself, often contemplating its own existence.

Snevu.title: Snevu
Snevu.lead: Snevu was a planet in the Unknown Regions where the Battle of Snevu was fought between the Killiks and the Chiss.

Solibus IV.title: Solibus IV
Solibus IV.lead: Solibus IV was a planet visited by Aayla Secura during her apprenticeship to Quinlan Vos. It was there that the two Jedi would open the Shu-Wang Prism and solve the Mystery of the Lodi.

Solacton.title: Solacton system/Legends
Solacton.lead: The Solacton system was in a remote part of the Periphery. However, a number of hyperspace routes did pass through the system en route to the Iotran system.

Soltan.title: Soltan
Soltan.lead: Soltan was a planet in the Ansion system, which was located in the Mid Rim's Churnis sector. A ball of barren rock, it was in an area of space aligned with the Galactic Republic, and later the Galactic Empire.

Somavva.title: Somavva
Somavva.lead: Somavva was a planet located in the Tharin sector of the Outer Rim.

Socco.title: Socco
Socco.lead: Socco was a planet in the Outlier systems of the Corellian sector.

Solu Five.title: Solu Five
Solu Five.lead: Solu Five was a planet located in the Outer Rim Territories along several profitable hyperlanes. During the Galactic War, the planet was represented in the Galactic Senate of the Galactic Republic by Senator Grom Zian.

Socorro asteroid belts.title: Socorro asteroid belts
Socorro asteroid belts.lead: Socorro in the Outer Rim Territories was home to asteroid belts that were rich in doonium ore. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, Imperial Navy officer Filia Rossi was stationed at Socorro and captained an ore freighter escort that supplied the construction of the Death Star battle station with doonium from these asteroid belts.

Sorjus.title: Sorjus
Sorjus.lead: Sorjus was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Meridian sector. It was the homeworld of the Paaerduag species. The spacer Ja'Gatcha and merchant Mic'tunan'jus Orgu were two Paaerduag who had left their home planet by 3956 BBY.

Soronia.title: Soronia

facts.routes: Corellian Trade Spine, Corellian Run, Secure Route ID-5N, Trade Route X143

Soronia.lead: Soronia was the seventh planet in the Corellian system. It was a frozen, rocky world and had no moons. Soronia and the other lifeless world in the star system, Crollia, were both located on the fringes of the system, and were believed to have naturally formed in orbit around the star Corell—unlike the other five worlds, which were placed in the system through the use of Centerpoint Station.

Sooma.title: Sooma
Sooma.lead: Sooma was a planet of grassy plains and an oxygen-filled atmosphere. It was homeworld to the Soomans.

Soterios.title: Soterios
Soterios.lead: Soterios was a dry planet in Tapani sector's Melantha Province. Most of the world was scoured by windswept canyons and vast expanses of wastelands. There were few settlements and the indigenous flora and fauna had been driven to extinction by species introduced from elsewhere in the galaxy.

Sorrus.title: Sorrus

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, New Territories, Trans-Hydian

Sorrus.lead: Sorrus was a planet in the Sorrus system located in the Outer Rim Territories. Its terrain consisted of mountain ranges and large deserts. The planet also had many sprawling cities. It had three capitals, one of which was Yinn La Hi. The Sorrusian people were xenophobic, and known for being unfriendly to outsiders. Jenna Zan Arbor once had her scientific lab located on Sorrus.

Somov Rit.title: Somov Rit
Somov Rit.lead: Somov Rit was a sparsely populated green world with a native Human population. During the New Sith Wars, Jedi scout Torr Snapit came to the planet seeking Force-sensitive recruits, but his only luck was with three young children: Rain, Tomcat and Bug. Rain later helped rebuild the Sith Order as Darth Bane's apprentice, Darth Zannah.

Sorl.title: Sorl
Sorl.lead: The planet of Sorl was Jedi Master Noor R'aya's homeworld.

Sorella.title: Sorella

facts.sector: Tapani sector, Freeworlds Territory, Three Ellas
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Sorella.lead: Sorella was a planet in the Sorella system in Tapani sector. Sorella was also one of the Freeworlds Territory. Also, it was a member of the Three Ellas, with a liberal government looser about crime and smuggling than most Tapani worlds.

Soullex.title: Soullex
Soullex.lead: Soullex was a planet in the Fardon system in Wild Space of the galaxy. After the Battle of Tantive V, it was garrisoned as the headquarters of Fleet Admiral Gaen Drommel. Drommel was betrayed and killed by Colonel Niovi, who surrendered the Guardian to the New Republic.

Sotipe.title: Sotipe

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Metharian Nebula Territories

Sotipe.lead: Sotipe was the seventh planet in the Derilyn system. It was a gas giant and had 14 moons.

Sonn Vilmari.title: Sonn Vilmari
Sonn Vilmari.lead: Sonn Vilmari was a planet in the Colundra sector of the Outer Rim.

Sorotarr VI.title: Sorotarr VI
Sorotarr VI.lead: Sorotarr VI was a planet located in the Sorotarr system, a part of the Yushan sector in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim. It was the site of the establishment known as the Game and was a favorite destination for gamblers. Similarly to worlds such as Adarlon and Harloen, by the time of the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Rebel Alliance, Sorotarr VI was commonly frequented by people such as corporate executives; Imperial Moffs, Fleet Admirals, and nobles; and dishonest individuals, who were all traveling incognito and were seeking out entertainment.

Soun IV.title: Soun IV/Legends
Soun IV.lead: Soun IV was an astronomical object located in the Soun system, a part of the Outer Expansion Zone sub-region and the freestanding subsectors portion of the Expansion Region. In 22 BBY, a princess from Soun IV visited the Outlander Club on the Core Worlds planet Coruscant. By 12 ABY, the Soun system fell within the borders of the New Republic.

Sorfina.title: Sorfina
Sorfina.lead: Sorfina was a planet. Occasionally, gaudy artworks were requested by buyers on Sorfina.

Sondarr.title: Sondarr
Sondarr.lead: Sondarr was a planet in the Sertar sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Sorimow.title: Sorimow
Sorimow.lead: Sorimow was a planet within the Sorimow system in the Pacanth Reach of the Outer Rim Territories.

Soum.title: Soum
Soum.lead: Soum was a planet located in the galaxy. It was the homeworld of the feline sentients known as the Souma.

Soruus.title: Soruus
Soruus.lead: Soruus was an Outer Rim Territories world located in the Tion Cluster's Cronese Mandate sector. Originally a part of the Kingdom of Cron, it was a successful trade world during the reign of Cronese King Xim and was also associated with a tradition of gladiatorial spectacles that persisted over the subsequent millennia. The merchant, philosopher, and historian Bleys Harand at one point visited a gladiatorial arena on Soruus in search of a contemporary visual depiction of Xim.

Son-tuul.title: Son-tuul
Son-tuul.lead: Son-tuul was a jungle planet located in the Outer Rim Territories. It was the base of the Son-tuul Pride, a criminal organization and one of the Five Crime Syndicates. Darth Vader attacked the Son-tuul Pride and liberated its cache of credits. A group of mercenaries then met at a cantina on the planet to steal those credits from Vader's forces. Later on, a new crew of mercenaries, led by Chelli Aphra, was formed by the Son-tuul Pride to search for their leader 0-0-0's memories. Shortly after they were recovered, the Empire attacked and destroyed the Son-tuul Pride.

Sooncanoo Beacon.title: Sooncanoo Beacon
Sooncanoo Beacon.lead: Sooncanoo Beacon was a Galactic Republic hyperspace beacon. It was situated in the Sooncanoo system, a part of the Northern Dependencies portion of the Inner Rim.

Sriluur.title: Sriluur/Legends

facts.affiliation: Hutt Empire, Galactic Empire, Yuuzhan Vong Empire, Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire

Sriluur.lead: Sriluur was a planet in the Tharin sector of the Outer Rim. Homeworld to the sentient Weequay species, Sriluur held a key position along the Sisar Run, one of the many important hyperlanes connecting Hutt Space with the rest of the Outer Rim. The planet was orbited by five moons, most notably Ruul, the only one of the five able to support life. It was an arid world covered in deserts, volcanoes and acidic seas. Despite this, the planet was almost entirely self-sufficient thanks to an unlikely but very productive agricultural sector.

Sronk.title: Sronk
Sronk.lead: The Sronk were a cultural group who spoke Basic using hand-based metaphors, such as "seeing things full-left-handed" for "seeing things first-hand" and "full slamming brunt of the closed right hand" to describe a large-scale military offensive.

Spefik.title: Spefik
Spefik.lead: Spefik was a barren, rocky planet in the Atrivis sector of the Outer Rim Territories. The planet was home to a Rebel base during the Galactic Civil War; however, the base was destroyed by Imperial forces in the battle of Spefik around 0.5 ABY. Imperial pilot Ranulf Trommer distinguished himself in that battle.

Spira.title: Spira/Legends
Spira.lead: Spira was a planet in the Core Worlds. It had beautiful beaches and was a popular resort. It had a low axial tilt, which gave it a large temperate zone over much of its surface.

Spee.title: Spee
Spee.lead: Spee was a celestial body located in the Spee system, a part of the Saijo sector in the Western Reaches portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the site of a spaceport and a number of restaurants as well as at least one hotel.

Spindrift.title: Spindrift
Spindrift.lead: Spindrift was a planet in the Spindrift system, located in the Outer Rim's Rseik sector. An isolated world, Spindrift was home to an Imperial outpost called Spindrift Station during the era of the Galactic Civil War. In 3 ABY, Spindrift Station was attacked by a Rebel squadron flying repurposed TIE starfighters, who captured the station in order to obtain route coordinates for an Imperial armada carrying a unique creature called a teezl.

Spinax III.title: Spinax III
Spinax III.lead: Spinax III was a waterworld in the Spinax system of the Allied Tion sector. It was viewed romantically by many in the Tion Cluster, as it had a famous tradition of leviathan-hunters: for millennia, hunters would take to Spinax's oceans to hunt the planet's immense crustaceans, creatures with minimal but malevolent intelligence and tough, flexible skeletons useful for a range of crafts. However, careless undersea mining polluted Spinax's seas, and the last leviathans died centuries before the Battle of Yavin.

Stalsinek IV.title: Stalsinek IV
Stalsinek IV.lead: Stalsinek IV was an Inner Rim jungle planet located in the Hapes Cluster. It was the site of the Temple of Stalsinek, which in turn contained a fountain that was the source of legendary healing waters. During the Galactic Civil War, two groups of offworlders visited Stalsinek IV in order to acquire a sample of the healing waters, with one of the groups coming into contact with a local tribe of beings that worshiped at the temple.

Spunchina.title: Spunchina
Spunchina.lead: Spunchina was a planet in Wild Space known for its wild orgies. Jabba Desilijic Tiure once participated in one of these orgies and survived.

Spirador.title: Spirador
Spirador.lead: Spirador was the capital planet of the Tandon sector and the site of Moff Harlov Jarnek's palace.

Spoi.title: Spoi

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Metharian Nebula Territories

Spoi.lead: Spoi was the fifth planet in the Kidron system.

Spirana.title: Spirana/Legends
Spirana.lead: Spirana was an location in the Inner Rim Territories. It was situated along the Corellian Run.

Spussion.title: Spussion
Spussion.lead: Spussion was the sixth planet of the Bestine system located in the Inner Rim Territories. Spussion was one of the three gas giants in the star system and had twenty-one moons.

Stamia.title: Stamia
Stamia.lead: Stamia was the sixth planet orbiting the star Tive in the Taanab system. Located in the Inner Rim Territories, it was a gas giant, with 28 moons.

Sprizen.title: Sprizen (disambiguation)
Sprizen.lead: Sprizen may refer to one of the following:

Stalimur.title: Stalimur

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, The Slice, Tion Cluster

Stalimur.lead: Stalimur was an Outer Rim Territories world located in the Tion Hegemony sector. The stormy world featured moors inhabited by a population of farmers known as the Stalimurans, who observed a Tionese winter holiday known as the Devouring. The world was also home to the vicious Stalimur pirates.

Sposia.title: Sposia/Legends
Sposia.lead: Sposia was a planet located in the Sposia system of the Unknown Regions' Chiss Space. The hyperlane known as the Path of the Houses linked it to the Csilla and Naporar systems. Sposia was home to House Sabosen, one of the Ruling Families of the sentient Chiss species, and it was the site of the Chiss Ascendancy's top academies and medcenters.

Spintir.title: Spintir/Legends
Spintir.lead: Spintir was a planet in the Spadja sector of the Outer Rim that was home to a Jedi temple known as the Dawn Temple, and an unusually high number of mammals. Spintir was a wealthy trade world.

Starkiller Base.title: Starkiller Base
Starkiller Base.lead: Starkiller Base, also known as the Starkiller, was a superweapon as well as a series of military installations and shipyards built by the First Order on the ice planet of Ilum in the Unknown Regions. The installations were commanded by an unofficial triumvirate of General Armitage Hux, Kylo Ren, and Captain Phasma, and as such the installation was considered the unofficial capital of the First Order.

Spalex.title: Spalex
Spalex.lead: Spalex was a planet located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories that contained a massive vein of thorilide. The Galactic Empire was dissuaded from mining it by the Spalexians, although the First Order uncovered Imperial survey records and threatened the natives into handing over their reserve before Resistance members intervened.

Stic.title: Stic/Legends
Stic.lead: Stic was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Xappyh sector. It constantly underwent rapid climatic, geological, and biological changes, and is native fauna was forced to be adaptive in order to survive. Stic was home to the sentient Xi'Dec species. The Xi'Dec evolved more than 180 different sexes, a phenomenon that, after the planet was discovered by the Galactic Republic, attracted curious tourists from throughout the galaxy.

Stroiketcy.title: Stroiketcy
Stroiketcy.lead: Stroiketcy was a comet captured in the orbit of the star Yavin. The name "Stroiketcy" came from a Corellian word meaning "tailed one."

Stentat.title: Stentat

facts.routes: Corellian Run, Coruscant–Dantooine hyperlane, Koros Trunk Line, Leisure Corridor, Martial Cross, Metellos Trade Route, Namadii Corridor, Perlemian Trade Route …

Stentat.lead: Stentat was one of two gas giants in the Coruscant system.

Stenos.title: Stenos/Legends
Stenos.lead: Stenos was a planet located in the Spadja sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was homeworld of the Stenax race.

Stennaros.title: Stennaros/Legends
Stennaros.lead: Stennaros was a planet in the Stennaros system, within the Expansion Region's Har Worlds sector. The homeworld of the Near-Human Stennes species and its Force-sensitive, shape-shifting Stennes Shifter offshoots, millennia of both species' persecution led to Stennaros being pock-marked with artillery craters and otherwise scarred. With prejudices against the Stennes Shifters leading to many members of both species being killed, the baseline Stennes were a closed xenophobic society, albeit being socially and culturally advanced within their own system.

Storinal.title: Storinal
Storinal.lead: Storinal was an Outer Rim world. The Galactic Empire defeated the New Republic at the Battle of Storinal. The planet was artistically landscaped with lush green countryside, rivers, hills, tropical flower gardens, beaches and seas, and graceful cities. Because of its inherent beauty, the planet's chief economic resource was tourism. The planet was the homeworld of Storini glass prowlers. Ithorian starfruit was grown on the planet.

Stoga.title: Stoga
Stoga.lead: Stoga was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories. A dry, desert world of large canyons and craggy rock formations, Stoga was largely overlooked by the galactic governments due to its remote location—making it a haven for smugglers, outlaws and mercenaries to keep a low profile.

Stieg.title: Stieg
Stieg.lead: Stieg was a planet in the Outer Rim. It was populated by the Stieg-Fan, who ran a peaceful government. During the planet Kegan's isolationist period, The Learning taught that Stieg was a dangerous place to visit, surrounded in war and without any governing body.

Storthus.title: Storthus
Storthus.lead: Storthus was a desolate planet in the Churba sector of the Mid Rim. It was the homeworld of the giant stone eels, an indigenous species composed of living rock.

Stassia.title: Stassia
Stassia.lead: Stassia was a planet located in the Core Worlds. Its inhabitants were very tolerant under any circumstances. During the Galactic Civil War, Stassia was ruled by the Galactic Empire under the governorship of Tren Pergallis.

Stindaron.title: Stindaron
Stindaron.lead: Stindaron was a gas giant in the Dathomir system, located in the Quelii sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was orbited by twenty moons and occupied the seventh orbital position around the star Domir.

Stovax.title: Stovax
Stovax.lead: Stovax was a planet located in the Core Worlds that the Obroan Institute and Kroddok Stopa intended to excavate.

Stensen's Colony.title: Stensen's Colony
Stensen's Colony.lead: Stensen's Colony was a terrestrial celestial body situated in the Stensen's Colony system, a part of the Stensen sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Ghothian slime pools, which originated in the sector's Ghothia system, could be found there.

Steelious.title: Steelious
Steelious.lead: Steelious was a Core Worlds planet that was located near the world Yarrv. The Hervack Spaceport on Steelious served as an important port for Rebel Alliance smuggling. Shortly after the Battle of Yavin, diplomats from Steelious traveled to Yarrv in order to negotiate a trade agreement with the latter planet's ruling royal family. Yarrv's Baron Karin, in the hopes of subjugating Steelious, planned to assassinate the diplomats, causing a war between the two planets that would benefit the military conglomerate owned by the baron.

Stewjon.title: Stewjon/Legends
Stewjon.lead: Stewjon was a terrestrial planet located in the Stewjon system. It had an atmosphere that allowed Humans to breathe oxygen comfortably. Stewjon was the homeworld of Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi and his family, though he was taken from the planet at a young age for training to become a Jedi.

Stauz Czycz's species homeworld.title: Stauz Czycz's species homeworld
Stauz Czycz's species homeworld.lead: This planet was located in the galaxy. It was the homeworld of an alien species that were razed by the Empire. Stauz Czycz was the only one to survive the Imperial destruction.

Stellan.title: Stellan
Stellan.lead: Stellan was a human male case officer at the Imperial Security Bureau for Bracchia, a Koorivar spy for the Galactic Empire. He and Bracchia were interrogated by Emperor Palpatine himself in an attempt to find conspirators within the Imperial security apparatus.

Sterdic IV.title: Sterdic IV

facts.affiliation: Galactic Empire, Alliance to Restore the Republic

Sterdic IV.lead: Sterdic IV, also known as Sterdic Four, or simply as Sterdic, was a planet located in the Ryndellian sector of the Mid Rim Territories, on the edge of the Outer Rim Territories. Cawa City, located on Sterdic IV, was liberated from Imperial rule by the Alliance to Restore the Republic seventeen days after the Battle of Endor.

Stenness.title: Stenness
Stenness.lead: Stenness was a terrestrial planet in the Airon sector of the Inner Rim Territories. A crime lord operated a massive gambling den on Stenness. The smugglers Han Solo and Sana Starros illegitimately got married on Stenness while robbing the crime lord's gambling den.

Strokill Prime.title: Strokill Prime
Strokill Prime.lead: Strokill Prime was a waterworld in the Outer Rim Territories where the Galactic Empire operated an underwater base. The Mon Calamari king Lee-Char was kept prisoner in the base on Strokill Prime, but was killed by stormtroopers during a Rebel Alliance rescue attempt.

Subterrel.title: Subterrel/Legends
Subterrel.lead: Subterrel was a planet within the Subterrel sector beyond the Outer Rim Territories, widely known for its extensive mining operations.

Sump.title: Sump/Legends
Sump.lead: Sump was planet in the Outer Rim Territories' Koradin sector. It was the homeworld of the easily-manipulated Nuknog species, the leaders of which sold their world to a consortium of mining corporations around 1000 BBY. The Nuknog were then essentially reduced to slavery, working for centuries at offworld mines and factories for no pay while Sump was gradually polluted.

Suolriep.title: Suolriep (disambiguation)
Suolriep.lead: Suolriep may refer to one of the following:

Sucharme.title: Sucharme
Sucharme.lead: Sucharme was a planet affiliated with the Trade Federation prior to the Invasion of Naboo. The Federation's primary garrison, Tallaga Garrison, was located in the city of Tallaga.

Sufezz.title: Sufezz
Sufezz.lead: Sufezz was a planet located in the Outer Rim Territories. It had a Shrine of Kooroo.

Sulphor.title: Sulphor
Sulphor.lead: Sulphor was a planet located within the Velus system of the Core Worlds.

Sunaj IV.title: Sunaj IV
Sunaj IV.lead: Sunaj IV was a planet in the Sunaj system. The Relentless patrolled the vicinity of Sunaj IV prior to the Battle of Hoth.

Sulorine.title: Sulorine/Legends
Sulorine.lead: Sulorine was an Outer Rim Territories celestial body located in the Suolriep sector. Jedi Knight Obi-Wan Kenobi was tasked with an assignment on Suolriep; however, before he could travel there from the planet Coruscant, Jedi Master Mace Windu instead gave him another mission, one involving joining the voyage of the Galactic Republic exploration and colonization starship Outbound Flight.

Suliana.title: Suliana
Suliana.lead: Suliana was an Agriworld in the Senex sector where fields of cotton grew.

Sukkult.title: Sukkult
Sukkult.lead: Sukkult was a planet in the Inner Rim. Residing there was a Herglic collector of Tritonite documents. During the Clone Wars, the planet was located within Separatist space.

Sundari.title: Sundari/Legends
Sundari.lead: Sundari was the domed capital city of the New Mandalorian faction of Mandalorians, located on the Outer Rim world of Mandalore, where it stood alongside Mandalore's traditional capital of Keldabe. Situated within one of Mandalore's white-sand desert regions, the bio-cube city of Sundari hosted a large number of New Mandalorians by the time of the Clone Wars, including the sect's leader, Duchess Satine Kryze. Automated transports ferried individuals from the city's docks into its interior, which was filled with high-technology structures made of permacrete, beskar iron, and transparisteel.

Sulomu.title: Sulomu
Sulomu.lead: Sulomu was an ice planet in the Ansion system, which was located in the Mid Rim's Churnis sector. Its atmosphere was freezing, rendering it uninhabitable.

Sty.title: Sty
Sty.lead: Sty was a gas giant in the Dagobah system of the Outer Rim Territories' Sluis sector. Along with the rest of the star system, it lay on the hyperlane known as the Rimma Trade Route. The planet occupied the fifth orbital position around the star Darlo and had fifty-five moons.

Su Exposs.title: Su Exposs
Su Exposs.lead: Su Exposs was the fourth planet orbiting the star Bright Jewel in the Bright Jewel system. Located in the Bright Jewel sector of the Mid Rim, it was a gas giant.

Sumarin.title: Sumarin
Sumarin.lead: Sumarin was a planet located within the Sumarin system of the Outer Rim Territories.

Stygeon Prime.title: Stygeon Prime

facts.affiliation: Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire (during occupation)

Stygeon Prime.lead: Stygeon Prime, also known simply as Stygeon, was a mountainous, snowy planet located in the Stygeon system of the Outer Rim Territories' Nuiri sector. The world's blizzard conditions made it the perfect location for a prison, as prisoners attempting escape would not survive outside the prison walls unless they could use a local tibidee to fly them to safety.

Sunin.title: Sunin
Sunin.lead: Sunin was a world located in the Tharin sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Many gunrunners of the Sendavé Shared Interest Collective were from Elkkasinn and Sunin.

Suba.title: Suba
Suba.lead: Suba was a planet located in the Atravis sector within the Outer Rim Territories. The Dressellian smuggler Has Obitt found the Malicious Moondog, a cantina on Suba, no more nastier than the cantina on Rajtiri, the Wanton Wellspring.

Stronghold.title: Stronghold
Stronghold.lead: The Stronghold was a Quasar Fire-class cruiser-carrier in service to the Imperial Navy during the Imperial Era. At some point, the cruiser-carrier sustained damage to its hull and lay in a debris field with two TIE/ln space superiority starfighters. The 340-meter-long (1,116 feet) starship was equipped with sublight engines and four hangar bays.

Sunspot.title: Sunspot
Sunspot.lead: Sunspot was an astronomical object in the galaxy. During the Galactic Civil War, Sunspot was the location of the Rebel Alliance's space-bound maximum security penitentiary known as Sunspot Prison.

Sy Myrth.title: Sy Myrth/Legends

facts.affiliation: Xim's Empire, Galactic Republic, Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders, Darth Revan's Sith Empire, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Separatist holdouts …

Sy Myrth.lead: Sy Myrth, formerly known as Far Barseg, was a planet located in the Jospro sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of the Sy Myrthians.

Taanab.title: Taanab/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Sith Empire, Brotherhood of Darkness, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Galactic Federation of Free Alliances

Taanab.lead: Taanab was a planet of green meadows in the Taanab system of the Inner Rim Territories. It was primarily used for agriculture and farming. Its populace was known for always maintaining an air of formality. Taanab had problems with seasonal pirate raids from bandits striking from the planet Norulac for millennia prior to the Battle of Taanab.

T'olan.title: T'olan
T'olan.lead: T'olan was an astronomical object in the Wuun system. Early in the Clone Wars, a terrible battle was fought at T'olan.

Svivren.title: Svivren/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Independent, New Republic, Galactic Federation of Free Alliances, Galactic Alliance Remnant

Svivren.lead: Svivren was a mountainous Outer Rim Territories planet not far from Andasala. It was at the terminus of the Five Veils Route, which connected it to Suarbi. Despite the harsh climate of the world and its severe seasonal variation, the native Svivreni thrived and made it an important regional trading port. Its population of more than eight billion included large colonies of Humans, Sullustans and Ewoks. The source of Svivren's Ewok population was unknown. The importance of trade was reflected in the planet's Festival of Great Trade.

Syndaar.title: Syndaar
Syndaar.lead: Syndaar was the sector capital of the Thrasybule sector, near Celanon. It was the location of the Syndaar Military Prep School.

Surron.title: Surron
Surron.lead: Surron was a world located in the Surron sector of the Expansion Region. It was the homeworld of the Surronians, an insectoid species with a guild-based society. The Surronian were long-respected shipbuilders, renowned for their innovative starship designs. The Surron system hosted shipyards and Surron was the headquarters of the shipwright Surron StarTech.

T'surr.title: T'surr
T'surr.lead: T'surr was a cold and windswept high-gravity planet in the Expansion Region's Nuon e Safyd sector. Most of the planet's lifeforms had excellent low-light vision, and the harsh conditions of the world gave rise to a predatory sentient species also known as the T'surr. T'surr males often left their homeworld for the wider galaxy, but their planet was never represented in the Galactic Republic or the New Republic.

Syvris.title: Syvris/Legends

facts.routes: Hollastin Run, The Sy-Y, Triellus Trade Route
facts.affiliation: Hutt Cartel, Brotherhood of Darkness, Galactic Empire

Syvris.lead: Syvris was a moon in the Outer Rim Territories. It was a favorite haunt of spice smugglers. Many of the moon's residents were smugglers, who lived and worked at a shadowport located in its largest crater.

T'grel.title: T'grel
T'grel.lead: T'grel was the second planet orbiting the star C'rel in the N'zoth system. Located in the Koornacht Cluster of the Core Worlds, it was a searing rock.

T-4.title: T-4

facts.region: Expansion Region, The Slice, Trailing Sectors

T-4.lead: T-4 was a moon orbiting the planet Thaere Privo in the Thaereian system of the Expansion Region.

Swedlan.title: Swedlan
Swedlan.lead: Swedlan was one of the three primary planets that made up the Pimbrellan League. Located in Kathol sector within the Outer Rim Territories, Its atmosphere could not sustain most forms of humanoid life. Sealed domed cities were built in underground cave systems, financed with the profits gained from trade with nearby Dolstan.

Syni IV.title: Syni IV/Legends
Syni IV.lead: Syni IV was a planet located in the Syni system in Wild Space of the galaxy.

Suurja.title: Suurja
Suurja.lead: Suurja was an agrarian planet with a breathable atmosphere that was located within the Suurja system of the Outer Rim Territories and harbored both a native species called Suurjans and a colonist population of 16 million. By the year 3966 BBY, Suurja served as a resource world for the nearby city-covered planet of Taris.

Surcaris.title: Surcaris
Surcaris.lead: Surcaris was a planet in the Mid Rim's Trans-Vulta sector where a group of Mandalorian mercenaries, possibly under Munin Skirata, fought. It was also the location where Munin found a young Kal Skirata.

Tabiid.title: Tabiid
Tabiid.lead: Tabiid was a planet located in the Tabiid system of the Mid Rim that served as a base for the Antarian Rangers during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

Taakarroo.title: Taakarroo

facts.routes: Durkteel Loop, Great Kashyyyk Branch, Nightroad, Randon Run

Taakarroo.lead: Taakarroo was a planet in the Kashyyyk system, occupying the first orbital position around the star Kashyyyk. Taakarroo was a searing rock.

T'var'k.title: T'var'k
T'var'k.lead: T'var'k was the second planet orbiting the star Nagi Prime in the Nagi system. Located in the satellite galaxy Firefist beyond the Unknown Regions, it was a hothouse world.

Syngia.title: Syngia
Syngia.lead: Syngia was a celestial body located in the Syngia system of the Sertar sector, in the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It lay on the hyperlane known as the Shaltin Tunnels, which connected it to the Lianna and Zygerria systems.

Sylvia IV.title: Sylvia IV

facts.government: Clanic (before its discovery), Galactic Republic governor

Sylvia IV.lead: Sylvia IV was a planet and the Sylphe Homeworld, located in the Sylenia V system. It was discovered some decades before the Ruusan Reformation by the Galactic Republic.

Suraz 4.title: Suraz 4
Suraz 4.lead: Suraz 4 was a celestial object in Mirrin sector that was the site of the Suraz engagement between the First Order and the New Republic's Rapier Squadron led by Poe Dameron. It was part of a star system that also contained Suraz 5.

Talay.title: Talay/Legends
Talay.lead: Talay was a oceanic planet located in the Mid Rim.

Taboon.title: Taboon

facts.region: Inner Rim, Stenness Node, The Slice

Taboon.lead: Taboon was a gas giant in the Aweris system. It shared its name with the Taboon hardwood. Bogga the Hutt's palace was on Vo Dasha, a moon orbiting Taboon.

Talfaglio.title: Talfaglio

facts.affiliation: New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire, Five Worlds, Confederation

Talfaglio.lead: Talfaglio was a reddish-orange planet in the Corellian sector.

Talasea.title: Talasea

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Talasea.lead: The fourth planet in the Morobe system, Talasea orbited the yellow primary star in a red/yellow binary group. A cool, moist, forested, and fog-shrouded world, Talasea had a higher gravity than standard and was lashed by severe thunderstorms during the rainy season. Island continents made up its land masses. Animal life included native insects and reptiles, along with feral mammals descended from those brought for an early farming colony, including banthas and rycrits. Indigenous plant life included green ivy, tendril-moss, and the kaha tree.

Tallaan.title: Tallaan

facts.routes: Giju Run, Procopian Shipping Lane, Shapani Bypass

Tallaan.lead: Tallaan was a planet in Tapani sector's Freeworlds Territory at the confluence of the Giju Run, the Procopian Shipping Lane, and the Shapani Bypass. It was best known for its starship production.

Tahlboor.title: Tahlboor

facts.affiliation: Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire

Tahlboor.lead: Tahlboor was a planet in the Thanium sector. It was home to the Tahlbooreans, who were divided into two castes: the Troobs and the Hobors, perpetually at war. In the past, an ancient Tahlboorean civilization had constructed the Sky cannon, an awesome weapon that had resulted in the destruction of both their civilization and one of the world's twin moons.

Talas.title: Talas
Talas.lead: Talas was a dry, rocky, volcanic Outer Rim world located in the Kamdon system in the Calamari sector. It was the headquarters of Tallet and Lekket.

Taboth.title: Taboth

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Alliance of Free Planets, New Republic, Galactic Federation of Free Alliances, Five Worlds, Confederation

Taboth.lead: Taboth was the second planet in the Both system.

Talita.title: Talita
Talita.lead: Talita was the twelfth planet in the Kamino system. It was orbited by six moons.

Tala 9.title: Tala 9
Tala 9.lead: Tala 9 was located within the Tala system of the Inner Rim. It was the location of a droid-controlled factory. The droids discouraged sentients from visiting by only using droid languages to issue landing codes. The system was discontinued after two fully laden passenger liners collided in orbit. The equipment aboard the ships was of an older model, and misinterpreted a landing signal that was intended for vessels with upgraded systems.

Tallaso.title: Tallaso
Tallaso.lead: Tallaso was a planet situated in the Tallaso system, a part of the D'Aelgoth sector in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, the Human Riggins Delahrg served as the Imperial governor of Tallaso. He extorted money from Tallaso's native planetary government and took bribes from galactic business consortiums and crime syndicates that wished to exploit the planet's resources. Delahrg's position ensured a comfortable life for him and was powerful on a local scale—although it was relatively unimportant in the wider context of the Empire.

Talcim Cluster.title: Talcim Cluster/Legends
Talcim Cluster.lead: The Talcim Cluster was an asteroid field in the Cegul sector of the Outer Rim Territories that had a mining facility that was abandoned and forgotten.

Tal Nami.title: Tal Nami
Tal Nami.lead: Tal Nami was a planet located in Hutt Space and was the homeworld of the Tal Nami species.

Taktos.title: Taktos
Taktos.lead: Taktos was the second planet orbiting the star Utapau in the Utapau system. Located in the Tarabba sector of the Outer Rim Territories, it was a searing rock.

Talcene.title: Talcene
Talcene.lead: Talcene was a planet located in the Talcene system, a part of the Talcene sector of the Mid Rim. It was connected to the Orleon and Salvara systems by the Perlemian Trade Route super-hyperroute, which served as a dividing line between the regions known as the Slice and the Trans-Hydian. Talcene shared its name with the Talcene Transit, a hyperspace route linking the Perlemian Trade Route to the Suolriep sector's Saleucami system. The planet's surface featured cityscape.

Talesia.title: Talesia
Talesia.lead: Talesia was a planet known for manufacturing some of the galaxy's deadliest thermal detonators.

Talhovi.title: Talhovi
Talhovi.lead: Talhovi was a Mid Rim world located in the Juvex sector. It was the homeworld of the Mekuun family, with whom the Ancient Houses of the Senex-Juvex region had prohibited trade. Talhovi nevertheless remained economically powerful and exported goods such as Talhovian ale.

Tabor V.title: Tabor V
Tabor V.lead: Tabor V was a planet located in the galaxy. It was the homeworld of the Xyrass. The planet was controlled by a pirate organization known as the Snake's Guild. The Galactic Empire knew its coordinates, but the Imperial authority thought it was unoccupied.

Takodana.title: Takodana
Takodana.lead: Takodana was a remote, neutral planet located in the Mid Rim, though it fell in the southwestern region of the galaxy known as the Western Reaches.

Takobo.title: Takobo
Takobo.lead: Takobo was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories that was home to a number of emigrated species, including Ithorians. The peaceful world boasted colorful architecture with a mix of modern and classical designs. During the Galactic Civil War, two Imperial Inquisitors, the Seventh Sister and the Fifth Brother, captured a Force-sensitive Ithorian named Pypey from the Ithorian settlement known as Hammertown. The infant was rescued by Ezra Bridger and other members of the rebel crew of the starship Ghost.

Talravin.title: Talravin
Talravin.lead: Talravin was a Core Worlds celestial body located on the Hydian Way hyperlane. It was the homeworld of the Human Jedi Knight Bastila Shan. More than three centuries later, it was the site of a casino. A Rodian thief once broke into its vault but accidentally locked himself inside. At some point generations prior to that time, a starship also crashlanded on Talravin, in the process creating a large canyon.

Talus.title: Talus/Legends

facts.routes: Corellian Trade Spine, Corellian Run, Secure Route ID-5N, Trade Route X143
facts.terrain: Forests, Mountains, Grassy plains, Mud flats, Seas
facts.affiliation: Federation of the Double Worlds, Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Galactic Federation of Free Alliances, Five Worlds, Confederation

Talus.lead: Talus was one of the Twin Worlds located in the Corellian system that orbited Centerpoint Station, the other being Tralus, its sister planet.

Tammuz-an.title: Tammuz-an/Legends
Tammuz-an.lead: Tammuz-an was a double-ringed planet in the Outer Rim Territories. The planet's inhabitants, called Tammuz-an, were tall blue- or purple-skinned humanoids governed by a monarchy. The planet was the homeworld of Mon Julpa.

Taloraan.title: Taloraan/Legends

facts.affiliation: Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire

Taloraan.lead: Taloraan was the largest planet in the Kelavine system of the Expansion Region, with a diameter of 100,000 kilometers.

Tandankin.title: Tandankin

facts.affiliation: Galactic Empire, Alliance of Free Planets

Tandankin.lead: Tandankin was a planet located in the Spadja sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Tamazall.title: Tamazall/Legends
Tamazall.lead: Tamazall was a New Republic prison planet located in the Boeus sector of the Expansion Region. Zurga Pass was in its foothills. The planet was protected by the Tamazall Militia. Prisoners were transported via monorail.

Tammar.title: Tammar

facts.affiliation: Xim's Empire, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Tammar.lead: Tammar, originally known as Lelrais, was the Tammarian homeworld. This planet had an unusually thin atmosphere, which caused native Tammarians to evolve a chemical pouch called a chaghizs torm to store oxygen. This allowed them to survive in the vacuum of space for short periods. Tammar also had no standing water.

Tamban.title: Tamban
Tamban.lead: Tamban was an inhabited planet in Core Worlds. From Tamban, the Koornacht Cluster near the Deep Core could be observed through a telescope. It was ruled by Emperor Preedu III before Palpatine rose to power.

Talleles.title: Talleles
Talleles.lead: Talleles was a planet in the Essesia system. It was a smaller than average gas giant with two moons.

Talu.title: Talu
Talu.lead: Talu was the planet in Zsinj space where Han Solo executed the Talu insertion mission during the hunt for Zsinj.

Tancon.title: Tancon/Legends
Tancon.lead: Tancon was a terrestrial planet located in the Tancon system of the Outer Rim Territories' Koradin sector. It was situated at a distance of two days' travel with a starship equipped with a Class 1 hyperdrive from the Soarin system of the Wazta sector. At some point between 0 ABY and 3 ABY, the Rebel Alliance maintained on Tancon a base with a briefing room in it.

Tanda.title: Tanda
Tanda.lead: Tanda the Hutt was a spaceport director who was in charge of part of Nal Hutta's imports and exports during the Galactic Civil War. Following the Battle of Yavin, he was kidnapped by the Zann Consortium.

Tanalou.title: Tanalou
Tanalou.lead: Tanalou was a frozen rock planet with no moons that occupied the fifth and outermost orbital position around the yellow star Baralou within the Baralou system of the Outer Rim Territories' Varada sector.

Tandun III.title: Tandun III

facts.affiliation: Infinite Empire, Galactic Republic, Republic Group, Antarian Rangers, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Tandun III.lead: Tandun III, also known as Tandun Three, was a youthful planet that occupied a young star system in the Outer Rim Territories.

Tandis Four.title: Tandis Four
Tandis Four.lead: Tandis Four was a planet in the Galactic Republic. It was the location of the Museum of Light, which on Count Dooku's orders was destroyed by the Separatists during the Clone Wars, prior to the conclusion of the struggle for control of Drongar. This attack hurt Loyalist morale in the region, and Tannon Praji considered it the greatest tragedy of the Clone Wars, and a heathen act on behalf of Dooku.

Tandgor.title: Tandgor (disambiguation)
Tandgor.lead: Tandgor may refer to one of the following:

Tamarena.title: Tamarena
Tamarena.lead: Tamarena was a gas giant in the Dantooine system, located in the Raioballo sector of the Outer Rim.

Tallek.title: Tallek
Tallek.lead: Tallek was a planet once plagued by thorn fever. The Galactic Empire rounded up anyone who caught the disease and let them die in isolation camps.

Tamboon.title: Tamboon
Tamboon.lead: Tamboon was a planet located in the Tungra sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Once, a cooking droid named L9-G8 prepared a crock of Tauntaun chowder for the Prince of Tamboon.

Tamsye Prime.title: Tamsye Prime
Tamsye Prime.lead: Tamsye Prime was a planet located in the Tamsye Prime system in the Thanium sector in the Outer Rim Territories. During the Clone Wars, the planet produced shell munitions for the Galactic Republic. In 5 BBY, Saw Gerrera abandoned Jyn Erso on the planet whilst on a mission there.

Tantive IV.title: Tantive IV/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Royal Alderaan Civil Fleet, Alliance to Restore the Republic

Tantive IV.lead: The Tantive IV was a CR90 corvette in the service of the Royal House of Alderaan. The ship was a central player in the events following the end of the Clone Wars and the beginning of the Galactic Civil War.

Tangrene.title: Tangrene

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Zsinj's Empire, Thrawn's Confederation, Imperial Remnant, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Tangrene.lead: Tangrene was a planet in the Morshdine sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Tantra.title: Tantra

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Metharian Nebula Territories
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire

Tantra.lead: Tantra was a planet in the eponymous Tantra sector on the Outer Rim. It lay on the major hyperlane known as the Rimma Trade Route was located at a hyperspace junction, where the Route joined the subsidiary Coyn Run.

Tanjay IV.title: Tanjay IV
Tanjay IV.lead: Tanjay IV was a powerful world located in the Core Worlds. During the Alsakan Conflicts, it was allied with the Galactic Republic's capital world, Coruscant. In 22 BBY, during the Separatist Crisis, Tanjay IV's Republic representative Nemrileo irm-Drocubac was part of Commerce Guild Presidente Shu Mai's plot to achieve the secession of a number of Republic worlds. However, for his doubts in Mai's leadership, irm-Drocubac was murdered in what appeared to be a traffic accident on Coruscant.

Tantajoc V.title: Tantajoc V
Tantajoc V.lead: Tantajoc V was a jungle-covered planet in the Tantajo system of the Mid Rim Halori sector. Tantajoc V orbited a binary star and was completely uninhabited by sentients as of 3 ABY, although its harsh and humid forests teemed with dangerous predators. After fleeing a coup on nearby Velmor in 17 BBY, Velmorian crown prince Denid and his retainer Jedidiah crash-landed on Tantajoc V, where they survived for the next 20 years in a hostile environment.

Taoska.title: Taoska
Taoska.lead: Taoska was the fifth planet orbiting the star Tyrius in the Tyrius system. Located in the Savareen sector of the Outer Rim Territories, it was an ice ball that was visible from Rodia.

Tanzis.title: Tanzis system/Legends
Tanzis.lead: The Tanzis system was a star system located in the Tapani sector's Mecetti Province, on the Leozi Route.

Tanya.title: Tanya
Tanya.lead: Tanya was a planet located in the Tapani sector's Tanya system. The rebel cell known as Shimper Ale maintained a manor house on Tanya. The planet produced vast harvests of grain and vegetables each year and was an important agricultural producer of the sector.

Tantive V.title: Tantive V

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, New Territories, Trans-Hydian

Tantive V.lead: Tantive V was a planet in the Tantive system of Kwymar sector. It was the location of the Battle of Tantive V, after the Battle of Endor. The New Republic won the battle, causing the retreat of Gaen Drommel to Soullex.

Tao-Grant.title: Tao-Grant
Tao-Grant.lead: Tao-Grant was a gas giant, the sole planet in the Tao-Grant system. It was orbited by at least two moons.

Tarassi.title: Tarassi
Tarassi.lead: Tarassi was the second planet orbiting the binary stars Adega Prime and Adega Besh in the Adega system. Located in the Auril sector of the Outer Rim, it was a barren rock.

Tar Morden.title: Tar Morden

facts.affiliation: Confederacy of Independent Systems, Alliance to Restore the Republic

Tar Morden.lead: Tar Morden was a planet located in the Tar Morden system, within the Vensensor sector of the galaxy's Expansion Region, along the Corellian Trade Spine. It was the site of a Confederacy of Independent System facility that manufactured LM-432 crab droids. These Techno Union factories were taken by the Galactic Republic during the Battle of Tar Morden at the end of the Clone Wars, and tens of thousands of crab droids were captured. These droids were eventually used in live-fire stormtrooper training exercises at the Imperial Academy on the planet Carida.

Taraloon.title: Taraloon

facts.region: Expansion Region, Quintar Nebula, The Slice

Taraloon.lead: Taraloon was an uncharted planet that served as base of operations of the pirate, Drek Drednar and his crew, who had built a base there. Native to the planet were the reptilian Gornalak.

Tangar.title: Tangar

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems

Tangar.lead: Tangar was a site of CIS activity during the Clone Wars. A flotila of starships dropped out of hyperspace off Tangar, then jumped again.

Taral V.title: Taral V
Taral V.lead: Taral V was a planet controlled by the Sith Empire during the Cold War. During the Cold War, a Galactic Republic strike team was sent to Taral V to retrieve information on a missing Jedi. The planet was home to many dangerous species.

Taratos IV.title: Taratos IV
Taratos IV.lead: Taratos IV was a planet located in the Taratos system, in the Inner Rim. During the Clone Wars, the scientist Bant'ena Fhernan traveled to Niriktavi Bay on Taratos IV to study the world's Niriktavi coral, which Fhernan suspected had some antibacterial properties. However, while Fhernan and her team were on the planet, the Confederacy of Independent Systems annexed the world. Large numbers of battle droids landed on Taratos IV and killed Fhernan's team, while Fhernan herself was captured.

Tanthior.title: Tanthior
Tanthior.lead: Tanthior was a planet located in the Corellian sector of the Core Worlds.
