Tantara.title: Tantara
Tantara.lead: Tantara was a planet located in the Inner Rim.

Tansyl 5.title: Tansyl 5
Tansyl 5.lead: Tansyl 5, also known simply as Tansyl, was a planet that was the homeworld of the Frigosian species. Due to its atmosphere being different from that of Takodana, the Frigosians Thromba and Laparo wore breathing apparatuses around where a humanoid nose would be during their time on Takodana.

Tangenine.title: Tangenine
Tangenine.lead: Tangenine was a planet located in the Core Worlds' Tangenine sector. It was home to the norango bush farmers Remba and Kelven and their children Lauren Mel Coelho and Julien. One of the world's syndicates, the Malandro syndicate, charged protection fees from Remba and Kelven until Remba refused to pay them, leading to the murder of the couple and their workers. The syndicates later gained prominence when the Separatist Alliance dealt damage to Tangenine's infrastructure during the Clone Wars.

Taris.title: Taris/Legends

facts.population: 60 billion (4156 BBY), 6 billion (3956 BBY), 30% Human, 70% other, 1 billion (3 ABY)
facts.affiliation: Taris Civil Authority, Galactic Republic, Exchange, Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders, Jedi Order, Darth Revan's Sith Empire, Outcasts (Dark Age) …

Taris.lead: Taris was an urban planet in the fifth orbit of its star, located in the Taris system, within the Ojoster sector, of the Outer Rim Territories. Taris was orbited by four moons, including an anomalous moon nicknamed "Rogue Moon." The term Tarisian was used to describe people and products from the planet, which took over a millennium to build, after being settled by Human colonists from unknown origins. Eventually, Alien species settled or visited the city, and before long the Republic took notice of the world.

Taspir III.title: Taspir III

facts.terrain: Volcanoes, Mountains, Lakes of molten lava

Taspir III.lead: Taspir III was a mountainous planet located in the Outer Rim Territories.

Tarkin's Fang.title: Tarkin's Fang
Tarkin's Fang.lead: Tarkin's Fang was a planet located in the Deep Core, near the Treskov system. It was the location of a secret Galactic Empire base. However, the Empire abandoned it at the end of the Galactic Civil War, sealing it up well stocked for use as a base should another war with the New Republic break out.

Tasariq.title: Tasariq

facts.climate: Temperate (crater bottoms), Hot and cool extremes (surface)

Tasariq.lead: Tasariq was a planet in the Inner Rim. It was a barren world with atmosphere-filled craters and tasar crystals. Tasariq joined the Republic in 22 BBY. It was later part of the Galactic Empire. Barimoq Industries, a Tasari-run corporation that produced a variety of personal projectile weapons, was based on Tasariq.

Tarsa.title: Tarsa
Tarsa.lead: Tarsa was a forested planet in the Tarsa system, which was located in the Mid Rim.

Targonn.title: Targonn/Legends
Targonn.lead: Targonn was a planet located in the Outer Rim Territories. This mountainous planet was the homeworld of the sentient Targonnian species. It was ruled by Dictator-Forever Craw until it was liberated by the Revoltists with the help of C-3PO and R2-D2.

Tarhassan.title: Tarhassan

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems

Tarhassan.lead: Tarhassan was a planet in the Expansion Region. It was controlled by the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.

Tas-La.title: Tas-La
Tas-La.lead: Tas-La was a world in the Si'Klaata Cluster of Hutt Space.

Tarnoonga.title: Tarnoonga/Legends
Tarnoonga.lead: Tarnoonga was an ocean-covered planet located in the Arkanis sector.

Tarnith.title: Tarnith
Tarnith.lead: Tarnith was an Outer Rim Territories world situated in the Ojoster sector. It was a resource world for the planet Taris, and in 3966 BBY, it began to be threatened by the Mandalorian Neo-Crusader warriors. Subsequently the Galactic Republic established a protective security cordon, the Jebble-Vanquo-Tarnith line, around Taris. The Mandalorians nevertheless eventually established both a staging area and an armor-and-weapons-producing War Forge on Tarnith.

Tartaglia.title: Tartaglia
Tartaglia.lead: Tartaglia was a planet located in the Tartaglia system, a part of the Hollan sector in the New Territories portion of the Mid Rim. Hyperlanes linked it to the Asamin system in the Strabin sector, the Nicandra system in the sector of the same name, and the Vectinia system of the Hewett sector.

Tashtor Seneca.title: Tashtor Seneca
Tashtor Seneca.lead: Tashtor Seneca was a location in the Tashtor Seneca system, a part of the Mid Rim's Tashtor sector. During the Galactic Civil War, the forces of the Galactic Empire destroyed the Croc of Gold, the freighter of the Rebel Alliance operative Devon Fuller, over Tashtor Seneca.

Taspan II.title: Taspan II
Taspan II.lead: Taspan II was a planet in the Taspan system, in the Inner Rim. The Galactic Empire had a weapons facility on the planet, where gravity well projectors were tested by Imperial scientists. However, the facility was abandoned and the planet destroyed during the cataclysmic Big Crush. After the destruction of Taspan II, floating debris from the former planet played a role in the Battle of Mindor in 5 ABY and the subsequent destruction of the system.

Taris asteroid belt.title: Taris asteroid belt
Taris asteroid belt.lead: The Taris asteroid belt was located in the Taris system. It contained a number of asteroids orbiting the sun, including the Rogue Moon which orbited in the opposite direction to the rest.

Taskeed.title: Taskeed/Legends

facts.affiliation: Xim's empire, Confederacy of Independent Systems

Taskeed.lead: Taskeed was a planet located within the Outer Rim Territories. Originally known as Taskored, it was absorbed into Xim's empire as he expanded his borders from the Kingdom of Cron. During his campaigns, Xim tested a powerful weapon on Taskeed, leaving behind a massive crater that became known as the Pentakus Crater.

Taronda.title: Taronda
Taronda.lead: Taronda was a remote mining world. During the Clone Wars, Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker and his padawan, Ahsoka Tano were sent by the Jedi Council to negotiate a trading agreement with the miners of the planet for raw materials for the Republic. Before negotiations could start however, the planet was attacked by the Separatists. Outnumbering the Republic forces, the Separatists had them pinned down under their own deflector shield. The Republic forces were saved by the arrival of a Venator-class Star Destroyer.

Taria II.title: Taria II
Taria II.lead: Taria II was a planet that was known for its swamps and ravines.

Tarivo III.title: Tarivo III
Tarivo III.lead: Tarivo III was a planet located in the Lantillian sector of the Mid Rim.

Tarawa.title: Tarawa
Tarawa.lead: Tarawa was a celestial body located in the Tarawa system, a part of the Steniplis sector in the Western Reaches portion of the Outer Rim Territories. At some point between 2 BBY and 0 BBY, the Rebel Alliance prevailed over the Galactic Empire at a confrontation at Tarawa.

Tarshan.title: Tarshan (disambiguation)
Tarshan.lead: Tarshan may refer to one of the following:

Tatooine.title: Tatooine/Legends

facts.routes: 5709-DC Shipping Lane, Corellian Skip Run, The Crystal Passage, Old Corellian Run, Rycar's Run, Tatooine Dash, Triellus Trade Route
facts.population: 80,000–200,000:, 70% Humans, 5% Tusken Raiders, 5% Jawas, 20% other, 5,000–10,000 settlers (Historic), Unknown indigenous population
facts.species: Tusken Raider, Kumumgah, Jawas, Mongo Beefhead, Cliffborer worm (intelligent descendants)
facts.language: Bocce, Galactic Basic Standard, Huttese, Jawaese, Tusken, Historic:, Kumumgah language, Rakata
facts.affiliation: Infinite Empire, Czerka Corporation, Hutt Cartel, Besadii kajidic, Gardulla the Elder's criminal empire, Desilijic kajidic …

Tatooine.lead: Tatooine (pronounced /tætu'in/; Jawaese: Tah doo Een e) was a desert world and the first planet in the binary Tatoo star system. It was part of the Arkanis sector in the Outer Rim Territories. It was inhabited by poor locals who mostly farmed moisture for a living. Other activities included used equipment retailing and scrap dealing. The planet was on the 5709-DC Shipping Lane, a spur of the Triellus Trade Route, which itself connected to the Sisar Run. The planet was not far from the Corellian Run. It had its own navigation system.

Tava Yagen.title: Tava Yagen Asteroid Belt/Legends
Tava Yagen.lead: Tava Yagen was an asteroid belt in the Bovo Yagen system. Several of the asteroids had deposits of Durelium, Quadrillium and Hfredium along with prismatic crystals that were sent to Trellar Yagen for processing.

Taul.title: Taul/Legends
Taul.lead: Taul was a swamp planet in the Gunthar system of the Outer Rim.

Tati.title: Tati
Tati.lead: Tati was a planet located in the Bellassa system of the Core Worlds. Ferus Olin and Roan Lands once vacationed on the planet, where they found a tranquil waterfall-fed pool deep in the forest.

Te Hasa.title: Te Hasa/Legends
Te Hasa.lead: Te Hasa was a desert planet with a Type II atmosphere that was located within the Gree Enclave, a part of the Outer Rim Territories region of the galaxy. A hidden planet that had been terraformed by members of the sentient Gree species into a harsh desert world with bioengineered predators, Te Hasa was used for thousands of years to store many pieces of ancient Gree technology that the cephalopod species had forgotten how to use.

Tauber.title: Tauber
Tauber.lead: Tauber was an Inner Rim world that lay on the Rimma Trade Route super-hyperroute. In 214 BBY, an antidote to the disease known as the Bordal Contagion was created on Tauber. Two centuries later, a hospital on Tauber was where the A4 laboratory assistant droid designated EV-A4-D began his service, while Neuro-Saav Corporation ran material-design laboratories on the world by 2 ABY. Doctor Cinto Alaras and the undercover Rebel Alliance Agent Sommen both worked at the Neuro-Saav facilities.

Tazan.title: Tazan
Tazan.lead: Tazan was a planet in the Expansion Region.

Taxiode.title: Taxiode
Taxiode.lead: Taxiode was a toxic rock planet that lacked moons and occupied the third closest orbital position to the star Abo. It was located within the Lehon system, a part of the Unknown Regions' area known as the Tempered Wastes.

Taum Reese.title: Taum Reese
Taum Reese.lead: Taum Reese was the third planet orbiting the star Tive in the Taanab system. Located in the Inner Rim, it was a terrestrial world.

Tay'ah'loo.title: Tay'ah'loo
Tay'ah'loo.lead: Tay'ah'loo was a planet in Imperial Space. In 1 ABY, an unscheduled capsule carrying Bledsoe's disease landed on the planet. The plague was released and decimated the population of Tay'ah'loo within days. Stormtroopers soon arrived to cart away the dead and disinfect the planet.

Tasrin.title: Tasrin
Tasrin.lead: Tasrin was a planet located in the Colonies.

Tastini.title: Tastini
Tastini.lead: Tastini was a planet in the Chamberlam system.

Tatrang I.title: Tatrang I
Tatrang I.lead: Tatrang I was a hot rock planet with no moons that was located within the Tatrang system, a part of the Tammuz sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The planet occupied the closest orbit to its star, the red giant Tatrang. Tatrang I was lifeless and was considered commercially worthless.

Tatrang II.title: Tatrang II
Tatrang II.lead: Tatrang II was a searing rock planet with no moons that was located within the Tatrang system, a part of the Tammuz sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It occupied the second closest orbit around the system's star, the red giant Tatrang. The planet was lifeless and was considered to be commercially worthless.

Tatrang III.title: Tatrang III
Tatrang III.lead: Tatrang III was a poisonous jungle planet with three moons that was located within the Tatrang system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Tammuz sector. It occupied the third closest orbit around the system's star, the red giant Tatrang. The planet was uninhabitable and considered to be commercially worthless.

Tatrang V.title: Tatrang V
Tatrang V.lead: Tatrang V was the fifth planet of the Tatrang system, located in the Tammuz sector of the Outer Rim. It was a desolate mountainous world with two moons.

Tatrang VI.title: Tatrang VI
Tatrang VI.lead: Tatrang VI was a ringed gas giant–type planet with twenty-three moons that was located within the Tatrang system, a part of the Tammuz sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It occupied the sixth orbital position around the system's star, the red giant Tatrang. The planet was considered to hold little economic value.

Tatrang VII.title: Tatrang VII
Tatrang VII.lead: Tatrang VII was a ringed gas giant–type planet with eleven moons that was located within the Tatrang system, a part of the Tammuz sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It occupied the seventh orbital position around the system's star, the red giant Tatrang. The planet was considered to hold little economic value.

Tatrang VIII.title: Tatrang VIII
Tatrang VIII.lead: Tatrang VIII was an asteroid belt in the eighth orbital position of the Tatrang system, located in the Tammuz sector of the Outer Rim.

Taypho.title: Taypho
Taypho.lead: Taypho was a planet located in the Mid Rim, away from the major hyperlanes.

Tejrivozs.title: Tejrivozs

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Tejrivozs.lead: Tejrivozs was a planet in the trinary star system of Riflorii. It was a colony of the Advozsec and was controlled by a powerful crime family. It was left alone by the Yuuzhan Vong.

Telfrey.title: Telfrey
Telfrey.lead: Telfrey was a planet in the Mid Rim's Trans-Nebular sector that was home to a native sentient species called the Telfreyans, and also supported a population of Humans during the Imperial Period. Among the Humans who called Telfrey home were Tay Vanis and Yom Argo, who later left home to serve the Rebel Alliance as spies. Vanis and Argo later returned to Telfrey to investigate reports of increased Imperial activity in the region, and eventually Telfrey erupted in open rebellion.

Tefau.title: Tefau
Tefau.lead: Tefau was a location in the Tefau system of the Outer Rim Territories' Suolriep sector. Soth Petikkin, a Tefaun who worked as a recruiter for the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War, was from Tefau.

Tel IV.title: Tel IV
Tel IV.lead: Tel IV was a planet located in the Halthor sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Telil Menin.title: Telil Menin
Telil Menin.lead: Telil Menin was a planet in the Leria Kerlsil system. The first planet in the system consisted of barren rock with no moons.

Teh'Jar II.title: Teh'Jar II
Teh'Jar II.lead: Teh'Jar II was a planet that occupied the second orbital position in the Teh'Jar system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Minos Cluster. During the Galactic Civil War, the Galactic Empire began to use armed patrols to enforce a high technology ban there.

Tegrat.title: Tegrat
Tegrat.lead: Tegrat was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Koradin sector. During the Galactic Civil War, the Galactic Empire launched an invasion of Tegrat's star system, causing numerous inhabitants of the planet to rush toward the local spaceport and many starships fleeing Tegrat. Among the vessels that hastily left Tegrat was the light freighter Sidewinder, aboard which several individuals had booked passage to the planet Tatooine.

Teevan.title: Teevan/Legends
Teevan.lead: Teevans were a species from Teevan. Their bodies were highly flexible and able to bend in ways most humanoids found difficult to impossible. They also had silver-hued skin. Jedi apprentice Tru Veld was a Teevan.

Telerath.title: Telerath/Legends

facts.species: 30% Human, 10% Arkanian and Arkanian Offshoots, 60% other

Telerath.lead: Telerath was an Inner Rim banking world, the home of the Telerath Interstellar Banking Initiative. It was created as an experiment in face-to-face customer service by an interstellar bank. Customers were guaranteed to meet with living bank representatives, did not need to make scheduled appointments, and were offered a fantastic variety of comforting recreational activities and accommodations.

Teardrop.title: Teardrop
Teardrop.lead: Teardrop was a planet located in Shelsha sector. It contained Por'ste Island and was near Briston.

Telkadis.title: Telkadis
Telkadis.lead: Telkadis was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Telkadis system, a part of the Greater Plooriod sector in the Northern Dependencies portion of the Expansion Region. Its surface featured forests of taku trees. The area was home to the rodent known as the volete as well as the predatory arachnid known as the Telkadis hiding tree spider. The latter burrowed into the taku trees, from which they ambushed prey such as voletes and also attacked Telkadian foresters and loggers when their host trees were threatened.

Technology-deficient planet.title: Technology-deficient planet
Technology-deficient planet.lead: The "technology-deficient planet" was a technologically primitive planet inhabited by Humans, or Near-Humans. Their technology had not developed beyond the use of horses, slugthrowers, and metal swords. They had no advanced technology whatsoever.

Tel III.title: Tel III

facts.government: Alliance to Restore the Republic Sector Command

Tel III.lead: Tel III was the third planet of the Tel Minor system, located in the Expansion Region.

Tedel.title: Tedel
Tedel.lead: Tedel was a planet. It was home to the besiioth.

Tekurr'k.title: Tekurr'k
Tekurr'k.lead: Tekurr'k was a planet located within the Tekurr'k system of the Mid Rim's Senex sector.

Telepan.title: Telepan
Telepan.lead: Telepan was a planet located within the Telepan system of the Core Worlds.

Tel II.title: Tel II
Tel II.lead: Tel II was the second planet of the Tel Minor system, located in the Expansion Region. It was a small ball of rock.

Tel I.title: Tel I
Tel I.lead: Tel I was the innermost planet of the Tel Minor system, located in the Expansion Region. It was a small ball of rock.

Teagan.title: Teagan

facts.population: 350 million:, 85% Devon, 4% Mirialans, 3% Neimoidians, 3% Humans, 5% others

Teagan.lead: Teagan was a planet in the Kwymar sector of the Outer Rim.

Tei-Untis.title: Tei-Untis
Tei-Untis.lead: Tei-Untis was a planet inhabited by Zabraks that was located in the Tei-Untis system of the Core Worlds and the Interior. It was situated in grid square K-10 of the Standard Galactic Grid. A kleptocracy, it was governed by thieves. Some of the most skilled pickpockets in the galaxy were trained at the Tei-Untisian School of Ribbons.

Telos IV.title: Telos IV

facts.terrain: Beach, Canyons, Cityscape, Forest, Gorges, Grasslands, Hills, Mountains, Polar region
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Telos Security Force, Darth Revan's Sith Empire, Telosian Council, Chodo Habat's Ithorian herd, Exchange, Czerka Corporation, Jedi Order …

Telos IV.lead: Telos IV, often called simply Telos, was the fourth world within the Telos system, located in the Outer Rim's Kwymar sector. Situated on the strategically important Hydian Way hyperlane, on the edge of Galactic Republic-controlled space, the Telosian military and economic power bases were considered vital to the survival of the Republic. In addition, the planet played host to the Agricultural Corps, where Jedi who had failed their training were sent to work as farmers and laborers. During one of the earliest battles of the Jedi Civil War, Telos was devastated by forces of the Sith Empire.

Terephon.title: Terephon

facts.region: Inner Rim, Transitory Mists, The Slice
facts.affiliation: Hapes Consortium, Galactic Federation of Free Alliances

Terephon.lead: Terephon was a planet in the Hapes Cluster, located in the Transitory Mists. The Mists, which blocked all long-range and holocomm transmissions, ensured Terephon's isolation and helped shape its reputation as a backwater in the Consortium. Nevertheless, rising from the marshy plains of the planet were Hapan cities and mountain ranges; the world became popular for hunting, and wealthy nobles often built retreats on Terephon.

Telti.title: Telti/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Techno Union, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Telti.lead: Telti was a moon located in the Inner Rim.

Terra Sool.title: Terra Sool

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Terra Sool militia

Terra Sool.lead: Terra Sool was a planet located within the Terra Sool system of the Expansion Region. It was liberated from the Confederacy of Independent Systems by Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi in 22 BBY, during the Clone Wars.

Teloc Ol-sen.title: Teloc Ol-sen
Teloc Ol-sen.lead: Teloc Ol-sen was a desert planet located within the Teloc Ol-sen system of the Mid Rim that was inhabited by the Teloc Hunters. At some point before 2 ABY, the vigilante group known as the Zulirian Swordmasters fought and massacred a Rebel cell on Teloc Ol-sen. Members of Alliance Intelligence later wrote a report on this event.

Tepasi.title: Tepasi/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, New Republic, Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire

Tepasi.lead: Tepasi was a planet located within the Tepasi system of the Core Worlds. A forested world situated on the Commenor Run, it was colonized by Humans before 26,000 BBY and was already emerging as a hub of commerce when it became a founding member of the Galactic Republic. In 200 BBY, Tarzen Tagge provided aid to the planet after it experienced a series of groundquakes, precipitating the crime lord's founding of the Tagge Company.

Tentator.title: Tentator
Tentator.lead: Tentator was a planet located within the Tentator system of the Colonies, used as a prison by the Galactic Republic. The Slam gang escaped from the Greylands Security Complex on-planet, but were recaptured and returned to the poorly-maintained high-security prison, along with their ship, an Ubrikkian star yacht.

Tellanroaeg.title: Tellanroaeg

facts.affiliation: Hutts, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire

Tellanroaeg.lead: Tellanroaeg was an Outer Rim Territories astronomical object. It was located on the Corellian Run super-hyperroute in the Gaulus sector. During the Clone Wars, Tellanroaeg became the site of a battle between the forces of the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems. In 19 BBY, Order 66, a contingency order issued to the clone commanders of the Grand Army of the Republic, reached Tellanroaeg.

Terana Asteroids.title: Terana
Terana Asteroids.lead: Terana was an asteroid belt that was located in the Vernet system, within the Expansion Region of the galaxy.

Telos.title: Telos
Telos.lead: Telos was an astronomical object located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories, along the Hydian Way. During the campaign at Salient, an Imperial battle group was stationed at Telos under the command of Admiral Utu. Moff Wilhuff Tarkin requested that Utu dispatch whatever vessels she could spare from Telos to Salient, and was later informed by a commander that Utu hoped to send two Star Destroyers.

Tenupe.title: Tenupe
Tenupe.lead: Tenupe was a mountainous and tropical planet located within the Tenupe system that was located in the Utegetu Nebula of Wild Space and was on the Sparkle Run. It was orbited by the Shattered Moon. It had multiple inland seas and was controlled by the Killiks; however the planet was captured by the Chiss during the Battle of Tenupe of the Swarm War in 36 ABY. Jagged Fel and Alema Rar spent two years marooned on the planet after the Dark Nest Crisis taking away a Twi'lek story-chain from there.

Ter Abbes.title: Ter Abbes
Ter Abbes.lead: Ter Abbes was a grim industrialized planet located within the Ter Abbes system of the Expansion Region, just off the Perlemian Trade Route. Its government was democratically elected, but prone to instability, as was proven when Nom Anor contracted Mandalorian mercenary Goran Beviin to assassinate Tholote B'Leph, an opposition politician just prior to an election. The civil war ignited by his death was still in progress in 25 ABY.

Terr'skiar.title: Terr'skiar
Terr'skiar.lead: Terr'skiar was a trade world located in the Terr'skiar system, a part of the Kashyyyk Region's Terr'skiar sector in the Slice portion of the Mid Rim. The hyperlanes known as the Nightroad and the Ootmian Pabol linked it to the Pizilis system and the Coachelle and New Apsolon systems, respectively, while the Terr'skiar Pass route connected it to the Trax sector's Bissillirus system. Terr'skiar served as the capital of the Terr'skiar sector.

TerraAsta.title: TerraAsta
TerraAsta.lead: TerraAsta was a planet located within the TerraAsta system of the Colonies.

Tentrix.title: Tentrix
Tentrix.lead: Tentrix was a vast, beautiful blue planet located within the Tentrix system of the Expansion Region.

Terrelia.title: Terrelia/Legends
Terrelia.lead: Terrelia was a celestial body located in the Terrelia system of the Inner Rim. It was the homeworld of the Terrelian Jango Jumper thief Cassie Cryar.

Teptixii.title: Teptixii
Teptixii.lead: Teptixii was a blue-green planet located in the Teptixii system of the Unknown Regions. In 0 ABY, the Galactic Empire Task Force Admonitor commanded by Captain Voss Parck engaged alien Warlord Nuso Esva's eight Firekiln warships and twenty-seven escort ships alongside Captain Calo Drusan's Imperial Star Destroyer Chimaera over the planet. Nuso Esva—posing as Imperial Court member Lord Odo aboard the Chimaera—advised Drusan to divide his ships by coming behind them, which was successful in prompting them to retreat to hyperspace.

Tenara.title: Tenara
Tenara.lead: Tenara was a planet that was located in the Tenara system. It was situated in the Back Reach area of the Gordian Reach sector, within the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. A small hyperlane connected Tenara to the planet Korphir.

Temako.title: Temako/Legends
Temako.lead: Temako was a planet located in the Outer Rim Territories of the galaxy. The world was the location of Keizar-Volvec's manufacturing headquarters during the Galactic Civil War.

Tenek.title: Tenek
Tenek.lead: Tenek was a human cook who worked at Hotel Rix on the planet Ferrix while the building was used as a base of operation by the Galactic Empire. In 5 BBY, Tenek entered the kitchen with a tray while a funeral procession was taking place outside for the local woman Maarva Andor. Once in the kitchen, Tenek found himself held at blaster point by Maarva's son, Cassian, but the intruder lowered the weapon once he recognized the cook.

Teta.title: Teta/Legends
Teta.lead: Teta was the Empress of the Koros system in 5000 BBY, the instigator of the Unification Wars of Koros, and a key military commander in the Great Hyperspace War. Born into nobility on the wealthy planet of Koros Major, Teta eventually inherited the Koros empire; she quickly became known as the "Warrior Empress," after leading her army into battle and personally foiling many assassination attempts.

Teyr.title: Teyr/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Galactic Federation of Free Alliances

Teyr.lead: Teyr was a bureaucratic and tourism planet located in the Surric system of the Colonies.

Teya IV.title: Teya IV
Teya IV.lead: Teya IV was a planet located within the Teya system of the Expansion Region and was the homeworld of the Strak. It was where Willm Lywin founded the Teyan Praxeum in 4600 BBY. In 4000 BBY, Mistress Tannis taught Vici Ramunee and Veni Ramunee at the Praxeum. This is where the Teyan Apologia was written. The planet was made up of many villages and hamlets, with no real colonization.

Thaere Privo.title: Thaere Privo

facts.region: Expansion Region, The Slice, Trailing Sectors

Thaere Privo.lead: Thaere Privo was a planet located within the Thaereian system of the Expansion Region. The Galactic Senate tasked Thaere with protecting the Cularin system in a neighboring sector. Thaere joined the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.

Thalassia.title: Thalassia/Legends
Thalassia.lead: Thalassia was a planet located within the Thalassian system of the Outer Rim Territories. It was one of the slavery capitals of the outer rim and the location of the Thalassian slavers' base of operations and the home planet of the Thalassians.

Thandruss.title: Thandruss
Thandruss.lead: Thandruss was a terrestrial planet located in the Expansion Region's Thand sector. It was the homeworld of the Krytollaks, warm-blooded sentients with hard outer shells. Krytollaks had a society consisting of a worker class and a royal class and were ruled by a global absolute monarchy.

Th'irus.title: Th'irus
Th'irus.lead: Th'irus was a planet located within the Th'irus system of the Wild Space.

Tervissis.title: Tervissis
Tervissis.lead: Tervissis was a planet located within the Tervissis system of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of two sentient species, the Tervigs and the Bandies. The two species were at war with one another, with the Tervigs subjugating the Bandies.

Teth.title: Teth/Legends

facts.affiliation: Hutts, B'omarr Order, Smugglers, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire

Teth.lead: Teth was the third planet orbiting the star of the same name and had two moons that orbited the planet itself. It was located within the Teth system of the Baxel sector in the outer border of the Outer Rim region of the galaxy that crossed over into the Wild Space region.

Thakwaa.title: Thakwaa/Legends
Thakwaa.lead: Thakwaa was a temperate planet dominated by grassy plains that was located in the Thakwaa system of the Tunka sector in the Outer Rim Territories. It was an isolated world that attracted little attention from the Galactic Empire until the end of the Galactic Civil War. The Empire gave up trying to take over this planet due to its native species' unpredictable nature's as well as their size and strength, not because the planet was useless.

Tertiary Kesmere.title: Tertiary Kesmere
Tertiary Kesmere.lead: Tertiary Kesmere was a cloudy, storm-wracked world located in the Tertiary Kesmere system, a part of the Raioballo sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of the winged hornagaunt species, including the wing-clipped pet Grendel. Between 4 ABY and 12 ABY, Tertiary Kesmere fell within the borders of the Pentastar Alignment.

Thaldo.title: Thaldo
Thaldo.lead: Thaldo was a planet located within the Thaldo system of the Mid Rim. The Rebel cell on Thaldo was one of many infiltrated by Nagai spies some time following the Battle of Yavin.

Thabit.title: Thabit
Thabit.lead: Thabit was a planet located within the Thabit system of the Inner Rim. Local Maiferri Tag was a Rebel spy arrested and executed by the Galactic Empire shortly before the suicide of Keth Beamis.

Thanut.title: Thanut

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire, Galactic Federation of Free Alliances, Confederation

Thanut.lead: Thanut was a celestial body in the same system as Fondor.

Thanos.title: Thanos

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Greater Maldrood, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Thanos.lead: Thanos was a planet located in the Thanos system of the Taldot sector. During the Clone Wars, the planet was located within Separatist space. During the Imperial Era, it contained an Imperial shipyard that was kept under tight control. The shipyard produced exclusively Imperial-class Star Destroyers. By 4 ABY, Thanos had become an Imperial fortress world. After the Battle of Endor, the planet and its shipyard fell under control of High Admiral Treuten Teradoc's Greater Maldrood. Thanos was eventually captured by the New Republic in 8 ABY.

Thanium.title: Thanium
Thanium.lead: Thanium was a planet located within the Thanium system of the Outer Rim Territories. It was absorbed into Xim's Empire as he expanded his borders from the Kingdom of Cron.

Tetso.title: Tetso Shopping Worlds
Tetso.lead: The Tetso Shopping Worlds were a group of planets located within the Tetso system, in the Slice portion of the Core Worlds that was known as the Arrowhead. In 2 ABY, Princess Mi expressed interest in visiting the Tetso Shopping Worlds.

Tertiary Fujar.title: Tertiary Fujar system/Legends
Tertiary Fujar.lead: The Tertiary Fujar system was a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Tamarin sector. Around 214 BBY, the Fujari pirate gang operated out of an asteroid base in the system. Following the Bordal Contagion of that year, the Fujari forced a Kett Shipping convoy to emerge from hyperspace into an ambush in the Tertiary Fujari system, but both the pirate starships and their base were destroyed by the Trade Defense Force escort of Kett Shipping's new parent organization, the Trade Federation.

Thabeska.title: Thabeska
Thabeska.lead: Thabeska was a planet located in the Outer Rim Territories where the Fardi clan operated. It was windy and dusty, and newcomers to the planet could be identified by having clean, dust-free clothing. After surviving Order 66, former Jedi Padawan Ahsoka Tano spent the first year of the Imperial Era in hiding on Thabeska, working for the Fardis as a mechanic.

Thanta Zilbra.title: Thanta Zilbra
Thanta Zilbra.lead: Thanta Zilbra was a smuggler who crashed on a planet with a native fungus with tremendous healing properties. Obtaining sponsorship from the New Republic, Zilbra established a colony on the planet, now known as Thanta Zilbra to harvest Zilbra fungus. Zilbra was killed when the planet was destroyed during the Corellian Crisis, but did insist his four sons and two daughters evacuate.

The Covey.title: The Covey

facts.routes: Corellian Run, Coruscant–Dantooine hyperlane, Koros Trunk Line, Leisure Corridor, Martial Cross, Metellos Trade Route, Namadii Corridor, Perlemian Trade Route …

The Covey.lead: The Covey was an asteroid belt between the planets Improcco and Nabatu in the Coruscant system.

The Redoubt.title: The Redoubt/Legends
The Redoubt.lead: The Redoubt, also known as the Chiss Redoubt, was a remote star cluster that was located in Chiss Space, near the Utegetu Nebula, and that contained at least ten habitable planets and hundreds of stars. It contained the Brask Oto Command Station system, in which was the Brask Oto Command Station. Discovered at some point before the year 178 BBY and claimed by the Chiss, the cluster was to be used as a refuge in the event that the Chiss Ascendancy was overrun by any foreign invader. Exploration of the Redoubt by the Chiss Defense Fleet only began in earnest around 27 BBY.

Tharkos.title: Tharkos
Tharkos.lead: Tharkos was a planet located in the Tharkos system of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the headquarters of Millennium Astro-Engineering. The planet was attacked by the Stenax during the Stenax Massacres of 5 ABY.

The Belk.title: The Belk
The Belk.lead: The Belk was an asteroid field that was located within the Colavas system, in the Halla sector of the galaxy's Mid Rim.

The Red Twins.title: The Red Twins/Legends
The Red Twins.lead: The Red Twins were a pair of dying stars located in Wild Space.

The Clar.title: The Clar
The Clar.lead: The Clar was an astronomical object located within the Clar system, a part of Wild Space. It was the site of the Vivab deserts, a zone of ice-swept plains. The Morellian scout Barosa Warren and Casti Tholon, his Human student at the Galactic Outdoor Survival School, had visited the Clar by 2 ABY, where they explored and charted the Vivab deserts.

The Home.title: The Home

facts.affiliation: Jonex Mine Eight Eleven B, Order of the Sith Lords, Lumiya's Sith

The Home.lead: The Home was a large iron asteroid in a star system designated MZX32905, near Bimmiel. The name was a translation of what the sapient mynock-like indigenous species called it.

The Pit.title: The Pit/Legends
The Pit.lead: The Pit was an area of stray asteroids scattered throughout the arm of a nebula and located at the end of the Kessel Run. Despite being easier to navigate than the Kessel Run, pilots who had made it by the Maw would often be so relieved at having passed through the most dangerous part of the run that they would lose focus entering the Pit and collide with an asteroid, destroying their spacecraft.

Thassalia.title: Thassalia (disambiguation)
Thassalia.lead: Thassalia may refer to one of the following:

Tharados.title: Tharados
Tharados.lead: Tharados was a small, cold planet that was located within the Tharados system of the Mid Rim. The Zabrak Haast Aath ran a slave compound there for Riboga the Hutt. Twelve clone troopers were also sent there during the Clone Wars, due to an administrative error.

Thape.title: Thape
Thape.lead: Thape was a celestial body located in the Thape system, a part of the Lambda sector in the Slice portion of the Mid Rim. A hyperlane linked it to the Ando and Leritor systems. Between around 25,000 BBY and 22,000 BBY, the, society of Force-sensitives known as the Order of Dai Bendu—which was present on the Ando system planet Ando Prime as early as approximately 37,453 BBY and as late as around 32 BBY—had a presence at Thape.

The Barren.title: The Barren

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, The Slice, Trailing Sectors

The Barren.lead: The Barren was an asteroid belt that ringed the star Christoph in the Savareen sector in the Outer Rim Territories.

The Hammers.title: The Hammers

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, The Slice, Trailing Sectors

The Hammers.lead: The Hammers was an asteroid belt located in the Savareen sector between Christophsis and Erodsis.

The Halo.title: The Halo

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, The Slice, Trailing Sectors

The Halo.lead: The Halo was an asteroid belt located in the Savareen sector beyond the gas giant Erodsis.

The Chase.title: The Chase
The Chase.lead: The Chase was the an asteroid field orbiting the binary stars Toydar and Little Toydar in the Toydaria system. Located in Hutt Space, it was situated beyond the planet Fii.

The Reef.title: The Reef
The Reef.lead: The Reef, also known as The Reef asteroid cloud, was a natural belt of asteroids and dust that resulted from the collision of the two outmost planets in the Lamaro system. The natives of the system gave the belt its name.

Thairwsthis 12.title: The Relevant Farm Act of Thairwsthis 12
Thairwsthis 12.lead: The Relevant Farm Act of Thairwsthis 12 was a law that shared its name with the Mid Rim's Thairwsthis system and established crop boundaries on an agricultural planet. However, the incandescent solar flares that periodically etched most of that world's surface excited both adult and young members of the mind eel species, and they ignored the stipulations of the law—a fact that was at one point noted in a weather forecast for the planet's West Fissure region that warned its inhabitants to exercise caution regarding the eels.

The Deep.title: The Deep
The Deep.lead: The Deep was a planet located in the Unknown Regions with a barren and lifeless surface. At some point, Luke Skywalker traveled to the Deep to rescue R2-D2 from a mining complex.

Roost.title: The Roost
Roost.lead: The Roost, also known as Roost Station, was a repurposed industrial processing RKDA-class space station shadowport located in deep space in the Bitrose sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was originally commissioned as an orbital lauch base for the starfighter of local security forces. Later, it became to be operated by Ranzar Malk and served as the base of a crew of mercenaries and a profitable outlaw tech enterprise illegally modifying starships. Access to the Roost was invitaion only and was personally vetted by Malk.

Tharin.title: Tharin sector
Tharin.lead: The Tharin sector was a part of the Outer Rim Territories.

Thisspias.title: Thisspias/Legends

facts.government: Absolute monarchy with democratically elected parliament
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Darth Revan's Sith Empire, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Thisspias.lead: Thisspias was an Expansion Region planet located in the Farstey sector. It was home to the creatures known as cygnats and was the homeworld of the sentient reptilian Thisspiasians. The Thisspiasians were governed by a millennia-old absolute monarchy that was complemented by a democratically elected parliament. The Thisspiasians, an ancient species of warriors, joined the Galactic Republic early in its history, becoming instrumental in averting both external and internal threats to that government. Between 3959 BBY and 3956 BBY, the planet fell within the borders of Darth Revan's Sith Empire.

Thobek.title: Thobek
Thobek.lead: Thobek was an obscure terrestrial planet situated in the Thobek system, a part of the Core Worlds' Farlax sector. It was situated along the Widek Bypass, a hyperlane connecting the planets Orooturoo and Widek in the Farlax sector.

Thesme.title: Thesme
Thesme.lead: Thesme was a planet located within the Thesme system of the Outer Rim Territories. An industrial world, it served as the lackluster sector capital of Thesme sector, on the Thesme Trace.

Thila.title: Thila/Legends
Thila.lead: Thila was a small planet in the Thila system of the Outer Rim Territories. It was home to a major Alliance to Restore the Republic base, Thila Command. The planet had relatively huge mountain ranges, of which the peaks of its gigantic mountains were visible from orbit.

Thokos.title: Thokos
Thokos.lead: Thokos was a planet located within the Thokos system of the Core Worlds. Colonists from Thokos settled Ammuud. Thokos has been settled over 25 millennia ago.

Tholatin.title: Tholatin

facts.affiliation: Yuuzhan Vong, Mandalorian Protectors, Galactic Alliance

Tholatin.lead: Tholatin was a planet located within the Tholatin system of the Mid Rim. It was the location of Esau's Ridge, a thin crevasse in a towering rock wall inhabited by smugglers. The planet's chief of security was Plaan in 25 ABY. Tholatin was conquered by the Yuuzhan Vong some time during the latter's onslaught into the galaxy. The planet was eventually liberated from the invaders by the Mandalorian Protectors under Boba Fett in 29 ABY.

Tholon.title: Tholon
Tholon.lead: Tholon was a Wild Space planet located within the star system of the same name. A desolate rock world with rich deposits of various ores, it was the first planet discovered by the Human scout Casti Tholon by 2 ABY.

Thebeon 8.title: Thebeon 8
Thebeon 8.lead: Thebeon 8 was a planet located within the Thebeon system of the Core Worlds with a pro-New Order government. Its ruler was styled "Most High Proctor."

The Wheel.title: The Wheel/Legends

facts.affiliation: Independent, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire, Galactic Federation of Free Alliances …

The Wheel.lead: The Wheel was a large space station located in the Besh Gorgon system of the Mid Rim along the Perlemian Trade Route.

Tholoth.title: Tholoth/Legends
Tholoth.lead: Tholoth was a planet located within the Tholoth system of the Colonies.

Tholaz.title: Tholaz
Tholaz.lead: Tholaz was a planet located within the Tholaz system of the Core Worlds.

Theal.title: Theal
Theal.lead: Theal was a planet situated in the Theal system, a part of the freestanding subsectors portion of the Mid Rim. It was an inhospitable world that was explored by the Republic Survey Corps scout Barosa Warren. More than fifty years later, by 2 ABY, Theal was controlled by the Galactic Empire and was considered to be one of the most dangerous planets under the Empire's jurisdiction.

Thermon.title: Thermon
Thermon.lead: Thermon was a planet located within the Thermon system of the Mid Rim with many moons that spewed methane gas from geysers.

Thira.title: Thira
Thira.lead: Thira was the innermost planet in the Vaxal system. It was a searing rock with one moon.

The Scattering.title: The Scattering
The Scattering.lead: The Scattering was a asteroid field orbiting the binary stars Toydar and Little Toydar in the Toydaria system located in Hutt Space region of the the galaxy, it was situated between the planets Credquant and Nubisa.

Thearterra.title: Thearterra/Legends
Thearterra.lead: Thearterra was an obscure planet located in the S-K system of the Unknown Regions' Chiss Space. A hyperlane linked the world to the Avidich system. The surface of Thearterra was constantly racked by volcanoes, hailstorms, and groundquakes. The world was part of the Chiss sentient species' government of the Chiss Ascendancy.

Therpsis.title: Therpsis
Therpsis.lead: Therpsis was a small mining planet and the homeworld of Pete Vandhaar.

Themis.title: Themis
Themis.lead: Themis was a planet located in the Themis system of the Inner Rim. It was the homeworld of the Themians. Themis was orbited by a moon which contained an explosive ore that was capable of acting as a power source.

Theron.title: Theron
Theron.lead: Theron was a planet in the Theron system in the Vilonis sector of the Mid Rim Territories, in grid square O-16 of the Standard Galactic Grid, whose surface featured famous spiral stone formations. It had a strong racing culture, including podracing and the Five Sabers tournament.

Thedavio VII.title: Thedavio VII
Thedavio VII.lead: Thedavio VII was a world located in the Expansion Region. Prior to the Battle of Hoth, a fleet of unidentified black starships was spotted near the planet. It was unknown whether they were some kind of new Imperial design.

Thule.title: Thule/Legends

facts.terrain: Rocky plains, Rich savannas, Blackened hills, Hollowed canyons
facts.affiliation: Xim's empire, Adas's Sith Empire, Old Sith Empire, Exar Kun's Sith Empire, Krath, Darth Revan's Sith Empire, Brotherhood of Darkness, Order of the Sith Lords …

Thule.lead: Thule was a dry and arid Force nexus steeped in the dark side of the Force that lay upon the western flanks of the Stygian Caldera in the Esstran sector. A hidden Sith fortress world for most of its history, Thule consistently served as a redoubt and resource for many generations of Sith over a protracted period of millennia.

Thustra.title: Thustra/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Thustra.lead: Thustra was a planet located within the Thustra system, Sumitra sector of the galaxy's Expansion Region. It was also the homeworld of a Near-Human race known as the Sephi. Until the advent of the Clone Wars, Thustra was a member world of the Galactic Republic, and was thus represented in the Galactic Senate by a senator. By 21 BBY, approximately nine months into the civil war, the Sephi betrayed the Republic and joined Thustra with the rebellion of the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Thrakia.title: Thrakia

facts.region: Inner Rim; Transitory Mists, The Slice
facts.affiliation: Hapes Consortium, Galactic Empire, Galactic Alliance

Thrakia.lead: Thrakia was a planet with large land masses and rich in natural resources located in the Hapes Cluster. It was the homeworld of an unidentified species, described as an intelligent species of insectoids.

Thorgeld I.title: Thorgeld I
Thorgeld I.lead: Thorgeld I, also known as Thorgeld, was a Core Worlds planet. The mansion of Fabritech, Inc. head Kvarn Mandel and his family was located on the planet, in the underground city of Fabrin. During the Galactic Civil War, the crew of the light freighter Dorion Discus visited Thorgeld I. Shortly after the freighter left the planet, the Imperial Customs Frigate Assessor attempted to board the vessel for a customs inspection, but the Dorion Discus eventually escaped into hyperspace.

Thraisai.title: Thraisai/Legends
Thraisai.lead: Thraisai was a planet located in the Thraisai system of Wild Space. At some point between 17 BBY and 0 ABY, the Human bounty hunter Beilert Valance led a group of mercenaries in capturing a ring of enslavers on Thraisai, a mission that helped Valance attain the status of an elite hunter.

Thracior.title: Thracior
Thracior.lead: Thracior was a Core Worlds planet that was home to a clan-based culture. In 32 BBY, the planet's warlords began arguing over territory, leading to raids between the local tribes. As a result, the parents of the Human siblings Dane and Floria, who were married despite being from different clans, were killed. Dane and Floria escaped death and subsequently moved to a space station. 27 BBY, Floria told Jedi Padawan Anakin Skywalker about her and Dane's past at Thracior.

Thrang.title: Thrang

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Metharian Nebula Territories

Thrang.lead: Thrang was the fifth planet in the Elrood system. It was a sizable gas giant with 7 moons.

Thonner.title: Thonner/Legends

facts.sector: Zuma sector, Inner Zuma Region, Moddell subsector

Thonner.lead: Thonner was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Moddell sector. It was covered in shallow oceans and seas that were broken by strings of sandy islands. Freshwater vents also dotted Thonner's surface, and lichen imported from the planet Maya Kovel grew on the world's islands. Thonner's Lesser Firagh Peninsula was home to dangerous fauna such as the Zoun mauler.

Threfal.title: Threfal
Threfal.lead: Threfal was a world located in the Threfal system, a part of the Mid Rim's Iska sector. Threfal had a Type I breathable atmosphere and was the homeworld of the plant known as the meatvine, which could be used as food.

Thomork.title: Thomork
Thomork.lead: A Core Worlds astronomical object, Thomork was the site of an Imperial Military shipyard. Shortly before the Battle of Endor, the facility produced Imperial-class Star Destroyers. Years before 10 ABY, the Empire spread the rumor that the Thomork shipyard was closed due to a hive virus outbreak and, to lend credence to the rumor, killed over 450 people there. The shipyard was then secretly re-opened and used for Imperial construction projects such as the first World Devastator superweapon.

Thrugii.title: Thrugii
Thrugii.lead: Thrugii was a planet located within the Thrugii system of the Outer Rim Territories. A desolate, rocky planet near an asteroid field, it has been the home of many failed miners. The residents were considered claim jumpers by the sector authorities, who said that they controlled all the rights to Thrugii and the asteroid belt. After the authorities locked down the planet, the miners found themselves out of supplies. Smuggler Kaine Paulsen was killed while trying to deliver supplies to them.

Thrantin.title: Thrantin
Thrantin.lead: Thrantin, or OM813, was the planet headquarters of Barosa Warren and the Galactic Outdoor Survival School. It was located in the Ollonir Boundaries of the Colonies.

Thovinack.title: Thovinack (disambiguation)
Thovinack.lead: Thovinack may refer to one of the following:

Thoran.title: Thoran
Thoran.lead: Thoran was a planet located within the Bothan sector of the Mid Rim.

Thorsgild.title: Thorsgild
Thorsgild.lead: Thorsgild was a celestial body located in the Thorsgild system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Meerian sector. By some point between 5 ABY and 9 ABY, the cantina that the individual Simms Jonndril called the "Blood Bucket" was a favorite establishment of his on Thorsgild, and he eventually told about it to a group of smugglers.

Thull's Vault.title: Thull's Vault
Thull's Vault.lead: Thull's Vault was a planet located in the Thull's Vault system of the Juvex sector, a part of the Senex-Juvex region in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim. It was connected via hyperlane to the Arporatal-Lanin and Talhovi systems. The planet's surface featured luminescent sands.

Thosa.title: Thosa
Thosa.lead: Thosa was a planet of barren rock orbiting Dostra Major in the Dostra system. It was the fifth planet in the system, and was orbited by two moons.

Thrad.title: Thrad
Thrad.lead: Thrad was a dry desert planet which was represented by Nadea Tural in the Imperial Senate. In 4 BBY, Tural was rescued by the crew of the Ghost after her shuttle crashed.

Thune.title: Thune
Thune.lead: Thune was a planet located in the Thune system in the Wazta sector of the Outer Rim Territories, situated in grid square I-18 of the Standard Galactic Grid along the Koda Spur. From space, it looked like a brown and blue orb.

Thuna III.title: Thuna III
Thuna III.lead: Thuna III was an astronomical object located within Wild Space's Thuna system. At some point by 32 BBY, a colony on Thuna III was devastated by a groundquake. In the wake of the disaster, a band of raiders intended to pillage the settlement.

Thyferra.title: Thyferra/Legends

facts.terrain: Cave networks, Forests, Grassy canyons, Mountains, Tropical jungles
facts.population: 117 million:, Thriving Season:, 84% Vratix, 12% Human, 4% other, Imperial:, 72% Vratix, 28% Human
facts.government: Thriving Season: Planetary representative democracy, Imperial: Corporate plutocracy
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Darth Revan's Sith Empire, Stark Commercial Combine, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire …

Thyferra.lead: Thyferra was a hot, humid planet located in the Polith system on the Rimma Trade Route, on which most of the galaxy's bacta was produced. It was also a major political power as bacta production was an essential commodity.

Tibrin.title: Tibrin/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Alliance of Free Planets, New Republic

Tibrin.lead: Tibrin (pronounced /ˈtɪbrɪn/ or /tɪˈbrɪn/) was a planet located within the Mid Rim and the homeworld of the Ishi Tib.

Till Chorios.title: Till Chorios
Till Chorios.lead: Till Chorios was a celestial body located in the Till Chorios system, one of the Chorios systems situated in the Meridian sector of the Outer Rim Territories. By the date 13:4:4, Senator Bufus Ritsomas represented Till Chorios in the Galactic Republic's Senate. Ritsomas was implicated in participating in an Outer Rim slavery ring that saw the senator profit from the activities of Thalassian slavers in the Meridian sector.

Tierfon.title: Tierfon/Legends
Tierfon.lead: Tierfon was a small planet in the Tierfon system of the Sumitra sector, located in the Expansion Region. Its surface was dotted with mountain ranges, huge gorges, and rock cliffs.

Timora.title: Timora
Timora.lead: Timora was a planet located in the Timora system of the Outer Rim Territories. Timora was the inner endpoint of the Shiritoku Way and the closest planet to Bakura in Wild Space. Its people exported sunpetals. It also served as a shipping point for repulsorlift products from Bakura.

Thyrsus.title: Thyrsus/Legends
Thyrsus.lead: Thyrsus was a planet located in the Thyrsus system of the Inner Rim and the homeworld of the Thyrsians, an Echani offshoot that originated the Sun Guard.

Tiisheraan.title: Tiisheraan/Legends
Tiisheraan.lead: Tiisheraan was a planet located in the Tiisheraan system, a part of the Southern Core portion of the Core Worlds. In 3638 BBY, the Hutt scientist and droid inventor Doctor Juvard Illip Oggurobb believed that Tiisheraan would be perfectly suited for hosting a private laboratory that he wished to have.

Tieos.title: Tieos/Legends
Tieos.lead: Tieos was a planet located in the Tieos system, a part of the Abrion sector within the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The planet featured several oceans on its surface, and its landmasses were completely covered in grasslands. Shortly following the Battle of Yavin, Tieos held massive future potential as an agriworld.

Tililix.title: Tililix
Tililix.lead: Tililix was a planet in the Til system of the Unknown Regions which orbited the star Til. It was the Tarro homeworld before it was destroyed when Til went supernova.

Tillo.title: Tillo system/Legends
Tillo.lead: The Tillo system was a star system located within the Tapani sector of the Colonies. It was located in Reena Province on the Caloria Run.

Tinn VI.title: Tinn VI
Tinn VI.lead: Tinn VI was a gas giant in the Tinn system. It had six moons, including Tinn VI-B and the inhabited Echnos. Located at the limit of the Mid Rim, it was a common stopover point for spacers en route to the Outer Rim Territories.

Tinallis.title: Tinallis

facts.terrain: Rainforests, Cliffs, Oceans, Polluted industrial areas

Tinallis.lead: Tinallis was a planet located within the Tinallis system of the Mid Rim. Though it was an industrialized planet, it was noted for the wildlife in its oceans, seashores, and rainforests. One of its native creatures, the tresher, was a lucrative but illegal trade item.

Timbra Ott.title: Timbra Ott
Timbra Ott.lead: Timbra Ott was a planet located in the Kathol Outback, at the end of the Galtea Run.

Tikath.title: Tikath
Tikath.lead: Tikath was a planet located in the Tikath system of the Outer Rim Territories. It was a fortress world with a notoriously strong defense. A group of rebel operatives traveled to the planet in pursuit of Imperial scientist Etha Naru.

Tiems.title: Tiems
Tiems.lead: Tiems was a city on the planet Tiems in the Tiems system of the Outer Rim Territories. During the Galactic Civil War, several thousand Alliance to Restore the Republic prisoners were held in the city. They were liberated by Alliance forces under the command of General Carlist Rieekan during the Battle of Tiems. The city was connected to other settlements by the Tiems Road, and was located near the Gopps Forest and the Blue River.

Tibro.title: Tibro
Tibro.lead: Tibro was an astronomical object located in the Tibro system, a part of the Baronos sector in the Slice portion of the Colonies. The Human male Beyla Rus was born on Tibro in 24 BBY. Tibro was also the homeworld of the Human female Maxig Kress.

Tierell.title: Tierell

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, New Territories, Trans-Hydian

Tierell.lead: Tierell was a planet located in the Tierell system within the Thesme sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Tifnyl.title: Tifnyl

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Metharian Nebula Territories

Tifnyl.lead: Tifnyl was the fourth planet of the Tifnyl system. It was a gas giant located in the Elrood sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Its moon was the location of an Imperial listening post during the Galactic Civil War.

Tinnel.title: Tinnel IV
Tinnel.lead: Tinnel IV, also known as Tinnel, was an ancient, conservative planet located in the Tinnel system in the Quanta sector of Core Worlds, along the Corellian Run. Tinnel IV was the homeworld of Jothan Tiaan Jerjerrod, Jax Jerjerrod, and Tiaan Jerjerrod. During the Imperial Era, Tinnel IV supported the Galactic Emperor Sheev Palpatine. After the signing of the Galactic Concordance, which conditionally allowed the remnants of the Empire to peacefully co-exist with the New Republic, Tinnel IV came under control of the Inner systems' Imperial remnant.

Tibalt.title: Tibalt
Tibalt.lead: Tibalt was a location in the galaxy. In 3 ABY, during the Galactic Civil War, an Imperial Viper probe droid was sent to Tibalt in search of the hidden base of the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

Tirahnn.title: Tirahnn/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Honorable Union of Desevro & Tion, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire

Tirahnn.lead: Tirahnn was a bustling trade world in the Inner Rim's Zeemacht Cluster, that served as an important stop along the Perlemian Trade Route. A mercantilist society essentially ruled by super-rich "merchant princes," Tirahnn was known across the galaxy for its massive bazaars and markets, the largest of which stretched for miles and were bigger than entire nations on other planets. This made Tirahnn a popular destination for rich tourists, with the annual Great Fair especially drawing a vast number of visitors to the world.

Tof.title: Tof/Legends
Tof.lead: The Tof were green-skinned near-humans from the planet Tof, located in Firefist, a dwarf satellite galaxy orbiting the main galactic disc, within the wider Unknown Regions. They were ruled by patriarchs who usually had military experience and were in control of their own interstellar empire known as the Tof Kingdom.

Togoria.title: Togoria/Legends

facts.terrain: Savannahs, Dense forests, Great canyons, Swamps
facts.affiliation: Mandalorians, Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Greater Maldrood, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Togoria.lead: Togoria was a planet in the Mid Rim and the homeworld of the Togorians.

Tokmia.title: Tokmia/Legends
Tokmia.lead: Tokmia was a mostly icy, snow-covered planet in the Anoat sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Home to the primitive, barely-sentient Oku species, Tokmia featured bountiful crystal and ore deposits, from which the Figg Excavations mining company earned a fortune before abandoning the planet. In 3 ABY, during the Galactic Civil War, Tokmia was one of three worlds in the Anoat sector, including Hoth, to which the Galactic Empire sent reconnaissance probe droids in search of the hidden Rebel Alliance base.

Tinnel IV.title: Tinnel IV/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Darth Revan's Sith Empire, Galactic Empire

Tinnel IV.lead: Tinnel IV was the fourth planet in the Tinnel system on the Corellian Run, and the sector capital of the Quanta sector.

Tion.title: Tion

facts.affiliation: Kingdom of Cron, Xer's Empire, Xim's Empire, Honorable Union of Desevro and Tion, Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire

Tion.lead: Tion was a planet located within the Tion Hegemony of the Outer Rim Territories.

Todirium III.title: Todirium III/Legends
Todirium III.lead: Todirium III was a planet located within the Todirium system of the Outer Rim Territories. Located near warlord Zsinj's territory, it was a bleak iron mining colony that refined durasteel. Wraith Squadron raided the planet in the guise of Rogue Squadron during their campaign against Zsinj.

Tocoya.title: Tocoya
Tocoya.lead: Tocoya was a planet located within the Tocoya system of the Inner Rim and the homeworld of the Tocoyan race. Neb Dulo, a disciple of the religion Davrilat, was from the planet.

Tlactehon.title: Tlactehon

facts.region: Expansion Region, The Slice, Trailing Sectors

Tlactehon.lead: A trade world lying on the Corellian Run super-hyperroute, Tlactehon was located in the Expansion Region's Kailion sector. A delegation from Tlactehon that was in reality a front for a gang of smugglers once traveled to the planet Muunilinst, where it was scheduled to meet with representatives of the InterGalactic Banking Clan. As part of the conquest of the galaxy by the extragalactic Yuuzhan Vong, the invaders held the Tlactehon system until at least 27 ABY.

Tizon.title: Tizon
Tizon.lead: Tizon was a planet located within the Tizon system of the Core Worlds and one of the original 13 planets of the Duskhan League.

Titanicus.title: Titanicus
Titanicus.lead: Titanicus was the fifth planet from the sun in the Sacorrian system. It was a gas giant orbited by 14 moons.

Tocco.title: Tocco system/Legends
Tocco.lead: The Tocco system was a star system located within the Tapani sector. It was part of the Melantha Province, situated near the Lupani and Ricaldi systems.

Togominda.title: Togominda/Legends

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Western Reaches, Greater Javin
facts.sector: Javin sector (prior to c. 400 BBY), Anoat sector (c. 400 BBY—), Yarith sector (generations after c. 400 BBY)

Togominda.lead: Togominda was a world situated in the Outer Rim Territories' Yarith sector. It featured salt geysers, which attracted both free-traders and pilots to the world. Lynciro Corporation owned a private retreat on Togominda known as "Master of Coins."

Tiragga.title: Tiragga
Tiragga.lead: Tiragga was a planet of the Tiragga system, in the Mieru'kar sector, located within the Outer Rim of the galaxy. The planet was orbited by at least two moons. The second moon was home to a Rebel Alliance outpost during the Galactic Civil War, a large conflict between the Alliance and the Galactic Empire. At some point during the conflict, the base personnel became infected with the Direllian Plague, a fatal disease that could only be cured with the administration of Shiarha Root, a rare plant found on the world of Kirtania.

Tirsa.title: Tirsa
Tirsa.lead: Tirsa was an industrial planet located within the Tirsa system of the Outer Rim Territories. It was home to the Tirsa Wargear armaments company that manufactured the Leviathan submersible carrier.

Tintel.title: Tintel
Tintel.lead: Tintel was an Expansion Region celestial body located in the Belasco sector. During the Galactic Civil War, it served as one of the mid-race stopping points of the Dahvil-Fodro Hyperspace Promenade, a popular interstellar racing route. The racer and undercover Rebel Alliance operative Siro Simito once participated in the race, during which he made a detour from the segment of the race's route connecting Tintel to the Azna system in order to make a delivery for the Alliance on the astronomical object Fait d'Fait.

Tinoon.title: Tinoon/Legends

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Greater Javin, Western Reaches

Tinoon.lead: Tinoon was a planet located within the Tinoon system of the Outer Rim Territories relatively close to the Zephry Asteroid field. The planet's orbit was home to a customs check point and a Cargo Facility. It was raided by pirates after the Battle of Hoth.

Tisht.title: Tisht
Tisht.lead: Tisht was a planet that was located within the Tisht system in Hutt Space, a region of the galaxy controlled by the Hutt species. The planet lay on the hyperlane called the Dead Road, which connected it to the worlds of M'Hanna and Saqqar.

Tinta.title: Tinta
Tinta.lead: Tinta was a white, fluffy toy tauntaun, known to its owner, Jyn Erso, the daughter of Galen, and Lyra Erso, as a "snow lizard." The toy was one of Jyn's playthings while she lived in her family's homestead on the planet Lah'mu. Jyn generally kept Tinta with her other toys in her toybox, but in the year 13 BBY, it and several other toys were out on her bed when the Galactic Empire arrived at the homestead in search of Galen.

Tiss'Sharl.title: Tiss'sharl system
Tiss'Sharl.lead: The Tiss'sharl system was a star system located in the Xappyh sector within the Outer Rim Territories and the New Territories. It was positioned in grid square R-4 on the Standard Galactic Grid. The reptilian Tiss-shar were native to the system.

Toola.title: Toola/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders, Darth Revan's Sith Empire, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Zsinj's Empire, New Republic …

Toola.lead: Toola was a cold planet located in the Kaelta system. It was the homeworld of the Whiphids and was located in the Slice.

Toong'l.title: Toong'l/Legends
Toong'l.lead: Toong'l, also known as Toong'L, was a planet located within the Toong'l system of the Outer Rim Territories and the homeworld of the Toong species.

Toloran.title: Toloran
Toloran.lead: Toloran was the Tolo homeworld, located in the Panto system along with Pantolomin. A winter wonderland that attracted tourists, it was also inhabited by ice dragons. It was far enough away from its sun that it had a cold climate. Like all locations in the system, it was dedicated to tourism and entertainment. Mountaintop resorts let clientele enjoy winter activities such as repulsor skiing, hover sledding, and wilderness survival camps. Tourists could also travel on the Snow Nara ice barge through ice floes and on hunting expeditions for ice dragons.

Torina.title: Torina

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Metharian Nebula Territories

Torina.lead: Torina was a terraformed planet located in the Torina system of the Elrood sector.

Toprawa.title: Toprawa/Legends

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, New Territories, Trans-Hydian
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders, Darth Revan's Sith Empire, Sith Empire, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire

Toprawa.lead: Toprawa was a remote, forested planet in the Toprawa system of the Kalamith sector in the Bright Jewel Oversector, located in the Outer Rim Territories near the Hydian Way.

Tomark II.title: Tomark II
Tomark II.lead: Tomark II, also known as Tomark, was a Mid Rim world located in the Ividal sector. During the Galactic Civil War, it was the site of the Rebel Alliance starfighter base known as Chiron Base, from which attacks on Galactic Empire convoys were carried out.

Topa.title: Topa
Topa.lead: Topa was a mineral-poor planet in the Sespe system of the Periphery, orbited by Torega. Shadowports on Topa served local pirate groups.

Tol.title: Tol
Tol.lead: Tol was a barren, rocky planet, third in the Dostra system in Corporate Sector. It had no moons.

Tollero.title: Tollero
Tollero.lead: Tollero was the second planet in the Atrig system. It was a searing rock incapable of supporting life.

Toosma.title: Toosma
Toosma.lead: Toosma was the fourth and largest planet orbiting the star Tyrius in the Tyrius system. Located in the Savareen sector of the Outer Rim Territories, it was a yellow-orange gas giant and had a total of 18 moons.

Tolan.title: Tolan
Tolan.lead: Tolan was a planet located within the Tolan system of the Colonies. It was the location of the Tolan Navy Shipyards, near Dankayo and probably within a few sectors of Ralltiir.

Tomik.title: Tomik
Tomik.lead: Tomrik was the largest gas giant in the Bacrana system. The planet consisted of swirling bands of gasses, colored bright orange and red. Sixteen satellites orbited the planet, most of them originating as asteroids captured from the Carba Asteroid Belt. Lant Mining Corporation conducted mining operations on three of Tomik's moons. The moons were strip-mined and abandoned.

Tol Ado.title: Tol Ado
Tol Ado.lead: Tol Ado was a planet located within the Tol Ado system of the Outer Rim Territories.

Torize.title: Torize
Torize.lead: The planet Torize was located in the system of the same name on the Trition Trade Route in the Kathol sector of the Outer Rim Territories. A major trade and industrial hub, the planet was orbited by numerous space stations, and spaceports littered the surface. A naturally volcanic planet with high levels of activity, Torize's atmosphere was hazardous to most beings, and a breath mask was required. The atmosphere was worsened by an industrial accident in 5 ABY that released toxic pollutants into the air.

Ton-Falk.title: Ton-Falk
Ton-Falk.lead: Ton-Falk was a celestial body located in the Ton-Falk system, a part of the Pakuuni sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was situated on the Overic Griplink hyperspace route, which linked it to the Florn and Pakuuni systems.

Tomo-Reth.title: Tomo-Reth
Tomo-Reth.lead: Tomo-Reth was an astronomical object located in the Tomo-Reth system, a part of the Trailing Sectors portion of the Inner Rim. It was the site of the Caliginous Automaton of Tomo-Reth, a famous, more than fifty meters–high droid that sat on a brick throne and breathed fire at visitors, causing them to become amazed.

Tol Amn.title: Tol Amn
Tol Amn.lead: Tol Amn was a murky, stormy planet that was located within the star system of the same name, in the Hutt Space region of the galaxy. The planet lay on the hyperlane called the Oktos Route that connected it both to the planet Toydaria and the hyperspace route known as the Trax Tube.

Tonjumi.title: Tonjumi
Tonjumi.lead: Tonjumi was the seventh planet orbiting the star Stisste in the Saleucami system. Located in the Suolriep sector of the Outer Rim Territories, it was a frozen rock.

Tolfrania.title: Tolfrania system/Legends
Tolfrania.lead: The Tolfrania system was a part of the Slice portion of the Inner Rim. It shared its name with the document known as the Tolfranian brief, on which the Galactic Republic Senatorial aide Eero Iridian was working on in 89 BBY.

Torgazi.title: Torgazi
Torgazi.lead: Torgazi was a toxic hothouse in the Ottega system in the Mid Rim.

Toydaria.title: Toydaria/Legends

facts.region: Mid Rim, Hutt Space, The Slice
facts.affiliation: Hutt Cartel (vassal), Galactic Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Toydaria.lead: Toydaria was a large, muddy planet located in the Toydaria system of Hutt Space, and home to the mind trick-resistant Toydarians.

Tralus.title: Tralus/Legends

facts.routes: Corellian Trade Spine, Corellian Run, Secure Route ID-5N, Trade Route X143
facts.affiliation: Federation of the Double Worlds, Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Galactic Alliance, Five Worlds, Confederation

Tralus.lead: Tralus was the sister planet of Talus in the Corellian system. Together, they were known as the Twin Worlds. Both shared the same orbit around Centerpoint Station. Tralus was quite hospitable to most sentient beings of the galaxy due to its many climates.

Torolis.title: Torolis/Legends
Torolis.lead: Torolis was a Bothan colony world located within the Torolis system of the Mid Rim.

Trammis III.title: Trammis III/Legends

facts.language: Galactic Basic Standard; formerly: Old High Trammic

Trammis III.lead: Trammis III, or Trammis Three, also known simply as Trammis, was a planet located within the Trammis system of the Centrality region.

Torque.title: Torque
Torque.lead: Torque ("Torqua-na" in Huttese) was a planet located within the Torque system of the Outer Rim Territories and the sector capital of the Gordian Reach. A lackluster industrial world, it was the headquarters of Bwahl the Hutt.

Trancret.title: Trancret
Trancret.lead: Trancret was a planet in the Trancret system and the sector capital of the Perkell sector. It was home to the Trancretes. The Trancret Stock Exchange Swindle was pulled off by the Red & Black League of Herstell V.

Tralfin.title: Tralfin
Tralfin.lead: Tralfin was tropical resort world located in the Outer Rim Territories' Xappyh sector. In 28 BBY, the Human Qan Gindoch was born on Tralfin. Shortly after the Battle of Yavin, Moff Crin Harson of the Galactic Empire was murdered on Tralfin. A group of Rebel Alliance agents with which Harson had been acquainted was implicated in the crime, but eventually the real killer was discovered and the Rebels were cleared of the murder charges.

Trailia.title: Trailia
Trailia.lead: Trailia was a low-tech planet, located in the Trailia system of the Outer Rim Territories, on the fringes of known space. It was the homeworld of the Trailians. It was a technologically primitive world with thick jungles.

Torvik.title: Torvik
Torvik.lead: Torvik was the fourth planet in the Atrig system. A swampy planet, it was orbited by one moon and was capable of sustaining life.

Tozeer.title: Tozeer
Tozeer.lead: Tozeer was a planet located within the Tozeer system of the Outer Rim Territories. Tozeer was a desert world with Jawas and Tusken Raiders living on it.

Torpris.title: Torpris
Torpris.lead: Torpris was a planet located within the Torpris system of the Core Worlds.

Tragrud.title: Tragrud
Tragrud.lead: Tragrud was the only planet in the Tragrud system, a star system located in the Periphery, a sector in the Outer Rim Territories.

Trallan.title: Trallan
Trallan.lead: Trallan was a planet located within the Trallan system of the Colonies and the homeworld of Captain Theb Tobbra.

Trammen.title: Trammen

facts.region: Expansion Region, The Slice, Exploitation Region (c. 17,000 BBY)
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Grand Companies, Galactic Empire

Trammen.lead: Trammen was a heavily populated Expansion Region world located in the Harron sector. Situated on the Ootmian Pabol hyperspace route, around the time of the beginning of the Alsakan Conflicts, it was a part of the Galactic Republic as well as the Exploitation Region that was controlled by the trading conglomerates known as the Grand Companies. During the Galactic Civil War, Trammen served as a Galactic Empire staging area.

Tothis.title: Tothis
Tothis.lead: Tothis was a lackluster industrial world located in the Tothis system of the Outer Rim Territories' Corporate Sector. The Authority Guardian Corridor hyperlane connected Tothis to the Atchorb and Kir systems.

Tran Mariel.title: Tran Mariel
Tran Mariel.lead: Tran Mariel was a planet located within the Tran Mariel system of the Core Worlds and the homeworld of the Runyip.

Tosste.title: Tosste/Legends
Tosste.lead: Tosste was a uninhabited rocky planet located within the Outer Rim Territories.

Toskhowwl VI.title: Toskhowwl VI
Toskhowwl VI.lead: Toskhowwl VI was a planet located within the Toskhowwl system of the Mid Rim. Around 5 ABY, the Jaltiri tribals lived on Toskhowwl VI and were known beyond their world for their custom of building stacks of severed heads.

Tovarskl.title: Tovarskl
Tovarskl.lead: Tovarskl was a terrestrial planet in Wild Space and a colony world of the Yam'rii.

Tracyn.title: Tracyn
Tracyn.lead: Tracyn was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories' Mandalore sector. Located within the Mandalore system, Tracyn occupied the third orbit around the system's star, Mandalore, between the orbits of Akaan and Kalevala. A world of significant volcanic activity, a total of four moons surrounded Tracyn. After the Taung forces of Mandalore the First journeyed from Roon to conquer the uninhabited planet that became Mandalore, the newly renamed Mandalorians spread out to conquer the worlds of the surrounding system, including Tracyn. The planet's name came from the Mando'a word tracyn, meaning "fire".

Trandosha.title: Trandosha/Legends

facts.routes: Durkteel Loop, Great Kashyyyk Branch, Nightroad, Randon Run
facts.climate: Humid (in some parts) Arid (in some parts)
facts.terrain: Jungles, Rainforests, Woodlands, Savannahs, Deserts, Grasslands, High mountains, Seas, Villages
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire

Trandosha.lead: Trandosha, also known as Dosha or Hsskhor, was the homeworld of the warlike, reptilian Trandoshan species. It was located in the same star system as Kashyyyk, the home world of the Wookiees, causing bitter animosity between the two species.

Trenwyth.title: Trenwyth/Legends
Trenwyth.lead: Trenwyth was a planet located within the Trenwyth system of the Outer Rim Territories.

Trasse.title: Trasse/Legends
Trasse.lead: Trasse was a barren, isolated asteroid located within the Trasse system of the Mid Rim that was heavily protected by Imperial forces.

Treylon II.title: Treylon II
Treylon II.lead: Treylon II was a planet located within the Treylon system of the Colonies. It was the headquarters of Zygian Savings and Loan and the homeworld of Tour Aryon.

Trevura.title: Trevura
Trevura.lead: Trevura was an Imperial-controlled Inner Rim planet with a prominent droid population. At some point between 0 BBY and 5 ABY, an underground droid resistance group on Trevura hired the assassin droid S-R6 to kill the local governor, Merno Blask. In response, Blask arranged for a recently developed anti-droid inhibit setting for blasters to be field-tested in Voma, the planet's capital.

Trascor.title: Trascor
Trascor.lead: Trascor was a terrestrial planet located in the Trascor system, a part of the Corva sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It featured the large island continent Klypash.

Trantor.title: Trantor
Trantor.lead: Trantor was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Trantor system of the Core Worlds.

Transel.title: Transel
