Transel.lead: Transel was an obscure, backwater terrestrial planet located in the Transel system, a part of the Southern Core portion of the Colonies. It was situated on the hyperlane known as the Shipwrights' Trace, which connected it to the Bassadro, Fondor, and Surric systems.

Trassitan.title: Trassitan
Trassitan.lead: Trassitan was an astronomical object located in the Trassitan system, a part of the Veragi sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The Veragi Trade Route hyperlane linked Trassitan to the Veragi system as well as the Dubrillion system in the Myto sector.

Tremaal.title: Tremaal/Legends

facts.routes: Commenor Run, Hydian Way, Brentaal–Denon Route, Corsin Run, Perlemian Trade Route

Tremaal.lead: Tremaal was a hot planet devoid of any life that was located in the Brentaal system. It had one moon.

Traxal 1.title: Traxal 1
Traxal 1.lead: Traxal 1 was the first planet orbiting the star Nubus in the Nubus system. Located in the Core Worlds, it was a searing rock.

Traxal 2.title: Traxal 2
Traxal 2.lead: Traxal 2 was the second planet orbiting the star Nubus in the Nubus system. Located in the Core Worlds, it was a searing rock.

Trenal.title: Trenal
Trenal.lead: Trenal was the third planet in the Tasar system. It had 14 satellites.

Trebela.title: Trebela
Trebela.lead: Trebela was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Trebela system, a part of the Altier sector in the Slice portion of the Expansion Region. A city on Trebela served as its capital.

Tranthellix.title: Tranthellix
Tranthellix.lead: Tranthellix was a Mid Rim world situated in the Senex sector. It was the homeworld of the large carnivorous birds known as the Tranthebar mountain rippers. The world was owned by House Petro of the Senex-Juvex region and was the site of sky cities. Eventually racing using the Tranthebar mountain rippers as mounts became established on Tranthellix. Both the rippers and the races were restricted to their homeworld due to House Petro wishing to profit off them, although they became popular in the Core Worlds due to live HoloNet broadcasts.

Trasemene.title: Trasemene

facts.affiliation: Confederacy of Independent Systems, Separatist holdouts, Galactic Empire

Trasemene.lead: Trasemene was an Outer Rim Territories celestial body located in the Phelleem sector. A part of the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars, in 19 BBY it saw a battle where the navy of the Galactic Empire defeated that of the Separatist holdout led by Toonbuck Toora. Trasemene also shared its name with the Siege of Trasemene.

Trauchta.title: Trauchta
Trauchta.lead: Trauchta was a gas giant in the fifth position of the Ansion system, which was located in the Mid Rim's Churnis sector. It had six moons.

Trellen.title: Trellen

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Trellen.lead: Trellen was a world situated in the Core Worlds, at the junction of the Hydian Way and Trellen Trade Route hyperlanes. A part of the Galactic Republic since at least 17,000 BBY, millennia later, Trellen served as a Galactic Empire fortress world as well as a stronghold of the New Republic. In 10 ABY, Imperial forces attacked Trellen as part of their emergence from the Deep Core.

Trendivar.title: Trendivar
Trendivar.lead: Trendivar was a planet in the Hunnoverrs sector of the Outer Rim. A skirmish occurred here between the forces of the Vanderijar kajidic and the bounty hunters of Grim Destiny.

Trellar Yagen.title: Trellar Yagen
Trellar Yagen.lead: Trellar Yagen was one of Bovo Yagen's four sons. He settled on Bovo Yagen with his family. The planet Trellar Yagen was named after him.

Troiken.title: Troiken/Legends

facts.terrain: Desert, Forests, Mountains, Plains, Rainforests, Tundra
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Troiken.lead: Troiken was a planet located in the Troiken system of the Outer Rim Territories, and the homeworld of the Xexto.

Trian.title: Trian/Legends
Trian.lead: Trian was a planet located within the Trian system of Wild Space.

Trogan.title: Trogan/Legends

facts.affiliation: Xim's Empire, Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Trogan.lead: Trogan was a planet located within the Trogan system of the Outer Rim Territories, known for its strong tides, natural beauty, terrible weather, and lush vegetation springing from desolate wasteland. The planet's residents hoped to turn it into a tourist attraction, in order to compete with rival Berchest, but despite spectacular oceanic activity, the hoped-for tourism never materialized, and the planet's economy stagnated at a subsistence level.

Trulalis.title: Trulalis
Trulalis.lead: Trulalis was a planet in the Trulalis system, and it was colonized some time around 500 BBY. The planet was known for its theater. The populace was eliminated by the Galactic Empire. It was the homeworld of Adalric Cessius Brandl and his son, Jaalib Brandl. Adalric trained Jaalib as an actor on the depopulated world, and also trained Fable Astin in the Jedi arts, intending to turn her to the dark side of the Force and give her to Emperor Palpatine on Byss. Adalric tricked Astin into murdering Vialco, his nemesis, but Jaalib helped Astin escape Trulalis.

Trinta.title: Trinta

facts.terrain: Fetid swamp (90%), Wooded islands, Mudbanks, Polar ice caps

Trinta.lead: Trinta was a swamp planet located within the Yartiv system of the Outer Rim Territories near Kwenn Space Station. It was home to a dark side nexus that was occupied by an insane Halagad Ventor during the height of the Galactic Empire.

Troxar.title: Troxar

facts.affiliation: Benevolence of Troxar, Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems

Troxar.lead: Troxar was a planet located within the Troxar system of the Expansion Region and the Troxan homeworld.

Trunska.title: Trunska

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Trunska.lead: Trunska was a planet located within the Trunska system of the Colonies.

Trieron.title: Trieron
Trieron.lead: Trieron was a Mid Rim world and the third planet in the Veron Minor system. It was a research planet covered in cool oceans and glacial continents. Several learning institutions had oceanographic research bases there, including Academy at Sab Rufo, Metharg's University, and UnitedChem/SoroSuub University.

Tro'Har.title: Tro'Har

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Metharian Nebula Territories

Tro'Har.lead: Tro'Har was a planet located within the Coyn system of the Outer Rim Territories in the Elrood sector. Covered in methane ice, it boasted a navigation beacon to assist inbound traffic. The name "Tro'Har" meant "Farthest Blade" in the Coynite language.

Trinka.title: Trinka

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Metharian Nebula Territories

Trinka.lead: Trinka was the first planet in Elrood's system. A barren planet of high temperatures, it boasted a small research station.

Trosh.title: Trosh
Trosh.lead: Trosh was a planet located within the Trosh system of the Outer Rim Territories. It was one of many planets where the Galactic Empire enslaved the native people, claiming that it was protecting the rights of the inhabitants.

Troska.title: Troska
Troska.lead: Troska was a forested planet located within the Troska system of the Outer Rim Territories.

Trif.title: Trif
Trif.lead: Trif was a planet located within the Trif system of the Outer Rim Territories.

Troos.title: Troos
Troos.lead: Troos was a planet located within the Gordian Reach of the Outer Rim Territories.

Trinciuum.title: Trinciuum
Trinciuum.lead: Trinciuum was the second planet in the Muunilinst system. It was a planet formed of acidic clouds of gas and orbited by a single moon.

Trinovat.title: Trinovat
Trinovat.lead: Trinovat was a sunny, verdant world located in the Trinovat system. It was situated in the Loop Worlds area of the Gordian Reach sector within the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The hyperlane known as the Junction-Tierell Loop connected it to the Durgen's Star and Near Indosa systems. Trinovat was the homeworld of the sentient Trinovate species and featured small farms and mines.

Trop.title: Trop
Trop.lead: Trop was a gas giant–type planet with eleven moons that occupied the sixth orbital position around the star Asar. It was located within the Ilum system, a part of the Unknown Regions' 7G sector.

Troukree homeworld.title: Troukree homeworld
Troukree homeworld.lead: A planet in the Unknown Regions was the homeworld of the Troukree species. By 0 ABY, the Storm-hair Warlord Nuso Esva was preparing to conquer the planet, prompting a group of Troukree led by Vaantaar to flee the world and join Senior Captain Thrawn's Empire of the Hand, which opposed Esva's realm. The Troukree refugees later settled on the Outer Rim Territories planet of Poln Major. In 0 ABY, Vaantaar told the Hand of Judgment, a group of five Galactic Empire stormtrooper deserters, that he and his refugees did not know their homeworld's fate.

Trivar II.title: Trivar II/Legends
Trivar II.lead: Trivar II was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories which housed a large Imperial Detention Center.

Trundalki IV.title: Trundalki IV
Trundalki IV.lead: Trundalki IV was a world located in the Mid Rim.

Tryast.title: Tryast
Tryast.lead: Tryast was a planet that was located within the Empress Teta system, in the Deep Core region of the galaxy. It was orbited by one moon.

Tund.title: Tund/Legends

facts.terrain: Modern:, Radioactive wasteland, Historic:, Jungles, Forests, Prairies, Escarpments, Rivers
facts.population: Historic: 18 million, 7% Sith, 73% Toong, 20% other, Current: None
facts.affiliation: Sharu, Adas's Sith Empire, Old Sith Empire, Sorcerers of Tund, Centrality

Tund.lead: Tund was a verdant terrestrial planet and potent Force nexus situated upon the north-eastern borders of the Open Sea in the Centrality sector. A remote colony world of the Sith species first settled around 27,700 BBY, Tund saw use as a prison for heretics and exiles prior to the collapse of the old Sith Empire, and subsequently came to serve as both the headquarters of the Sith-blooded Sorcerers of Tund and the adopted homeworld of the Toong species. The planet was destroyed in 5 BBY by a biological warhead released by the Croke Sorcerer of Tund Rokur Gepta.

Truuine.title: Truuine
Truuine.lead: Truuine was an Inner Rim waterworld planet. It featured an equatorial belt of islands as well as a polar region with mountains and glaciers. By 4000 BBY, the planet was the site of the Truuine Jedi Praxeum, a training facility established by Jedi Master Mroon Jassa. Around that time, the Gotal Kith Kark visited Truuine and encountered Jassa, which eventually led to the former taking up Jedi studies at the Praxeum. During the reign of the Galactic Empire millennia later, Truuine's islands were home to Karkarodon and Patrolian settlers.

Tsyk.title: Tsyk
Tsyk.lead: Tsyk was a planet located in the eponymous star system and lay along the hyperlane known as the Hollastin Run, which connected it to the worlds of Hollastin and Circumtore. It was the homeworld of the sentient species, the Tsyklen. Their homeworld was considered part of Hutt Space as early as 4000 BBY, and the species was counted as a prized client species by the Hutts, who controlled the region. By that time, Tsyk became a gloomy, polluted world.

Tsoss Beacon.title: Tsoss Beacon/Legends
Tsoss Beacon.lead: Tsoss Beacon was an asteroid in the Tsoss Beacon system of the Deep Core, containing an Imperial communications relay station built in 3 BBY.

Tufar.title: Tufar

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Metharian Nebula Territories

Tufar.lead: Tufar was the sixth planet in the Elrood system. It was a frigid world of methane ice.

Tumus.title: Tumus system/Legends
Tumus.lead: The Tumus system was a star system located within the Tapani sector's Mecetti Province. It was situated on the Procopian Shipping Lane, in the Colonies region of the galaxy.

Tsukkia.title: Tsukkia

facts.affiliation: Corporate Alliance, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire

Tsukkia.lead: Tsukkia was a planet located within the Tsukkia system of the Colonies and housed the manufacturer of Tsukkian water freighters.

Truuzdann.title: Truuzdann
Truuzdann.lead: Truuzdann was a planet in the Corellian sector. It was primarily visited for its small spaceport.

Tue.title: Tue

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Metharian Nebula Territories

Tue.lead: Tue was the first planet in the Kidron system.

Tujiamoor.title: Tujiamoor
Tujiamoor.lead: Tujiamoor was an Inner Rim astronomical object. It was the site of the Talecalle volcano chain. Around 11 ABY, Doctor Ils Ee visited Tujiamoor after stealing the Gree artifact known as the Sharka'k Noor. Shortly after that, the Talecalle volcanoes, which had remained dormant for 3,000 years, suddenly erupted, killing 400,000 colonists. Later, the xenoarchaeologist Corellia Antilles speculated that it was the artifact that had activated the volcanoes on Tujiamoor.

Tsutai.title: Tsutai
Tsutai.lead: Tsutai was a gas giant located in the Felucia system in the Outer Rim Territories' Thanium sector. During the Clone Wars, this area of space was contested over by the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Tunyok.title: Tunyok
Tunyok.lead: Tunyok was a frozen planet located in the Opoku system of the Outer Rim Territories.

Tureen VI.title: Tureen VI
Tureen VI.lead: Tureen VI was an astronomical object in the Tureen system of the Outer Rim Territories' Kriz sector. It was the origin of the Soup People, a group known for making high-quality soup. The Besalisk chef Dexter Jettster wrote in the menu for his restaurant, Dex's Diner on the planet Coruscant, that his soups were good enough to make their eaters think they were made by the Soup People of Tureen VI.

Tulpaa.title: Tulpaa
Tulpaa.lead: Tulpaa was an Unknown Regions planet. It was located in the Rakatan Archipelago, a group of worlds settled by remnants of the collapsed Infinite Empire of the Rakata species. During the subsequent tens of millennia, the Rakatan tribes inhabiting Tulpaa and its fellow planet Makatak emerged as the most advanced of the Rakatan Archipelago worlds.

Tungra.title: Tungra
Tungra.lead: Tungra was the primary planet of the Tungra system.

Tulatharri Junction.title: Tulatharri Junction
Tulatharri Junction.lead: Tulatharri Junction was an astronomical object located within the Tulatharri Junction system of the Outer Rim Territories' Veragi sector. During the Clone Wars, fought between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems, Republic colonel Hurst Romodi participated in military actions at Tulatharri Junction and was later decorated for his efforts while fighting there.

Tsevuka.title: Tsevuka
Tsevuka.lead: Tsevuka was a planet in the Outer Rim of the galaxy, and the homeworld of the Tsevukan species. At some point the planet came under the control of the Galactic Empire, causing an uproar among the planet's natives.

Tureen VII.title: Tureen VII
Tureen VII.lead: Tureen VII, was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories that was orbited by twin moons. Following the destruction of the Death Star at Yavin, the people of Tureen VII started aiding the Alliance to Restore the Republic in secret. However, having learned of Tureen VII's sympathy to the Alliance's cause, the Galactic Empire set up a blockade around the planet and establishing bases on the planet's twin moons.

Ttaz.title: Ttaz
Ttaz.lead: Ttaz was a rocky desert planet. Gray and colorless, a civilization lived in its caves and it was the location of a Rebel base.

Tynna.title: Tynna/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Corellian Hegemony, Confederacy of Independent Systems, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire, Galactic Alliance, Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire

Tynna.lead: Tynna was a planet located within the Tynnani system of the Expansion Region and the homeworld of the Tynnans, a species of aquatic mammals. A member world of the Republic, Tynna defected to the Confederacy of Independent Systems prior to the Clone Wars, and later repelled an invasion by the Galactic Empire. During its membership of the New Republic, Tynna was captured by the extragalactic Yuuzhan Vong and its environment modified to serve the invaders as a biological production center.

Turpimir.title: Turpimir

facts.affiliation: Jedi Order, Army of Light, Galactic Republic

Turpimir.lead: Turpimir was a Jedi who served in the Army of Light during the Ruusan campaign, and Turpimir died in the final battles in 1000 BBY. The fourth planet of the Hoth's Brand system was later named Turpimir in honor of the fallen Jedi.

Turkana.title: Turkana/Legends
Turkana.lead: Turkana was a sparsely populated planet located within the Turkana system near the Pakuuni sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Twith.title: Twith
Twith.lead: Twith was a planet located within the Twith system of the Core Worlds on one end of the Hyabb-Twith Corridor. It was constantly at war with Hyabb.

Tyne's Horky.title: Tyne's Horky

facts.affiliation: Kleb Zellock's criminal empire, Galactic Empire

Tyne's Horky.lead: Tyne's Horky was an ore-rich mining world in the Teraab sector. Its streets were full of mining and service droids, used to mine Keschel and Nergon-14.

Typha-Dor.title: Typha-Dor
Typha-Dor.lead: Typha-Dor was a planet located within the Uziel system of the Outer Rim Territories.

Tyed Kant.title: Tyed Kant
Tyed Kant.lead: Tyed Kant was an inhabited gas giant in the Core Worlds, near Demophon. It was the only planet in the Kantel system.

Tyan.title: Tyan
Tyan.lead: Tyan was a Mid Rim planet located in the Tyan sector. By 76 BBY, it was represented in the Galactic Republic by Senator Galim Eddawan, whose cruiser was captured by the pirate Lorian Nod, with Eddawan not being seen again afterward. In 12 ABY, Tyan was a member of the New Republic and was the site of a battle of the Galactic Civil War.

Tythe.title: Tythe/Legends

facts.affiliation: Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Republic

Tythe.lead: Tythe was a planet located in the Tythe system of the Outer Rim Territories, near Nelvaan.

Tython.title: Tython/Legends

facts.routes: Koros-Tython hyperlane, Tython hyperspace route, Tython hyperspace route
facts.terrain: Historic:, Mountains, Forests, Plains, Deserts, Modern: Barren fields and ash
facts.affiliation: Je'daii Order, Jedi Order, New Sith, Galactic Republic

Tython.lead: Tython was a planet in the Tython system of the Deep Core that played a pivotal role in the histories of the Je'daii Order and its successor, the Jedi Order. A verdant world that was incredibly rich in the Force, Tython was inhabited by an unknown species hundreds of thousands of years before the rise of the Galactic Empire, and it was visited by both the Gree and Kwa, two of the earliest species to have achieved interstellar travel.

Tuttin IV.title: Tuttin IV
Tuttin IV.lead: Tuttin IV was a planet located within the Tuttin system of the Inner Rim, one of the Six Local Systems.

Tyshapahl.title: Tyshapahl
Tyshapahl.lead: Tyshapahl was a planet located within the Tyshapahl system of the Outer Rim Territories.

Tuulab.title: Tuulab
Tuulab.lead: Tuulab was the second planet in the Triitus system of the Corva sector.

Tyberious.title: Tyberious (disambiguation)
Tyberious.lead: Tyberious may refer to one of the following:

Twing.title: Twing
Twing.lead: Twing was the seventh planet orbiting the star Prael in the Japrael system. Located in the Japrael sector of the Inner Rim, it was a gas giant.

Tyria.title: Tyria
Tyria.lead: Tyria was a female Human Jedi Master serving the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Cold War with the resurgent Sith Empire.

Tyne Albamon.title: Tyne Albamon
Tyne Albamon.lead: Tyne Albamon was an astronomical object located within the Tyne Albamon system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Rseik sector. Within a decade after extending its operations to the Rseik sector following the Bordal Contagion of 214 BBY, the Trade Federation established at Tyne Albamon a depot for storing various goods. Tyne Albamon was eventually mentioned in the memoirs of the Trade Defense Force captain Firmus Kett.

Tyybann.title: Tyybann
Tyybann.lead: Tyybann was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Inner Rim.

Twon Ketee.title: Twon Ketee
Twon Ketee.lead: Twon Ketee was a toxic swamp planet that was home to rathtars.

Tyegin.title: Tyegin
Tyegin.lead: Tyegin was a forested planet located in the Tyegin system in the Inner Rim Territories with many railroads on its surface.

Uaua.title: Uaua/Legends
Uaua.lead: Uaua was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Centrality sector. It was the homeworld of the Quor'sav, a species of tall, flightless sentients with avian and monotreme traits. After a virus accidentally introduced by off-world colonists nearly eliminated the Quor'sav, they developed a distrust for members of non-avian species.

Uba III.title: Uba III
Uba III.lead: Uba III was a planet located within the Uba system of the Mid Rim. It was a home to an Ubese colony, which was destroyed by the Jedi in 1800 BBY during the New Sith Wars, an act that aroused massive amounts of contempt for the Order. It became an asteroid belt.

Uba IV.title: Uba IV/Legends

facts.affiliation: Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire

Uba IV.lead: Uba IV, a planet in the Mid Rim, was the home of the Ubese people following the destruction of Uba III. At the end of the first Battle of Uba IV, it was heavily poisoned and irradiated.

Ubertica.title: Ubertica
Ubertica.lead: Ubertica was a planet located within the Ubertica system of the Mid Rim. While habitable, it had a relatively low level of atmospheric oxygen.

Uba V.title: Uba V
Uba V.lead: Uba V was a planet located within the Uba system of the Mid Rim. It was a home to an Ubese colony, which was destroyed by the Jedi in the Battle of Uba IV during the New Sith Wars.

UR41-284.title: UR41-284
UR41-284.lead: UR41-284 was a planet located within the UR41-284 system of the Unknown Regions.

Uba I.title: Uba I
Uba I.lead: Uba I was a planet located within the Uba system of the Mid Rim. It was a home to an Ubese colony, which was destroyed by the Jedi in the bombardment of the Uba system during the New Sith Wars.

Uba II.title: Uba II
Uba II.lead: Uba II was a planet located within the Uba system of the Mid Rim. It was a home to an Ubese colony, which was destroyed by the Jedi in the bombardment of the Uba system during the New Sith Wars.

Ubuuga.title: Ubuuga
Ubuuga.lead: Ubuuga was a planet located in the Ubuuga system and the homeworld of the Ubuugans and the Ubuugan fleshborers. Ubuuga was well-known for its caviar.

U-Tendik.title: U-Tendik
U-Tendik.lead: U-Tendik was a planet in the Mid Rim used as a refuge by the Rodian Tetsu Clan. The landscape was dominated by tall Tendril trees, which bore large nuts of the same name. The Rodians Nok and Teeku herded arboreal creatures known as "Tree-Botts" for milk and meat. Other native creatures included bo-toads and manka cats.

Ubrikkia.title: Ubrikkia/Legends

facts.region: Mid Rim, The Slice, Hutt Space (c. 5000 BBY)
facts.affiliation: Darth Revan's Sith Empire, Galactic Empire

Ubrikkia.lead: Ubrikkia was a Mid Rim industrial world situated in the Kastolar sector. Located on the Ootmian Pabol hyperlane, for millennia it fell under the influence of Hutts from nearby Hutt Space, directly constituting a part of that domain around 5000 BBY. Ubrikkia was the site of the headquarters of the company Ubrikkian Industries and its subsidiaries and shared its name with the ornament known as the Ubrikkian tail spiral ring.

Ucret.title: Ucret (disambiguation)
Ucret.lead: Ucret may refer to one of the following:

Uden Fen.title: Uden Fen
Uden Fen.lead: Uden Fen was an asteroid belt located between the planets Zoge Ver and Renenen in the Guter Wade system. It held the third orbital position around the star Rek in the Trilon sector of the Outer Rim.

Udnil II.title: Udnil II
Udnil II.lead: Udnil II was a planet located within the Airam sector of the Outer Rim Territories. A space battle between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire took place near the planet during the Galactic Civil War.

Udrin Cara.title: Udrin Cara
Udrin Cara.lead: Udrin Cara was a secret Imperial military design center in the Mid Rim. Jeres Moridon was stationed there as a researcher, where he was exposed to Maladeria II, a toxic gas that was being researched at the facility for possible military applications.

Tzarib.title: Tzarib
Tzarib.lead: Tzarib was a planet located in the Inner Rim. Quaghens could be caught there.

Ubardia.title: Ubardia
Ubardia.lead: Ubardia was a world in the Ubardia system in the Colonies, located along the Hydian Way. Thirty years after the Battle of Endor, Ubardia was a member world in the New Republic, where it was represented by Gadde Neshurrion in the Galactic Senate.

Ubduria.title: Ubduria
Ubduria.lead: Ubduria was an Inner Rim Territories celestial body. It was one of the two homeworlds—the other being the Outer Rim planet Nag Ubdur—of the sentient Ubdurian species. The Ubdurians were among the galaxy's earliest spacefaring species and eventually established a commercial empire along the hyperspace route known as the Vaathkree Trade Corridor. At one point, the forces of the Mandalorian warrior culture devastated Ubduria as part of one of their crusades into the galaxy's inner regions.

Uchinao.title: Uchinao
Uchinao.lead: Uchinao was a small, inhabited planet located in the Five Points system of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories.

Uba.title: Uba
Uba.lead: Uba was an astronomical object located in the galaxy's Mid Rim.

Umbara.title: Umbara/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Brotherhood of Darkness, Confederacy of Independent Systems

Umbara.lead: Umbara, informally known as the Shadow World due to the rays of its sun never completely reaching its surface, was a perpetually dark planet within the reaches of the Ghost Nebula. It was home to the Umbarans, a species of pale Near-Humans. It was also the site of a large battle during the Clone Wars.

Uluu.title: Uluu
Uluu.lead: Uluu was a planet in the Zug system. It was the farthest planet away from the system's star, Zug, and because of this, it was extremely cold. Uluu possessed a single natural satellite.

Ulabos.title: Ulabos

facts.routes: Corellian Run, Coruscant–Dantooine hyperlane, Koros Trunk Line, Leisure Corridor, Martial Cross, Metellos Trade Route, Namadii Corridor, Perlemian Trade Route …

Ulabos.lead: Ulabos was a frozen, rocky planet in the Coruscant system. It was surrounded by immense rings of ice and rock, known as the Ulabos ice bands.

Ukio.title: Ukio/Legends

facts.affiliation: Brotherhood of Darkness, Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Ukio.lead: Ukio was a well-known agriworld in the Ukio system of the Abrion sector and the homeworld of the Ukians. It served as one of the top producers of foodstuffs for the Core Worlds.

Ukatis.title: Ukatis
Ukatis.lead: Ukatis was an Inner Rim celestial body situated in the Ukatis system. During the blockade of the system at some point by 3996 BBY, the Ukatis enforcer Nayama shot down the starship of Jedi Padawan and smuggler Jolee Bindo, forcing it to crash-land on Ukatis. Nayama then led Bindo to be incarcerated in a local prison, from which he was subsequently broken out. Thereafter, the Padawan kidnapped Nayama, though the two later fell in love and would eventually marry and leave Ukatis.

Ultaar.title: Ultaar/Legends
Ultaar.lead: Ultaar was a planet in the Mid Rim Bortele sector, covered in jungles of towering giant blossoms that covered the world with a thick scent. Ultaar was home to the four-armed sentient species known as the Ultaarian Greenback. During the Galactic Civil War, Ultaar became host to a small Rebel Alliance presence, which was wiped out in 0 ABY by cyborg bounty hunter Beilert Valance.

Ulicia.title: Ulicia
Ulicia.lead: Ulicia was an industrial planet located in the Ulicia system of the Outer Rim Territories' Corporate Sector, which was governed by the Corporate Sector Authority. It was positioned along the hyperlane known as the Shaltin Tunnels. In 0 ABY, the CSA executive Hart-and-Parn Gorra-Fiolla recovered a prisoner named Naven Crel from the headquarters of the Commex corporation located at Ulicia.

Uhanayih.title: Uhanayih

facts.affiliation: Yinchorri, Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Galactic Federation of Free Alliances

Uhanayih.lead: Uhanayih was a planet in the Yinchorri system. It was a lifeless rock close to the system's primary star. In the Yinchorri language, its name meant "within world," and it was associated with the spirit realm in the Yinchorri religion. During the Yinchorri technological and military buildup, the High Command built a command center inside the world, giving its name new meaning. In 33 BBY during the Yinchorri Uprising, Uhanayih was attacked by the Navy of the Galactic Republic.

Umaren'k.title: Umaren'k
Umaren'k.lead: Umaren'k was a planet located in the Umaren'k system of the Unknown Regions.

Ulda Frav.title: Ulda Frav
Ulda Frav.lead: Ulda Frav was a tropical Expansion Region planet located in the Hangshan sector. Located in widely explored space by 5000 BBY, by 3998 BBY the world was visited by both a group of Jedi who arbitrated a treaty there and the Nazzar Crown Prince Qrrrl Toq. On the planet, the Jedi informed Toq of his potential for becoming a Jedi, which he eventually did. Millennia later, Vlaydm Churhee served as a sharpshooter on Ulda Frav before forming the Churhee's Riflemen mercenary unit.

Uluq.title: Uluq

facts.sector: Hapes Cluster, Hapan Rim Worlds, Transitory Mists

Uluq.lead: Uluq was a gas giant with amber-striped clouds and twin of Qogo in the Hapes Cluster and shared the same system as Shedu Maad. Uroro Station was once built between Qogo and Uluq to serve as a transfer station for Hapan ships traveling along the Throat to the mining world of Shedu Maad.

Uncharted planet.title: Uncharted planet
Uncharted planet.lead: This uncharted planet was located in Wild Space and was home to a small colony of Barundi. When a ship belonging to Illyan Webble, the president of Seraphan Industries, crashed on the planet, Webble discovered the fabled Yavin Vassilika in the Barundi village. Several treasure hunters later visited the planet in an effort to retrieve the Vassilika.

Ugor homeworld.title: Ugor homeworld
Ugor homeworld.lead: The Ugor homeworld was a planet in the Paradise system—known as J21-Z65 on most star charts—in the Airam sector of the Outer Rim Territories, at galactic coordinates M-20. The Ugor species evolved on the world. Although knowledge of the planet had been lost by the time of the Galactic Civil War, the Imperial sentientologist Obo Rin speculated that conditions there must have been perfect to allow for large, unicellular beings like the Ugors to evolve. It must have had easily obtainable nutrients, for example, and an absence of predatory species.

Ulmatra.title: Ulmatra/Legends
Ulmatra.lead: Ulmatra was a minor trade world that was located within the Ulmatra system of the galaxy's Hutt Space region. It lay at the intersection of the Pabol Sleheyron and the Dead Road hyperlanes. The former connected Ulmatra to the planets Sleheyron and Randa, while the latter linked the planet to the worlds of Kafane and Zisia. Ulmatra was home to the creature known as the Ulmatran condor, and the planet lay within the sphere of influence of the Kajidier kajidic, a clan of the Hutt species.

Unagin.title: Unagin
Unagin.lead: Unagin was a minor trade planet. It was located within the Unagin system of the Al'Nasrl sector, a part of the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The planet lay on the hyperlane called the Hollastin Run, which connected it to the worlds of Tsyk and Syvris. A smaller hyperspace route also connected Unagin to the planet Riileb. Due to Unagin's location near Hutt Space, starships that prepared to enter or leave that region frequently stopped at the planet.

Uhltenden.title: Uhltenden
Uhltenden.lead: Uhltenden was a planet located within the Thrasybule sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Surrounded by a debris ring from many wrecked starships, the planet had an atmosphere toxic to life, and no natural life resided on the planet.

Ulklub.title: Ulklub
Ulklub.lead: Ulklub was a hot rock planet with no moons that occupied the closest orbital position to the star Opoku. It was located within the Opoku system, a part of the Galov sector within the galactic regions known as the Outer Rim Territories and the Slice. The Triellus Trade Route hyperlane connected Ulklub to the star systems of Arami and Lyran.

Uenes.title: Uenes
Uenes.lead: Uenes was the first planet orbiting the star Teth in the Teth system. Located in the Baxel sector of the Outer Rim Territories, it was a scorching rock.

Umthyg.title: Umthyg
Umthyg.lead: Umthyg was a lackluster industrial world located in the Umthyg system of the Juvex sector, a part of the Senex-Juvex region in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim. A hyperlane known as the Agarix Trade Route linked it to the Dramassia system as well as the Dasoor system of the Agarix sector, while another hyperspace route connected it to the Farstone system. Umthyg was under the control of the aristocratic Ancient Houses of the Senex-Juvex.

Ulkantha asteroids.title: Ulkantha asteroids
Ulkantha asteroids.lead: The Ulkantha asteroids were located in the Ulkantha system, a part of the Tharin sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. At some point between 0 ABY and 3 ABY, the Galactic Empire carried out a raid in the Ulkantha asteroids. As a result, the Empire's Star Destroyer fleet known as the Death Squadron learned about an extensive Sakiyan smuggling ring based at the Syvris shadowport in the Al'Nasrl sector's Syvris system. The Death Squadron subsequently carried out a devastating attack on the shadowport.

Urazuun.title: Urazuun
Urazuun.lead: Urazuun was a sixth planet orbiting the star Zug in the Zug system. It was one of four gas giants in that system, along with Zauhu, Faargau, and Laazrau.

Urfon.title: Urfon
Urfon.lead: Urfon was the fifth planet from the star Solis Axum in the Axum system.

Urkupp.title: Urkupp
Urkupp.lead: Urkupp was a planet located within the Urkupp system of the Outer Rim Territories. The homeworld of the Dashade race, Urkupp was destroyed in 3996 BBY by the creation of the Cron Drift during the Great Sith War. However the Dashade survived by having offworld colonies.

Urdur.title: Urdur/Legends
Urdur.lead: Urdur was a remote planet in the Urdur system. It was located so far from its sun that it was perpetually frozen. It was the site of an outlaw tech base run by Klaus "Doc" Vandangante after his escape from Stars' End.

Urce.title: Urce

facts.region: Mid Rim, New Territories, Wild Space (c. 12,000 BBY–11,000 BBY), Lesser Plooriod Cluster
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Urce.lead: Urce was a Mid Rim planet located in the Lesser Plooriod Cluster. A member of the Galactic Republic since at least the Clone Wars, during the Galactic Civil War Urce served the Galactic Empire as a regional seat of power and was the site of the palace of High Inquisitor Mox Slosin. In 12 ABY, the Imperial Remnant was victorious over the New Republic at a confrontation at Urce.

Uogo'cor.title: Uogo'cor/Legends

facts.affiliation: Confederacy of Independent Systems, Pirate gangs, Dark Warbirds, Galactic Empire, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Uogo'cor.lead: Uogo'cor was a planet located within Trax sector, just off the Trax Tube. Its port often serviced the pirates that preyed on the Trax Tube. The name translated from the language of the native Uogo meant "home of the suffering ones".

Uru.title: Uru
Uru.lead: Uru was a planet located within the Uru system of the Outer Rim Territories, and was the homeworld of the sentient Oni species.

Usean II.title: Usean II
Usean II.lead: Usean II was an Outer Rim Territories world located in the Tunka sector. It was home to the rocket grass plant and the herbivore lrashtash, which had large incisor-like teeth to frighten predators. At some point, when the Imperial Wilek Nereus was stationed on Usean II, he added a set of lrashtash teeth to his dental collection. Later, when Nereus was asked about the origin of the teeth, he claimed they were from an "Useani camnzin," a predator he invented for his own entertainment and that of his inquirers.

Otherworld.title: Unidentified world (Stranger)
Otherworld.lead: The wizards of the Night Spirit were banished to an extra-dimensional world by the Ewoks from the Forest Moon of Endor. The world was a devastated wasteland filled with bones of dead animals and no vegetation. They stayed there until they finally found a way back though the rip in space to attack Endor. However, the attack failed, and they were forced to return.

Purple planet.title: Unidentified purple planet

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems

Purple planet.lead: This unidentified planet was the site of a battle between the Confederacy of Independent Systems and the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.

Urun Five.title: Urun Five
Urun Five.lead: Urun Five was a planet located within the Urun system of the Expansion Region where the natives would sometimes stick non-natives on top of their trees as decorations.

Uquine.title: Uquine/Legends
Uquine.lead: Uquine was a planet in the Uquine system of the Colonies.

Ungr.title: Ungr
Ungr.lead: Ungr was the second to first planet in the Honoghr system. Its surface was toxic rock.

Unistros.title: Unistros
Unistros.lead: Unistros was the third planet orbiting the star Utapau in the Utapau system. Located in the Tarabba sector of the Outer Rim Territories, it was a terrestrial world.

Upekzar.title: Upekzar

facts.terrain: Polar ice caps, Rain forests, Oceans, Plains, Mountains, Forests, Volcanos, Islands

Upekzar.lead: Upekzar was a small terrestrial planet counted among the Sith Worlds of the Esstran sector that was unique among the mostly barren worlds of the Stygian Caldera for its diversity of verdant biomes. The planet was most notable for the Circle of Visions, a circular ring of islands and seashore locations concentrated in the planet's southern hemisphere that hosted expansive volcanic cave systems.

Uriek.title: Uriek
Uriek.lead: Uriek was a planet located in the Ash Worlds sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Uphrades.title: Uphrades

facts.terrain: Agricultural continents (originally), Oceans (originally), Rocky plains, canyons, and craters

Uphrades.lead: Uphrades was a planet located in the Uphrades system of the Inner Rim. Originally a green and fertile agriworld during the years leading up to the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire, Uphrades supplied the Republic capital planet Coruscant with much of its food supplies. This earned it the nickname "Coruscant's Granary" until the Sith Lord Darth Angral targeted the agriworld during his campaign of vengeance in 3643 BBY.

Krykas asteroid field.title: Unidentified asteroid field (Krykas V)
Krykas asteroid field.lead: A large, hazardous asteroid field was located in the Krykas system, a part of the Mid Rim's Spirva sector. The terrestrial planet Krykas V was situated in the middle of the asteroid field. At some point, the corvette Bhishana Bhaga reverted to realspace in the middle of the asteroid field after its hyperdrive had malfunctioned. The captain of the corvette crash-landed the badly-damaged starship on Krykas V. Later, a group of individuals traversed the asteroid field to reach Krykas V in response to the crash of the Bhishana Bhaga.

Uninhabited planetoid.title: Uninhabited planetoid
Uninhabited planetoid.lead: In the year 3 ABY, several members of the Rebel Alliance set up an ambush on an uninhabited planetoid. They sent out a distress signal that was picked up by four Imperial TIE fighters on a far reconnaissance patrol, and when the TIEs arrived, they were promptly destroyed, and their lone survivor was interrogated. Four Rebels then used his recognition codes to enter his secret armada, which was passing near the planetoid, in stolen TIEs of their own.

Upper Brightday.title: Upper Brightday

facts.region: Expansion Region, Outer Expansion Zone, Northern Dependencies

Upper Brightday.lead: Upper Brightday was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Upper Brightday system. It was a part of the Expansion Region's Trestis sector, being located both in the Outer Expansion Zone sub-region and the Northern Dependencies portion of that region. Upper Brightday shared its name with the Inner Rim celestial body Brightday.

Utapau.title: Utapau/Legends

facts.terrain: Scrublands, Savanna, Canyons, Sinkholes, Desert surface, Grottoes, Underground oceans
facts.language: Utapese, Utai language, Galactic Basic Standard
facts.affiliation: Utapaun Committee, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Galactic Alliance, Galactic Alliance Remnant

Utapau.lead: Utapau was an arid sinkhole world in the Utapau system of the Tarabba sector in the Outer Rim Territories. Utapau was the homeworld of the Pau'ans and the Utai, more commonly referred to collectively as Utapauns. These species lived in the many giant sinkholes that dotted the planet's scrub-covered surface.

Ut.title: Ut

facts.region: Inner Rim; Transitory Mists, The Slice

Ut.lead: Ut was a planet located in the Ut system of the Hapes Cluster. It provided a song to Leia Organa Solo when the Hapes Consortium sent a diplomatic envoy to Coruscant in 8 ABY.

Utrost.title: Utrost
Utrost.lead: Utrost was a cosmopolitan terrestrial astronomical object situated in the Utrost system. It was located in the Coruscant sector, which in turn was a subsector the Corusca sector of the Core Worlds. Utrost lay at a distance of merely a few light-years from Coruscant, a city-world in the Coruscant system that served as the capital of the Galactic Republic and the Galactic Empire.

Uukaablis.title: Uukaablis
Uukaablis.lead: Uukaablis was the fourth planet of the Uukaablis system, and home to the Uukaablians.

Uyter.title: Uyter/Legends

facts.region: Mid Rim, Kashyyyk Region, The Slice
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Uyter.lead: Uyter was a planet located within the Uyter system of the Mid Rim. It was an agriworld with an independent-minded people.

Utharis.title: Utharis
Utharis.lead: Utharis was a planet located within the Utharis system of the Core Worlds.

Uviuy Exen.title: Uviuy Exen/Legends

facts.routes: Corsin Run (pre-3694 BBY), Hydian Way (post-3694 BBY), Shwuy Exchange
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Alsakan, Galactic Empire, New Republic

Uviuy Exen.lead: Uviuy Exen was a heavily populated planet in the Colonies' Shwuy sector. It lay at the intersection of the Hydian Way and Shwuy Exchange hyperlanes, which led various starships traveling along those routes to pass through the Uviuy Exen system.

Ussuis.title: Ussuis

facts.routes: Perlemian Trade Route, Triellus Trade Route

Ussuis.lead: Ussuis was the second planet in the Centares system. It was covered in toxic oceans.

V'rof.title: V'rof
V'rof.lead: V'rof was the third planet orbiting the star C'rel in the N'zoth system. Located in the Koornacht Cluster of the Core Worlds, it was a volcanic rock.

Utegetu Nebula.title: Utegetu Nebula/Legends

facts.system: Sarm system, Tenupe system, Tusken's Eye system, Woteba system

Utegetu Nebula.lead: The Utegetu Nebula was a shell nebula located in Wild Space of the galaxy.

Usta.title: Usta
Usta.lead: Usta was a terrestrial world located in the Usta system. It was situated in the Back Reach area of the Gordian Reach sector within the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The hyperlane known as the Feena Run linked it to the Barison and the Cometwash systems. A joint venture between members of the T'sarki species native to the planet Kalishik and the inhabitants of the Arda system oversaw energy mining operations on Usta, which rendered the world pitted and poisoned.

Usk.title: Usk/Legends
Usk.lead: The letter was the twenty-first letter of the Aurebesh alphabet. It was pronounced "usk", and had the value of /U/.

Utaruun.title: Utaruun

facts.routes: Corellian Run (—by 4000 BBY), Old Corellian Run

Utaruun.lead: Utaruun was a terrestrial planet located in the Utaruun system, a part of the Arkanis sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. Utaruun was located on the Old Corellian Run hyperlane between the Austan and Tatoo systems.

Usnia.title: Usnia
Usnia.lead: Usnia was a forested planet located in the Usnia system of the Senex sector, a part of the Senex-Juvex region in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim. It was also situated close to the Tangles, an area of intersecting hyperlanes. Usnia was connected via hyperspace routes to the Dornean, Trenthellix, and Varadan systems. It was declared a nature reserve by House Petro, one of the aristocratic Ancient Houses of the Senex-Juvex region.

Ushmin.title: Ushmin
Ushmin.lead: Ushmin was a small world just on the borders of the Imperial Remnant.

Uthtara.title: Uthtara
Uthtara.lead: Uthtara was a Mid Rim astronomical object located in the Eucer sector. During the Tionese War, it was the site of a Galactic Republic hyperspace jump-beacon that facilitated commercial interstellar travel to the celestial body Okator VIII. At some point during the conflict, warships affiliated with the Republic's enemy, the Honorable Union of Desevro & Tion, attacked Uthtara, damaging the jump-beacon.

Utor.title: Utor (disambiguation)
Utor.lead: Utor could refer to one of the following:, The Utor Shock, The Utor system

Useria.title: Useria
Useria.lead: Useria was a planet whose moon was home to the legendary Lunar Gardens, which were in ruins by the time of the Cold War.

Uvadala.title: Uvadala
Uvadala.lead: Uvadala was an astronomical object located in the Uvadala system, a part of the Ividal sector in the Slice portion of the Mid Rim. At some point during the Clone Wars, Uvadala was the site of a military operation which saw the participation of several starfighter squadrons of the Galactic Republic.

Ushruu.title: Ushruu
Ushruu.lead: Ushruu was a forested planet in the Ushruu system in the Altier sector of the Expansion Region. It was also the homeworld of the Enchantress, a female Force-sensitive human.

Vaathkree.title: Vaathkree/Legends

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, The Slice, Hutt Space (22 BBY)
facts.terrain: Crevasses, Lava flats, Volcanic mountain chains

Vaathkree.lead: Vaathkree, also known as Vaath'kror, was a volcanic Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Tharin sector's Periphery region. It was the homeworld of the sentient Vaathkree species, members of which had skin covered in a layer of stone or metal and were avid, religious traders. The Vaathkree constructed vnals, sentient, partly organic domed cities, for housing off-world visitors to their homeworld.

Farfalla.title: Valenthyne Farfalla

facts.affiliation: Jedi Order, Army of Light, Galactic Republic, House Farfalla

Farfalla.lead: Valenthyne Farfalla was a noted male half-Bothan Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order during the Golden Age of the Old Republic. Farfalla had a reputation for being foppish and vain and fought for the Army of Light as a Jedi Lord during the New Sith Wars. During the final years of the Ruusan campaign, Farfalla left Ruusan to gather three hundred followers to aid in the struggle for the world.

Vaal.title: Vaal/Legends
Vaal.lead: Vaal was a warm, grassy planet in the Gordian Reach in the Outer Rim Territories. The planet was dominated by large savannas and was home to several ferocious predators.

Va'art.title: Va'art
Va'art.lead: Va'art was a planet located within the Va'art system of the Mid Rim. It was orbited by a jungle moon known as the Jungle moon of Va'art.

V'shar.title: V'shar

facts.government: A mix of representative democracy and theocracy

V'shar.lead: V'shar was a Wild Space planet that was the homeworld of the sentient Ka'hren species. A tradition-bound, religious, and isolationist people, the Ka'hren had a system of government in which their many organized faiths had a direct influence. Centuries before 2 ABY, V'shar was home to the Unfyr warrior culture, which was known for its use of the rantok sword.

Vahaba asteroid belt.title: Vahaba asteroid belt
Vahaba asteroid belt.lead: The Vahaba asteroids were in the Quelii sector, near Halmad, along the Outer Rim of the galaxy. They were home to ore miners and skilled metal fabricators, who once had trade ties with Alderaan. They were part of Zsinj space and, in 8 ABY, were the location of the beginning of the Battle of Selaggis.

Vagran.title: Vagran

facts.terrain: Forests, Jungles, Oceans, Plains, Rolling hills

Vagran.lead: Vagran was a planet located in the Corellian sector with different temperate zones all varying in temperature and precipitation. Its climates and its favorable sunlight enabled Vagran to support a great deal of life.

Vakkar.title: Vakkar/Legends
Vakkar.lead: Vakkar was a planet located within the Vakkar system of the Colonies.

Valgauth.title: Valgauth/Legends
Valgauth.lead: Valgauth was one of three planets in the Valgauth system of the Expansion Region, and the only one to support any life. It was covered in barren wastelands and junk fields.

Valc VII.title: Valc VII

facts.affiliation: Galactic Empire, Pentastar Alignment, Imperial Remnant

Valc VII.lead: Valc VII was a planet located in the Perinn sector of the Outer Rim Territories near the Unknown Regions.

Vaenrood.title: Vaenrood
Vaenrood.lead: Vaenrood was a planet in the Vaenrood system, which was located in the Pakuuni sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Several months before the liberation of Kal'Shebbol, capital of the Kathol sector, the New Republic fought the Galactic Empire on Vaenrood.

Valera.title: Valera
Valera.lead: Valera was an astronomical object located in the Valera system, a part of the Southern Core portion of the Colonies. At some point between 19 BBY and 3 ABY, an uprising against the Galactic Empire took place on Valera. Although the insurrection was quelled by the Imperial Star Destroyer Stalker under the command of Captain Akal Zed, the Imperial forces lost several support vessels during the fighting due to flawed planning on Zed's part.

Vaklin.title: Vaklin
Vaklin.lead: Vaklin was a planet located in the Vaklin system of the Inner Rim Territories and the homeworld of Shula Shevu. A world deeply-seated in pro-Jedi tradition, the planet was initially resistant to anti-Jedi propaganda by the Galactic Empire, but eventually succumbed to pressures from Darth Vader.

Vaced.title: Vaced/Legends
Vaced.lead: Vaced was a planet located within the Vaced system of the Mid Rim beyond Bilbringi.

Vaal asteroid field.title: Vaal asteroid field
Vaal asteroid field.lead: The Vaal asteroid field consisted of several asteroid fields located in the Vaal system, intersecting the planet Vaal's orbit. In the year 0 BBY, Darth Vader's TIE Advanced x1 sustained damaged upon entering the Vaal asteroid field, causing it to crash-land on Vaal.

Valahari.title: Valahari/Legends
Valahari.lead: Valahari was an Outer Rim planet that claimed neutrality in the Clone Wars, but gave newer and advanced ships to the Confederacy of Independent Systems that gave the CIS an advantage over the Galactic Republic.

Vagneria.title: Vagneria system/Legends
Vagneria.lead: The Vagneria system was a part of the Core Worlds. It was the origin point of the meal known as the Vagnerian canapé.

Vagar Praxut.title: Vagar Praxut
Vagar Praxut.lead: Vagar Praxut was a remote planet located within the Vagar Praxut system. It lay in the Kharmort's Miasma nebula, a part of the galaxy's Unknown Regions. Vagar Praxut was the homeworld of the sentient Vagaari species.

Valc.title: Valc system
Valc.lead: The Valc system was a star system located in the Perinn sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Vale.title: Vale
Vale.lead: Vale was a celestial body located in the Vale system, a part of the Atravis sector in the Western Reaches portion of the Outer Rim Territories. In 13 BBY, a squadron of the Galactic Empire that included the Imperial starfighter pilot and hero Shea Hublin, Air Marshal of the Greater Seswenna region, was ambushed at Vale by anti-Imperial rebels. In the ensuing confrontation, Hublin lost a leg and a half of his arm and later transferred from the Imperial Starfighter Corps and instead took up a line command aboard the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Kabalian Cross.

Vandor-1.title: Vandor-1

facts.routes: Corellian Run, Coruscant–Dantooine hyperlane, Koros Trunk Line, Leisure Corridor, Martial Cross, Metellos Trade Route, Namadii Corridor, Perlemian Trade Route …

Vandor-1.lead: Vandor-1 was a rocky, barren planet in the Coruscant system. It was the third planet from the sun Coruscant Prime.

Vandor-2.title: Vandor-2

facts.routes: Corellian Run, Coruscant–Dantooine hyperlane, Koros Trunk Line, Leisure Corridor, Martial Cross, Metellos Trade Route, Namadii Corridor, Perlemian Trade Route …

Vandor-2.lead: Vandor-2 was a rocky, barren planet in the Coruscant system. It was the fourth planet from the sun Coruscant Prime.

Vandos.title: Vandos
Vandos.lead: Vandos was a planet located in the Vandos system of the Outer Rim Territories. It was controlled by the Separatists during the Clone Wars.

Vandor-3.title: Vandor-3

facts.routes: Corellian Run, Coruscant–Dantooine hyperlane, Koros Trunk Line, Leisure Corridor, Martial Cross, Metellos Trade Route, Namadii Corridor, Perlemian Trade Route …
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire, Galactic Federation of Free Alliances

Vandor-3.lead: Vandor-3, also spelled as Vandor-Three, was the fifth planet in the Coruscant system.

Valrar.title: Valrar
Valrar.lead: Valrar was a planet located within the Valrar system of the Mid Rim. Its dense canopy forests blocked most sunlight from reaching the planet's surface. Khabarakh was reassigned here by Thrawn after his failure to capture Leia Organa Solo on Kashyyyk.

Vanqor.title: Vanqor/Legends
Vanqor.lead: Vanqor was the largest planet in the Uziel system. It was located about 6 parsecs away from Florrum.

Vannix.title: Vannix
Vannix.lead: Vannix was a planet located within the Vankalay system of the Core Worlds, in a sector bordering the Kuat sector. It was represented in the New Republic Senate by Addath Gadan until she advocated appeasing the Yuuzhan Vong during the Yuuzhan Vong War.

Vanan.title: Vanan
Vanan.lead: Vanan was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Atravis sector's Vanan system in the Western Reaches portion of the Outer Rim Territories. In 4 ABY, when members of the slaver group known as the Herdessan Guild working for the Sith Lady Lumiya captured a miscreant, Finn, one of them suggested selling the offender as a slave to work in the lava mines on Vanan.

Vandron.title: Vandron (disambiguation)
Vandron.lead: Vandron may refer to one of the following:

Varada Five.title: Varada Five
Varada Five.lead: Varada Five was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Varada system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Varada sector. During the Galactic Civil War, Varada Five was home to the headquarters of the Varada sector branch of the SoroSuub Corporation, a Sullustan-run conglomerate based on the Brema sector planet Sullust.

Vanquo.title: Vanquo
Vanquo.lead: Vanquo was a mining world in the Outer Rim's Meerian sector that became the site of one of the early battles of the Mandalorian Wars. A mountainous planet, Vanquo was a resource world for the nearby ecumenopolis of Taris and a haven for refugees from the early conquests of the Mandalorian armies. When Taris was threatened by the Mandalorians, Vanquo became part of a Republic security cordon known as the Jebble-Vanquo-Tarnith line. In 3964 BBY, Vanquo was attacked by the Mandalorians in force, commanded by Mandalore the Ultimate and his lieutenant, Cassus Fett.

Vandyne.title: Vandyne

facts.affiliation: Infinite Empire, Ciutric Hegemony, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Vandyne.lead: Vandyne was an industrialized planet located within the Vandyne system of the Outer Rim Territories. As Vandyne was within the region of the Ciutric Hegemony and was located in the same "corridor" of space as Axxila, it was a target for the space pirates known as Kavil's Corsairs. During the Clone Wars, the Ciutric Hegemony joined the Confederacy of Independent Systems, and so the planet became a member of the Separatist Alliance.

Valorsi.title: Valorsi
Valorsi.lead: Valorsi was a planet located within the Valorsi system of the Juvex sector in the Mid Rim. Its native inhabitants, who came from many species, were known as Valorsians. Spacers told rumors of the pleasure world, which was said to have something to please even the most depraved lusts. The world's harems, where beings of both sexes and of innumerable species were kept and carefully bred for their beauty, were whispered about in taverns across the galaxy. Valorsian harems were rumored to be carefully guarded.

Varadan.title: Varadan
Varadan.lead: Varadan was a Mid Rim world of the Senex sector. It orbited two stars and was very hot. Controlled by the aristocratic Ancient Houses of the Senex-Juvex region, it served as a mining world and employed enslaved labor.

Valsedian asteroid belt.title: Valsedian asteroid belt

facts.affiliation: Hutt Cartel, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Alliance to Restore the Republic

Valsedian asteroid belt.lead: The Valsedian asteroid belt was an ore-rich asteroid belt located deep within Hutt Space.

Valnoos.title: Valnoos/Legends
Valnoos.lead: Valnoos was a world in the Morshdine sector of the Outer Rim Territories. In 45 ABY, it was home to several casinos which were attended by miners in the rift, including Tharston Kharl. The most notable of the casinos on Valnoos was the Blue Star, which was the site of an assassination attempt on the lives of Han Solo and Luke Skywalker by the Columi brothers, Craitheus and Marvid Qreph.

Vallt.title: Vallt

facts.affiliation: Zerpen Industries, Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems

Vallt.lead: Vallt was a planet located in the Juris sector of the Outer Rim Territories that was the homeworld of the Valltii and Taqwa species, and also the birthplace of Jyn Erso. Vallt was a cold world, with half the planet covered in glacial ice. The climate was often snowy and windy and quite inhospitable to off-worlders. Vallt was connected to Pastoria and Sterdic IV via hyperspace route.

Valkorion.title: Valkorion
Valkorion.lead: Valkorion was a male Human warrior from the planet Zakuul who lived centuries before the Galactic War. When the Force entity known as Vitiate arrived on Zakuul, he chose Valkorion to become his new host body, and took possession of the man's physical form. The mind of the original Valkorion was completely suppressed, and his identity was used by Vitiate to build and rule over the Eternal Empire based on Zakuul.

Vandin.title: Vandin
Vandin.lead: Vandin was a planet with at least one floating tibanna gas platform that housed tibanna gas miners. The planet utilized at least some form of organized security force, consisting of a number of probe droids. The Brekken Gang maintained some presence on the planet.

Vardos.title: Vardos
Vardos.lead: Vardos was a planet located in the Jinata system in the galaxy's Core Worlds, and was home to Iden and Garrick Versio. Vardos was notable for its diversity and loyalty, with even the planet's many alien inhabitants expressing faith in the Empire. Vardos was ruled by Protectorate Gleb with the help of the local Jinata Security.

Varl.title: Varl/Legends

facts.terrain: Modern:, Airless craters, Domed cities, Historic:, Polluted wastelands, Ancient:, Forests, Oceans

Varl.lead: Varl was the original homeworld of the Hutts, t'landa Til, and possibly the Rybets. According to Hutt legend, it was devastated in a cataclysm that vaporized its atmosphere and obliterated its moons, as well as all other planets in its star system. The planet was located in the Ardos system, in the Hutt Space oversector. It was the original capital of the Hutt Empire, from the empire's formation in 25,200 BBY, to the planet's destruction in 15,000 BBY, where the Hutts relocated to Nal Hutta, as the sector and empire's new capital.

Varn.title: Varn
Varn.lead: Varn was a water planet in the Quelii sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Varonat.title: Varonat/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Empire, New Republic (As of 12 ABY)

Varonat.lead: Varonat was a planet located in the Anoat sector of the Outer Rim Territories, situated along the Ison Corridor. It was a steaming jungle and adopted home of the Morodin species.

Vasuuli.title: Vasuuli (disambiguation)
Vasuuli.lead: Vasuuli may refer to one of the following:

Vasha.title: Vasha/Legends

facts.sector: Zuma sector, Inner Zuma Region, Moddell subsector

Vasha.lead: Vasha was a desert planet located in the Outer Rim Territories' Moddell sector. It was the homeworld of the insectoid Vashan species, which governed itself through a system theocratic castes and members of which were prized as workers across the Moddell sector. After it experienced a series of religious wars that ended when contact was established with the Galactic Republic, Vasha came to be dominated by the Ayrou species from the planet Maya Kovel, with Ayrou administrators overseeing deep-delving mines from which Vashan miners retrieved valuable ores and minerals.

Vaynai.title: Vaynai/Legends
Vaynai.lead: Vaynai was a resort planet located within the Vaynai system of the Outer Rim Territories on the Perlemian Trade Route.

Veccacopia.title: Veccacopia
Veccacopia.lead: Veccacopia was an astronomical object located within the Veccacopia system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Tunka sector. It was the homeworld of the sentient Cacop species.

Velabri.title: Velabri
Velabri.lead: Velabri was a planet located within the Velabri system of the Outer Rim Territories. It was conquered by the Galactic Empire.

Varristad.title: Varristad
Varristad.lead: Varristad was a small mining planet located in the Varristad system within the Abrion sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Vaykaaris.title: Vaykaaris (disambiguation)
Vaykaaris.lead: Vaykaaris may refer to one of the following:

Varhus.title: Varhus
Varhus.lead: Varhus was a planet in the Muunilinst system.

Vastrip IV.title: Vastrip IV
Vastrip IV.lead: Vastrip IV was a celestial body located in the Vastrip system, a part of the Northern Dependencies portion of the Inner Rim. The Human scout Lar Maendin was born at Vastrip IV in 23 BBY, a fact that was noted in 7 ABY by New Republic General Airen Cracken in Wanted by Cracken, a datafile that served as a compilation of reports on various threats to the New Republic.

Varlinaar.title: Varlinaar
Varlinaar.lead: Varlinaar was a planet located within the Varlinaar system of the Outer Rim Territories. Rorworr once smuggled a team of Rebels into the Imperial base on the planet under the pretense of bringing the Imperials rare foods.

Vasch.title: Vasch
Vasch.lead: Vasch was a planet located within the Vasch system of the Outer Rim Territories. A world of lush, green, rolling hills, it was the source of Vaschean rye, and was possibly the homeworld of Sam Heggs.

Vatleria.title: Vatleria
Vatleria.lead: Vatleria was a dark and foggy planet located within the Vatleria system of the Outer Rim Territories. Long abandoned by its inhabitants, the world eventually became the site of an Imperial base in its stone ruins. By 0 BBY, the base was assaulted by the Rebel Four, an Alliance to Restore the Republic team, but they were defeated by machinations of the Sith Lord Darth Vader.

Vassek.title: Vassek/Legends
Vassek.lead: Vassek was a planet in the Vassek system of the Outer Rim Territories. The planet was located within Separatist space during the Clone Wars. General Grievous maintained a castle on its third moon.

Vartos.title: Vartos
Vartos.lead: Vartos was a planet, located in the Tharin sector of the Outer Rim Territories, which was orbited by at least two moons.

Vatta Four.title: Vatta Four
Vatta Four.lead: Vatta Four was a terrestrial celestial body located in Wild Space's Vatta system. During the Galactic Civil War, the local inhabitants of Vatta Four manufactured the type of slugthrower rifle known as the Baed Sharpshooter.

Vardoss IV.title: Vardoss IV
Vardoss IV.lead: Vardoss IV, also known simply as Vardoss, was a celestial body located in the Vardoss system, a part of the Expansion Region's Vardoss sector. A hyperlane linked it to the Horob system as well as the Neshei system of the neighboring Neshei sector.

Vashka.title: Vashka
Vashka.lead: Vashka was a planet in the galaxy. It was covered in trees and mountains, with small towns dotting the edge of the planet's seas. In its prehistory, it hosted a variety of megafauna, before they were hunted to extinction for the safety of the sentient inhabitants. However, one creature, the Vashkan apidactyl, could not be completely exterminated despite the locals' best efforts. Much of its formerly-hazardous forest was replaced with even rows of ferns, palm trees, and sunburst flowers. The planet had only one large metropolis, Vashka City.

Velusia.title: Velusia/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Velusia.lead: Velusia was a planet in the Velus system of the Core Worlds. Largely oceanic, it supported a wide variety of life. Rocky, volcanic islands near the equator supported a population including the Aquar, a native Near-Human species.

Vendaxa.title: Vendaxa/Legends

facts.affiliation: Infinite Empire, Confederacy of Independent Systems

Vendaxa.lead: Vendaxa was a planet located within the Vendaxa system of the Expansion Region.

Velmor.title: Velmor/Legends

facts.terrain: Forests, Grassland, Oceans, Arctic polar regions
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Alliance of Free Planets

Velmor.lead: Velmor was the third, terrestrial planet in the Velm system in the Mid Rim near Myrkr, Obroa-skai and Aquaris.

Veloc.title: Veloc
Veloc.lead: Veloc was a planet in the fourth orbit around the star Velm. The first of two gas giants in the Velm system, it was located in the Halori sector in the Trans-Hydian portion of the Mid Rim. Veloc was orbited by thirty-three moons, 281 asteroid moonlets, and a planetary ring.

Vena.title: Vena
Vena.lead: Vena was a planet located within the Vena system of the Expansion Region and ruled by Baroness Omnino.

Vellity.title: Vellity
Vellity.lead: Vellity was a planet in the Trax sector's Vellity system, located in the Mid Rim. An agrarian world, it was the homeworld of the Near-Human Borneck.

Ventrux.title: Ventrux
Ventrux.lead: Ventrux was a planet located within the Ventrux system within the Thesme sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of Jenna Zan Arbor and original headquarters of Arbor Industries, although the laboratories were closed down when Jenna relocated to Simpla-12.

Vendara.title: Vendara
Vendara.lead: Vendara was a planet located within the Vendara system in the Kwymar sector of the Outer Rim region of the galaxy. It was home to the Vendaran species and the predatory mollusks called skeeg.

Ventooine.title: Ventooine/Legends
Ventooine.lead: Ventooine was a planet located within the Ventooine system of the Outer Rim Territories. It was ruled by the Satabs until their line was ended by Han Solo and the local Tieress, Chrysalla. The planet exported sansanna spice, crystals, and a mineral named Shadeshine.

Venir.title: Venir
Venir.lead: Venir was a planet located in the Kuat sector of the Core Worlds.

Velser's Ring.title: Velser's Ring/Legends

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Greater Javin, Western Reaches

Velser's Ring.lead: Velser's Ring, Velsor's Ring, or Velser's Rim, was an asteroid belt in the Bespin system named after the leader of the survey team that discovered it.

Venaari.title: Venaari
Venaari.lead: Venaari was a Mid Rim world, and the third planet in the Vellakiya system. It was the headquarters of Venaari Enterprises. The Galactic Empire increased its presence on the planet following the Battle of Endor due to Project Orrad, which was exposed by Shandria L'hnnar. The heightened Imperial security made it difficult for the New Republic to gain a foothold on Venaari.

Vengler.title: Vengler
Vengler.lead: Vengler was a planet located within the Vengler system in Wild Space. Imperial scouts discovered it a few years before 7 ABY. It had a very primitive spaceport in which there was Varno Market, the principal point of interest of the planet. The inhabitants were mostly farmers and had a life of subsistence. Otherwise, the planet was seemingly not highly regarded. Vengler was also the home of the Scitrok Warriors.

Velumia.title: Velumia
Velumia.lead: Velumia was the third planet that orbited Velus, the Velus system's sun. The planet, like the rest of its system, was located in the Northern Dependencies portion of the Core Worlds. Velumia was a gas giant with seven moons. The planet, along with the rest of its system, was located along the Shawken Spur hyperlane, connecting it to the Shawken and Thokos systems. The Velusia system, and therefore Velumia itself, was additionally connected by another hyperlane to the Scipio system.

Velmooine.title: Velmooine
Velmooine.lead: Velmooine was a desert planet with four moons that occupied the second orbital position around the star Velm. It was located in the Velm system, a part of the Halori sector in the Trans-Hydian portion of the Mid Rim.

Veladine.title: Veladine
Veladine.lead: Veladine was the sixth planet orbiting the star Velm. It was the outermost planet in the Velm system, which was located in the Halori sector in the Trans-Hydian portion of the Mid Rim. Veladine's surface consisted of ice, and it was orbited by three asteroid moonlets.

Vendred.title: Vendred

facts.region: Mid Rim, Kashyyyk Region, The Slice

Vendred.lead: Vendred was the first planet in the Bissillirus system, a barren globe that was orbited by a single unstable moon. The planet had a local year of fifty-six standard days.

Venzeiia 2 Prime.title: Venzeiia 2 Prime
Venzeiia 2 Prime.lead: Venzeiia 2 Prime was a planet located within the Venzeiia system of the Expansion Region that was subjugated by the Empire after the Battle of Hoth.

Velx-Shel.title: Velx-Shel
Velx-Shel.lead: Velx-Shel was a planet located within the Corellian sector of the Core Worlds.

Venestria.title: Venestria
Venestria.lead: Venestria was an astronomical object located in the Venestria system, a part of the Clacis sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It lay on the Braxant Run hyperlane between the Muunilinst and Kwevron systems, and another hyperspace route linked it to the Cezith system.

Vergill.title: Vergill

facts.region: Inner Rim Transitory Mists, The Slice

Vergill.lead: Vergill was a planet located within the Vergill system of the Inner Rim. It was an influential member of the Hapes Consortium. In 25 ABY, the planet's archon was Beed Thane.

Vernet.title: Vernet
Vernet.lead: Vernet was an agriworld located within the Vernet system of the Expansion Region.

Viamarr 4.title: Viamarr 4
Viamarr 4.lead: Viamarr 4 was a planet located within the Viamarr system of the Inner Rim. Its capital city was Velery. Viamarr Blackroot fungus was grown in the planet's subterranean caves.

Vestar.title: Vestar/Legends
Vestar.lead: Vestar was the Icarii homeworld located within the Vestar system of the Outer Rim Territories.

Verkuyl.title: Verkuyl
Verkuyl.lead: Verkuyl was a planet located within the Verkuyl system of the Outer Rim Territories where alazhi was grown.

Vex Major.title: Vex Major

facts.sector: Zuma sector, Inner Zuma Region, Moddell subsector

Vex Major.lead: Vex Major, also known as Far Gent, was a swampy Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Moddell sector. Originally settled by a sect of the Order of the Ffib, by the time of the Yuuzhan Vong War decades later Vex Major was inhabited by insular clans of Human fishers.

Vessitoar.title: Vessitoar
Vessitoar.lead: Vessitoar was a planet located within the Vessitoar system of the Mid Rim with a New Republic military training facility.

Vexta Belt.title: Vexta Belt
Vexta Belt.lead: Vexta Belt was an asteroid belt located in the Vexta system of the Carrion sector.

Verla Klest.title: Verla Klest
Verla Klest.lead: Verla Klest was an gas giant–type planet with nine moons that occupied the seventh orbital position around the star Abo. It was located within the Lehon system, a part of the Unknown Regions' area known as the Tempered Wastes.

Veroleem.title: Veroleem
Veroleem.lead: Veroleem was a planet in the Unknown Regions.

Verig.title: Verig
Verig.lead: Verig was a primitive planet home to a group of native nomadic hunters. During the Galactic Civil War, Rebel Alliance tactician Beryl Chiffonage traveled to Verig and drew inspiration from the planet's nomads, who used a bola-like weapon to trip the large Pryss-creatures, to develop a similar maneuver for use against Imperial All Terrain Armored Transport walkers.

Vestral.title: Vestral
Vestral.lead: Vestral was one of the many planetary haunts that Captain Ellin Lah and the crew of the Woebegone frequented.

Vertseth.title: Vertseth/Legends
Vertseth.lead: Vertseth was a celestial body located in the Vertseth system, a part of the Slice portion of the Colonies. The company Vertseth Automata constructed the techno-service droid Todo 360 at Vertseth.

Vesla Two.title: Vesla Two
Vesla Two.lead: Vesla Two was a planet located in the Vesla system of the Outer Rim's Corosi sector. It could originally support life, but the Sith Lord Darth Mekhis tested one of her new superweapons on the planet and caused catastrophic atmospheric damage—enough to draw a colony of shyrack broodlings.

Vesla Three.title: Vesla Three
Vesla Three.lead: Vesla Three was a planet located in the Vesla system of the Outer Rim's Corosi sector. The Sith Lord Darth Mekhis tested one of her new superweapons on the planet during the Cold War, ripping apart Vesla Three with gravity-manipulating technology.

Viamarr.title: Viamarr
Viamarr.lead: Viamarr was a world in the Viamarr system of the Inner Rim Territories that was controlled by the Galactic Empire. The Leonis family once lived on this planet and during Zare Leonis's fifteenth birthday, laughed over stories of their time on this world and other worlds half-forgotten.

Vetine.title: Vetine
Vetine.lead: Vetine was a planet located in the Merrick sector within the Inner Rim Territories. It was the location of an Imperial base with a research lab containing the two remaining fragments of the Great Tree that Darth Sidious stole from the Jedi Temple after declaring himself Emperor and converting the temple into the Imperial Palace. Luke Skywalker and Shara Bey of the Alliance to Restore the Republic carried out a mission to retrieve the tree fragments from the Empire.

Vexar.title: Vexar
Vexar.lead: Vexar was a gas giant of the Vexar system located in the Corporate Sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was orbited by at least three moons, including the third moon of Vexar.

Veros.title: Veros
Veros.lead: Veros was a planet located in the Veros system in the Dimean sector of the Expansion Region. It was also the homeworld of the Verosian species. It was once rich, but the Galactic Empire gained control of the planet and took the Verosians' wealth for itself.

Veron.title: Veron/Legends
Veron.lead: Veron was an agriworld located in the Veron system of the Senex sector, a part of the Senex-Juvex region in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim. The Senex-Juvex Loop hyperlane linked it to the Cyimarra and Presteen systems, while the Veron Route connected it to the New Cylimba system of the D'Aelgoth sector.

Vjun.title: Vjun/Legends

facts.affiliation: Old Sith Empire, Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Order of the Sith Lords, Dark Empire, Dark Side Elite, X1's faction …

Vjun.lead: Vjun (or Vijjun) was a dark, almost lifeless planet in the Vjun system, known for its acidic rainfalls. It was also renowned for its expensive hand-woven tunics. It was the location of Bast Castle, a fortress used by Count Dooku, and later a place where Darth Vader studied the dark side of the Force.

Vinsoth.title: Vinsoth/Legends

facts.routes: Celanon Spur, Salin Corridor, Sprizen End Run, Spurs of Celanon
facts.terrain: Deserts, Grassy plains, Mountains, Polar ice caps
facts.affiliation: Chevin Conglomerate, Galactic Republic, Darth Revan's Sith Empire, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Zsinj's Empire, Thrawn's confederation …

Vinsoth.lead: Vinsoth was the home planet of the Chevin and Chev species in the Quelii sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was a temperate planet with zones of grasslands and prairies, arctic ice, and deserts.

Vilosoria.title: Vilosoria
Vilosoria.lead: Vilosoria was a Mid Rim planet situated in the Lifh sector. It was the homeworld of the Vilosorian species, which cycled between being docile beings and vicious carnivores based on the change of seasons on the planet. Vilosoria was invaded by the Galactic Empire, which established a garrison there.

Vladet.title: Vladet
Vladet.lead: Vladet was a planet in the Colonies. It was the sector capital of Rachuk sector. An Imperial base was located on Grand Isle. Without vaccination, any visitor to the planet would catch Rachuk roseola. When Rogue Squadron attacked the planet, Imperial Admiral Devlia was killed.

Vicondor.title: Vicondor/Legends
Vicondor.lead: Vicondor was a planet located in the Vicondor system of the Mid Rim. Its inhabitants joined with the people of Junction V, Delaluna, and Bezim to build the Station 88 Spaceport. This coalition of planets chose to remain loyal to the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.

Virujansi.title: Virujansi/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire

Virujansi.lead: Virujansi was a planet in the Virujansi system of the Inner Rim. The planet's populace had a complex hierarchy.

Vispil.title: Vispil
Vispil.lead: Vispil was a planet located within the Vispil system of the Outer Rim Territories. It refused warlord Zsinj's bribes and fought against him.

Vo.title: Vo

facts.region: Core Worlds; the Arrowhead, Southern Core

Vo.lead: The seventh and outermost planet in its system, Vo was a frozen, moonless, lifeless rock. It was located in the Sacorrian system, one of the Outlier systems of the Corellian sector, in the Arrowhead portion of the Galactic Core. In 18 ABY, the government of Vo's system-mate Sacorria attempted to secede from the New Republic.

Vilimia.title: Vilimia
Vilimia.lead: Vilimia was the fourth planet that orbited the sun Velus. The planet was located within the Velus system of the Northern Dependencies portion of the Core Worlds. Vilimia was a gas giant with thirteen moons. The planet, along with the rest of its system, was located along the Shawken Spur hyperlane, connecting it to the Shawken and Thokos systems. The Velus system, and therefore Vilimia itself, was additionally connected by another hyperlane to the Scipio system.

Vizcarra.title: Vizcarra
