Vizcarra.lead: Vizcarra was a Galactic Empire prison planet located in the Outer Rim Territories' Cegul sector. The Wookiee Syychi, who went on to be enslaved by the Empire, was born there, and at one point she and the smuggler Memcha-Badawzi—who was sentenced to imprisonment on Vizcarra—both escaped from an enslaver starship traveling to the planet. Similarly, in 2 BBY the smuggler Tait Ransom also escaped from detention on the planet Omman Minor before he could be shipped off to Vizcarra.

Viidaav.title: Viidaav
Viidaav.lead: Viidaav was a planet located in the Bryx sector of the Mid Rim. It was inhabited by the Viidaav species.

Vintrus.title: Vintrus
Vintrus.lead: Vintrus was a planet located in the Manda Sector in the Mid Rim.

Virgillia 7.title: Virgillia 7

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Aristocracy, Galactic Empire, Virgillian Free Alignment

Virgillia 7.lead: Virgillia 7, or Virgillia VII, was a planet located within the Virgillia system of the Outer Rim Territories.

Vindalia.title: Vindalia
Vindalia.lead: Vindalia was a planet located within the Vindalia system of the Colonies and the homeworld of the Vindalian species.

Viis.title: Viis
Viis.lead: Viis was a planet located within the Viis system of the Unknown Regions. It was home to the Viis Empire. It was decimated by a prolonged outbreak of Mnggal-Mnggal.

Vinza.title: Vinza
Vinza.lead: Vinza was a hothouse world located in the Anoat sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It had no moons and was located in Separatist space during the Clone Wars.

Vo Tunbren.title: Vo Tunbren
Vo Tunbren.lead: Vo Tunbren was a planet in the Tadra sector a subsector of the Cegul sector in the Outer Rim Territories. It was the location of an Imperial communications research facility where Jeres Moridon was stationed.

Vlemoth Port.title: Vlemoth Port/Legends

facts.language: Galactic Basic Standard, Mando'a, Muun, Talz

Vlemoth Port.lead: Vlemoth Port was a planet located within the Instrop sector of the Outer Rim Territories. An uninhabited world once known only as P1S15IS0079, Vlemoth Port was purchased from the Galactic Republic by Vlem Hill, and developed by the Muuns into an industrial center. Scattered tribes of displaced Talz could also be found on Vlemoth Port, in addition to an enclave of Mandalorian immigrants centered around the settlement of Arumorut.

Vir Aphshire.title: Vir Aphshire
Vir Aphshire.lead: Vir Aphshire was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories' Tharin sector which had honey fields, orchards, and clay hives. Around 0 ABY, the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry drove the Galactic Empire's forces from the orchards and clay hives, during which news came about the destruction of the Empire's Death Star. After the fighting, the rebel Sergeant Fektrin led a scout party to observe the nearest settlement on the planet and had Private Hazram Namir pass his report on to Captain Micha Evon.

Virgillia.title: Virgillia
Virgillia.lead: Virgillia was a world located in the Virgillia system. It was orbited by a forested moon.

Vontor.title: Vontor

facts.affiliation: Hutt Empire, Xim's empire, Galactic Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire, Confederation

Vontor.lead: Vontor was a planet located in the Si'Klaata Cluster within the boundaries of Hutt Space. Vontor was a huge source of kiirium.

Vodran.title: Vodran/Legends

facts.affiliation: Hutt Empire, Galactic Empire, Yuuzhan Vong empire, Confederation

Vodran.lead: Vodran was a murky, humid planet in the Si'Klaata Cluster, on the Ac'fren Spur of Hutt Space. Its surface featured jungles and swamps, and was home to the reptilian Vodran. It was also the original planet where the garbage-eating dianoga evolved, a pest that eventually spread throughout the galaxy.

Voon.title: Voon/Legends
Voon.lead: Voon was a Core Worlds planet. A part of the Krenher sector, it was situated on the Hyabb-Twith Corridor hyperlane, a zone long embroiled in a conflict between the worlds Hyabb and Twith. Decades before 4050 BBY, the Nelori Marauders established their main base on Voon. The planet's location in the contested area allowed the Nelori to carry out raids against starships and worlds both along the Corridor and in the nearby star systems without any fear of pursuit or reprisal.

Voktunma.title: Voktunma
Voktunma.lead: Voktunma was a planet in the Voktunma system of the Core Worlds.

Von-Alai.title: Von-Alai
Von-Alai.lead: Von-Alai was a planet in the Von-Alai system of the Expansion Region, polluted by Kontag factories.

Voltare.title: Voltare
Voltare.lead: Voltare was a spaceport planet in the Voltare system of the Inner Rim.

Vob.title: Vob
Vob.lead: Vob was a gas giant–type planet located in the Vob system, a part of the Ktilac Regions sector in the Slice portion of the Inner Rim. It was famous for its perpetual atmospheric storms, which constituted a natural wonder. The Vob system was one of only three star systems in the Ktilac Regions—which were governed by the native Ktilac, Murachaun, and Tocoyan species—that was open to outsiders under strict conditions.

Vornax.title: Vornax
Vornax.lead: Vornax was a barren planet located within the Vornax system of the Outer Rim Territories. The planet itself was covered in abandoned droid factories and piles of rusted scrap and garbage. The factories had been left disused for centuries. The only beings who ever visited the abandoned world were those attempting to escape law, or bounty hunters looking to collect a bounty.

Vorian IV.title: Vorian Four
Vorian IV.lead: Vorian Four was a terrestrial astronomical object located within the Vorian system of the Expansion Region. It was polluted with niobarium by the Commerce Guild, but the incident was covered up by Shu Mai.

Voorlach.title: Voorlach
Voorlach.lead: Voorlach was a planet located within the Voorlach system of the Colonies with a Klatooinian Trade Guild presence. It was here that Platt Okeefe became impressed with the workings of the Trade Guild and resolved to join them in order to earn her first freighter.

Vorpa'ya.title: Vorpa'ya
Vorpa'ya.lead: Vorpa'ya was an agriworld in the Outer Rim Territories of the galaxy, located within the Mandalore sector's Vorpa'ya system, not far from the neighboring world of Concord Dawn. A terrestrial planet with a breathable atmosphere, Vorpa'ya was conquered by the Mandalorians, and became part of Mandalorian space.

Vonak.title: Vonak
Vonak.lead: Vonak was a planet home to the Cilare species which subscribed to martial values and savored combat around 25 ABY. It had wide open grassy plains and was home to canine and a reptilian species which were hunted by the warriors.

Vor Deo.title: Vor Deo

facts.routes: Corellian Run (—by 4000 BBY), Cranan-Excarga Route, Old Corellian Run

Vor Deo.lead: Vor Deo was an Outer Rim Territories trade world situated in the Arkanis sector. Located on the Old Corellian Run hyperlane and at the endpoint of the Cranan-Excarga Route, during the reign of the Galactic Empire, an increasing number of illegal cargoes smuggled to Vor Deo led the Imperial authorities to concentrate law enforcement efforts there.

Voorsbain.title: Voorsbain
Voorsbain.lead: Voorsbain was a Mid Rim industrial planet situated in the Tangles area of the Senex sector. It was under the control of the aristocratic House Picutorion. During the Galactic Civil War, the individual Uris planned to unleash nanogene droids on the population of the planet in order to turn it into an army of mutated, zombie-like warriors.

Volgax.title: Volgax

facts.language: Flames of the Crucible, Galactic Basic Standard

Volgax.lead: Volgax was a planet located within the Volgax system of the Core Worlds.

Volik.title: Volik
Volik.lead: Volik was a temperate planet with rocky terrain that was located within the Unknown Regions' Volik system. The planet's surface was dominated by expansive grasslands and small mountain ranges, as well as numerous canyons and waterfalls. Volik's plant life included the bannak and tanna trees and the mumau root, while the reyko was the most frequently encountered example of the planet's fauna.

Voniss.title: Voniss
Voniss.lead: Voniss was an astronomical object located in the Voniss system, a part of the freestanding subsectors portion of the Mid Rim. The meteorological phenomena of the celestial body included dust storms.

Vorrnti.title: Vorrnti
Vorrnti.lead: Vorrnti was a world located in the Vorrnti system, within the Northern Dependencies portion of the Inner Rim. It contained Vorrnti City.

Vondoru.title: Vondoru
Vondoru.lead: Vondoru was a planet in the Unknown Regions. During the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire, an Imperial fleet ambushed the Valor-class cruiser Intercessor over Vondoru and destroyed it.

Vorlag.title: Vorlag
Vorlag.lead: Vorlag was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories that was the cavernous homeworld of the sentient Vorlaggn species. A palace existed on the planet that was owned by the crime lord Slussen Urla-fir Kal Kethin-wa Canker.

Vortex.title: Vortex/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Vortex.lead: Vortex was a Mid Rim planet in the Glythe sector. The planet was the homeworld of the Vors, a non-emotional winged species.

Vulpter.title: Vulpter/Legends

facts.population: 421 million:, 88% Vulptereen, 6% Amaran, 2% Human, 2% Neimoidian, 2% other
facts.affiliation: Trade Federation, Alliance to Restore the Republic

Vulpter.lead: Vulpter was the third planet of the Vulpter system in the Deep Core, and the homeworld of the sentient Vulptereen species. Originally an unspoiled world with a wide array of flora and fauna, Vulpter was transformed over the millennia into a massively polluted globe covered in waste and factories. This meant that the planet was unable to sustain itself in terms of agriculture, and was thus entirely reliant on importing foodstuffs from other worlds. Vulpter was a noted producer of starships, and was home to one of the galaxy's largest podracer factories.

Vorzyd IV.title: Vorzyd IV
Vorzyd IV.lead: Vorzyd IV was a planet in the Vorzyd system. All the Vorzydiaks on Vorzyd IV were dedicated to manufacturing products and were disdainful of fun and games.

Vorzyd V.title: Vorzyd V/Legends

facts.population: 2 billion:, 63% Vorzydiaks, 10% Hrakians, 8% Humans, 6% Kilmaulsi, 4% Selonians, 9% other
facts.affiliation: Commonality, Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Alliance to Restore the Republic, Greater Maldrood, Yuuzhan Vong empire …

Vorzyd V.lead: Vorzyd V, also known as Vorzyd 5, Vorzyd-5, or Gambler's World, was a planet in the Vorzyd system of the Outer Rim Territories.

Vorzyd II.title: Vorzyd II
Vorzyd II.lead: Vorzyd II was a planet located within the Vorzyd system of the Outer Rim Territories.

Vulvarch.title: Vulvarch
Vulvarch.lead: Vulvarch was a planet located within the Vulvarch system of the Colonies, not far from Atzerri. Luke Skywalker discovered the Star Morning docked at Vulvarch while en route to retrieve the Fallanassi from Farlax sector.

Vulta.title: Vulta
Vulta.lead: Vulta was a planet located within the Atreyis system of the Mid Rim. It was the homeworld of the Vultan species, as well as Greff-Timms Industrial and Oss Wilum.

Vuma.title: Vuma/Legends
Vuma.lead: Vuma was a planet located within the Vuma system of the Core Worlds.

Vuchelle.title: Vuchelle
Vuchelle.lead: Vuchelle was an orange-colored astronomical object located in the Outer Rim Territories' Atrivis sector. Situated along the Braxant Run hyperlane, Vuchelle in 22 BBY became the site of attempted negotiations between a Jedi-led Galactic Republic task force and the pirates of Iridium, who had been committing raids against Republic convoys. The pirates attacked the Jedi task force but were eventually defeated, with one of their starfighters believed to have reentered Vuchelle's atmosphere and burned up as a result.

Vulpus.title: Vulpus
Vulpus.lead: Vulpus was a terrestrial planet located in the Vulpter system of the Deep Core. It occupied the first orbital position around the star Vulpter, and it featured a searing hot environment and a rocky surface.

Vulp Major.title: Vulp Major
Vulp Major.lead: Vulp Major was a gas giant in the Vulpter system of the Deep Core. The planet had nine moons and occupied the sixth orbital position around the Vulpter star.

Vulp Minor.title: Vulp Minor
Vulp Minor.lead: Vulp Minor was a terrestrial planet located in the Vulpter system of the Deep Core. The planet featured a frozen environment, and its surface consisted of rock. Vulp Minor occupied the fifth orbital position around its star, Vulpter, and it had three moons.

Vorzyd III.title: Vorzyd III
Vorzyd III.lead: Vorzyd III was a planet located within the Vorzyd system of the Outer Rim Territories.

Vorzyd I.title: Vorzyd I
Vorzyd I.lead: Vorzyd I was a planet located within the Vorzyd system of the Outer Rim Territories.

Vultar.title: Vultar
Vultar.lead: Vultar was a planet located in the Vultar system, a part of the Arrowhead region in the Slice portion of the Core Worlds. Evidence pointed to the Celestials, an advanced species that disappeared from the galaxy in 30,000 BBY, having used a set of devices, including the gravity-manipulation machine known as the Cosmic Turbine, to construct the Vultar system, including its planets.

Voss.title: Voss

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Tion Cluster, The Slice

Voss.lead: Voss was a terrestrial planet in the Voss system located in Allied Tion sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Originally only having one native sentient species known as Gormak, the planet was discovered by the ancient Sith who used Voss for its resources, until the Jedi arrived to drive them off. Seeking allies among the natives, the Jedi taught some of the Gormak tribes on how to use the Force, but the Gormak were unprepared and those tribes radically evolved into a different looking species named the Voss.

Vryssa.title: Vryssa
Vryssa.lead: Vryssa was a planet located within the Vryssa system of the Outer Rim Territories that hosted an Imperial garrison base. Buldobeasts were commonly found on this planet. At some point in 1 ABY, the entire garrison was wiped out by Boba Fett while pursuing the bounty on Rivo Xarran.

Vrosynri 8.title: Vrosynri 8
Vrosynri 8.lead: Vrosynri 8 was a minor world in the Ciutric Hegemony.

Vulcusion.title: Vulcusion (disambiguation)
Vulcusion.lead: Vulcusion may refer to one of the following:

Vrogas Vas.title: Vrogas Vas

facts.affiliation: Jedi Order, Alliance to Restore the Republic

Vrogas Vas.lead: Vrogas Vas was a planet located in Outer Rim Territories. It had no known native life forms and large amounts of gaseous emissions, and it housed the Jedi Temple in which Jedi Master Phin-Law Wo was stationed.

Wayland.title: Wayland/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire, Galactic Alliance, Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire

Wayland.lead: Wayland was a lush, semi-tropical planet in the Outer Rim Territories.

Waskiro.title: Waskiro/Legends
Waskiro.lead: Waskiro was a mountainous world in the Jospro sector of the Outer Rim. The planet was heavily involved in trade, namely mining. At some point in history, the contact with the mining colony was lost.

Walalla.title: Walalla
Walalla.lead: Walalla was a planet located within the Walalla system of the Inner Rim.

Vycinyth.title: Vycinyth
Vycinyth.lead: Vycinyth was a forested resort planet in the Barnaba Province of the Tapani sector. Its Tapani Arts and Sports Complex accommodated swoop races, shockboxing, and Cracian thumper races. The planet was orbited by four space casinos and the moon Vilhon.

Vvaw.title: Vvaw/Legends
Vvaw.lead: Vvaw was a planet located in the Vvaw system, a part of the Calaron sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. Jedi Master Jmmaar, a member of the Viraanntesse species that originated in the Expansion Region's Viraanntesse system, hailed from Vvaw.

Wakeelmui.title: Wakeelmui

facts.routes: Shawken Spur, Corsin Run (pre-3694 BBY), Hydian Way (post-3694 BBY)

Wakeelmui.lead: Wakeelmui was a world located in the Colonies. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, the corporation Sienar Fleet Systems maintained a presence in the Wakeelmui star system. It was also the homeworld of Imperial sergeant Barich who worked for Sienar Fleet Systems in the missile division.

Vurdon Ka.title: Vurdon Ka/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Vurdon Ka.lead: Vurdon Ka was a planet located within the Vurdon Ka system of the Inner Rim. It was an idyllic world of mosses and inhabited by the peaceful Vuvrians. It was located along the Perlemian Trade Route. The planet joined the Galactic Republic by 22,000 BBY, and later went on to be apart of the Galactic Empire. It was conquered by the Yuuzhan Vong prior to the fall of Duro during the Yuuzhan Vong War.

Wakiza.title: Wakiza
Wakiza.lead: Wakiza was a planet located within the Wakiza system of the Core Worlds of the galaxy. One of the original thirteen planets of the Duskhan League, it was located within the Koornacht Cluster. Wakiza was orbited by the Imperial Navy shipyard Black Eight. "Sleepy" Nagelson was shot down while flying a reconnaissance mission over Wakiza for the New Republic.

Walin'or.title: Walin'or (disambiguation)
Walin'or.lead: Walin'or may refer to one of the following:

Weerden.title: Weerden
Weerden.lead: Weerden was an Imperial planet located within the Weerden system of the Core Worlds, near Coruscant. It was here that an assassin droid killed Grand Inquisitor Laddinare Torbin by crashing his shuttle, Sark-I into Torbin's palace.

Wann Tsir.title: Wann Tsir
Wann Tsir.lead: Wann Tsir was a planet located in the Wann Tsir system, a part of the Sepan sector in the Slice portion of the Expansion Region. During the Galactic Civil War, Wann Tsir was protected by a planetary shield.

Vykos.title: Vykos
Vykos.lead: Vykos was a planet located within the Vykos system of the Outer Rim Territories. It was a stopping point on the Relgim Run of the luxury liner Kuari Princess, a planet of fast-flowing rivers (such as the Tueinami) which attacted white-water rapid rafters and deep canyons (such as the Grand Aderian Range, a kilometer deep).

Vuzsa.title: Vuzsa/Legends
Vuzsa.lead: Vuzsa was an Outer Rim Territories world located in the Arkanis sector. It served as a refueling point for starships traveling along the Trans Gulf Route hyperlane. During the Galactic Civil War, the Rebel Alliance maintained a safehouse at Vuzsa, at which the Rebel agent Tiree once hid in order to evade capture by the Galactic Empire.

Vundaria.title: Vundaria
Vundaria.lead: Vundaria was a planet located within the Vundaria system of the Inner Rim Territories which exported fire lamps.

Wall of Dantooine.title: Wall of Dantooine
Wall of Dantooine.lead: The Wall of Dantooine was a vast obsidian asteroid field in the Dantooine system. No mining operation had claimed the entire field, as it was too large to manage effectively. Stretching as far as the eye could see, it was a useful landmark for travelers.

Wazta.title: Wazta/Legends
Wazta.lead: Wazta was a celestial body located in the Wazta system, a part of the Wazta sector of the Outer Rim Territories. At some point by the time shortly after the Battle of Yavin, multiple infantry units of the Galactic Empire's Army at Wazta defected, after which several Imperial Navy starships and their crews deserted, as well. The defections of the Wazta units were addressed in Imperial Communique #2734.19g, and General Nasda later mentioned them in a communique sent to all Sector Commanders of the Imperial Military, as well.

Vyndal.title: Vyndal
Vyndal.lead: Vyndal was a planet located in the galaxy that was covered with colorful forests, and rocky plains. Vyndal was also the homeworld to a unknown race.

Wadi Raffa.title: Wadi Raffa
Wadi Raffa.lead: Wadi Raffa was a Legacy planet in the Wadi Raffa system in the Airam sector of the Outer Rim Territories in the Western Reaches. Wadi Raffa was a beautiful planet, featuring land masses with green and yellow forests and conical mountains, including a volcano. Wadi Raffa's rivers combined with the seas to form estuaries, and from its sandy coves and red clay riverbanks, an array of inlets and scattered rocky islands were visible amongst the deep blue water.

Wecacoe.title: Wecacoe
Wecacoe.lead: Wecacoe was a planet located in the galaxy's Colonies region that Captain Cassian Andor, Kertas, and Rismor of the Rebel Alliance traveled to in order to extract Imperial security protocols.

Waymancy.title: Waymancy system
Waymancy.lead: The Waymancy system was located in the Inner Rim Territories and the Interior in grid square K-8 of the Standard Galactic Grid. In 9 ABY, the Waymancy system fell within the borders of the New Republic.

Wehttam.title: Wehttam
Wehttam.lead: Wehttam was a planet located within the Wehttam system of the Core Worlds. Wehttam was the Wehttam homeworld. It was located in the Farlax sector.

Wistril.title: Wistril
Wistril.lead: Wistril was a planet in the Wistril system, located in the Outer Rim Territories. It was known as a smugglers haven.

Widek.title: Widek
Widek.lead: Widek was a planet located within the Widek system of the Core Worlds. It was also the terminus of the Widek Bypass.

Werncin 3.title: Werncin 3
Werncin 3.lead: Werncin 3 was a slaving planet located within the Werncin system of the Outer Rim Territories' Kwymar sector, on the Listehol Run.

Wen'he'dinae.title: Wen'he'dinae
Wen'he'dinae.lead: Wen'he'dinae was a terrestrial planet located in the Wen'he'dinae system, a part of the Eidoloni sector in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim. The planet had several seasons and was home to a multitude of carnivorous creatures.

Wilpiet.title: Wilpiet
Wilpiet.lead: Wilpiet was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Wilpiet system, a part of the Cademimu sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories. During the Galactic Civil War, the Rebel Alliance maintained a depot there. A group of Alliance operatives that used the Simiyiar-class light freighter Waterspire operated in Wilpiet's vicinity. Less than two months prior to some point by 2 ABY, the Kerestian bounty hunter Milacass stole the Waterspire from the Wilpiet depot, as a result becoming wanted for theft and destruction of Alliance property.

Weken.title: Weken
Weken.lead: Weken was a terrestrial planet with two moons that was located within the Parthovian Cluster's Faarlsun system, in the Wild Space region of the galaxy. The planet occupied the third orbit around its star, the yellow-white Faarlsun, and had a poisonous environment.

Wego.title: Wego
Wego.lead: Wego was the innermost planet of the Obas system located within the Expansion Region of the galaxy.

Welarn.title: Welarn
Welarn.lead: Welarn was a planet located within the Vernet system of the Expansion Region. This gas giant was orbited by 23 moons.

Weytta.title: Weytta
Weytta.lead: Weytta was a planet located within the Weytta system of the Outer Rim Territories, near Murkhana. It was the homeworld of the Jedi Master Roan Shryne and his parents, Jula and Jen.

Weldii III.title: Weldii III
Weldii III.lead: Weldii III was a mining planet located in the Core Worlds. It was the site of a brutal mining colony led by the Bith administrator Lenc. After the gunrunner Praaelon Di sold weaponry to both sides in a local miners' rebellion, by 3 ABY Lenc tasked a group of bounty hunters and pirates with bringing Di back to Weldii III. When the attempt failed, Di led his own armed force in an attack on Lenc and his staff at Mine Shaft 342 on Weldii III and defeated the administrator.

Wizar II.title: Wizar II
Wizar II.lead: Wizar II was a planet located within the Wizar system of the Wild Space. It was the homeworld of a species of squid-like sentients known as Uroths. It was a terrestrial planet, largely unknown to the outside galaxy.

Werda.title: Werda
Werda.lead: Werda was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories' Mandalore sector. Located within the Mandalore system, Werda occupied the ninth and outermost orbit around the system's star, Mandalore. A frigid world bereft of any moons, Werda was classified as an ice ball. After the Taung forces of Mandalore the First journeyed from Roon to conquer the uninhabited planet that became Mandalore, the newly renamed Mandalorians spread out to conquer the worlds of the surrounding system, including Werda. The planet's name came from the archaic Mando'a word werda, meaning "darkness".

Weitun.title: Weitun
Weitun.lead: Weitun was the second planet orbiting the star Sriluur in the Sriluur system. Located in the Tharin sector of the Outer Rim Territories, it was a searing rock.

Wielu.title: Wielu
Wielu.lead: Wielu was a planet in the galaxy with two suns, and was well known for its famous beaches and thriving black market. During the Clone Wars, Obi-Wan Kenobi, Anakin Skywalker and Ahsoka Tano briefly vacationed here.

Wellspring of Life.title: Wellspring of Life/Legends
Wellspring of Life.lead: The Wellspring of Life was a planet located somewhere "in the heart of the galaxy," the homeworld to the midi-chlorians. Its surface appeared barren and heavily damaged, but life was plentiful in large open spaces deep beneath the ground. Large amounts of light were released from within the planet, which was hidden in the Force, and also appeared to negatively affect mechanical and electronic devices.

Force planet.title: Wellspring of Life/Legends
Force planet.lead: The Wellspring of Life was a planet located somewhere "in the heart of the galaxy," the homeworld to the midi-chlorians. Its surface appeared barren and heavily damaged, but life was plentiful in large open spaces deep beneath the ground. Large amounts of light were released from within the planet, which was hidden in the Force, and also appeared to negatively affect mechanical and electronic devices.

Wetyin's Colony.title: Wetyin's Colony
Wetyin's Colony.lead: Wetyin's Colony was the main settlement on the moon Yavin 4 that was established when settlers traveled from the planet Setor to become farmers. In the months after the Battle of Endor, Shara Bey and Kes Dameron settled in a new home in the colony after completing their service in the Alliance to Restore the Republic. Having their own home had been their dream after being separated from one another, as well as their son, Poe, for much of the Galactic Civil War.

Whiforla II.title: Whiforla II
Whiforla II.lead: Whiforla II was a planet located along the galaxy's Shipwrights' Trace trade route. Whiforla-song was a language spoken by the avian inhabitants of the planet.

Wobani.title: Wobani
Wobani.lead: Wobani was a temperate planet partially hidden by a swirling dust cloud, located in the Wobani system, in the Bryx sector of the galaxy's Mid Rim. During the Imperial Era, the planet was used by the Galactic Empire as a site for labor and prison camps.

Weik.title: Weik/Legends
Weik.lead: Weik was a terrestrial planet located in Wild Space. Weik was far from established hyperlanes and was nearly disconnected from the rest of the galaxy.

Wukkar.title: Wukkar/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Black Sun, New Republic, Yuuzhan Vong empire

Wukkar.lead: Wukkar was a heavily-populated planet located within the Wukkar system of the Core Worlds. Part of Galactic Republic space since the Republic's inception, Wukkar became a part of the Galactic Empire until surrendering to the New Republic. It was later occupied by the Yuuzhan Vong species during their invasion of the galaxy.

Wroona.title: Wroona/Legends

facts.routes: Harrin Trade Corridor, Rimma Trade Route
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Corellian Hegemony, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire

Wroona.lead: Wroona was the homeworld of the near-Human Wroonians, located in the Wroona system.

Wor Tandell.title: Wor Tandell/Legends
Wor Tandell.lead: Wor Tandell was the primary planet of the Tandell system in the Dolomar sector. Its surface was covered with an array of oceans and landmasses.

Womrik.title: Womrik
Womrik.lead: Womrik was a planet located within the Womrik system in the Dufilvian sector of the Mid Rim, near New Cov. The sights of its ice-capped mountain peaks, which were second to none, attracted many tourists and were a source of pride the planet's inhabitants.

Worxer.title: Worxer

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Metharian Nebula Territories

Worxer.lead: Worxer, also called Yablon, was a planet in the stellar drift clouds of Elrood sector. It was destroyed when its sun went supernova around 198 BBY. The Galactic Republic only managed to evacuate a few of the native Spiners, and by the time of the Galactic Civil War, most people believed the species extinct, a mistake not far from the truth. One remaining Spiner, by the name of Hedji, was part of Han Solo's freelance group the 'Star-hoppers of Aduba 3', he spoke little of his past due to its suggested horror and distress.

Xa Fel.title: Xa Fel/Legends
Xa Fel.lead: Xa Fel was a populated planet in the Kanchen sector of the Core Worlds. It was the homeworld of the Xa Fel. The planet readily supported all forms of life.

Wynth.title: Wynth
Wynth.lead: Wynth was an astronomical object located in the Wynth system, a part of the Wyloff sector in the Northern Dependencies portion of the Colonies. Shortly after the Battle of Yavin, the Rebel Alliance operative and Imperial defector Colonel Vin Northal was stationed at Wynth.

Wxtm.title: Wxtm
Wxtm.lead: Wxtm was a planet located in the Wxtm system of the Outer Rim Territories. One of its native creatures was an avian called a ravenscreecher, which had six legs.

Woqua.title: Woqua
Woqua.lead: Woqua was a planet located within the Woqua system of the Core Worlds.

Wyloff.title: Wyloff
Wyloff.lead: Wyloff was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Wyloff system, a part of the Wyloff sector in the Northern Dependencies portion of the Colonies. The capital city of Wyloff was surrounded by middle class suburbs. Wyloff was also the location of the Wyloff sector Imperial Intelligence ExComm facility.

Woteba.title: Woteba
Woteba.lead: Woteba was a planet located in the Utegetu Nebula of Wild Space between Reecee and Adumar.

Wyveral.title: Wyveral
Wyveral.lead: Wyveral was a planet located within the Wyveral system of the Mid Rim where many advances in forensic medicine were made.

Wrea.title: Wrea/Legends
Wrea.lead: Wrea was an inhabited planet located within the Wrea system of the Outer Rim Territories near the Smuggler's Run. When Kueller's explosive droids decimated the inhabitants of the Run, the Wreans offered medical assistance. Wrea also contained a Republic outpost during the Clone Wars.

Worru'du.title: Worru'du
Worru'du.lead: Worru'du was a planet located within the Worru'du system of the Core Worlds and known for its grass fields. The grass from Worru'du could be used for basket weaving.

Wodenstam.title: Wodenstam
Wodenstam.lead: Wodenstam was a world located within the star system of the same name, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Skine sector. Around 10 ABY, it served as the homeworld of Lucross Collections, a loan sharking and credit laundering operation and member of the criminal Tenloss Syndicate.

Wol Cabassh.title: Wol Cabassh/Legends
Wol Cabassh.lead: Wol Cabassh was an Outer Rim Territories planet situated in the Quelii sector. It was the homeworld of both the plasma leech spacecraft parasite and the related sentient Wol Cabasshites. The latter species fed on plasma and metals and communicated via the use of natural magnetic fields. Over millennia, starship travel spread both the plasma leech and the Wol Cabasshites far from Wol Cabassh.

Wyndigal 2.title: Wyndigal 2
Wyndigal 2.lead: Wyndigal 2, originally known as Huronom, was a swampy planet located within the Wyndigal system in the Ash Worlds in the Outer Rim Territories.

Wortan.title: Wortan
Wortan.lead: Wortan was a city in the Aro-voa canyon on Iridonia.

Worrite homeworld.title: Worrite homeworld
Worrite homeworld.lead: The Worrite homeworld was an astronomical object unknown to the galaxy at large. The crustacean–insectoid Worrite species hailed from this location.

Wynkahthu.title: Wynkahthu
Wynkahthu.lead: Wynkahthu was a gas giant in the Mid Rim Territories with turbulent atmospheric storms located near Ord Mantell. In 2 BBY, the rebel group known as the Spectres journeyed to Wynkahthu with the pirate captain Hondo Ohnaka and the gangster Azmorigan to secure the contents of an adrift Imperial cargo ship. Their ship, the Ghost, remained outside of the atmospheric storm that had trapped the Imperial ship while Ezra Bridger, Zeb Orrelios, Ohnaka, and Azmorigan entered the ship to locate the precious cargo onboard.

Xal 3.title: Xal 3

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories; Inner Zuma Region

Xal 3.lead: Xal 3 was a planet located within the Xal system of the Ablajeck sector, not far from Endor. It served as the base for the Armorers' Confederacy.

Xobome 6.title: Xobome 6
Xobome 6.lead: Xobome 6 was a planet located within the Xobome system of the Colonies, between Commenor and Doldrums. Its high plains were blasted by freezing winds. Wraith Squadron captured the Night Caller over Xobome 6.

Xeron.title: Xeron
Xeron.lead: Xeron was a planet located within the Xeron system, a part of the Trailing Sectors portion of the Inner Rim. Xeron was the site of a battle between the Rebel Alliance and Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War circa 3 ABY, where the Imperial Army attacked Rebel ground troops with a new warbot to devastating effect.

Xo.title: Xo
Xo.lead: Xo was a planet located within the Xo system in the Spinward sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of the Zanibar species and the site of their sacrificial rituals.

Xoman Three.title: Xoman III
Xoman Three.lead: Xoman III, or Xoman Three, also known as Xoman Free, was a planet located in the Halla sector of the Mid Rim.

Xartun.title: Xartun
Xartun.lead: Xartun was an Outer Rim Territories planet in the Ojoster sector that was involved in manufacturing. A New Republic world, it was near warlord Zsinj's territory. Although the planet was a signatory to the New Republic, a deal brought about by a previous planetary leader, the governor of Xartun during 7 ABY, Nojin Koolb, had it secretly allied with Warlord Zsinj.

Xoemefel.title: Xoemefel
Xoemefel.lead: Xoemefel was a planet in the Xoemefel system of the Mid Rim. It was the site of Ops Post, a New Republic Scout Service base.

Xaza IV.title: Xaza IV
Xaza IV.lead: Xaza IV was a planet located in the Xan sector of the Mid Rim. Around 3.5 ABY, an exquisite oil-burning chandelier owned by Rithgar, the master of the Kothlis Shadowport came from this planet.

Xend.title: Xend
Xend.lead: Xend was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Inner Rim's Xend system. It was home to insects as well as the winged xendrite, a type of reptavian that typically hanged from tree branches and hunted insects. The creatures had no natural predators, and their population was instead controlled by that of the available insects.

Xerton Nine.title: Xerton Nine
Xerton Nine.lead: Xerton Nine was an astronomical object that occupied the ninth orbital position within the Xerton system of Wild Space. The Braxant Run hyperlane linked the Xerton system to the Qonto system. At some point following the Battle of Endor that occurred in 4 ABY, the Grand Magnus was a title held by an individual from Xerton Nine.

Xerxes.title: Xerxes
Xerxes.lead: Xerxes was a terrestrial planet located in the Xerxes system of the Core Worlds. During the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Rebel Alliance, it had a planetary police force and was the site of a weapons shop.

Xolu.title: Xolu
Xolu.lead: Xolu was a planet that was located within the Xolu system in Hutt Space, a sector of the galaxy controlled by the Hutt species. It was connected to the worlds of Hollastin and Far Pando by the hyperlane called the Pando Spur.

Xantar.title: Xantar
Xantar.lead: Xantar was a planet located within the Xantar system of the Outer Rim Territories' Corva sector.

Xanas.title: Xanas (disambiguation)
Xanas.lead: Xanas may refer to one of the following:

Xilxash.title: Xilxash
Xilxash.lead: Xilxash was an agricultural planet that applied for and was granted Galactic Alliance membership in 44 ABY. It was a small backwater world, known for its delicious brul fruit.

Xochtl.title: Xochtl
Xochtl.lead: Xochtl was a world located in the Xochtl system. It was situated in the Loop Worlds area of the Gordian Reach sector within the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. A hyperlane connected it to the Bronsoon system.

Xirl.title: Xirl
Xirl.lead: Xirl was a jungle planet located in the Xirl system in Wild Space, near the Kalidorn system. The Stinker was a creature that was native to Xirl. The female human Gozetta built a hunting lodge on Xirl. The planet was a source of messages piggy-backing on official channels, calling on people to resist the Galactic Empire.

Xala.title: Xala
Xala.lead: Xala was a planet located in the Xala system in Wild Space that was orbited by at least one moon.

Xendek.title: Xendek
Xendek.lead: Xendek was a blue planet located in the Xendek system in the Calaron sector of the Outer Rim Territories. The argora was a type of bird native to Xendek. The Xendekians believed that the argora brought rain and crops and was responsible for all good fortune on the planet. At some point the Galactic Empire stole a argora for the Emperor's personal zoo. Later, the Spectres attempted to rescue the bird.

Xifal.title: Xifal
Xifal.lead: Xifal was a planetoid located in Xifal system, within the Allied Tion sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories.

Yag'Dhul.title: Yag'Dhul/Legends

facts.routes: Corellian Trade Spine, Hidakai Pool, Rimma Trade Route
facts.climate: Hostile; from frigid polar regions to sultry equatorial areas
facts.terrain: It depended on the position of the atmosphere, ranging from habitable zones to frozen plains
facts.government: Theocratic mathematocracy, Elected planetary governor and ruling bodies known as the Body Calculus and the coalition of Factors
facts.affiliation: Corellian Hegemony, Galactic Republic, Darth Revan's Sith Empire, Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Empire, Eriadu Authority, New Republic …

Yag'Dhul.lead: Yag'Dhul was a small world located in the Inner Rim at the intersection of the Rimma Trade Route and the Corellian Trade Spine. The complex interaction of orbits and rotations between Yag'Dhul and its three moons meant that the planet was continually beset by massive tidal forces powerful enough to pull the atmosphere into different regions, exposing large areas of the surface to hard vacuum.

Yaga Minor.title: Yaga Minor/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Thrawn's Confederation, Pentastar Alignment, Imperial Remnant, Fel Empire, Empire-in-exile

Yaga Minor.lead: Yaga Minor was an industrialized planet located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. Yaga Minor primary native species were the Yagai, insectoids with a hive-caste society and was known throughout the galaxy for its major starshipbuilding facilities. It was famous for where the Outbound Flight departed towards the Unknown Regions in 27 BBY.

Yalara.title: Yalara
Yalara.lead: Yalara was a planet located within the Yalara system of the Wild Space of the galaxy.

Xyquine II.title: Xyquine II

facts.terrain: Deserts, Forests, Jungles, Mountains, Oceans, Plains, Tundras

Xyquine II.lead: Xyquine II, also known simply as Xyquine, was a planet located within the Xyquine system of the Corellian sector. The world boasted a diverse array of life.

Yablari.title: Yablari/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Exar Kun's Sith Empire, Darth Revan's Sith Empire

Yablari.lead: Yablari was an agrarian planet located within the Vorzyd sector's Yablari system of the Outer Rim Territories. Located along the Perlemian Trade Route, Yablari's agricultural technology was highly advanced and prolific.

Yabosta.title: Yabosta
Yabosta.lead: Yabosta was a planet located in the Yabosta system of the Expansion Region. It was orbited by at least two moons, the second of which was called Skalokor. Port Kalla was one of the largest cities on the planet, and its primary spaceport.

Y'nybeth.title: Y'nybeth
Y'nybeth.lead: Y'nybeth was a world located within the star system of the same name of the Expansion Region. It was the dark place and homeworld of the Plasmars, transparent amoebic creatures that absorbed any available warmth into their bodies.

Yanibar.title: Yanibar

facts.climate: Dry, very hot (in summer), Frigid, wet (in winter)

Yanibar.lead: Yanibar was a Wild Space planet with a harsh environment that included seasonal climate extremes. At some point by 3951 BBY, it was settled by a group of families and friends of Jedi. The colony was intended to be a temporary refuge to help those people hide from attacks by the Sith; however, the Jedi who arranged the colonization were all killed in combat and thus, Yanibar became forgotten.

Xuaquarres.title: Xuaquarres
Xuaquarres.lead: Xuaquarres was a planet located within the Xuaquarres system of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the location of both the Graveyard of the Dragons and a secret storehouse of Emperor Palpatine.

Yalln.title: Yalln
Yalln.lead: Yalln was a terrestrial industrial world situated in the Yalln system, a part of the Mortex sector in the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It featured corporate complexes, outside of which stretched vast unsettled territories.

Yaralou.title: Yaralou
Yaralou.lead: Yaralou was a saturated planet with no moons that occupied the fourth orbital position around the yellow star Baralou, which was located within the Baralou system of the Outer Rim Territories' Varada sector.

Yabol Opa.title: Yabol Opa/Legends
Yabol Opa.lead: Yabol Opa was a Colonies planet located on the Perlemian Trade Route. A member of the Galactic Republic since at least 22,000 BBY, Yabol Opa allied itself with the planet Alsakan during its long struggle against the Republic's capital world, Coruscant. By 22 BBY, the University of Yabol Opa stretched across the entire surface of the planet, which had become a part of the Galactic Empire by five years later.

Xorth.title: Xorth
Xorth.lead: Xorth was a agriworld located within the Xorth system of the Core Worlds.

Yamime.title: Yamime
Yamime.lead: Yamime was a gas giant located in the Felucia system, which in turn was found in the Outer Rim Territories' Thanium sector. During the Clone Wars, this area of space was contested over by the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Yaled IV.title: Yaled IV
Yaled IV.lead: Yaled IV was a world. It was home to a group of cyborgs who worshiped the war robot deity ZIMM.

Xxan.title: Xxan
Xxan.lead: Xxan was a water-covered planet that was located in the Outer Rim Territories. The underwater city Acquos was located on the world, and was connected to a small spaceport on the surface of the planet, via a turbolift.

Yaka homeworld.title: Yaka (planet)
Yaka homeworld.lead: Yaka was a terrestrial planet located in the Yaka system, a part of the Northern Dependencies portion of the Colonies. It was situated near the Perave system and was the homeworld of the sentient Yaka species, members of which spoke the Yakan language.

Yaloris.title: Yaloris
Yaloris.lead: Yaloris was a planet. The Yalor were the native sentient species of the planet.

Yar Togna.title: Yar Togna
Yar Togna.lead: Yar Togna was an Outer Rim Territories planet that was home to the sentient Tognath species. A high-gravity world with a dense, oxygen-poor atmosphere, it featured a massive volcanic mountain range that ejected large quantities of sulfur and ash into the planet's air. The airborne particles were consumed by the large, floating creatures known as float-jellies, which thereby prevented Yar Togna's climate from becoming frigid.

Xorrn.title: Xorrn/Legends
Xorrn.lead: Xorrn was a mineral rich planet located in the Ferra sector within the Outer Rim Territories. Xorrn was a young planet. As the surface of the planet had only recently begun to cool, the natural resources of the planet were easily accessed. However the unstable crust and prohibitive start-up costs prevented nearly all mining operations.

Yavin Prime.title: Yavin Prime/Legends
Yavin Prime.lead: Yavin Prime, also known as Yavin (Yavin pronounced: YAH-vin), was a bright red gas giant in the Gordian Reach sector (part of the Bright Jewel Oversector).

Yinchorr.title: Yinchorr/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Galactic Federation of Free Alliances, Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire

Yinchorr.lead: Yinchorr was a planet located in the Expansion Region and was homeworld of the Yinchorri species. It was first charted c. 500 BBY by the Galactic Republic.

Yelsain.title: Yelsain/Legends
Yelsain.lead: Yelsain was a planet in the Minos Cluster.

Yavin.title: Yavin/Legends
Yavin.lead: Yavin was the small orange primary of the Yavin system. It was orbited by two planets and a captured comet.

Yarrv.title: Yarrv
Yarrv.lead: Yarrv was a tropical Core World planet of dense jungles, warm oceans and wide, sandy beaches.

Yerphonia.title: Yerphonia
Yerphonia.lead: Yerphonia was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Yerphonia system of the Core Worlds. It was the site of the prestigious All Science Research Academy.

Yashuvhu.title: Yashuvhu/Legends
Yashuvhu.lead: Yashuvhu was a planet on the near fringes of the Unknown Regions. It was a lush and temperate world that featured mountains and jungles, including the Yashaka Mountains. Sometime during the Old Republic era, Human settlers had landed on the planet but lost contact with the galactic community. The descendants of the settlers, known as the Yashuvhi, also had an established Force tradition which dated to the descendants of a legendary Jedi who crashed on the planet sometime during the years of the Galactic Republic.

Yen-2.title: Yen-2
Yen-2.lead: Yen-2 was an asteroid/planetoid in the Verde system of the Periphery. It was an independently-owned Doonium mining colony. It was serviced by Jatayus Outbound for within-region transport and Xizor Transport Systems for out-of-region transport.

Yeltha.title: Yeltha

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, Alliance of Free Planets, New Republic, Galactic Federation of Free Alliances, Five Worlds, Confederation

Yeltha.lead: Yeltha was a planet in the Both system with a surface of molten searing rock. It had no moons.

Yibikkoror.title: Yibikkoror

facts.affiliation: Yinchorri, Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Galactic Federation of Free Alliances

Yibikkoror.lead: Yibikkoror was a planet of the Yinchorri system. It was a small world with a dense atmosphere and possibly no solid surface. The Yinchorri built at least one balloon city on the planet, and its residents used flutter-packs for transportation. In 33 BBY during the Yinchorri Uprising, it was the site of the Battle of Yibikkoror.

Yetoros.title: Yetoros
Yetoros.lead: Yetoros was the fourth planet in the Utos system. It was a gas giant orbited by eight moons.

Yaronn.title: Yaronn
Yaronn.lead: Yaronn was a Wild Space waterworld whose only significant landmass was a 200–square kilometer–large, forest-covered continent. During the Galactic Civil War, the Claw, a bounty hunter carrying a grudge against a group of smugglers, sent a message inviting them to Yaronn. There, the Claw prepared to hunt on the group, offering to cease hostilities against the smugglers if they evaded capture.

Yhifar.title: Yhifar
Yhifar.lead: Yhifar was a Mid Rim gas giant located in the Juvex sector. It was the site of the Gas Vortex, the eye of an immense, millennia-old storm. The Gas Vortex provided living beings with tolerable atmospheric pressure and breathable air, allowing the construction of settlements in that area. Reckless gas miners dived into the high-pressure depths of Yhifar in armored submersibles tethered to mining platforms in the Gas Vortex.

Yhuli.title: Yhuli (disambiguation)
Yhuli.lead: Yhuli may refer to one of the following:

Yetnis.title: Yetnis
Yetnis.lead: Yetnis was a planet located within the Yetnis system of the Inner Rim Territories.

Yasla.title: Yasla
Yasla.lead: Yasla was one of two planets in the Karlatt system terraformed by the Machinist Theocracy that served as home to ultra-wealthy Morses. It was in the Karlatt system of the Galactic Core.

Yarille.title: Yarille
Yarille.lead: Yarille was a planet located within the Yarille system of the Outer Rim Territories.

Yarkora homeworld.title: Yarkora homeworld
Yarkora homeworld.lead: The mysterious Yarkora homeworld was located in a star system unknown to the rest of the galactic community, within the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. It remained undiscovered by explorers in the time since the first recorded encounter with a Yarkora, in the year 3 BBY. Xenoscientists speculated that they originated in an arid climate, evolving to become the dominant sentient species of their secret homeworld.

Yellowblade's Landing.title: Yellowblade's Landing
Yellowblade's Landing.lead: Yellowblade's Landing was a settlement on the ice world Orto Norwe which was controlled by the criminal gang known as the Scourge. During the Clone Wars the Sith brothers Darth Maul and Savage Opress landed on the world and slaughtered all residents of Yellowblade's Landing to prevent them from revealing their presence to the Jedi Order.

Yarma.title: Yarma
Yarma.lead: Yarma was a planet in the Yarma system within the Tharin sector of the Outer Rim Territories where Reklam Station, an Imperial salvage yard, was located. In 2 BBY, a mission was undertaken by members of Phoenix Cell to steal a squadron of Y-wing starfighters for their fleet.

Ylesia.title: Ylesia/Legends

facts.population: 190 million:, 55% Human, 25% Rodian, Twi'lek, and Nikto, 1.5% t'landa Til, 0.5% Hutt, 18% other
facts.affiliation: Hutt Cartel, Besadii kajidic, Black Sun, Yuuzhan Vong empire, Peace Brigade, Ylesian Republic

Ylesia.lead: Ylesia was a tropical world located in Hutt Space. It was controlled by the Besadii Hutts. The planet was used as a slave colony dedicated to spice production covered up as a religious retreat.

Yugami.title: Yugami
Yugami.lead: Yugami was a planet located within the Yugami system of the Outer Rim Territories. Its people were in a constant state of conflict with the Pursian species of Pursin.

Yn.title: Yn
Yn.lead: Yn was a planet located within the Yn system of the Inner Rim. Around 5300 BBY, the Jedi laid siege to an Imperial stronghold at the battle of Yn. Tulak Hord, Ortan Cela, Khem Val, and Veshikk Urk broke the siege with their army of dark side warriors. Hord and Khem Val fed on the energies of the fallen Force-users using an ancient Sith ritual. Millennia later, Yn was represented in the New Republic Senate by Wwebyls, a tiny humanoid.

Yir Tangee.title: Yir Tangee/Legends
Yir Tangee.lead: Yir Tangee was a planet in the Yir Tangee system of the Colonies. In 22 BBY, Senator Havriso Looruya was appointed to the Galactic Senate's Loyalist Committee—a committee to assist with the crisis of Separatists' attempts to secede from the Galactic Republic—as a representative of Yir Tangee. Looruya was discovered funding Separatist territories after being accused by Senator Onaconda Farr of the planet Rodia, leading to Looruya's stepping down from the committee.

Ylix.title: Ylix
Ylix.lead: Ylix was a backwater Mid Rim planet located in the Ylix system between Anobis and Ithor. It was a long-time rival of nearby Goelitz, which it finally defeated in battle. It was also the home of the mercenary Gallandro.

Yoribuunt.title: Yoribuunt
Yoribuunt.lead: Yoribuunt was a beautiful, swirling gas giant in the Yoribuunt system of the Tharin sector near Hutt Space. It was a popular stop for sight-seers on luxury liners.

Yitheeth.title: Yitheeth

facts.affiliation: Yinchorri, Galactic Republic, Galactic Empire, New Republic, Galactic Federation of Free Alliances

Yitheeth.lead: Yitheeth was an oceanic planet of the Yinchorri system. The Yinchorri built at least one city on its surface. In 33 BBY during the Yinchorri Uprising, it was the site of the Ambush on Yitheeth. Shallow seas covered 93% of its surface.

Yuka Major.title: Yuka Major
Yuka Major.lead: Yuka Major was the second planet in the Kamino system. It shared part of its name with the thirteenth planet of the system, Yuka.

Yoberra.title: Yoberra
Yoberra.lead: Yoberra was a celestial body located in the Yoberra system, a part of the Airam sector of the Outer Rim Territories. The octopedal being Jomo hailed from Yoberra, a fact that was noted in the 13:4:18 issue of the HoloNet News' CoCo District Edition, in an article mentioning Jomo's triumph in the "Mobquet Presents: Fastest Land Beings" racing event.

Yoggoy.title: Yoggoy
Yoggoy.lead: Yoggoy was a planet in the Unknown Regions. It was covered in mounds similar to the Castle Lands, with flowers imported from Alderaan. The Tachyon Flier crashed on Yoggoy in 27 ABY in the location known as the Crash. It was home to the Killiks of the Yoggoy hive and the capital of the Colony.

Yntrann.title: Yntrann
Yntrann.lead: Yntrann was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Yntrann system, a part of Wild Space. During the Galactic Civil War, after the Scandium Team of the Rebel Alliance's Special Forces was disbanded, the Ebranite former member of the team Rith Tar'ak was transferred to Yntrann, where she briefly commanded a small yet highly decorated desert warfare task force as part of one of the early Special Forces wilderness regiments. Since leadership did not appeal to Tar'ak, she eventually requested a transfer to another branch of the Alliance and was stationed off-world.

Yorn Skot.title: Yorn Skot
Yorn Skot.lead: Yorn Skot was a gas giant in the Yorn Skot system near Dargulli. It was a natural source of non-spinsealed tibanna gas.

Ymura.title: Ymura
Ymura.lead: Ymura was one of two planets in the Karlatt system terraformed by the Machinist Theocracy that served as home to ultra-wealthy Morses. It was in the Karlatt system of the Galactic Core.

Ytha'ac Cluster.title: Ytha'ac Cluster/Legends
Ytha'ac Cluster.lead: The Ytha'ac Cluster was a cluster of asteroids located within the Ytha'ac system, in the Airam sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Yisgga.title: Yisgga
Yisgga.lead: Yisgga was a colony planet located within the Yisgga system of the Inner Rim Territories which the Star Morning had visited.

Yitabo.title: Yitabo/Legends
Yitabo.lead: Yitabo was a Mid Rim agriworld located in the Kastolar sector. Settled by Bornecks, Saurin, and Wookiees, it featured several settlements. Early in his career, the bounty hunter Cradossk tracked down and killed the thief Thoxo on Yitabo. The mercenary known as "Gunman" was later captured by Galactic Empire–affiliated slavers who were seizing Wookiees near Yitabo at some point by 8 ABY.

Yuka.title: Yuka
Yuka.lead: Yuka was the thirteenth and outermost planet in the Kamino system. It partly shared its name with the second planet of the system, Yuka Major.

Yukka.title: Yukka
Yukka.lead: Yukka was a planet under the control of the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. The Atomic Punk night club was located on the planet.

Yorgraxx.title: Yorgraxx
Yorgraxx.lead: Yorgraxx was a planet located in the Prefsbelt sector of the Outer Rim.

Yout.title: Yout system
Yout.lead: The Yout system was a star system in the Qiilura sector of the Mid Rim Territories that contained the twelfth moon of Yout During the Clone Wars, the IG-86 sentinel droid KRONOS-327 undertook a failed mission in the Yout system.

Zaddja.title: Zaddja/Legends
Zaddja.lead: Zaddja was a barren planet located in the Zaddja system of the Trilon sector, beyond the most inhabited regions of the galaxy. It was orbited by a small asteroid shroud.

Yvara.title: Yvara

facts.sector: Kathol sector, Kathol Rift, Blue Swirl
facts.terrain: Desert plains, Red mountain ranges, White ice-caps, Yellow-green fungal plains

Yvara.lead: Yvara was the homeworld of the Yvarema species. It was located just inside the Kathol Rift. The planet had a varied topography, with ice and snow capped poles, vast desert plains, and fungal-covered fields. Three oceans covered the planet, and each of the continents were ringed by mountain ranges to create a natural barrier. The planet's indigenous species, the Yvarema, lived in underground warrens just north of the planet's equator.

Yulant.title: Yulant
Yulant.lead: Yulant was an agricultural planet in the Core Worlds owned by the Salliche Agricultural Corporation who sued Dasobo Meats, a meat shipping company based on the planet. It was one of the worlds on the Ag Circuit. Approximately six months after the Battle of Endor, workers here revolted against increased Imperial control.

Zaadja.title: Zaadja/Legends
Zaadja.lead: Zaadja was an icy planet with snowy plains surrounded by impervious mountains.

Zaloriis.title: Zaloriis/Legends

facts.affiliation: Galactic Empire, Zalorian Separatists, Alliance to Restore the Republic

Zaloriis.lead: Zaloriis was an Expansion Region planet colonized by Humans from Fondor. By 0 ABY it was home to Camp Culroon, a hidden Galactic Empire research base. That year, the planet attempted to join the Rebel Alliance, but Darth Vader led a strike force to recapture the planet.

Z'fell.title: Z'fell
Z'fell.lead: Z'fell was a planet in the Z'fell system of the Koornacht Cluster. It was one of the original 13 planets of the Duskhan League. The planet was attacked by the New Republic during the Battle of N'zoth.

Zaraksander.title: Zaraksander
Zaraksander.lead: Zaraksander was an astronomical object in the Expansion Region's Imberlin sector. It was the site of the Fioer desert, and an Eloinie Petro-Munitions munitions factory was located on the celestial body's southern continent.

Zalso.title: Zalso
Zalso.lead: Zalso was a planet located in the Core Worlds' Zalso system. The Human Kiras Torla, who graduated from the offworld Galactic Outdoor Survival School around 12 BBY and was middle-aged around 2 ABY, was native to Zalso. It was also the homeworld of Ral Shawgrim, a Human who was born at some point no earlier than 16 BBY aboard a luxury liner in the Outer Rim Territories' Tion Hegemony.

Zarsteck.title: Zarsteck
Zarsteck.lead: Zarsteck was a planet located within the Zarsteck system of the Core Worlds.

Yurb.title: Yurb
Yurb.lead: Yurb was an arid planet located within the Yurb system of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of the razor-tailed tiger of the Dust Pits.

Yutusk.title: Yutusk
Yutusk.lead: Yutusk was a temperate backwater planet in the Yutusk system subjugated by the Galactic Empire. It was the homeworld of chef Vimran Trell, whom was conscripted in the Imperial Navy. His parents Tranira Trell and Francill Trell were killed when Imperial forces rounded up and executed suspected Rebel sympathizers on Yutusk.

Yuvern.title: Yuvern/Legends
Yuvern.lead: Yuvern was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Oplovis sector. It was the homeworld of the two-headed, snakelike Yuvernians. One young Yuvernian, Cane Adiss, dreamed of leaving his homeworld and becoming an explorer, and he was eventually taken offworld by the trader Kal'Falnl C'ndros. By 2 ABY, the Yuvernian had become a spice smuggler for the crime lord Jabba the Hutt, whose first assignment took Adiss back to Yuvern. Arriving in-system, the Yuvernian encountered the Imperial Oplovis Sector Fleet.

Yuuzhan'tar.title: Yuuzhan'tar
Yuuzhan'tar.lead: Yuuzhan'tar was an extra-galactic, living, sentient planet in a distant galaxy, far from the main galaxy. It was the homeworld of the Yuuzhan Vong species, and had a large asteroid belt ring around its equator. The Yuuzhan Vong themselves also referred to the planet simply as "the homeworld". It was destroyed in a devastating ancient conflict that forced the Yuuzhan Yong to leave their native galaxy.

Zabba II.title: Zabba II
Zabba II.lead: Zabba II was a planet located within the Zabba system of the Outer Rim Territories and, said to house the Cursed Palace.

Zarracina III.title: Zarracina III
Zarracina III.lead: Zarracina III was a planet located in the Expansion Region's Zarracina sector. It was the homeworld of the Zarracine species. When a stable hyperspace jump point was discovered in the Zarracina system in 11,660 BBY, the Pius Dea–controlled Galactic Republic attempted to acquire Zarracina III.

ZXK-100346.6a.title: ZXK-100346.6a
ZXK-100346.6a.lead: ZXK-100346.6a was a planet located in the ZXK-100346 system, in the Outer Rim. It was the sixth planet in the star system and had a very cold climate that resulted in it being covered in ice. Due to its remote location, ancient Jedi Masters traveled to the planet to hide the Soulsaber, a dark-side device. They constructed the Cavern of Light and placed the artifact there. During the Galactic Civil War, the Dark Jedi Thaum Rystra traveled to the planet in order to steal the Soulsaber. A group of Rebel Alliance fighters battled him there, but he was able to flee with it.

Zalori.title: Zalori system/Legends
Zalori.lead: The Zalori system was located in the Hapan Rim Worlds, an area of the Hapes Cluster in the Slice portion of the Inner Rim. It was connected by the hyperlane known as the Great Rim Route to the Rynmar and Terephon systems.

Zadaria.title: Zadaria system/Legends
Zadaria.lead: The Zadaria system was located in the Gateworlds, an area of the Hapes Cluster in the Slice portion of the Inner Rim. It was connected via hyperlanes to the Febrini and Phelope systems. The Zadaria system was the origin point of the beverage known as Zadarian brandy.

Zaria.title: Zaria
Zaria.lead: Zaria was a terrestrial world located in the Zaria system of the Juvex sector, a part of the Senex-Juvex region in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim. The Senex-Juvex Loop hyperlane linked it to the Anstares and Malador systems.

Zakuul.title: Zakuul

facts.terrain: Swamps and bogs, Forests, Fields, Urban
facts.affiliation: Eternal Empire, Eternal Alliance, Elected Zakuulan government

Zakuul.lead: Zakuul was a planet located in Wild Space that had a unique connection to the Force being balanced between the light and dark sides of the Force. Zakuul served as the capital planet of the Eternal Empire.

Zeltros.title: Zeltros/Legends

facts.routes: Trellen Trade Route, Lesser Lantillian Route, Great Kashyyyk Branch
facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic, Alliance of Free Planets, New Republic

Zeltros.lead: Zeltros was a planet in the Inner Rim, and the homeworld of the Zeltron race. An opulent world, hedonism was the doctrine encouraged by the empathetic Zeltrons, and Zeltros was continuously in a state of never ending revelry. The Zeltron appreciation of beauty in its many forms led to luxurious art and architecture covering the world, and the galaxy's most wealthy favored Zeltros as a vacation destination.

Zauhu.title: Zauhu
Zauhu.lead: Zauhu was a planet in the Zug system. It was the first planet beyond the asteroid belt and one of the four gas giants in the system, along with Urazuun, Faargau, and Laazrau. Zauhu had the largest number of natural satellites in the star system – forty-seven.

Zeffliffl.title: Zeffliffl
Zeffliffl.lead: Zeffliffl was a planet in the Atrivis sector of the Outer Rim Territories, located on the Relgim Run. It was home to the Zeffliffl species, which evolved in salt water seas in the planet's southern hemisphere. The Zeffliffl had established contact with the wider galaxy prior to 14 ABY.

Zekulae.title: Zekulae

facts.terrain: Rich mineral soil with blue crystals

Zekulae.lead: Zekulae was a planet located at the heart of the Zeemacht Cluster within the Zekulae system of the Inner Rim. It was a barren world, noted for its dark, rich mineral soil, which was studded with blue crystals. Its soil was extremely fine and so was everpresent on the planet. Its inhabitants were known as the Zeku. It sat outside the globular cluster known as Cosm's Well.

Zenobah.title: Zenobah
Zenobah.lead: Zenobah was the second planet in the Demophon system. It had a hot climate and was covered in plains. It had two moons, and was destroyed when its sun went supernova.

Zelmaadine.title: Zelmaadine
Zelmaadine.lead: Zelmaadine was a moonless volcanic planet that occupied the first orbital position around the star Velm. It was located in the Velm system, a part of the Halori sector in the Trans-Hydian portion of the Mid Rim.

Zeloc.title: Zeloc
Zeloc.lead: Zeloc was a planet in the fifth orbit around the star Velm. It was the second of two gas giants in the Velm system, located in the Halori sector in the Trans-Hydian portion of the Mid Rim. Zeloc was orbited by eleven moons, and it was also encircled by a ring system.

Zeloa.title: Zeloa
Zeloa.lead: Zeloa was a planet located in the Zel system, in the Inner Rim.

Zellone.title: Zellone
Zellone.lead: Zellone was a gas giant in the Zel system.

Zchtek worlds.title: Zchtek worlds
Zchtek worlds.lead: The Zchtek worlds of the Mid Rim were home to the Jin. Subjugated by the Galactic Empire, they were the site of a genocide perpetrated by that regime.

Zebitrope IV.title: Zebitrope IV
Zebitrope IV.lead: Zebitrope IV was a terrestrial planet located in the Zebitrope system, a part of the Centrality sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It occupied the fourth orbital position in its star system, which was connected to the Cadma system via the Cadma Conduit hyperlane.

Zebitrope VIII.title: Zebitrope VIII
Zebitrope VIII.lead: Zebitrope VIII was a terrestrial planet located in the Zebitrope system, a part of the Centrality sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It occupied the eight orbital position in its star system, which was connected to the Cadma system via the Cadma Conduit hyperlane.

Zeenada.title: Zeenada

facts.affiliation: Confederacy of Independent Systems, Galactic Republic

Zeenada.lead: Zeenada was a marshy planet primarily covered in jungles.

Zelaba.title: Zelaba
Zelaba.lead: Zelaba was a planet in the Outer Jalor sector of the Mid Rim.

Zender.title: Zender
Zender.lead: Zender was a Human male captain who served the resurgent Sith Empire during the Galactic War.

Zeitooine.title: Zeitooine
Zeitooine.lead: Zeitooine was a jungle planet located in the Inner Rim's Zeitooine system that was ruled by a monarchy. At some point by the time of the High Republic Era, several Jedi fell during the Zeitooine Schism. In 232 BBY, it was the site of a mission carried out by members of the Jedi Order, including Jedi Knight Dez Rydan. The mission helped manage some of the unrest the planet was experiencing, but the effect of the Jedi presence stalled over time. In 228 BBY, a group of Nihil visited a tavern on Zeitooine after their failed raid on the planet Baori Minor.

Zastiga.title: Zastiga
Zastiga.lead: Zastiga was a planet in the Zastiga system in the Kallea sector on the edge of the Outer Rim Territories, frequented by traders. It was the location of a secret Rebel Alliance meeting where Chancellor Mon Mothma and Admiral Gial Ackbar revealed to senior Rebel leaders that the Galactic Empire was constructing a second Death Star.

Zaur.title: Zaur
Zaur.lead: Zaur were a species of lizard native to the planet Bogano. They had a low stance and an adhesive grip, allowing them to travel quickly across many types of surface, including cavern walls. They thrived in rocky and windy habitats, and their sensitivity to climate meant that they functioned better in colder temperatures than warmer ones.

Zhar.title: Zhar/Legends
Zhar.lead: Zhar was a gas giant located in the Zhar system of the Cadavine sector. Of its dozen moons, two were terrestrial. One of them, Gall, was the site of an Imperial enclave. Rogue Squadron set up a temporary base on the other, Kile, from which they launched an attempt to capture Boba Fett and rescue Han Solo, then trapped in carbonite.

Ziost.title: Ziost/Legends

facts.terrain: Rocky, Frozen mountains, Glaciers, Tundra, Forests, Polar ice caps
facts.affiliation: Adas's Sith Empire, Old Sith Empire, Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders, Darth Revan's Sith Empire, Vitiate's Sith Empire, New Sith, Order of the Sith Lords …

Ziost.lead: Ziost (pronounced /ziɒst/), referred to as the "Gateway to the Empire" during the Galactic War, was a rocky world—and potent focal point of the dark side of the Force—located in the Ziost system, a star system in the Sith Worlds region of the Outer Rim Territories' Esstran sector. It was connected to other nearby worlds by the Nache Bhelfia hyperlane. Ziost was also the one of the primary adopted homeworlds of the Sith species, considered one of the five sacred Sith planets, and served as the capital of Adas's Sith Empire and the Old Sith Empire.

Zeta 0-9.title: Zeta Zero Nine

facts.terrain: Pitching ice seas, Treacherous rocky islands

Zeta 0-9.lead: Zeta Zero Nine was a planet located in the Wastes of Wild Space in the galaxy.

Zirulast.title: Zirulast
Zirulast.lead: Zirulast was a terrestrial backwater planet located in the Zirulast system, a part of the Belasco sector in the Slice portion of the Expansion Region. Orbiting the white dwarf star of the same name, Zirulast was situated on the Ootmian Pabol hyperlane, which connected it to the Belasco system as well as the New Apsolon system in the Mid Rim. Zirulast was a dry and dusty world encircled by rings of ice particles. The Temolaks, sentient humanoids speaking the Temolish language, were native to the planet, evolving redundant internal organs in order to survive the rigors of their homeworld.

Zerm.title: Zerm/Legends
Zerm.lead: Zerm was a planet located in the Kessel sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Zhina.title: Zhina
Zhina.lead: Zhina was one of the original 13 planets of the Duskhan League. It was orbited by the Imperial shipyard Black Eleven.

Zirku.title: Zirku
Zirku.lead: Zirku was a Mid Rim world in the Riflorii system.

Zham Hlar.title: Zham Hlar

facts.region: Expansion Region, The Slice, Trailing Sectors

Zham Hlar.lead: Zham Hlar was the third planet of the Thaereian system of the Expansion Region. The space station Burnout was located in orbit of the planet.

Zilior.title: Zilior
Zilior.lead: Zilior was a planet located within the Uziel system of the Outer Rim Territories.

Zhanox.title: Zhanox/Legends

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Western Reaches, Greater Javin
facts.sector: Javin sector (prior to c. 400 BBY), Anoat sector (c. 400 BBY—)

Zhanox.lead: Zhanox was an Outer Rim Territories mining world located in the Anoat sector. Its surface was covered by stony spires, between which were rubble-strewn valleys. The mines of Zhanox were overseen by Ugnaughts, while Human colonists inhabited the world's valleys. The Bespin Wing Guard member Alec Mard hailed from Zhanox.

Zhann.title: Zhann
Zhann.lead: Zhann was a planet located within the Zhann system of the Colonies and known for its puppet shows.

Zephry Asteroid field.title: Zephry Asteroid field

facts.region: Outer Rim Territories, Greater Javin, Western Reaches

Zephry Asteroid field.lead: The Zephry Asteroid field was a location in the Zephry system where Ace Azzameen on the Otana rendezvoused with Aeron in order to deliver to her a captured Imperial Viper probe droid from the Saila Na system.

Zlarbv IV.title: Zlarbv IV
Zlarbv IV.lead: Zlarbv IV was a planet in the Zlarbv system and the home to a green, tentacled alien. Kelko once encountered this alien on this planet.

Zigoola.title: Zigoola
Zigoola.lead: Zigoola was a planet and a potent dark side vergence in The Force located in Wild Space, near the Calamari sector. A Sith Temple was located on the barren world, and was used by the Order of the Sith Lords for hoarding Sith artifacts. The planet did not appear in the Jedi Archives and its location was kept secret by the Sith.

Zircon.title: Zircon
Zircon.lead: Zircon was a planet located within the Zircon system of the Outer Rim Territories.

Zisia.title: Zisia
Zisia.lead: Zisia was a rich planet that was located within the Zisia system in Hutt Space, a region of the galaxy controlled by the Hutt species. The planet lay on the hyperlane called the Dead Road, which connected it to the worlds of Elgit and Ulmatra. Zisia was the homeworld of the sentient Zisian species, members of which served as pliant slaves for millennia.

Ziugen.title: Ziugen
Ziugen.lead: Ziugen was a slave colony world that was located within the Ziugen system in Hutt Space, a region of the galaxy controlled by the Hutt species. The planet lay on the hyperlane called the Shag Pabol that connected it to the world of Ylesia and the Outland Transit Station. A smaller hyperspace route also linked Ziugen to the planet of Poytta. The inhabitants of Ziugen were equally devoted to industry and agriculture.

Zin Taal.title: Zin Taal
Zin Taal.lead: Zin Taal was an Outer Rim Territories world located in the Carrion sector. By 11 ABY, the mercenary First Sun Mobile Regiment established a command base there. The New Republic, intending to capture the base, dispatched a New Republic Special Forces strike force that was dropped onto the world. The team's mission on Zin Taal was eventually complicated by an unforeseen circumstance.

Ziux.title: Ziux
Ziux.lead: Ziux was the fourth planet orbiting the binary stars Toydar and Little Toydar in the Toydaria system. Located in Hutt Space of the galaxy, it was a gas giant.

Zhadalene.title: Zhadalene
Zhadalene.lead: Zhadalene was a world located in the Kanz sector's Zhadalene system within an intersecting portion of the Outer Rim Territories and the New Territories. Situated within grid square N-4 of the Standard Galactic Grid, it lay along the Veragi Trade Route hyperlane between the Argazda system and the Sh'ung-tesk system. By 5 ABY, during the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the New Republic, Zhadalene contributed to the Imperial Military.

Zonama Sekot.title: Zonama Sekot/Legends

facts.region: Varied:, Unknown Regions, 29 ABY: Core Worlds (briefly), 29 BBY: Tingel Arm, Outer Rim Territories,, Yuuzhan Vong galaxy (believed but unproved)
facts.sector: Varied:, 29 ABY: Coruscant sector (briefly), 28 ABY: Chiss Space, 29 BBY: Gardaji sector
facts.system: Varied:, 29 ABY: Coruscant system (briefly), 28 ABY: Klasse Ephemora system, 29 BBY: A trinary system, Gardaji Rift
facts.terrain: Rainforests, Mountains, Rivers, Small polar ice caps, Small oceans, Tampasi
facts.population: 137 ABY:, 44% Ferroan, 32% Yuuzhan Vong, 20% Langhesi, 4% other species, 29 ABY: 2 million, 80% Yuuzhan Vong, 8% Ferroan, 3% Langhesi, 9% other species

Zonama Sekot.lead: Zonama Sekot (Ferroan for "World of Body and Mind") and labelled by Chiss surveys as M-Eighteen, was a living rogue planet in the Unknown Regions. Zonama was the planet itself, while Sekot was the living organism. It became the adopted homeworld of the extra-galactic Yuuzhan Vong after the end of their war of conquest of the galaxy.

Zor Vlahu.title: Zor Vlahu

facts.affiliation: Jedi Order, Army of Light, Galactic Republic

Zor Vlahu.lead: Zor Vlahu was a Jedi who fought in the Ruusan campaign during the New Sith Wars. He had a sister named Myl Vlahu, and the two died in an assault on the Sith in 1000 BBY. Vlahu's lightsaber was claimed by the Sith and used by a Sith minion, attempting to impersonate a Dark Lord, in a later battle. The planet of Zor Vlahu in the Ruusan system bore his name.

Zygerria.title: Zygerria/Legends

facts.affiliation: Infinite Empire, Zygerrian Slave Empire, Zygerrian Slavers Guild, Confederacy of Independent Systems

Zygerria.lead: Zygerria was the homeworld of the near-Human Zygerrian species.

Zorbia II.title: Zorbia II

facts.sector: Zuma sector, Inner Zuma Region, Moddell sector

Zorbia II.lead: Zorbia II was a terrestrial planet located in the Outer Rim Territories' Moddell sector. Its terrain consisted of deserts, forests, and plains. The world was home to a group of Humans known as the Zorbian space pirates, whose roots seemed to be Corellian. The Zorbians were a significant nuisance in the Outer Moddell systems due to their tendency to attack others in the sector.

Zonju V.title: Zonju V
Zonju V.lead: Zonju V was a planet in the Wild Space, rimward of Rutan. Its terrain consisted of shallow, dusty, scrubby, sparsely-foliated canyons and gorges; littered with deserted ruins carved from sandstone rock. The capital city was Zoronhed.

Zuliria.title: Zuliria
Zuliria.lead: Zuliria was a Mid Rim celestial body located in the Eucer sector. It featured several cities and was home to the flying creature known as the Ruori, which most Zulirian urban residents used for transportation. Zuliria hosted the Zuliria Museum of Antiquities, at which the Arcona Ther-das at one point worked as an acquisitions director.

Zossi Belt.title: Zossi Belt
Zossi Belt.lead: The Zossi Belt was an asteroid belt located in the Faarlsun system, a part of the Parthovian Cluster in Wild Space. It occupied the second orbit around its star, the yellow-white Faarlsun.

Zorbia I.title: Zorbia system/Legends

facts.sector: Zuma sector, Inner Zuma Region, Moddell sector

Zorbia I.lead: The Zorbia system was among the Outer Moddell systems in the Moddell sector, one of the subsectors making up the Inner Zuma Region within the Outer Rim Territories' Zuma sector. The system was located on the edge of the Monsua Nebula and lay on the hyperlane known as the Ovise Reach, connecting it to the Endor and Trindello systems. The Zorbia system contained three planets, including Zorbia II at its second orbital position. Zorbia II's local days lasted twenty-eight hours, and the planet had a 360-day-long local year.

Zorbia III.title: Zorbia system/Legends

facts.sector: Zuma sector, Inner Zuma Region, Moddell sector

Zorbia III.lead: The Zorbia system was among the Outer Moddell systems in the Moddell sector, one of the subsectors making up the Inner Zuma Region within the Outer Rim Territories' Zuma sector. The system was located on the edge of the Monsua Nebula and lay on the hyperlane known as the Ovise Reach, connecting it to the Endor and Trindello systems. The Zorbia system contained three planets, including Zorbia II at its second orbital position. Zorbia II's local days lasted twenty-eight hours, and the planet had a 360-day-long local year.

Zoraster.title: Zoraster
Zoraster.lead: Zoraster was a planet located within the Zoraster system. It was situated in the Zoraster sector, a part of the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of the Human Condi. At some point by 28 BBY, the slaver Krayn captured Condi, taking him off-world and forcing him to work aboard his starship among other slaves.

Zoma V.title: Zoma V
Zoma V.lead: Zoma V was a jungle planet in the Zoma system, probably near Tatooine. It was inhabited by the primitive Felinians, to whom Imperial weapons were smuggled by Sithless Leethe.

Zorb.title: Zorb
Zorb.lead: Zorb was a planet located in the Zorb system of the Outer Rim Territories.

Zuborte Ma.title: Zuborte Ma
Zuborte Ma.lead: The Zuborte Ma asteroid field was located between the planets of Mygeeto and Itzeho, in the Mygeeto system of the Albarrio sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was considered an easy asteroid field to navigate since the InterGalactic Banking Clan took control of the system. During the Galactic Civil War, a part of the Battle of Mygeeto took place in the asteroid field.

Zongorlu.title: Zongorlu

facts.affiliation: Galactic Republic (claimed in propaganda), Imperial Remnant

Zongorlu.lead: Zongorlu was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Noonian sector. It was home to the sentient, plant-like Zongorlu species. In 3963 BBY, during the Mandalorian Wars, a Galactic Republic transmission station was located on Zongorlu, from which propaganda broadcasts were made by an actor performing the persona of Republic "Captain Goodvalor."

Zuggit.title: Zuggit
Zuggit.lead: Zuggit was a planet located within the Zuggit system of the Inner Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of a twelve-foot tall, twin-headed, and magenta-skinned alien.

Zyluria.title: Zyluria
Zyluria.lead: Zyluria was a world located in the Zyluria system of the Juvex sector, a part of the Senex-Juvex region in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim. A hyperlane linked it to the Carsanza system. Zyluria's surface featured gentle plains, and it was the homeworld of the Zylurians, a sentient species that, by 43 ABY, had long served the aristocratic Ancient Houses of the Senex-Juvex.

Zoge Ver.title: Zoge Ver
Zoge Ver.lead: Zoge Ver was the second planet orbiting the star Rek in the Guter Wade system. Located in the Trilon sector of the Outer Rim, it was a sulfuric rock.

Zosha.title: Zosha
Zosha.lead: Zosha was an uninhabited planet that orbited a bluish star in the Unknown Regions' Zosha system. A white-colored celestial body loomed large in Zosha's sky, and the planet itself appeared gray, blue, and white from space.

Zyzar.title: Zyzar
Zyzar.lead: Zyzar was a mountainous planet within the reaches of the galaxy. During the Age of the Empire, it hosted the headquarters of the Varluk Organization. Sand rains would sometimes occur on Zyzar.

Zoh.title: Zoh
Zoh.lead: Zoh was a isolated junk planet located in the Sarka sector of the Mid Rim Territories where Jek-14 took refuge. R0-GR visited the world and recorded his time there in his autobiography From Trenches to Wrenches: The Roger Story.
